articles.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Reliability Based Bi-Objective Portfolio Optimization
articles.title_zh: 用于基于可靠性的双目标投资组合优化的深度强化学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06610v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Portfolio optimization under uncertainty is inherently a multi-objective decision problem involving complex interactions among return, risk, market dynamics, and practical investment constraints. Existing reliability based portfolio optimization approaches primarily rely on static optimization frameworks and often fail to capture sequential decision making, tail risk, and market frictions such as transaction costs. To address these limitations, we propose a deep reinforcement learning framework for multi-objective reliability based portfolio optimization (MORP-DRL). The proposed framework jointly optimizes expected return and downside risk using three complementary risk measures: variance, Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR), and Entropic Value-at-Risk (EVaR). To model uncertainty and heavy-tailed market behavior, asset returns are represented using GARCH(1,1), Extreme Value Theory, and a t-copula dependence structure, while realistic scenarios are generated through quasi-Monte Carlo simulation. A Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) based strategy is developed under practical constraints including transaction costs and portfolio bounds, and is benchmarked against NSGA-II. Experiments on ten global equity indices across pre-COVID, COVID, and post-COVID market regimes demonstrate that MORP-DRL achieves competitive risk-return performance, reduced downside risk during periods of market stress, and scalability to high-dimensional portfolio settings.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种用于多目标、基于可靠性的投资组合优化的深度强化学习框架 MORP-DRL，以应对不确定市场中收益、风险、动态变化和实际约束交织的问题。框架联合优化期望收益与下行风险，并结合方差、条件在险价值（CVaR）和熵在险价值（EVaR）三类风险度量。为刻画不确定性和重尾市场行为，作者使用 GARCH(1,1)、极值理论和 t-copula 依赖结构建模资产收益，并通过准蒙特卡洛生成现实场景；在交易成本和投资组合边界等约束下，构建了基于近端策略优化（PPO）的投资策略。
authors: Sounaq Das, Tanmay Sen, Raghu Nandan Sengupta, Aditya Gupta

articles.title: When Certificates Fail: A Unified Safety Framework for Embedded Neural Interface Models
articles.title_zh: 当证书失效时：面向嵌入式神经接口模型的统一安全框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06630v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Formal robustness certificates for embedded neural-interface models can pass while task accuracy collapses: at perturbation budget e=0.25, EEGNet classification accuracy drops by 25.7% under projected-gradient attack while the Lipschitz-style certificate remains valid for all 9 tested subjects. We argue that this gap between mathematical certification and operational safety is one instance of a broader alignment failure in neural interfaces, where training objectives diverge from user welfare. We propose a unified empirical audit framework organized around three such failures: verification insufficiency, in which certificates pass while task behavior degrades; proxy-fidelity divergence, in which task-optimized representations damage neural signal structure (a time-domain auxiliary objective reduces reconstruction MSE by 0.1132 while worsening spectral log-MSE); and latent information exfiltration, in which public-task embeddings retain private attributes (subject identity recoverable at 48.1% versus 6.7% chance). We instantiate the framework on BCI Competition IV 2a and SEED-IV using multiple deep and classical EEG decoders, official session-level validation, null controls, and paired statistical tests. The verification gap persists across EEGNet, CSP+LDA, and FBCSP+LDA, and is therefore architecture-independent. Our results establish that operational safety auditing, not certificate verification alone, is necessary for responsible neural-interface deployment.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文指出，嵌入式神经接口模型的形式鲁棒性证书可能在数学上仍然有效，但实际任务精度却显著下降，例如 EEGNet 在投影梯度攻击下分类准确率下降，而 Lipschitz 风格证书仍对测试对象成立。作者将这种认证与运行安全之间的差距视为神经接口中的广义对齐失败，即训练目标与用户福祉偏离。文章提出一个统一的经验审计框架，涵盖验证不足、代理保真度偏离和潜在信息外泄三类失败，并在 BCI Competition IV 2a 与 SEED-IV 数据集上用多种深度和传统 EEG 解码器进行实例化评估。

articles.title: Physics-guided spatiotemporal neural models for fuel density prediction
articles.title_zh: 用于燃料密度预测的物理引导时空神经模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06999v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents a physics-guided machine learning (PGML) framework for fuel density prediction, integrating physics constraints and domain knowledge into deep learning models to enhance model accuracy and stability. We explore three deep learning architectures -- ConvLSTM, Adaptive Fourier Neural Operator (AFNONet), and Video Vision Transformer (ViViT) -- to model the spatiotemporal evolution of fuel density. Our approach incorporates differentiable physics-informed terms in the loss function, including a mass-conserving fuel transport term and a rate-of-spread estimation. Experimental results, averaged across multiple independent trials, demonstrate that the proposed PGML framework outperforms purely data-driven baselines without physics constraints in both accuracy and stability. This framework enables computationally efficient, physically plausible fire forecasting to support adaptive prescribed burn management.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种用于燃料密度预测的物理引导机器学习框架，将物理约束和领域知识纳入深度学习模型，以提升预测精度与稳定性。作者比较了 ConvLSTM、自适应傅里叶神经算子（AFNONet）和视频视觉 Transformer（ViViT）三种架构，用于建模燃料密度的时空演化。框架在损失函数中加入可微的物理信息项，包括质量守恒的燃料输运项和蔓延速率估计；多次独立实验表明，相比纯数据驱动基线，该方法在精度和稳定性上表现更好，可支持计算高效且物理合理的火灾预测与适应性计划烧除管理。
authors: Tolga Caglar, Jaynil Jaiswal, Saqib Azim, Yudhir Gala, Mai H. Nguyen, Ilkay Altintas

articles.title: Latent graph encoding of multimodal neuroimaging features with generative AI architectures
articles.title_zh: 基于生成式 AI 架构的多模态神经影像特征潜在图编码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07027v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While generative models enable encoding of complex neuroimaging data for feature generation and reconstruction, developing optimal architectural frameworks with appropriate encoding and latent space processes is crucial for studying structural and functional properties of the brain. We design a multimodal generative framework for structural and functional magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) features through systematic evaluation of encoding strategies, latent multimodal fusion, and generative model selection. Using structural gray matter volume (GMV) and static functional network connectivity (sFNC) features from a large neuroimaging dataset, we analyze generative frameworks involving variational autoencoders (VAEs), transformers, generative adversarial networks (GANs), and diffusion models. Architectures that employ modality-aware graph encoding of functional connectivity into a lower-dimensional latent space outperform vectorized encoders or direct data space approaches. The proposed multimodal graph VAE (gMMVAE) surpasses alternative generative variants across multiple metrics for generation fidelity, reconstruction quality, efficiency, and latent space discriminability, highlighting its potential for robust multimodal neuroimaging analysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究如何为复杂神经影像数据构建合适的生成式编码与潜在空间框架，以支持特征生成、重建以及脑结构和功能性质分析。作者基于大规模神经影像数据中的结构灰质体积（GMV）和静态功能网络连接（sFNC）特征，系统比较了变分自编码器、Transformer、生成对抗网络和扩散模型等架构，以及不同的编码、融合和生成策略。结果表明，将功能连接以模态感知图编码方式映射到低维潜在空间优于向量化编码或直接数据空间方法；提出的多模态图 VAE（gMMVAE）在生成保真度、重建质量和效率等多项指标上优于其他生成变体。
authors: Ishaan Batta, Meenu Ajith, Vince Calhoun

articles.title: Gauge-Invariant Learnable Spectral Positional Encodings for Directed Graphs via Hermitian Block Krylov Subspaces
articles.title_zh: 通过厄米块 Krylov 子空间实现有向图的规范不变可学习谱位置编码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07032v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spectral positional encodings (PEs) for emphdirected graphs face two obstacles: magnetic Laplacians require an O(n³⁾ Hermitian eigendecomposition per potential, and their complex eigenvectors are defined only up to unitary gauge, which prior work handles with basis-invariant architectures. We propose learnable spectral PEs of the form h_θ(A_q),R, where A_q is a normalized magnetic operator, h_θ a learnable scalar spectral response, and R a block of random probes. Because the PE is a emphmatrix function of the operator, it is gauge-invariant by construction. We compute it in a Hermitian block Krylov subspace from sparse matrix--vector products only, prove that k = O(łog(1/ǎrepsilon)) block steps suffice uniformly over heat--resolvent response families, and give a covering-number argument for why low-dimensional structured families generalize where free per-eigenvalue weights overfit. On a directed SBM whose symmetrization is uninformative by construction, direction-blind PEs stay at chance while magnetic Krylov PEs converge to the exact-eigendecomposition oracle as the depth grows. The same probes yield gauge-invariant pairwise features with 1/sqrts Monte-Carlo error, and the undirected q=0 case improves heterophilous benchmarks over no-PE and polynomial baselines.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对有向图谱位置编码面临的两大问题展开：磁拉普拉斯算子通常需要高代价的厄米特征分解，且复特征向量存在酉规范不唯一性。作者提出形式为 h_θ(A_q)R 的可学习谱位置编码，其中 A_q 为归一化磁算子，h_θ 为可学习标量谱响应，R 为随机探针块；由于编码是算子的矩阵函数，因而天然具有规范不变性。方法仅依赖稀疏矩阵-向量乘法在厄米块 Krylov 子空间中计算，并证明对热核和 resolvent 响应族只需对数级块步数即可达到给定精度；在有向随机块模型实验中，磁 Krylov 位置编码随深度增加可逼近精确特征分解基准，而忽略方向的位置编码表现接近随机猜测。

articles.title: An Hybrid Quantum-Classical Diffusion Model for Image Generation
articles.title_zh: 用于图像生成的混合量子-经典扩散模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07072v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum diffusion models provide a physics-consistent route to generative learning by formulating noising and denoising directly on quantum states. However, applying such models to classical high-dimensional data is constrained by the qubit cost of state encoding and the computational burden of simulating large density operators. We propose a scalable hybrid generative pipeline that combines a classical autoencoder for dimensionality reduction with a mixed-state quantum denoising diffusion probabilistic model (MSQuDDPM) operating in the learned latent space. The autoencoder compresses data into compact latent codes that can be embedded into a small-qubit Hilbert space, after which the quantum diffusion model learns a generative distribution over latent density operators and decodes samples back to the original domain. Algorithmically, we simplify the reverse dynamics by predicting an estimate of the clean state h̊o₀ at timestep t and computing the one-step reverse update via an analytic backward propagation rule, rather than learning an explicit predictor for h̊oₜ₋₁. We demonstrate the proposed approach on MNIST image generation and discuss how mixed-state quantum diffusion can serve as a practical backbone for hybrid quantum--classical generative modeling under realistic qubit budgets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种可扩展的混合生成流程，将经典自编码器用于降维，并在学习到的潜在空间中运行混合态量子去噪扩散概率模型。方法通过将潜在编码嵌入小量子比特希尔伯特空间，缓解高维经典数据量子态编码与密度算符模拟的成本问题。作者还通过预测时间步上的干净态估计并采用解析反向传播规则来简化反向动力学，并在 MNIST 图像生成任务上进行验证。
authors: Qipeng Qian, Keli Deng, Yuntao Qian

articles.title: Mechanistic Interpretability for Neural Networks: Circuits, Sparse Features and Symbolic Reasoning
articles.title_zh: 神经网络的机制可解释性：电路、稀疏特征与符号推理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07316v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This article offers a comprehensive overview of mechanistic interpretability, an emerging field that seeks to reverse-engineer the internal algorithms of modern neural networks. While traditional explainable AI methods often stop at surface-level input-output correlations, this approach directly addresses the opaque "black box" nature of machine learning models, which is essential for ensuring safety and auditability in high-stakes deployments. The paper provides a detailed examination of Transformer circuit analysis, exploring how internal components like the residual stream, attention mechanisms, and induction heads drive complex tasks and in-context learning. It subsequently tackles the core challenge of superposition and polysemanticity, demonstrating how tools like Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) and transcoders can decompose tangled network activations into distinct, human-interpretable features. Furthermore, the paper explores methods for actively controlling and modifying model behavior through steering vectors and causal interventions. Finally, it connects these mechanistic insights with neurosymbolic AI frameworks designed to translate neural representations into explicit, executable logical rules.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文综述机制可解释性这一旨在逆向工程现代神经网络内部算法的研究方向，强调其相较传统可解释 AI 更关注模型内部因果机制。文章重点讨论 Transformer 电路分析，包括残差流、注意力机制和归纳头在复杂任务与上下文学习中的作用。它还介绍稀疏自编码器、转码器、引导向量和因果干预等工具，并将机制洞见与神经符号 AI 框架联系起来。

articles.title: An optimal control approach for neural network architecture adaptation with a posteriori error estimation
articles.title_zh: 一种基于后验误差估计的神经网络架构自适应最优控制方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07637v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work presents a novel approach for adapting neural network architecture along the depth based on a posteriori error estimation. By formulating neural network training as a continuous-time optimal control problem, we derive rigorous error estimates that quantify how approximation error distributes across network layers. This error decomposition enables a principled depth adaptation strategy: new layers are inserted at locations of maximum estimated error, allowing the network to efficiently capture complex, nonlinear variations in the underlying problem. Our framework introduces a novel network architecture that treats weights and biases as piecewise linear functions varying across layers, with the error estimator bounding the discrepancy between this discrete representation and the true continuous optimal control solution. The approach leverages dual weighted residual methodology from finite element analysis to derive computable upper bounds on the functional error. A key theoretical contribution is the derivation of explicit error bounds that decompose the total approximation error into interval-wise contributions, providing a rigorous basis for targeted architecture refinement. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on scientific datasets, including learning the observable-to-parameter map for the Navier-Stokes equation. Numerical results reveal that our approach consistently outperforms existing architecture adaptation methods in terms of generalization performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文将神经网络训练表述为连续时间最优控制问题，并据此推导后验误差估计，用于衡量近似误差在网络深度方向上的分布。基于误差分解，方法在估计误差最大的层间位置插入新层，从而更有原则地进行深度自适应。框架还将权重和偏置视为随层变化的分段线性函数，并利用有限元中的双加权残差思想给出可计算的泛函误差上界。
authors: C G Krishnanunni, Thomas Scott, Tan Bui-Thanh

articles.title: Recovering Candidate Circadian Regulators of Arrhythmic Pituitary Hormone Genes Using Reliability-Weighted Magnetic Laplacian with rwMagLap
articles.title_zh: 使用可靠性加权磁拉普拉斯 rwMagLap 恢复无节律垂体激素基因的候选昼夜节律调控因子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06579v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study how to recover candidate circadian-clock regulators of pituitary hormone genes that are important for women's health but do not show a clear 24-hour rhythm in bulk tissue, aiming to nominate clock-linked regulatory targets that could inform future chronopharmacologic and chronotherapeutic strategies. We propose rwMagLap, which builds a graph on rhythmic backbone genes. For each edge, we combine 24-hour fit quality with peak-time phase, represented as a complex unit-circle value, yielding a Hermitian adjacency matrix and a magnetic Laplacian. We insert arrhythmic hormone genes, treated as anchors, by a reliability-weighted nearest-neighbor projection. The projected anchor-neighbor weights are pooled into a soft teleport distribution, and complex personalized PageRank then ranks rhythmic backbone genes by the magnitude of their PageRank scores. In pituitary data, we find that all 11 women's-health anchors are arrhythmic. Even so, we find that the top-50 list is 7.95× enriched for the 13-gene KEGG circadian set (7 of the 8 set genes in the 454-gene backbone; corrected Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) pBH=4×10⁻⁶) and 4.54× enriched for the 111-gene Reactome set (8 of 16 genes; pBH=1.6×10⁻⁴), while a phase-blind real-valued baseline recovers none. We recover candidates through reliability weighting and phase-aware seeding rather than through magnetic propagation. The magnetic phase adds a different capability: it represents temporal order. On pituitary backbone, the magnetic embedding recovers measured peak-time order of connected pituitary genes with accuracy 0.971, while q=0, i.e., no magnetic charge, is at chance.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注若干与女性健康相关但在整体垂体组织中不呈现明显 24 小时节律的激素基因，旨在识别其潜在的昼夜钟相关调控因子。作者提出 rwMagLap，在有节律骨架基因上构建结合 24 小时拟合质量与峰值相位的复值图，并用磁拉普拉斯与可靠性加权近邻投影将无节律激素基因作为锚点纳入排序。垂体数据分析显示，尽管所有 11 个女性健康锚定基因均为无节律，排名靠前基因仍显著富集于 KEGG 昼夜节律基因集，提示该方法可从无节律目标中恢复钟控调控线索。

articles.title: Fast determinantal sampling on general spaces and diffusion geometry
articles.title_zh: 一般空间与扩散几何上的快速行列式采样
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06644v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Determinantal point processes have recently emerged as a kernel-based alternative to standard independent sampling for constructing efficient minibatches, coresets, and other compact representations of large-scale datasets. In particular, sampling mechanisms based on DPPs are believed to demonstrate better approximation properties compared to classical i.i.d. samplers, even at the scale of the exponent. One of the key strengths of DPP based samplers is that they can be deployed over very general spaces, in contrast to more classical sampling methods beyond i.i.d. which tend to work in very well-structured settings, principally Euclidean spaces. In this work, we establish explicit rate guarantees for determinantal sampling in spaces that extend far beyond known Euclidean setups, focusing on spectral kernels obtained from eigenspaces of naturally associated Laplacian and other Markov diffusion operators. This includes, in particular, Riemannian manifolds and weighted networks. In determinantal sampling from compact Riemannian manifolds, we establish sampling rates that automatically pick up the intrinsic dimensionality dᵢₙₜ of the underlying manifold. In the setting of networks, we investigate DPP-based samplers on the celebrated k-nearest neighbour graphs, as well as weighted random geometric graphs, and demonstrate a similar improved dependence on the intrinsic dimensionality of the data. Overall, our approach achieves guarantees of big(sample sizebig)⁻frac¹²⁻frac¹²dᵢₙₜ that match known rates on Euclidean spaces of comparable dimension. In terms of techniques, we connect to the celebrated Weyl's Law for manifold spectra, and leverage tools from the theory of Markov diffusions and Dirichlet forms as well as certain ingredients from the theory of pseudodifferential operators, which could be of independent interest in this area.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究行列式点过程在一般空间中的采样理论与速率保证，强调其作为独立同分布采样之外的核方法在构造小批量、核心集和紧凑数据表示方面的潜力。作者聚焦由拉普拉斯算子和马尔可夫扩散算子特征空间诱导的谱核，将已有欧氏空间结果推广到黎曼流形和加权网络等更广泛情形。结果表明，在紧致黎曼流形上的行列式采样可自动反映数据的内在维度，并为非欧几里得场景提供明确的采样率保证。
authors: Hoang-Son Tran, Pranav Gupta, Subhroshekhar Ghosh

articles.title: ORAN-DEFEND: Subspace Detection and Sanitization of Backdoor DRL xApps in Open RAN
articles.title_zh: ORAN-DEFEND：开放 RAN 中后门 DRL xApp 的子空间检测与净化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06647v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Open Radio Access Networks (O-RAN) increasingly delegate near-real-time control to deep reinforcement learning (DRL) xApps obtained from third-party vendors, creating a new supply-chain attack surface. A backdoor policy behaves optimally until an adversary injects a covert trigger into the observed key performance indicator (KPI) telemetry, at which point it issues harmful control actions that degrade quality of service (QoS). We present ORAN-DEFEND, a retraining-free wrapper that sanitizes a frozen, potentially compromised xApp by projecting each KPI window onto a safe subspace estimated from a small number of trusted clean rollouts via singular value decomposition (SVD). We establish, both analytically and empirically, a precise recovery condition: the defense succeeds if the trigger energy concentrates in the orthogonal complement of the safe subspace, and we quantify this boundary through the trigger's Eperp energy fraction. On the Colosseum COLORAN dataset, we evaluate four structurally distinct DRL backdoor attacks, like TrojDRL, SleeperNets, BadRL, and Q-Incept, spanning inner-loop and outer-loop poisoning regimes and demonstrate 100% return recovery and ≥99.5% defense success rate across all four when the subspace assumption holds. A geometry ablation reveals an intrinsic and previously uncharacterized limit of any linear projection defense: when the trigger collocates with the legitimate signal, the Eperp energy fraction governs recovery monotonically, and the linear residual detector collapses to chance even while a nonlinear classifier retains perfect separability.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对开放无线接入网中第三方深度强化学习 xApp 可能携带后门的问题，提出无需重新训练的防御包装器 ORAN-DEFEND。方法利用少量可信干净轨迹通过奇异值分解估计安全子空间，并将每个 KPI 时间窗口投影到该子空间以净化潜在触发器。作者从理论和实验上给出防御成功条件，即触发器能量需集中在安全子空间的正交补中，并在 Colosseum COLORAN 数据集上评估多种结构不同的 DRL 后门攻击。
authors: Md Raihan Uddin, Fatemeh Lotfi, Tolunay Seyfi, Fatemeh Afghah

articles.title: Pelican-VLA 0.5: Attending Before Acting Benefits Generalization
articles.title_zh: Pelican-VLA 0.5：先注意再行动有助于泛化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06655v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this report, we present Pelican-VLA 0.5, a unified VLA model that integrates vision-language understanding, future-frame generation, and action prediction within a single architecture. Pelican-VLA 0.5 achieves attention-level generalization: without object annotations, segmentation masks, attention supervision, or task-specific fine-tuning, its action pathway already focuses on the instruction-relevant object and contact region. This behavior persists across unseen scenes and unseen robot embodiments, and is substantially stronger than in other open-source VLA baselines. We verify that this ability originates from the learnable Reasoning Slots inserted between perception and action: by routing task-relevant visual information through a compact bottleneck, the slot interface induces manipulation-centric attention during pre-training and remains effective across different policy structures, including a MoT-style architecture.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报告介绍 Pelican-VLA 0.5，一种统一的视觉-语言-动作模型，将视觉语言理解、未来帧生成和动作预测整合到同一架构中。模型在无需物体标注、分割掩码、注意力监督或任务特定微调的情况下，其动作路径能关注与指令相关的物体和接触区域。作者认为这种能力源自感知与动作之间插入的可学习 Reasoning Slots，它通过紧凑瓶颈路由任务相关视觉信息，从而在预训练中诱导面向操作的注意力并提升跨场景和跨机器人本体的泛化。
authors: Zeyuan Ding, Wenhai Liu, Yang Xu, Jiayu Hu, Yinda Chen, Yi Zhang, Yong Dai, Jian Tang, Xiaozhu Ju

articles.title: CaLiSym: Learning Symplectic Dynamics of Real-World Systems through Structured Canonical Lifts
articles.title_zh: CaLiSym：通过结构化正则提升学习真实世界系统的辛动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06824v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Physics-informed learning promises data-efficient and stable dynamics prediction, yet its strongest geometric guarantees have largely remained confined to closed conservative systems. This excludes many robotic systems of practical interest, where actuation, dissipation, and constraints continuously exchange energy and momentum with the environment. We introduce CaLiSym, a lightweight framework that extends exact symplectic learning to such systems by changing where the geometric prior is imposed. Rather than enforcing symplecticity on the measured physical state, CaLiSym embeds the state and its physical ports into a structured lifted canonical phase space, where the learned dynamics evolve through an exactly symplectic map. The lift is explicit and algebraic, requiring neither recurrent latent states, transformer decoders, implicit optimization, nor inference-time ODE integration. We instantiate the framework with generalized-ridge SympNet predictors and introduce GRB-SympNet, a B-spline variant that combines local approximation with exact symplectic structure. Experiments on a controlled dissipative double pendulum, a real-world quadrotor, and a contact-rich quadruped demonstrate consistent improvements in out-of-distribution autoregressive prediction while using parameter-efficient models. At the same time, the learned lifted dynamics preserve the symplectic form to numerical precision. These results show that symplectic learning can be extended beyond conservative mechanics through structured canonical lifts, enabling geometry-preserving dynamics models for real-world robotic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 CaLiSym，用于将精确辛结构学习扩展到包含驱动、耗散和约束的真实机器人系统。方法不直接在观测物理状态上强制辛性，而是将状态及其物理端口嵌入结构化提升的正则相空间，并在其中通过精确辛映射演化。该提升为显式代数形式，不依赖循环潜变量、Transformer 解码器、隐式优化或推理时 ODE 积分，并结合广义岭 SympNet 与 B 样条变体 GRB-SympNet 进行实验验证。
authors: Aristotelis Papatheodorou, Pranav Vaidhyanathan, Natalia Ares, Ioannis Havoutis, Gerard J. Milburn

articles.title: Weight-Space Physics: Interpretable Hypernetworks for Lattice Quantum Field Theories
articles.title_zh: 权重空间物理：用于格点量子场论的可解释超网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07127v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Lattice field theory is the workhorse of non-perturbative physics, used to simulate phenomena from the strong nuclear force to critical phenomena in materials. Its Boltzmann distributions are parametrized analytically by coupling constants, but these bare parameters are weak predictors of observables -- extracting physics typically requires extensive simulation. While normalizing flows have emerged as effective samplers at fixed couplings, it remains difficult to interpret what these networks have learned. This raises a natural question: can the physics be read off directly from the flow network parameters themselves, and can those parameters be generated for unseen theories? We propose lattice field theory as a testbed for neural network interpretability: because the target physics is qualitatively well-understood and smoothly varying, it provides ideal synthetic data with known ground truth. To this end, we introduce JEPAWG, a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture-based Weight Generator that maps couplings directly to flow weights via a learned latent space. On a scalar theory at lattices of size 6² to 11², the JEPAWG latent space recovers the correct intrinsic dimension of the underlying manifold, locates the phase transition, and encodes a finite-size shift aligned with the 2D Ising exponent ν approx 1, allowing us to uncover physical structure by studying the network weights alone. This suggests the fascinating idea of treating the network weights as a new type of physical observable. As a generator, JEPAWG also interpolates and extrapolates to unseen couplings effectively and remains robust to weight-space discontinuities introduced by multi-seed training data, outperforming PCA, AE, and VAE baselines.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文将格点场论作为神经网络可解释性的测试平台，探讨是否能从归一化流网络参数中直接读取物理信息，并为未见耦合参数生成相应网络权重。作者提出 JEPAWG，一种基于联合嵌入预测架构的权重生成器，可将耦合常数映射到流模型权重的潜在空间。以标量场论小规模格点为例，研究旨在揭示网络权重空间与物理可观测量、相变结构之间的关系。
authors: Tobias Göbel, Julian R. Ebelt, Zier Mensch, Mathis Gerdes, Miranda C. N. Cheng

articles.title: Bifidelity Parameter Estimation Using Conditional Diffusion Models
articles.title_zh: 使用条件扩散模型的双保真参数估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.01894v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a bifidelity method for uncertainty quantification of parameter estimates in complex systems, leveraging generative models trained to sample the target conditional distribution. In the Bayesian inference setting, traditional parameter estimation methods rely on repeated simulations of potentially expensive forward models to determine the posterior distribution of the parameter values, which may result in computationally intractable workflows. Furthermore, methods such as Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) necessitate rerunning the entire algorithm for each new data observation, further increasing the computational burden. Hence, we propose a novel method for efficiently obtaining posterior distributions of parameter estimates for high-fidelity models given data observations of interest. The method first constructs a low-fidelity, conditional generative model capable of amortized Bayesian inference and hence rapid posterior density approximation over a wide-range of data observations. When higher accuracy is needed for a specific data observation, the method employs adaptive refinement of the density approximation. It uses outputs from the low-fidelity generative model to refine the parameter sampling space, ensuring efficient use of the computationally expensive high-fidelity solver. Subsequently, a high-fidelity, unconditional generative model is trained to achieve greater accuracy in the target posterior distribution. Both low- and high- fidelity generative models enable efficient sampling from the target posterior and do not require repeated simulation of the high-fidelity forward model. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method on several numerical examples, including cases with multi-modal densities, as well as an application in plasma physics for a runaway electron simulation model.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种用于复杂系统参数估计不确定性量化的双保真方法，利用条件生成模型学习目标后验分布。传统贝叶斯推断通常需要反复运行昂贵的高保真正向模型，且 MCMC 等方法在新观测到来时往往需重新执行完整算法，计算代价较高。该方法先构建低保真条件生成模型以实现摊销贝叶斯推断，并在特定观测需要更高精度时通过自适应细化改进后验密度近似。
authors: Caroline Tatsuoka, Minglei Yang, Dongbin Xiu, Guannan Zhang

articles.title: Comprehensive Evaluation of Large Language Model Responses: A Multi-Factor Scoring System
articles.title_zh: 大型语言模型回答的综合评估：一种多因素评分系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06940v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The remarkable performance of large language models (LLMs) in linguistic tasks underscores an urgent need for comprehensive evaluation of their response quality. Prevailing methods, often confined to singular dimensions, fall short of capturing the full spectrum of model capabilities. This study introduces a multifactor scoring paradigm, integrating accuracy, conciseness, factual consistency, readability, and coherence, complemented by a graphical user interface (GUI) for visualizing outcomes. Evaluations on the TruthfulQA dataset unveil mainstream LLMs' strengths in reasoning tasks (peaking at a composite score of 0.6104) alongside pervasive limitations in navigating complex facts and ambiguities. Transcending the narrow lens of traditional metrics, this framework offers a transparent, adaptable avenue to illuminate model potential and deficiencies. Though presently focused on English tasks, its horizons beckon toward multilingual domains. This work carves a novel path for knowledge engineering and model refinement.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种多因素评分范式，用于更全面地评估大型语言模型回答质量，综合考虑准确性、简洁性、事实一致性、可读性和连贯性。作者还配套设计图形用户界面以可视化评估结果，并在 TruthfulQA 数据集上比较主流模型表现。结果显示模型在推理任务上具有一定优势，但在复杂事实和歧义处理方面仍存在普遍局限。
authors: Yiming Gai, Junde Lu, Xuefei Huang

articles.title: QCNN with Rough Path Signature Kernels
articles.title_zh: 结合粗路径签名核的量子卷积神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07634v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Time series analysis plays a vital role across a wide range of scientific and engineering domains but poses substantial computational challenges. A major difficulty arises from the time reparameterization invariance of time series data, which complicates the extraction of meaningful temporal features. In this work, we address the problem of time series classification by exploring the application of quantum computation techniques. We propose a hybrid quantum-classical architecture that integrates recent advances in quantum neural networks with the mathematical framework of path signatures, mitigating the impact of time reparametrization invariance. The architecture employs feature layers that compute a signature kernel between pairs of input paths, consisting of a reference path and a target path for classification, using either classical or quantum variational linear solvers (VQLS). These feature layers are followed by a Quantum Convolutional Neural Network (QCNN) to perform downstream learning tasks. We evaluate several realizations of the proposed architecture, differing in QCNN configurations, on a binary classification task involving time series representations of handwritten digits. Our experiments demonstrate the potential advantages of implementing path signature kernel layers within quantum circuits and provide an analysis of the computational limitations associated with the VQLS component.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文面向时间序列分类，提出一种融合量子神经网络与路径签名数学框架的混合量子-经典架构，以缓解时间重参数化不变性带来的特征提取困难。模型使用特征层计算参考路径与待分类目标路径之间的签名核，可通过经典方法或量子变分线性求解器实现。随后，签名核特征被输入量子卷积神经网络执行下游分类，并在二分类任务中比较不同 QCNN 配置的表现。

articles.title: FDRMFL: Multimodal Federated Feature Extraction Model Based on Information Maximization and Contrastive Learning
articles.title_zh: FDRMFL：基于信息最大化与对比学习的多模态联邦特征提取模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.02076v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We propose FDRMFL, a task-driven multimodal feature extraction framework for federated regression under non-IID data distributions. Extracting predictive features from high-dimensional multimodal inputs is particularly challenging in this setting: data cannot leave each client, local samples are scarce and heterogeneously distributed, and unsupervised dimensionality reduction discards task-relevant information while federated training introduces representation drift across communication rounds. FDRMFL addresses these challenges through a unified four-term local objective: MSE prediction loss, a correlation-based mutual information surrogate that preserves dependence between the fused representation and the continuous target, a symmetric KL penalty that aligns cross-modal latent distributions before fusion, and an InfoNCE-style contrastive loss that anchors local representations to the global consensus. Experiments on three synthetic and two real-world near-infrared spectroscopy datasets under non-IID federated partitions, with comprehensive ablation and sensitivity analyses, demonstrate that each component contributes to the framework's effectiveness. FDRMFL reduces mean MSE by 33.8% relative to the best traditional baseline (PCA) and by 43.0% relative to VAE in simulation, and attains the lowest overall mean MSE among six federated algorithms including FedAvg, FedProx, MOON, SCAFFOLD, and FedBN.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出FDRMFL框架，用于非独立同分布数据下联邦回归任务中的多模态特征提取。该方法在本地目标函数中联合预测损失、互信息替代项、跨模态分布对齐惩罚和对比学习损失，以缓解数据不可共享、样本稀缺、分布异质和表示漂移等问题。在合成数据和近红外光谱真实数据上的实验与消融分析表明，各组成模块均有助于提升任务驱动的联邦表示学习效果。

articles.title: Zinc oxide nanoparticles coupled with Deltamethrin as an effective and safer bio-nanomolecule for ticks
articles.title_zh: 氧化锌纳米颗粒与溴氰菊酯偶联作为高效且更安全的蜱类生物纳米制剂
articles.abstract: Nanomaterials hailing from Zinc are known to possess anti-parasitic abilities, having potential for tick control when incorporated within the integrated pest management programs. The nano composites of zinc showed roughly spherical type of morphology possessing different size dimensions upon characterization using SEM, EDX and FTIR. The nanomaterials arising from zinc oxide and zinc sulfide were then subject to coating with deltamethrin and tested for acaricidal efficacy against the adults, larvae and eggs of Hyalomma ticks. The bioassays had shown that among sulphides and oxides, the oxides had a slightly enhanced efficacy. The deltamethrin test group had shown higher lethal concentrations indicating the reduction in sensitivity/development of tolerance or resistance of these ticks against this acaricide. The Allium cepa toxicity assay analyzing the cytotoxicity, DNA damage and chromosomal aberrations was utilized to evaluate effects of chemical and nano-acaricides used in this study. It was found that the metallic nanoparticles used in the study had mild to moderate genotoxic and cytotoxic effects. However, the chemical acaricide (deltamethrin) had shown moderate to high toxic effects on DNA damage, phase indices and chromosomal aberrations. This study links the idea of employing eco-friendly yet efficient acaricidal nanomaterials that have minimal impacts on the non-targets from a prospective “One-health for all”. This is the high time to consider evaluating the repurposing the promising forms of existent acaricides at herd/farm levels to combat the prevailing acaricidal resistance worldwide.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究考察锌基纳米材料及其与溴氰菊酯复合后对璃眼蜱成虫、幼虫和虫卵的杀螨效果。经SEM、EDX和FTIR表征，相关纳米复合物呈近球形形貌，其中氧化物体系的杀螨活性略优于硫化物体系。葱根毒性试验显示金属纳米颗粒具有轻至中度遗传毒性和细胞毒性，而化学杀螨剂溴氰菊酯表现出更高毒性，提示纳米复合策略可能具有一定安全性优势。

articles.title: Composition-Tuned p-/n-Type Conductivity and Annealing-Enhanced Properties of Spray-Pyrolyzed Ag–S-Sn Semiconductor Thin Films for Optoelectronic Applications
articles.title_zh: 用于光电应用的喷雾热解Ag–S–Sn半导体薄膜：组分调控p/n型导电性与退火增强性能
articles.abstract: Two-dimensional layers of silver tin sulfide (Ag8SnS6) nanostructures were fabricated, demonstrating potential applications as light-absorbing layers in optoelectronic systems, with the ability to achieve both n-type and p-type conductivity using a cost-effective approach for large-scale production. To achieve this, an aqueous solution containing silver acetate (0.04 M), thiourea (Ag:S = 1:3), and various concentrations of tin chloride was prepared and spray-pyrolyzed onto glass substrates at 285°C. The thickness of all samples was measured using a Taly step profilometer. The synthesized samples underwent structural, optical, and electrical characterization and were annealed in a nitrogen atmosphere at 450°C for one hour. The XRD patterns of the layers prior to annealing indicated a poor crystalline structure with the formation of canfieldite (Ag8SnS6) and tin sulfide (SnS) phases, both exhibiting orthorhombic structures. Post-annealing, the structural properties of the films improved, characterized by an increase in the intensity of the (022) direction corresponding to the Ag8SnS6 phase, along with the emergence of new peaks related to the Acanthite (α-Ag2S) and cassiterite (SnO2) phases. Additionally, in most layers, annealing resulted in increased absorption across a wide range of wavelengths and a decrease in their bandgap. The heating process also led to a reduction in resistivity and a significant increase in carrier density in the layers. Hall effect measurements also indicated that the films exhibit both n-type and p-type conductivity, depending on the Sn:Ag concentration.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究通过喷雾热解法在玻璃基底上制备银锡硫纳米结构薄膜，探索其作为光电系统吸光层的潜力，并通过调控组分实现n型和p型导电。样品经结构、光学和电学表征，并在氮气气氛中退火。结果显示，退火前薄膜结晶性较弱且含Ag8SnS6和SnS相，退火后Ag8SnS6相关衍射峰增强并出现新的银硫化物和氧化锡相关峰，表明结构性能得到改善。

articles.title: New Herbicide-Degrading Microorganisms for the Biogenic Synthesis of Silver Nanoparticles
articles.title_zh: 用于银纳米颗粒生物合成的新型除草剂降解微生物
articles.abstract: In this study, herbicide-degrading soil microorganisms were evaluated as potential agents for the biogenic synthesis of silver nanoparticles (AgNPs). A total of 42 microbial isolates were obtained from anthropogenically stressed soils and the cotton rhizosphere, of which 13 exhibited high resistance to the herbicides pendimethalin and clethodim. The most active strains were identified as Acinetobacter radioresistens R27 and Bacillus pumilus R25. The formation of AgNPs was confirmed by UV-Vis spectroscopy, scanning electron microscopy (SEM), and X-ray diffraction (XRD), revealing predominantly spherical nanoparticles with a face-centered cubic structure. According to the Debye–Scherrer analysis, the crystallite sizes ranged from 21.3 to 74.3 nm. Furthermore, the synthesized AgNPs exhibited a pronounced dose-dependent fungicidal efficiency against economically significant phytopathogens, including Aspergillus flavus (with a maximum inhibition zone of up to 35.0 ± 0.5 mm at 100 mg/L), Fusarium spp., and Alternaria alternata. These findings demonstrate the dual potential of the investigated degrading strains for both environmental bioremediation and the eco-friendly production of nanomaterials for plant protection.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究筛选能够降解除草剂的土壤微生物，并评估其作为绿色合成银纳米颗粒的生物因子。研究从受人为扰动土壤和棉花根际中获得42株分离物，其中部分菌株对二甲戊灵和烯草酮具有较高抗性，活性菌株包括Acinetobacter radioresistens R27和Bacillus pumilus R25。通过UV-Vis、SEM和XRD证实所合成银纳米颗粒多为球形且具面心立方结构，并对多种重要植物病原真菌表现出剂量依赖性抑菌效果，显示其在生物修复和纳米材料绿色制备中的双重潜力。

articles.title: Quantum machine learning performance evaluation for air pollution assessment with benchmarking and comparative analysis using multi-metric scoring and quantum circuit expressibility
articles.title_zh: 基于多指标评分与量子线路表达能力的空气污染评估量子机器学习性能评价
articles.abstract: Our study proposes the MDQ-3L framework, a multi-metric, quantum-aware hierarchy for benchmarking classical machine learning, deep learning, and quantum machine learning models in air quality prediction. PM2.5, PM10, NO, NO2, NOx, NH3, CO, SO2, O3, Benzene, Toluene, and Xylene were considered predictors of AQI. Seventeen ML regressors, nine DL models, and seven QML circuits were evaluated using MAE, MSE, RMSE, R², RMSLE, MAPE, and QML-specific expressibility (0.739-2.0) and entangling power (0-0.398). Aggregated via min-max normalization and weights, the framework penalizes negative R² and high structural costs, yielding CatBoost and DBN as top performers, while QML trailed by 25–40% in composite scores due to generalization gaps and barren plateau risks. MDQ-3L aligns circuits to targets, reducing QCNN/TTN penalties by ~ 30% relative to non-benchmarked rankings. Our approach exposes QML limitations under NISQ constraints (4–6 qubits, shallow depth), supporting low-entanglement ansätze like SELR/HEA for 10–15% potential gains, and provides an interpretable tool for hybrid environmental modeling, advancing Quantum Machine Intelligence benchmarks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出MDQ-3L框架，用于在空气质量预测中对经典机器学习、深度学习和量子机器学习模型进行多指标、量子感知的基准评估。研究以多种污染物作为AQI预测变量，综合MAE、MSE、RMSE、R²等回归指标以及量子线路表达能力和纠缠能力进行评分。结果显示CatBoost和DBN表现最佳，而量子机器学习模型在当前NISQ约束下因泛化差距和贫瘠高原风险而落后，但低纠缠线路设计可能带来改进空间。

articles.title: Optimizing produced water reinjection pump energy consumption using variable frequency regulation
articles.title_zh: 利用变频调节优化采出水回注泵能耗
articles.abstract: In mature oil fields, the hydraulic load on Produced Water Re-injection (PWRI) pumps is highly dynamic, driven by fluctuating reservoir backpressure and varying wastewater production rates. However, standard mechanical design practices typically size centrifugal injection pumps for the “worst-case” peak pressure condition expected at the end of the field’s life. This static design philosophy creates a severe hydraulic mismatch during the early-to-mid operational years, forcing operators to dissipate excess hydraulic energy across choke valves. This practice not only results in substantial thermodynamic losses but also subjects the mechanical system to excessive throttling, vibration, and wear. This study analyzes the mechanical and energetic advantages of replacing conventional Fixed-Speed Drive (FSD) throttling control with a Staged Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) strategy. A coupled hydraulic-mechanical simulation was developed to model the transient interaction between the surface pumping system and the subsurface reservoir load over a 20-year lifecycle. The model integrates a dynamic system head curve derived from field data with pump performance curves governed by Affinity Laws. Results indicate that the reservoir backpressure fluctuates significantly (3,500–4,200 psi), causing fixed-speed pumps to operate far from their Best Efficiency Point (BEP). The proposed variable speed control strategy eliminates throttling losses, reducing the lifecycle electricity requirement from 177.45 GWh to 151.22 GWh—a 14.8% relative reduction in total system energy consumption. Furthermore, based on established turbomachinery reliability physics, theoretical projections suggest this optimization mitigates mechanical stress on valve trims and piping infrastructure. While the primary benefit is thermodynamic optimization, the associated reduction in power consumption yields an estimated operational cost saving of 3.15 million, validating the strategy as both mechanically superior and economically viable.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对成熟油田采出水回注泵在储层背压和污水产量波动下的动态负荷问题，分析传统定速泵节流控制造成的能量损失、振动和磨损。作者提出以分阶段变频驱动策略替代固定转速节流控制，并建立耦合地面泵送系统与地下储层负荷的20年生命周期液压—机械仿真模型。研究旨在评估变频调节在降低能耗、改善机械匹配和提升运行可靠性方面的优势。

articles.title: Spatiotemporal Analysis of Climate Variability and Natural Disaster Patterns in Brazil Using Self-Organizing Maps
articles.title_zh: 利用自组织映射分析巴西气候变率与自然灾害模式的时空特征
articles.abstract: Natural disasters in Brazil are characterized by their growing complexity, driven by the interaction between climatic variability and ongoing climate change, requiring robust analytical methods for their understanding and management. This study employed the Self-Organizing Map (SOM) algorithm to identify patterns in multivariate natural disaster data, integrating climatic variables, such as mean precipitation and standard deviation (SD, mm), and administrative variables, including official recognitions and emergency decrees. SOM performance was evaluated under different parameter configurations (grid size: 5x5, 10x10, 15x15; learning rate: 0.1, 0.5, 1.0; sigma: 0.5, 1.0, 1.5), using clustering quality metrics — quantization error (QE), topological error (TE), Silhouette coefficient — and robustness via Adjusted Rand Index (ARI). Analysis of variance (ANOVA) was applied to determine the influence of variables on cluster formation. The results highlighted that configurations with 10x10 and 15x15 grids, learning rates between 0.5 and 1.0, and sigma of 0.5 showed optimal performance (QE ~ 0.025, TE < 0.22, Silhouette > 0.54, ARI ~ 0.795), with mean precipitation (F = 1457.30, p < 0.001) and its standard deviation (F = 428.35, p < 0.001) as the most discriminative variables, followed by administrative indicators, such as official recognitions (F = 105.66, p < 0.001) and emergency decrees (F = 103.33, p < 0.001). SOM revealed nine distinct regional clusters, reflecting seasonal and spatial patterns, with high variability in the Northeast and greater homogeneity in the South, associated with events such as floods, droughts, and wildfires. It is concluded that SOM is an effective tool for organizing and interpreting complex disaster data, offering stable clusters and valuable insights for climate risk planning and management in Brazil, with potential to support adaptive public policies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究采用自组织映射算法分析巴西自然灾害多变量数据，整合降水均值、降水标准差以及官方认定和应急法令等行政变量。研究比较不同网格规模、学习率和邻域参数下的聚类质量，并使用量化误差、拓扑误差、轮廓系数和调整兰德指数评价模型表现。结果表明，较大的网格和适中至较高学习率配置表现较优，降水变量对聚类形成具有显著影响，有助于理解气候变率与灾害格局的关系。

articles.title: Biofilm induction and tolerance to invasion of marine bacterial communities
articles.title_zh: 海洋细菌群落的生物膜诱导及其对外来微生物入侵的耐受性
articles.abstract: Background Marine microorganisms form highly diverse microbial ecosystems that play critical roles in surface colonization and biofouling dynamics. Traditional antifouling approaches largely rely on chemical coatings, raising environmental concerns particularly in aquatic ecosystems. This work aims to explore the emergent properties of natural marine multispecies communities to develop stable underwater biofilms tolerant to external microbial invasion, as a foundation for future biofilm-based antifouling approaches.Results Using a bottom-up assembly approach, we constructed multispecies biofilm communities from 161 marine bacterial isolates. Initial high-throughput screening on treated and untreated polystyrene material identified top biofilm formers in monoculture, which were further validated on the PSX700-coated surfaces, a polysiloxane material widely used on underwater vehicles and other marine, underwater infrastructures. Selected isolates were combined into multispecies communities and tested for biofilm biomass, community stability, and extent of invasion by Pseudoalteromonas tunicata. Several multispecies communities exhibited significant biofilm induction and compositional stability compared to their component species. Furthermore, communities assembled with tolerant isolates showed strong tolerance to P. tunicata invasion, suggesting that community-level invasion tolerance may be associated with the component species.Conclusion Together, these findings demonstrate that rational assembly of marine bacterial communities can generate stable, invasion-tolerant biofilms. This study provides a foundation for the potential of targeted biofilm assembly toward environmentally friendly, biofilm-based living coatings for marine applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探索天然海洋多物种细菌群落的涌现特性，以构建稳定且能抵御外来微生物入侵的水下生物膜，为未来基于生物膜的防污策略提供基础。研究从161株海洋细菌分离物出发，通过自下而上的组装方式筛选单菌生物膜形成能力，并在聚苯乙烯及PSX700涂层表面进行验证。随后将优选菌株组合成多物种群落，评估其生物膜生物量、群落稳定性以及对Pseudoalteromonas tunicata入侵的抵御程度，发现部分群落表现出显著生物膜诱导和组成稳定性。

articles.title: Leveraging Graph Neural Networks and Conventional Machine Learning for Phishing URL Detection
articles.title_zh: 利用图神经网络与传统机器学习进行钓鱼 URL 检测
articles.abstract: Phishing attacks continue to pose a significant and escalating risk to cybersecurity, allowing malicious actors to trick users and obtain confidential information, including login credentials and financial details, by imitating legitimate websites. Conventional detection techniques frequently fall short in addressing these increasingly sophisticated threats, emphasizing the necessity for more advanced and adaptable detection mechanisms. This paper proposes a hybrid phishing URL detection model that integrates the topological learning capabilities of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) with the classification strength of Random Forest (RF). In this model, URLs are represented as nodes within a web graph, capturing structural and behavioral relationships, while RF processes both graph-based embeddings and traditional URL features to deliver accurate and scalable classification. A secondary model combining GNN with Logistic Regression (GNN-LR) was also developed for comparison. Experiments conducted on publicly available datasets comprising over 11,000 labeled URLs demonstrated that the proposed GNN-RF model achieved outstanding performance, with 99.3% accuracy, 99.1% precision, 99.5% recall, and a 99.3% F1-score—outperforming traditional machine learning models and the GNN-LR alternative. Moreover, the hybrid approach significantly reduced false positives, reinforcing its practicality for real-world deployment. These results underscore the effectiveness of combining graph-based learning with ensemble methods, positioning the GNN-RF model as a robust and intelligent solution to modern phishing threats.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种混合式钓鱼 URL 检测模型，将图神经网络的拓扑表征能力与随机森林的分类能力结合起来。模型将 URL 表示为网络图中的节点，以捕捉结构和行为关系，并融合图嵌入与传统 URL 特征进行分类。基于包含 11000 余个标注 URL 的公开数据集，GNN-RF 模型取得了较高性能，并优于用于对比的 GNN-逻辑回归模型。

articles.title: Geometric Irreversibility and Dissipation Bounds in Non-Reciprocal Neural Attractor Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 非互易神经吸引子动力学中的几何不可逆性与耗散边界
articles.abstract: Non-reciprocal attractor networks can possess equilibrium-like stationary densities while sustaining irreversible probability currents. This separation implies that scalar landscape descriptions can correctly predict attractor occupancies and even leading action barriers, yet fail to predict the geometry and thermodynamic cost of rare transitions. Here we show that the solenoidal component of the drift controls a quantitative triad: the asymmetry of forward and reverse transition paths, the steady-state entropy production, and the precision bound for time-integrated neural currents. In a solvable bistable model, the quasipotential remains unchanged while the minimum-action escape and relaxation paths form directed loops; the corresponding path-asymmetry index scales linearly with the non-reciprocal drift, whereas entropy production scales quadratically. Monte Carlo simulations recover the Freidlin--Wentzell barrier, and thermodynamic uncertainty products remain above the stochastic-thermodynamic bound. We then extend the calculation to high-dimensional non-reciprocal attractor networks and show that the same path--current--dissipation structure persists under full-space geometric minimum-action optimization. These results identify a falsifiable nonequilibrium signature of attractor computation: two systems with the same landscape can have different transition routes, different irreversible currents, and different thermodynamic precision costs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨非互易吸引子网络中平衡态样的稳态密度与不可逆概率流可同时存在的现象。作者指出，漂移项的无源分量同时控制正反转变路径不对称性、稳态熵产生以及时间积分神经流的精度界。在可解双稳态模型和高维非互易吸引子网络中，研究展示了路径、概率流与耗散之间的统一结构。

articles.title: Framework-stabilized multistage transition in antiferroelectric ceramics for high-energy storage
articles.title_zh: 用于高能量存储的反铁电陶瓷中框架稳定的多阶段相变
articles.abstract: Antiferroelectric ceramics are attractive for pulsed power capacitors, yet their energy-storage capability is often constrained by premature field-induced phase transitions and insufficient breakdown strength. Here, we show that stabilizing a PbZrO3-derived antiferroelectric framework, together with high-field-tolerant microstructural engineering, enables multistage polarization switching under electric fields. The optimized composition exhibits sequential field-induced transitions rather than a single abrupt antiferroelectric-ferroelectric transition, delivering an ultrahigh recoverable energy density of 15.2 J cm− 3 with an efficiency of 81.4%. The material further maintains approximately 12.0 J cm− 3 from room temperature to 110°C and releases 90% of the stored energy within 45 ns. Prototype multilayer ceramic capacitors operate up to 100 kV mm⁻¹ and achieve an energy-storage density of 21.1 J cm− 3. Synchrotron X-ray diffraction, atomic-resolution scanning transmission electron microscopy and in situ measurements reveal that the multistage switching originates from a stabilized commensurate antipolar framework with localized Pb2+ displacement evolution. These results establish antiferroelectric-framework stabilization as an effective strategy for expanding the usable polarization window of high-power dielectric capacitors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向脉冲功率电容器应用，提出通过稳定 PbZrO3 衍生反铁电框架并进行耐高场微结构工程来提升储能性能。优化材料在电场下表现出连续多阶段极化切换，而非单一突变式反铁电—铁电相变，实现了高可恢复能量密度和较高效率。同步辐射 X 射线衍射、原子分辨扫描透射电镜和原位测试表明，多阶段切换源于稳定的公度反极性框架及局域 Pb2+ 位移演化。

articles.title: Study of Optical and Magnetic Properties of Cadmium Telluride Hybrid Nano structures with n-type conductivity for Optoelectronic Device and Quantum Bits Applications
articles.title_zh: 面向光电子器件与量子比特应用的 n 型碲化镉杂化纳米结构光学与磁学性质研究
articles.abstract: The research work presented here delivers the morphology driven behavior of spin electrons in undoped and Fe doped cadmium telluride (CdTe) nano-structures having n-type conductivity for the possible applications of Semiconducting Quantum Bits. The photoluminescence spectrum for the undoped CdTe nanostructure gives the violet emission, however when doped with Fe the emission maximum is found to be in the green region. The van der Pauw Hall measurement of the nano-structures discussed in the present research work reveals the n-type conductivity indicating more number of electrons. Further the work is extended to test the electrons acting as spin electrons, by using Superconducting Quantum Interference Device (SQUID). The M-H curves obtained at 300 K and 5 K gives the evidence of electrons behaving as spin electrons. At 5 K the magnetization is found to be enhanced in undoped CdTe nano-structures. In Fe doped CdTe nanostructures, due to co-existence of triangular and star shaped morphology, the localised spins may have been isolated reducing spin flip However, it is noticed from the M-H curve that due to the hybrid morphology in Fe doped CdTe nano-structures, the shift in the magnetization curve is observed at temperature 300 K and also at 5 K. These findings obtained for the undoped and Fe doped CdTe nano-structures engrave them for the feasible applications as optoelectronic devices and semiconducting Quantum Bits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察未掺杂和 Fe 掺杂 n 型 CdTe 纳米结构中由形貌驱动的自旋电子行为及其潜在半导体量子比特应用。光致发光结果显示，未掺杂 CdTe 呈紫光发射，而 Fe 掺杂后发射峰转移至绿光区域；霍尔测量表明样品具有 n 型导电性。SQUID 测量的 M-H 曲线显示电子表现出自旋相关磁响应，且低温下未掺杂 CdTe 的磁化增强，Fe 掺杂样品的混合形貌可能影响局域自旋与自旋翻转过程。

articles.title: Multi-Knob Switchable Chiral Superconductivity Quartet in Rhombohedral Graphene
articles.title_zh: 菱方石墨烯中可由多参数开关调控的手性超导四重态
articles.abstract: Chiral superconductors break orbital time-reversal symmetry and may host topological quasiparticles with non-Abelian statistics. In rhombohedral graphene, superconductivity develops from a spin-valley-polarized quarter-metal (QM) parent state and features unique magnetic hysteresis of resistance that indicates orbital time-reversal-symmetry-breaking. Exploring and controlling the full spin-valley flavors of such superconductivity could enable novel superconducting and topological devices, but have remained unexplored. Here we report transport measurements on rhombohedral hexalayer graphene (R6G), which reveal a new superconducting state (SCH) that is induced by an out-of-plane magnetic field, in addition to CSC similar to those observed in thinner layers. This SCH state emerges above 0.8 T, persists up to 1.6 T and can be switched on/off by magnetic field H⊥, carrier density n, and gate displacement field D. Quantum oscillations and anomalous Hall measurements show that SCH stems from a field-induced quarter-metal (QM′) parent phase, which carries orbital magnetization opposite to that of the zero-field QM. Across the full (n, D, H⊥) parameter space, superconductivity can be realized from all four spin-valley isospin flavors, establishing a switchable chiral-superconductor quartet in R6G. We interpret the parent-state switching as arising from competition between a Kane-Mele like spin-valley splitting and magnetic-field coupling to spin-valley-dependent magnetic moments. Our work establishes rhombohedral graphene as a multi-knob platform for different isospin-polarized superconductivities, which enables programmable superconducting networks with possible Majorana modes along domain walls.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了菱方六层石墨烯中的输运测量结果，揭示一种由垂直磁场诱导的新超导态，并与较薄层中观察到的手性超导态相联系。该超导态出现在特定磁场范围内，可通过垂直磁场、载流子密度和栅极位移场进行开关调控。量子振荡和反常霍尔测量表明，该状态源于场诱导的四分之一金属母相，其轨道磁化方向与零场母相相反。

articles.title: Online Structure Learning and Planning for Autonomous Robot Navigation using Active Inference
articles.title_zh: 基于主动推理的自主机器人导航在线结构学习与规划
articles.abstract: Autonomous navigation in unfamiliar environments requires robots to simultaneously explore, localise, and plan under uncertainty, without relying on predefined maps or extensive training. We present Active Inference MAPping and Planning (AIMAPP), a framework unifying mapping, localisation, and decision-making within a single generative model, drawing on cognitive-mapping concepts from animal navigation (topological organisation, discrete spatial representations and predictive belief updating) as design inspiration.The agent builds and updates a sparse topological map online, learns state transitions dynamically, and plans actions by minimising Expected Free Energy. This allows it to balance goal-directed and exploratory behaviours.We implemented AIMAPP as a ROS-compatible system that is sensor and robot-agnostic and integrates with diverse hardware configurations. It operates in a fully self-supervised manner, is resilient to sensor failure, continues operating under odometric drift, and supports both exploration and goal-directed navigation without any pre-training. We evaluate the system in large-scale real and simulated environments against state-of-the-art planning baselines, demonstrating its adaptability to ambiguous observations, environmental changes, and sensor noise. The model offers a modular, self-supervised solution to scalable navigation in unstructured settings. AIMAPP is available at [link absent for double-blind review]
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出 AIMAPP 框架，将建图、定位与决策统一到单一生成模型中，用于未知环境中的自主机器人导航。系统在线构建和更新稀疏拓扑地图，动态学习状态转移，并通过最小化期望自由能在目标导向行为与探索行为之间取得平衡。AIMAPP 兼容 ROS、对传感器和机器人平台无关，可在无预训练和自监督条件下运行，并在真实与仿真大规模环境中与先进规划基线进行了比较。

articles.title: The Oscillating Worldline: Symplectic Involution, Topological Mass Generation, and the Geometric Resolution of Baryon Asymmetry
articles.title_zh: 振荡世界线：辛对合、拓扑质量生成与重子不对称性的几何化解决
articles.abstract: By introducing the Extended Equivalence Principle, this paper proposes a topological framework that reinterprets the kinematic null boundary in Special Relativity (v → c) and the gravitational event horizon in General Relativity (r → rs) as isomorphic manifestations of a universal Null Topological Seam (ds2Σ → 0). We posit that elementary particles do not terminate at these boundaries, but rather undergo a discrete topological transformation of their proper causal flow. By elevating the geometry to the complexified cotangent bundle, we demonstrate that intersecting this null boundary triggers a symplectic involution (Ω → −Ω) governed by the topological Maslov index. This rigorously reverses the canonical Hamiltonian vector flow, acting as an exact geometric CPT inversion into a “Black Mirror” bipartite topology while preserving the background metric (gμν ). Applied to gravitational collapse, the algebraic inversion of the Raychaudhuri expansion scalar (θ → −θ) gracefully bypasses the Penrose singularity theorems, generating exact relativistic repulsive gravity. By preserving global state purity across the conjugate phase sectors, the framework geometrically resolves the eternal Black Hole Information Paradox, predicting anomalous, maximally squeezed pair correlators in the Hawking flux. Crucially, this framework natively derives the Standard Model mass hierarchy and fundamental gauge parameters. Path-integral evaluations of the boundary’s chiral projection dictate a strict trans-phasic transition probability, while evaluating the Bohr-Sommerfeld winding numbers on the doubled SU (3)k × SU (3)−k boundary yields the exact Koide formula vacuum angle (δ = 2/9), shown to hold for on-shell pole masses. Its stability against radiative corrections is formulated as a rigorous 6-point constraint problem for future bulk dynamics. Furthermore, the boundary geometry inherently models the mass-suppressed, chiral-restricted neutrino as a topological zero-mode. Applying Călugăreanu’s theorem (Lk = T w + W r) to the boundary’s chiral projection strictly requires the antichronous return trajectories to generate Writhe, self-braiding into stable SU (3)C Trefoil knots (31). The topological self-energy of this knot natively derives the hadronic mass gap (∼ 1836me). Finally, a WKB expansion of the global wave functional across this bipartite manifold recovers the local Schrödinger equation while satisfying the timeless Wheeler-DeWitt constraint (ˆHtotΨ = 0) as a strict topological symmetry, resolving the Problem of Time. Ultimately, we establish that the requisite cosmological antimatter is not missing, but is geometrically sequestered within this stable hadronic topology, rigorously resolving the Baryon Asymmetry.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出一种拓扑框架，将狭义相对论中的运动学零边界和广义相对论中的引力事件视界解释为统一的零拓扑缝的同构表现。作者认为基本粒子在这些边界处并非终止，而是经历固有因果流的离散拓扑变换，并在复化余切丛中触发由 Maslov 指数控制的辛对合。该框架进一步被用于讨论引力坍缩、辛几何 CPT 反演、排斥引力以及黑洞信息和重子不对称性等问题，但其具体论证和物理可检验性需结合原文审慎评估。

articles.title: Machine learning and deep learning for ground data deformation analytics: a comprehensive critical review
articles.title_zh: 用于地表形变数据分析的机器学习与深度学习：一项综合性批判综述
articles.abstract: Ground deformation threatens infrastructure integrity, environmental sustainability, and socio-economic resilience across rapidly urbanizing and tectonically active regions. Recent advances in Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR), Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS), and multi-source Earth observation platforms have generated large spatiotemporal datasets, accelerating the adoption of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) for deformation analytics. Nevertheless, existing studies remain fragmented, with limited integration of causal-factor taxonomy, uncertainty-aware prioritization, and data-centric modeling. This review presents a comprehensive synthesis of ML/DL-driven ground deformation analytics through a novel tripartite framework comprising preconditioning, triggering, and data-processing factors. A systematic bibliometric analysis of 1,078 publications retrieved from Scopus and Web of Science (2010–2026) was performed, from which 312 high-quality studies were retained following rigorous screening and snowballing procedures. Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) was developed to map causal interdependencies among deformation drivers, while a Python-based Fuzzy Analytical Hierarchy Process (FAHP) quantitatively ranked research emphasis. FAHP results revealed that triggering factors accounted for 45.1% of global research attention, followed by preconditioning factors (38.7%) and data-processing factors (16.2%). Groundwater level fluctuation exhibited the highest global relative weight (0.150), followed by seismic activity (0.132) and precipitation (0.121). The findings highlight critical underrepresentation of sensor and processing uncertainties, emphasizing the need for physics-informed neural networks, explainable artificial intelligence, and advanced multi-sensor data fusion for scalable and interpretable geohazard mitigation. The review provides a strategic roadmap for future research, emphasizing the integration of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), model interpretability, and open-science principles for planetary-scale geohazard mitigation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述聚焦 InSAR、GNSS 和多源地球观测数据推动下的地表形变机器学习与深度学习分析。作者提出由预制约因素、触发因素和数据处理因素构成的三分框架，并对 2010—2026 年相关文献进行了系统计量分析和筛选。研究还引入故障树分析和模糊分析方法，以梳理形变驱动因素之间的因果关联并支持不确定性-aware 的优先级评估。

articles.title: Observation of Macroscopic Gravitational Symmetry Breaking via Extreme Radial Stress
articles.title_zh: 通过极端径向应力观测宏观引力对称性破缺
articles.abstract: This study investigates the under-explored contribution of internal radial stress to macroscopic gravitational potentials. We utilize a novel, precision-damped torsion balance apparatus designed to isolate and measure gravitational perturbations induced by radial stress within rapidly rotating macroscopic masses, rigorously controlling for acoustic, thermal, and electromagnetic variables. Our findings reveal a measurable anisotropic influence along the plane of rotation that diverges from standard weak-field predictions. The measured potential exhibits an anomalous kinematic scaling (∝ ω!) distinct from baseline system noise, with a statistical significance exceeding 5σ. This anisotropy suggests a potential coupling between the internal stress-energy tensor and the local spacetime metric that is not fully accounted for in standard linear approximations. If this phenomenological stress-metric coupling scales macroscopically, it provides a natural, non-linear mechanism for observed rotational gravitational symmetry breaking, offering a potential localized solution to astrophysical discrepancies such as the anomalous pulsar braking index (𝑛 < 3) and equatorial spacecraft flyby anomalies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用精密阻尼扭秤装置，尝试隔离并测量快速旋转宏观质量内部径向应力引起的引力扰动。作者报告了沿旋转平面的可测各向异性影响，称其偏离标准弱场预测，并具有区别于系统噪声的运动学标度特征。论文提出这可能反映内部应力-能量张量与局域时空度规之间的宏观耦合，但相关结论需要进一步独立验证和理论检验。

articles.title: Performance Comparison of Neural Network Approaches for Electric Potential Field Generation in Surface Ion Traps
articles.title_zh: 表面离子阱中电势场生成的神经网络方法性能比较
articles.abstract: Quantum computing is now one of the most promising areas in modern computational science. Trapped ions are considered one of the best candidates for qubits because they have long coherence times and allow high-fidelity operations. Surface electrode ion traps are especially important because they support scalable quantum charge-coupled device architectures for advanced quantum computations. However, common simulation methods for trap design, such as the finite element method, are computationally expensive and slow down prototyping and optimization. In this paper, we compare three neural network architectures for fast electric potential field generation in surface ion traps: a Convolutional Neural Network, a Fourier Neural Operator, and Fully-Connected Layers. Our results show that the Fourier Neural Operator gives the best overall performance. It reaches an average effective potential field error of only 0.02% and is about 10 times faster than conventional methods. These results suggest that the Fourier Neural Operator is a strong candidate for trap design and ion dynamics simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究比较了三种用于表面电极离子阱电势场快速生成的神经网络架构：卷积神经网络、傅里叶神经算子和全连接网络。传统有限元等仿真方法计算成本较高，会限制离子阱设计与优化效率。结果显示，傅里叶神经算子整体表现最佳，具有较低平均有效势场误差，并显著快于常规方法，因而适合用于离子阱设计和离子动力学模拟。

Sheverdyaeva, Paul Noël, and Pietro Gambardella Bismuth is a promising spin current generator owing to its strong spin–orbit coupling, spin-polarized surface states, and large intrinsic spin Hall conductivity predicted by theory. articles.title: Gaussian Field Representations for Turbulent Flow: Compression, Scale Separation, and Physical Fidelity
articles.title_zh: 湍流流场的高斯场表示：压缩、尺度分离与物理保真度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.16449v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Representing turbulent flow fields in a compact yet physically faithful form remains a central challenge in computational fluid dynamics. We propose a continuous parametric representation based on localized Gaussian primitives, in which the velocity field is modeled as a superposition of kernels with learnable positions, amplitudes, and scales. This formulation yields a compact, grid-independent encoding while enabling evaluation of derived quantities such as vorticity and enstrophy. The approach is assessed on three-dimensional Taylor-Green vortex fields spanning stages from smooth flow to fully developed turbulence. We quantify the compression-accuracy trade-off using both primary variables and derivative-sensitive diagnostics. The baseline isotropic formulation achieves high velocity accuracy at compression ratios exceeding 1e3-1e4, but exhibits substantial enstrophy degradation due to loss of small-scale structure. To address this limitation, we investigate structure-aware extensions including adaptive placement, multi-resolution kernels, and anisotropic Gaussians. The anisotropic formulation provides the most consistent improvement, better aligning with elongated vortical structures and recovering intermediate- and high-wavenumber content, while other strategies yield modest gains. A compact-support Beta basis improves enstrophy in some cases but introduces localized artifacts. Overall, the results indicate that the main limitation of baseline Gaussian representations lies in geometric expressiveness rather than parameter count. The proposed framework provides a compact, interpretable, and continuous representation of turbulent flows, and establishes a foundation for structure-aware and physics-informed flow compression.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出一种基于局域高斯基元的连续参数化表示，用可学习的位置、振幅和尺度叠加来描述湍流速度场。该方法可实现紧凑且与网格无关的编码，并支持计算涡量、熵产相关量等派生物理量。作者在三维 Taylor-Green 涡数据上评估压缩精度权衡，发现各向同性基线在速度场上可获得很高压缩率和精度，但会损失小尺度结构；进一步的自适应、多分辨率和各向异性高斯扩展可改善物理保真度，其中各向异性形式表现更稳定。
authors: Dhanush Vittal Shenoy, Steven H. Frankel

articles.title: Artificial-Intelligence-Guided Electrochemical Oxidation for Destroying Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances (PFAS) in Drinking-Water Networks: A Transferable Framework from the United States to Peru
articles.title_zh: 人工智能引导的电化学氧化用于破坏饮用水网络中的全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）：从美国到秘鲁的可迁移框架
articles.abstract: Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), colloquially known as "forever chemicals," persist in drinking-water sources worldwide and resist removal by conventional treatment trains. Electrochemical oxidation (EO) on boron-doped diamond (BDD) and related non-active anodes is among the few technologies capable of mineralizing PFAS rather than merely transferring it between phases, but its energy demand and operational optimization remain limiting factors, particularly for chain-length-dependent degradation kinetics. This methodological and technology-transfer article proposes and specifies an Artificial-Intelligence-guided Electrochemical Oxidation (AI-EO) framework for PFAS destruction in drinking-water networks, integrating an XGBoost-LSTM ensemble for real-time prediction and control of operational parameters (current density, flow rate, residence time) with a filter-press BDD/SS316L reactor. We synthesize quantitative degradation-efficiency data reported in the peer-reviewed literature, detail the reactor engineering, instrumentation, chemical reaction pathways, and machine-learning architecture, and construct a quantitative comparison matrix contrasting United States implementation conditions (regulatory limits, energy infrastructure, capital availability) with the Peruvian context. We then derive an evidence-based, four-phase technology-transfer roadmap prioritizing public spaces and critical infrastructure (community kiosks, schools, health posts) in Lima and provincial Empresas Prestadoras de Servicios (EPS). The framework identifies energy intensity, electrode cost, and the absence of a national PFAS monitoring baseline as the principal barriers to adoption in Peru, and proposes solar-hybrid power, locally sourced mixed-metal-oxide (MMO) electrodes, and university-EPS partnerships as mitigation pathways. All cited efficiency data, degradation constants, and regulatory limits are drawn from verifiable, DOI-indexed sources; no primary wet-laboratory results are claimed. The framework is intended as a reproducible engineering and policy blueprint for pilot validation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种用于饮用水网络中PFAS降解的人工智能引导电化学氧化框架，结合硼掺杂金刚石等非活性阳极反应器与机器学习控制策略。框架采用XGBoost-LSTM集成模型实时预测和调控电流密度、流速与停留时间等参数，以提升不同链长PFAS的矿化效率并降低能耗。文章还综合文献中的降解数据，讨论反应器工程、仪器配置、反应路径和技术从美国向秘鲁等场景转移的适用性。
