Material properties for these alloys computed from atomistic simulations using standard interatomic potentials (IPs) exhibit a strong dependence on local ordering that is captured by simulations with effective LOAA IPs, but not the original AA method. The advantage of LOAA is that it requires smaller system sizes to achieve statistically converged results and therefore enables the simulation of complex materials, such as high-entropy alloys, at a fraction of the computational cost of standard IPs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文扩展了用于随机合金的有效平均原子方法，引入来自偏径向分布函数的信息以描述局域有序或短程有序效应，提出局域有序平均原子方法。作者基于统计力学进行了严格推导，并在非化学计量二元二维六角晶体以及三维 FeNiCr 和 NiAl 合金中通过蒙特卡罗获得的基态进行验证。结果表明，标准原子间势模拟所得材料性质对局域有序高度敏感，而新方法能够捕捉这种依赖，并以更小体系尺寸获得统计收敛，从而降低复杂合金模拟成本。
authors: Chloe A. Zeller, Ronald E. Miller, Ellad B. Tadmor

articles.title: Two-Dimensional Altermagnetism in Epitaxial CrSb Ultrathin Films
articles.title_zh: 外延 CrSb 超薄膜中的二维交替磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.12344v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnets constitute an emerging class of collinear magnets that exhibit zero net magnetization yet host spin-split electronic bands arising from non-relativistic spin-space-group symmetries. Realization of altermagnetism in the two-dimensional (2D) limit remains an outstanding challenge because dimensional reduction suppresses kZ dispersion and destabilizes the symmetry operations essential for spin compensation. Here, we investigate ultrathin CrSb films grown epitaxially on Bi2Te3 substrate and uncover the evolution of altermagnetism in the 2D limit. Scanning tunneling microscopy (STM), quasiparticle interference (QPI), angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), and density functional theory (DFT) calculations show that interfacial symmetry breaking in the one-unit-cell (1 UC) limit gives rise to localized electronic states and uncompensated magnetic moments. These interfacial effects become weakened from 7/4 UC, accompanied by the recovery of a bulk-like coordination environment and the emergence of altermagnetic electronic characteristics. Our results show that the essential altermagnetic electronic structure of CrSb survives at a thickness of only ~1.05 nm, demonstrating the robustness of altermagnetism in the 2D limit and opening opportunities for integrating stray-field-free spin order into low dimensional spintronic architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了生长在 Bi2Te3 衬底上的 CrSb 超薄膜，探索交替磁性在二维极限中的演化。通过扫描隧道显微镜、准粒子干涉、角分辨光电子能谱和密度泛函理论计算，作者发现单晶胞厚度下界面破缺对称性会产生局域电子态和未补偿磁矩。随着厚度增加至 7/4 晶胞及以上，界面效应减弱，类似体相的配位环境恢复，并出现交替磁性的电子结构特征，说明 CrSb 的关键交替磁性质可在超薄极限中逐步建立。
authors: Keren Li, Yuzhong Hu, Yue Li, Ruohang Xu, Shaozhong Ma, Heping Li, Kun Liu, Chen Liu, Lu Cao, Jincheng Zhuang, Yee Sin Ang, Jiaou Wang, Haifeng Feng, Weichang Hao, Yi Du

articles.title: Microstructural Insights into Fast Ion Transport in Solid Electrolytes via Multiscale Modeling
articles.title_zh: 通过多尺度建模揭示固态电解质中快速离子传输的微观结构机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.18630v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Improving solid electrolytes is critical for high-performance all-solid-state batteries, yet the microstructural features that enable fast ion transport remain poorly understood. Here, we use multiscale modeling to resolve polycrystalline ion transport from atomic-scale hopping at grain boundaries to continuum-scale percolation, thereby providing insights into realistic solid-electrolyte microstructures. Accurate lightweight machine-learning potentials -- developed via closed-loop active learning for exemplar argyrodites Li₆PS₅X, X in Cl, Br, I -- are employed to integrate molecular dynamics with finite element simulations. We find that diffusion barriers of the anion-ordered bulk scale linearly with anion radius. Grain boundaries exert opposite effects depending on the bulk: enhancing ion diffusion in low-diffusivity phases but suppressing it in fast-diffusing ones. Li₆PS₅I exhibits non-Arrhenius transport behavior consistent with experimental observations. Our results clarify the pivotal role of grain boundaries in ion transport and guide a priori microstructural design of advanced solid electrolytes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用多尺度建模，从晶界处的原子尺度跳跃到连续尺度渗流过程，解析多晶固态电解质中的离子传输。作者针对银硫锗矿型 Li6PS5X（X 为 Cl、Br、I）通过闭环主动学习构建轻量且准确的机器学习势，并将分子动力学与有限元模拟结合。结果表明，阴离子有序体相的扩散势垒与阴离子半径近似线性相关；晶界对扩散的影响取决于体相扩散能力，可增强低扩散相中的离子扩散，但抑制快速扩散相中的传输，且 Li6PS5I 表现出与实验一致的非 Arrhenius 输运行为。
authors: Yongliang Ou, Lena Scholz, Sanath Keshav, Yuji Ikeda, Marvin Kraft, Sergiy Divinski, Rafael Gómez-Bombarelli, Wolfgang G. Zeier, Felix Fritzen, Blazej Grabowski

articles.title: Valence Modifications in Hygroscopic VI3 Degraded Crystals via Soft X-Ray Synchrotron Radiation
articles.title_zh: 利用同步辐射软 X 射线研究吸湿性 VI3 降解晶体中的价态修饰
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.05924v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Among van der Waals crystals, transition metal trihalide VI3 has driven attention for its magnetic and orbital properties. However, its chemical instability under ambient conditions make its exploitation challenging for technological implementation. In this context, here we show how synchrotron radiation soft X-rays partially restore stoichiometric chemical and electronic properties of VI3 crystals. By combining X-ray absorption and X-ray photoemission spectroscopies, we show as-cleaved and aged (in ultra-high vacuum conditions) chemical degradation of VI3 crystal surface, with the formation of vanadates, and its, at least partial, recovery under high-flux soft X-ray beam exposure, revealing that superficial hygroscopic contamination couples relatively weakly to the crystal surface.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注范德华晶体 VI3 在环境条件下化学不稳定所带来的表面降解问题，并考察同步辐射软 X 射线对其化学和电子性质的影响。通过 X 射线吸收谱和 X 射线光电子能谱，作者发现新鲜解理及在超高真空中老化的 VI3 表面会发生化学降解并形成钒酸盐。高通量软 X 射线照射可至少部分恢复其化学计量和电子性质，表明表面吸湿性污染与晶体表面的耦合相对较弱。
authors: A. De Vita, V. Polewczyk, G. Panaccione, G. Vinai

articles.title: Real-Time Dynamics in Two Dimensions with Tensor Network States via Time-Dependent Variational Monte Carlo
articles.title_zh: 利用含时变分蒙特卡罗与张量网络态模拟二维实时动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.06768v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reliably simulating two-dimensional many-body quantum dynamics with projected entangled pair states (PEPS) has long been a difficult challenge. In this work, we overcome this barrier for low-energy quantum dynamics by developing a stable and efficient time-dependent variational Monte Carlo (tVMC) framework for PEPS. By analytically removing all gauge redundancies of the PEPS manifold and exploiting tensor locality, we obtain a numerically well-conditioned tVMC equation. This enables long-time evolution in previously inaccessible regimes. We explain how the difficulties in the traditional approach, particularly those associated with gauge redundancies, are resolved within tVMC. We demonstrate the power and generality of the method through five representative real-time local quench dynamics in two dimensions: (I) chiral edge propagation in a free-fermion Chern insulator; (II) vison propagation in a pure Z2 gauge theory; (III) vison confinement dynamics in a Z2 lattice gauge theory coupled to Higgs field; (IV) fractionalized charge transport in a fractional Chern insulator; and (V) superfluidity and critical velocity in interacting bosons. All simulations are performed on >= 10 x 10 lattices with evolution times beyond T = 10 using modest computational resources. In addition, we also simulate the paradigmatic dynamics of the Ising model following a global quench at the critical transverse field, and obtain, with modest bond dimension, agreement with previous results. The method significantly extends the reach of classical tensor-network simulations for studying elementary excitations in quantum many-body systems in real-time and provides a valuable computational counterpart to emerging quantum simulators. As a by-product in the development, we also present a new form of minSR, which is more stable and offers a new perspective on tVMC.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种用于投影纠缠对态（PEPS）的稳定高效含时变分蒙特卡罗框架，以模拟二维低能多体量子实时动力学。作者通过解析消除 PEPS 流形中的规范冗余并利用张量局域性，获得数值条件良好的演化方程，从而实现以往难以达到的长时间演化。方法在多个二维局域淬火问题中得到展示，包括陈绝缘体边缘传播、Z2 规范理论中的 vison 动力学、分数量子陈绝缘体中的分数化电荷输运等。

articles.title: Quantum-inspired Chemical Rule for Discovering Topological Materials
articles.title_zh: 用于发现拓扑材料的量子启发化学规则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.13115v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Topological materials exhibit unique electronic structures that underpin both fundamental quantum phenomena and next-generation technologies, yet their discovery remains constrained by the high computational cost of first-principles calculations and the slow, resource-intensive nature of experimental synthesis. Recent machine-learning approaches, such as the heuristic topogivity rule, offer a data-driven pre-screening tool by quantifying each element's intrinsic tendency toward topological behavior. Here, we develop a hybrid quantum-classical neural network (HQCNN) that extends this rule into a quantum-inspired formulation. Within this framework, the HQCNN maps compositional descriptors to quantum probability amplitudes, naturally introducing pairwise inter-element correlations inaccessible to classical heuristics. The physical validity of these correlations is substantiated by constructing an equivalent complex-valued neural network (CVNN), confirming both the consistency and interpretability of the formulation. Retaining the simplicity of chemical reasoning while embedding quantum-native features, our quantum-inspired rule enables efficient and generalizable topological classification. High-throughput screening combined with first-principles (DFT) validation reveals five previously unreported topological compounds, demonstrating the enhanced predictive power and physical insight afforded by quantum-inspired heuristics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对拓扑材料发现中第一性原理计算昂贵、实验筛选缓慢的问题，提出一种混合量子-经典神经网络来扩展已有的元素拓扑倾向性规则。该框架将成分描述符映射为量子概率振幅，从而自然引入元素间成对关联，并通过等价复值神经网络验证其一致性与可解释性。该量子启发规则在保留化学直觉简洁性的同时嵌入量子特征，用于更高效地预筛选潜在拓扑材料。
authors: Xinyu Xu, Rajibul Islam, Ghulam Hussain, Yangming Huang, Xiaoguang Li, Pavlo O. Dral, Arif Ullah, Ming Yang

articles.title: Lanthanide Ion Electronic Structure Controls Magnetic Excitations in Topological Quantum Ferrimagnets LnMn₆Sn₆ (Ln = Tb, Dy, Ho)
articles.title_zh: 镧系离子电子结构调控拓扑量子亚铁磁体 LnMn₆Sn₆（Ln = Tb、Dy、Ho）中的磁激发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.17715v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The LnMn₆Sn₆ family of topological magnets is a promising platform for next-generation spintronic and magnonic technologies. However, the influence of the lanthanide ion (Ln³⁺) on the excited-state spin dynamics, or magnons, remains a critical knowledge gap. Here, we present the first comparative study of the magnetic dynamics in LnMn₆Sn₆ materials (Ln = Tb, Dy, Ho) using Brillouin light scattering. Our findings reveal a direct correlation between the lanthanide ion's intrinsic properties and the magnon behavior. We demonstrate that the magnon frequency in the absence of an applied magnetic field is primarily dictated by the strength of the lanthanide exchange coupling, as modeled by its relationship with the de Gennes factor. The response of the magnon to an applied field is influenced by material's gyromagnetic ratio and the overall anisotropy of the material, which are dictated by total angular momentum and the anisotropy of the lanthanide sublattice, respectively. These results establish that simple lanthanide substitution provides a powerful and predictable method for tuning magnon properties, enabling the rational design of materials for advanced technological applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用布里渊光散射首次比较了 LnMn₆Sn₆（Ln = Tb、Dy、Ho）系列拓扑磁体中的磁动力学，重点考察镧系离子对磁振子行为的影响。结果表明，零外场下的磁振子频率主要由镧系离子交换耦合强度决定，并可用其与 de Gennes 因子的关系来描述。外加磁场下的响应则受材料旋磁比和整体各向异性影响，说明通过替换镧系元素可预测地调控磁振子性质。
authors: Kelsey A. Collins, Jacob Pfund, Michael R. Page, Menka Jain, Michael A. Susner, Michael J. Newburger

articles.title: Finite-momentum bound pairs of two electrons in an altermagnetic metal
articles.title_zh: 交替磁性金属中两个电子的有限动量束缚对
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.12905v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We solve the two-electron problem on a square lattice with d-wave altermagnetism, considering both on-site and nearest-neighbor attractive interactions. The altermagnetic spin-splitting in the single-particle dispersion naturally gives rise to a ground state of two-electron bound pairs with nonzero center-of-mass momentum. The emergence of finite-momentum bound states suggests that altermagnetic spin splitting may favor pairing at nonzero center-of-mass momentum, which could be relevant for proposed Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) superconductivity in altermagnetic systems. Additionally, when the nearest-neighbor attraction is strong, the resulting finite-momentum bound pairs exhibit a mixture of both spin-singlet and spin-triplet characteristics, suggesting the possibility of unconventional superconductors, where spin-singlet and spin-triplet pairings coexist.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究具有 d 波交替磁性的方格子两电子问题，并考虑 onsite 与最近邻吸引相互作用。单粒子色散中的交替磁自旋劈裂会自然导致具有非零质心动量的两电子束缚对基态，这可能与交替磁体系中提出的 FFLO 超导有关。当最近邻吸引较强时，有限动量束缚对还呈现自旋单态与三重态混合特征，提示可能存在非常规超导配对。
authors: Hui Hu, Zhao Liu, Jia Wang, Xia-Ji Liu

articles.title: Field-induced transitions from incommensurate to commensurate phases in helical antiferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 螺旋反铁磁体中磁场诱导的非公度相到公度相转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.22343v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Heisenberg antiferromagnet with an easy-plane anisotropy is discussed in which a magnetic spiral is induced by Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction and/or frustration of the exchange coupling. The distortion of the spiral by small in-plane magnetic field is described analytically. It is found that the field can gradually change the vector of the magnetic structure bf k₀ and can produce transitions between phases with incommensurate and commensurate magnetic orderings when bf k₀ is close to bf g/n, where bf g is a reciprocal lattice vector and n is integer. Analytical expressions for critical fields are derived for n=2, 3, and 4. Application of the theory to the triangular-lattice compound m̊ RbFe(MoO₄₎₂ is discussed alongside its potential applicability to other materials. As a by-product of the main consideration, model parameters are found which describe more accurately the full set of available experimental data suggested before for m̊ RbFe(MoO₄₎₂.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文讨论具有易平面各向异性的海森堡反铁磁体，其中磁螺旋由 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用和/或交换挫折诱导。作者解析描述了小的面内磁场对螺旋结构的扭曲，并发现磁场可逐渐改变磁结构矢量，在其接近倒格矢分数值时诱导非公度与公度磁有序相之间的转变。文中给出了 n=2、3、4 情形的临界场解析表达式，并讨论了其在三角晶格化合物 RbFe(MoO₄)₂ 等材料中的应用。
authors: P. T. Bolokhova, A. V. Syromyatnikov

articles.title: Displacive quantum critical point in superconducting hydrides: The case of H₃S
articles.title_zh: 超导氢化物中的位移型量子临界点：H₃S 的情形
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.00833v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: H₃S sulfur hydride has been widely investigated for its high superconducting critical temperature T_c of 203 K at about p_c = 155 GPa. Despite being the precursor of superconducting hydrides, a detailed picture of its structural phase diagram in an extended temperature and pressure range is still missing. To determine it with inclusion of both thermal and quantum effects, we carry out path integral molecular dynamics combined to a MACE neural network potential trained on BLYP density functional theory configurations. The resulting H₃S phase diagram is characterized by the displacive transition between the centrosymmetric Imbar3m and polar R3m phases, which originates from a quantum critical point (QCP) located at p_QCP approx 134 GPa. We show that the experimental T_c peak falls into a centrosymmetric region of large nuclear quantum fluctuations above the displacive QCP, as measured by local phonon Green's functions resolved in imaginary time, where fluctuating moments are at play. We study the critical behavior of the system in the proximity of the QCP by a finite-size scaling analysis, showing that it belongs to the 4D Ising universality class. We finally discuss its implications for the superconducting state.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用路径积分分子动力学结合基于 BLYP 密度泛函数据训练的 MACE 神经网络势，考察 H₃S 在宽温压范围内的结构相图及核量子效应。结果显示，H₃S 的相图由中心对称 Im-3m 相与极性 R3m 相之间的位移型转变主导，其起源于约 134 GPa 的量子临界点。作者指出实验超导临界温度峰值位于该量子临界点以上、具有强核量子涨落的中心对称区域，并通过有限尺寸标度分析研究其临界行为。
authors: Marco Cherubini, Abhishek Raghav, Michele Casula

articles.title: Machine Learning Hamiltonians are Accurate Energy-Force Predictors
articles.title_zh: 机器学习哈密顿量可作为精确的能量-力预测器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.16897v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recently, machine learning Hamiltonian (MLH) models have gained traction as fast approximations of electronic structures such as orbitals and electron densities, while also enabling direct evaluation of energies and forces from their predictions. However, despite their physical grounding, existing Hamiltonian models are evaluated mainly by reconstruction metrics, leaving it unclear how well they perform as energy-force predictors. We address this gap with a benchmark that computes energies and forces directly from predicted Hamiltonians. Within this framework, we propose QHFlow2, a state-of-the-art Hamiltonian model with an SO(2)-equivariant backbone and a two-stage edge update. QHFlow2 achieves 40% lower Hamiltonian error than the previous best model with fewer parameters. Under direct evaluation on MD17/rMD17, it is the first Hamiltonian model to reach NequIP-level force accuracy while achieving up to 20× lower energy MAE. On QH9, QHFlow2 reduces energy error by up to 20× compared to MACE. Finally, we demonstrate that QHFlow2 exhibits consistent scaling behavior with respect to model capacity and data, and that improvements in Hamiltonian accuracy effectively translate into more accurate energy and force computations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作指出，现有机器学习哈密顿量模型多以重构误差评估，尚不清楚其作为能量和力预测器的真实性能。作者建立了直接从预测哈密顿量计算能量与力的基准，并提出 QHFlow2 模型，其采用 SO(2) 等变骨干网络和两阶段边更新机制。结果显示，QHFlow2 在哈密顿量误差、力精度和能量误差方面均显著优于或接近代表性模型，并呈现随模型容量和数据量改善的稳定标度行为。
authors: Seongsu Kim, Chanhui Lee, Yoonho Kim, Seongjun Yun, Honghui Kim, Nayoung Kim, Changyoung Park, Sehui Han, Sungbin Lim, Sungsoo Ahn

articles.title: Inelastic Constitutive Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks: A generalized framework for automated discovery of interpretable inelastic material models
articles.title_zh: 非弹性本构 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络：用于自动发现可解释非弹性材料模型的通用框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.17750v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A key problem of solid mechanics is the identification of the constitutive law of a material, that is, the relation between strain history and stress. Machine learning has lead to considerable advances in this field lately. Here we introduce inelastic Constitutive Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (iCKANs). This novel artificial neural network architecture can discover in an automated manner symbolic constitutive laws describing both the elastic and inelastic behavior of materials. That is, it can translate data from material testing into corresponding elastic and inelastic potential functions in closed mathematical form. We demonstrate the advantages of iCKANs using both synthetic data and experimental data of the viscoelastic polymer materials VHB 4910 and VHB 4905. The results demonstrate that iCKANs accurately capture complex viscoelastic behavior while preserving physical interpretability. It is a particular strength of iCKANs that they can process not only mechanical data but also arbitrary additional information available about a material (e.g., about temperature-dependent behavior). This makes iCKANs a powerful tool to discover in the future also how specific processing or service conditions affect the properties of materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出非弹性本构 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（iCKANs），用于从材料测试数据中自动发现描述弹性与非弹性行为的符号本构规律。该方法可将数据转化为闭式数学形式的弹性和非弹性势函数，兼顾预测精度与物理可解释性。作者通过合成数据以及 VHB 4910、VHB 4905 黏弹性聚合物实验数据验证了该框架，并强调其可融合温度等额外材料信息。
authors: Chenyi Ji, Kian P. Abdolazizi, Hagen Holthusen, Christian J. Cyron, Kevin Linka

articles.title: Emergence of correlation-driven altermagnetism in Hubbard model on geometrically frustrated lattice-clusters
articles.title_zh: 几何挫折晶格团簇 Hubbard 模型中关联驱动交替磁性的涌现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.00536v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the emergence of correlation-driven altermagnetism in simple and extended Hubbard model on geometrically frustrated lattice-clusters using exact diagonalization. By systematically tuning the degree of geometric frustration across different cluster geometries -- including the fully frustrated 3x3 torus, the partially frustrated 2x3 cylinder and the unfrustrated 2x4 cylindrical lattice -- we isolate the necessary conditions for compensated anisotropic spin order. At half-filling on 3x3 lattice, the average altermagnetic spin-response <Δₛₚᵢₙ> remains small despite robust local moment formation, indicating that localized moments alone are insufficient to break directional symmetry. In contrast, the introduction of a single mobile charge carrier (hole or electron) induces a finite <Δₛₚᵢₙ> that increases monotonically with on-site interaction U . This altermagnetic phase is characterized by a d-wave-like alternating sign structure in real-space correlations, a broad momentum-space distribution in the altermagnetic structure factor Sₐₗₘ₍q) and a distinct particle-hole asymmetry with significantly enhanced response for one-electron-doped system. We demonstrate that these correlations remain zero on the unfrustrated 2x4 lattice, establishing geometric frustration as a fundamental prerequisite. The inclusion of nearest-neighbor Coulomb repulsion V weakens the altermagnetic correlations in 3x3 lattice through enhanced electronic localization but facilitates the onset of altermagnetic order in 2x3 lattice beyond a critical threshold. Finally, we show that the anisotropy parameter A is non-zero only for degenerate ground states, revealing that macroscopic symmetry breaking on finite clusters requires a confluence of geometric frustration and ground-state degeneracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用精确对角化研究简单与扩展 Hubbard 模型在几何挫折晶格团簇中的关联驱动交替磁性。通过比较完全挫折、部分挫折和无挫折团簇，作者分析了补偿型各向异性自旋序形成的必要条件。结果表明，半填充时局域磁矩并不足以产生明显交替磁响应，而引入单个可动电荷载流子后会诱导随 onsite 相互作用增强而增大的交替磁响应，并呈现 d 波样实空间符号交替和粒子-空穴不对称性。
authors: Md Fahad Equbal, M. A. H. Ahsan

articles.title: Nuclear-Electronic Quantum Dynamics in a Plasmonic Nanocavity
articles.title_zh: 等离激元纳米腔中的核-电子量子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.12373v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Plasmonic nanocavities are a promising platform for strong light-matter coupling and enhanced spectroscopies at the single-molecule level. These nanoscale environments are challenging to model due to their strongly multimodal character and short cavity lifetimes. Herein, we study the effects of these environments using real-time nuclear-electronic orbital time-dependent density functional theory (RT-NEO-TDDFT) coupled to multiple classical cavity modes in a manner that includes cavity loss. In RT-NEO-TDDFT, the quantum mechanical densities of all electrons and specified nuclei, typically protons, are propagated in real time. We show that a cavity with many modes at different frequencies can be used to probe and modify the nuclear-electronic quantum dynamics of chemical systems. Ultrafast excited-state proton transfer reactions can be probed through the time- and energy-resolved cavity emission of a multimode cavity. Under strong coupling conditions, the cavity can modify the dynamics, in some cases suppressing proton transfer and exhibiting Rabi-like oscillations of the cavity emission due to polariton formation. Utilizing the spectral density for an experimentally relevant nanoparticle-on-mirror single-molecule cavity, we show that an excited-state proton transfer system can evolve into resonance with the cavity even when initially out of resonance with the dominant cavity peak. In this case, tuning the dominant cavity peak to be resonant with the electronic transition leads to polariton formation for a small collection of molecules. The RT-NEO framework with multimode cavities enables the efficient simulation of chemical reactions in physically realistic electromagnetic environments, providing fundamental insights into the dynamics and associated spectroscopic signatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用实时核-电子轨道含时密度泛函理论，并耦合多个含损耗的经典腔模，模拟等离激元纳米腔中的强光-物质相互作用。该方法同时实时传播电子和指定原子核（通常为质子）的量子密度，用于研究多模腔对化学体系核-电子动力学的探测与调控。结果表明，多模腔发射可解析超快激发态质子转移过程，而强耦合条件下腔场可能抑制质子转移并产生与极化激元形成相关的类 Rabi 振荡。
authors: Jonathan H. Fetherolf, Tim Duong, Tao E. Li, Sharon Hammes-Schiffer

articles.title: Quantum Algorithms to Determine Spin-Resolved Exchange-Correlation Potential for Strongly Correlated Materials
articles.title_zh: 用于确定强关联材料自旋分辨交换-关联势的量子算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.16605v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Accurate exchange-correlation (XC) potentials are essential for density functional theory, yet reliable approximations remain challenging for strongly correlated systems. In this work, we present a quantum algorithmic framework to determine spin-resolved XC potentials using a variational quantum eigensolver. Using the Hubbard model as a prototypical strongly correlated lattice system, we prepare ground states in fixed spin sectors through a Hamiltonian variational ansatz initialized from the non-interacting (U=0) Slater-determinant ground state. From the resulting many-body ground states, we extract the XC energy and compute the corresponding spin-resolved XC potentials via finite differences. The accuracy of the approach is benchmarked against exact diagonalization for one- and two-dimensional Hubbard systems of various lattice sizes. We demonstrate that the variational ansatz reproduces the ground-state energies and densities with high fidelity, enabling accurate construction of both magnetic and non-magnetic XC potentials. We analyzed the dependence of the XC potentials on the interaction strength, charge, spin densities, and magnetization. We also present an empirical complexity scaling relation for the computational cost of the method at a fixed fidelity. These results illustrate how quantum computing can be used to construct spin-resolved XC functionals for correlated lattice models, providing a potential pathway for improving density functional approximations in strongly correlated materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种基于变分量子本征求解器的量子算法框架，用于确定强关联体系中的自旋分辨交换-关联势。作者以 Hubbard 模型为原型，通过哈密顿量变分 Ansatz 在固定自旋扇区制备基态，并由多体基态提取交换-关联能，再通过有限差分计算自旋分辨势。与精确对角化的比较表明，该方法可高保真再现一维和二维 Hubbard 系统的基态能量与密度，从而构造磁性和非磁性交换-关联势。
authors: H. Arslan Hashim, Volodymyr M. Turkowski, Eduardo R. Mucciolo

articles.title: An integrated theoretical and numerical approach to understand modern experiments on quantum magnetism
articles.title_zh: 理解现代量子磁性实验的理论与数值一体化方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.16820v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In recent decades, the study of quantum magnets, which feature unconventional behaviour such as exotic quantum phase transitions and quantum spin liquids, and unconventional magnetic states of matter, has made remarkable progress. However, each of the three foundational pillars -- numerical simulations, analytical methods and, to a lesser extent, materials synthesis and experiments -- often tends to view itself as the primary driver of the field. Even though the need for collaboration among theory, numerics and experiment to understand the complex phases of quantum magnets is well established, in our view there remains a persistent perception from experts in one area that the other two serve merely as supporting tools, primarily useful for validating the dominant ideas of one speciality, and less relevant to shaping the underlying scientific narrative. We refer to this mindset as the "pride and prejudice" in modeling and understanding modern quantum magnetism. In this Perspective, we advocate for a different, more integrated approach to overcome the challenges faced by quantum magnetism researchers. We argue that this alternative mindset has already started to advance the understanding of several important quantum magnetic models and their materials realizations.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇观点文章讨论量子磁性研究中数值模拟、解析理论以及材料合成与实验之间的关系，强调单一领域主导视角可能限制对复杂量子磁体的理解。作者将这种倾向概括为现代量子磁性建模中的“傲慢与偏见”，并主张以更紧密的一体化方法推动领域发展。文章呼吁理论、数值和实验共同塑造科学问题与解释框架，以更有效地研究奇异量子相变、量子自旋液体和非常规磁性态。
authors: Zi Yang Meng, Cristian D. Batista, Shiliang Li

articles.title: Self-consistent vertex corrected GW with static and dynamic screening using tensor hypercontraction: assessment of molecular charged excitations
articles.title_zh: 采用张量超收缩的静态与动态屏蔽自洽顶角修正 GW：分子带电激发评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.25581v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate self-consistent vertex corrections to the GW self-energy for ionization potentials (IPs) and electron affinities (EAs). We benchmark IPs against ΔCCSD(T) references in the G₀W₀Γ29 and GW100 sets and compare GW100 EAs with EOM-CCSD references. Because many anions are metastable, these addition energies are model quantities and should not be interpreted as experimental EAs. Tensor hypercontraction (THC) of the Coulomb integrals enables efficient self-consistent GWΓΣ implementations, where vertex corrections are included only in the self-energy. We establish a hierarchy of vertex-corrected self-energies relative to scGW, ordered from least to most negative as SOX > SOSEX > G3W2 > 2SOSEX > scGW. Equivalently, the absolute magnitude increases along this sequence. This trend follows an effective-screening picture, in which increasing screening progressively reduces exchange contributions. Static and dynamic variants show consistent differences due to the frequency dependence of the screened interaction. Across all methods, vertex corrections act as an approximately frequency-uniform self-energy renormalization rather than altering its spectral structure. In terms of accuracy, scGWΓΣ does not uniformly improve IPs or the EA model quantities over scGW. For IPs, SOX and SOSEX usually degrade performance, whereas 2SOSEX and G3W2 remain close to scGW, with only marginal improvements for selected systems at higher cost. Although the tested variants reduce EA MAEs, this should not be interpreted as a general improvement for physical anions because many nominal EA states are metastable. These results indicate that generic vertex insertions are insufficient to outperform scGW; systematic improvements require designed diagrammatic approximations combined with efficient tensor factorization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了用于电离势和电子亲和能计算的 GW 自能自洽顶角修正，并在 G₀W₀Γ29、GW100 等分子测试集上与高精度耦合簇参考结果比较。作者利用库仑积分的张量超收缩实现高效的自洽 GWΓΣ 计算，其中顶角修正仅加入自能。结果建立了相对于 scGW 的一系列顶角修正自能层级，并指出这些修正主要表现为近似频率均匀的自能重整化；同时，静态与动态屏蔽版本因屏蔽相互作用的频率依赖而存在系统差异。
authors: Munkhorgil Wang, Ming Wen, Pavel Pokhilko, Chia-Nan Yeh, Miguel A. Morales, Dominika Zgid

articles.title: Dielectric, magnetic, and magnetodielectric behaviors of BaFe12O19 hexaferrite modulated by Mn and Ti substitutions
articles.title_zh: Mn 和 Ti 取代调控 BaFe12O19 六角铁氧体的介电、磁性与磁介电行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.04620v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We prepared Mn- and Ti mono-doped and co-doped BaFe12O19 hexaferrites via solid-state reaction to investigate the interplay between magnetic and dielectric properties. Mn2+ ions preferentially occupy the 4f2 and 2b sites, while Ti4+ ions mainly substitute the Fe3+ ions at 4f1 and 12k sites as revealed by the Raman spectroscopy and formation energy. Pure BaFe12O19 exhibits ferrimagnetism. The hexaferrites related to Ti doping have noncollinear longitudinal conical spin order at low temperatures, where BaFe6Mn3Ti3O19 retains this spin order up to room temperature. Ti4+ substitution at 4f1 and 12k sites plays a pivotal role in stabilizing the noncollinear conical spin order through adjusting the superexchange interactions and reducing the uniaxial magnetocrystalline anisotropy along the c-axis. The magnetic response exhibits two distinct transition temperatures because Ti4+ ions interrupt the magnetic superexchange interactions with two inequivalent exchange integrals. Pure BaFe12O19 presents a quantum paraelectric behavior at low temperatures, which is disrupted by Mn-Ti co-doping due to the decoupling of electric dipoles within the triangular bipyramid. Electron hopping and polaronic effects dominate the dielectric response at 10-50 K, while Maxwell-Wagner interfacial polarization and electron hopping contribute to dielectric dispersion at higher temperatures. The negative MD effect of pure BaFe12O19 and BaFe6Mn3Ti3O19 at 10 K originates from spin-phonon coupling and electric polarization induced by noncollinear spin order under magnetic field, respectively. The Mn-Ti co-doped samples achieve relatively higher MD responses at low magnetic fields. In higher temperatures, the MD effect arises mainly from the magnetic field modulation of the electron hopping with non-intrinsic interfacial polarization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作通过固相反应制备 Mn、Ti 单掺杂及共掺杂 BaFe12O19 六角铁氧体，研究磁性与介电性质之间的耦合。拉曼光谱和形成能分析表明，Mn2+ 与 Ti4+ 倾向占据不同 Fe 位点，其中 Ti4+ 取代对稳定低温非共线纵向锥形自旋序起关键作用，部分共掺杂样品可将该自旋序保持至室温。研究还显示，Ti 掺杂会改变超交换相互作用并引入两个磁转变温度，而 Mn-Ti 共掺杂会破坏纯 BaFe12O19 的低温量子顺电行为。
authors: Xiao-Fan Zhang, Yang Yang, Ze-Qing Guo, Li Lv, Can Gao, Jian-Ping Zhou, Xiao-ming Chen

articles.title: Bound-State Spectra of a Lifshitz-Type Dirac Equation in (2+1) Dimensions
articles.title_zh: （2+1）维 Lifshitz 型 Dirac 方程的束缚态谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.09249v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate a Dirac-type equation in (2+1) dimensions modified by Lifshitz spatial derivatives with dynamical exponent z=2, focusing on the spectral properties of bound-states under radial confinement. Analytical solutions are obtained for constant backgrounds, hard-wall confinement, and harmonic potentials, while logarithmic confinement is treated numerically via the Numerov method and complemented by a semiclassical WKB analysis. The resulting spectra exhibit characteristic scaling laws governed by the Lifshitz parameter b, including E - M propto b/R₀² for hard-wall confinement, E - M propto sqrt2b,ømega for harmonic trapping, and E - M sim α łnsqrtb in the semiclassical regime of logarithmic confinement, where M is a mass scale. These results provide a consistent characterization of how higher-order spatial derivatives modify the energy spectra in two-dimensional Dirac systems and may be relevant for effective descriptions of materials with quadratic low-energy dispersion, such as bilayer graphene and related anisotropic 2D systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究了含有动力学指数 z=2 的 Lifshitz 空间导数修正的（2+1）维 Dirac 型方程，重点分析径向限制下的束缚态能谱。作者对常数背景、硬壁限制和谐振子势给出解析解，并用 Numerov 方法结合 WKB 半经典分析处理对数限制。结果揭示了由 Lifshitz 参数控制的特征能量标度，为理解高阶空间导数如何改变二维 Dirac 系统能谱提供了统一描述，并可能适用于双层石墨烯等具有二次低能色散的材料模型。
authors: Lucas K. R. Queiroz, Van Sérgio Alves, Nilberto Bezerra, Luis Fernández, Francisco Peña

articles.title: Markov Chain Monte Carlo in Tensor Network Representation
articles.title_zh: 张量网络表示中的马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2412.02974v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) is a powerful tool for sampling from complex probability distributions. Despite its versatility, MCMC often suffers from strong autocorrelation and the negative sign problem, leading to slowing down the convergence of statistical error. We propose a novel MCMC formulation based on tensor network representations to reduce the population variance and mitigate these issues systematically. By introducing stochastic projectors into the tensor network framework and employing Markov chain sampling, our method eliminates the systematic error associated with low-rank approximation in tensor contraction while maintaining the high accuracy of the tensor network method. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method on the two-dimensional Ising model, achieving an exponential reduction in statistical error with increasing bond dimension cutoff. Furthermore, we address the sign problem in systems with negative weights, showing significant improvements in average signs as bond dimension cutoff increases. The proposed framework provides a robust solution for accurate statistical estimation in complex systems, paving the way for broader applications in computational physics and beyond.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种基于张量网络表示的马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗新框架，旨在降低总体方差、减弱自相关并缓解负号问题。方法通过在张量网络中引入随机投影算符并结合马尔可夫链采样，避免低秩张量收缩近似带来的系统误差，同时保持张量网络方法的高精度。作者在二维 Ising 模型中展示了随键维截断增大统计误差可显著降低，并在含负权重系统中观察到平均符号的改善。

articles.title: Variational Quantum Eigensolver: A Comparative Analysis of Classical and Quantum Optimizer Methods
articles.title_zh: 变分量子本征求解器：经典与量子优化器方法的比较分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2412.19176v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this study, we investigated the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) application for the Ising model as a testbed model, in which we thoroughly delved into several optimizers, both classical and quantum, and analyzed the extent to which each of these methods would offer a benefit. We then investigated a new combinatorial optimization scheme, termed QN-SPSA+PSR, in which the Fubini-Study metric is approximated within the Quantum Natural Gradient (QN) framework, with its inner gradient estimated by the Simultaneous Perturbation Stochastic Approximation (SPSA), while the outer gradient of the cost function is evaluated exactly by the Parameter-Shift Rule (PSR). The QN-SPSA+PSR method integrates the QN-SPSA computational efficiency with the precise gradient computation of the PSR, improving the stability of QN-SPSA-based and convergence speed per parameter update while maintaining low computational consumption. Our results provide a potential performance improvement in the VQAs' optimization subroutine, even in Quantum Machine Learning's optimization section, and enhance viable paths toward efficient quantum simulations on Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum Computing (NISQ) devices. Additionally, we also conducted a detailed study of quantum circuit ansatz structures in order to find the one that would work best with the Ising model and NISQ, in which we utilized the properties of the investigated model.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以 Ising 模型为测试平台，系统比较了变分量子本征求解器中多种经典和量子优化方法的表现。作者提出名为 QN-SPSA+PSR 的组合优化方案，在量子自然梯度框架中近似 Fubini-Study 度量，用 SPSA 估计内部梯度，并用参数平移规则精确计算代价函数外部梯度。结果表明，该方法兼顾计算效率与梯度精度，可提升优化稳定性和单次参数更新的收敛速度，并对变分量子算法和量子机器学习优化具有潜在价值。
authors: Duc-Truyen Le, Vu-Linh Nguyen, Cong-Ha Nguyen, Quoc-Hung Nguyen, Van-Duy Nguyen

articles.title: Theory of Strongly Correlated Systems: An Introduction to Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Model
articles.title_zh: 强关联体系理论：Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型导论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.07195v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model provides an analytically tractable framework for exotic strongly correlated phases where conventional paradigms like Landau's Fermi liquid theory collapse. This review offers a pedagogical introduction to the SYK physics, highlighting its unique capacity to model strange metals -- systems exhibiting linear-in-temperature resistivity, Planckian dissipation, and quasiparticle breakdown. We systematically construct both Majorana and complex fermion variants, transforming them into training grounds for modern many-body physics techniques, for instance, (1) large-N formulations via disorder averaging and replica symmetry, (2) Schwinger-Dyson and Kadanoff-Baym equations, (3) imaginary time Matsubara formulation, (4) real-time dynamics via Keldysh formalism, and the associated (5) non-perturbative Keldysh contour deformations. These tools lay the foundation for equilibrium thermodynamics, quantum chaos, quench dynamics, and transport in the thermodynamic limit, all within a solvable, chaotic quantum system. Intended as a self-contained resource, the review bridges advanced technical machinery to physical insights, with computational implementations provided. Though principally treating the SYK model as a condensed matter laboratory, we also highlight its profound connection to quantum gravity, woven throughout this work, underscoring how this solvable chaotic fermionic model serves as a lens onto black hole thermodynamics and holographic duality.
articles.abstract_zh: 这是一篇面向教学的综述，介绍 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev（SYK）模型在研究非传统强关联相和奇异金属中的作用。文章系统构造 Majorana 与复费米子版本，并讲解大 N 处理、无序平均、Schwinger-Dyson 与 Kadanoff-Baym 方程、Matsubara 虚时形式、Keldysh 实时形式及非微扰轮廓变形等技术。该综述旨在把现代多体理论工具与可解的混沌量子系统联系起来，用于理解平衡热力学、量子混沌、淬火动力学和输运。

articles.title: PyKirigami: An interactive Python simulator for kirigami structures
articles.title_zh: PyKirigami：用于剪纸结构的交互式 Python 模拟器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.15753v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In recent years, the concept of kirigami has been used in creating deployable structures for various scientific and technological applications. While high-fidelity Finite Element Analysis (FEA) is the standard for analyzing stress distributions and material deformation, it is computationally intensive and often ill-suited for the rapid exploration of vast kinematic configuration spaces. In this work, we develop PyKirigami, a lightweight, open-source Python framework for the efficient deployment simulation of kirigami structures. Unlike continuum mechanics solvers, PyKirigami models tessellations as articulated rigid-body networks, allowing for the real-time simulation of global deployment trajectories and volumetric transformations. The tool incorporates collision detection and interactive actuation, enabling users to validate folding paths and identify geometric locking states in both 2D and 3D topologies. This framework serves as a fast kinematic prototyping tool for kirigami structures, allowing researchers to verify deployment mechanics and self-contacts prior to performing detailed mechanical analysis or physical fabrication.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作开发了开源 Python 框架 PyKirigami，用于高效模拟剪纸结构的展开过程。不同于计算开销较大的连续介质有限元分析，该工具将镶嵌结构建模为铰接刚体网络，从而能够实时模拟整体展开轨迹和体积变换。框架还包含碰撞检测和交互式驱动功能，可帮助研究者在详细力学分析或实物制作前快速验证折叠路径、自接触和几何锁定状态。
authors: Qinghai Jiang, Gary P. T. Choi

articles.title: Many-body post-processing of density functional calculations using the variational quantum eigensolver for Bader charge analysis
articles.title_zh: 利用变分量子本征求解器对密度泛函计算进行多体后处理以开展 Bader 电荷分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.12887v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum chemistry and condensed matter physics are among the most promising applications of quantum computers. Further, estimating properties of a material is crucial to evaluate its industrial applications. To investigate charge distributions of weakly and strongly correlated systems we calculate Bader charges for various periodic systems by solving many-body Hamiltonians using the variational quantum eigensolver. The Hamiltonians are computed from Kohn-Sham orbitals obtained from a prior DFT calculation. We first demonstrate the accuracy of our method on various doped MgH2 supercells. Further, we show that our approach, compared to standard DFT, significantly improves the Bader charge values for strongly correlated transition metal oxides, where we take DFT+U results as a reference. The computational framework behind our many-body calculations, called Dopyqo, is made openly available as a software package.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出将变分量子本征求解器作为密度泛函理论计算后的多体处理工具，用于周期体系的 Bader 电荷分析。作者先从 DFT 得到的 Kohn-Sham 轨道构造多体哈密顿量，再通过 VQE 求解，以研究弱关联和强关联体系中的电荷分布。结果在掺杂 MgH2 超胞中验证了方法精度，并表明其在强关联过渡金属氧化物中相较标准 DFT 可得到更接近 DFT+U 参考的 Bader 电荷；相关计算框架 Dopyqo 也以软件包形式开放。
authors: Erik Schultheis, Alexander Rehn, Gabriel Breuil

articles.title: Two-way coupling in active suspensions suppresses particle accumulation and induces non-monotonic flow stabilization

articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02745v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We experimentally study the two-way coupling between a swarm of centimetre-scale active swimmers (Artemia salina) and an electromagnetically driven quasi-two-dimensional cellular flow. The swimmer loading N and the background forcing E are varied independently across 85 conditions, and the coupled dynamics are characterized through Lagrangian diagnostics built on the attracting Lagrangian coherent structures (LCS) of the flow. In the dilute limit, swimmers accumulate onto the attracting LCS most strongly when their speed is comparable to the flow speed, recovering the mobility-selective accumulation predicted by one-way-coupled simulations at the fixed aspect ratio of A. salina. As the loading increases, this accumulation is progressively suppressed, a collective effect inaccessible to single-swimmer models. The back-action of the swarm on the flow is itself bidirectional and regime-dependent: at low forcing the swarm disorders the attracting-LCS web and scatters the topological critical points of the cellular pattern, whereas at high forcing it reorganizes and reinforces the skeleton. The temporal stability of the skeleton is correspondingly non-monotonic in both N and E, with the conditions of maximal stability migrating systematically through the (N,E) plane. This reinforcement of coherent structures has no counterpart in prior simulations, which reported a predominantly disruptive back-action. Resolving both directions of the coupling shows how collective activity can either erode or reinforce the transport skeleton of a structured flow.
articles.abstract_zh: 该实验研究厘米尺度卤虫活性游动群体与电磁驱动准二维胞状流之间的双向耦合。稀释条件下，游动速度与流速相当时颗粒最容易沿吸引型拉格朗日相干结构累积；随着群体负载增加，这种累积被逐步抑制。研究还发现群体对背景流的反作用依赖于驱动强度：低驱动下会扰乱流动骨架，高驱动下则可能重组并强化其结构。
authors: Miyi Wu, Ziyue Yu, Lei Fang

articles.title: An Investigation of Ozone Formation through its Precursors (CO, NOx, VOC) and its Loss at a Sub-Urban Site of Etawah, India
articles.title_zh: 印度埃塔瓦郊区站点臭氧生成及其前体物（CO、NOx、VOC）与损耗过程研究
articles.abstract: Tropospheric ozone (O₃) is a critical photochemical oxidant and secondary pollutant formed through complex photochemical reactions involving carbon monoxide (CO), nitrogen oxides (NOₓ), and volatile organic compounds (VOCs) in the presence of solar radiation. This study investigates the formation and loss of surface ozone at a semi-urban site in Etawah, Uttar Pradesh, India (26°78’N, 79°02’E). Continuous measurements of O₃, NO, NO₂, CO, and selected VOCs were carried out over seasonal cycles using standard analytical instruments (Thermo Fischer 49i, 42i, T300 and GC-FID). Ozone loss pathways studied include ozonolysis of biogenic and anthropogenic alkenes leading to organic acid formation (formic and acetic acids), and removal by black carbon (BC) aerosols. Statistical modeling using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) was employed to predict ground-level ozone concentrations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察印度北方邦埃塔瓦半城市站点近地面臭氧的形成与损耗机制，重点关注 CO、NOx 和 VOC 等前体物在太阳辐射下的光化学作用。作者开展了臭氧、氮氧化物、一氧化碳和部分 VOC 的连续季节观测，并分析烯烃臭氧化、有机酸生成以及黑碳气溶胶清除等臭氧损耗途径。研究还采用主成分分析和人工神经网络预测地面臭氧浓度。

articles.title: Synergistic Dual-Scaffold Confinement of Co Nanoparticles via Nitrogen-Doped Carbon Networks and Graphene-Templated SBA-15 for Ammonia Decomposition
articles.title_zh: 氮掺杂碳网络与石墨烯模板 SBA-15 对 Co 纳米颗粒的协同双骨架限域用于氨分解
articles.abstract: Thermally induced sintering of Co nanoparticles fundamentally limits the operational longevity of non-noble metal catalysts for ammonia decomposition. Herein, rather than relying on a conventional pore-filling strategy that suffers from inevitable pore blockage and severe metal agglomeration at high metal loadings, we engineered a hierarchical dual-scaffold architecture integrating a graphene-templated SBA-15 (SBA-15-G) matrix with 2-methylimidazole-derived nitrogen-doped carbon (NC) networks. Graphene nanosheets function as a rigid 2D structure-directing agent, substantially enhancing the siliceous framework’s thermal stability. The in situ pyrolysed NC adlayer maximises defect density (Iᴅ/Iɢ= 1.05) and Co–Nx coordination, synergistically anchoring aggregation-prone Co nanoparticles. La thermodynamically stabilises the metal–support boundary via La–O–Si linkages, while K acts as an electron donor to enrich Co active sites, lowering the barrier for the rate-determining N2 desorption step. The optimal Co-La0.02/K0.04@NC2.5-SBA-15-G catalyst achieves 98.2 % NH3 conversion at 550 °C (gas hourly space velocity (GHSV) = 18 000 mL g−1 h−1), with an apparent activation energy (Eₐ) of 88.5 kJ mol−1. The catalyst sustains structural integrity without deactivation over 50 h, providing a generalisable design strategy for ultra-stable thermocatalytic architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对非贵金属 Co 催化剂在氨分解中易因热烧结而失活的问题，设计了由石墨烯模板 SBA-15 和 2-甲基咪唑衍生氮掺杂碳网络组成的层级双骨架结构。石墨烯提高硅基框架热稳定性，氮掺杂碳层通过缺陷和 Co–Nx 配位锚定 Co 纳米颗粒，同时 La 和 K 分别稳定界面并调节电子结构。优化催化剂在 550 °C 下实现高氨转化率并表现出较低表观活化能，显示出良好的抗烧结与催化性能。

articles.title: Transparent and Flexible Trilayer Graphene–InP Schottky Photodetectors for Near-Infrared Sensing and Field-Deployable Power Grid Monitoring
articles.title_zh: 用于近红外传感和现场电网监测的透明柔性三层石墨烯–InP 肖特基光探测器
articles.abstract: Near-infrared photodetectors operating at the telecommunication wavelength of 1.55 µm play a central role in optical sensing and monitoring systems deployed in complex industrial environments. In this work, we report a transparent and mechanically flexible trilayer graphene–InP Schottky photodetector designed for broadband near-infrared sensing and validated under real field conditions on active power transmission lines. The device is fabricated by transferring high-quality trilayer graphene onto an InP thin film, forming a uniform Schottky junction that enables efficient photocarrier separation and strongly suppresses dark current. Optical characterization reveals an average transmittance exceeding 85% in the visible spectrum (400–700 nm), while electrical measurements demonstrate an ultra-low reverse dark current on the order of 10⁻¹⁵ A at − 1 V. Under 1.55 µm illumination, the photodetector achieves a peak responsivity of 1.76 A W⁻¹ and a specific detectivity of approximately 1.2 × 10¹³ Jones. Mechanical reliability tests show that more than 90% of the initial responsivity is retained after 1,000 bending cycles at a bending radius of 5 mm, confirming the suitability of the device for flexible and conformal deployment. Field experiments conducted on live high-voltage transmission lines verify stable near-infrared signal detection for corona discharge monitoring and fault-related optical emission sensing. The system operates autonomously by harvesting electromagnetic energy from the surrounding power line environment, eliminating the need for external power sources or battery replacement. The combination of high near-infrared responsivity, optical transparency, mechanical durability, and self-powered field operation establishes the graphene–InP Schottky photodetector as a promising platform for infrared sensing in smart power grid and distributed monitoring applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了一种透明且机械柔性的三层石墨烯–InP 肖特基光探测器，面向 1.55 微米通信波段近红外传感及复杂工业环境中的现场监测。器件通过将高质量三层石墨烯转移至 InP 薄膜上形成均匀肖特基结，从而实现有效光生载流子分离并降低暗电流。测试显示其具有高可见光透过率、低反向暗电流、较高响应度和探测率，并在多次弯折后保持大部分初始性能。

articles.title: Research on 3D Spatial Localization and Prediction of Deep Concealed Ore Bodies Based on Graph Neural Networks and Multi- Source Geological Constraints
articles.title_zh: 基于图神经网络与多源地质约束的深部隐伏矿体三维空间定位与预测研究
articles.abstract: Spatial localization and prediction of deep concealed ore bodies is a major technical challenge in mineral resource exploration. Deep ore bodies exhibit strong spatial heterogeneity due to superimposed multi-stage geological processes. Sparse borehole data and high geological uncertainty further limit the applicability of conventional prediction methods. Existing approaches rely mainly on statistical interpolation and data-driven learning in Euclidean space. They struggle to capture spatial topological relationships among geological elements and cannot ensure geological plausibility under small-sample conditions. To address these issues, this paper constructs a graph-learning prediction framework for 3D spatial localization of deep concealed ore bodies. The framework encodes multi-source geological data into a heterogeneous graph structure through a heterogeneous graph neural network-based spatial association modeling method, enabling effective fusion of multi-source information. It then embeds mineralization geological knowledge as structural and semantic constraint losses into the model training process via a geological knowledge graph-constrained GNN prediction method. This allows data-driven learning and geological rule constraints to operate synergistically. Experiments on six datasets show the proposed method consistently outperforms all six baselines, validating the framework’s effectiveness.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文面向深部隐伏矿体定位预测中样本稀疏、地质不确定性高和空间异质性强等难题，提出一种图学习预测框架。方法将多源地质数据编码为异构图结构，并利用异构图神经网络建模地质要素间的空间关联。作者进一步将成矿地质知识以结构和语义约束损失的形式嵌入训练过程，以提高小样本条件下预测结果的地质合理性。

articles.title: An Explainable Deep Learning Framework for Integrated Steel Microstructure Classification and Surface Defect Analysis
articles.title_zh: 用于钢铁显微组织分类与表面缺陷分析的一种可解释深度学习集成框架
articles.abstract: Automated analysis of steel microstructures and surface defects is critical for quality control in modern manufacturing. However, existing approaches typically address microstructure classification and defect detection as isolated tasks, limiting their practical applicability in integrated inspection workflows. This study presents a unified deep learning framework that combines ultra-high carbon steel (UHCS) microstructure classification using the UHCS micrograph database, NEU surface defect detection using the NEU surface defect dataset, rule-based severity estimation, and Grad-CAM explainability into a single dual-mode pipeline. For microstructure classification, a ResNet50 model with transfer learning achieved 88.52% ± 1.05% accuracy across three independent training runs on six microstructural classes, outperforming both EfficientNetB3 (87.04% ± 1.05%) and a baseline CNN trained from scratch (76.67%). For surface defect detection, a YOLOv8 model achieved mAP@0.5 of 0.715 ± 0.005 across six defect categories. Severity estimation was performed using a transparent rule-based module whose threshold stability was validated through sensitivity analysis, with 87% of severity assignments remaining consistent under threshold perturbation of ± 0.05. Grad-CAM visualizations confirmed that the classification model focuses on physically meaningful microstructural features, with per-class confidence scores consistent with known metallurgical complexity. The proposed framework moves beyond isolated model predictions toward a practical and interpretable inspection tool suitable for automated steel quality assessment. Results demonstrate strong and reproducible performance across both tasks, with statistical reliability confirmed through three independent training runs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个统一的双模式深度学习流程，将超高碳钢显微组织分类、NEU 表面缺陷检测、基于规则的严重度估计和 Grad-CAM 可解释性整合到同一检测框架中。显微组织分类方面，基于迁移学习的 ResNet50 在六类组织上取得优于 EfficientNetB3 和从零训练 CNN 的准确率；表面缺陷检测方面，YOLOv8 在六类缺陷上获得较稳定的 mAP@0.5。研究强调该框架有助于将材料显微组织识别与表面缺陷质量控制结合到实际工业检测流程中。

articles.title: Dispersion Characteristics of Transverse Surface Waves in a Functionally Graded Piezoelectric Half-Space with a Triple Dielectric Overlayer System: Effects of Material Ordering, Substrate Grading, and Thickness Allocation
articles.title_zh: 功能梯度压电半空间中带三层介质覆盖层的横向表面波色散特性：材料排序、基底梯度与厚度分配的影响
articles.abstract: This study presents an exact analytical formulation for the propagation of transverse surface (SH-type) waves in a functionally graded piezoelectric (FGP) half-space coated with three distinct dielectric layers. The dispersion relation is obtained by enforcing the continuity of mechanical displacement, shear stress, electric potential, and electric displacement across the vacuum/layer, layer/layer, and layer/substrate interfaces. The revised numerical study separates three design variables: material-property ordering, substrate grading, and thickness allocation. The updated results show that both density ordering and shear-stiffness ordering produce clear phase-velocity separation over the normalized total-thickness range, while dielectric-permittivity ordering remains a secondary mechanism and becomes visibly distinguishable mainly under amplified permittivity contrast. The grading parameter α acts as a global tuning parameter: positive α shifts the open- and short-circuit dispersion branches upward, whereas negative α lowers the phase velocity and can enhance the electromechanical coupling response. Because the α scan and the thickness-allocation study are designed to isolate different mechanisms, they use the two fixed baseline stacks explicitly listed in the numerical-setup table: a moderate-contrast stack for grading sensitivity and a high-contrast fixed stack for thickness redistribution. The thickness-allocation results show that redistributing the same total coating thickness among mechanically distinct layers can strongly change phase velocity and moderately modify K2. The triple-layer FGP configuration therefore provides multiple independent degrees of freedom for tailoring SH-SAW dispersion and coupling characteristics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究给出了功能梯度压电半空间上覆三层不同介质时 SH 型横向表面波传播的精确解析表述。作者通过在真空/层、层/层和层/基底界面施加机械位移、剪应力、电势和电位移连续条件，推导色散关系，并分别考察材料属性排序、基底梯度和厚度分配的影响。结果表明密度排序和剪切刚度排序能显著分离相速度，介电常数排序影响相对次要；梯度参数可作为全局调控量，改变开路和短路色散分支及机电耦合响应。

articles.title: Model Ag/HOPG catalysis for ethylene epoxidation: comparison of methods for the preparation of large Ag particles with high surface coverage
articles.title_zh: 用于乙烯环氧化的 Ag/HOPG 模型催化：高覆盖度大银颗粒制备方法比较
articles.abstract: The results of the preparation of Ag/HOPG model catalysts for ethylene epoxidation, focusing on the preparation of large silver particles with high coverage of HOPG (highly oriented pyrolytic graphite) surface and suitable for in situ XPS and STM studies are presented. Several approaches to make Ag/HOPG samples are compared. SEM, STM and XPS combined with deep-machine learning analysis quantify particle size distributions, the number of Ag particles per unit surface area / Ag support surface coverage. It is shown that damaging of the basal plane of graphite (by Ar+ etching) i) is perspective for film-like coating; ii) promotes Ag-C encapsulation. These make such samples unsuitable for reaction mechanistic studies. In contrast, thermal vacuum deposition of silver using an EFM3 e‑beam evaporator on freshly peeled HOPG produces uniformly distributed relatively flat Ag particles with controlled mean sizes of 30 to 100 nm range and Ag coverages up to 0.59 monolayer. Annealing of the sample with 100 nm Ag particles in vacuum at 500°C reveals Ostwald ripening behavior. O1s XPS line analysis confirms that prepared low-oxygen Ag/HOPG systems are suitable model catalysts for instrumental ethylene epoxidation studies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文比较了多种制备 Ag/HOPG 模型催化剂的方法，目标是在高定向热解石墨表面获得适合原位 XPS 和 STM 研究的大尺寸、高覆盖度银颗粒。结合 SEM、STM、XPS 和深度机器学习分析，作者量化了银颗粒尺寸分布、单位面积颗粒数和表面覆盖度。研究发现，氩离子刻蚀损伤石墨基面虽有利于膜状覆盖，但会促进 Ag-C 包覆而不适合反应机理研究；相比之下，电子束热真空沉积可在新剥离 HOPG 上制备较均匀且低氧的银颗粒模型体系。

articles.title: Quantum computing: Laser-optical system offers full control over 2,000 trapped Rydberg atoms
articles.title_zh: 量子计算：激光光学系统实现对2000个俘获里德堡原子的完全控制
articles.abstract: Fraunhofer ILT in Aachen has developed a highly complex laser-optical system for a quantum computer currently under construction at the 5th Institute of Physics at the University of Stuttgart. This system enables 2,000 Rydberg atoms to be positioned with submicrometer precision in the computer's highly compact vacuum chamber. To do this, the system projects an array of 2,000 individually controllable laser beams into the chamber. These beams act as optical tweezers and hold the trapped Rydberg atoms precisely at the distance required for them to interact with each other. The computer's quantum logic processes are based on these interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了亚琛 Fraunhofer ILT 为斯图加特大学在建量子计算机开发的一套复杂激光光学系统。该系统可在紧凑真空腔内以亚微米精度定位 2000 个里德堡原子，并通过 2000 束可单独控制的激光形成光镊阵列来固定原子。量子逻辑过程依赖这些被精确排列原子之间的相互作用。

articles.title: Controlled generation of 3D vortices in driven atomic Josephson junctions
articles.title_zh: 受驱动原子约瑟夫森结中三维涡旋的可控生成
articles.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 28, July 2026. SignificanceUnderstanding how quantized vortices form, interact, and decay lies at the heart of quantum-fluid dynamics. We introduce a driven atomic Josephson junction as a versatile platform to create and control these excitations with single-cycle ...
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文围绕量子流体中量子化涡旋的形成、相互作用与衰减展开，提出以受驱动原子约瑟夫森结作为产生和控制三维涡旋激发的平台。摘要信息表明，该方法可通过单周期驱动等手段调控涡旋动力学，为研究量子流体非平衡过程提供实验或理论工具。由于提供的摘要被截断，具体模型、实验参数和定量结论需查阅原文。

articles.title: Twist-configured moire-moire reconstruction governs diverse commensurate double-moire phases in twisted bilayer graphene on h-BN
articles.title_zh: 扭转构型的莫尔-莫尔重构支配 h-BN 上扭转双层石墨烯中的多样相称双莫尔相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02822v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The coexistence of multiple moire lattices in van der Waals heterostructures raises a fundamental question: how do distinct moire patterns interact and reconstruct? Here, we investigate twisted bilayer graphene (tBG) on hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN), where tBG and graphene/h-BN moire structures coexist, using conductive atomic force microscopy combined with continuum-model simulations. We show that reconstruction between these moire lattices-moire-moire reconstruction-manifests across multiple length scales, giving rise to diverse commensurate double-moire phases. Locally, the stacking registry between the two moire lattices is uniquely selected by the global twist configuration (helical or alternate), mediated by rotational relaxation of the shared graphene layer. This registry, together with twist angle and strain, governs commensurate domains from C3z-symmetric to strained symmetry-modified structures. These results establish moire-moire reconstruction as a general framework for engineering structural and electronic order -- including theoretically predicted topological flat bands below the magic angle -- in multilayer moire materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨范德华异质结构中多个莫尔晶格共存时如何相互作用和重构，重点研究六方氮化硼上的扭转双层石墨烯。作者结合导电原子力显微镜和连续模型模拟，发现 tBG 莫尔结构与石墨烯/h-BN 莫尔结构之间会发生“莫尔-莫尔重构”，并在多个长度尺度上产生多样的相称双莫尔相。局部堆垛配准由全局扭转构型选择，并受共享石墨烯层的旋转弛豫、扭角和应变共同控制，这为工程化多层莫尔材料的结构与电子有序提供了框架。
authors: Yuta Seo, Naoto Nakatsuji, Jimpei Kawase, Naoto Hishida, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Takuto Kawakami, Mikito Koshino, Tomoki Machida

articles.title: Pressure-Driven Structural Transitions without a Displacive Charge-Density Wave in La₂SmNi₂O₇
articles.title_zh: La₂SmNi₂O₇中无位移型电荷密度波的压力驱动结构转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.03363v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigated the structural properties of bilayer nickelate La₂SmNi₂O₇ as a function of pressure and temperature. At ambient conditions, we show that the material crystallizes as a monoclinic superstructure distinct from the one previously reported and close to the pseudo-orthorhombic structure of pristine La₃Ni₂O₇. No signatures of satellite reflections associated with charge density wave (CDW) ordering are detected at low temperature. Upon compression, a sequence of pressure-induced structural transitions from monoclinic to orthorhombic 15 GPa and then tetragonal 21 GPa symmetry is observed. Within the superconducting dome, the quality of the X-ray diffraction data enables structural refinements enabling theoretical models to understand the emergence of superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究了双层镍酸盐 La₂SmNi₂O₇ 随压力和温度变化的结构性质。结果表明，常压下该材料形成一种不同于既往报道的单斜超结构，并接近本征 La₃Ni₂O₇ 的赝正交结构；低温下未观测到与电荷密度波有序相关的卫星反射。加压后，材料依次在约15 GPa和21 GPa发生由单斜到正交、再到四方对称性的结构转变；在超导穹顶区内获得的高质量X射线衍射数据可为理解超导出现的理论模型提供结构基础。
authors: J. Huang, Sitaram Ramakrishnan, P. Rodière, P. Toulemonde, Z. Rahmany, V. Balédent, B. Vignolle, Sourav Marik, P. Fertey, P. Foury-Leylekian

articles.title: Nonlocal Orbital-Angular-Momentum Dichroism of Vortex Light in Strained Crystals
articles.title_zh: 应变晶体中涡旋光的非局域轨道角动量二色性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.03544v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vortex light carries orbital angular momentum (OAM) in its transverse phase, unlike spin, which is encoded in polarization. We show that this phase cannot produce OAM dichroism in any continuously translation-invariant system, even when optical nonlocality and multipole light--matter coupling are included. Nonuniform strain in a two-dimensional Dirac material bypasses this no-go condition by supplying transverse momentum transfer through a long-wavelength pseudo-gauge field, so that the OAM dichroism factorizes into a nonlocal elasto-optic tensor and the overlap of the vortex transverse phase current with the strain field. For a micron-scale Gaussian bubble, the resonant OAM-odd conductivity reaches (sim10⁻³e²/hbar), within reach of differential optical measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论涡旋光轨道角动量所携带的横向相位在光-物质相互作用中的二色性响应。作者证明，在连续平移不变体系中，即使考虑光学非局域性和多极耦合，也不会产生轨道角动量二色性；而二维狄拉克材料中的非均匀应变可通过长波长赝规范场提供横向动量转移，从而绕过这一限制。对于微米尺度高斯气泡，应变诱导的轨道角动量奇性电导可达到约10⁻³e²/ℏ量级，有望被差分光学测量探测。

articles.title: Evidence of the Cooper-Pair Field with Gaussian Memory Kernel in Unconventional Superconductors
articles.title_zh: 非常规超导体中具有高斯记忆核的库珀对场证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.03937v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a dynamical description of the superconducting pair field in which the Cooper-channel Hubbard--Stratonovich field Δ is treated as a memory-dressed Bogoliubov pair field rather than as a purely static order parameter. Starting from the standard pair-field effective action, we couple Δ to antinode-selected collective or self-generated fields. An ensemble of such modes produces a distribution of local Bogoliubov frequencies; when this distribution is approximately Gaussian, ensemble averaging gives the memory factor exp[-t²/(2τ_g²⁾]. In cuprate superconductors, the antinodal gap or pseudogap restricts the active electronic phase space and acts as a momentum-space spectral cavity. It selects fluctuation wavevectors mathbf Qₐ that may become charge-density-wave-like instabilities in an ordered limit, but behave as a reservoir of local collective fields in the fluctuating regime. The same framework admits resonant algebraic prefactors, so that threshold and forced-oscillator responses generate the hierarchy p=-1/2,1/2,1,3/2,łdots, while the Gaussian envelope cuts off secular growth and converts these branches into finite spectral components. The resulting picture contains a robust pseudogap memory channel and, below T_c, an additional condensate-assisted coherent channel proportional to |Δ₀₍T)|². Thus the superconducting transition primarily reorganizes pair-field spectral weight between incoherent pseudogap memory and coherent Bogoliubov memory. The frequency-domain response is expressed in terms of parabolic-cylinder functions, and comparisons with Raman, ARPES, tunneling, and doping-dependent ARPES scaling suggest that these probes are complementary projections of the same Gaussian-memory pair continuum. We compare our numerical results with the recent experimental data on Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一种超导配对场的动力学描述，将库珀通道 Hubbard–Stratonovich 场 Δ 视为带记忆修饰的 Bogoliubov 配对场，而非纯静态序参量。通过将 Δ 与反节点选择的集体场或自生场耦合，并对局域 Bogoliubov 频率分布进行系综平均，可在近似高斯分布下得到高斯记忆因子。该框架被用于解释铜氧化物超导体中反节点能隙或赝能隙对电子相空间的限制，以及涨落态下局域集体场储库和有限谱响应的形成。

articles.title: Hall Coefficient Sign Reversal Driven by Orbital-Selective Oxygen-Vacancy Scattering in Nickelate Films
articles.title_zh: 镍酸盐薄膜中由轨道选择性氧空位散射驱动的霍尔系数符号反转
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.04122v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hall measurements in superconducting bilayer nickelate films show sign reversals that cannot be explained by rigid-band electron doping alone. We combine a DFT+CDMFT-derived correlated multi-orbital quasiparticle model with a T-matrix treatment of oxygen-vacancy scattering in a semiclassical Boltzmann transport framework. We find that multiband compensation is insufficient by itself: in-plane vacancies selectively suppress the transport channel dominated by the dₓ^₂₋y^₂ orbital and drive R_H through zero, whereas inner-apical vacancies make R_H more negative. These results identify pocket-resolved and orbital-selective oxygen-vacancy scattering as the microscopic origin of the Hall coefficient sign reversal and provide a framework for oxygen-stoichiometry-dependent transport in nickelate films.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究了超导双层镍酸盐薄膜中霍尔系数符号反转的微观机制，指出其不能仅由刚性带电子掺杂解释。作者结合 DFT+CDMFT 得到的关联多轨道准粒子模型、氧空位散射的T矩阵处理以及半经典 Boltzmann 输运理论，发现单纯多带补偿不足以导致符号反转。面内氧空位会选择性抑制以 dₓ²₋y² 轨道为主的输运通道并推动 R_H 过零，而内顶位氧空位则使 R_H 更负，从而揭示了口袋分辨和轨道选择性散射的重要作用。
authors: Jian-Jian Miao, Yue Liu, Yue Zhao, Yichen Hua, Changming Yue, Wei-Qiang Chen

articles.title: Emergent Fermi polarons in Dirac materials
articles.title_zh: 狄拉克材料中的涌现费米极化子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.04161v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate band-structure effects on the absorption spectra of quantum impurities in Dirac materials. We uncover the formation of novel quasiparticles -- Dirac-Fermi polarons -- emerging from the dressing of impurities by excitations near the Dirac point. These quasiparticles are remarkably robust, persisting for both attractive and repulsive interactions, and across the full range of electron and hole doping. We show that their spectroscopic signature is a generic feature of Dirac materials, accessible with established techniques in both solid-state and ultracold atomic platforms. Our results establish polaron spectroscopy as a powerful probe of Dirac points at energies far from the Fermi surface, providing direct access to band-structure effects beyond conventional approaches.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究了狄拉克材料中能带结构对量子杂质吸收谱的影响。研究发现，杂质被狄拉克点附近激发所修饰后可形成新的准粒子——狄拉克-费米极化子；这类准粒子在吸引和排斥相互作用以及电子、空穴掺杂范围内均表现出显著稳健性。其光谱特征被认为是狄拉克材料的普遍性质，可在固态和超冷原子平台上通过已有技术探测，并为研究远离费米面的狄拉克点能带效应提供新方法。
authors: Xin Chen, Eugen Dizer, Rafał Ołdziejewski, Kostya S. Novoselov, Marton Kanász-Nagy, Richard Schmidt

articles.title: Cuprate d-wave superconductivity based on Non perturbative many body theory for spin fluctuation
articles.title_zh: 基于自旋涨落非微扰多体理论的铜氧化物 d 波超导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.04168v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We employ the nonperturbative many-body spin GW method to compute the single-particle Green's function, and the covariance method to evaluate the correlation functions of two body, for the Hubbard model for superconductors. The key transition temperatures, namely the Neel temperature and the superconducting critical temperature Tc are found to be in quantitative agreement with experimental data. The evolution of the Fermi surface in different doping regimes is also presented, which clearly shows transitions from pseudogap to strange metal and to Fermi liquid phase. The method has been benchmarked at strong coupling and low temperature and is free from the fermion sign problem. Simulations on lattices up to 64 times 64 are also feasible, making access to the thermodynamic limit possible. This approach may offer a new route toward investigating strongly correlated systems, especially cuprate superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用非微扰多体自旋 GW 方法计算 Hubbard 模型中的单粒子格林函数，并用协方差方法评估二体关联函数，以研究超导体性质。作者得到的 Néel 温度和超导临界温度 Tc 与实验数据定量相符，并展示了不同掺杂区间费米面从赝能隙到奇异金属再到费米液体相的演化。该方法在强耦合和低温条件下经过基准检验，避免了费米子符号问题，并可扩展到较大晶格，为研究铜氧化物等强关联体系提供了新途径。
authors: Jianwei Gong, Junnian Xiong, Ruitao Xiao, Hui Li, Ziyu Li, Huaqing Huang, Dingping Li

articles.title: Topological Electronic States and Phonon Mediated Superconductivity in Ru Based Ternary Pnictides: ZrRuAs and HfRuP
articles.title_zh: Ru基三元磷族化物 ZrRuAs 与 HfRuP 中的拓扑电子态和声子介导超导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.04651v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This study investigates the structural, electronic, mechanical, optical, thermodynamic, and superconducting properties of ZrRuAs and HfRuP. Electronic band structure calculations reveal topological semimetallic behavior in both compounds with several bands crossing the Fermi level. The inclusion of spin orbit coupling lifts band degeneracies in both compounds. The Fermi surface shows both electron and hole segments. The estimated Pugh ratio, Poisson ratio and machinability index indicate that both compounds are ductile in nature and exhibit excellent machinability. Optical results show metallic reflectivity and notable absorption in the ultraviolet region. Thermodynamic analysis indicates stable behavior. The estimated superconducting transition temperatures are 9.75 K for ZrRuAs and 9.03 K for HfRuP that indicates strong coupling conventional superconductivity. The results provide a detailed view of the physical and superconducting properties of ZrRuAs and HfRuP and help to close the existing research gaps in these topological superconducting materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文系统研究了 ZrRuAs 和 HfRuP 的结构、电子、力学、光学、热力学及超导性质。能带计算显示两种化合物均具有拓扑半金属性质，多个能带穿越费米能级，自旋轨道耦合会解除能带简并，费米面同时包含电子和空穴部分。力学和热力学分析表明其具有延展性、良好可加工性和稳定性；估算的超导转变温度分别约为9.75 K和9.03 K，指向强耦合常规超导行为。
authors: Jubair Hossan Abir, Tanvir Khan, Tauhidur Rahman, Md. Kamrul Hassan, Sraboni Saha Moly, Mst. Maskura Khatun, Raihana Shams Islam, Saleh Hasan Naqib

articles.title: Quantum Geometric Friedel Oscillations
articles.title_zh: 量子几何 Friedel 振荡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.04654v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In conventional Friedel oscillations, the real-space charge density oscillations induced by an impurity are characterized by an oscillation period set by the Fermi momentum. In this work, we show that the conventional theory is incomplete when the Bloch wavefunctions carry nontrivial quantum geometry. We demonstrate that in metals with an isolated (nearly) flat band at the Fermi energy, quantum geometry induces a distinct type of oscillations, which we call the emphquantum geometric Friedel oscillations (QGFOs). The period of the QGFOs is set by the momentum space separation of the quantum metric hot spots of the flat band. The conventional and quantum metric-induced oscillations coexist at low temperatures. At higher temperatures, the conventional Friedel oscillations away from the impurity site are set by the thermal length such that the oscillations can be easily washed out by temperature effects. Remarkably, the QGFOs decay length is set by the quantum metric length which is defined by the integration of the quantum metric of the flat band. As a result, the QGFOs can persist even at temperatures much larger than the bandwidth of the flat band. Moreover, the decay length is independent of temperature for a wide range of temperatures which is a manifestation of the quantum metric protection. In conclusion, we show that the quantum metric induces novel Friedel oscillations. Our work suggests that the measurement of the QGFOs is a powerful way to detect the quantum metric length (which is associated with the integral of the quantum metric) and the quantum metric hot spot separations (which are associated with the distribution of the quantum metric in the momentum space).
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究指出，当 Bloch 波函数具有非平庸量子几何时，传统 Friedel 振荡理论并不完整。作者证明，在费米能附近存在孤立近平带的金属中，量子度量可诱导一种新的实空间电荷密度振荡，即量子几何 Friedel 振荡，其周期由平带量子度量热点在动量空间中的间隔决定。与易受温度热长度限制而衰减的传统振荡不同，该振荡的衰减长度由量子度量长度控制，因此即使在温度远高于带宽时也可能持续存在。
authors: Xing-Lei MA, Jinchao Zhao, Bo-Qing Wu, K. T. Law

articles.title: On the mathrmInₓGa₁₋ₓAs channel noise in InP HEMTs from 4 K to 300 K
articles.title_zh: 4 K至300 K范围内 InP HEMT 中 InₓGa₁₋ₓAs 沟道噪声研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.04757v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The InP high-electron-mobility transistor (HEMT) is indispensable for low-noise amplifiers (LNAs) in radio astronomy and quantum computing. The composition of the mathrmInₓGa₁₋ₓAs channel in InP HEMT is known to influence the LNA noise performance. However, the various physical mechanisms responsible for noise generation are not fully characterized and understood. Here, we investigate the mathrmInₓGa₁₋ₓAs channel noise from 4 K to 300 K for 100-nm gate-length InP HEMTs with channel indium content of 53%, 60% and 70%. Channel noise was quantified by extracting the equivalent drain noise temperature Td using both on-wafer and LNA-based measurements, covering 40-300 K and 4-40 K, respectively. The 60% indium channel InP HEMT exhibited the lowest channel noise across the full temperature range. The Td extracted from on-wafer characterization was found to obey a parabolic temperature dependence which predicted the Td at 4 K for all InP HEMTs in good agreement with LNA-based measurements. By expressing the channel noise as the sum of one thermal and one excess noise term, it was found that the former increased linearly with ambient temperature and dominated at 300 K. The channel noise at 4 K was determined by the excess noise term and exhibited a non-monotonic dependence on the channel indium content in the InP HEMT. The results suggest that the excess noise in the InP HEMT originates not only from temperature-independent shot noise but also from impact ionization and real-space transfer noise.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究了100 nm栅长 InP 高电子迁移率晶体管中不同铟含量 InₓGa₁₋ₓAs 沟道在4 K至300 K的噪声表现。作者通过片上测试和低噪声放大器测试提取等效漏极噪声温度，比较了53%、60%和70%铟含量器件，发现60%铟沟道在整个温度范围内具有最低沟道噪声。片上表征得到的噪声温度呈抛物线型温度依赖，并能较好预测4 K结果；进一步分析表明沟道噪声可分解为随环境温度线性增加的热噪声项和额外噪声项。
authors: Junjie Li, Justin H. Chen, Austin J. Minnich, Jan Grahn

articles.title: Local Defects and the Topology of the Haldane Model
articles.title_zh: 局域缺陷与 Haldane 模型拓扑性的关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.04771v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the interplay between local defects and topology in the Haldane model within the framework of the tenfold classification. The Haldane model realizes a Chern-insulating phase characterized by an integer topological invariant (C=± 1) and supports chiral edge states. Introducing vacancies gives rise to localized states at the defect sites, classified by a Z₂ invariant ν = Cḑot m,mod,2, where m=N_A-N_B is the net sublattice imbalance of the vacancy configuration: an odd imbalance hosts a protected zero-energy mode, whereas an even imbalance does not. We identify three independent experimental signatures that distinguish these topological defect states from trivial (adatom) defects. First, vacancy-induced states exhibit characteristic dislocations in their wavefunction profiles that track the phase winding associated with the defect. Second, a fractional charge of e/2 accumulates at vacancy sites, while no such charge appears at adatoms. Third, the probability current circulating around a vacancy-induced state flows in the opposite direction to that of chiral edge states, in direct analogy with the current reversal produced by a vortex in a p-wave superconductor. All three signatures are in quantitative agreement with the Z₂ prediction.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者在十重分类框架下研究了 Haldane 模型中局域缺陷与拓扑之间的相互作用。Haldane 模型可实现以整数陈数 C=±1 表征的陈绝缘体相并支持手征边缘态；引入空位后，缺陷处出现由 Z₂ 不变量 ν=C·m mod 2 分类的局域态，其中 m 为A、B子晶格空位数差，奇数不平衡可支持受保护零能模。研究还提出了区分拓扑空位态与平庸吸附原子缺陷的实验特征，包括波函数位错、空位处 e/2 分数量子电荷积累以及与手征边缘态方向相反的环流。

articles.title: Lindblad theory of linear response susceptibility and dispersive readout in minimal Kitaev junctions
articles.title_zh: 极简 Kitaev 结中线性响应磁化率与色散读出的 Lindblad 理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.04968v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The field of hybrid superconductor-semiconductor quantum dots is advancing toward the development of functional devices that leverage the advantages of both types of materials. However, the inherent complexity of these devices demands a comprehensive theoretical framework for a complete understanding of their responses to external probes, readout and the dissipation arising from environmental coupling. We present a Lindblad-based linear response formalism that captures the multi-level nature of these devices, their probe-readout flexibility, and the non-unitary effects of finite-frequency response, including the so-called Sisyphus and Hermes dynamical susceptibilities. These arise from fluctuations in the rates and jump operators, and are hence absent in standard Kubo linear response treatments.
