articles.title: Single ion maps 3D electromagnetic fields above chips with record sensitivity
articles.title_zh: 单离子以前所未有的灵敏度绘制芯片上方三维电磁场
articles.abstract: Researchers at ETH Zurich have developed a method that uses a single ion to detect electromagnetic fields above a surface and to create a three-dimensional map of them. In the future, this approach can be used to improve chips for quantum computers and quantum sensors.
articles.abstract_zh: 苏黎世联邦理工学院研究人员开发了一种利用单个离子探测表面上方电磁场并构建三维分布图的方法。该技术具有很高的探测灵敏度，未来可用于改进量子计算机和量子传感器芯片的设计与表征。

articles.title: Monitoring method for armoring shielding cable in strong electromagnetic region in substation
articles.title_zh: 变电站强电磁区域铠装屏蔽电缆的监测方法
articles.abstract: The strong magnetic environment formed by the leakage magnetic field of the reactor in high voltage substation may pose a risk of overheating to the surrounding cable loop, which poses a challenge to the maintenance of the secondary circuit. A practical method has been proposed to monitor anomalies in secondary circuits in this paper. Firstly, application status and limitations of conventional method to detect the abnormal condition in strong electromagnetic region is discussed. Secondly, the composite discrimination criteria consisting of 5 criteria are proposed and a monitoring system based on these criteria is developed. Finally, these systems deployed on site and applied to monitoring the status of cable overheating in the strong electromagnetic region in 500kV substations in east China. The on-site operation results have verified the effectiveness of the proposed method and system. The proposed method lays a foundation for wide application of monitoring and early warning for cable overheating in high voltage substation.
articles.abstract_zh: 高压变电站中电抗器漏磁场形成的强磁环境可能导致周边电缆回路过热，给二次回路维护带来风险。本文分析了传统异常检测方法在强电磁区域中的适用性与局限，提出由五项判据构成的复合判别准则，并据此开发监测系统。该系统已在华东地区500 kV变电站现场部署，用于监测强电磁区域电缆过热状态，运行结果验证了方法的有效性。

articles.title: A Complete-Coverage Path-Planning Algorithm Based on Local Path Cost
articles.title_zh: 一种基于局部路径代价的完全覆盖路径规划算法
articles.abstract: Complete coverage path planning (CCPP) is a core enabling technology for autonomous operation and navigation of mobile robots and unmanned surface vehicles (USVs). However, in large-scale and complex environments, due to the lack of directional guidance in population evolution, existing heuristic path planners often suffer from slow convergence, premature trapping in local optima, and excessive turning maneuvers along the planned tour. To mitigate the blindness of conventional mutation operators, this paper proposes a complete-coverage path-planning algorithm based on local path cost (CCPP-LPC). First, a local path cost evaluation model is constructed to adaptively quantify each waypoint’s marginal negative contribution to the overall path length, thereby identifying nodes with high optimization potential. Second, an adaptive dual-guided perturbation node selection strategy is designed, which derives both optimization-oriented and diversity-oriented probability distributions from local costs, guiding the population to preferentially refine high-cost segments while preserving gene diversity. To assess the performance of CCPP-LPC, comprehensive comparisons against six state-of-the-art heuristic algorithms on four simulated grid maps of varying scales and complexity are conducted, as well as three real-world physical application scenarios. Experimental results show that CCPP-LPC not only improves computational efficiency, but also achieves the best performance across key metrics, including total path length, number of turns, and repeated coverage ratio. These outcomes highlight CCPP-LPC as a practically valuable approach for complete-coverage optimization under multi-constrained, complex environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 完全覆盖路径规划是移动机器人和无人水面艇自主作业与导航的关键技术，但在大规模复杂环境中，现有启发式算法常存在收敛慢、易陷入局部最优和转向过多等问题。本文提出基于局部路径代价的完全覆盖路径规划算法，通过评估各路径点对总体路径长度的边际负面贡献来识别高优化潜力节点。算法进一步采用自适应双引导扰动节点选择策略，在优先优化高代价路径段的同时保持种群多样性。

articles.title: Bound State Solutions of the Relativistic Finite-difference Equation for the Ring-shaped Quesne Oscillator Potential
articles.title_zh: 环形Quesne振子势相对论有限差分方程的束缚态解
articles.abstract: We solve exactly the relativistic finite-difference equation for the quantum three-dimensionalring-shaped Quesne oscillator potential. Our investigation is based on a finite-difference version ofrelativistic quantum mechanics. So-called relativistic configurational r-space is a key concept here.We show that the radial wavefunctions and angular wavefunctions are expressed through the con-tinuous dual Hahn polynomials and Jacobi polynomials, respectively. A discrete energy spectrumhas been found. The radial wave functions and energy spectrum have the correct nonrelativisticlimit. We also build a dynamical symmetry group SU (1, 1) for the radial part of the equation ofmotion, which allows us to find the energy spectrum purely algebraically. The dependence of theeffective potential, wave functions, and probability densities of the system on the radial coordinatewas studied, and it was determined that the energy spectrum monotonically shifts toward higherenergies with the increase of the parameter α.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文精确求解了三维环形Quesne振子势的相对论有限差分方程，研究基于相对论量子力学的有限差分形式和相对论构型空间。结果表明，径向波函数和角向波函数分别可由连续对偶Hahn多项式和Jacobi多项式表示，并得到离散能谱。作者还构建了径向运动方程的SU(1,1)动力学对称群，从代数角度推导能谱，并讨论了参数α对有效势、波函数、概率密度和能级移动的影响。

articles.title: Substantial Shortwave Direct Radiative Forcing by Airborne Tire Wear Particles
articles.title_zh: 空气中轮胎磨损颗粒产生显著短波直接辐射强迫
articles.abstract: Tire wear particles (TWPs) are widespread light-absorbing carbonaceous aerosols with uncertain radiative effects. Using valence electron energy loss spectroscopy (VEELS) and Mie theory, we find airborne TWPs strongly absorb visible light and scatter infrared radiation, with a complex refractive index N of ~ 1.35 − 0.28i at 550 nm. Their global annual mean shortwave direct radiative forcing (DRF) at the top of atmosphere (TOA) under cloudy conditions reaches 0.0148 W m− 2, accounting for 5% of black carbon’s value and falls within the same order of magnitude as those of brown carbon and micro/nanoplastics (MNPs). Given the global transition to heavier electric vehicles and increasing atmospheric TWP abundance, TWPs may become an increasingly important non-exhaust aerosol contributor to anthropogenic climate warming. Main Text: Tire wear particles (TWPs) are generated primarily by mechanical abrasion of tire tread against road surfaces, with additional contributions from the evaporation and condensation of volatile components from the tire tread (1, 2). Airborne TWPs have been shown to remain suspended for extended periods and to undergo long-range transport, implying widespread atmospheric dispersal (3). Given their carbon-containing components (2), TWPs may absorb visible light impacting the Earth-atmosphere energy budget through aerosol-radiation interactions (the direct radiative effect, DRE), with potentially consequential impacts on climate (4–9). Driven by increased demand brought about by economic growth, the global vehicle fleet has increased sharply (10–12), rising from 890 million in 2005 to 1.28 billion in 2015, and being projected to reach ~ 1.83–1.97 billion by 2030 (13). The current number of vehicles, together with their projected growth, underscores the significance of emissions from non-exhaust traffic-related particles, particularly TWPs (2, 14, 15). Simultaneously, the world is undergoing a transition to electric vehicles with low tailpipe emissions, reshaping traffic-related pollution (16). As heavier electric vehicles penetrate markets, exhaust emissions will decline correspondingly while TWP emissions surge further (16, 17). As TWP burden rises, the relative importance of TWPs to the climate system may become increasingly consequential. Although the direct radiative forcing (DRF) of canonical aerosol components (e.g., black carbon BC (18–25), brown carbon BrC (19, 22, 23, 26), sulfate (27), nitrate (28), dust (29)) has been extensively assessed, quantitative estimates of TWP DRF remain uncertain (30). A principal limitation is the lack of measured optical property data, which propagates substantial uncertainty into forcing estimates (31). Optical properties are fundamental inputs for aerosol DRF calculations and strongly influence its magnitude and spatial pattern. Among the optical parameters, aerosol optical depth (AOD), single-scattering albedo (SSA), and asymmetry factor (g) are central to quantifying the DRF (32). In particular, SSA quantifies the relative contribution of scattering to total extinction, strongly controlling the sign and magnitude of regional DRF (33). At the top of the atmosphere (TOA), a local change in SSA of only ~ 11% can even flip the forcing from positive to negative (34, 35). Motivated by this gap, we develop a reproducible framework to derive spectral optical constants of TWPs from valence electron energy loss spectroscopy (VEELS) and quantify their global shortwave DRF with Santa Barbara DISORT Atmospheric Radiative Transfer (SBDART) simulations. We evaluate their clear-sky and cloudy responses at the surface and TOA, and compare cloudy-sky TOA forcing with that of representative absorbing aerosols. In doing so, we fill a critical blind spot in climate modeling by providing the first optical parameter sets suited for increasingly abundant TWPs, and constraining their radiative forcing. This framework also provides a transferable template for other aerosols and a new perspective on the climatic impacts of transportation development.
articles.abstract_zh: 轮胎磨损颗粒是一类广泛存在的吸光碳质气溶胶，其辐射效应仍存在不确定性。研究利用价电子能量损失谱和Mie理论发现，空气中轮胎磨损颗粒强烈吸收可见光并散射红外辐射，在550 nm处具有显著复折射率特征。估算显示，其全球年平均云条件下大气顶短波直接辐射强迫可达0.0148 W m−2，约为黑碳的5%，提示随着电动车增重和颗粒排放增加，轮胎磨损颗粒可能成为更重要的非尾气人为增暖气溶胶来源。

articles.title: Development of Machine Learning Algorithms to Predict Damage Level of RC Structures Exposed to Extreme Dynamic Loads
articles.title_zh: 用于预测极端动力荷载下钢筋混凝土结构损伤等级的机器学习算法开发
articles.abstract: The widespread use of reinforced concrete structures in buildings highlights the importance of investigating the behavior of these structures under explosive loading. Theoretical methods and numerical simulations are frequently used to predict the damage of reinforced concrete structures under blast loading. The high cost and difficulty in conducting experimental analysis, as well as the need for strong knowledge in computer modelling and the high computational cost associated with numerical simulations, have demanded a much simpler and more accurate method for the analysis of structures subjected to blast loading. Recently Machine Learning has emerged as a promising solution for these complex problems. In this research, five machine learning models are proposed to predict the damage degree of RC column under blast loading. They are Random Forest (RF), Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM), Categorical Boosting (CatBoost), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) and the Support Vector Machine (SVM). The dataset used to train and test the models are constructed by collecting data from finite element models. The results show that, CatBoost stands out as the most effective algorithm among those tested for predicting the damage level of RC columns under blast loading, offering high accuracy and reliability. It is observed that the depth of the structural element, charge weight and yield strength of longitudinal reinforcement have a highest influence on the damage degree of RC columns when subjected to detonation loads. Finally, the research results shows that ML model can predict the structural damage and failure modes of RC columns under blast loading quickly and accurately, and provide guidance for the explosion-proof design of RC columns.
articles.abstract_zh: 钢筋混凝土结构在爆炸荷载下的损伤评估通常依赖理论方法、实验或数值模拟，但实验成本高、建模复杂且计算开销大。本文提出五种机器学习模型预测爆炸荷载作用下钢筋混凝土柱的损伤等级，包括随机森林、LightGBM、CatBoost、XGBoost和支持向量机。模型训练与测试数据来自有限元模型，结果表明CatBoost在该任务中表现最优，显示机器学习可为爆炸损伤快速评估提供有效工具。

articles.title: A rechargeable non-aqueous Mg–O 2 battery based on magnesium peroxide chemistry
articles.title_zh: 基于过氧化镁化学的可充非水系镁–氧电池
articles.abstract: Nature Chemistry, Published online: 03 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41557-026-02199-2 Rechargeable magnesium–oxygen batteries could offer high energy density, but poor reversibility has limited their development. Now it has been shown that tailoring the Mg2+ solvation environment enables reversible magnesium peroxide chemistry and stable cycling in a non-aqueous battery.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究围绕可充镁–氧电池中可逆性不足这一关键瓶颈展开。作者表明，通过调控 Mg2+ 的溶剂化环境，可在非水系电池中实现更可逆的过氧化镁化学反应，并获得较稳定的循环性能。该工作为高能量密度镁–氧电池的发展提供了新的电解质与反应路径设计思路。

articles.title: Enhancing oxygen reduction reaction mass activity in polymer electrolyte fuel cells via molecular machine learning
articles.title_zh: 通过分子机器学习提升聚合物电解质燃料电池中氧还原反应的质量活性
articles.abstract: The search for efficient fuel cell additives is a critical challenge for improving their oxygen reduction reaction activity. Here, we present the first successful application of active learning (AL) to guide the experimental discovery of organic molecules that enhance the mass activity (MA) of Pt cathode catalysts in polymer electrolyte fuel cells (PEFCs), a class of fuel cells often referred to in the literature as proton-exchange membrane fuel cells. Using our in-house simplified molecular input line entry system-X molecular characterization tool, we trained neural networks, autonomously tailored for our data, on an initial set of 96 organic compounds, of which 84 passed RDKit validity checks for modeling. Model performance improved over three AL cycles, with the mean absolute error decreasing from 0.202 to 0.165 and the root mean square error decreasing from 0.271 to 0.218. The cycles were guided by predictive ranking, experimental feasibility constraints, and LSTM-based molecule generation. Among the additives identified, melam, a melamine dimer, achieved a 67 improvement in MA over the no-additive baseline. These results demonstrate the feasibility of AL in low-data regimes for PEFC additive discovery and highlight the importance of data consistency, model retraining, and close machine learning–experiment coordination.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将主动学习用于实验发现可提升聚合物电解质燃料电池 Pt 阴极催化剂氧还原质量活性的有机添加剂。作者基于初始有机化合物数据训练神经网络，并通过多轮主动学习、可实验性约束和分子生成筛选候选分子，模型预测误差逐步降低。实验发现三聚氰胺二聚体 melam 可显著提高质量活性，说明主动学习在低数据量燃料电池添加剂发现中具有可行性。
authors: Ekaterina Gracheva, Shin-ichi Yamazaki, Guillaume Lambard, Keitaro Sodeyama, Tsutomu Ioroi and Masafumi Asahi

articles.title: Ising superconductivity and anomalous metallic states in a bulk crystal with artificial unidirectional stacking layers
articles.title_zh: 具有人造单向堆垛层的块体晶体中的伊辛超导与反常金属态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01302v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The two-dimensional (2D) limit in macroscopic bulk crystals provides a powerful platform for exploring exotic quantum phases. Here, we report the synthesis of a Sr0.75ClNbS2 superconductor that achieves unidirectional, parallel AA stacking-a configuration never before realized in a bulk crystal. Unlike conventional intercalation, which merely expands the interlayer spacing, our approach employs a planar Sr-Cl network to enforce a complete stacking reorganization, driving all NbS2 layers from the native antiparallel AB stacking into a unidirectional, parallel AA arrangement. This stacking switch globally breaks inversion symmetry, transforming centrosymmetric 2H-NbS2 into a noncentrosymmetric bulk crystal with D3h point group symmetry. Crucially, this structural design reproduces, in three dimensions, the electronic environment of an isolated monolayer, thereby preventing cancellation of the local Ising fields. As a result, strong Ising spin-orbit coupling and spin-split bands persist throughout the bulk. Transport measurements reveal extreme superconducting anisotropy (γ ~ 77), an in-plane upper critical field (~ 10.65 T) that far exceeds the Pauli paramagnetic limit, and clean-limit superconductivity indicative of high crystalline quality. Moreover, magnetotransport uncovers a novel magnetic-field-induced anomalous metallic state characterized by finite dissipation yet a vanishing Hall response. Direct band-structure measurements corroborate the layer-decoupled, quasi-2D electronic nature of the system. This work establishes stacking-geometry engineering as a powerful strategy to artificially enforce a globally noncentrosymmetric, quasi-2D superconducting state in bulk crystals, paving the way for designing quantum materials with tunable crystalline symmetry and electronic band topology.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道合成了 Sr0.75ClNbS2 超导体，在块体晶体中实现了单向平行 AA 堆垛的 NbS2 层结构。平面 Sr-Cl 网络驱动堆垛重组，使原本中心对称的 2H-NbS2 转变为非中心对称结构，从而在三维块体中保留类似单层的伊辛自旋轨道耦合与自旋劈裂能带。输运实验显示出强超导各向异性和较高的面内上临界场，表明该人工堆垛策略可用于构筑块体二维量子态。
authors: Xiangqi Liu, Chen Xu, Haonan Wang, Runfeng Zhang, Ziyi Zhu, Zhengyang Li, Lianbing Wen, Ze Yan, Fanbo Shen, Jiawei Luo, Zhengtai Liu, Xia Wang, Leiming Chen, Ke Qu, Jianping Sun, Jinguang Cheng, Shiwei Wu, Zhenzhong Yang, Dawei Shen, Yanfeng Guo

articles.title: A Fuzzy Sphere Journey in Critical Phenomena
articles.title_zh: 临界现象中的模糊球之旅
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01310v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This review discusses the recently proposed fuzzy sphere regularization for studying 2+1D critical phenomena, particularly three-dimensional (3D) conformal field theory (CFT). The fuzzy sphere scheme not only offers remarkable efficiency in extracting extensive CFT data at low computational cost but also reveals unexpected connections among 3D CFT (critical phenomena), noncommutative geometry, and the quantum Hall effect. We introduce the fundamental ideas of fuzzy sphere regularization, emphasizing its role in demonstrating the state-operator correspondence of 3D CFTs on the S² × R geometry. Additionally, we review key developments in this approach across various directions and outline potential future applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇综述讨论了用于研究 2+1 维临界现象、特别是三维共形场论的模糊球正则化方法。该方案能以较低计算成本高效提取共形场论数据，并揭示三维临界现象、非对易几何与量子霍尔效应之间的联系。文章介绍其基本思想、在 S² × R 几何上体现态-算符对应的作用，并总结相关进展与未来应用方向。

articles.title: Microscopic origins of inertial magnetization dynamics
articles.title_zh: 惯性磁化动力学的微观起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01398v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultrafast experiments have uncovered inertial magnetization dynamics in ferromagnets, but their microscopic origin remains elusive. Using a non-Markovian quantum master equation we show that inertial dynamics arise from coherent interactions with optical phonons in the lattice. The fast optical frequency explains the nutation observed on picosecond timescales and accounts for variations between experiments through substrate-dependent phonon damping. By establishing magnon{phonon coupling as the microscopic basis of inertial magnetization, our results open new pathways for tailoring ultrafast spin dynamics and controlling magnetic states at terahertz frequencies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对铁磁体中超快实验观测到的惯性磁化动力学，提出其微观来源可归因于与晶格光学声子的相干相互作用。作者利用非马尔可夫量子主方程表明，光学声子的高频特征可解释皮秒尺度上的章动现象，而衬底相关的声子阻尼可导致不同实验结果的差异。该结论将磁振子–声子耦合确立为惯性磁化的微观基础，为太赫兹频率下调控超快自旋动力学提供了途径。
authors: Caleb Webb, Ling Gan, Shufeng Zhang

articles.title: Vitriflow: calibrated amorphous structure ensembles from melt-quench simulation
articles.title_zh: Vitriflow：由熔融–淬火模拟生成的校准非晶结构集合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01407v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Melt--quench molecular dynamics is widely used to construct amorphous materials models, but the resulting ensemble is defined by choices that are often made implicitly: numerical settings, melt temperature, liquid-hold time, quench rate, system size, and post-generation screening. We introduce vitriflow, a computational materials methodology that turns these choices into an explicit decision chain. The framework couples numerical stability, descriptor-based protocol calibration, user-defined artefact screening, and statistical convergence of the generated analysis ensemble in a material-specific descriptor space. We demonstrate the approach for a-SiO₂, a-Si₃N₄, and a-Sm₂O₃, which respectively test tetrahedral network fidelity, MG2 i̊ghtarrow PBE i̊ghtarrow HSE06 DFT refinement of a heteropolar nitride, and amorphous/crystal discrimination in a mixed-coordination rare-earth oxide. vitriflow separates defect-free from oxygen-bridge-defective silica, quantifies DFT-refinement response in a common a-Si₃N₄ structural population, and removes recrystallised Sm₂O₃ structures without imposing fixed coordination. The result is a reproducible route for generating amorphous ensembles whose numerical settings, thermal protocol, screening actions, and statistical precision are selected from the materials question rather than assumed a priori.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出 vitriflow，一种用于非晶材料建模的计算流程，将熔融–淬火分子动力学中常被隐式处理的数值设置、熔融温度、保温时间、淬火速率、体系尺寸和后筛选等选择转化为显式决策链。该框架结合数值稳定性、基于描述符的流程校准、用户定义的伪影筛除以及结构集合的统计收敛分析。作者在非晶 SiO2、Si3N4 和 Sm2O3 上展示其可区分缺陷结构、量化 DFT 精修响应并去除再结晶样本，从而提高非晶结构生成的可重复性与可靠性。
authors: Jonathon Cottom, Robin Delhomme, Emilia Olsson

articles.title: Generalized quantum geometry formulated through interacting vertex correlations
articles.title_zh: 通过相互作用顶点关联表述的广义量子几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01434v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum geometry characterizes the variation of electron wavefunctions in solids along a parameter space. Conventionally, crystal momentum is chosen as the parameter, since it couples to electromagnetic fields, offering an interpretation of quantum geometry in terms of dipole matrix elements, polarization fluctuations, and optical responses. However, Bloch momentum is not the only possible parameter space in which a wavefunction can evolve. In this work, we show that quantum geometry can be extended beyond the bare Bloch-band geometry to manifolds whose adiabatic parameters represent deformations of the ground state, including collective bosonic fluctuations, external fields, or structural distortions. We show that the generalized quantum geometric tensor is encoded by correlations of interacting vertices, conjugate to the deformation parameters. By way of illustration, we briefly discuss the application of these extended geometric concepts to manifolds generated by Hubbard-Stratonovich bosonic fields, or Jahn-Teller configurational spaces. The formulation presented here is framed by general manifolds, which extend quantum geometry to generic structural, collective, and interactive many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将量子几何从传统的布洛赫动量空间推广到由基态形变参数构成的更一般流形，包括集体玻色涨落、外场或结构畸变等。作者指出，广义量子几何张量可由与这些形变参数共轭的相互作用顶点关联函数编码。文中还简要讨论了该框架在 Hubbard-Stratonovich 玻色场流形和 Jahn-Teller 构型空间中的潜在应用，为相互作用体系中的量子几何提供了更通用表述。

articles.title: Resonant cooling of nuclear spins by optically-oriented holes in MAPbI₃ perovskite crystals
articles.title_zh: MAPbI3 钙钛矿晶体中由光取向空穴引起的核自旋共振冷却
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01441v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Resonant cooling of nuclear spins by photogenerated spin-oriented holes is demonstrated for MAPbI₃ perovskite crystals. It is evidenced by Hanle-effect measurements under helicity-modulated excitation with variable frequency. The resonance position in magnetic field shifts toward higher fields with increasing modulation frequency. The invariance of the Hanle curve upon in-plane sample rotation is consistent with the involvement of ²⁰⁷Pb nuclei with spin I = 1/2, which do not exhibit quadrupolar splitting. The shape of the resonance feature in the Hanle curve reveals that the nuclear spins are cooled by carriers with a negative g-factor, consistent with holes. The resonance fields associated with the modulation frequencies exceed the half-width of the weakly localized hole contribution to the Hanle curve, indicating that strongly localized holes are the primary carriers responsible for the nuclear spin cooling.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在 MAPbI3 钙钛矿晶体中展示了由光生自旋取向空穴导致的核自旋共振冷却。作者通过在不同调制频率的圆偏振激发下测量 Hanle 效应，观察到共振磁场随调制频率升高而向高场移动。样品面内旋转下 Hanle 曲线保持不变，支持 207Pb 核自旋参与；共振特征和磁场尺度进一步表明强局域空穴是核自旋冷却的主要载流子。
authors: Mladen Kotur, Dmitri R. Yakovlev, Nataliia E. Kopteva, Bekir Turedi, Maksym V. Kovalenko, Manfred Bayer

articles.title: Intrinsically low thermal conductivity of stoichiometric lithium niobate:Experimental measurement and microscopic origin
articles.title_zh: 化学计量铌酸锂的本征低热导率：实验测量与微观起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01673v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: With the rapid development of integrated electro-optic and nonlinear optical devices based on lithium niobate (LiNbO₃, LN), thermal management is becoming a critical area of focus. However, experimental measurement of thermal transport in stoichiometric LiNbO₃ (sLN) remains scarce, and the intrinsic microscopic mechanisms remain to be established. Here, we combine the laser pump-probe technique of frequency-domain thermoreflectance (FDTR) with state-of-the-art machine-learned atomistic simulations to comprehensively investigate thermal transport in sLN. The measured and simulated room-temperature thermal conductivity (κ) values of sLN agree well, which are orders-of-magnitude lower than that of many classic and emerging semiconductors such as silicon. Furthermore, the temperature-dependent κ exhibits a T⁻α scaling with α near unity, suggesting that thermal transport is dominated by intrinsic phonon-phonon scattering. By comparing sLN with cubic boron arsenide (cBAs) which serves as an ultrahigh-κ benchmark, we reveal that harmonic properties are not responsible for the low κ of sLN, which feature phonon heat capacity and group velocities that are either higher than or comparable to those in cBAs. Instead, the low κ originates from substantially stronger anharmonicity and larger scattering phase space. These two factors collectively suppress phonon lifetimes by 1-2 orders of magnitude, leading to a maximum phonon mean free path of approximately 140 nm. As a result, notable size effects emerge in thin-film sLN below 1 μm, with κ dropping to half the bulk value at 10 nm. Altogether, our findings establish a fundamental understanding of thermal transport in sLN and provide atomistic insights for thermal management in advanced lithium niobate technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合频域热反射激光泵浦–探测实验和机器学习原子模拟，系统研究化学计量 LiNbO3 的热输运。实验与模拟得到的室温热导率相互吻合，并显示其显著低于许多典型和新兴半导体材料。温度依赖关系接近 T 的负幂律，表明本征声子–声子散射主导热输运；与高热导率立方砷化硼的比较用于揭示其低热导率的微观来源。
authors: Wenjiang Zhou, Fuwei Yang, Yuxi Wang, Weiheng Li, Wujuan Yan, Kexin Zhang, Bai Song

articles.title: Predicting Novel Stable Materials for Experimental Synthesis
articles.title_zh: 预测用于实验合成的新型稳定材料
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01713v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning-accelerated materials discovery has yielded large numbers of computationally stable compounds, yet many remain experimentally unrealized, underscoring a persistent gap between prediction and synthesis. Here, we introduce a hierarchical screening framework that combines PBE-based thermodynamic stability, efficient dynamical-stability screening enabled by universal machine-learning interatomic potentials, and SCAN-based thermodynamic refinement. Applying this protocol to the 894 stable materials previously reported in Sci. Data 9, 302 (2022), we first curate 603 unique structures, of which only 298 remain thermodynamically stable on the complete PBE phase diagrams, demonstrating the critical role of competing phases in stability assessment. Dynamical screening then identifies 166 materials stable under both harmonic-phonon and finite-temperature molecular dynamics criteria, and SCAN phase diagrams further narrow this set to 109. Finally, by combining decomposition enthalpy with chemical-space completeness, we prioritize 25 candidates as high-confidence targets for experimental synthesis. This work provides a practical protocol for translating stability predictions into experimentally actionable synthesis targets, closing a key gap in machine-learning-driven materials discovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种分层筛选框架，用于从机器学习预测的稳定材料中识别更有可能被实验合成的候选物。流程结合 PBE 热力学稳定性、通用机器学习原子间势支持的动力学稳定性筛选，以及 SCAN 泛函下的热力学精修。作者对既有数据库中的候选材料重新评估，逐步缩小至兼具热力学与动力学稳定性的集合，并依据分解焓和化学空间完整性优选出高置信度实验合成目标。
authors: Yuqi An, Sihong Zhu, Joseph Montoya, Xingyu Guo, Zhenbin Wang

articles.title: Ultrasonic Observation of Slowing Down of Multipole Fluctuations in Sr₂RuO₄
articles.title_zh: Sr2RuO4 中多极涨落减慢的超声观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01720v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We performed ultrasonic measurements on the unconventional superconductor Sr₂RuO₄ to investigate the dynamical properties of the electronic states near its superconducting transition temperature, T_c = 1.4 K. We observed an increase in the in-plane transverse ultrasonic attenuation coefficient as the temperature approached T_c. The ultrasonic attenuation exhibited a Landau-Khalatnikov-type ultrasonic frequency dependence with a typical relaxation time of approximately 10⁻¹⁰ s. Under an applied magnetic field of 10 T, the superconducting transition was suppressed. However, the ultrasonic attenuation coefficient exhibited an increase down to low temperatures, indicating the slowing down of fluctuations associated with multipole degrees of freedom. Based on group-theoretical considerations, we propose that the electric hexadecapole plays a crucial role in the slowing down. Furthermore, we discuss the relationship between multi-component superconducting order parameters and multipole degrees of freedom.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过超声测量考察非常规超导体 Sr2RuO4 在超导转变温度附近电子态的动力学性质。随着温度接近 Tc，作者观察到面内横向超声衰减增强，并呈现 Landau-Khalatnikov 型频率依赖，对应约 10⁻¹⁰ 秒的弛豫时间。在 10 T 磁场抑制超导转变后，超声衰减仍在低温增强，表明与多极自由度相关的涨落减慢；作者提出电十六极矩可能在其中起关键作用。
authors: Ryosuke Kurihara, Mitsuhiro Akatsu, Shunsuke Yaoita, Keisuke Mitsumoto, Yuichi Nemoto, Yoshiyuki Yoshida, Hiroshi Yaguchi, Terutaka Goto

articles.title: Evidence for Deconfined Magnetic Order in the Kitaev-J₃ Model
articles.title_zh: Kitaev-J3 模型中去禁闭磁有序的证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01815v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the Kitaev-J₃ honeycomb model using variational Monte Carlo calculations combined with a vison-quasiparticle analysis of the parent Kitaev spin liquid (KSL). We provide evidence for deconfined magnetic phases in which zigzag or antiferromagnetic order coexists with remnant Z₂ topological structure inherited from the KSL. The optimized variational wave functions retain multiple linearly independent topological sectors on a torus, whereas those of conventional ordered phases collapse to a single sector. The vison-quasiparticle analysis shows that magnetic order naturally arises from vison-pair condensation while single visons remain gapped, yielding a microscopic mechanism for magnetic ordering without immediate confinement. The resulting phases further host gapless spinons with multiple Majorana cones, offering a possible microscopic scenario for the anomalous low-temperature longitudinal thermal transport reported in magnetically ordered Kitaev materials such as Na₂Co₂TeO₆. Our results reveal a microscopic route to fractionalized magnetism beyond the conventional dichotomy between magnetic order and spin-liquid behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合变分蒙特卡洛计算和母态 Kitaev 自旋液体的 vison 准粒子分析，研究蜂窝晶格 Kitaev-J3 模型。结果表明，锯齿形或反铁磁有序可与继承自 Kitaev 自旋液体的残余 Z2 拓扑结构共存，形成去禁闭磁性相。作者认为磁有序可由 vison 对凝聚产生，而单个 vison 仍保持能隙，从而提供一种磁有序不必立即导致禁闭的微观机制，并可能解释若干 Kitaev 材料中的低温热输运异常。

articles.title: Quantifying angular momentum of coherently driven circular phonons
articles.title_zh: 相干驱动圆偏振声子的角动量定量测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01841v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The use of intense terahertz (THz) pulses to manipulate low-energy excitations offers a powerful approach for ultrafast control of electronic and magnetic properties in materials. Theory suggests that circular ionic motions driven by THz fields carry angular momentum, potentially generating internal magnetic fields. Recent experiments in nonmagnetic SrTiO3 (STO) have hinted at such THz-induced fields, but their origin remains debated. Here, we employ ultrafast x-ray diffraction to resolve the time-dependent ionic trajectories in STO following excitation by circularly polarized THz pulses. Our analysis reveals that oxygen ions, despite their lower mass, contribute around 90% of the phonon angular momentum. The resulting imbalance between the negatively and positively charged ions provides a clear explanation for the mechanism behind induced magnetism in STO. This work further provides the first quantitative measurement of circular ionic motions and their angular momentum and establishes a general methodology for the investigation of angular momentum transfer in solids, paving the way for new strategies to control topological phonon transport and phonon-driven magnetism in quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用超快 X 射线衍射解析 SrTiO3 在圆偏振太赫兹脉冲激发后的离子运动轨迹，以定量评估圆形离子振动携带的声子角动量。结果表明，尽管氧离子质量较小，却贡献了约 90% 的声子角动量，负、正离子贡献的不平衡为 SrTiO3 中太赫兹诱导磁性的机制提供了清晰解释。该工作建立了研究固体中角动量转移的通用实验方法。
authors: Roman Mankowsky, Serhane Zerdane, Shih-Wen Huang, Mathias Sander, Xin Liu, Danylo Babich, Martina Basini, Puneet Kaur, Jan-Chi Yang, Michael Fechner, Urs Staub, Henrik Lemke

articles.title: Fermiology and spin polarization of topological surface states in PtBi₂
articles.title_zh: PtBi₂ 中拓扑表面态的费米面特征与自旋极化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01947v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Layered PtBi₂ is a candidate for topological superconductivity arising in Fermi-arc surface states. Using spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, we demonstrate that the Fermi arcs in PtBi₂ are singly degenerate and spin-polarized, which establishes their nontrivial topology and constitutes a necessary condition for topological superconductivity. We further uncover a pronounced surface-termination dependence of the Fermi-arc dispersion, yielding either nearly flat or approximately linear bands in agreement with first-principles calculations. Together, the observed spin polarization and termination-dependent bandwidth of the Fermi-arc surface states identify key ingredients underlying the potential emergence of topological superconductivity in PtBi₂.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用自旋分辨和角分辨光电子能谱研究层状 PtBi₂ 的费米弧表面态。实验显示这些费米弧为单重简并且具有自旋极化，从而支持其非平庸拓扑性质，并满足拓扑超导可能出现的必要条件。研究还发现费米弧色散强烈依赖表面终止方式，可呈近乎平坦或近似线性的能带形态。
authors: Anders Christian Mathisen, Xin Liang Tan, Stefanie Suzanne Brinkman, Kristian Mæland, Fabian Göhler, Øyvind Finnseth, Grigory Shipunov, Falk Pabst, Manuel Alonso Lemos, Balasubramanian Thiagarajan, Craig Polley, Björn Trauzettel, Anna Isaeva, Jorge I. Facio, Hendrik Bentmann

articles.title: Curvature-driven wall accumulation in chiral active particles
articles.title_zh: 手性活性粒子中由曲率驱动的壁面聚集
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01948v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a dilute system of non-motile chiral active particles confined in geometries ranging from straight channels to circular enclosures. Activity is introduced through chiral particle-wall interactions, modeled as tangential wall forces that generate the edge currents characteristic of chiral active matter. Remarkably, although the particles lack self-propulsion, these boundary currents induce density inhomogeneities. We show that boundary curvature drives a wall accumulation phenomenon: particles remain uniformly distributed in straight channels but accumulate near the boundaries of circular confinements. Numerical simulations and a hydrodynamic theory for the density and momentum fields consistently capture this curvature-induced wall-accumulation. These results identify boundary curvature as a fundamental control parameter for chiral edge transport and confinement-induced organization, with potential experimental relevance to spinning colloids and granular spinners.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究受限几何中稀薄的非自推进手性活性粒子体系，活性来源于粒子与壁面的手性相互作用并产生边缘流。结果表明，尽管粒子本身不具备自推进能力，边界电流仍会诱导密度不均匀；在直通道中粒子分布均匀，而在圆形约束中会向边界聚集。数值模拟和流体动力学理论共同表明，边界曲率是调控手性边缘输运和受限自组织的重要参数。
authors: Alessandro Petrini, Raphaël Maire, Umberto Marini Bettolo Marconi, Lorenzo Caprini

articles.title: An efficient formalism for inertial spin waves: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya antiferromagnets as case studies
articles.title_zh: 惯性自旋波的高效形式主义：以 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 反铁磁体为例
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02021v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic inertia, emerging in the ultrafast regime, supports inertial spin waves (SWs) as novel magnetic excitations. Despite considerable efforts devoted to inertial SWs, a systematic formalism for fully characterizing their intrinsic properties, especially chirality and polarization, is still lacking, and inertial SWs in spatially nonuniform magnetic configurations remain poorly explored. Here, we develop a framework for calculating inertial SWs and establish a general definition of their chirality and polarization via the ellipticity angle, a unified parameter encoding frequency sign, phase difference, and elliptical axis ratio. Using this method, we systematically investigate precessional and nutational SWs in uniaxial antiferromagnets with staggered and homogeneous Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions (DMIs), covering uniform collinear, canted, and spiral magnetic configurations. The results reveal that small staggered DMI preserves spin-wave degeneracy, whereas small homogeneous DMI lifts it. Further space-time inversion symmetry breaking in canted and spiral structures fully removes spin-wave degeneracy across the entire Brillouin zone. Long-wavelength nutational SWs behave as backward waves, and flat bands emerge in canted and spiral configurations near a critical inertial relaxation time. In canted and spiral configurations, nutational modes are always lefthanded whereas precessional modes are always righthanded; additionally, the dispersion spectra of the canted configuration can be derived from those of the spiral configuration via band folding. Polarization is wavenumber insensitive for uniform configurations but becomes strongly dispersive for nonuniform ones. This work advances the fundamental understanding of magnetic inertial dynamics and provides theoretical insights for the development of ultrafast magnonic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种计算惯性自旋波的理论框架，并通过椭圆率角统一定义其手性和偏振性质。作者将该方法应用于含交错与均匀 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用的单轴反铁磁体，涵盖均匀共线、倾斜和螺旋磁结构。结果显示，小的交错 DMI 保持自旋波简并，而小的均匀 DMI 会解除简并；在进一步破缺时空反演对称性的结构中，自旋波简并可在整个布里渊区被完全解除。
authors: De-Yun Zhao, Ri-Xing Wang, Meng-Qiu Cai, Mikhail Cherkasskii, Peng-Bin He

articles.title: A depth resolved investigation of hydrogen uptake in carbon based nanostructures by soft-to-hard photoemission spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 利用软到硬 X 射线光电子能谱深度分辨研究碳基纳米结构中的氢吸收
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02022v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hydrogen chemisorption on graphitic carbon modifies the carbon orbital hybridization from sp2 to sp3, altering both structural and electronic properties. Understanding not only the lateral extent but also the depth distribution of hydrogen uptake in three-dimensional carbon architectures is essential for both fundamental studies and storage applications. To this end, we investigate here the evolution of the C 1s core-level lineshape in nanoporous graphene (NPG) and vertically aligned carbon nanotubes (CNTs) upon hydrogenation, exploiting soft-to-hard X-ray photoemission spectroscopy to achieve a depth-resolved analysis. Decomposition of the C 1s spectra reveals the formation of an sp3 rich overlayer in both systems, with an effective thickness ranging from a fraction of a graphitic monolayer (NPG) to approximately one graphitic layer (CNTs), indicating limited hydrogen penetration beneath the outermost accessible surfaces. Overall, hydrogenation in both materials remains predominantly localized on the surface. These results clarify the spatial distribution of hydrogen in curved and porous graphitic networks and provide quantitative constraints on its chemisorption for carbon-based hydrogen storage applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过软到硬 X 射线光电子能谱分析氢化后纳米多孔石墨烯和垂直排列碳纳米管的 C 1s 芯能级线形演化，以获得氢吸附的深度分布信息。谱线分解表明，两类体系均形成富 sp3 的表层，其有效厚度从少于一个石墨单层到约一个石墨层不等，说明氢主要局限在最外层可接近表面。该结果有助于量化弯曲和多孔石墨网络中氢的空间分布。
authors: Orlando Castellano (Dipartimento di Scienze, Università degli Studi di Roma Tre, Rome, Italy, INFN Sezione di Roma Tre, Rome, Italy), Alice Apponi (INFN Sezione di Roma Tre, Rome, Italy), Luca Cecchini (INFN Sezione di Roma, Rome, Italy), Daniele Paoloni (Dipartimento di Scienze, Università degli Studi di Roma Tre, Rome, Italy), Simone Ritarossi (Dipartimento di Scienze, Università degli Studi di Roma Tre, Rome, Italy, INFN Sezione di Roma Tre, Rome, Italy), Francesco Pandolfi (INFN Sezione di Roma, Rome, Italy), Ilaria Rago (INFN Sezione di Roma, Rome, Italy), Tien-Lin Lee (Diamond Light Source Ltd, Didcot, United Kingdom), Samuel Jeong (Department of Applied Physics, Institute of Pure and Applied Sciences, University of Tsukuba, Japan), Yoshikazu Ito (Department of Applied Physics, Institute of Pure and Applied Sciences, University of Tsukuba, Japan, Tsukuba Institute for Advanced Research), Carlo Mariani (INFN Sezione di Roma, Rome, Italy, Sapienza Università di Roma, Rome, Italy), Gianluca Cavoto (INFN Sezione di Roma, Rome, Italy, Sapienza Università di Roma, Rome, Italy), Francesco Offi (Dipartimento di Scienze, Università degli Studi di Roma Tre, Rome, Italy, INFN Sezione di Roma Tre, Rome, Italy), Alessandro Ruocco (Dipartimento di Scienze, Università degli Studi di Roma Tre, Rome, Italy, INFN Sezione di Roma Tre, Rome, Italy)

articles.title: Anisotropic nanoscale coherent polariton transport in CrSBr
articles.title_zh: CrSBr 中各向异性的纳米尺度相干极化激元输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02071v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In a combined experimental and theoretical study, we demonstrate anisotropic polariton transport on the nanoscale in the van der Waals antiferromagnet CrSBr. While effective cavity-polariton formation emerges via the self-hybridization of ultra-high oscillator strength excitons with a thin slab photonic mode, the absence of external mirrors facilitates spectroscopic investigation of these polaritons via cathodoluminescence (CL) on length scales determined by the electron wavelength. This direct access allows us to perform precise charting of the polariton landscape with nanometric resolution, and to probe polariton interference phenomena. The main finding of the work highlights that the coherent polariton transport follows the C₂ᵥ symmetry of CrSBr, allowing exclusive transport along the crystallographic a-axis, while no coherent feature is found along the b-axis direction. Our work sets the foundation to use CL spectroscopy in cavity-polaritonics in more advanced landscapes, such as photonic crystals or optical lattices, and establishes the technique as a powerful tool to probe anisotropic expansion and relaxation phenomena on the nanoscale
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合实验与理论，在范德华反铁磁体 CrSBr 中展示了纳米尺度的各向异性极化激元输运。由于高振子强度激子与薄片光子模式自杂化形成有效腔极化激元，作者可利用阴极发光在纳米分辨率下绘制极化激元图景并探测干涉现象。主要发现是相干极化激元输运遵循 CrSBr 的 C2v 对称性，仅沿晶体学 a 轴出现，而沿 b 轴未观测到相干特征。
authors: Paritosh Malik, Dogyun Ko, Vita Solovyeva, Chirag Chandrakant Palekar, Imad Limame, Sven Rodt, Kseniia Mosina, Zdeněk Sofer, Alexander Steinhoff, Martin Esmann, Stephan Reitzenstein, Bo Han, Christopher Gies, Christian Schneider

articles.title: Anisotropic tunneling through magnetic barriers in 8-Pmmn borophene
articles.title_zh: 8-Pmmn 硼烯中穿越磁势垒的各向异性隧穿
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02077v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a theoretical study of electron tunneling through a magnetic barrier in 8-Pmmn borophene, created by depositing two ferromagnetic strips on the borophene sheet. Using a low-energy effective Hamiltonian that captures the anisotropic Dirac spectrum, we solve the Dirac equation in three regions and impose wave-function continuity at the interfaces. From the resulting spinor solutions, we compute current densities and determine transmission and reflection probabilities as functions of incident energy, angle, and barrier parameters. The transmission exhibits strong anisotropy due to the tilted Dirac cones, with pronounced suppression for specific incident directions, suggesting directional filtering of carriers. We further calculate the conductance using the Landauer-Büttiker formalism, revealing that both magnetic strength and barrier width can tune the charge transport properties. The results demonstrate that engineered magnetic barriers in 8-Pmmn borophene enable precise control over electron flow, offering a platform for anisotropic transport control and tunable quantum devices. The interplay between the intrinsic anisotropy of borophene and external magnetic barriers provides rich opportunities to manipulate Dirac fermions in two-dimensional systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文理论研究了 8-Pmmn 硼烯中由两条铁磁条带构建的磁势垒对电子隧穿的影响。作者基于包含各向异性 Dirac 能谱的低能有效哈密顿量，求解不同区域的 Dirac 方程并计算透射、反射和电导。结果显示，倾斜 Dirac 锥导致强烈各向异性透射，并在特定入射方向出现显著抑制，表明该体系可用于方向选择性载流子过滤和可调量子输运器件。
authors: Rachid El Aitouni, Sanae Zriouel, Clarence Cortes, David Laroze, Ahmed Jellal

articles.title: The Wigner function for Integer quantum Hall effect
articles.title_zh: 整数量子霍尔效应的 Wigner 函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02094v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Wigner's quasi-probability distribution function in phase space is a specialized representation of the density matrix, possessing significant physical importance. In this article, we first review the wave function describing electronic motion in an electromagnetic field under the Landau gauge. Next, based on an introduction to the properties of the Wigner function, we calculate the Wigner function for the integer quantum Hall effect using the integral method.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文围绕相空间中的 Wigner 准概率分布函数在整数量子霍尔效应中的表示展开。作者首先回顾 Landau 规范下电磁场中电子运动的波函数，并介绍 Wigner 函数的相关性质。随后利用积分方法计算整数量子霍尔效应对应的 Wigner 函数，为该效应的相空间描述提供形式化结果。
authors: Yao Wang, Qi-Ming Fu, Huawei Fan, Li Yu, Kang Li

articles.title: Quantum-geometric shift of quasiequilibrium: Origin of nonreciprocal current driven by quantum-metric dipole
articles.title_zh: 准平衡的量子几何位移：量子度量偶极驱动非互易电流的起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02100v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study nonlinear DC electric transport of quantum-metric origin by combining adiabatic perturbation theory with the nonequilibrium Green function approach. The adiabatic ansatz provides a basis for directly treating a DC electric field in the velocity gauge, rather than introducing it as the zero-frequency limit of an AC field. The resulting adiabatic-basis Hamiltonian takes the same form as in the length gauge, enabling a systematic comparison across different formulations. Applying this fully quantum formulation, we find a longitudinal nonreciprocal current governed by the quantum-metric dipole. The essential ingredient is a quantum correction to the distribution function that is absent in semiclassical treatments. We trace this correction to the finite spread of an electron wave packet during relaxation under a bias field, thereby identifying shifted quasiequilibrium as the physical origin of quantum-metric nonreciprocal transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合绝热微扰理论与非平衡格林函数方法，探讨源于量子度量的非线性直流电输运。作者在速度规范中直接处理直流电场，并发现由量子度量偶极控制的纵向非互易电流。其关键机制是半经典理论中缺失的分布函数量子修正，该修正源于偏置场下弛豫过程中电子波包有限展宽导致的准平衡态位移。
authors: Sota Kitamura, Takahiro Anan, Takahiro Morimoto

articles.title: A 2048-spin bulk acoustic wave Ising machine for number partitioning and Sudoku
articles.title_zh: 用于数划分与数独问题的 2048 自旋体声波 Ising 机
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02112v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optical coherent Ising machines based on time-multiplexing have demonstrated significant progress in terms of connectivity and spin scalability. However, they are constrained by large physical footprints, high power consumption, poor thermal stability, and high cost. Here, we present a time-multiplexed Ising machine leveraging propagating wave packets in solid-state delay lines at microwave frequencies, enabling thermally stable, robust, low-power, tabletop, and affordable design. We use two serially connected 20.5 MHz, 707 μs bulk acoustic wave delay lines supporting 2,048 spins. Our design provides all-to-all connectivity with 15-bit coupling resolution and finds approximate MAX-CUT solutions in 341 ms, potentially scalable to sub-ms by using higher frequency delay lines. Additionally, we demonstrate solutions to number partitioning and Sudoku problems. Compared with state-of-the-art Coherent Ising machines, our machine exhibits four orders of magnitude higher thermal stability. Against the simulated bifurcation algorithm, our design achieves comparable results on the MAX-CUT problem, while outperforming it on the more complex number-partitioning and Sudoku problems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种基于固态延迟线中微波频段传播波包的时间复用 Ising 机，以替代传统光学相干 Ising 机在体积、功耗、稳定性和成本方面的局限。装置由两条串联的 20.5 MHz、707 微秒体声波延迟线构成，可支持 2048 个自旋，并提供全连接和 15 位耦合分辨率。作者展示了其在 MAX-CUT、数划分和数独问题上的求解能力，并指出其热稳定性相较先进相干 Ising 机提高约四个数量级。
authors: Venkatesh Vadde, Roman Ovcharov, Victor H. González, Roman Khymyn, Artem Litvinenko, Johan Åkerman

articles.title: Plaid-Like Spin Splitting and Chirality of Magnon Bands in Antiferromagnetic MnTe₂
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁 MnTe₂ 中磁振子能带的格纹状自旋劈裂与手性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02114v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets constitute an emerging class of magnetic materials that combine compensated antiferromagnetic order with spin-split excitations arising from crystalline symmetries. Despite strong theoretical interest, their experimental identification remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate that helicity- and angle-resolved Raman scattering measurements reveal reduced rotational symmetries of magnons and a pronounced imbalance between left- and right-circular polarization channels, indicating momentum-dependent magnon handedness. First-principles DFT+U calculations combined with linear spin-wave theory uncover a characteristic plaid-like spin-splitting structure in momentum space. The resulting magnon spin textures are dictated by the unconventional sublattice symmetries of MnTe₂ and closely emulate those of altermagnetic electronic bands. Our work provides evidence of chiral spin-wave excitations unique to this non-coplanar antiferromagnet.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用螺旋度和角分辨 Raman 散射揭示 MnTe₂ 中磁振子的降低旋转对称性以及左右圆偏振通道之间的显著不平衡，表明存在动量依赖的磁振子手性。第一性原理 DFT+U 计算结合线性自旋波理论发现，其动量空间中具有特征性的格纹状自旋劈裂结构。研究表明，这些磁振子自旋纹理由 MnTe₂ 的非常规子晶格对称性决定，并与交替磁性电子能带的自旋纹理相似。
authors: Dirk Wulferding, Daehyeon An, Jiwon Choi, Dongmin Mun, Youngsu Choi, Sivasakthi Kuppusamy, Sritharan Krishnamoorthi, Raman Sankar, Myung Joon Han, Se Kwon Kim, Kwang-Yong Choi

articles.title: Unconventional Mixed-Parity Magnetism in Rare-Earth Tetraborides
articles.title_zh: 稀土四硼化物中的非常规混合宇称磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02117v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetism has advanced the study of compensated magnets by revealing non-relativistic spin splitting, traditionally classified into strictly even- or odd-parity spin textures. Here, we unveil a fundamentally different regime: component-resolved mixed-parity spin splitting in a fully three-dimensional compensated magnet. Using first-principles calculations, tight-binding and k ḑot p models, along with spin-group symmetry analysis, we demonstrate that the non-coplanar ground state of TbB₄ enforces a unique momentum-space spin texture. The in-plane spin components exhibit odd-parity p- and f-wave-like textures, whereas the out-of-plane component retains an even-parity d-wave altermagnetic character. Crucially, the coexistence of the in-plane odd-parity textures is driven not by relativistic spin-orbit coupling, but by a staggered Berry phase arising from the inherent scalar spin chirality. This mixed-parity structure dictates distinct transport fingerprints, including bulk non-relativistic Edelstein and spin Hall responses, as well as a symmetry-allowed Berry curvature dipole. These results establish the rare-earth tetraborides as a robust platform for engineering complex spin-charge conversion phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出在三维补偿磁体中存在一种分量分辨的混合宇称自旋劈裂机制，不同于传统交替磁性中严格偶宇称或奇宇称的分类。基于第一性原理、紧束缚和 k·p 模型以及自旋群对称性分析，作者指出 TbB4 的非共面基态会产生独特的动量空间自旋纹理：面内自旋分量呈奇宇称 p 波和 f 波特征，而面外分量保持偶宇称 d 波交替磁性特征。该混合宇称结构预示非相对论 Edelstein 与自旋 Hall 响应以及对称性允许的 Berry 曲率偶极等输运特征。
authors: Dong-Choon Ryu, Jae-Ho Han, Bongjae Kim, Chang-Jong Kang

articles.title: A density matrix renormalization group approach to quantum point contacts
articles.title_zh: 量子点接触的密度矩阵重整化群研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02183v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using the density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) combined with the correction-vector method, we investigate the competition between an harmonic potential and repulsive interactions in a one-dimensional fermionic system. The parabolic confinement induces spatial inhomogeneity, and by tuning its curvature one can continuously interpolate between a potential well--relevant for cold-atom setups--and a quantum barrier, as realized in mesoscopic systems such as quantum point contacts. We analyze how the ground-state particle distribution evolves with the strength and sign of the confining potential and how the confinement reshapes the spectral weight of the local density of states (LDOS) at the center of the chain. In the barrier regime, a localized peak emerges in the electron part of the spectrum (ømega >0) as a direct consequence of the potential. In contrast, in the well configuration and for weak interactions, a localized feature persists but shifts to the hole sector (ømega <0). However, for stronger interactions, the LDOS no longer displays clear signatures of the external potential, indicating that correlations dominate over single-particle confinement.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将密度矩阵重整化群与校正矢量方法结合，考察一维费米子体系中谐振子势与排斥相互作用之间的竞争。抛物型束缚势会诱导空间非均匀性，通过调节曲率可在冷原子体系相关的势阱与介观量子点接触中的势垒之间连续过渡。结果表明，在势垒情形下，链中心局域态密度的电子谱区出现由外势导致的局域峰；在势阱且弱相互作用下，类似特征转移到空穴谱区，而强相互作用会削弱外势在谱函数中的清晰信号。

articles.title: Differentiable inverse design of short-range order in high-entropy alloys: from target sro to target property
articles.title_zh: 高熵合金短程有序的可微逆向设计：从目标短程有序到目标性能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02219v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Short-range order (SRO) governs the mechanical response of multi-principal-element alloys, but designing an alloy for a target property usually means solving two disconnected problems: building a structure matching a desired SRO pattern, then separately checking its property, with no shared optimization. This work replaces the standard random-swap search (reverse Monte Carlo) with a gradient-based approach: atom occupancy is treated as continuous rather than fixed, so the whole process can be tuned using gradient descent, the same method used to train neural networks. This builder matches random-swap accuracy on small systems, but is six times faster and eight times more accurate on large 4000-atom systems, and scales smoothly to alloys with many elements without extra bookkeeping. A physics-based correction term, adapted from prior two-element work and extended here to many elements, keeps designed structures thermodynamically realistic rather than just numerically matching the target SRO pattern. A small neural network then predicts mechanical properties directly from composition and SRO statistics, closing the loop from target property back to structure. Tested on nine face-centered-cubic and body-centered-cubic alloys, the pipeline captured SRO-driven stiffness changes from -20% to +57%, and cell-size checks showed at least 864 atoms are needed to get the direction and size of these changes right, since the commonly used 108-atom cells can mislead. Against real simulations for a cobalt-chromium-nickel alloy, the method matched three of four target stiffness values within 6%. The method is released as an open-source Python package, anisro, offering a practical route to gradient-based, property-driven alloy design.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对多主元合金中短程有序对力学响应的关键作用，提出一种基于梯度优化的结构逆向设计方法，以取代传统随机交换式反向蒙特卡罗搜索。方法将原子占位视为连续变量，从而可用类似神经网络训练的梯度下降进行优化，并在大规模体系中实现更高效率和精度。作者还引入物理约束修正以保持结构热力学合理性，并结合小型神经网络由成分和短程有序统计量预测力学性能，形成从目标性能到结构设计的闭环。
authors: Tiancheng Ding, Conrard Giresse Tetsassi Feugmo

articles.title: Ultrafast Demagnetization Governed by Spin Fluctuations in CaRuO₃/SrTiO₃ Superlattice
articles.title_zh: CaRuO₃/SrTiO₃超晶格中由自旋涨落主导的超快退磁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02224v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: For ultrafast magnetization switching devices, critical slowing down in conventional ferromagnets near their Curie temperature constitutes a key challenge that must be overcome. In contrast to this typical behavior, we observe an anomalous acceleration of demagnetization in CaRuO₃/SrTiO₃ superlattices, a moderately correlated weak itinerant ferromagnet. The demagnetization rate increases with rising temperature, pump fluence, and applied magnetic field. To explain these anomalous phenomena, we develop a phenomenological model integrating the three-temperature model with self-consistent renormalization theory. Because the intrinsic gradient magnetism of the superlattice suppresses the typical divergence of specific heat, the conventional thermodynamic bottleneck is bypassed. Our model reveals that this decoupling enables the ultrafast dynamics to be predominantly governed by the spin-fluctuation-driven enhancement of the electron-spin scattering vertex. Our work demonstrates how spatial inhomogeneity can decouple macroscopic thermodynamic singularities from microscopic scattering processes, offering a new paradigm for manipulating ultrafast spin dynamics in correlated quantum materials. The pronounced sensitivity of the demagnetization rate to external parameters further suggests the potential for designing highly tunable ultrafast spintronic devices that leverage enhanced fluctuations near the magnetic instability.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注超快磁化翻转器件中传统铁磁体在居里温度附近临界慢化的问题，并在弱巡游铁磁CaRuO₃/SrTiO₃超晶格中观察到反常的退磁加速。实验显示退磁速率随温度、泵浦通量和外加磁场升高而增加。作者建立结合三温模型与自洽重整化理论的唯象模型，指出超晶格内禀梯度磁性抑制了比热的典型发散，使超快动力学主要受自旋涨落增强的电子—自旋散射控制。
authors: Yu-Han Gao, Wen-Xiao Shi, Yuan-Sha Chen, Ji-Rong Sun, Qing-Lin Yang, Xu Yang, Zhuo Deng, Peng-Tao Yang, Zheng Chang, Hong-Mei Feng, Wei He, Xiang-Qun Zhang, Zhao-Hua Cheng

articles.title: Efficient Large-Scale STEM-EELS Simulations With Torched-TACAW
articles.title_zh: 基于Torched-TACAW的高效大规模STEM-EELS模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02236v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The time auto-correlation of auxiliary wave functions (TACAW) method enables efficient simulations of ultra-low-loss electron energy loss spectra (EELS) arising from vibrational and magnon excitations. In practical applications to realistic materials systems, however, TACAW calculations become challenging due to the large system sizes required for models containing defects, interfaces, impurities, or grain boundaries, as well as the substantial computational cost and data throughput associated with molecular dynamics and multislice calculations. Here we discuss a practical methodology for large-scale TACAW simulations and present torched-TACAW, a freely available implementation of the TACAW part of the described workflow for efficient STEM-EELS simulations. The overall approach combines molecular dynamics based on foundational machine-learned interatomic potentials, partitioning of elongated supercells, and on-the-fly processing of multislice outputs in order to enable near ab initio quality simulations with tractable memory use and data flow. Using rutile TiO2 as a model system, we analyze important numerical aspects of the method, including windowing and supercell partitioning, and demonstrate atomic-resolution STEM-EELS simulations for thick samples.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作介绍用于超低损耗电子能量损失谱模拟的辅助波函数时间自相关方法，并针对含缺陷、界面、杂质或晶界等真实材料体系中的大规模计算瓶颈提出实践流程。作者发布了Torched-TACAW，这是一个用于高效STEM-EELS模拟中TACAW部分的开源实现。整体方案结合机器学习原子间势驱动的分子动力学、细长超胞分区以及多重散射输出的即时处理，以在可控内存和数据流条件下实现接近从头算质量的模拟。
authors: Martin Osmera, João Vaz, Paul M. Zeiger, Ján Rusz

articles.title: From Bloch to Néel: Anisotropy-dependent Domain-Wall Character in FePd Thin Films
articles.title_zh: 从布洛赫型到奈尔型：FePd薄膜中各向异性依赖的畴壁特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02256v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report an experimental investigation of the depth-dependent domain wall formation in L1₀₋FePd thin films with high perpendicular magnetic anisotropy. Using circular dichroism X-ray resonant magnetic scattering (CD-XRMS) as a function of the incident X-ray angle, we explore the depth evolution of chiral spin textures in two samples with different strengths of magnetocrystalline anisotropy. Combined with CD-STXM, CD-ptychography, and macroscopic characterization of the structural order, magnetic properties, and surface morphology, we relate these observations to differences in the long-range order of the L1₀ phase of FePd. One FePd thin film with very high magnetocrystalline anisotropy, characterized by QPMA=1.8, exhibits an unexpectedly large Néel contribution. Angular-dependent CD-XRMS directly reveals a smooth transition from a hybrid Bloch-Néel chirality within the upper FePd layer towards a purely Néel-type structure at the lower FePd interface. In the second FePd sample, despite a still relatively large QPMA=1.45, the domain walls were found to be purely Néel type. These results indicate a crucial role of the long-range structural order in determining the formation of the magnetic structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究实验考察了具有高垂直磁各向异性的L1₀-FePd薄膜中随深度变化的畴壁形成。作者利用随入射角变化的圆二色性X射线共振磁散射，并结合CD-STXM、CD-ptychography及宏观结构和磁性表征，分析手性自旋织构与FePd长程有序程度之间的关系。结果显示，即使在很高磁晶各向异性下也可出现显著奈尔型分量，并在不同样品中观察到从混合布洛赫—奈尔手性到纯奈尔型畴壁的深度演化或纯奈尔型结构。
authors: Annika Stellhorn, Alicia Backs, Ekaterina Klyushina, Connie Bednarski-Meinke, Steffen Tober, Denis Vasiukov, Oskar Stepancic, Vítor Alexandre de Oliveira Lima, Lukas Aniansson, Paul Steadman, Manuel Valvidares, Jörg Schwenke, Claudiu Bulbucan, Elizabeth Blackburn

articles.title: Localization and Topological Properties of SU(3) Fermions in non-Abelian Gauge Fields: Color-Orbit Coupling and Color-Flip Fields
articles.title_zh: 非阿贝尔规范场中SU(3)费米子的局域化与拓扑性质：颜色—轨道耦合和颜色翻转场
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02274v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interplay between disorder, gauge fields, and internal degrees of freedom fundamentally affects localization and topological properties of quantum many-body systems. Motivated by recent experimental realizations of synthetic non-Abelian gauge fields for SU(3) colored fermions, we investigate their localization and topological properties in 1D bichromatic optical lattices consisting of strong and weak laser beams. Describing the non-Abelian gauge field via color-orbit coupling and color-flip (Rabi) fields, we obtain a tight-binding description of trapped SU(3) colored fermions corresponding to a generalized three-color Aubry-André model. We show that these fields explicitly break the conventional self-duality of a simple three-color Aubry-André system. This duality breaking generates mobility regions across the energy spectrum, demonstrating that non-Abelian fields can either enhance or hinder color localization. Using exact diagonalization, density-of-states evaluations, and finite-size scaling of the inverse participation ratio, we obtain phase diagrams that identify regions of extended or localized bulk states. Furthermore, the color-orbit and Rabi fields induce edge states with topological properties. We develop an exact mapping from our 1D disorder model into a 2D color Harper model with a fictitious magnetic flux ratio and dimension controlled by the weak laser beam's phase. Using this mapping, we evaluate topological invariants, such as the charge-charge Chern number, for edge states emerging in energy gaps, revealing the topological insulating nature of several gapped phases. Lastly, we identify that these topological color-insulator phases can energetically neighbor three configurations: two extended, two localized, or one of each. This sharply contrasts with conventional topological insulators, which always neighbor two extended phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究受合成非阿贝尔规范场实验进展启发，考察一维双色光晶格中SU(3)有色费米子的局域化与拓扑性质。作者通过颜色—轨道耦合和颜色翻转拉比场描述非阿贝尔规范场，得到广义三色Aubry-André紧束缚模型。结果表明，这些场会显式破坏常规自对偶性，在能谱中产生迁移区域，并可增强或抑制颜色局域化；研究还通过精确对角化、态密度和逆参与比有限尺寸标度绘制扩展态与局域态相图。
authors: Bar Alluf, C. A. R. Sá de Melo

articles.title: Velocity and force autocorrelations in Brownian dynamics with a Lorentz force
articles.title_zh: 含洛伦兹力布朗动力学中的速度与力自相关
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02282v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive a general relation between the velocity and force autocorrelation tensors (VACT and FACT) for a Brownian particle subject to an external magnetic field. Using time-symmetry arguments, we show that, for the full Langevin dynamics, the VACT depends only on the FACT, independently of the details of the interaction potential. Under the hypothesis of timescale separation between thermalization and interaction-driven motion, this relation simplifies considerably in the overdamped (Brownian) limit. A central feature of the overdamped result is that, unlike in the field-free case, the part of the VACT that controls the self-diffusion of the particle couples to the antisymmetric part of the FACT, with a coupling strength set by the ratio of the cyclotron frequency to the thermalization rate. We validate and illustrate the formalism on an exactly solvable model: a dimer of charged particles bound by a harmonic potential. Depending on the relative sign of the particle charges, the magnetic field is found to produce either a transient suppression of mobility and diffusion that is fully recovered at long times, or a persistent oscillatory force autocorrelation, regions of negative mobility, and a long-time suppression of self-diffusion.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文推导了外磁场中布朗粒子的速度自相关张量与力自相关张量之间的一般关系。基于时间对称性论证，作者证明在完整朗之万动力学中，速度自相关仅依赖于力自相关，而不依赖相互作用势的具体形式；在热化与相互作用运动时间尺度分离时，该关系在过阻尼极限下显著简化。一个关键发现是，与无磁场情形不同，控制自扩散的速度自相关部分会耦合到力自相关的反对称部分，耦合强度由回旋频率与热化速率之比决定。

articles.title: Correlation and entanglement dynamics of free fermions in disguise
articles.title_zh: 伪装自由费米子的关联与纠缠动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02359v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the nonequilibrium dynamics following a quantum quench in spin chains that can be solved via a mapping to free fermions in disguise. These models feature an exponential degeneracy of all energy eigenvalues, raising the question of the validity of the established framework describing the properties of integrable systems out of equilibrium. We present two main results. First, we develop an analytic method to compute the quasi-momentum distribution function characterizing the generalized Gibbs ensemble, and derive an analytic formula to compute the corresponding expectation values for special observables. Second, we conjecture a modification of the standard formula for the entanglement growth based on the quasi-particle picture, taking into account that each fermion in disguise carries an additional amount of entropy due to the exponential degeneracy of the energy eigenvalues. We test our theoretical predictions against numerical tensor-network computations for different initial states and Hamiltonian parameters. For the local observables, we find excellent agreement. For the entanglement dynamics, we find small deviations suggesting that our conjecture is only approximately correct. Our results represent a first step towards the extension of the established framework of integrable systems out of equilibrium to models hosting free fermions in disguise.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察可映射为“伪装自由费米子”的自旋链在量子淬火后的非平衡动力学，这类模型所有能量本征值具有指数简并，从而挑战传统可积系统非平衡描述框架。作者发展了解析方法计算表征广义吉布斯系综的准动量分布函数，并给出特殊可观测量期望值的解析公式。针对纠缠增长，论文提出对标准准粒子图像公式的修正，考虑每个伪装费米子因指数能级简并携带的额外熵，并用张量网络数值结果进行检验。
authors: Dávid Szász-Schagrin, Pablo Bayona-Pena, Lorenzo Piroli, Eric Vernier

articles.title: Coupled Spin-Orbital p-Wave Magnetism via Structural and Magnetic Chirality
articles.title_zh: 由结构手性与磁手性耦合产生的自旋—轨道p波磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02378v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Helical spin textures represent the minimal realization of p-wave magnetism which is characterized by momentum-odd spin polarization. Independently, structurally chiral crystals exhibit momentum-odd orbital polarization arising from broken inversion symmetry. Here, we demonstrate that spin-orbit coupling couples these two independent microscopic chirality degrees of freedom, allowing the orbital polarization of a chiral crystal to generate an additional contribution to the p-wave spin splitting. The resulting spin-orbital state is naturally classified by the relative chirality η=ḩiₘₐₜₕᵣₘ cḩiₘₐₜₕᵣₘ ₘ, giving rise to two symmetry-distinct p-wave phases corresponding to homochiral and heterochiral configurations which can be directly probed by the longitudinal conductivity. These phases exhibit distinct transport signatures, establishing relative chirality as an experimentally accessible symmetry degree of freedom in chiral magnetic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作指出，螺旋自旋织构是p波磁性的最小实现，其特征是动量奇的自旋极化；而结构手性晶体则因反演对称性破缺产生动量奇的轨道极化。作者证明自旋—轨道耦合能够连接这两种微观手性，使手性晶体的轨道极化为p波自旋劈裂提供额外贡献。由此形成的自旋—轨道态可按相对手性分类，产生同手性和异手性两类对称性不同的p波相，并可通过纵向电导的输运特征直接探测。
authors: Tom G. Saunderson, Börge Göbel, Ersoy Şaşioğlu, Samir Lounis

articles.title: Q-GAIN: A Python Package for Machine Learning and Physically Informed Analysis Applications
articles.title_zh: Q-GAIN：用于机器学习与物理信息分析应用的Python软件包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02413v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Here we describe the quantum gas analysis and inference (Q-GAIN) Python package, which enables rapid deployment of machine learning (ML) and physics-informed analysis techniques for cold-atom experiments. Out of the box, Q-GAIN implements classification, object detection, and physics-informed metrics for feature detection in images of atomic Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs). Q-GAIN encourages a natural, module-based workflow: starting with data loading and preprocessing, followed by ML-based feature identification, and ending with conventional analysis techniques. We demonstrate this modularity by configuring Q-GAIN for three ML tasks. First, we demonstrate the basic workflow of the Q-GAIN framework by implementing the standard task of classifying handwritten digits from the MNIST dataset. Then, we re-implement our earlier soliton detection (SolDet) package in the Q-GAIN framework, enabling the detection and analysis of solitonic excitations in time-of-flight data. Finally, we develop an object-detection tool that identifies quantized vortices in images of ring-shaped BECs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文介绍量子气体分析与推断Python软件包Q-GAIN，用于在冷原子实验中快速部署机器学习和物理信息分析技术。该软件包内置了针对原子玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚体图像的分类、目标检测和物理信息特征识别指标，并支持从数据载入、预处理、机器学习识别到传统分析的模块化流程。作者通过MNIST数字分类、孤子激发检测以及环形BEC中量子化涡旋识别三个任务展示了其适用性。
authors: M. Doris, S. Guo, S. M. Koh, L. Ritter, A. R. Fritsch, S. Mukherjee, I. B. Spielman, J. P. Zwolak

articles.title: Bottlenecks in Hamiltonian-Adaptive Resolution Simulation Method for Modeling Interfaces
articles.title_zh: 用于界面建模的哈密顿自适应分辨率模拟方法中的瓶颈
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02415v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Hamiltonian-Adaptive Resolution Simulation (H-AdResS) method allows to combine atomistic and particle-based coarse-grained models in a single simulation box, which makes it very attractive to model systems containing interfaces or reactive regions surrounded by an interacting environment. In our previous work [arXiv:2604.21867], we implemented H-AdResS in LAMMPS 2023 and extended its use to interfaces, focusing on MOF/CO₂ interfaces as an example. We found that, despite its advantages, using this method properly for this kind of systems is not trivial. In this work, an in-depth analysis of the impact of the choice of thermostatting schemes and long-range electrostatics models is presented. Even though its Hamiltonian formulation enables performing H-AdResS simulations within constant temperatures ensembles, not every thermostat is appropriate. We demonstrate that Langevin thermostat is a reliable choice for this method, while Nosé-Hoover results in artifacts. In addition, we show that using short-range models such as the Damped Shifted Force method for electrostatics, a popular choice for H-AdResS simulations, can lead to non-physical results when modeling interfaces. The need of capping strategies to deal with discontinuities in forces and energies arising from abrupt changes in resolution is also discussed. Finally, the impossibility of changing the definition of the H-AdResS Hamiltonian to include a gradual interpolation of the bonded degrees of freedom is discussed. We hope that this contribution helps the reader to appropriately set up H-AdResS simulations and to assess if this method can be used to accurately model their system of interest.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析哈密顿自适应分辨率模拟方法在界面体系建模中的关键限制，该方法可在同一模拟盒中结合原子级模型和粒子基粗粒化模型。作者基于其在LAMMPS中实现并应用于MOF/CO₂界面的工作，深入考察恒温方案和长程静电模型选择的影响。结果表明，尽管该方法具有哈密顿形式，并非所有恒温器都适用；Langevin恒温器较可靠，而Nosé-Hoover可能引入伪影，短程静电近似也可能导致非物理结果。
authors: Hari Haran Sudhakar (Sorbonne Université, CNRS, Physicochimie des Électrolytes et Nanosystèmes Interfaciaux, F-75005, Paris, France), Alessandra Serva (Sorbonne Université, CNRS, Physicochimie des Électrolytes et Nanosystèmes Interfaciaux, F-75005, Paris, France, Réseau sur le Stockage Electrochimique de l'Energie), Rocio Semino (Sorbonne Université, CNRS, Physicochimie des Électrolytes et Nanosystèmes Interfaciaux, F-75005, Paris, France)

articles.title: One-Body Purity, Non-Gaussianity, and Entanglement in Interacting Integrable Models
articles.title_zh: 相互作用可积模型中的单体纯度、非高斯性与纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01326v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: When describing entanglement in typical midspectrum eigenstates of many-body lattice Hamiltonians, two paradigms have emerged that capture the behavior observed in integrable and nonintegrable systems, Haar-random fermionic Gaussian states and Haar-random pure states, respectively. Remarkably, the former capture the behavior of interacting integrable systems, whose eigenstates are non-Gaussian. We argue that the paradigm that captures both the entanglement properties and the lack of Gaussianity in integrable systems is that of random superpositions of polynomially many Gaussian states. In contrast, eigenstates of nonintegrable systems are consistent with being described by random superpositions of exponentially many Gaussian states. We gain this understanding by comparing analytical and numerical results for the one-body purity, the non-Gaussianity, and the entanglement entropy of the random superpositions and the Hamiltonian eigenstates.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论多体晶格哈密顿量中典型能谱中部本征态的纠缠刻画，并比较可积与非可积体系的不同随机态范式。作者指出，可积相互作用体系虽本征态非高斯，但其纠缠与非高斯性可由多项式数量高斯态的随机叠加描述；非可积体系则更符合指数数量高斯态随机叠加的图像。研究通过单体纯度、非高斯性和纠缠熵的解析与数值比较支持这一理解。
authors: Rafał Świketek, Maksymilian Kliczkowski, Lev Vidmar, Marcos Rigol

articles.title: Lamb Shift of a Static Atom Facing a Rotating Surface
articles.title_zh: 面对旋转表面的静止原子的兰姆位移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01495v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study how the Lamb shift of a static atom is modified when a nearby planar body rotates rigidly about its normal while the atom is held at a fixed distance a. We derive a general formula for the shift in terms of the angularly Doppler-shifted reflection coefficients of the surface, valid for any axially symmetric planar material. Expanding the result to second order in the angular velocity Ømega, we identify two independent contributions associated with the orbital and spin components of the electromagnetic angular momentum. The orbital contribution, proportional to (Ømegah̊o)², reproduces locally the Lamb shift induced by a surface translating at the tangential velocity Ømegah̊o, whereas the spin contribution, proportional to (aØmega)², originates from the rotational Doppler shift of the photon helicity and survives even on the rotation axis. We first illustrate the formalism using a graphene sheet and then apply it to finite-thickness Drude and plasma conductors and to doped semiconductors. Rotation enhances the Casimir-Polder interaction for graphene and metallic surfaces, whereas it weakens it for doped semiconductors, depending on whether the carrier plasma frequency reaches the near-field scale 1/a. Above a threshold angular velocity, the atomic level also acquires a finite linewidth, providing a spectroscopic signature of quantum friction.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究当平面材料绕法向刚性旋转时，固定距离处静止原子的兰姆位移如何被修正。作者推导了适用于轴对称平面材料的一般公式，并在角速度二阶展开中区分出与电磁角动量轨道分量和自旋分量相关的两类贡献。研究以石墨烯为例说明方法，并进一步讨论有限厚度 Drude、等离子体导体和掺杂半导体，发现旋转对不同材料的 Casimir-Polder 相互作用可产生增强或削弱效应。
authors: César D. Fosco, Fernando C. Lombardo, Francisco D. Mazzitelli

articles.title: The ring wants to be broken
articles.title_zh: 环想要被打破
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01967v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Ramsey community number r_κ is the minimum network size at which a graph's connectivity is better described by a partition into communities than by no partition, under a prescribed community-detection rule. It was introduced through numerical simulations of networks grown by local rules, which suggested that community structure can emerge without any node heterogeneity. Here I compute r_κ analytically for the simplest homogeneous, locally wired graph: the circulant ring lattice Cₙ₍₁,dots,c). Using a Bernoulli stochastic block model with symmetric Beta priors as the detection rule, the Bayesian evidence for a balanced two-community partition and for the unpartitioned network are both obtained in closed form, so the transition between them can be located exactly. The result is a sharp dependence on the interaction range: the plain cycle (c=1) is never partitioned, its two-community posterior decaying as n⁻⁽²α⁺³⁾, so r_κ=infty; but the next-nearest-neighbour ring (c=2) acquires a finite r_κsimeq 35 nodes, above which the partition is preferred with a log-evidence growing as (łn 2),n. This provides an exactly solvable instance of community emergence in a network with no built-in communities, and shows that a minimal amount of local connectivity is enough to break the ring.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作解析研究 Ramsey 社区数，即在给定社区检测规则下，网络何时更适合被划分为社区而非视为无社区结构。作者以最简单的齐次局域连边图——循环环格为对象，利用带对称 Beta 先验的 Bernoulli 随机块模型计算两社区划分与未划分模型的贝叶斯证据。结果显示，相互作用范围决定转变：普通环不会被划分，而含次近邻连接的环在约 35 个节点以上会偏好两社区结构。

articles.title: False vacuum decay in a two-dimensional quantum spin system
articles.title_zh: 二维量子自旋系统中的假真空衰变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01994v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: False vacuum decay describes the relaxation of a metastable state through the nucleation and growth of bubbles of the stable phase. Despite describing a broad variety of phenomena across different fields, the quantum version of the nucleation theory has little experimental or numerical support. Testing its predictions is particularly important in two or more spatial dimensions, where bubble nucleation acquires its true geometrical nature. Here, we study false vacuum decay in the quantum Ising model in two dimensions. Through tree tensor network simulations we extract the decay rate, the effective interface tension and the critical bubble size. We compare them to new semi-classical field theory calculations, and find excellent agreement. These results provide numerical evidence that the critical-bubble picture survives in an interacting quantum spin system in 2+1 dimensions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察二维量子 Ising 模型中的假真空衰变，即亚稳态通过稳定相气泡的成核与生长发生弛豫。作者利用树张量网络模拟提取衰变率、有效界面张力和临界气泡尺寸，并与新的半经典场论计算比较。结果显示二者高度一致，为 2+1 维相互作用量子自旋系统中临界气泡图像的适用性提供了数值证据。
authors: Luka Pavešić, Ian G. Moss, Simone Montangero

articles.title: Thermodynamics of Quantum Reservoir Computing
articles.title_zh: 量子储备池计算的热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02157v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum reservoir computing provides a framework for processing complex temporal data, yet its fundamental computational and energetic limits remain unresolved. Here, we establish a non-equilibrium thermodynamic framework that links the macroscopic predictive performance of driven open quantum systems to their microscopic energetic costs.
