articles.title: Optimization Algorithms of the Proposed FOC of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor for Electric Vehicles
articles.title_zh: 面向电动汽车永磁同步电机改进型磁场定向控制的优化算法
articles.abstract: The optimization algorithms used for the suggested Field-Oriented Control FOC strategy of a Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor PMSM for electric vehicle applications. The goal of the study is to improve the PMSM drive system's stability, efficiency, and dynamic performance across a range of operating scenarios. The creation of a comprehensive electric vehicle model took into account the electric motor, powertrain, and vehicle dynamics. To determine how vehicle mass affected performance and energy consumption, three different vehicle weights, 600 kg, 900 kg, and 1200 kg, were simulated. The FOC system incorporates advanced optimization approaches to minimize current ripple and electromagnetic torque variations while improving speed tracking, torque response, and energy utilization. MATLAB Simulink is used to design and simulate the PMSM model and control system in order to assess the efficacy of the suggested methods. The refined FOC technique achieves greater performance in terms of quick transient response, decreased steady-state error, and enhanced overall drive efficiency, according to comparative simulation results, making it ideal for contemporary electric vehicle propulsion systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究用于电动汽车永磁同步电机磁场定向控制策略的优化算法，目标是提升驱动系统在多种工况下的稳定性、效率和动态性能。作者构建了包含电机、传动系统和车辆动力学的综合电动汽车模型，并模拟600 kg、900 kg和1200 kg三种车辆质量对性能和能耗的影响。仿真结果表明，优化后的控制策略可降低电流纹波和电磁转矩波动，改善速度跟踪、转矩响应和能量利用效率。

articles.title: Electromagnetic Environment Distortion Near UHV AC and DC Transmission Lines Under Thunderstorm Cloud Electric Fields
articles.title_zh: 雷暴云电场下特高压交直流输电线路附近电磁环境畸变
articles.abstract: The stratified charge structure within thunderstorm clouds generates a significant background electric field near the ground, distorting the electromagnetic environment (EME) of ultra-high voltage (UHV) transmission lines. Currently, research has rarely investigated the distinct impacts of thunderstorm conditions on UHV alternating current (UHVAC) and direct current (UHVDC) systems respectively. To address this, the finite element method (FEM) is employed to model 1000 kV UHVAC and ± 800 kV UHVDC lines based on typical mid-to-low latitude thunderstorm charge distributions. By incorporating the background field as a voltage boundary condition, the EME influence patterns for both line types are quantitatively assessed. Results indicate that for UHVAC lines, the thunderstorm field induces a significant DC bias, increasing the instantaneous peak field intensity by approximately 20% over normal operation. For UHVDC lines, the field accelerates space ion migration, leading to a 28% increase in total electric field intensity and a 48% rise in ion flow density. These findings reveal the EME modulation mechanisms under thunderstorm clouds, providing a theoretical foundation for the electromagnetic protection design of various UHV configurations.
articles.abstract_zh: 雷暴云分层电荷结构会在近地面产生显著背景电场，从而改变特高压输电线路周围电磁环境。本文采用有限元法建立1000 kV特高压交流线路和±800 kV特高压直流线路模型，并将雷暴背景电场作为电压边界条件，定量评估其影响。结果表明，雷暴电场会使交流线路产生明显直流偏置并使瞬时峰值场强增加约20%；对直流线路则会加速空间离子迁移，使总电场强度和离子流密度分别增加约28%和48%。

articles.title: Mitigating Cadmium Stress in Milk Thistle through Plant Growth-Promoting Rhizobacteria and Radiated Achenes: A Biochemical and Physiological Perspective
articles.title_zh: 植物促生根际细菌与辐照瘦果缓解水飞蓟镉胁迫：生化与生理视角
articles.abstract: Soil contamination with cadmium (Cd) as a significant environmental challenge, has become a persistent and highly toxic heavy metal due to increased industrial and agricultural activities. Cd exposure negatively impacts plant growth, photosynthetic efficiency, nutrient uptake, and oxidative balance, which reduce crop productivity and harmful effects to human health. This study aimed to evaluate the effect of two eco-friendly approaches, plant growth-promoting rhizobacteria (PGPR) and gamma-radiated achenes (0-10 GY) on growth indices, biochemical, and yield attributes of milk thistle (Silybum marianum) under 200 μM Cd stress. Results revealed that combination of PGPR inoculation and 4 GY radiation improved shoot length by 31%, photosynthetic rate by 7.08%, and silymarin content by 28%, while reducing oxidative stress markers H₂O₂ by 33%, MDA by 7.89% under Cd stress. Enhanced activity of antioxidant enzymes such as, superoxide dismutase, catalase, by 97% and 50%, respectively, and accumulation of phenolics and flavonoids by 100% and 33% were also observed. Mineral nutrients, osmolytes, photosynthetic pigments, gas exchange parameters, silymarin content, and oil content revealed significant improvement with the application of PGPR and achene radiation treatments. Overall, treatment effectiveness ranked as radiation doses (GY): 4 > 2 > 0 > 6 > 8 > 10, with 4 GY + PGPR showing the greatest improvement in Cd tolerance and silymarin accumulation. However, growth parameters, biochemical, and yield attributes were significantly increased with the application of PGPR under non-stressed plants. These findings highlight the potential of integrating PGPR and gamma radiation to improve milk thistle resilience and productivity in Cd-contaminated environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 镉污染是重要环境问题，会抑制植物生长、光合作用、养分吸收和氧化平衡，并影响作物生产与人体健康。本文评估植物促生根际细菌和0–10 Gy伽马辐照瘦果对200 μM镉胁迫下水飞蓟生长、生化指标和产量性状的影响。结果显示，PGPR接种与4 Gy辐照组合可提高株高、光合速率和水飞蓟素含量，并降低H₂O₂和MDA等氧化胁迫标志物，同时增强抗氧化酶活性和酚类、黄酮等代谢物积累。

articles.title: Comparative genomics of the RBOH gene family across 22 Brassicaceae species and characterization of BnRBOHs
articles.title_zh: 22种十字花科物种RBOH基因家族的比较基因组学及BnRBOHs特征分析
articles.abstract: Respiratory burst oxidase homologs (RBOHs) are key enzymes on the plant plasma membrane that mediate stress-induced extracellular reactive oxygen species (ROS) bursts, playing important roles in plant growth, development, and stress responses. Previous studies on the RBOH gene family have largely focused on identification and functional analysis in single species, and systematic phylogenetic analyses across a broad range of Brassicaceae species remain lacking. In this study, based on genomic data from 22 Brassicaceae species, we systematically identified the RBOH gene family and obtained a total of 314 RBOH genes. Phylogenetic analysis classified these 314 RBOH genes into five conserved groups. Whole genome duplication (WGD) was the major driving force for gene family expansion, contributing 58.6% of the genes (184 genes). Synteny analysis revealed the evolutionary and retention patterns of RBOH genes between Brassica napus and its diploid progenitors Brassica rapa and Brassica oleracea. Promoter analysis revealed abundant stress-responsive and hormone-responsive cis-elements, with the abscisic acid-responsive element ABRE and the hormone cross-regulatory element as-1 being the most enriched. Expression analysis showed that BnRBOH genes exhibited differential response patterns under abiotic stresses such as drought and salt stress, with significantly more responses in root tissues than in leaf tissues. Transcription factor regulatory network analysis identified 244 transcription factors regulating 18 BnRBOH genes, with stress-responsive core transcription factor families such as ERF, NAC, and WRKY being dominant. This study fills the gap in large-scale phylogenetic research on the RBOH gene family in Brassicaceae and provides important theoretical foundations for molecular design breeding of stress-tolerant rapeseed.
articles.abstract_zh: 呼吸爆发氧化酶同源蛋白是植物质膜上的关键酶，参与胁迫诱导的胞外活性氧爆发，并在植物生长发育和逆境响应中发挥重要作用。本文基于22种十字花科物种基因组数据系统鉴定出314个RBOH基因，并将其划分为五个保守类群。研究表明，全基因组复制是该家族扩张的主要驱动力，共线性分析揭示了甘蓝型油菜及其二倍体祖先种之间RBOH基因的进化和保留模式，启动子分析还发现了丰富的胁迫和激素响应元件。

articles.title: TRIE: An Evaluation Framework for Stochastic PDE Surrogates
articles.title_zh: TRIE：随机偏微分方程代理模型的评估框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00196v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many scientific systems exhibit uncertainty from stochastic forcing, unresolved degrees of freedom, or imperfect observations, making reliable surrogate forecasting fundamentally distributional rather than pointwise. For such systems, deterministic neural surrogates fail to capture statistical measures and forecast uncertainty. We introduce TRIE, an evaluation framework for stochastic PDE surrogates that asks whether models reproduce invariant measures, provide trustworthy predictive uncertainty, and scale to efficient probabilistic generation. We demonstrate TRIE on two stationary chaotic spatially extended SPDEs, stochastic Kuramoto--Sivashinsky and stochastic Kolmogorov flow, across 11 parameter values. Our evaluation shows that standard pointwise-trained neural surrogates can produce plausible short rollouts while failing to match long-time statistical structure. Approximate uncertainty methods such as Monte Carlo dropout and heteroscedastic Gaussian likelihoods produce stochastic forecasts, but are often miscalibrated and overconfident under temporal and spatial uncertainty diagnostics. Across these criteria, generative models provide the most consistent performance, accurately capturing invariant measure statistics and achieving the lowest CRPS in all reported probabilistic settings. Finally, we show that latent generative models with automatic dimension discovery retain much of this statistical fidelity while reducing Kolmogorov inference time by roughly 12×. We release our code and data at https://github.com/scailab/TRIE-SPDE-Bench to support reproducible evaluation of stochastic PDE forecasting models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出 TRIE 框架，用于评估随机偏微分方程代理模型是否能再现不变测度、给出可靠预测不确定性并高效生成概率预报。作者在随机 Kuramoto–Sivashinsky 方程和随机 Kolmogorov 流等平稳混沌空间扩展系统上进行测试，发现常规逐点训练神经代理虽能生成看似合理的短期轨迹，却可能无法匹配长期统计结构。蒙特卡洛 dropout 和异方差高斯似然等近似不确定性方法也常出现校准不足和过度自信问题。
authors: Bharat Srikishan, Javier E. Santos, Nikhil Muralidhar, Charles D. Young

articles.title: Wildfire-induced nutrient redistribution drives depth-dependent functional decoupling and network destabilization
articles.title_zh: 野火诱导的养分再分配驱动深度依赖的功能解耦与网络失稳
articles.abstract: Background Fire frequency and severity are increasing in subtropical regions under climate change, profoundly altering soil biogeochemical cycling. However, little is known about how wildfire influences microbial carbon (C), nitrogen (N), and phosphorus (P) cycling functions throughout the soil profiles. Here, we used metagenomic sequencing to characterize microbial functional genes associated with C, N, and P cycling across a wildfire severity gradient in surface (0–10 cm), middle (10–30 cm), and deep (30–50 cm) soils in a subtropical forest.Results We found that vertical spatial heterogeneity primarily structured microbial functional potentials, while wildfire reshaped this structure in a depth-dependent manner. Increasing fire severity significantly enriched microbial N and P cycling potentials but reduced the abundance of C degradation genes in surface soils. In contrast, subsurface microbial functional potentials remained comparatively stable across the fire gradient. Partial Least Squares Path Modeling (PLS-PM) showed that wildfire influences N and P cycling functions primarily through its indirect effects on soil nutrients. Functional co-occurrence network analysis revealed divergent patterns in microbial interactions across fire severity. Low severity fire fostered increased network complexity, whereas extreme fires reduced network complexity, increased vulnerability, and led to the loss of keystone connectors, indicating destabilization of tightly coupled microbial functional interactions.Conclusions Our findings reveal a pronounced vertical decoupling of microbial functional responses to wildfire in subtropical forest soils, with substantial functional reorganization in surface layers but comparatively buffered responses in deeper soils. These results highlight the importance of incorporating soil-depth variation into post-fire assessments of ecosystem resilience and nutrient cycling. The observed nutrient-mediated enhancement of N and P cycling and the destabilization of microbial functional networks under severe fire provide new insights for predicting post-fire ecosystem trajectories and developing forest management strategies aimed at maintaining soil function and promoting ecosystem recovery under increasingly severe wildfire regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用宏基因组测序分析亚热带森林中不同火烧强度下表层、中层和深层土壤微生物碳、氮、磷循环功能基因的变化。结果表明，垂直空间异质性是塑造微生物功能潜力的主要因素，而野火以深度依赖方式重塑这一结构：表层土壤中氮、磷循环潜力增强，碳降解基因丰度下降。路径模型显示野火主要通过改变土壤养分间接影响氮、磷循环功能，功能共现网络分析则提示火烧可能削弱网络稳定性。

articles.title: Node-Level Fault Monitoring in WSN using Deep Neural Networks with Real-Time Graph Mapping and Performance Analysis
articles.title_zh: 基于深度神经网络、实时图映射与性能分析的无线传感器网络节点级故障监测
articles.abstract: A Wireless Sensor Network (WSNs) are essential in the places thatrequire real-time observations. They are however susceptible tonode-level failures, which will have an impact on the reliability ofthe data. The paper provides a deep learning method used to identifyfaults in WSNs through the perspective of a temporal feature oftemperature, battery life, and sensor readings. The Convolution Neural Network (CNN), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models are used in the study and validated to classify the faulty nodes. The evaluation of these models were demonstrated using the parameters such as accuracy, precision, recall and F1-Score and confusion matrix. The obtained values are plotted using the graph-mapping interface in a real-time, dynamically displayed and understandable node status.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种用于无线传感器网络节点级故障识别的深度学习方法，利用温度、电池寿命和传感器读数等时间特征进行建模。研究比较了 CNN、RNN 和 LSTM 模型在故障节点分类中的表现，并使用准确率、精确率、召回率、F1 值和混淆矩阵进行评估。结果通过实时图映射界面动态展示节点状态，以提高故障监测的可解释性和实用性。

articles.title: Horseshoe Salinity Pattern in the Upper Indian Ocean and its Decadal Variability
articles.title_zh: 上印度洋马蹄形盐度格局及其年代际变率
articles.abstract: Salinity plays a crucial role in the global hydrological cycle and climate system by regulating upper ocean stratification and sea surface temperature (SST). Past studies have revealed the dynamics of salinity variation in the world’s major ocean basins and its linkage to global climate on inter-annual to decadal time scales. However, understanding of upper ocean salinity variability in the Indian Ocean, especially on decadal time scale and its global implications, remains limited. This study identifies a prominent Horseshoe Salinity Pattern (HSP), present in the Indian Ocean, extending from surface to 150m depth. It exhibits pronounced decadal variability and is closely associated with SST variability in the southeastern Indian Ocean (SEIO). Composite maps and a sea surface salinity budget analysis reveal that SST anomalies in the SEIO region modulate the local Walker and Hadley circulation anomaly causing the variation in the precipitation pattern. These changes drive upper ocean freshening or salinification, producing the observed HSP Pattern. Advection contributes regionally to salinity variability, particularly in the southern Indian Ocean, but does not play a dominant role in shaping the coherent HSP structure. Further, this pattern modulates upper-ocean stratification, leading to the development of SST anomalies in the western tropical Indian Ocean. These findings offer novel insight into the Indian Ocean salinity dynamics, highlighting the role of SST-salinity coupling and have the potential for improving predictions of decadal climate variability and its global implications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究识别出印度洋上层从海表延伸至约 150 米深度的显著马蹄形盐度格局，并指出其具有明显年代际变率。分析表明，该格局与东南印度洋海表温度变化密切相关，后者可调制局地 Walker 和 Hadley 环流异常，进而改变降水分布并驱动海洋淡化或盐化。盐度收支分析显示，平流在部分区域尤其是南印度洋对盐度变化有贡献，但并非主导机制。

articles.title: GTS-21 alleviates oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation-induced intestinal epithelial cell injury via the PI3K/Akt pathway
articles.title_zh: GTS-21 通过 PI3K/Akt 通路减轻氧糖剥夺/复氧诱导的肠上皮细胞损伤
articles.abstract: Objective: The present study aimed to evaluate the protective effect of GTS-21 against intestinal IR injury and its potential mechanism in in vitro experiments. Methods: In this study, intestinal IR injury model was established in rat intestinal epithelial cells (IEC-6) using oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation (OGD/R).. Cells were divided into five groups: control (Group S), OGD/R (Group OGD/R), GTS-21 + OGD/R (Group GTS), wortmannin + OGD/R (Group T), and GTS-21 + wortmannin + OGD/R (Group GTS+T). Cells were pretreated with GTS-21 (200 μM) 1 h before OGD and/or the PI3K inhibitor wortmannin (WM; 2 μM) 1.5 h before OGD. Cell viability was evaluated using a Cell Counting Kit-8 assay, and apoptosis was assessed by flow cytometry.. The protein levels of Bax, Bcl-2, cleaved caspase-3, cleaved caspase-9 and phosphorylated (p-)Akt were analyzed by western blotting. Reactive oxygen species (ROS), malondialdehyde (MDA) and superoxide dismutase (SOD) levels were measured using colorimetric assays. The levels of TNF-α, IL‑1β, IL‑6 and IL-10 were quantified using ELISA. Results: OGD/R significantly decreased cell viability and p-Akt/Bcl-2 expression, increased apoptosis, pro-apoptotic protein expression, inflammatory cytokine levels, ROS levels and MDA levels, and reduced SOD and IL-10 levels. Treatment with GTS-21 significantly attenuated the inflammatory response and oxidative stress, and reduced apoptosis. However, these protective effects of GTS-21 were abolished by co-treatment with the PI3K inhibitor WM. Conclusion:GTS-21 alleviated OGD/R-induced intestinal epithelial cell injury by attenuating apoptosis, inflammation and oxidative stress, likely through activation of the PI3K/Akt pathway.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在 IEC-6 大鼠肠上皮细胞中建立氧糖剥夺/复氧模型，以评估 GTS-21 对肠缺血再灌注样损伤的保护作用及其机制。结果显示，OGD/R 降低细胞活力和 p-Akt、Bcl-2 表达，并增加凋亡、氧化应激和炎症反应；GTS-21 预处理可缓解这些损伤表现。PI3K 抑制剂 wortmannin 削弱了 GTS-21 的保护作用，提示其效应可能依赖 PI3K/Akt 信号通路。

articles.title: Assembly and characterization of the mitochondrial genome of Camellia pitardii Coh.-St
articles.title_zh: 皮氏山茶线粒体基因组的组装与特征分析
articles.abstract: Camellia pitardii Coh.-St., an economically important tree species in the genus Camellia valued for both its seed oil and ornamental traits, currently lacks a systematically characterized mitochondrial genome. In this study, we assembled and annotated the complete mitogenome of C. pitardii using a hybrid approach that combined Illumina NovaSeq 6000 short reads and Oxford Nanopore long reads. Using bioinformatics tools, we systematically analyzed repetitive sequences, codon usage bias, and RNA editing sites. Furthermore, we constructed phylogenetic trees based on conserved protein-coding genes from both mitochondrial and chloroplast genomes to elucidate the phylogenetic position of these genes. The assembled C. pitardii mitogenome is 895,290 bp in length with a GC content of 45.68%. Annotation revealed a total of 38 protein-coding genes (PCGs), three rRNA genes, and 30 tRNA genes. We identified 260 simple sequence repeats (SSRs), 33 tandem repeats, and 620 pairs of dispersed repeats. Among these, three pairs of long repeats are predicted to mediate the formation of eight potential genomic substructures. The mitogenome exhibited a distinct codon usage bias, with 92.86% of the highly preferred codons (relative synonymous codon usage [RSCU] > 1) ending in A or U. Additionally, 667 RNA editing sites were predicted across the 38 PCGs, encompassing 14 types of amino acid substitutions; 46.48% of these editing events resulted in the conversion of hydrophilic residues to hydrophobic ones. Phylogenetic analyses revealed topological incongruence between the mitochondrial and chloroplast gene trees regarding the placement of several Camellia clades, suggesting a complex evolutionary history for the organelles of C. pitardii and its close relatives. In conclusion, this study characterizeed the fundamental features of the C. pitardii mitogenome, providing valuable baseline data for comparative organellar genomics, phylogenetic reconstruction, and the utilization of germplasm resources within the genus Camellia.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合 Illumina 短读长和 Oxford Nanopore 长读长数据，组装并注释了皮氏山茶的完整线粒体基因组。结果显示其线粒体基因组长度为 895,290 bp，GC 含量为 45.68%，包含 38 个蛋白编码基因、3 个 rRNA 基因和 30 个 tRNA 基因。研究还系统分析了简单重复、串联重复、分散重复、密码子使用偏好和 RNA 编辑位点，并基于线粒体与叶绿体保守蛋白编码基因探讨其系统发育位置。

articles.title: Near-Sensor Damage Localization in Multi-Story Buildings with Level-Crossing Spike Encoding and a Compact Spiking Neural Network
articles.title_zh: 采用电平交叉脉冲编码与紧凑型脉冲神经网络的多层建筑近传感器损伤定位
articles.abstract: Wireless, battery-powered accelerometer nodes are widely used for vibration-based structural health monitoring (SHM), but battery life limits the energy for sampling, on-node inference, and radio transmission. We ask whether an event-driven spike front-end can localize stiffness-degrading damage in a multi-story building while making compute cost scale with signal content. Our pipeline places a small modal filterbank before a level-crossing (temporal-contrast) encoder whose single threshold ((θ)) jointly controls accuracy, synaptic-operation count, and the data volume leaving the sensor; a tiny feed-forward spiking neural network (SNN) trained with a surrogate gradient then classifies the spikes. On a six-class task for a five-story shear building under ambient excitation with random damage severity and noise, the SNN reaches ((87.2%)) accuracy, within two points of a dense 1D convolutional baseline (((89.2%))), at an estimated ((49)) versus ((318)),nJ per inference (operation counts at ((45)),nm). Sweeping ((θ)) traces an accuracy-energy Pareto frontier spanning an order of magnitude, and ablations identify the filterbank as the key enabler. A tuned classical modal-feature classifier is the most accurate method here, so we frame the pipeline's value as event-driven, low-data-rate sensing at competitive accuracy rather than an accuracy gain. Code, trained weights, and seeds are publicly available.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向无线电池供电加速度传感节点在结构健康监测中的能耗瓶颈，提出由模态滤波器组、电平交叉时间对比编码器和小型前馈脉冲神经网络组成的近传感器损伤定位流程。以五层剪切建筑在环境激励、随机损伤程度和噪声条件下的六分类任务为例，模型精度接近一维卷积基线，同时显著降低推理能耗。阈值参数可在精度、突触操作次数和传感器输出数据量之间形成帕累托权衡，消融实验表明滤波器组是关键组件。

articles.title: Parametric Sensitivity Assessment of Slip Flow and Thermophoretic Effects on a Vertical Stretching Surface Using Response Surface Methodology
articles.title_zh: 基于响应面法的垂直拉伸表面滑移流与热泳效应参数敏感性评估
articles.abstract: This study investigates the effect of velocity slip on magnetohydrodynamic boundary-layer flow, emphasizing energy slip and thermophoresis under steady-flow conditions. While Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) employs specialized equipment to generate detailed internal images through proton alignment, the present work focuses on fluid-dynamic mechanisms governing heat and mass transfer. The governing partial differential equations are transformed into ordinary differential equations using similarity transformations and solved with MATLAB’s bvp4c solver. A sensitivity analysis is performed to optimize heat transfer performance, representing a key novelty of the study. The results reveal that increasing the velocity slip parameter from 0.7 to 1.9 significantly alters the velocity and temperature profiles, leading to an enhancement of the Nusselt number by approximately 3.3% and a reduction in skin friction by nearly 19.3%. The influence of the dipole effect on flow characteristics is also examined. Furthermore, Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) demonstrate superior predictive accuracy compared to Response Surface Methodology (RSM). Comparison with earlier studies confirms the validity of the results. Overall, the findings demonstrate the potential of velocity slip to enhance heat transfer more effectively than energy slip and thermophoresis in advanced thermal management systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察稳态条件下速度滑移对磁流体动力学边界层流动的影响，并重点分析能量滑移和热泳对传热传质的作用。作者通过相似变换将控制偏微分方程化为常微分方程，并使用 MATLAB bvp4c 求解，同时开展敏感性分析以优化传热性能。结果显示，速度滑移参数增大可改变速度与温度分布，提高努塞尔数并降低表面摩擦；人工神经网络的预测精度优于响应面法。

articles.title: Topologically Engineered Nematic Networks with Ultrastrong Adhesion and Light-Debonding on Demand
articles.title_zh: 具有超强黏附与按需光脱粘能力的拓扑工程化向列网络
articles.abstract: Adhesives that combine high bonding strength with rapid, controllable debonding remain fundamentally constrained by an intrinsic trade-off between adhesion and reversibility. Conventional pressure-sensitive adhesives (PSAs) rely on viscoelastic dissipation to achieve strong bonding, but their performance is fixed by formulation and cannot be actively switched. Nematic liquid crystal elastomers (LCEs) provide a distinct route in which adhesion is governed by bulk orientational order and can be modulated by the nematic–isotropic phase transition, although the achievable adhesion strength has so far remained limited.  Here we show that network topology engineering transforms nematic elastomers into ultrastrong and reversibly switchable adhesives that exceed industrial benchmarks while enabling remote release on demand. By reducing the fraction of multifunctional crosslinkers, we introduce a dense population of dangling oligomer chains within a percolated nematic network, producing adhesion strengths above 4500 N/m and substantially surpassing commercial duct tapes. Incorporation of MXene nanoplatelets further enhances adhesion while simultaneously enabling rapid photothermal switching through localized heating across the nematic–isotropic transition. Illumination collapses adhesion by more than an order of magnitude (>97%), while cooling restores the adhesive state.  The resulting adhesive behaviour differs fundamentally from that of conventional PSAs because the bonded state evolves through slow reorganization of orientational order under confinement. These results establish a general strategy for ultrastrong yet reversibly switchable adhesion in which network topology, orientational order and photothermal activation are coupled within a single soft material system.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对高黏附强度与可逆脱粘之间的传统矛盾，提出通过网络拓扑工程增强向列液晶弹性体黏附性能。通过降低多官能交联剂比例，材料内部形成大量悬垂低聚物链，同时保留贯通的向列网络，从而实现超过工业胶带基准的超高黏附强度。引入 MXene 纳米片进一步提升黏附并赋予快速光热开关能力，使材料可实现远程按需释放。

articles.title: Mutation-induced conformational remodeling explains gain- and loss-of-function phenotypes in Euglena gracilis phytoene synthase
articles.title_zh: 突变诱导的构象重塑解释裸藻八氢番茄红素合酶的功能获得与功能丧失表型
articles.abstract: Phytoene synthase (CrtB) catalyzes the first committed step in carotenoid biosynthesis and is a key target for enzyme engineering. However, the structural basis underlying gain- and loss-of-function mutations remains poorly understood. Here, we investigated the effects of the Y197A, E121H, and L349F mutations on the conformational dynamics of Euglena gracilis CrtB using molecular dynamics simulations (MD) of the apo enzyme. The simulations revealed mutation-dependent remodeling of the conformational energy landscape, resulting in distinct changes in residue mobility, local interaction networks, and active-site architecture. E121H exhibited the largest redistribution of conformational dynamics, whereas L349F showed pronounced constriction of the hydrophobic flap pocket accompanied by a more rigid interaction network involving Tyr127 and Glu158. In contrast, both gain-of-function variants retained a relatively accessible hydrophobic flap despite local structural rearrangements. These findings provide a structural framework linking mutation-induced conformational remodeling around the catalytic center to the experimentally observed differences in carotenoid production and may facilitate the rational engineering of phytoene synthases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用载脂状态分子动力学模拟，分析 Y197A、E121H 和 L349F 突变对裸藻八氢番茄红素合酶构象动态的影响。结果表明，不同突变会重塑构象能量景观，并导致残基运动性、局部相互作用网络和活性位点结构发生差异性变化。E121H 引起最显著的动态重分布，L349F 则使疏水瓣口袋收缩并增强局部刚性；这些发现为解释类胡萝卜素产量差异提供了结构依据。

articles.title: Biosynthesized Silver Nanoparticles from Strobilanthes attenuata: Characterization and Enhanced Antibacterial Activity
articles.title_zh: 由 Strobilanthes attenuata 生物合成的银纳米颗粒：表征及增强抗菌活性
articles.abstract: In this study, silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) were synthesized through a green approach using the aqueous extract of Strobilanthes attenuata and their antibacterial potential was investigated. The formation of AgNPs was confirmed by the appearance of a characteristic surface plasmon resonance peak in the UV-visible absorption spectrum, while FTIR analysis indicated that plant-derived functional groups participated in the reduction of silver ions and stabilization of the synthesized nanoparticles. Particle size distribution, surface charge and colloidal stability were evaluated by dynamic light scattering and zeta potential analysis using a Malvern Zetasizer Nano ZS, whereas morphology was examined using scanning electron microscopy. The biosynthesized AgNPs displayed antibacterial activity against Escherichia coli, Staphylococcus aureus, Bacillus subtilis and Pseudomonas aeruginosa, with inhibition zones generally increasing with concentration (25–100 µg/mL). However, the aqueous extract of the plant did not show any activity against all tested bacterial strains. These findings indicated that conversion of the plant extract into nanoparticle form significantly enhanced its antibacterial activity. Thus, S. attenuata can be utilized for the green synthesis of nanoparticles with potential antimicrobial applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用 Strobilanthes attenuata 水提物绿色合成银纳米颗粒，并评估其抗菌潜力。紫外-可见吸收、傅里叶变换红外、动态光散射、ζ电位和扫描电子显微镜等表征证实了纳米颗粒的形成、稳定性和形貌特征。生物合成银纳米颗粒对大肠杆菌、金黄色葡萄球菌、枯草芽孢杆菌和铜绿假单胞菌表现出浓度依赖性抑菌作用，而植物水提物本身未显示明显活性，说明纳米化显著增强了抗菌效果。

articles.title: THz-induced phonon mode mixing and collective dynamics in a polar nanolattice
articles.title_zh: 极性纳米晶格中的太赫兹诱导声子模式混合与集体动力学
articles.abstract: Manipulating phonons through symmetry is a fundamental approach to alter the dynamic responses of materials. Most often new phases are sought through control of the unit-cell (e.g. via strain, doping, light, etc.). By comparison, there is vast potential to look beyond the unit-cell into higher-order architectures to control wave scattering and interference effects that remains less explored. We describe the THz-induced dynamics of an SrTiO3 thin film with a nanoscale ordered interfacial dislocation network probed with 2- and 3-dimensional time-resolved x-ray diffraction and classical molecular dynamics simulations. We find that symmetry breaking at all scales is an effective approach to create a dynamical electric polarization and to control phonon mixing that generates previously unreported collective modes in the THz regime with circular vortex-like displacements. This work opens a new pathway to explore dynamical functional properties that can be extended to magnetic, electric, and ferroelectric systems by controlling the real-space topology via epitaxy.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨通过多尺度对称性调控声子行为，以改变材料动态响应的可能性。作者利用二维和三维时间分辨 X 射线衍射及经典分子动力学模拟，研究具有纳米有序界面位错网络的 SrTiO3 薄膜在太赫兹激发下的动力学。结果表明，跨尺度对称性破缺可诱导动态电极化并调控声子混合，产生具有环形涡旋状位移的太赫兹集体模式，为通过外延拓扑设计功能动力学性质提供了新路径。

articles.title: Quantum semiconductor design could expand search for dark matter
articles.title_zh: 量子半导体设计或将拓展暗物质搜寻范围
articles.abstract: Dark matter accounts for 85% of the matter in the universe, but scientists still do not know what it is made of. A study, published in Physical Review Letters, by Rice University researchers proposes a detector design that could help search for axions, hypothetical particles that many physicists think could make up dark matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 该新闻报道介绍了一项发表于 Physical Review Letters 的研究，研究者提出一种可能用于搜寻轴子的探测器设计。轴子是假想粒子，被认为可能构成宇宙中占物质总量约85%的暗物质。该工作围绕量子半导体设计如何提升或拓展暗物质探测能力展开，具体技术细节需查阅原文。

articles.title: Dissipation splits the Mott transition in one dimension
articles.title_zh: 耗散使一维莫特转变发生分裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00086v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding how dissipation modifies quantum phase transitions is a central challenge in many-body physics. A paradigmatic example is the one-dimensional Mott transition, which in isolated systems separates a conducting Luttinger liquid (LL) from a Mott insulator (MI). Here, we study the fate of this transition in the presence of dissipative baths locally coupled to the density. Using bosonisation and an exact integration of the bath degrees of freedom, we show that dissipation fundamentally reshapes the phase diagram for bath exponents s<3/2, where s characterises the low-energy bath spectrum. Rather than undergoing a direct LL-MI transition, the system develops an intermediate dissipative phase (DP) that is compressible and gapless, yet has zero superfluid stiffness. As a result, the conventional Mott transition splits into two distinct critical phenomena: a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transition from the LL to the DP, followed by a new commensurate-incommensurate transition from the DP to the MI. We derive an effective field theory for the latter transition and characterize its universality. For 1 <3/2, the critical exponents vary continuously with the bath exponent as β=ν=1/z=s-1, while for s<1 the transition is governed by β=ν=1/z=0 and the doping vanishes sharper than any power law. State-of-the-art Monte Carlo simulations quantitatively support our predictions. These results demonstrate that dissipation can qualitatively alter the nature of the Mott transition and generate novel critical behaviour in strongly correlated one-dimensional systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论局域耦合到密度的耗散浴如何改变一维莫特转变的相图。通过玻色化和对浴自由度的精确积分，作者发现当浴谱指数低于特定阈值时，传统的 Luttinger 液体到莫特绝缘体的直接转变被一个可压缩、无能隙但超流刚度为零的耗散相所分隔。因此，莫特转变分裂为从 Luttinger 液体到耗散相的 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless 转变，以及从耗散相到莫特绝缘体的新型公度-非公度转变。
authors: Oscar Bouverot-Dupuis, Alberto Rosso, Laura Foini

articles.title: Holographic Quantum Transformer: A Generalist Neuro-Symbolic Architecture for Solving Frustrated Systems via Generative Attention
articles.title_zh: 全息量子 Transformer：通过生成式注意力求解受挫体系的通用神经符号架构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00398v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Simulating two-dimensional frustrated quantum matter is a grand challenge due to the sign problem and exponential Hilbert space complexity. In this work, we introduce the Holographic Quantum Transformer (HQT), a physics-inspired generative architecture that leverages global self-attention to resolve non-local entanglement patterns. We validate HQT on the square lattice J₁₋J₂ Heisenberg model. On the heavily frustrated 8 × 8 lattice at the quantum critical point (J₂₌₀.5), HQT reaches a ground-state energy per site (E/N) of -0.5001(1), consistent with the expected finite-size scaling trend. Beyond numerical accuracy, HQT exhibits intrinsic physical awareness, autonomously recovering the underlying J₂ interaction geometry through interpretable attention maps. Our central contribution is ``Holographic Transfer", a zero-shot size-extrapolation protocol with rapid alignment: a model trained on 8 × 8 systems is directly projected onto larger 10 × 10 lattices via continuous positional-embedding interpolation and head re-initialization, achieving high-fidelity initialization and rapid convergence. This zero-shot protocol yields an energy of E/N = -0.49782(3), statistically consistent with the variational state of the art while requiring no from-scratch training on the target lattice. Our results establish generative attention as a scalable paradigm for transferable quantum simulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出全息量子 Transformer，一种受物理启发的生成式架构，用全局自注意力捕捉二维受挫量子物质中的非局域纠缠模式。作者在平方晶格 J1-J2 海森堡模型上验证该方法，并在强受挫量子临界区域获得与有限尺寸标度趋势一致的基态能量。模型的注意力图还能自动恢复相互作用几何，并通过“全息迁移”实现从 8×8 到更大晶格的零样本尺寸外推与快速收敛。
authors: Xingran Guo, Tiaojie Xiao, Jie Liu, Keqin Li

articles.title: Surface Platinum Alloying for Passivation of Oxide Interfaces on Superconducting Niobium Films
articles.title_zh: 用于超导铌薄膜氧化物界面钝化的表面铂合金化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00429v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dielectric loss arising from two-level systems (TLS) at surfaces and interfaces remains a primary limitation to coherence in superconducting transmon qubits. Niobium (Nb), a widely used material in superconducting quantum circuits, readily forms native oxides under ambient conditions, leading to lossy dielectric interfaces that degrade device performance. Here, a robust and scalable fabrication strategy is demonstrated for chemically stabilizing Nb surfaces and mitigating further oxidation, including protection of both surface and sidewall regions. High-purity Nb films were fabricated with bulk-like superconducting transition temperatures (T_c = 9.30±0.10) K. We demonstrate that a thin Pt encapsulation layer, deposited after native oxide formation, can be transformed via thermal annealing into a Nb-Pt alloy at the surface. Spectroscopic and microscopic analyses confirm the formation of a chemically stable metallic alloy layer and its ability to suppress further oxide growth. Ab initio simulations elucidate the atomic-scale rearrangement and electronic structure evolution associated with Pt incorporation on native niobium oxide, providing insight into the stabilization mechanism of the alloyed surface. This approach offers a materials pathway for engineering chemically robust Nb interfaces, including sidewalls, toward higher-coherence superconducting qubit architectures."
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对超导 transmon 量子比特中表面和界面两能级系统导致的介电损耗问题，提出一种稳定铌薄膜表面、抑制进一步氧化的可扩展制备策略。作者在高纯铌薄膜表面沉积薄铂封装层，并经热退火形成 Nb-Pt 表面合金，同时保护表面和侧壁区域。谱学、显微表征和第一性原理模拟表明，该金属合金层具有化学稳定性，可抑制氧化物继续生长，从而有望改善超导量子器件界面质量。
authors: Ananya Chattaraj, Conan Weiland, Bruce Ravel, Kim Kisslinger, Sooyeon Hwang, Xiao Tong, Ajith Pattammattel, Andrew M. Kiss, Steven L. Hulbert, Aswin kumar Anbalagan, Andrew L. Walter, Peter V. Sushko, Mingzhao Liu

articles.title: Real-time dynamics of triplet-resonant tunneling driven by nonequilibrium phonons
articles.title_zh: 非平衡声子驱动的三重态共振隧穿实时动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00520v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Driven nonequilibrium systems can host emergent functionalities beyond equilibrium, but real-time access to excited-state dynamics remains limited. Here we report real-time measurements of phonon-driven charge and spin dynamics in excited states of a double quantum dot. Under phonon irradiation, resonant inter-dot tunneling emerges at triplet resonance. Time-resolved charge sensing reveals that the resonant inter-dot tunneling is strongly modified by spin blockade. For weaker inter-dot coupling, the nonequilibrium phonon environment generates a unidirectional transport cycle along the phonon density gradient.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了双量子点激发态中由声子驱动的电荷与自旋动力学的实时测量。在声子照射下，三重态共振处出现共振点间隧穿，时间分辨电荷探测显示该过程受到自旋阻塞的显著调制。对于较弱的点间耦合，非平衡声子环境可沿声子密度梯度产生单向输运循环。
authors: Kazuyuki Kuroyama, Sasha R. Valentin, Arne Ludwig, Andreas D. Wieck, Yasuhiro Tokura, Seigo Tarucha, Sadashige Matsuo

articles.title: Robustness of Quantum Discord in Nonequilibrium Electronic Transport through Tunnel-Coupled Quantum Dots
articles.title_zh: 隧穿耦合量子点非平衡电子输运中量子失协的鲁棒性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00602v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum discord captures quantum correlations beyond entanglement and can remain finite even when the entanglement vanishes. We investigate the transient nonequilibrium dynamics and steady-state behavior of quantum discord and classical correlations in a double quantum dot (DQD) system coupled to fermionic reservoirs. By employing a quantum Langevin equation formalism, we obtain the exact reduced density matrix of the system, enabling a comprehensive analysis of its quantum and classical correlations under nonequilibrium conditions. The influence of system-reservoir coupling strength, spectral bandwidth, thermal bias, and varying initial state on both the transient dynamics and steady-state correlations is systematically analyzed. Quantum discord remains finite in the nonequilibrium steady state over a broad parameter range. Although thermal gradients reduce the overall magnitude of correlations, quantum discord persists and exhibits greater resilience. These results demonstrate that nonequilibrium electronic transport, together with the environmental spectral properties and reservoir asymmetry, provides an effective means of controlling nonclassical correlations in mesoscopic systems and establishes quantum discord as a robust hallmark of open fermionic quantum devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究了与费米库相连的双量子点系统中量子失协与经典关联的瞬态非平衡动力学和稳态行为。作者利用量子朗之万方程形式精确获得系统约化密度矩阵，并系统分析系统-库耦合、谱带宽、热偏置和初态等因素的影响。结果表明，量子失协可在较宽参数范围的非平衡稳态中保持有限值，并相较总体关联在热梯度下表现出更强的韧性。
authors: Thingujam Yaiphalemba Meitei, Saikumar Krithivasan, Md. Manirul Ali, Arijit Sen

articles.title: In vacuo synthesis of single-layer Ni3(HITP)2 on HOPG surface using metallo-organic precursor
articles.title_zh: 利用金属有机前驱体在 HOPG 表面真空合成单层 Ni3(HITP)2
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00614v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Single-layer conjugated metal-organic frameworks (SL c-MOFs) are predicated theoretically to host rich quantum phases. To date, however, the experimental synthesis has largely resulted in SL c-MOFs on metal substrates, whose intrinsic properties are strongly screened due to substrate hybridization. To overcome this obstacle, here we develop a method to grow clean SL c-MOF Ni3(HITP)2 on a chemically inert substrate of highly oriented pyrolytic graphite (HOPG). By means of an ultra-high vacuum based multi-step protocol using nickel acetylacetonate [Ni(acac)2] precursor, we obtain continuous single-layer Ni3(HITP)2. Scanning tunneling microscopy reveals a well-defined hexagonal framework with a uniform azimuthal orientation rotated by approximately 30 degrees with respect to the underlying graphite lattice. Furthermore, we control the growth of bilayer Ni3(HITP)2 which features an unusual AA stacking configuration. This work establishes metallo-organic chemistry as an efficient route for integrating 2D c-MOFs onto inert substrates, which opens a new avenue for exploring the exotic quantum properties of SL c-MOFs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种在化学惰性的高定向热解石墨（HOPG）衬底上生长洁净单层共轭金属有机框架 Ni3(HITP)2 的方法，以减弱金属衬底杂化对本征性质的屏蔽。作者采用超高真空多步工艺和乙酰丙酮镍前驱体制备出连续单层结构，扫描隧道显微镜显示其具有清晰六角框架，并相对石墨晶格旋转约 30 度。研究还实现了双层 Ni3(HITP)2 的可控生长，发现其呈现少见的 AA 堆垛构型。
authors: Chuyu Song, Yifei Feng, Henan Chen, Nian Lin

articles.title: Quench of chiral superconductivity by quantum phase fluctuations in twisted cuprate bilayers
articles.title_zh: 扭转铜氧化物双层中量子相位涨落对手性超导的淬灭
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00630v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Following theoretical proposals of chiral d+id' superconductivity in twisted cuprate bilayers, experimental signatures of time-reversal symmetry breaking (TRSB) remain highly controversial. Here we demonstrate that quantum phase fluctuations fundamentally reshape the phase diagram of this proposed chiral state. Unlike regular superconducting orders, the chiral d+id' state requires long-range coherence of an interlayer phase degree of freedom and is therefore intrinsically vulnerable to phase fluctuations. Incorporating these fluctuations nearly eliminates the chiral phase over most parts of the phase diagram, restricting it to a narrow twist-angle window and ultra-low temperatures. The fluctuation-driven destruction of chirality produces a first-order transition into the d-wave state, giving rise to coexistence and metastability. Meanwhile, Josephson phase locking is strongly weakened at the TRSB quantum critical point, which sits well within the superconducting regime. More broadly, our work establishes quantum phase fluctuations as a fundamental constraint on the emergence of TRSB phases in low-dimensional layered quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对扭转铜氧化物双层中理论预言的手性 d+id' 超导态，分析量子相位涨落对其相图的影响。作者指出，该手性态依赖层间相位自由度的长程相干，因此对相位涨落具有内禀脆弱性；纳入涨落后，手性相在大部分相图中几乎被消除，仅限于窄扭角窗口和极低温区域。涨落驱动的手性破坏会导致向 d 波态的一阶转变，并引发共存与亚稳态，同时显著削弱时间反演对称性破缺量子临界点附近的约瑟夫森相位锁定。
authors: Yin Shi, Mengxian Zhao, Fei Yang, Miao Liu, Sheng Meng

articles.title: Collective phase modes in twisted d-wave superconducting bilayers
articles.title_zh: 扭转 d 波超导双层中的集体相位模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00662v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Twisted cuprate bilayers have been predicted to host high-temperature chiral d+id' superconductivity, originating from higher-order Josephson coupling processes. In such two-dimensional superconducting systems, long-wavelength fluctuations in the phase of the superconducting order parameter constitute gapless collective modes and therefore remain significant even at zero temperature. Here, we perform a theoretical analysis of the low-energy phase fluctuations in twisted d-wave superconducting bilayers, systematically retaining Josephson coupling to all orders. We demonstrate that higher-order Josephson coupling processes lead to nontrivial modifications of the phase dynamics. In particular, the stiffness of the relative phase between the two layers is finite even in the normal state, which is a direct consequence of the intralayer U(1) symmetry breaking explicitly induced by interlayer tunneling. Phase fluctuations suppress the relative-phase stiffness but enhance the overall-phase stiffness in the d+id' phase. Furthermore, the relative-phase fluctuations acquire a small but finite excitation gap, which is no longer equal to the Josephson plasma frequency and is strongly suppressed upon approaching the chiral quantum critical point, indicating the breakdown of Josephson phase locking within the superconducting state.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文理论分析了扭转 d 波超导双层中的低能相位涨落，并系统保留所有阶次的约瑟夫森耦合。研究表明，高阶约瑟夫森耦合会显著改变相位动力学，其中两层相对相位的刚度即使在正常态中也为有限值，这源于层间隧穿显式诱导的层内 U(1) 对称性破缺。在 d+id' 相中，相位涨落会抑制相对相位刚度但增强整体相位刚度，并使相对相位涨落获得一个小但有限的激发能隙。
authors: Yin Shi, Mengxian Zhao, Fei Yang, Miao Liu, Sheng Meng

articles.title: Dependence of charge separation efficiency on the exciton-charge transfer offset and Gaussian disorder in organic solar cells
articles.title_zh: 有机太阳能电池中电荷分离效率对激子-电荷转移能级偏移和高斯无序的依赖
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00699v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: State-of-the-art organic solar cells increasingly rely on low-offset semiconductor blends, challenging the traditional requirement of a large energetic driving force for efficient charge separation. In these systems, the energetic offset Δ ELE₋CT between local exciton (LE) and charge-transfer (CT) states approaches the thermal energy, making exciton-CT hybridization and thermal repopulation of the exciton level critical to device performance. In this work, we directly compare a macroscopic two-state rate model with three-dimensional kinetic Monte-Carlo (kMC) simulations to investigate microscopic charge separation dynamics and the role of Gaussian energetic disorder. We demonstrate that in the absence of disorder, the analytical rate model accurately reproduces kMC predictions for the whole range of Δ ELE₋CT. Specifically, the macroscopic model successfully explains horizontal shifts in the internal quantum efficiency curves that arise depending on how the energetic offset is physically realized in the constituent molecules. We show that these variations can be captured entirely through the ratio of degeneracies of the LE and CT states, respectively. Introducing Gaussian energetic disorder into the kMC simulation reveals a distinct crossover behavior depending on Δ ELE₋CT. While disorder is mostly detrimental at large offsets, it can significantly boost efficiency at intermediate and low offsets. Thermalization of charge carriers within the disorder-broadened density of states creates an effective driving force allowing charge separation even at zero or negative energetic offsets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注低能级偏移有机太阳能电池中局域激子态与电荷转移态之间能量差接近热能时的电荷分离机制。作者将宏观两态速率模型与三维动力学蒙特卡洛模拟直接比较，以考察微观电荷分离动力学和高斯能量无序的作用。结果显示，在无无序条件下，解析速率模型可在整个能级偏移范围内准确再现蒙特卡洛结果，并能解释因分子中能级偏移实现方式不同而产生的内量子效率曲线平移。
authors: Maik Schwuchow, Carsten Deibel, Angela Thränhardt

articles.title: Weak-coupling tensor cross interpolation impurity solver for nonequilibrium dynamical mean-field theory
articles.title_zh: 用于非平衡动力学平均场理论的弱耦合张量交叉插值杂质求解器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00702v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Simulating nonequilibrium quantum many-body systems remains a major challenge due to the exponential growth of the computational complexity with real time. Here we implement a nonequilibrium impurity solver based on the weak-coupling expansion and the tensor cross interpolation (TCI), and apply it to nonequilibrium dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT). The method approximates the integrands of the high-dimensional integrals arising in the weak-coupling expansion in a tensor-train form, enabling efficient evaluations without stochastic sampling and thereby mitigating the sign problem affecting continuous-time quantum Monte Carlo (CT-QMC) methods. Benchmark calculations for an exactly solvable nonequilibrium impurity model agree well with the exact results and reveal a low-rank structure of the integrands. When applied to interaction-quench problems in the half-filled Hubbard model, the method reproduces fast thermalization at a critical interaction strength with accuracy comparable to CT-QMC. Away from half filling, where the sign problem becomes even more severe, the present approach remains well controlled, revealing a crossover instead of a sharply defined fast thermalization point in the 3/4-filled case. The solver can also be applied to steady-state DMFT problems, yielding accurate spectral functions in the metallic regime without analytic continuation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文实现了一种基于弱耦合展开和张量交叉插值的非平衡杂质求解器，并将其用于非平衡动力学平均场理论。该方法将弱耦合展开中高维积分的被积函数近似为张量列车形式，从而无需随机采样即可高效计算，并缓解连续时间量子蒙特卡洛方法中的符号问题。基准测试显示其与可精确求解模型结果吻合良好；在半填充 Hubbard 模型相互作用淬火问题中，该方法以接近 CT-QMC 的精度再现了临界相互作用强度处的快速热化，并在远离半填充时仍保持良好可控性。
authors: Shuta Matsuura, Hiroshi Shinaoka, Philipp Werner, Naoto Tsuji

articles.title: Universal logic circuit for gate-controlled superconductor-based switches operating at liquid-helium temperatures
articles.title_zh: 在液氦温度下工作的栅控超导开关通用逻辑电路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00769v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The observation of the gate-controlled supercurrent (GCS) effect in superconducting nanostructures initiated major research efforts toward the realisation of superconducting-based computing architectures. Here we introduce a universal logic circuit that can be a promising superconducting building block of classical hybrid supercomputers. We demonstrate a functionally complete set of logic gates by realising the AND, OR, NOT and COPY gates. The general layout and scalability of our device, combined with recent experiments demonstrating fast switching and small voltage signals, make it a functional candidate in superconducting electronics. Our device enables the realization of all classical logic gates and the half-adder combinational logic circuit using at most three nanowires, each uniquely configured with two side-gate electrodes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种基于栅控超电流效应的通用逻辑电路，面向超导电子学和经典混合超算架构。作者通过实现 AND、OR、NOT 和 COPY 门展示了功能完备的逻辑门集合。该器件布局具有通用性和可扩展性，最多使用三根纳米线且每根配有两个侧栅电极，即可实现所有经典逻辑门以及半加器组合逻辑电路。
authors: Martin Berke, Lőrinc Kupás, Tosson Elalaily, Máté Sütő, Szabolcs Csonka, Péter Makk

articles.title: Vanadium superconducting microwave resonators on silicon wafers
articles.title_zh: 硅晶圆上的钒超导微波谐振器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00809v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the correlation between material properties and microwave losses in superconducting films is a crucial subject for developing low-loss materials for quantum circuits. We focus on vanadium (V) as a novel material for superconducting quantum devices and discuss loss in V films in relation to their structural properties. Using a sputtering method, we grow four V-film structures on (001)-oriented Si wafers, employing Nb and Ta as the buffer and capping layer materials, respectively: Nb/V/Ta, Nb/V, V/Ta, and V. X-ray diffraction and atomic force microscopy reveal that the V films grown on the Nb buffer layers have higher uniformity of lattice orientation and smaller grain size than that directly grown on the Si wafer. Coplanar waveguide resonators are fabricated from the four V-film structures, and averaged photon number (łangle nₘ̊ ₚₕ ångle) dependences of internal quality factor (Qₘ̊ ᵢₙₜ) are obtained by performing microwave measurements. By analyzing the obtained Qₘ̊ ᵢₙₜ vs łangle nₘ̊ ₚₕ ångle, it is found that loss at the V surface is dominated by łangle nₘ̊ ₚₕ ångle-independent non-two-level-system (non-TLS) losses, which can be mitigated by introducing the Ta capping layer. Furthermore, the V films on the Nb buffer layers exhibit lower Qₘ̊ ᵢₙₜ in the łangle nₘ̊ ₚₕ ångle range from 10⁰ to 10⁶ and higher non-TLS loss than that directly grown on Si wafers, even though the former has higher lattice-orientation uniformity than the latter. Origins of these trends might be relevant to V oxides, of which presence at surfaces and grain boundaries in bulk regions in the V resonators is suggested by energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, and/or V hydrides.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究钒薄膜的结构性质与超导微波损耗之间的关系，以评估其作为量子电路低损耗材料的潜力。作者在取向硅晶圆上制备了 Nb/V/Ta、Nb/V、V/Ta 和 V 四种薄膜结构，并通过 X 射线衍射和原子力显微镜发现，生长在 Nb 缓冲层上的钒膜具有更高的晶格取向均匀性和更小晶粒尺寸。基于这些薄膜制备的共面波导谐振器测量表明，钒表面损耗主要受与平均光子数无关的非双能级系统损耗支配。
authors: Y. Fujita, Y. Urade, Y. Hibino, M. Tsujimoto, K. Inomata, G. Fujii, W. Mizubayashi

articles.title: Non-self-averaging topological Anderson insulator
articles.title_zh: 非自平均拓扑安德森绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00892v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Current research on the disordered topological quantum phases primarily focuses on the uncorrelated and short-range correlated disorder regime. These topological Anderson insulators are typically self-averaging. However, topological quantum systems with long-range correlated disorder have received limited attention due to the absence of tractable analytical methods. In fact, the long-range correlated disorder introduces more complex effects on topological quantum states. Here, we demonstrate that the long-range correlated disorder could induce anomalously statistical feature where the topological Anderson states become non-self-averaging, and the phase diagram is strongly dependent on individual disorder configurations. We term this statistical phase the non-self-averaging topological Anderson insulator. The non-self-averaging property is identified by the non-vanishing finite values of the relative variance of the Lyapunov exponent in the thermodynamic limit, alongside the non-Gaussian distributions of the Lyapunov exponent. Consequently, the topological properties of a single disordered sample deviate from the ensemble average, causing a breakdown of the central limit theorem. The non-self-averaging topological Anderson insulator provides insights into the interplay between correlated disorder and topology.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究长程关联无序对拓扑安德森绝缘体的影响，区别于以往主要关注非关联或短程关联无序且通常具有自平均性的情形。作者发现，长程关联无序可诱导异常统计特征，使拓扑安德森态表现为非自平均，相图强烈依赖具体无序构型。该性质通过热力学极限下 Lyapunov 指数相对方差保持有限以及其非高斯分布来识别，意味着单个无序样品的拓扑性质可能显著偏离系综平均。

articles.title: Symmetry Classification of Non-Reciprocal Responses in Multiterminal Ring Devices
articles.title_zh: 多端环形器件中非互易响应的对称性分类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00919v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a symmetry-based framework to classify the non-reciprocal responses of multiterminal ring quantum devices. The device is modeled as a ring of n vertices, where a binary variable eₖᵢₙ+1,-1 on each bond encodes the preferred direction of signal flow between terminals. Non-reciprocity corresponds to a preferred current configuration on the ring, and the symmetry group of the device partitions all 2ⁿ configurations into equivalence classes(orbits) characterized by a topological winding number W. Using the minimal non-trivial case n=3, we establish two results independent of microscopic details. First, lifting the degeneracy within an orbit generates non-reciprocal responses. For n=3 this requires simultaneous breaking of both time-reversal T and spatial inversion I. Breaking either alone is insufficient. Second, the residual geometry symmetry after T and I are broken determines which responses are observable. For an isosceles triangular geometry, only two types of response are allowed: uniform circulation (all bonds carrying current in the same direction) and semi-circulation with the reversed bond on the geometrically distinct base. Semi-circulation with the reversed bond on either equal leg is symmetry-forbidden. Both predictions are validated using a minimal toy model of three quantum dots coupled to superconducting baths, which demonstrates a reactive quantum circulator response.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一个基于对称性的框架，用于分类多端环形量子器件的非互易响应。模型将器件表示为含 n 个顶点的环，每条键上的二元变量编码端口间信号流的优选方向，所有构型由器件对称群划分为以拓扑绕数表征的等价类。以 n=3 的最小非平凡情形为例，作者证明轨道内简并的解除可产生非互易响应，且需同时破坏时间反演对称性和空间反演对称性；剩余几何对称性进一步决定可观测响应类型。

articles.title: Exceptional points in dissipative coupling polaron-polaritons
articles.title_zh: 耗散耦合极化子-极化激元中的例外点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00994v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding how strong correlations and dissipation combine to shape collective quantum excitations is a central challenge in many-body physics. We investigate the effect of dissipative light-matter coupling on strongly interacting exciton-polaritons in the presence of a biexciton resonance, which gives rise to polaron-polariton quasiparticles. We show that the interplay between many-body correlations and non-Hermitian coupling generates anomalous dispersion relations and exceptional points in the polaron-polariton spectrum. The location and coexistence of exceptional points are controlled by the dissipative coupling and the relative decay rates of the excitonic and photonic constituents, allowing them to emerge across different polaron-polariton branches. These results identify dissipative polaron-polaritons as a versatile platform for exploring non-Hermitian many-body physics with tunable light-matter quasiparticles.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究在双激子共振存在时，耗散光-物质耦合如何影响强相互作用激子极化激元并形成极化子-极化激元准粒子。作者表明，多体关联与非厄米耦合的相互作用会在极化子-极化激元谱中产生异常色散关系和例外点。例外点的位置及其共存由耗散耦合强度以及激子与光子组分的相对衰减率调控，使其可出现在不同的极化子-极化激元分支上。
authors: A. J. Vega-Carmona, D. A. Mendoza, A. Camacho-Guardian, M. A. Bastarrachea-Magnani

articles.title: Phase diagram of a double-occupancy cell model of a fluid with Curie-Weiss interaction
articles.title_zh: 具有居里–外斯相互作用的双占据晶胞流体模型的相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01009v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A double-occupancy cell model of a fluid with Curie-Weiss interaction is studied. First, we show that the model is isomorphic to the Blume-Capel model on a complete graph through a simple transformation from spin to occupancy variables. We then investigate its phase behavior within the grand-canonical ensemble using a combination of analytical and numerical methods. Despite its simplicity, the model exhibits a remarkably rich thermodynamic behavior depending on the ratio between the local repulsive and global attractive interactions. We identify regimes characterized by a single critical point, two distinct critical points, tricritical behavior, and triple-point formation. For sufficiently strong repulsion, the system possesses three fluid phases of different densities, leading to both gas-liquid and liquid-liquid coexistence. The locations of the critical, tricritical, and triple points are determined, and the corresponding phase diagrams are constructed. These results demonstrate that the competition between double-occupancy repulsion and long-range attraction is sufficient to generate complex phase behavior in a minimal multiple-occupancy lattice-gas model.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了带有居里–外斯相互作用的双占据晶胞流体模型，并通过从自旋变量到占据变量的变换，证明其与完全图上的 Blume-Capel 模型同构。作者在巨正则系综中结合解析与数值方法研究相行为，发现局域排斥与全局吸引相互作用之比可导致单临界点、双临界点、三临界行为以及三相点等丰富现象。对于足够强的排斥，体系可出现三种不同密度的流体相，并产生气-液与液-液共存。
authors: R. V. Romanik, O. A. Dobush, M. P. Kozlovskii, I. V. Pylyuk, M. A. Shpot

articles.title: Exact interlayer triplet-pairing eigenstates in the extended Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: 扩展 Hubbard 模型中的精确层间三重态配对本征态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01038v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: η-pairing symmetry generalizes the pairing mechanisms in superconductivity but is broken in the presence of interlayer interactions. In this work, we extend this approach to triplet pairs. We propose interlayer triplet-pairing operators for the multi-layer extended Hubbard model. We find that a set of exact condensate-pair eigenstates can be constructed, which exhibit off-diagonal long-range order. In contrast to the η-pairing mechanism, this originates from restricted spectrum generating algebra and is only available for bilayer and trilayer systems in the presence of interlayer Hubbard interactions. Nevertheless, the system also retains the original on-site η-pairing symmetry in the absence of interlayer interactions. Consequently, both singlet and triplet pairs coexist in the eigenstates of the multi-layer Hubbard model. We employ quench dynamics to demonstrate the results through numerical simulations. Our findings open avenues for the study of exact condensate-pair states in strongly correlated systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作将 η 配对思想推广到三重态配对，提出了多层扩展 Hubbard 模型中的层间三重态配对算符。研究发现，在双层和三层体系且存在层间 Hubbard 相互作用时，可构造一组具有非对角长程序的精确凝聚配对本征态，其机制不同于传统 η 配对。数值淬火动力学模拟验证了这些结果，并表明多层 Hubbard 模型中可同时存在单重态与三重态配对。

articles.title: Breathing mode inducing dynamical pairing in Kagome materials
articles.title_zh: Kagome 材料中呼吸模诱导的动力学配对
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01052v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The breathing mode in Kagome materials is a structural modulation that breaks inversion symmetry and has been shown to be a crucial source for intriguing phases in the normal state. In this work, we carry out a full classification of superconducting symmetries in kagome superconductors and demonstrate the emergence of odd-frequency dynamical Cooper pairs entirely driven by the breathing mode. We then show that odd-frequency spin-singlet Cooper pairs can be realized by controlling the breathing mode in kagome lattices with conventional spin-singlet s-wave superconductivity. Since odd-frequency pairing is intrinsically nonlocal in time, our results put forward the breathing mode for designing dynamical Cooper pairs in kagome materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究对 Kagome 超导体中的超导对称性进行了完整分类，并指出呼吸模结构调制可驱动奇频动力学 Cooper 对的产生。作者表明，在具有常规自旋单重态 s 波超导性的 Kagome 晶格中，通过调控呼吸模可以实现奇频自旋单重态配对。由于奇频配对在时间上本质非局域，该结果为在 Kagome 材料中设计动力学 Cooper 对提供了途径。
authors: Debmalya Chakraborty, Anushree Datta, Jorge Cayao

articles.title: Bandwidth-Limited Critical Currents in Electrically Tunable Moiré Bands
articles.title_zh: 电可调莫尔能带中的带宽受限临界电流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01056v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Moiré superlattices host narrow minibands whose bandwidth governs correlated and topological phases. Here, we demonstrate that the bandwidth also sets the critical current for the onset of out-of-equilibrium transport. In bilayer graphene aligned to hexagonal boron nitride, we explore the high-current transport regime as we continuously flatten the valence miniband using an out-of-plane displacement field. We observe a significant reduction in the critical current, which is captured by a minimal analytical model and corresponds to the calculated narrowing of the miniband. Moreover, by comparing distinct moiré platforms, we show that the scaling between critical current and bandwidth is a universal feature of graphene superlattices. Our results reveal a direct link between miniband dispersion and high-current transport, and establish this regime as a fast and accessible electrical probe of bandwidth evolution.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，莫尔超晶格窄迷你能带的带宽不仅影响关联与拓扑相，也决定非平衡输运开始时的临界电流。在与六方氮化硼对准的双层石墨烯中，作者利用垂直位移场连续压平价带迷你能带，并观测到临界电流显著降低。实验结果可由最小解析模型解释，并与计算得到的能带变窄相对应；不同石墨烯莫尔平台的比较显示，临界电流与带宽的标度关系具有普适性。
authors: Riccardo Bertini, Xueqiao Wang, Sergey Slizovskiy, Zhiren Zheng, Julien Barrier, Chiara Pizzo, Robin Smeyers, Krystian Nowakowski, Hitesh Agarwal, Alvaro Moreno, Bert Jorissen, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Milorad V. Milošević, Lucian Covaci, Vladimir Fal'ko, Pablo Jarillo-Herrero, Roshan Krishna Kumar, Frank H. L. Koppens

articles.title: Universal Short-Imaginary-Time Quantum Critical Dynamics Near Boundaries
articles.title_zh: 边界附近普适短虚时量子临界动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01076v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While imaginary-time evolution has long served as a standard paradigm for ground-state preparation in numerical simulations and quantum devices, its intrinsic dynamical properties has been largely overlooked. Here, we investigate the short-imaginary-time critical dynamics in quantum systems with boundaries. A universal scaling theory is developed and verified in the two-dimensional quantum Ising model, uncovering rich dynamic critical behaviors dictated by boundary universality classes. For ordered initial states, the boundary order parameter Mₛ decays with imaginary time τ as Mₛ propto τ⁻β₁/ν z, where β₁ denotes the boundary order parameter exponent, and ν and z correspond to the correlation length exponent and the dynamic exponent, respectively. For disordered initial states, the autocorrelation of the boundary order parameter is governed by a novel critical exponent θ₁, which is closely related to the critical initial slip behavior of Mₛ characterized by the corresponding exponent θ₁'. In contrast to its positive bulk counterpart, the boundary initial-slip exponent θ₁' is negative for the ordinary transition while remaining positive for the special transition. Although the static universality classes of d-dimensional quantum phase transitions generally coincide with those of (d+1)-dimensional classical phase transitions, we show that θ₁ does not follow this conventional quantum-classical mapping. We further discuss the implications of our results for more exotic forms of boundary criticality. Our findings provide new physical insights into boundary critical dynamics and offer a novel route for probing exotic boundary critical behaviors in quantum many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究了带边界量子体系中的短虚时临界动力学，建立了普适标度理论，并在二维量子 Ising 模型中加以验证。对于有序初态，边界序参量随虚时按由边界临界指数、关联长度指数和动力学指数决定的幂律衰减；对于无序初态，边界序参量自关联受新的临界指数控制。研究揭示了由边界普适类决定的丰富动力学临界行为，包括与体相情形不同的边界初始滑移特征。
authors: Yu-Rong Shu, Yuan-Biao Li, Shuai Yin

articles.title: Exact dimer ground states of long-range spin chains and ladders
articles.title_zh: 长程自旋链与自旋梯中的精确二聚体基态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01081v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interacting spin chains and ladders are known to support a plethora of quantum phases with complex ground-state phase diagrams. In this work, we study a large family of such models and determine precise, explicit conditions under which an exact dimer state is guaranteed to be the ground state. These general conditions are validated for various generalizations of the Majumdar-Ghosh model using exact diagonalization. Our results provide exact reference points in the phase diagrams of a wide class of spin chains and ladders, including those with anisotropic and arbitrary-range interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论了一大类相互作用自旋链和自旋梯模型，并给出精确二聚体态成为基态的明确条件。作者将这些一般条件应用于 Majumdar-Ghosh 模型的多种推广，并通过精确对角化加以验证。结果为含各向异性和任意作用范围相互作用的自旋链与自旋梯相图提供了可精确定位的参考点。

articles.title: Diamond Diode for Extreme Venus Environments
articles.title_zh: 面向极端金星环境的金刚石二极管
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01093v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A diamond Schottky PIN diode (SPIND) with the highest reported current density to date of ~116 kA/cm2 is demonstrated carrying a total current of ~1.3 A through a 50 micron wide pseudo-vertical diode structure. The diamond SPIND also provides a maximum power handling capacity of 1.85 MW/cm2 and a low specific on-resistance Ron,S of 0.05 mOhm-cm2 at a forward bias of ~16 V. The diamond SPIN diode also shows excellent rectification characteristics with a current on-off ratio of ~6e12. An analytical model including thermionic emission and space charge limited current is presented together with Silvaco ATLAS TCAD simulations, to accurately reproduce the experimental J-V characteristics using multiple single trap levels and other physical models emulating a real device. Theoretical analysis from the analytical models in conjunction with ATLAS simulations shows that further improvement in the device turn on voltage and Ron,S can be achieved by reducing the defect density and contact resistance in order to approach the ultimate performance in the Mott-Gurney space charge limited current regime
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了一种金刚石肖特基 PIN 二极管，其电流密度达到约 116 kA/cm²，总电流约 1.3 A，并具有高功率处理能力、低比导通电阻和优异整流比。作者结合包含热电子发射与空间电荷限制电流的解析模型，以及 Silvaco ATLAS TCAD 仿真，对实验 J-V 特性进行了准确复现。理论与仿真表明，通过降低缺陷密度和接触电阻，有望进一步改善开启电压和导通电阻，使器件接近空间电荷限制电流机制下的极限性能。
authors: Harshad Surdi, Gabriel Munro-Ludders, Mohamadali Malakoutian, Srabanti Chowdhury, Savannah Eisner, Mohamed Fadil Isamotu, Mengyang Yuan, Stephen Goodnick, Franz Koeck, James Lyons, Trevor Thornton, Robert Nemanich

articles.title: Strange Luttinger liquids in a cavity-embedded one-dimensional electronic chain
articles.title_zh: 嵌入腔中的一维电子链中的奇异 Luttinger 液体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01146v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a one-dimensional electronic chain coupled to a homogeneous quantized vacuum field and electron-electron interactions. In the absence of the latter, we derive a low-energy effective description in the presence of light-matter coupling, which we identify as a strange Luttinger liquid. Although it retains a formal resemblance to conventional Luttinger liquid theory, the coupling to the quantum field qualitatively modifies the low-energy sector and breaks the standard velocity relation underlying Luttinger universality. For finite electron-electron interactions, we recover a phase diagram featuring several phases as a function of interaction strength and hopping amplitude, including a phase hosting Majorana-like zero modes. Using exact diagonalization, we compute observables that characterize the phase boundaries and show that the cavity field significantly shifts them. We also study the fate of Majorana-like states under the influence of the cavity field, highlighting their modification by light-matter coupling. Finally, we investigate whether the strange Luttinger liquid description identified in the noninteracting regime continues to hold when electron-electron interactions are introduced.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究了一维电子链与均匀量子化真空场及电子-电子相互作用的耦合。在无电子相互作用时，作者推导出含光-物质耦合的低能有效理论，并将其识别为一种奇异 Luttinger 液体，其低能性质虽形式上类似传统 Luttinger 液体，但标准速度关系被量子场耦合破坏。对于有限电子相互作用，研究得到包含类 Majorana 零模相在内的相图，并通过精确对角化表明腔场会显著移动相边界并改变类 Majorana 态。
authors: Danh-Phuong Nguyen, Christophe Mora, Cristiano Ciuti

articles.title: Topological Hall effect due to electron-skyrmion scattering
articles.title_zh: 电子-斯格明子散射导致的拓扑霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01149v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron scattering from chiral spin textures such as skyrmions is fundamental to the understanding of transport in more complex systems, including skyrmion crystals. Most of the previous studies have focused on the weak-coupling regime, where the exchange interaction is small compared with the electron energy. Real materials, however, often lie in the strong-coupling regime, which exhibits qualitatively different behavior. Using the Lippmann-Schwinger equation and Green's function formalism, valid for all coupling strengths, we uncover several new features in the scattering cross section, including Ramsauer-Townsend minima, pronounced intermediate-coupling resonances, and Landau-level resonances for skyrmions with larger winding numbers. These features strongly influence the topological and spin Hall conductivities, which depend sensitively on the incident electron energy. Our work provides important insights into the Hall transport in collective chiral spin textures such as the skyrmion crystal.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究从电子与手性自旋纹理中斯格明子的散射出发，分析其对拓扑霍尔和自旋霍尔输运的影响。作者采用适用于所有耦合强度的 Lippmann-Schwinger 方程与格林函数方法，发现散射截面中存在 Ramsauer-Townsend 极小、中等耦合共振以及高绕数斯格明子的 Landau 能级共振等新特征。这些特征使霍尔电导对入射电子能量高度敏感，并为理解斯格明子晶体等集体手性自旋纹理中的输运提供了重要依据。
authors: Arijit Mandal, Hareram Swain, B. R. K. Nanda, S. Satpathy

articles.title: Work Statistics Under Quantum-Jump and Quench Dynamics in Monitored Ising Chains
articles.title_zh: 受监测 Ising 链中量子跳跃与淬火动力学下的功统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00131v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate work statistics in monitored transverse-field Ising chains subject to both a quantum quench of the transverse field and either stochastic quantum jumps or controlled measurement sequences. For generalized measurements, we derive a trajectory-resolved generating function for work statistics in the two-point energy measurement scheme. Evaluating it using a fermionic Gaussian-state formalism, we show that, under stochastic jump dynamics, the work distribution crosses over from a comb-like structure to an essentially Gaussian form with shrinking sub-Gaussian tails, as the number of detection events grows. For controlled jump protocols, the energy added by each jump is constant when successive jumps are causally disconnected but decreases and then saturates when they lie within each other's light cone, yielding linear and sublinear growth of the average work, respectively. For monitored quenches, continuous observation washes out the fine structure of the isolated-quench distribution and again drives the statistics toward Gaussian behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察受监测横场 Ising 链在横场量子淬火以及随机量子跳跃或受控测量序列作用下的功统计。作者推导了广义测量下轨迹分辨的功统计生成函数，并利用费米高斯态形式进行计算。结果显示，随机跳跃动力学会使功分布从梳状结构逐渐转变为近似高斯形态，而受控跳跃协议中平均功的增长取决于相邻跳跃是否处于彼此光锥内；连续观测也会抹平孤立淬火分布的精细结构并推动统计趋向高斯。

articles.title: Susceptibility-kinetic uncertainty relations for quantum systems
articles.title_zh: 量子系统的易感性-动力学不确定性关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01035v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Kinetic uncertainty relations bound current precision of stochastic processes by dynamical activity. The extension of these bounds to quantum systems has been impeded by coherence, strong system-reservoir coupling, and the subtlety of defining dynamical activity in the quantum regime. Here, we introduce a partial dynamical activity through the quantum Fisher information associated with the rescaling of the system-reservoir coupling and show that it bounds current precision via a universal susceptibility-kinetic uncertainty relation. The general validity of this relation for any open quantum system is guaranteed by the natural contribution of a susceptibility term, which is experimentally accessible by tuning the system-reservoir coupling strength. We show how the partial dynamical activity encompasses previous definitions of activity in the weak-coupling Markovian limit and that it provides an information-geometric interpretation of correlator-based activities. We illustrate the tight constraint on precision that our bound provides with the example of steady-state transport through a double quantum dot, where quantum effects invalidate previously developed kinetic uncertainty relations. We expect our bound to provide a powerful tool for optimizing precision in arbitrary quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出了一种适用于开放量子系统的易感性-动力学不确定性关系，用以约束电流精度与动力学活动之间的关系。作者通过与系统-库耦合重标定相关的量子 Fisher 信息定义部分动力学活动，并引入可实验测量的易感性项，从而保证该关系在量子相干和强耦合情形下的普适有效性。研究还说明该定义在弱耦合 Markov 极限下可涵盖已有动力学活动概念，并以双量子点稳态输运为例展示了该界限对精度的约束作用。
authors: Didrik Palmqvist, Ludovico Tesser, Janine Splettstoesser

articles.title: Polynomial equivalence of the global transverse-field Ising model and the gate model of quantum computation
articles.title_zh: 全局横场伊辛模型与量子计算门模型的多项式等价性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01227v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The transverse-field Ising model has attracted a lot of attention in recent years, especially in the quantum simulation and quantum computation literature. This interest is driven by many platforms for analog quantum computation, which implement the transverse-field Ising model for solving optimization problems, such as quantum annealing. However, it has remained an open question whether the Ising model with a global transverse field is equivalent to the gate model of quantum computation. Here we answer this question affirmatively for the case of a non-monotonic time-dependent transverse field. Building on a recent result by Cesa and Pichler on global control of Rydberg atoms, we provide a construction that allows simulating arbitrary quantum circuits using the Ising model with global transverse field with polynomial overhead in time, qubit number, and energy scale. Although the polynomial overheads we establish here are large relative to what is feasible on real-world quantum hardware, our result motivates the development of more sophisticated methods for simulating quantum circuits using the Ising model with a global transverse field. Additionally, under the assumption that quantum computing is strictly more powerful than classical computing, our result serves as a no-go theorem for efficient classical simulation of the transverse-field Ising model with a time-dependent global transverse field. Therefore, our finding is relevant for multiple communities, from analog quantum simulation and quantum optimization on various platforms to complexity and control theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究带全局横场的横场伊辛模型是否在计算能力上等价于量子计算门模型。作者针对非单调含时横场给出肯定答案，并基于Rydberg原子全局控制的近期结果，构造了用该模型模拟任意量子线路的方法。该模拟在时间、量子比特数和能量尺度上仅需多项式开销，尽管目前开销仍大到难以直接用于实际硬件。

articles.title: Generalized Kramers-Wannier Duality from Bilinear Phase Map
articles.title_zh: 由双线性相位映射得到的广义Kramers-Wannier对偶性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2403.16017v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present the bilinear phase map (BPM), a concept that generalizes the Kramers-Wannier (KW) transformation to investigate unconventional gapped phases of qudit spin chains. Encoding the transformation in a matrix, the BPM enables the exploration of a broader spectrum of generalized quantum phases and dualities, including the nonunitarity in duality transformations, and derivation of general noninvertible fusion rules. Furthermore, we obtain strong constraints on anomaly conditions of qudit models with a general class of duality symmetries. This establishes a microscopic anomaly classification for a broad class of lattice dualities.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出双线性相位映射，用以将Kramers-Wannier变换推广到qudit自旋链中的非常规有能隙相。该框架通过矩阵编码对偶变换，可研究更广泛的量子相与对偶性，包括非幺正对偶变换和一般非可逆融合规则。作者还给出了具有一大类对偶对称性的qudit模型的反常条件强约束，从微观层面建立了晶格对偶性的反常分类。
authors: Linhao Li, Masaki Oshikawa, Han Yan

articles.title: Continuous time crystals as a PT symmetric state and the emergence of critical exceptional points
articles.title_zh: 作为PT对称态的连续时间晶体与临界例外点的涌现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2406.09018v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Continuous time-translation symmetry is often spontaneously broken in open quantum systems, and the condition for their emergence has been actively investigated. However, there are only a few cases in which its condition for appearance has been fully elucidated. In this Letter, we show that a Lindbladian parity-time (PT) symmetry can generically produce persistent periodic oscillations in a wide class of systems. This includes one-collective spin models, which have been studied thoroughly in the context of dissipative continuous time crystals, and spatially extended bipartite bosonic systems with conserved particle number. Interestingly, the periodic orbits in the PT-symmetric phase are found to be center-type, implying an initial state dependence. These results are established by proving that the Lindbladian PT symmetry at the microscopic level implies a nonlinear PT symmetry, and by performing a linear stability analysis near the transition point. This research will further our understanding of novel non-equilibrium phases of matter and phase transitions with spontaneous anti-unitary symmetry breaking.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，Lindblad动力学中的宇称-时间（PT）对称性可在广泛开放量子系统中普遍地产生持久周期振荡。相关体系包括耗散连续时间晶体中的单集体自旋模型，以及具有粒子数守恒的空间扩展二分玻色系统。作者证明微观Lindblad PT对称性会导致非线性PT对称性，并通过转变点附近的线性稳定性分析揭示PT对称相中的周期轨道具有中心型特征，因而依赖初态。
authors: Yuma Nakanishi, Ryo Hanai, Tomohiro Sasamoto
