articles.title: Measurement-and Feedback-Driven Non-Equilibrium Phase Transitions on a Quantum Processor
articles.title_zh: 量子处理器上由测量与反馈驱动的非平衡相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.07966v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Mid-circuit measurements and feedback operations conditioned on the measurement outcomes are essential for implementing quantum error-correction on quantum hardware. When integrated in quantum many-body dynamics, they can give rise to novel non-equilibrium phase transitions both at the level of each individual quantum trajectory and the averaged quantum channel. Experimentally resolving both transitions on realistic devices has been challenging due to limitations on the fidelity and the significant latency for performing mid-circuit measurements and feedback operations in real time. Here, we develop a superconducting quantum processor that enables global mid-circuit measurement with an average quantum non-demolition (QND) fidelity of 98.7% and fast conditional feedback with a 200 ns real-time decision latency. Using this platform, we demonstrate the coexistence of an absorbing-state transition in the quantum channel and a measurement-induced entanglement transition at the level of individual quantum trajectories. For the absorbing-state transition, we experimentally extract a set of critical exponents at the transition point, which is in excellent agreement with the directed percolation universality class. Crucially, the two transitions occur at distinct values of the tuning parameter. Our results demonstrate that adaptive quantum circuits provide a powerful platform for exploring non-equilibrium quantum many-body dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在超导量子处理器上研究中途测量与基于测量结果的反馈如何驱动量子多体非平衡相变。作者开发了支持全局中途测量和快速条件反馈的平台，实现平均98.7%的量子非破坏测量保真度与200 ns实时决策延迟。利用该平台，他们展示了量子信道中的吸收态相变与单条量子轨道层面的测量诱导纠缠相变的共存，并对吸收态转变提取了临界指数。
authors: Zhiyi Wu, Xuandong Sun, Songlei Wang, Jiawei Zhang, Xiaohan Yang, Ji Chu, Jingjing Niu, Youpeng Zhong, Xiao Chen, Zhi-Cheng Yang, Dapeng Yu

articles.title: Generalized Integrable Boundary States in XXZ and XYZ Spin Chains
articles.title_zh: XXZ与XYZ自旋链中的广义可积边界态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.16605v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We investigate integrable boundary states in the anisotropic Heisenberg chain under periodic or twisted boundary conditions, for both even and odd system lengths. Our work demonstrates that the concept of integrable boundary states can be readily generalized. For the XXZ spin chain, we present a set of factorized integrable boundary states using the KT-relation, and these states are also applicable to the XYZ chain. It is shown that a specific set of eigenstates of the transfer matrix can be selected by each boundary state, resulting in an explicit selection rule for the Bethe roots.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究各向异性Heisenberg链在周期或扭转边界条件下的可积边界态，涵盖偶数和奇数系统长度。作者表明可积边界态的概念可以自然推广，并利用KT关系为XXZ自旋链构造了一组因子化可积边界态，这些态同样适用于XYZ链。研究还显示，每个边界态会筛选转移矩阵的一组特定本征态，从而给出Bethe根的显式选择规则。

articles.title: A differential derivation of the Obara-Saika relation for Gaussian electron repulsion integrals
articles.title_zh: 高斯电子排斥积分Obara-Saika关系的微分推导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00102v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Obara-Saika (OS) method is one of the most widely used techniques in quantum chemistry for evaluating electron repulsion integrals (ERIs) via a set of recurrence relations that build higher angular momentum integrals from lower-order ones. The original derivation by Obara and Saika proceeded by directly relating integrals of differing angular momentum. In this work, we present a compact novel derivation of the OS vertical recurrence relation based solely on differential relations between Gaussian basis functions, expanding on a method suggested in earlier work. By explicitly deriving the required derivative expressions we identify all non-zero primitive terms contributing to the full ERI to develop a hierarchical formulation of the OS recursion relations. This approach has pedagogical value as a rigorous and self-contained derivation. Additionally, the resulting organization exposes independent primitive derivative quantities and may be useful for code generation and parallel implementations on modern GPU architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为量子化学中广泛用于计算电子排斥积分的Obara-Saika垂直递推关系提供了一种紧凑的新推导。与原始方法直接联系不同角动量积分不同，作者仅基于高斯基函数之间的微分关系推导该递推。该方法明确识别了完整电子排斥积分中所有非零原始项，形成层级化递推表述，具有教学价值，并可能有助于面向GPU的代码生成与并行实现。
authors: Charles C. Forgy, David A. Mazziotti

articles.title: Nuclear-size correction to the one-loop self-energy in hydrogenlike ions
articles.title_zh: 类氢离子中单圈自能的核尺寸修正
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00554v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The nuclear-size effect on both diagonal and off-diagonal one-loop self-energy matrix elements is considered for hydrogenlike ions with Z=60, 82, 90, and 92. Specifically, the 1s, 2s, 3s, 2p₁/₂, and 2p₃/₂ states, as well as the off-diagonal 1s-2s, 1s-3s, and 2s-3s matrix elements are considered. The calculations are performed within the rigorous quantum-electrodynamics framework, nonperturbatively in the nuclear-strength parameter α Z. Excellent agreement is found with results reported in the literature. Simple and useful approximate formulas to treat the nuclear-size correction are obtained, which, in particular, can be used to study the self-energy contributions to the field-shift factors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在严格量子电动力学框架下研究类氢离子单圈自能矩阵元的核尺寸效应，且对核强度参数αZ作非微扰处理。研究对象包括Z=60、82、90和92离子的若干对角态以及1s-2s、1s-3s和2s-3s等非对角矩阵元。计算结果与已有文献高度一致，并给出用于处理核尺寸修正的简便近似公式，可用于研究场位移因子的自能贡献。
authors: Ping Yang, Aleksei V. Malyshev, Aleksandr N. Kochnev, Vladimir M. Shabaev, Aleksandr S. Shamanaev, Ting-Yun Shi, Dmitry V. Sychkov

articles.title: Universal Design Path for Optomechanical Crystals and One-dimensional Photonic Crystals
articles.title_zh: 光机械晶体与一维光子晶体的通用设计路径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00706v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We have shown a pattern that connects the refractive index, area and the cavity modes of the optomechanical crystals (OMCs) by the same order function. By keeping the fundamental and second cavity modes within a range of -+16 nm and -+23 nm we have shown the link between the design area of the OMC and the refractive index of the material, by keeping the design area same we have shown the link between the refractive index and the cavity mode wavelength and by keeping the refractive index the same, we have shown the link between the cavity mode wavelength and the design area. We have performed simulations for 2 different OMC designs and 10 different refractive indices (9 different materials) to prove the first two claims and we have performed both simulations and experiments on a 3C-SiC OMC, which resulted as 100 nm shift of the second cavity mode, to prove the last claim. Our findings prove that a universal design for optomechanical crystals is possible, making the transition to different material bases easier to exploit their specific properties, suggesting a path to commercialize such devices for hybrid quantum technologies and having flexibility of tuning such devices for their own relative applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种将折射率、设计面积和光机械晶体腔模联系起来的通用规律。作者通过模拟不同光机械晶体设计和多种折射率材料，展示在控制腔模波长或设计面积时，折射率、腔模与结构面积之间的对应关系。并在3C-SiC光机械晶体上结合模拟与实验验证了腔模位移，表明面向不同材料平台的通用光机械晶体设计是可行的。
authors: Berke Demiralp, Nien-Hsuan Lee, Eva M. Weig

articles.title: High-performance parallel implementation of high-order coupled-cluster theories
articles.title_zh: 高阶耦合簇理论的高性能并行实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00981v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-order coupled-cluster theories with iterative triples (CCSDT), perturbative quadruples [CCSDT(Q)], and iterative quadruples (CCSDTQ) provide benchmark-quality correlation energies, but their steep computational scalings, O(N⁸⁾, O(N⁹⁾, and O(N¹⁰), together with the large memory requirements of high-order amplitude tensors, have historically limited their application to small molecules. In this work, we develop efficient open-source implementations of spin-restricted CCSDT (RCCSDT), RCCSDT(Q), RCCSDTQ, and spin-unrestricted CCSDT (UCCSDT) within the PySCF package. The shared-memory implementation combines compact triangular storage of the highest-order amplitude tensors with the multithreaded tensor contraction backend pytblis, enabling efficient use of modern many-core CPU architectures. This design delivers near-ideal thread scaling up to 90 cores and achieves wall times shorter than or comparable to existing single-node implementations for representative benchmark molecules. We further extend RCCSDT, RCCSDT(Q), and RCCSDTQ to distributed-memory architectures using MPI-based algorithms. By distributing compact high-order amplitudes across MPI ranks and overlapping communication with computation through nonblocking data transfers, the distributed implementation achieves near-ideal strong scaling on up to 32 nodes, corresponding to approximately 3,000 CPU cores. These developments substantially extend the practical reach of canonical high-order CC theory, enabling CCSDT(Q) calculations with approximately 100 correlated electrons in 450 orbitals and CCSDTQ calculations with approximately 50 correlated electrons in 115 orbitals. Applications to π-stacked noncovalent dimers, the CO dissociation energy of Cr(CO)₆, and the Cope rearrangement of semibullvalene demonstrate that canonical high-order CC benchmarks are now feasible for chemically realistic molecular systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在PySCF软件包中开发了自旋限制CCSDT、CCSDT(Q)、CCSDTQ以及自旋非限制CCSDT的高效开源实现。该实现通过高阶振幅张量的紧凑三角存储与多线程张量收缩后端结合，提高了现代多核CPU上的共享内存性能，并在最高90核上表现出近理想线程扩展。作者还将相关方法扩展到基于MPI的分布式内存架构，以缓解高阶耦合簇理论高计算标度和内存需求带来的限制。
authors: Yu Jin, Christopher Hillenbrand, Timothy C. Berkelbach, Huanchen Zhai

articles.title: Room temperature valley coherence in monolayer WSe2 mediated by chiral nematic liquid crystal
articles.title_zh: 由手性向列液晶介导的单层WSe2室温谷相干
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01098v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Valley coherence refers to a phase-coherent superposition of inequivalent momentum valleys, in which quantum information can be encoded in the relative valley phase. Chiral nematic liquid crystals, by imposing a flip of the spin angular momentum upon light reflection, provide an effective photonic environment for optically coupling excitons of the K and K' valleys in monolayer semiconducting transition-metal dichalcogenides. We experimentally demonstrate that using such liquid crystal as a substrate, it is possible through nearfield interaction to engineer a room temperature mechanism for inducing the intervalley coupling. Our results show that this approach provides a simple and scalable route toward valleytronic functionalities based on controlled coherent emission from valleys with opposite Berry curvature.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究利用手性向列液晶在单层WSe2中实现室温谷相干的机制。手性向列液晶可在光反射时翻转自旋角动量，为耦合K与K'谷激子提供有效光子环境。实验表明，将该液晶作为衬底可通过近场相互作用诱导谷间耦合，为基于相反Berry曲率谷的受控相干发射与谷电子学功能提供了简单且可扩展的路线。
authors: Hassan Lamsaadi, Andrea Balocchi, Aurélien Cuche, Hugo Lourenco Martins, Vincent Paillard, Sébastien Weber, Jean Marie Poumirol, Gonzague Agez

articles.title: Initial conditions for tidal synchronisation of a planet by its moon
articles.title_zh: 卫星使行星潮汐同步的初始条件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.09858v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Moons tidally interact with their host planets and stars. A close moon is quickly synchronised by the planet, or becomes captured in a higher spin-orbit resonance. However, the planet requires much more time to significantly alter its rotation rate under the influence of moon-generated tides. The situation becomes more complex for close-in planets, as star-generated tides come into play and compete with the moon-generated tides. Synchronisation of the planet by its moon changes the tidal dynamics of the entire star-planet-moon system and can lead to long-term stable configurations. In this paper, we demonstrate that a certain initial condition must be met for this to occur. Based on the angular-momentum conservation, the derived condition is universal and bears no dependence upon the planet's internal structure or tidal dissipation model. It is applicable to dwindling systems as well as tidally expanding orbits, and to the cases of initially retrograde motion. We present calculations for specific planet-moon systems (Earth and the Moon; Neptune and Triton; Venus and its hypothetical presently-extinct moon Neith; Mars, Phobos, and Deimos; Pluto and Charon), to constrain the dynamically plausible formation and evolution scenarios. Among other things, our analysis prompts the question of whether Pluto and Charon evolved into their current state from an initially more compact configuration (as is commonly assumed) or from a wider orbit -- a topic to be discussed at length elsewhere. Our results are equally applicable to exoplanets. For example, if asynchronous close-in exoplanets are detected, the possibility of tidal synchronisation by an exomoon should be considered.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究卫星、行星与恒星组成系统中的潮汐相互作用，重点讨论卫星能否使行星自转同步。作者指出，近距离卫星通常较快被行星同步或俘获进更高自旋-轨道共振，而行星在卫星潮汐作用下改变自转则需要更长时间；对近恒星行星，还需考虑恒星潮汐的竞争。基于角动量守恒，文章推导出行星被卫星同步所需满足的普适初始条件，该条件不依赖行星内部结构或具体潮汐耗散模型，并适用于轨道衰减、扩张及初始逆行等情形。

articles.title: Spin Femtoscopy: A Framework for Revealing Genuine Spin Correlations
articles.title_zh: 自旋飞秒关联学：揭示真实自旋关联的框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00413v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spin correlations are among the most fundamental quantum observables in many-body systems, yet they remain difficult to access experimentally in relativistic heavy-ion collisions. Existing spin measurements, including hyperon polarization and vector-meson spin alignment, have revealed important single-particle spin phenomena, but genuine two-particle spin correlations in the produced hadronic system remain largely unexplored. Here we propose spin femtoscopy, a framework for accessing genuine two-particle spin correlations through spin-resolved femtoscopic measurements. The key principle is that different two-particle spin configurations can give rise to different femtoscopic correlation functions because of quantum statistics, spin-dependent final-state interactions. Using ŁambdaŁambda pairs as a proof of principle, we exploit the self-analyzing weak decay of Łambda hyperons to construct spin-sensitive femtoscopic correlation functions with different singlet and triplet admixtures. We show that these observables provide experimental access to the spin-state populations of the pair and allow genuine spin correlations to be separated from spin-dependent femtoscopic mixing caused by quantum statistics and final-state interactions. This work extends femtoscopy from a probe of source geometry and final-state interactions to a framework for revealing the quantum spin structure of strongly interacting matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出“自旋飞秒关联学”框架，用于在相对论重离子碰撞中探测真实的双粒子自旋关联。其核心思想是，不同双粒子自旋构型会因量子统计和自旋依赖末态相互作用产生不同的飞秒关联函数。作者以ΛΛ对为例，利用Λ超子的自分析弱衰变构造具有不同单态与三重态混合的自旋敏感关联函数，从而为实验分离真实自旋关联和提取成对粒子的自旋态布居提供途径。
authors: Kehao Zhang, Xuan Wang, Xiaofeng Luo

articles.title: Bridging quantum mechanics and nonlinear optics in Raman scattering
articles.title_zh: 拉曼散射中量子力学与非线性光学的桥接
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00463v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a theoretical framework for spontaneous Raman scattering that fundamentally bridges quantum-mechanical and nonlinear-optical approaches. By conceptualizing spontaneous Raman scattering as a stimulated Raman gain or loss event seeded by the quantum vacuum field, we rigorously derive the spontaneous Raman cross-section directly from the third-order nonlinear susceptibility. Crucially, this framework predicts the existence of a hitherto unrecognized phenomenon: "spontaneous Raman loss" (sRL), which acts as the vacuum-seeded counterpart to stimulated Raman loss, complementing traditional spontaneous Raman scattering (spontaneous Raman gain, sRG). Furthermore, we establish a rigorous connection to the traditional Kramers-Heisenberg-Dirac (KHD) theory, revealing that the spontaneous process is governed by interference before a detector between the signal field emitted from molecules and the vacuum field itself that stimulates the molecules. This insight uncovers a direct correspondence between the sRG susceptibility and the rotating/counter-rotating interference terms in the KHD formula. Ultimately, we extend the foundational KHD theory by incorporating previously unrecognized essential terms, achieving perfect analytical agreement between the quantum mechanical and nonlinear optical descriptions of Raman scattering.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个自发拉曼散射的理论框架，将其理解为由量子真空场播种的受激拉曼增益或损耗事件，并由三阶非线性磁化率严格推导自发拉曼截面。该框架预言了此前未被认识的“自发拉曼损耗”现象，作为受激拉曼损耗的真空播种对应物，与传统自发拉曼散射相互补充。作者还将该框架与传统 Kramers-Heisenberg-Dirac 理论联系起来，指出自发过程受分子发射信号场与激发分子的真空场在探测前干涉的支配。

articles.title: First direct search for light dark matter interactions in a transition-edge sensor
articles.title_zh: 利用相变边缘传感器首次直接搜寻轻暗物质相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.18982v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose the use of transition-edge sensor (TES) single-photon detectors as a simultaneous target and sensor for direct dark matter searches, and report results from the first search of this kind. We perform a 489 h science run with a TES device optimized for the detection of 1064 nm photons, with a mass of ~0.2 ng and an energy threshold of ~0.3 eV, and set new limits on dark matter interactions with both electrons and nucleons for dark matter with mass below the MeV scale. With their excellent energy resolution, TESs enable search strategies that are complementary to recent results from superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors and kinetic inductance detectors. We show that next-generation TES arrays hold promise to probe new regions of light dark matter parameter space.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出将相变边缘传感器单光子探测器同时作为暗物质直接探测的靶体和传感器，并报告了此类实验的首次结果。研究团队使用针对 1064 nm 光子优化的 TES 器件进行了 489 小时的数据采集，器件质量约 0.2 ng、能量阈值约 0.3 eV。实验对 MeV 以下质量暗物质与电子和核子的相互作用给出了新的限制，并指出下一代 TES 阵列有望探索新的轻暗物质参数空间。
authors: Christina Schwemmbauer, Guy Daniel Hadas, Yonit Hochberg, Katharina-Sophie Isleif, Friederike Januschek, Benjamin V. Lehmann, Axel Lindner, Adriana E. Lita, Manuel Meyer, Gulden Othman, Elmeri Rivasto, José Alejandro Rubiera Gimeno

articles.title: Spatio-temporal equilibrium thermodynamics of guided optical waves at positive and negative temperatures
articles.title_zh: 正温与负温下导引光波的时空平衡热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.07784v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Optical thermalization has been recently studied in the 2D spatial evolution of (quasi-)monochromatic light waves propagating in multimode waveguides. Here, we investigate the spatio-temporal equilibrium properties of optical waves through the analysis of the (2+1)D Bose-Einstein thermal distribution and the corresponding classical Rayleigh-Jeans approximation. Numerical simulations of the nonlinear Schrödinger equation (NLSE) demonstrate relaxation toward the spatio-temporal Rayleigh-Jeans equilibrium state, as described by the corresponding wave turbulence kinetic equation. Remarkable adiabatic cooling phenomena stemming from the high-frequency tails of the Rayleigh-Jeans distribution are discussed and the consequent limitations of the classical approximation are highlighted. To overcome these issues, we make use of a quantum version of the NLSE whose associated kinetic equation describes relaxation toward the spatio-temporal Bose-Einstein equilibrium distribution. The analysis of thermodynamic properties reveals a strong dependence on the dispersion regime. In the anomalous dispersion regime, the system relaxes to positive-temperatures equilibrium states: as the number of modes of the waveguide increases, the fundamental spatial mode becomes macroscopically populated, while its temporal spectrum undergoes significant narrowing, ultimately leading to complete (2+1)D spatio-temporal condensation in the thermodynamic limit. In the normal dispersion regime, the system evolves toward negative-temperature equilibrium states characterized by an inverted spatial modal population. In this regime, we predict a phase transition to Bose-Einstein condensation at negative temperatures, which occurs by increasing the temperature above a negative critical value. Our work opens new avenues for future research and lay the groundwork for the development of spatiotemporal optical thermodynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究多模波导中光波的时空平衡性质，分析了（2+1）维 Bose-Einstein 热分布及其经典 Rayleigh-Jeans 近似。非线性薛定谔方程的数值模拟表明，系统会向时空 Rayleigh-Jeans 平衡态弛豫，并可由波湍流动力学方程描述。作者讨论了高频尾部导致的绝热冷却现象及经典近似的局限，并进一步采用量子版本的非线性薛定谔方程来描述向 Bose-Einstein 平衡分布的弛豫。研究显示，热力学性质强烈依赖色散机制，在反常色散等情形下可出现不同的温度行为。
authors: Lucas Zanaglia, Josselin Garnier, Claire Michel, Valérie Doya, Mario Ferraro, Stefan Wabnitz, Iacopo Carusotto, Antonio Picozzi

articles.title: Superradiance of entangled photon pairs from a high-density chip-scale Cs vapor cell
articles.title_zh: 高密度芯片级铯蒸气池中纠缠光子对的超辐射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.13909v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Superradiance is one of the most fundamental collective quantum phenomena in light-matter interactions and has been studied extensively since Dicke's seminal work. However, its practical implementation remains challenging because superradiant enhancement requires strict experiment conditions for strong collective coupling among emitters. Can superradiance emerge in a simple platform, such as an atomic vapor cell composed of thermally moving atoms? To address this question, we identify the key signatures of superradiance in a hot atomic ensemble and find a use case of superradiance using an atomic vapor cell. Here, the Photon-Pair SuperRadiance (PPSR) process in an atomic vapor cell provides a novel approach to generating superradiant quantum light from a practical atomic platform. We experimentally demonstrate a superradiant entangled photon-pair generation via PPSR process in a high-density, 1-mm-long chip-scale Cs vapor cell. The hot, dense atomic vapor cell allows the mean interatomic distance in the Doppler-broadened atomic ensemble to be reduced to 0.29 times the idler-photon wavelength, satisfying the condition for cooperative emission. The thin chip-scale geometry enables high atomic densities while mitigating the reabsorption of emitted photons and maintaining moderate optical depth. In this subwavelength regime, we clearly observe the temporal narrowing of the biphoton wavefunction from 0.60 ns to 0.17 ns due to a superradiant decay. This pronounced temporal compression provides strong evidence of collective superradiant emission in the chip-scale Cs vapor cell. Our PPSR source delivers a detected photon-pair rate exceeding 10⁶ pairs/s while maintaining a high coincidence-to-accidental ratio of 280.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨热原子蒸气池这一简易平台中是否能够产生超辐射，并提出利用光子对超辐射过程生成超辐射量子光。作者在一个高密度、1 mm 长的芯片级铯蒸气池中实验演示了超辐射纠缠光子对的产生。热而致密的原子蒸气降低了多普勒展宽原子系综中的平均原子间距，使其满足集体耦合条件，从而为实用原子平台上的超辐射量子光源提供了新路径。
authors: Heewoo Kim, Bojeong Seo, Han Seb Moon

articles.title: Theoria: Rewrite-Acceptability Verification over Informal Reasoning States
articles.title_zh: Theoria：面向非形式化推理状态的重写可接受性验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01223v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: When should an AI system's answer be trusted? Formal proof assistants offer certainty but cannot reach most of the problem distribution; scalar LLM judges offer coverage but produce opaque scores that cannot be audited after the fact and are subject to the same coherence issues as any LLM. We present Theoria, a verification architecture that closes this gap. A candidate solution is rewritten into a sequence of typed state transitions, each licensed by an explicit justification, whether that be a citation, computation, or problem-given fact, and every transition is independently auditable. The foundational invariant is completeness of change: every difference between consecutive proof states must be accounted for, so hidden premises surface as unlicensed mutations rather than passing silently. On HLE-Verified Gold (185 text-only expert problems), Theoria certifies 105 at 91.4% strict precision (Wilson 95% CI [84.5%, 95.4%]). Every certification produces a human readable proof trace in which each step can be independently challenged. Holistic LLM judges achieve comparable precision at matched coverage but fail on different problems (Jaccard 0.14-0.36), making the approaches complementary. On 95 adversarial poisoned proofs across 15 domains, structured judges catch 94.7% versus 83.2% for holistic judging (p= 0.0017). The overall 11.5 pp gap concentrates in hidden premises (90.6% vs. 62.5%, a 28 pp difference) and fabricated citations (100% vs. 90%), the error classes where the formal analysis predicts an advantage; performance is identical on arithmetic and theorem-misapplication errors, where no advantage is predicted. On GPQA Diamond (n= 65), certified precision is 97.1% (Wilson CI [85.1%, 99.5%]).
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 Theoria，一种用于评估人工智能答案可信度的验证架构，旨在弥合形式化证明助手覆盖不足与大语言模型评分不可审计之间的差距。该方法将候选解重写为带类型的状态转移序列，每一步都需由引用、计算或题目给定事实等明确理由授权，并可独立审计。其核心不变量是“变化完备性”，即相邻证明状态之间的每一处差异都必须被解释，从而将隐藏前提暴露为未授权变更。实验显示，在 HLE-Verified Gold 文本专家题集上，该方法在一定覆盖率下取得较高严格精度，并生成可供人工逐步质疑的证明轨迹。

articles.title: Managed Autonomy at Runtime: Gear-Based Safety and Governance for Single- and Multi-Agent Cyber-Physical Systems
articles.title_zh: 运行时托管自治：面向单智能体与多智能体信息物理系统的齿轮式安全与治理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00334v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous agents, whether LLM-driven software agents or robotic physical agents, face a common class of failure modes when operating without continuous human oversight: safety violations from unverified actions, behavioral instability from unconstrained loops, and continuity loss from unhandled error states. We develop system{}, a discrete-time control system that combines five execution gears (Gobs{}, Gsug{}, Gplan{}, Gexec{}, Gint{}) with utility-gated dispatch and event-driven fallback. For the single-agent case, we prove monotonic stability, execution safety, eventual stabilization, fallback completeness, and equivalence to a gear-constrained Markov decision process. For multi-agent cyber-physical systems (CPS), we apply the established smart{} managed-autonomy lifecycle and map runtime evidence into its four governance states (Stable{}/Meta{}/Assisted{}/Regulated{}). Consensus gating, swarm-level Lyapunov analysis, per-agent gear authority, and rendezvous control provide distributed safety and stability guarantees, including zero collision under the stated assumptions. We evaluate the resulting runtime on a three-agent UR5 robotic assembly cell using fault magnitudes calibrated from the NIST emph{Degradation Measurement of Robot Arm Position Accuracy} dataset across 10,000 Monte Carlo episodes. It achieves a 99.6% anomaly detection rate versus 2.1% for the single-agent baseline, reduces detection latency by 3.5×, and supplies a formal physical-workspace safety certificate. The execution gears act as micro-level permissions beneath the smart{} runtime governance states, separating action control from autonomy governance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种离散时间控制系统，用于管理大语言模型驱动软件智能体和机器人等自治体在无人持续监督时可能出现的安全违规、行为不稳定和错误状态连续性丢失问题。该系统结合五种执行“齿轮”、效用门控调度和事件驱动回退机制，并在单智能体场景下证明了单调稳定性、执行安全性、最终稳定化和回退完备性等性质。对于多智能体信息物理系统，作者将运行时证据映射到托管自治生命周期的治理状态，并通过共识门控、群体 Lyapunov 分析、逐智能体权限控制和会合控制提供分布式安全稳定保证。

articles.title: EO-VGGT: Orbital Ray-Conditioned 3D Foundation Models for Satellite Multi-View Reconstruction
articles.title_zh: EO-VGGT：面向卫星多视图重建的轨道射线条件化三维基础模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00417v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In the era of satellite constellations, multi-view optical satellite imagery is pivotal for Earth Observation (EO) and high-quality Digital Surface Model (DSM) reconstruction. Although feed-forward 3D foundation models have transformed computer vision, their deployment in satellite remote sensing is inherently constrained by the structural discrepancy between implicit perspective assumptions and explicit orbital pushbroom geometry. This geometric incongruity is further compounded by pronounced view-set heterogeneity. We present EO-VGGT, a framework that adapts a frozen perspective-driven model to orbital observations via explicit physical geometry embedding.First, the Geometry-Correlation Constrained Selection (GCCS) strategy prunes sub-optimal observations by balancing geometric diversity and radiometric consistency to optimize the input sequence. Second, a Sensor-Ray Encoder (SRE) parameterizes pixel-level pushbroom lines of sight derived from the Rational Function Model (RFM) into high-dimensional space-geometric tokens, reconciling the mathematical discrepancy between central projection and orbital kinematics. Third, a lightweight Ray-Pointing-Aware Adapter (RPAA) employs gated residual blocks to integrate these tokens directly into the frozen transformer backbone. Our findings underscore that integrating explicit physical geometry with optimized view selection is essential for robust feed-forward satellite 3D reconstruction.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文面向卫星星座时代的多视图光学遥感影像与高质量数字表面模型重建，提出 EO-VGGT 框架，以解决透视假设驱动的三维基础模型与轨道推扫成像几何之间的不匹配。该方法通过显式物理几何嵌入，将冻结的透视模型适配到轨道观测场景。框架包括几何相关约束选择策略以筛选更优观测、传感器射线编码器以表征基于有理函数模型的像素级视线，以及轻量级适配模块来调和中心投影和轨道运动学差异。
authors: Qiyan Luo, Yingdong Pi, Lekang Wen, Jie Yang, Xiaoyu Wang, Haiming Zhang, Mi Wang

articles.title: Energy-Efficient Context-Aware Multimodal AI Inference at the Edge
articles.title_zh: 边缘端能效型上下文感知多模态人工智能推理
articles.abstract: Deploying multimodal artificial intelligence models on resource-constrained edge devices faces inherent bottlenecks in energy consumption and computational latency, as conventional full-modality inference pipelines keep all perception encoders active regardless of task context and environmental conditions, causing substantial power waste and degraded real-time performance. To address this challenge, this work presents an energy-efficient context-aware multimodal edge inference framework featuring a lightweight modality activation sparsity evaluation unit, dynamic computation path scheduling, and a cross-modal speculative skipping mechanism. The framework quantifies the information value of each input modality in real time according to scene context, task complexity, and device power status, and adaptively activates or deactivates corresponding visual, audio, and sensor encoders, while tuning model quantization precision and operator fusion strategies to align with runtime resource budgets. Validated on NVIDIA Jetson Nano and Raspberry Pi 5 edge platforms across VQAv2, MMBench, and multimodal perception benchmarks, the proposed framework delivers a 42.3% reduction in end-to-end energy consumption and a 30%–65% decrease in inference latency against static full-modality baselines, alongside 1.5× to 2.3× higher throughput with an accuracy loss below 1.2%. The runtime context scheduling module introduces less than 9 ms of latency overhead and only 0.32 W of additional power draw, with per-inference energy as low as 0.6 J; for battery-powered mobile edge devices, the framework extends continuous operating duration by over 72% under typical perception workloads. These findings confirm that context-aware adaptive scheduling can dramatically boost the energy efficiency of edge multimodal inference without sacrificing task performance, offering a viable deployment solution for low-power Internet of Things, intelligent surveillance, and human-robot interaction scenarios.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对资源受限边缘设备部署多模态人工智能模型时的能耗和延迟瓶颈，提出一种上下文感知的节能推理框架。该框架通过轻量级模态激活稀疏性评估、动态计算路径调度和跨模态推测跳过机制，实时评估视觉、音频和传感器等模态的信息价值。系统可根据场景、任务复杂度和设备电量自适应启停编码器，并调整量化精度和算子融合策略。作者在 Jetson Nano 和 Raspberry Pi 5 等平台及多个多模态基准上验证，报告了显著的端到端能耗降低和实时性能改进。

articles.title: Quantum simulation of alignment dependent differential cross sections in co-propagating molecular beams at cold collision energies
articles.title_zh: 冷碰撞能量下共传播分子束中取向依赖微分截面的量子模拟
articles.abstract: Cold collisions can be achieved experimentally by co-propagating colliding partners of similar mass within a single molecular beam. This technique, combined with Stark-induced adiabatic Raman passage (SARP), makes it possible to measure the angular distributions for different molecular axis alignments of the incoming molecules, thus probing the stereodynamics of the collisions at very low energies. Reproducing SARP experiments is a very stringent test for theory, even though the systems under study involve closed-shell atoms and molecules with very few electrons for which exact quantum scattering calculations on highly accurate potential energy surfaces are computationally feasible. While simulations of some experimental results using first-principles theoretical calculations have been satisfactory, theory has been unable to reproduce the experimental angular distributions for He + D 2 inelastic collisions. Furthermore, an ℓ = 1 partial-wave resonance predicted by theory came at variance with the ℓ = 2 resonance obtained by fitting the experimental results. Here, we demonstrate how theory and experiment can be reconciled by the explicit consideration of the divergence of the molecular beam. While the effect of the divergence is almost irrelevant for collision energies higher than 0.5 K, at lower collision energies, it can produce significantly different results. Our simulations show that signatures of an ℓ = 2 resonance obtained through fitting of the experimental angular distribution ignoring beam divergence is, in fact, an ℓ = 1 resonance observed in the scattering calculations. These results indicate that the combination of theory and experiment is necessary for the analysis and interpretation of complex molecular beam experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论在单一分子束中使质量相近的碰撞伙伴共传播以实现冷碰撞，并结合 Stark 诱导绝热拉曼通道技术测量不同分子轴取向下的角分布。此类实验为低能碰撞立体动力学理论提供了严格检验，尤其是在 He + D₂ 非弹性碰撞中，既有理论难以再现实验角分布和共振特征。作者指出，通过显式考虑分子束发散等实验因素，可帮助调和理论预测与实验观测之间的差异。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Single-reference coupled-cluster theory based on the multi-purpose cluster operator
articles.title_zh: 基于多用途簇算符的单参考耦合簇理论
articles.abstract: In this paper, we develop a theoretical framework that extends single-reference (SR) coupled-cluster (CC) theory beyond its conventional role of describing a single electronic state—typically the lowest-energy state within the symmetry sector defined by the reference determinant. Rather than viewing the SR-CC cluster operator solely as a device for reproducing one target state, we consider more general constructions in which different components of the cluster operator play distinct roles, ranging from encoding states of different symmetry than the reference to enabling the SR-CC ansatz to describe multiple states simultaneously. These developments lead to a new class of SR-CC downfolding formalisms in which the resulting active-space effective Hamiltonians are capable of concurrently representing multiple correlated states non-orthogonal to the reference function. We establish three theorems that formalize this extension and demonstrate that standard CC downfolding emerges as a special case of the proposed framework. Finally, we introduce a Hermitian variant based on a unitary CC representation, which enables realistic simulations of ground and excited states while reducing the quantum resources required.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文发展了一种扩展单参考耦合簇理论的框架，使其不再仅限于描述由参考行列式确定的单个电子态。作者提出将簇算符的不同组成部分赋予不同功能，例如编码不同对称性的态或同时描述多个态。该框架导出一类新的单参考耦合簇降维形式，其有效哈密顿量可同时表示多个与参考函数非正交的相关态，并给出了相应定理及基于酉耦合簇表示的厄米变体。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Electrochemical porosification of n-GaN across acidic–neutral–alkaline electrolytes: From morphology to surface chemistry
articles.title_zh: 酸性、中性与碱性电解质中 n-GaN 的电化学多孔化：从形貌到表面化学
articles.abstract: Electrochemical etching is a scalable route to engineer nanoporous architectures in doped GaN, but cross-comparative investigations spanning the full electrolyte chemical window are still very limited. Here, we explore the electrochemical etching of Si-doped n-GaN in acidic, alkaline , and neutral electrolytes and correlate morphology, optical properties, and surface chemistry by using various characterization and simulation methodologies. Our findings reveal that the electrolyte with different pH values not only affects the pore size and density but also alters the dominant etching mode, which leads to morphologies ranging from interconnected “sponge-like” three-dimensional pore networks to intact surfaces with slightly and anisotropically etched pores beneath. We have established semiquantitative models to elaborate the changes in near-band edge absorption due to disorders of the pores and to describe the surface oxidation/hydroxylation, through respective optical and x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy measurements. The models are further corroborated with the Raman observations, supporting a unified picture in which porosification increases disorder/local strain fluctuations. We envisage that this work offers important information on the electrochemical etching of III-nitrides using electrolytes in full pH ranges and proposes new analytical methods, which are valuable in developing power-efficient GaN optoelectronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究系统考察了硅掺杂 n-GaN 在酸性、碱性和中性电解质中的电化学刻蚀行为，并将形貌、光学性质与表面化学联系起来。结果表明，电解质 pH 不仅影响孔径和孔密度，还会改变主导刻蚀模式，使材料呈现从互连海绵状三维孔网络到轻微各向异性亚表面刻蚀等不同形貌。作者还建立了半定量模型解释近带边吸收变化和表面氧化/羟基化，并结合拉曼结果支持多孔化会增强无序与局域应变涨落的统一图像。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Anharmonic phonons via quantum thermal bath simulations
articles.title_zh: 通过量子热浴模拟研究非谐声子
articles.abstract: Lattice vibrations within crystalline solids, or phonons, provide information on a variety of important material characteristics, from thermal qualities to optical properties and phase transition behavior. When the material contains light ions or is subjected to sufficiently low temperatures and/or high pressures, anharmonic and nuclear quantum effects (NQEs) may significantly alter its phonon characteristics. An accurate method, combining the quantum correlator approach with path integral molecular dynamics, was recently proposed to capture these effects [Morresi et al ., J. Chem. Phys. 154 (22), 224108 (2021)]. Unfortunately, this scheme may incur a substantial computational cost due to the increased number of degrees of freedom introduced by path integrals. In this work, we present an alternative that promises to mitigate this problem by accounting for NQEs via the quantum thermal bath (QTB) method. This is the first full exploration of the use of QTB for the calculation of phonon dispersion relations. We demonstrate the noteworthy efficiency and accuracy of the scheme and analyze its upsides and drawbacks by first considering 1-dimensional systems and then the physically interesting case of solid neon.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注晶体固体中的声子性质，尤其是轻离子、低温或高压条件下非谐效应与核量子效应对声子特征的影响。此前结合量子关联函数与路径积分分子动力学的方法较为准确但计算代价高，本文提出使用量子热浴方法来纳入核量子效应。作者首次系统探索量子热浴在声子色散关系计算中的应用，并通过一维体系及更具物理意义的体系评估其效率、准确性、优势与局限。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Optical frequency comb double-resonance spectroscopy of the 9030–9175 cm −1 states of ethylene
articles.title_zh: 乙烯 9030–9175 cm⁻¹ 能级的光学频率梳双共振光谱
articles.abstract: We use optical–optical double-resonance (OODR) spectroscopy to measure for the first time hot-band transitions of ethylene between states in the 3000 and 9000 cm −1 energy ranges. A 3.2 μm continuous wave (CW) pump is used to populate selected states in the ν 9 vibrational mode. The sub-Doppler OODR transitions are then probed with two different cavity-enhanced probes tunable around 1.7 μm: a frequency comb probe that allows for broadband measurements and simultaneous detection of many OODR lines and a CW probe that measures individual lines with higher signal-to-noise ratio and better frequency accuracy. We report center frequencies and relative intensities of 90 ladder-type hot-band transitions from three different states in the ν 9 vibrational mode. We exploit combination differences and measurements of polarization-dependent intensity ratios to determine the final state rotational quantum numbers J . Comparison to theoretical predictions from ExoMol allows tentative assignments for 28 transitions. We also report improved line center frequencies for the three pump transitions in the ν 9 band. Furthermore, we observe 18 sub-Doppler V-type transitions from the depleted ground state to the 6000 cm −1 region and assign 14 of them using ExoMol and the variational line list of Mraidi et al. [J. Quant. Spectrosc. Radiat. Transfer 310 , 108734 (2023)].
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用光学—光学双共振光谱首次测量了乙烯在 3000 与 9000 cm⁻¹ 能区态之间的热带跃迁。实验采用 3.2 μm 连续波泵浦选择性布居 ν₉ 振动模态中的能级，并用约 1.7 μm 的腔增强频率梳探针和连续波探针进行亚多普勒探测。作者报告了来自 ν₉ 模态三个不同态的 90 条阶梯型热带跃迁的中心频率和相对强度，并结合组合差、偏振强度比和 ExoMol 理论预测给出部分跃迁的暂定指认。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Ultrahigh spatiotemporal resolution terahertz scanning tunnelling microscopy
articles.title_zh: 超高时空分辨率太赫兹扫描隧道显微术
articles.abstract: Nature Reviews Physics, Published online: 02 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s42254-026-00952-7 Terahertz scanning tunnelling microscopy integrates picosecond pulses with atomic resolution, enabling detailed analysis of electron dynamics and molecular motions. This Technical Review outlines methods and applications, emphasizing insights into ultrafast phenomena and potential advances in quantum materials and technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该技术综述介绍了太赫兹扫描隧道显微术，这一方法将皮秒级太赫兹脉冲与原子级空间分辨率相结合。文章概述其关键方法和应用，重点讨论其在电子动力学与分子运动超快过程研究中的作用。该技术有望推动对量子材料及相关量子技术中超快现象的理解。

articles.title: The Riemann Hypothesis manifested in dynamical quantum phase transitions
articles.title_zh: 动力学量子相变中显现的黎曼假设
articles.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 01 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74935-8 The authors establish a formal correspondence between the Riemann Hypothesis and engineered quantum many-body dynamics. By constructing a Riemann-based Hamiltonian, they demonstrate that the hypothesis manifests through quantum phase transitions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究建立了黎曼假设与工程化量子多体动力学之间的形式对应关系。作者通过构造基于黎曼结构的哈密顿量，表明黎曼假设可在量子动力学相变中得到体现。由于摘要信息较简略，具体构造与验证细节需查阅原文。

articles.title: UAV-Based Thermal Sensing for Quantifying Diurnal Land Surface Temperature Variability in a Tropical Urban Heat Island Context
articles.title_zh: 基于无人机热感知的热带城市热岛背景下昼夜地表温度变化定量研究
articles.abstract: Urban Heat Island (UHI) intensity is strongly influenced by surface material properties and land-cover composition, yet fine-scale diurnal thermal dynamics are often inadequately captured by conventional satellite observations. This study evaluates the potential of drone-assisted thermal imaging to characterize high resolution day–night land surface temperature (LST) variability within a mixed-use urban campus in Johor Bahru, Malaysia. Thermal data were acquired using an unmanned aerial vehicle equipped with a thermal infrared sensor during three temporal epochs representing mid-day, late afternoon, and night time conditions. Radiometrically calibrated thermal orthomosaics were produced at centimetre-level spatial resolution and validated using concurrent ground-based measurements. Comparative analysis of ten surface materials, including asphalt, grass, concrete, ceramic new and old roofs, black and white car roofs, water bodies, metal and solar panel, reveals pronounced material-dependent thermal behaviour relative to ambient air temperatures. Impervious and dark-coloured surfaces exhibit extreme daytime heating and delayed nocturnal cooling, while vegetated and water-covered surfaces demonstrate consistently lower temperatures and more efficient thermal dissipation. These results underscore the critical role of surface material properties, colour, and thermal inertia in governing localized UHI dynamics. Overall, this study demonstrates the effectiveness of UAV-based thermal sensing for resolving fine-scale urban microclimate variability and provides valuable insights to support climate-resilient urban design and heat mitigation strategies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估了无人机热红外成像在马来西亚新山一处混合功能城市校园中刻画高分辨率昼夜地表温度变化的能力。研究在正午、傍晚和夜间获取热影像，并生成厘米级热正射镶嵌图，同时用地面实测数据验证。对沥青、草地、混凝土、屋顶、车辆屋顶、水体、金属和太阳能板等多类表面的比较表明，不同材料具有显著差异的热响应，深色和不透水表面白天升温强且夜间冷却滞后，而植被和水体具有相对缓和的热行为。

articles.title: Quantitative Analysis of PlanktoScope Data: a powerful tool for exploring ecosystem function
articles.title_zh: PlanktoScope 数据的定量分析：探索生态系统功能的有力工具
articles.abstract: Plankton communities are essential to aquatic ecosystems, driving primary production (phytoplankton) and global biogeochemical cycles. However, traditional methods for identifying and monitoring plankton are time- and labor-consuming and require a high level of expertise, which may limit large spatio-temporal studies. This study evaluated the effectiveness of the PlanktoScope, an open-source, automated imaging system for monitoring changes in plankton community composition in the coastal waters of La Paz Bay, Mexico. Over a 3-month period from September to November 2024, weekly plankton samples were collected, and the planktonic organisms were identified and counted using the automated classification of the PlanktoScope coupled with the web-interfaced Ecotaxa. A total of 28 taxa were identified, most of them at the genus level, with Chaetoceros (Bacillariophyta) dominating the planktonic assemblages. The PlanktoScope successfully highlighted a local temporal shift in planktonic composition during the studied period, between the warm season (September–October) and the warm–cold season transition (November). This shift was mainly driven by a collapse in planktonic cell abundance and an increase in Copepoda and Cyanobacteria biomass. The detected collapse of the autotroph Bacillariophyta (mainly diatoms) corresponded with a decrease in Chlorophyll-a concentrations detected from satellite images. Although the size spectrum revealed a planktonic assemblage dominated by small-size organisms, variation in the biomass distribution among size bins varied throughout the studied period. Our findings highlight the PlanktoScope's potential for high-frequency, cost-effective plankton monitoring. However, while promising, further validation over larger spatio-temporal scales covering different oceanographic contexts is necessary.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估了开源自动成像系统 PlanktoScope 结合 Ecotaxa 平台监测墨西哥拉巴斯湾沿岸浮游生物群落组成变化的有效性。研究在2024年9月至11月每周采集样本，共识别出28个分类单元，其中以硅藻门的 Chaetoceros 属占优势。结果显示，该系统能够捕捉研究期间从暖季到冷暖过渡期的局地群落组成变化，主要表现为浮游细胞丰度下降及群落结构转变。

articles.title: Hardware-Assisted Zero-Knowledge Authentication Scheme for Resource-Constrained IoT Terminals: USBKEY Implementation and Evaluation Based on GSVOLE-2DLC
articles.title_zh: 面向资源受限物联网终端的硬件辅助零知识认证方案：基于 GSVOLE-2DLC 的 USBKEY 实现与评估
articles.abstract: When resource-constrained Internet of Things (IoT) terminals connect to industrial control, sensing, and edge systems, it is necessary to balance low-overhead authentication, credential privacy protection, and cross-platform deployment. Traditional password and USBKEY authentication methods rely on static credentials and certificate mechanisms, which are vulnerable to eavesdropping, replay, and forgery attacks, while simultaneously suffering from privacy leakage and high platform adaptation costs. To address these issues, this paper proposes a hardware-assisted zero-knowledge authentication scheme for resource-constrained terminals. It utilizes a USBKEY as the local trusted hardware carrier and introduces a quadratic constrained zero-knowledge proof protocol under the Generalized Subspace Vector Oblivious Linear Evaluation framework (GSVOLE-2DLC) to construct a session-bound dynamic authentication process. In the registration phase, the scheme binds protocol parameters with user credentials and writes them into the USBKEY. In the authentication phase, the server (acting as the verifier ((V))) generates a random challenge, and the USBKEY (acting as the prover ((P))) generates temporary proof parameters based on local witness information. Subsequently, the verifier ((V)) completes the verification through constraint consistency and GSVOLE consistency, thereby avoiding the transmission of original identity credentials over the network. To adapt to terminals with varying computational capabilities, this paper further designs configurable finite field parameters and cross-platform modular arithmetic interfaces, which are implemented in a PowerPC-architecture USBKEY prototype and a host-side verification environment. Experimental results demonstrate that under the parameter configuration of a 64-bit prime field, ((n_C=4)), ((k_C=3)), ((d_C=3)), ((ell=2)), and ((t=7)), the total system authentication time is approximately 0.5476 s, and the verification time for the verifier ((V)) is 0.0031 s. Protocol performance and functional tests indicate that the proposed scheme can correctly execute identity authentication under the assumed threat model, making it suitable for IoT edge scenarios requiring privacy protection and lightweight authentication.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文针对资源受限物联网终端在工业控制、感知和边缘系统接入中的低开销认证、凭据隐私和跨平台部署需求，提出一种硬件辅助零知识认证方案。方案以 USBKEY 作为本地可信硬件载体，并在 GSVOLE-2DLC 框架下引入二次约束零知识证明协议，实现与会话绑定的动态认证。其设计旨在克服传统口令和证书式 USBKEY 认证易受窃听、重放、伪造攻击以及隐私泄露和适配成本高等问题。

articles.title: β2 integrin-induced neutrophil activation mediates trichloroethylene-sensitized mice kidney injury: an in vivo study
articles.title_zh: β2 整合素诱导的中性粒细胞活化介导三氯乙烯致敏小鼠肾损伤：一项体内研究
articles.abstract: Background Trichloroethylene (TCE) is widely used in the cleaning of metal surfaces and in organic synthesis. Occupational exposure to TCE in environmental contexts has been linked to the onset of occupational medicamentosa-like dermatitis due to trichloroethylene (OMDT). However, the precise mechanism by which activated vascular endothelial cells contribute to TCE-induced renal damage remains inadequately understood.Methods and Results TCE-sensitized mouse model was developed, and both β2 integrin-neutralizing antibody and the peptidylarginine deiminase 4 (PAD4) inhibitor GSK484 hydrochloride were utilized to elucidate the relationship between neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) and renal injury and to ascertain whether the release of NETs is mediated by β2 integrin. Our study demonstrates that the expression levels of neutrophil extracellular trap (NET) marker proteins, such as myeloperoxidase (MPO), PAD4, and neutrophil elastase (NE), were significantly elevated in the kidneys of TCE-sensitized mice, which exhibited pronounced renal damage. Importantly, the inhibition of PAD4 led to a substantial reduction in renal injury. Additionally, β2 integrin expression was notably upregulated in TCE-sensitized mice. Neutralizing β2 integrin in peripheral blood effectively inhibited NET release in these mice.Conclusions These findings suggest that the formation of the neutrophil extracellular trap network in the kidneys of TCE-sensitized mice is mediated by β2 integrin, which plays a pivotal role in the renal damage associated with TCE sensitization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用三氯乙烯致敏小鼠模型，探讨β2整合素介导的中性粒细胞活化及中性粒细胞胞外诱捕网（NETs）释放在肾损伤中的作用。结果显示，致敏小鼠肾脏中 MPO、PAD4 和 NE 等 NETs 标志蛋白显著升高，并伴随明显肾损害；抑制 PAD4 可显著减轻肾损伤。研究还提示β2整合素表达上调可能促进 NETs 形成，从而参与三氯乙烯相关肾毒性过程。

articles.title: The Release Behavior of Natural Turfgrass Used in the National Football League Across a Range of Vertical Loads
articles.title_zh: 美国国家橄榄球联盟所用天然草坪在不同垂直载荷下的释放行为
articles.abstract: This study characterizes the release traction mechanics and force-displacement behavior of a natural turfgrass surface used in the NFL. Four boundary conditions were applied using a previously described 6-degree-of-freedom (DOF) robotic test system. The natural turf surface showed a high level of variability in response; vertical preload force varied by ~ 850 N on average. Peak shear vs. vertical load behavior for this natural grass surface did not follow a linear trend as has been seen in testing on artificial turfs and in previous testing of natural grass at low vertical loads. No matter the test initial depth, ramp type or test type, shear forces greater than 2554 N were unable to be generated in the natural grass surface. This study identified fundamental response differences between natural turfgrass and synthetic surfaces at loading magnitudes and rates applicable to elite football player performance and potentially injurious overload situations. The findings can help elucidate and potentially reduce surface-related inconsistencies in player performance perception and injury rates.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用六自由度机器人测试系统表征 NFL 使用的天然草坪表面的释放牵引力学和力—位移行为。结果显示，天然草坪响应具有较高变异性，峰值剪切力与垂直载荷之间并未呈现人工草坪测试中常见的线性关系，且在多种测试条件下均难以产生超过2554 N的剪切力。研究揭示了天然草坪与合成草坪在精英橄榄球运动员表现和潜在损伤载荷条件下的基础响应差异，可为理解和降低场地相关表现差异与伤害风险提供依据。

articles.title: Active Learning-Driven Surrogate Modeling for Fatigue LifePrediction of LPBF Hastelloy-X Using Defect-Informed FiniteElement Analysis
articles.title_zh: 基于主动学习的替代模型用于 LPBF Hastelloy-X 疲劳寿命预测：结合缺陷信息的有限元分析
articles.abstract: Additively manufactured Hastelloy-X produced by laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) exhibits fatigue behaviour that is highly sensitive to process-induced defects such as surface roughness, subsurface porosity, and build orientation. However, existing life-prediction approaches typically treat these factors independently and require extensive experimental datasets. In this work, a hybrid defect-informed framework is developed that integrates finite element analysis (FEA) with Gaussian process (GP) active learning to predict strain-controlled fatigue life across a wide design space encompassing multiple strain amplitudes, temperatures, build orientations, and realistic defect conditions. A unified defect-sensitive strain–life (UDSL) model is proposed and calibrated using only 19 data points, achieving high predictive accuracy (𝑅² = 0.984, RMSE = 0.131 in log10(𝑁𝑓)) and 97.7% within-factor-of-two life prediction on a 440-point dataset, outperforming conventional strain–life models. Defect-informed FEA reveals a hierarchy of stress concentration factors and demonstrates that the interaction between surface roughness and porosity is sub-additive, captured by a generalised formulation calibrated to numerical results. Porous plasticity simulations further show significant void growth under loading, highlighting the evolving role of defects in fatigue processes. A GP surrogate trained on physics-informed features, including FEA-derived quantities and temperature interactions, is combined with an uncertainty-driven active learning strategy that achieves equivalent accuracy with only 20 training points, representing an approximately 2.5× improvement in data efficiency compared with random sampling. The model provides well-calibrated uncertainty estimates and demonstrates robust extrapolation capability across build orientations. Overall, the proposed framework reduces the experimental burden by more than 95% while maintaining high predictive fidelity. The integration of physics-based modelling, high-fidelity simulation, and data-efficient learning provides a practical and scalableapproach for fatigue life prediction and qualification of LPBF components in high-temperature applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种结合缺陷信息的混合框架，将有限元分析与高斯过程主动学习相结合，用于预测激光粉末床熔融 Hastelloy-X 在不同应变幅、温度、成形方向和缺陷条件下的应变控制疲劳寿命。作者提出统一的缺陷敏感应变—寿命模型，仅用19个数据点校准即取得较高预测精度，并在440点数据集上优于传统模型。缺陷信息有限元分析揭示了不同缺陷引起的应力集中层级，并表明表面粗糙度与孔隙率的相互作用呈次加和特征。

articles.title: Revised direct radiative forcing of airborne microplastics suggests warming
articles.title_zh: 修订后的空气中微塑料直接辐射强迫估计表明其具有增暖效应
articles.abstract: Microplastics are a common airborne pollutant, capable of being transported over large distances and with potential to alter the radiative properties of the atmosphere in large enough quantities, with implications for global climate. Since the first estimates of microplastic radiative forcing were published in 2021, new constraints on many aspects of the spatial and temporal distribution of airborne plastics and their physical and optical properties have emerged. Using these updated findings concerning the size distribution of airborne microplastics, new spectral absorption data for coloured plastics, and a new microplastic emissions dataset, we investigate the sensitivity of the direct radiative effect of airborne microplastics. We find clear-sky effective radiative forcings ranging from -3.28 to +46.7 mW m-2 depending on assumptions concerning colour, size distribution, vertical profile and spatial distribution. Assuming likely real-world conditions --- a mix of coloured microplastics, a power law size distribution, and distributing microplastics non-uniformly through the troposphere based on a new emissions dataset --- we calculate an updated estimate of +42.1±4.62 mW m-2 for a global-average surface concentration of 3.99 microplastics m-3. This revised radiative forcing is at least as large in forcing magnitude as the contributions of a number of other species routinely evaluated by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change. Our findings suggest that microplastics are likely contributing to atmospheric warming, and given that plastic pollution is projected to increase, should be included in climate change projections.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究基于近年来关于空气中微塑料粒径分布、彩色塑料光谱吸收特性和排放数据的新约束，重新评估了微塑料对大气直接辐射效应的影响。结果表明，在不同颜色、粒径分布、垂直廓线和空间分布假设下，晴空有效辐射强迫范围可从负值到显著正值变化。按较可能的现实条件估算，空气中微塑料产生约 +42.1±4.62 mW m-2 的直接辐射强迫，提示其总体可能具有增暖效应。

articles.title: Global Electric Field Generated by Earth’s Rotation in the Axisymmetric Geomagnetic Field: “Geophysical Batteries” in Chukchi and Seward Peninsulas
articles.title_zh: 地球在轴对称地磁场中自转产生的全球电场：楚科奇和苏厄德半岛的“地球物理电池”
articles.abstract: The generation of global electric field associated with Earth’s rotation in the axisymmetric (m=0) component of the geomagnetic field is considered. Because this component is independent of longitude and invariant under rotation about Earth’s axis, the induction depends only on the relative motion between the conductor and the magnetic field. For induction problem, this component may therefore be treated as stationary in an inertial frame, with the Earth rotating through it. First, two idealized cases of motional induction are examined: an unbounded ocean of uniform conductivity and an ocean containing an east–west-oriented land belt in the Northern Hemisphere. In the uniform ocean, the motional term V x B is fully balanced by the induced electrostatic field, resulting in zero currents. In the second case, continuity of the normal component of current at the ocean–land boundary causes the electric field within land to exceed that in the ocean by a factor of εₒcean/εₗₐₙd with finite steady currents. The governing equation for electric potential in the spherical thin-shell approximation is solved for the real ocean–land configuration. The solution shows that land geometry and conductivity contrasts strongly control the spatial structure of the electric field. Maximum field intensities occur near the Bering Strait, where the Chukchi and Seward peninsulas form compact regions of charge accumulation. These regions may be interpreted as natural batteries. Estimated electromotive forces are 1,000-10,000 V, while terminal voltages accounting for internal resistance are 10 -100 V . Similar regions of enhanced electric field are expected to occur widely across the Northern Hemisphere.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论地球在轴对称地磁场分量中自转所引起的全球电场生成问题，并将该磁场分量视为惯性系中静止、地球相对其运动的感生问题。作者先分析均匀无限海洋和含东西向陆地带海洋的理想情形，指出均匀海洋中运动项可被静电场平衡而无电流，而陆海边界会因电流连续性导致陆地电场增强并产生稳态电流。进一步采用球面薄壳近似求解真实海陆构型下的电势，表明陆地几何与电导率分布会显著影响感生电场和电流格局。

articles.title: Physics-constrained identification of equivalent interfacial friction coefficients and load-transfer behavior in a wedge-loading planetary traction drive
articles.title_zh: 楔加载行星牵引传动中等效界面摩擦系数与载荷传递行为的物理约束识别
articles.abstract: In wedge-loading planetary traction drives, torque is transmitted through multiple rolling contacts, while the interfacial friction coefficients and contact participation states are difficult to measure directly. This study proposes a physics-constrained inversion framework to identify equivalent interfacial friction coefficients and load-transfer behavior in a high-speed wedge-loading planetary traction drive. A quasi-static mechanical model is established to describe the coupling among normal load, tangential traction force, contact participation, and input–output torque equilibrium. Finite-element analysis is used to verify contact-load distribution and compensate for configuration variations of the loading mechanism, generating 720 physics-enhanced theoretical samples. A physics-informed neural network is then trained with friction-coefficient supervision, mechanical equilibrium residuals, and contact-state regularization. The model identifies the equivalent friction coefficients of five traction interfaces and infers the participation states of two adaptive loading branches. Analytical and finite-element normal loads agree within 2%, and the maximum relative error of the compensated loading-roller center distance is 7.99%. Compared with a baseline ANN, the proposed model reduces post-processed efficiency RMSE by 52.86%, 64.27%, and 63.06% at 500, 3000, and 6000 rpm, respectively.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种物理约束反演框架，用于识别高速楔加载行星牵引传动中多个滚动接触界面的等效摩擦系数和载荷传递行为。作者建立准静态力学模型描述法向载荷、切向牵引力、接触参与状态以及输入输出转矩平衡之间的耦合，并用有限元分析验证接触载荷分布、补偿加载机构构型变化。随后训练物理信息神经网络，结合摩擦系数监督、力学平衡残差和接触状态正则化，实现对五个牵引界面摩擦系数及两个自适应加载分支参与状态的识别。

articles.title: Unusual Behavior of the Ni1+ moment and interstitial band in bi-infinite-layered La3Ni2O5F
articles.title_zh: 双无限层 La3Ni2O5F 中 Ni1+ 磁矩与间隙能带的异常行为
articles.abstract: The discovery of superconductivity in hole-doped Ni1+ systems with "infinite layer" NiO2 square-lattices analogous to the Cu2+ CaCuO2 cuprate has renewed conflicting pictures of the Cu2+-Ni1+ similarity or distinction. Synthesis of Ni1+ La3Ni2O5F with two infinite NiO2 layers per cell provides an I4/mmm structure with equally mixed O and F anions within the blocking La(O,F) layer. Conventional non-magnetic density-functional-theory (DFT) studies, the starting point for materials lacking magnetic order, reveal an electride-like interstitial state that provides electron self-doping that may, among other effects, complicate magnetic behavior. This band is centered at the M point, remarkably linear, its density is highly anisotropic but 's-like' in terms of symmetry, and it is impervious to magnetic order. A metastable ferromagnetic (FM) state appears with negligible energy cost up to 0.75 μB per formula unit with a large exchange splitting, rendering impossible any Ginzburg-Landau expansion in the magnetic order parameter. As opposed to other nickelates where correlation corrections are needed to justify a Ni moment, 3d Hubbard repulsion U leads only to quantitative changes -- conventional DFT treatment of FM and antiferromagnetic order already provides a substantial Mott-like splitting of the dx2-y2 orbitals without U. La3Ni2O5F provides new information for understanding the Ni1+δ formal valence, where the interstitial band plays a role. Fluctuations arising from the extreme two-dimensionality are suggested to require consideration.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究围绕含两个无限 NiO2 层的 Ni1+ 化合物 La3Ni2O5F，探讨其电子结构、磁性和与铜氧化物类比关系。常规非磁性密度泛函理论计算揭示了一条类似电子化物的间隙态能带，可产生电子自掺杂并复杂化磁性行为；该能带位于 M 点附近，近似线性且对磁有序不敏感。研究还发现体系存在能量代价很小的亚稳铁磁态，并表现出较大的交换劈裂，说明其磁性行为难以用常规磁有序参数展开简单描述。

articles.title: Engineering Comparison and Multi-Criteria Selection of Micropropulsion Systems for Small Spacecraft
articles.title_zh: 小型航天器微推进系统的工程比较与多准则选择
articles.abstract: Micropropulsion has become a   mission-enabling subsystem for CubeSats and other small spacecraft because it   supports orbit maintenance, attitude control, collision avoidance, drag   compensation, formation flying, and controlled disposal. The modern design   problem is no longer whether propulsion should be used, but which micropropulsion   architecture is most suitable under severe constraints in mass, volume,   power, total impulse, safety, and mission duration. This paper reviews the   recent 2020-2026 micropropulsion literature and reorganizes it into an   engineering comparison framework covering cold-gas, chemical, and electric   propulsion systems, with electric propulsion further divided into   electrothermal, electrostatic, and electromagnetic types. A key argument of   the paper is that propulsion selection should not be based on a single metric   such as specific impulse. Instead, preliminary selection should be approached   as a multi-criteria engineering decision problem. To address that problem,   the paper introduces a universal weighting method based on a hybrid Analytic   Hierarchy Process (AHP), entropy weighting, and TOPSIS ranking framework. The   review shows that electric systems generally dominate missions requiring high   propellant efficiency or high-precision control, while cold-gas,   electrothermal, water-resistojet, and monopropellant systems remain   attractive when simplicity, faster response, safer handling, or stronger   thrust are more important. The paper concludes with a comparative engineering   analysis and proposes a structured decision framework for mission-specific   micropropulsion selection.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述面向 CubeSat 和其他小型航天器任务需求，比较冷气、化学和电推进等微推进架构，并将电推进进一步划分为电热、电静和电磁类型。作者强调，微推进系统选择不应仅依据比冲等单一指标，而应在质量、体积、功率、总冲量、安全性和任务周期等约束下进行多准则工程决策。论文提出结合层次分析法、熵权法和 TOPSIS 排序的通用加权选择框架，用于支持2020—2026年相关微推进技术的初步筛选与比较。

articles.title: Applications of Artificial Intelligence in Civil Engineering: Multimodal Data Fusion and Uncertainty Quantification
articles.title_zh: 人工智能在土木工程中的应用：多模态数据融合与不确定性量化
articles.abstract: With the increasing reliance of civil engineering on sensor networks, UAV imagery, LiDAR scanning, and ground-penetrating radar, the challenge of effectively integrating heterogeneous multimodal data and quantifying the uncertainties arising from noise, model errors, and environmental variations has become more critical. This paper reviews recent applications of artificial intelligence (AI) for multimodal data fusion in civil engineering and proposes a deep learning–physics coupling framework that integrates heterogeneous sources. An uncertainty quantification (UQ) module is embedded in the fusion pipeline using Bayesian approximation, Monte Carlo sampling, and hybrid modal uncertainty propagation mechanisms to evaluate the reliability of the fused results. A bridge structural health monitoring case demonstrates the proposed method’s capability to integrate acceleration, inclination, and UAV image data while producing interpretable uncertainty bounds. Results show that, compared with single-modality approaches, the proposed method improves detection accuracy by approximately 12% and provides quantifiable confidence intervals, thereby supporting more reliable engineering decision-making. Finally, the paper discusses potential applications of the framework in construction quality control, tunnel hazard warning, and digital twin systems, while outlining challenges in real-time operation, missing modality handling, and large-scale deployment.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着土木工程日益依赖传感器网络、无人机影像、激光雷达扫描和探地雷达，异构多模态数据融合及噪声、模型误差和环境变化导致的不确定性量化变得尤为关键。该文综述了人工智能在土木工程多模态数据融合中的最新应用，并提出一种深度学习—物理耦合框架，将贝叶斯近似、蒙特卡罗采样和混合模态不确定性传播嵌入融合流程。桥梁结构健康监测案例表明，该方法可融合加速度、倾角和无人机图像数据，并给出可解释的不确定性边界；相较单模态方法，检测精度约提升12%，并能提供可量化置信区间以支持工程决策。

articles.title: The integer quantum Hall transition: an S-matrix approach to random networks
articles.title_zh: 整数量子霍尔转变：随机网络的 S 矩阵方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2407.04132v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this paper we propose a new S-matrix approach to numerical simulations of network models and apply it to random networks that we proposed in a previous work 10.1103/PhysRevB.95.125414. Random networks are modifications of the Chalker-Coddington (CC) model for the integer quantum Hall transition that more faithfully capture the physics of electrons moving in a strong magnetic field and a smooth disorder potential. The new method has considerable advantages compared to the transfer matrix approach, and gives the value ν approx 2.4 for the critical exponent of the localization length in a random network. This finding confirms our previous result and is surprisingly close to the experimental value νₑₓₚ approx 2.38 observed at the integer quantum Hall transition but substantially different from the CC value ν_CC approx 2.6.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种用于网络模型数值模拟的新型 S 矩阵方法，并将其应用于作者此前提出的整数量子霍尔转变随机网络模型。随机网络是 Chalker-Coddington 模型的改进形式，更能反映强磁场与平滑无序势中电子运动的物理图像。相较转移矩阵方法，新方法具有明显优势，并给出随机网络中局域化长度临界指数约为ν≈2.4，接近实验值νₑₓₚ≈2.38，但显著不同于 CC 模型值ν_CC≈2.6。
authors: Hrant Topchyan, Ilya Gruzberg, Win Nuding, Andreas Klümper, Ara Sedrakyan

articles.title: Inferring measure synchronization in coupled bosonic Josephson junctions with reservoir computing
articles.title_zh: 利用储备池计算推断耦合玻色约瑟夫森结中的测度同步
articles.abstract: Whereas model-free, data-driven inference of chaos in dissipative systems has been extensively studied, little attention has been paid to the inference of chaos in conservative systems. Here, leveraging the technique of parameter-aware reservoir computing (RC) in machine learning, we present a model-free approach to the inference of measure synchronization (MS) in coupled bosonic Josephson junctions. We demonstrate that, using time series of several system states generated at different coupling strengths, a machine can be trained which, guided by the coupling coefficient, is able to infer not only the critical couplings at which MS emerges, but also the variation of the system order parameters during the transition from desynchronization to synchronization. The results highlight the potential of the parameter-aware RC technique in inferring the dynamics of high-dimensional Hamiltonian systems, and lay the groundwork for model-free analysis of the collective dynamics of quantum many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对保守系统中混沌与同步行为的数据驱动推断问题，提出一种基于参数感知储备池计算的无模型方法，用于识别耦合玻色约瑟夫森结中的测度同步。作者利用不同耦合强度下生成的多个系统状态时间序列训练机器，使其在耦合系数引导下推断测度同步出现的临界耦合，并预测系统序参量在去同步到同步转变过程中的变化。结果表明，参数感知储备池计算有望用于高维哈密顿系统动力学推断，并为量子多体系统集体动力学的无模型分析奠定基础。
authors: Han Zhang, Huawei Fan, Haibo Qiu, Jianlong Qiu, Xiangyong Chen, Qingguo Xiao and Xingang Wang

articles.title: Magnetic Bloch Oscillations in Odd-Wave Magnets and the Nonlinear Edelstein Effect
articles.title_zh: 奇波磁体中的磁性布洛赫振荡与非线性埃德尔斯坦效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30732v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bloch oscillations (BOs) are a quantum phenomenon in which electrons subjected to an electric field in a periodic potential exhibit an oscillating current without a net drift. In real conductors, scattering reduces the coherence required for BOs driving the system toward a steady state with a DC current. While previous studies have focused on charge transport, charge carriers also possess spin, raising the question of whether BOs can emerge in magnetic observables. Here, we show that the magnetization of odd-wave magnets can undergo BOs before relaxing to the steady-state Edelstein value, a phenomenon we term magnetic BOs. Using analytical and numerical methods, we demonstrate this effect in a minimal one-dimensional model of a p-wave magnet and generalize it to two dimensions. Our analysis further reveals that the Edelstein magnetization is generically nonlinear in the applied electric field. Finally, we argue that magnetic BOs can be detected in materials through higher-harmonic generation in THz sub-cycle lightwave spectroscopy. Magnetic BOs provide a genuine non-equilibrium signature of spin-charge coupling in unconventional magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究电场作用下奇波磁体中磁化强度的非平衡动力学，提出“磁性布洛赫振荡”概念：磁化强度可在弛豫到稳态埃德尔斯坦值之前发生布洛赫振荡。作者通过解析与数值方法在一维 p 波磁体最小模型中展示该效应，并推广至二维情形。研究还表明埃德尔斯坦磁化通常对外加电场呈非线性响应，并提出可通过太赫兹亚周期光波谱中的高次谐波产生进行实验探测。

articles.title: Athermality of generalized Gibbs ensembles
articles.title_zh: 广义吉布斯系综的非热性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30762v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Integrable quantum systems evolving from non-equilibrium initial states do not thermalize to conventional Gibbs ensembles (GE). Instead, at long times they relax to generalized Gibbs ensembles (GGEs), which incorporate the full set of local and quasi-local conserved quantities. While GGEs have been extensively studied in the literature, a quantitative characterization of how different they are from ordinary GEs is still lacking. In this work, we address this question by employing the concept of athermality, which we define within quantum resource theory as the relative entropy between a given state and the closest thermal state. We compute the athermality for several quantum quenches in paradigmatic integrable models, including the free XY spin chain, the interacting Lieb-Liniger model, the XXZ spin chain, and the harmonic chain. We find that often the athermality becomes anomalously small when the post-quench Hamiltonian is critical in its ground state, despite probing physics at a finite energy density. We also prove that it systematically develops a singularity at criticality, which is inherited from the entropy of the GGE.
articles.abstract_zh: 可积量子系统从非平衡初态演化后通常不会热化到普通吉布斯系综，而会弛豫到包含全套局域和准局域守恒量的广义吉布斯系综。该文借助量子资源理论中的非热性概念，将其定义为给定状态与最近热态之间的相对熵，并据此定量刻画广义吉布斯系综与普通热系综的差异。作者在自由 XY 自旋链、相互作用 Lieb-Liniger 模型、XXZ 自旋链和谐振子链等典型可积模型的量子淬火中计算非热性，发现当淬火后哈密顿量基态处于临界点时，有限能量密度下非热性常异常变小，并证明其在临界处会系统地产生源自广义吉布斯系综熵的奇异性。
authors: Riccardo Senese, Bruno Bertini, Katja Klobas, Pasquale Calabrese

articles.title: Unconventional superconductivity in AV₂X₂O family of surface altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 表面交替磁体 AV₂X₂O 家族中的非常规超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30766v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by the recent discovery of superconductivity at 16.3 K in layered oxychalcogenide Na₂₋ₓV₂Se₂O we investigate pairing instabilities in the broader family of layered materials composed of V₂O planes, believed to exhibit altermagnetic order in their monolayer form. Even though the bulk family members KV₂Se₂O and Rb₁₋δV₂Te₂O are likely conventional antiferromagnets that show only surface altermagnetism, our analysis predicts exotic equal-spin triplet superconductivity as the dominant pairing instability in these materials. This is a consequence of their unique magnetic and sublattice structure that renders electron bands incompatible with conventional spin-singlet pairing. The predicted triplet superconducting phases are topologically non-trivial and capable of supporting spin-polarized persistent currents, properties potentially useful in technological applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 受层状氧硫族化物 Na₂₋ₓV₂Se₂O 中发现16.3 K超导性的启发，该文研究由 V₂O 平面构成的更广泛层状材料家族中的配对不稳定性，这些材料的单层形式被认为具有交替磁序。尽管 KV₂Se₂O 和 Rb₁₋δV₂Te₂O 等体相成员可能是常规反铁磁体且仅表现出表面交替磁性，分析仍预言等自旋三重态超导是这些材料中的主导配对不稳定性。该结果源于其独特磁性与子晶格结构使电子能带不适合常规自旋单态配对；预言的三重态超导相具有非平庸拓扑性质，并可能支持自旋极化持久电流。

articles.title: Critically Enhanced Magnon Transport in Low-dimensional Magnets
articles.title_zh: 低维磁体中临界增强的磁振子输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30784v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transport properties of (quasi)particles in condensed matter depend profoundly on the spatial dimension. Motivated by recent advances in growing ultrathin magnetic films and monolayer van der Waals magnets, we present a theory of magnon transport in magnetic films spanning the crossover from bulk to the two-dimensional (2D) limit. We find a magnon conductivity that diverges~emphlogarithmically in magnetically soft but stable (quasi)2D magnets with long-range dipolar interactions. This critical enhancement is absent in bulk systems and may explain the unusually large magnon conductivities recently observed in ultrathin yttrium iron garnet films. Our results reveal an intrinsic mechanism for enhanced magnon transport in low dimensions and highlight the potential for engineering high-efficiency magnon conductors in atomically thin magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一套描述从体相到二维极限跨越过程中磁性薄膜磁振子输运的理论，背景是超薄磁性薄膜和单层范德华磁体制备技术的进展。研究发现，在具有长程偶极相互作用且磁性柔软但稳定的准二维磁体中，磁振子电导率会出现对数发散式的临界增强。该增强机制在体相系统中不存在，可能解释近期在超薄钇铁石榴石薄膜中观测到的异常大磁振子电导，并提示可通过低维工程设计高效磁振子导体。

articles.title: Experimental Realization of Synthetic Magnonic Lattice via Floquet Engineering
articles.title_zh: 通过 Floquet 工程实验实现合成磁振子晶格
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30845v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnonic systems, which exploit spin-wave excitations in magnetic materials, offer a promising platform for coherent information processing due to their low dissipation, strong nonlinearities, and intrinsic nonreciprocity. However, scaling magnonic circuits remains challenging, particularly with low-loss insulators such as yttrium iron garnet (YIG), which are difficult to pattern. Here, we experimentally realize a synthetic dimension in a magnonic system by coupling multimode magnon resonances in the frequency domain using time-periodic Floquet modulation. This approach enables electronically tunable interactions between discrete modes within a single YIG device, forming a reconfigurable mode-space lattice that supports functionalities such as Bloch oscillation. Our results demonstrate that high-dimensional magnonic dynamics can be achieved without increasing device footprint, establishing synthetic dimensions as a scalable and programmable route for integrated magnonic technologies. This advancement positions magnonic systems as promising platforms for engineering emergent phenomena that are inaccessible at equilibrium.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在磁振子系统中利用时间周期 Floquet 调制，在频域耦合多模磁振子共振，从而实验实现合成维度。该方法在单个钇铁石榴石器件中形成可电子调谐的离散模式相互作用与可重构模式空间晶格，并支持布洛赫振荡等功能。结果表明，无需增加器件占用面积即可实现高维磁振子动力学，为可扩展、可编程的集成磁振子技术提供了合成维度路径。
authors: Amin Pishehvar, Jayakrishnan M. P. Nair, Zhaoyou Wang, Zixin Yan, Yu Jiang, Liang Jiang, Benedetta Flebus, Xufeng Zhang

articles.title: Atomic-Scale Characterization of Oxide Interfaces and Superlattices Using Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy
articles.title_zh: 利用扫描透射电子显微镜对氧化物界面和超晶格进行原子尺度表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30859v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) is a cornerstone of our understanding of oxide interfaces and superlattices. No other technique provides the same level of insight into structure, chemistry, composition, and dynamics across as wide a variety of material systems. STEM imaging and diffraction, coupled with electron energy loss (EELS) and energy-dispersive X-ray (EDS) spectroscopies, offer unparalleled, high-resolution analysis of structure--property relationships. In this chapter we highlight investigations into key phenomena, including interfacial conductivity in oxide superlattices, charge screening effects in magnetoelectric heterostructures, interface engineering in iron oxides, and the complex physics governing atomic-scale chemical mapping. We also discuss emerging plasma preparation techniques and artificial intelligence-guided approaches to both ex situ and in situ microscopy. These studies illustrate how unique insights from STEM characterization can be integrated with other techniques and theory calculations to develop more predictive models for the behavior of functional oxides.
articles.abstract_zh: 该章节综述扫描透射电子显微镜在理解氧化物界面和超晶格结构、化学组成、成分分布及动态行为方面的核心作用。结合 STEM 成像、衍射、电子能量损失谱和能量色散 X 射线谱，可高分辨率解析结构—性能关系。文中重点讨论氧化物超晶格界面导电性、磁电异质结构中的电荷屏蔽、铁氧化物界面工程和原子尺度化学成像等问题，并介绍等离子体制样和人工智能引导的原位/非原位显微分析等新兴方向。

articles.title: Adaptive fine-tuning of foundation models for crystal structure prediction: Discovery of high-pressure phases in the CaFeNi system
articles.title_zh: 用于晶体结构预测的基础模型自适应微调：CaFeNi 体系高压相的发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30870v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The prediction of crystal structures is a key challenge in chemistry and materials science, but evolutionary crystal structure prediction (CSP) remains computationally expensive because it relies on repeated ab initio relaxations and energy ranking.
