To enable efficient integration of EVs while minimizing costs for users and avoiding network overloads, implicit coordination between EVs is required. This work compares two independent multi-agent reinforcement learning approaches for optimizing such decentralized EV charging: contextual combinatorial bandits and policy gradient algorithms. Using a realistic simulation environment with autonomous agents making decisions based on local environmental information (including price signals, state-of-charge, and temporal constraints), we evaluate their performance across varying congestion levels, and mixed-strategy configurations with heterogeneous agent groups under dynamic electricity pricing derived from real photovoltaic production data.
articles.abstract_zh: 电动汽车普及给电网管理带来峰值需求上升、电压波动、线路过载以及可再生能源并网等挑战，因此需要车辆之间的隐式协调以降低用户成本并避免网络拥塞。本文比较了两类用于分散式电动汽车充电优化的独立多智能体强化学习方法：上下文组合老虎机和策略梯度算法。研究在现实仿真环境中评估自主代理基于本地信息进行决策的表现，包括电价信号、电池荷电状态和时间约束，并考察不同拥塞水平、异质代理混合策略以及基于真实光伏发电数据的动态电价情形。
authors: Xavier Rate, Eloann Le Guern, Raphaël Féraud, Fatma Salem, Melissa Chiknoun, Eymeric Giabicani, Mehdi Feki, Patrick Maillé, Guy Camilleri, Anne Blavette, Hamid Benhamed

articles.title: Xiaomi-GUI-0 Technical Report
articles.title_zh: Xiaomi-GUI-0 技术报告
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31410v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents build on vision-language models to complete user tasks end-to-end in real applications through interface actions such as tapping, swiping, text entry, and navigation. However, existing GUI agents are trained and evaluated largely on offline trajectories, simulated environments, and standardized benchmarks. These differ substantially from real applications in interface layout, interaction logic, and abnormal-state distribution, and cannot faithfully characterize execution stability in real-world use, where account states, permission dialogs, payment authentication, and risk control continually reshape the state distribution and open a persistent gap between benchmark scores and real usability. To close this gap, we propose Xiaomi-GUI-0, a native multimodal GUI agent for real mobile environments, trained and evaluated within a real-device closed loop. At its core is a real-device-dominant hybrid infrastructure, where physical devices are the primary execution environment and sandboxes provide auxiliary support, so that data collection, training, rollout, and evaluation share an execution distribution close to real deployment. We construct multi-source training data spanning high-frequency head tasks, high-generalization data for long-tail intents, and capability-enhancement data for reflection and memory, and introduce an error-driven data flywheel that turns failure trajectories into corrected actions, reflective explanations, and recovery demonstrations. The model is trained through a progressive three-stage pipeline of supervised fine-tuning, step-level reinforcement learning, and agentic reinforcement learning. Evaluated on public benchmarks and our in-house RealMobile, Xiaomi-GUI-0 achieves 72.0% success on RealMobile and 78.9% on AndroidWorld, while substantially improving execution stability and abnormal-state recognition in real-world tasks.
articles.abstract_zh: 图形用户界面智能体依托视觉语言模型，通过点击、滑动、输入和导航等操作在真实应用中完成用户任务，但现有训练与评估多基于离线轨迹、模拟环境和标准基准，难以反映真实设备中的执行稳定性。本文提出 Xiaomi-GUI-0，一个面向真实移动环境的原生多模态 GUI 智能体，并在真实设备闭环中进行训练和评估。其核心是以物理设备为主、沙箱为辅的混合基础设施，使数据采集、训练、回放和评估共享更接近真实使用的执行分布。
authors: Wanxia Cao, Chengzhen Duan, Pei Fu, Pengzhi Gao, Niu Lian, Fazhan Liu, Hui Liu, Heng Qu, Qinzhuo Wu, Zhehao Yu, Tongbo Chen, Shiqi Cui, Anan Du, Shukai Jia, Yuanfa Li, Yike Liu, Wenchao Lu, Haoyuan Sun, Jiatong Sun, Cheng Tan, Yajie Wang, Changqiao Wu, Tao Xiong, Jiahui Yang, Yuxuan Yuan, Ruoceng Zhang, Shaojie Zhang, Jian Zhu, Jian Luan, Cong Zou

articles.title: Creating Intelligence: A Computational Foundation for AGI
articles.title_zh: 创造智能：通用人工智能的计算基础
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31819v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work introduces a new computational theory of mind grounded in set theory and hyperdimensional computing. Whereas traditional neural networks rely on continuous weights and matrix multiplication, this framework works with sparse binary data. It represents information as discrete sets, directly modeling biological neural population codes. I demonstrate that associative memory emerges naturally from network topologies featuring a combinatorially expanded hidden layer. Learning is driven by topological plasticity rather than scalar weight adjustments. This architecture unifies auto-associative and hetero-associative learning under a single core algorithm: information retrieval via subset pattern matching and exact nearest-neighbor search. Operating with constant-time complexity, these mechanisms bridge perceptual data (sparse distributed representations) and symbols (sparse holographic representations) without continuous bottlenecks. Mapping this framework to neuroanatomy, I propose that both the cerebellum and the neocortex implement variants of this algorithm, making subset pattern matching the fundamental engine of cognition. Because it relies on discrete logic rather than matrix arithmetic, this algorithm translates directly into in-memory hardware. This opens a new route toward synthetic intelligence with human-level energy efficiency.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于集合论和超维计算的新型心智计算理论，与依赖连续权重和矩阵乘法的传统神经网络不同，该框架使用稀疏二进制数据，将信息表示为离散集合，以对应生物神经群体编码。作者认为，具有组合扩展隐藏层的网络拓扑可自然产生联想记忆，学习由拓扑可塑性而非标量权重调整驱动。该架构通过子集模式匹配和精确最近邻搜索统一自联想与异联想学习，并被作者进一步映射到小脑和新皮层的可能计算机制。

articles.title: Position: Vision-Language-Action Models Cannot Be Verified to Perform Physical Reasoning
articles.title_zh: 立场：无法验证视觉-语言-动作模型具备物理推理能力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30686v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems, built on pretrained vision-language models (VLMs), have shown rapidly improving performance on robot manipulation benchmarks. These gains are commonly interpreted as evidence that semantic representations learned from internet-scale data transfer to physical execution generalization. This position paper argues that the assumption underlying this interpretation -- that semantic generalization is sufficient to support physical action decisions -- has not been independently verified and cannot be tested under current evaluation protocols. We support this claim by decomposing VLA policies into semantic mapping and physical action decision, and showing that task success rate -- the dominant evaluation metric -- cannot distinguish between these two sources of capability. As a result, improvements in benchmark performance are consistent with multiple competing explanations, including semantic matching, distributional overlap, and genuine physical generalization. We further argue that this identifiability gap has been reinforced through narrative drift, whereby successive systems inherit and strengthen prior interpretations of performance gains without isolating the underlying causal mechanism. To address this limitation, we propose a research direction based on evaluation designs that introduce controlled variation to separately measure semantic and physical generalization. Such designs make it possible to causally attribute performance without requiring access to model internals, and to empirically assess the role of VLM backbones as semantic interfaces rather than implicit sources of physical competence. Our goal is not to refute the role of VLMs in robotics, but to clarify the conditions under which claims of physical generalization can be meaningfully evaluated.
articles.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）系统在机器人操作基准上表现快速提升，常被解读为互联网规模语义表征能够迁移到物理执行泛化。本文作为立场论文指出，这一解释所依赖的假设——语义泛化足以支撑物理动作决策——尚未被独立验证，且在当前评估协议下难以检验。作者将 VLA 策略分解为语义映射和物理动作决策，并认为主流的任务成功率指标无法区分二者贡献，因此基准提升可能来自语义匹配、分布重叠或真正的物理泛化等多种原因。
authors: Taozhao Chen, Ian Manchester, Huaming Chen

articles.title: LUMOS: A Semantic Operating-System Layer for Accessibility-Grounded AI Agents
articles.title_zh: LUMOS：面向可访问性 grounding 的 AI 智能体语义操作系统层
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30697v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Current operating systems expose interfaces optimized for human users but not for AI agents. Humans benefit from pixels, icons, windows, visual grouping, mouse movement, and keyboard shortcuts; AI agents instead need compact semantic state, grounded actions, and reliable feedback. As a result, many computer-use agents are forced to interpret screenshots, OCR output, and visual crops, introducing high token costs, visual ambiguity, latency, and coordinate uncertainty. This paper introduces LUMOS (Language Model Unified Machine-Readable Operating-System Semantics), a semantic interaction layer between AI agents and operating systems. LUMOS converts native accessibility metadata and browser UI structures into machine readable semantic blueprints with stable identifiers, roles, names, values, bounds, and action affordances. It also supports live semantic pointer grounding by querying the UI element under or near the cursor through operating-system automation APIs. An LLM then acts through an accessibility grounded observe act loop using constrained visible-UI primitives rather than application-specific scripts. LUMOS does not claim to replace visual agents; instead, it reduces dependence on screenshots when operating systems already provide semantic structure. These results suggest a path toward AI-native operating systems and machine-readable interaction layers.
articles.abstract_zh: 当前操作系统界面主要面向人类用户设计，而 AI 智能体更需要紧凑的语义状态、可落地的动作和可靠反馈；依赖截图、OCR 和视觉裁剪会带来高 token 成本、视觉歧义、延迟和坐标不确定性。本文提出 LUMOS，即一种位于 AI 智能体与操作系统之间的语义交互层，将原生可访问性元数据和浏览器界面结构转换为机器可读的语义蓝图，包含稳定标识符、角色、名称、值、边界和动作能力。它还支持通过操作系统自动化 API 查询光标附近界面元素，实现实时语义指针定位，并让语言模型基于可访问性 grounding 的观察—行动循环进行操作。

articles.title: An AI-Based Solution for Secure Service Provisioning in IoT
articles.title_zh: 面向物联网安全服务供给的人工智能解决方案
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30701v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As the Internet of Things (IoT) continues its rapid expansion, the attack surface grows accordingly, with emerging threats targeting smart objects and their interactions. In this evolving landscape, securing service provisioning is crucial to ensure the proper functioning, security, and reliability of the IoT ecosystem. Service provisioning encompasses key tasks such as device registration, configuration, authentication, authorization, and software deployment, all of which are essential for seamless and secure IoT operations. In this paper, we present a comprehensive framework designed to select the most suitable smart objects to deliver a target service within a given IoT environment while also monitoring the behavior of the entities involved during the service provisioning phase. To achieve this, we employ a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) approach in which an intelligent agent learns, through interaction with a complex, dynamic environment, how to adapt to changes while adhering to predefined security constraints. For behavioral monitoring, we leverage Federated Learning (FL) to develop a global Behavioral Fingerprinting (BF) model that is fully distributed and can analyze how IoT devices interact within the network. In addition, the BF is used to compute a reliability score for each service provider, reflecting its degree of compliance with the defined security constraints. This score is then incorporated into the service provisioning process, allowing smart objects to select providers not only according to functional suitability but also to their reliability level. Finally, we conduct an extensive experimental evaluation to assess the robustness and scalability of our approach. The results demonstrate that our solution can be effectively deployed even on resource-constrained IoT devices, making it a viable and scalable security-enhancing mechanism for modern IoT ecosystems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对物联网快速扩张带来的攻击面增大问题，提出一个用于安全服务供给的综合框架，涵盖设备选择、注册、配置、认证、授权与软件部署等关键环节。框架利用深度强化学习在动态环境中选择最适合提供目标服务的智能对象，并在满足预设安全约束的同时适应环境变化。作者还引入联邦学习构建全局行为指纹模型，用于监测服务供给阶段相关实体的行为，从而提升物联网生态的安全性与可靠性。
authors: Marco Arazzi, Mert Cihangiroglu, Serena Nicolazzo, Antonino Nocera, Vinod P

articles.title: Stage-Transition Dense Reward Modeling for Reinforcement Learning
articles.title_zh: 用于强化学习的阶段转换密集奖励建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31377v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon robotic manipulation is often limited by sparse and delayed rewards, while manually designing dense shaping signals is costly and brittle to changes in environments and object configurations. This work proposes Stage-Transition Dense Reward (STDR), a visual reward-learning framework that converts unstructured expert videos into logically grounded dense rewards for training RL agents from scratch. STDR leverages semantic understanding to infer a task's stage structure from demonstrations, and delivers two complementary learning signals during online training: (i) stage-transition feedback that provides goal-directed reward, and (ii) within-stage progress feedback that supplies fine-grained guidance toward completing each stage. Furthermore, an out-of-distribution (OOD) detection mechanism and a grasping regulation module are integrated to enhance robustness and prevent reward hacking. Experiments on 14 manipulation tasks across MetaWorld, ManiSkill, and Franka Kitchen show that STDR consistently improves sample efficiency and success rates over multiple baselines, and matches or surpasses handcrafted dense rewards on several challenging tasks. Real-robot evaluations further indicate that STDR assigns stable, progress-aligned rewards on successful executions while producing appropriately low rewards for failures, suggesting robustness to visual noise and better-calibrated reward assignment across settings.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出阶段转换密集奖励（STDR）框架，用于缓解长时程机器人操作任务中稀疏、延迟奖励导致的训练困难。STDR从非结构化专家视频中推断任务阶段结构，并在在线训练中同时提供阶段转换反馈和阶段内进度反馈。框架还结合分布外检测与抓取调控模块以增强鲁棒性并抑制奖励欺骗，在多个机器人操作基准上的实验显示其提升了样本效率和任务成功率。
authors: Yang Yang, Bingjie Chen, Zihan Wang, Yizhe Li, Guoping Pan, Yi Cheng, Houde Liu

articles.title: Mitigating Positional Leakage in 3D Masked Autoencoders for Robust Representation Learning
articles.title_zh: 缓解三维掩码自编码器中的位置泄漏以实现鲁棒表征学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31570v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Masked autoencoding has emerged as a prominent paradigm for self-supervised learning on 3D point clouds, achieving competitive performance across downstream tasks. Unlike its 2D counterpart, 3D masked autoencoding directly reconstructs spatial coordinates, making it inherently susceptible to positional leakage. In this work, we identify that the decoder in existing 3D MAE frameworks tends to over-rely on positional information, which weakens semantic representation learning and leads to suboptimal feature quality. To address this issue, we propose MPL-MAE, a masked point learning framework that mitigates positional over-reliance while enhancing the utilization of encoder features. Specifically, we introduce a recalibrated positional embedding module that suppresses metric-dominant coordinate signals while preserving geometric topology, together with a gated positional interface module that dynamically regulates positional injection during reconstruction. These designs promote a more balanced interaction between spatial priors and semantic features, yielding robust and informative representations. Extensive experiments across downstream tasks demonstrate that MPL-MAE consistently achieves competitive performance, validating its effectiveness. Code is available at https://github.com/yanx57/MPL-MAE.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文指出，三维点云掩码自编码器由于直接重建空间坐标，容易使解码器过度依赖位置信息，从而削弱语义表征学习。作者提出MPL-MAE框架，通过重新校准的位置嵌入模块抑制由坐标度量主导的信号，同时保留几何拓扑信息。其门控位置接口模块可动态调节重建过程中的位置注入，使空间先验与语义特征更均衡地交互，并在下游任务中获得更稳健的表示。
authors: Xu Yan, Huiqun Wang, Chen Wang, Lei Ren, Di Huang

articles.title: Machine Learning Prediction of Early-Season Wildfire Risk in Ghana’s Guinea Savannah Using Multi-Source Data and CMIP6 Climate Scenarios
articles.title_zh: 利用多源数据与CMIP6气候情景机器学习预测加纳几内亚稀树草原早季野火风险
articles.abstract: Wildfires in Ghana’s Guinea Savannah zone affect large areas each dry season, yet Ghana still lacks a locally calibrated early-season fire danger tool for the northern savannah. This study develops and evaluates a machine learning fire-risk prototype for November-January using a 1 km gridded dataset for 2001-2024. The dataset combines MODIS burned area, NASA FIRMS active fire detections, ERA5-Land, CHIRPS, FLDAS soil moisture, MODIS vegetation products, SRTM topography, and human-access variables. Twenty-one base predictor variables were expanded into 123 model features using monthly lags, rolling statistics, anomalies, drought indices, and seasonal indicators. Five algorithms were compared: Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, and a multilayer perceptron. On the stratified test sample, the tree-based models achieved high discrimination, with AUC values of 0.960-0.962. Because the model-development sample was deliberately balanced relative to the full cell-month population, threshold-dependent metrics such as precision, F1, MCC, and Brier score are treated as sampling-dependent and are interpreted with prevalence-adjusted estimates. The full-feature LightGBM model exceeded the monthly aggregated Canadian Fire Weather Index by an absolute AUC difference of 0.28, although this comparison reflects both algorithm choice and the richer feature set rather than machine learning alone. Feature attribution did not support a single dominant soil-moisture control. Instead, temperature range, population density, surface pressure, precipitation memory, vegetation state, and soil-moisture memory all contributed to predicted fire risk. Surface pressure and other static or near-static variables are interpreted cautiously because they may encode spatial location and elevation. Bias-corrected CMIP6 experiments suggest higher late-century fire risk under SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5, but these projections are presented as illustrative because tree ensembles cannot extrapolate beyond the training envelope and human drivers were held constant. The revised index should therefore be viewed as a research prototype that can support future operational testing, not as a fully validated warning system.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向加纳北部几内亚稀树草原区缺乏本地化早季火险工具的问题，构建了2001—2024年1 km网格尺度的11月至1月野火风险机器学习原型。数据整合了MODIS火烧迹地、NASA FIRMS火点、ERA5-Land、CHIRPS、FLDAS土壤湿度、植被、地形和人类可达性变量，并扩展出滞后、滚动统计、异常、干旱指数等特征。比较结果显示树模型具有较高判别能力，作者还强调由于训练样本经过平衡处理，阈值相关指标需结合流行率校正谨慎解释。

articles.title: Functionalized Carbon Nanotubes as Nanoinhibitors of Asphaltene Aggregation: A Molecular Dynamics Approach for Enhanced Oil Recovery
articles.title_zh: 功能化碳纳米管作为沥青质聚集纳米抑制剂：面向提高采收率的分子动力学研究
articles.abstract: In the scientific literature, several experimental studies have investigated the use of nanoparticles to reduce asphaltene aggregation in crude oil systems. However, experimental approaches alone cannot fully elucidate the molecular-scale mechanisms governing asphaltene adsorption and aggregation or the influence of nanoparticle surface properties on these processes. In this study, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations were performed to examine the adsorption configuration of asphaltene molecules and the effect of bare and functionalized single-walled CNTs in a toluene /heptane mixture on their aggregation. The simulation results showed that CNTs adsorbed asphaltene molecules through π–π stacking and van der Waals interactions, while functionalized CNTs also formed hydrogen bonds. By comparing five systems containing CNTs both bare and functionalized with carbamoyl (CONH₂), methylcarbamoyl (CONHCH₃), hydroxymethyl (CH₂OH), and carboxylate (COO⁻) groups, radial distribution functions (RDFs), solvent-accessible surface area (SASA) analysis, cluster analysis, hydrogen bonding, and interaction energy calculations were performed to characterize the aggregation behavior. Results show that functionalized CNTs reduce asphaltene deposition more effectively than bare CNT, with carboxylate functionalized CNT exhibiting the strongest dispersing effect. This superior performance is attributed to enhanced electrostatic interactions and hydrogen bonding with polar sites of asphaltenes. These findings highlight the potential of rational CNT surface functionalization as a nanoscale strategy for mitigating asphaltene aggregation and enhanced crude oil recovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文采用分子动力学模拟研究裸单壁碳纳米管及多种功能化碳纳米管在甲苯/庚烷混合体系中对沥青质吸附和聚集的影响。结果表明，碳纳米管主要通过π–π堆积和范德华作用吸附沥青质，而功能化碳纳米管还可形成氢键。研究通过径向分布函数、溶剂可及表面积、团簇分析、氢键和相互作用能等指标比较不同官能团体系，为解释纳米颗粒抑制沥青质聚集的分子机制提供依据。

articles.title: The Investigation of the Corrosion Protective -properties of Reinforced Epoxy Resin With Clay Nanoparticles on Mild Steel
articles.title_zh: 黏土纳米颗粒增强环氧树脂涂层在低碳钢上的防腐性能研究
articles.abstract: This study investigated the development and optimization of clay nanoparticle-reinforced epoxy coatings for enhancing the corrosion protection and mechanical performance of mild steel in acidic environments. Epoxy nanocomposite coatings containing varying clay nanoparticle loadings (0–5 wt.%) were prepared and applied to mild steel substrates. A Central Composite Design (CCD) within the Response Surface Methodology (RSM) framework was employed to optimize the effects of clay loading and hydrochloric acid concentration on coating performance. Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy (EIS), potentiodynamic polarization, scanning electron microscopy (SEM), adhesion testing (ASTM D3359), and Rockwell hardness testing were used to evaluate the coatings. The electrochemical results showed that clay nanoparticle incorporation significantly increased polarization resistance (Rp), with coated samples exhibiting values up to 540 Ω compared with 210–234 Ω for unreinforced epoxy. Statistical analysis revealed that clay loading was the most significant factor influencing corrosion resistance (p < 0.05), while the optimization model predicted an optimum formulation at approximately 3.48 wt.% clay nanoparticles and 0.5 M HCl, corresponding to a predicted polarization resistance of 546.76 Ω. Experimental validation produced a higher Rp of 591.4 Ω, confirming the reliability of the optimization model. The optimized coating also demonstrated superior mechanical performance, achieving an ASTM D3359 adhesion rating of 3B compared with 1B for commercial coatings, and the highest Rockwell hardness of 85.9 HRC, exceeding those of Sikaflex (72.75 HRC) and Hinaz (78.25 HRC). SEM observations indicated improved coating integrity and nanoparticle dispersion, contributing to enhanced barrier properties. Overall, the optimized clay-reinforced epoxy coating exhibited significantly improved electrochemical stability, adhesion, hardness, and corrosion resistance, demonstrating its potential as a cost-effective and sustainable protective coating for mild steel in aggressive industrial environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究开发并优化黏土纳米颗粒增强环氧涂层，以提升低碳钢在酸性环境中的防腐和力学性能。作者制备了不同黏土含量的环氧纳米复合涂层，并采用响应面法中的中心复合设计评估黏土含量和盐酸浓度对涂层性能的影响。电化学阻抗、极化、SEM、附着力和硬度测试表明，加入黏土纳米颗粒可显著提高极化电阻，统计分析显示黏土负载量是影响耐蚀性的关键因素，优化配方约为3.48 wt.%黏土。

articles.title: Extraction and Characterization of Indigenous Ethiopian Violet Tree Bast Fiber
articles.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚本土紫树韧皮纤维的提取与表征
articles.abstract: Recently, there has been growing interest in sustainable consumption, mainly due to its eco-friendliness and potential as raw materials for the textile and fashion industries. This study investigated the qualities of the Ethiopian violet tree (Enjeji) and its potential for producing environmentally acceptable materials. Chemical extraction techniques using sodium hydroxide were used. Length, diameter, fineness, tenacity, moisture content, moisture regain, cellulose, hemicellulose, lignin, and ash content were the physical, mechanical, and chemical characteristics described. The findings demonstrate that the properties of the fiber are similar to those of other bast fibers utilized in the fashion and textile industries. Chemical composition analysis revealed that the Ethiopian violet tree fiber is composed of 62–66% cellulose, 18.5–25% hemicellulose, and 13.45-14% lignin. The FTIR spectra of the extracted fibers also confirmed the presence of cellulose, hemicellulose, and lignin. The dimensional characteristics of the fiber show a diameter of 14.2–30.8 lm and fineness of 4.6–13.5 tex, with fiber length ranging from 180 mm to 200 mm; moisture content and moisture regain are 10.8% and 12%, respectively. The mechanical properties of the fiber show tenacity 55cN/tex, tensile strength of 650–720 MPa, and elastic modulus1915 cN/tex, placing it close to established bast fibers such as hemp and flax. The high cellulose content, good dimensional and moisture characteristics, and good mechanical properties of banana fibers compared with conventional natural fibers indicate possible conventional and non-conventional applications in the textile and fashion industries.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察埃塞俄比亚紫树（Enjeji）韧皮纤维的提取、物理机械性质和化学组成，以评估其作为可持续纺织与时尚产业原料的潜力。作者采用氢氧化钠化学提取方法，并测定纤维长度、直径、细度、强力、含水率、回潮率以及纤维素、半纤维素、木质素和灰分含量。结果显示该纤维性质与已用于纺织领域的其他韧皮纤维相近，FTIR也证实了纤维素、半纤维素和木质素的存在。

articles.title: Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Secure Direct Communication Based on Decoy States and Polarization--Spatial Hyperentanglement
articles.title_zh: 基于诱骗态与偏振—空间超纠缠的测量设备无关量子安全直接通信
articles.abstract: Quantum secure direct communication (QSDC) can directly transmit confidential messages without pre-distributing secret keys. In practical applications, non-ideal light sources naturally contain multiphoton components, which can easily lead to photon-number-splitting attacks and constitute a core problem restricting secure practical implementation. Existing measurement-device-independent (MDI) QSDC protocols are mostly based on ideal source assumptions and lack strict security authentication for practical multiphoton risks. This paper proposes an MDI-QSDC protocol based on decoy states and polarization--spatial hyperentanglement. The protocol lower-bounds the contribution of the two-single-pair sector through an active three-intensity decoy-state mechanism and imposes a conservative bound on the potential information leakage caused by multiphoton events, while using polarization--spatial hyperentangled encoding to increase the payload of each valid HBSA event and relying on the MDI architecture to remove the need to trust the measurement device. Compared with similar schemes, this protocol significantly improves the secure message capacity in practical scenarios while maintaining detector-side security.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种结合诱骗态和偏振—空间超纠缠的测量设备无关量子安全直接通信协议，以应对实际非理想光源中的多光子成分及光子数分裂攻击风险。协议通过主动三强度诱骗态机制下界估计双单对扇区贡献，并对多光子事件可能造成的信息泄漏给出保守约束。借助超纠缠编码提升每个有效超纠缠贝尔态分析事件的载荷，同时利用MDI架构消除对测量设备可信性的依赖，从而提高实际场景下的安全消息容量。

articles.title: Intrinsic transverse magnetic nonreciprocal response in a noncollinear antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 非共线反铁磁体中的本征横向磁非互易响应
articles.abstract: Nonreciprocal responses transform broken symmetries into direction-dependent functionality, while a nonreciprocal response encoded directly in static magnetic response of an ordered magnet has not been realized. Here we reveal an intrinsic transverse magnetic nonreciprocity in the noncollinear antiferromagnet Mn3Ge. Using torque magnetometry, we observe a pronounced transverse torque that is odd under magnetic-field reversal, in sharp contrast to the reciprocal response of conventional magnets. A concomitant even-in-field planar Hall response emerges at the same low temperature around 210~K, well below the Neel temperature. Together, these measurements reveal a field-reversal-even transverse magnetic response in which opposite fields select symmetry-related, rather than time-reversed, noncollinear antiferromagnetic states. We attribute this behavior to spin-orbit-coupling-induced breaking of spin space group symmetry, which locks the noncollinear spin texture and its net magnetization to the lattice. These results establish a nonreciprocal magnetic response as a distinct collective response of chiral antiferromagnets, extending nonreciprocal phenomena beyond charge-current-based transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在非共线反铁磁体Mn3Ge中揭示了一种本征横向磁非互易响应，即静态磁响应本身呈现与方向相关的特性。通过扭矩磁ometry测量，作者观察到在磁场反转下呈奇性的显著横向扭矩，并在约210 K的低温下发现伴随出现的偶磁场平面霍尔响应。研究认为该现象源于自旋—轨道耦合导致的自旋空间群对称性破缺，使非共线自旋织构及其净磁化与晶格锁定，表明手性反铁磁体可呈现不同于电流输运的集体非互易磁响应。

articles.title: Network propagation in bipartite metabolite–reaction graphs for metabolomic data exploration
articles.title_zh: 用于代谢组数据探索的二部代谢物—反应图网络传播
articles.abstract: Introduction: Interpretation of metabolomic data is frequently limited by incomplete metabolite coverage and the predefined representation of biochemical organization provided by pathway-based approaches.Objectives This study aims to develop and evaluate a network propagation framework to facilitate metabolomic data exploration by diffusing statistical relevance scores across a metabolic topology.Methods A directed bipartite metabolite–reaction network was reconstructed using the KEGG database, comprising 8236 nodes with 1601 metabolites and 6635 reactions. Simulated metabolomic datasets with 75% sparsity mimicking two metabolic perturbations (oxidative stress and mitochondrial dysfunction) and two no-effect control groups, were generated to test the strategy. Node-level statistical signal scores were distributed across the network topology using a random walk-based diffusion operator combined with a semi-supervised clamping procedure to preserve initially observed measurements.Results Network propagation redistributed statistical signals across connected biochemical regions, allowing unmeasured metabolites and reactions to accumulate topology-aware significance scores. For both OS and MD scenarios, supervised univariate analyses revealed that significantly altered nodes formed highly interconnected, non-random topological modules. Furthermore, PLS-DA demonstrated that network propagation significantly enhanced multivariate predictive performance, yielding statistically validated performance gains via permutation testing, while effectively managing background noise in null comparisons.Conclusions The proposed bipartite metabolite–reaction network propagation framework provides an exploratory tool for metabolomics. By integrating topological context with statistical relevance, this approach complements established pathway analyses for hypothesis generation in partially observed metabolic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种基于网络传播的代谢组数据探索框架，以缓解代谢物覆盖不完整和传统通路方法依赖预定义生化组织的问题。作者基于KEGG重构了包含代谢物与反应节点的有向二部网络，并使用模拟的高稀疏代谢组数据测试氧化应激和线粒体功能障碍等扰动场景。该方法通过随机游走扩散算子和半监督钳制过程，将观测到的统计信号沿代谢拓扑传播，使未测量代谢物和反应也能获得拓扑感知的显著性评分。

articles.title: Ecological risks Assessment of heavy metals from the Kidaro Creek, Niger Delta Nigeria
articles.title_zh: 尼日利亚尼日尔三角洲Kidaro溪重金属生态风险评估
articles.abstract: This study assessed the concentrations, distribution, and ecological risks of selected heavy metals (Pb, Cd, Ni, V, Cr, and As) in surface water and sediments of Kidaro Creek, Niger Delta, Nigeria during the dry and wet seasons. Surface water and sediment samples were collected from three stations and analyzed using standard analytical procedures. The concentrations of Pb, Cd, Ni, Cr, and V in surface water ranged from 0.355–1.761, 0.119–0.258, 0.320–0.505, 0.045–0.366, and 0.029–0.359 mg/L respectively in the dry season, and 0.284–1.669, 0.008–0.025, 0.214–0.381, 0.278–0.567, and 0.045–0.366 mg/L in the wet season, exceeding World Health Organization (WHO) limits for drinking water, while As ranged from 0.006–0.014 mg/L (dry season) and 0.040–0.181 mg/L (wet season). In sediments, Pb, Cd, Ni, Cr, V, and As ranged from 12.98–47.96, 0.41–3.82, 0.600–7.49, 2.259–12.060, 0.247–5.409, and 0.005–0.129 mg/kg in the dry season and 14.62–49.98, 0.013–0.380, 0.457–9.55, 1.362–13.937, < 0.001–0.007, and 0.492–1.220 mg/kg in the wet season. Ecological risk assessment showed extremely high contamination in surface water, with contamination factors ranging from 10.63–435.0 in the dry season and 1.10–228.67 in the wet season, while sediment CF values were generally low (0.011–2.146). Surface water pollution load index (PLI) ranged from 47.72–152.38 in the dry season and 2.89–25.69 in the wet season, whereas sediment PLI ranged from 0.073–0.137 (dry season) and 0.012–0.026 (wet season). The potential ecological risk index (PERI) for surface water ranged from 11105.67–22501.33 in the dry season and 1796.33–3293 in the wet season, indicating extremely high ecological risk, while sediment PERI values ranged from 25.62–145.85 (dry season) and 4.81–16.66 (wet season), indicating generally low ecological risk. Cadmium contributed the largest share of ecological risk (86% in dry season and 53.9% in wet season in surface water; >90% in sediments). The findings indicated that Kidaro Creek is significantly impacted by heavy metal pollution, largely driven by anthropogenic inputs associated with petroleum-related activities in the Niger Delta. Continuous environmental monitoring and effective pollution management strategies are necessary to safeguard the aquatic ecosystem and surrounding communities.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估尼日利亚尼日尔三角洲Kidaro溪地表水和沉积物中Pb、Cd、Ni、V、Cr和As等重金属在旱季与雨季的浓度、分布及生态风险。结果显示，多种金属在地表水中的浓度超过世界卫生组织饮用水限值，沉积物中也检测到不同程度的金属累积，并呈现季节性变化。生态风险评估表明地表水存在极高污染风险，提示该区域水体和沉积环境可能受到显著重金属压力，需要持续监测和污染控制。

articles.title: Trained quantum Kolmogorov--Arnold networks can dequantize, and a discrete-logarithm encoding need not: a measurement-based map of where quantum advantage can live
articles.title_zh: 训练后的量子 Kolmogorov–Arnold 网络可能被去量子化，而离散对数编码未必如此：基于测量的量子优势分布图
articles.abstract: Quantum machine-learning models are only useful if a classical computer cannot cheaply imitate them. We test this directly for quantum Kolmogorov–Arnold networks (QKANs)—neural networks whose tunable “activation functions” are small quantum circuits—by asking whether each model can be contracted as an effcient tensor network (TN), the standard tool for classical quantum simulation. We make the test practical with a task-aware yardstick: the bond dimension a classical surrogate needs to copy the model’s output at the accuracy the model itself reaches. We find a clear ladder. The amplitude-encoded Chebyshev QKAN uses only logarithmically many qubits and is exactly classical. The variational QKAN, built from all-to-all controlled rotations, looks hard at random settings but, once trained to genuinely learn a smooth task (R2 = 0.30–0.62), is copied by a constant-bond-dimension surrogate at the sizes (n ≤ 10) we test. Noise pushes it toward classicality near p ≈ 0.03–0.05, echoing noisy random circuits. Every generic attempt to force hardness—a global measurement, a deeper entangler, or an interaction-based (IQP) feature map—instead destroys trainability through exponentially small gradients (a “barren plateau”). The escape is a discrete-logarithm feature map: its kernel variance is flat (0.07±0.01) from 4 to 14 qubits while a generic IQP kernel decays as 2−n , and a support-vector machine with it learns a classically hard concept to ≥ 99% accuracy while generic and classical kernels stay at chance—hardness placed in number theory stays both classically hard and shot-effciently learnable. The work provides a concrete, measurement-based criterion for when a quantum model is reproducible by a low-bond- dimension surrogate, and a design rule: seek advantage in structured, provably hard encodings rather than in deep entanglement.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察量子 Kolmogorov–Arnold 网络（QKAN）是否能被经典张量网络高效模拟，并以达到模型自身精度所需的键维数作为任务相关判据。结果显示，振幅编码的 Chebyshev QKAN 使用对数量子比特且可精确经典化；变分 QKAN 在随机参数下看似困难，但在学习平滑任务后可由常数键维数的经典替代模型复制。噪声会进一步推动模型趋向经典可模拟，而若通过全局测量、更深纠缠或 IQP 特征映射强行增加困难度，则可能因梯度指数衰减而破坏可训练性。

articles.title: Thermodynamics-Informed Graph Learning for Predicting CO2 Solubility in Water and Multicomponent Brines
articles.title_zh: 面向水和多组分盐水中 CO2 溶解度预测的热力学信息图学习
articles.abstract: Accurate prediction of CO2 solubility in saline water is essential for estimating dissolution trapping in carbon capture, utilization, and storage projects. Although recent gradient-boosting models achieve high accuracy on compiled CO2 solubility databases, most models treat brine composition as a flat vector and do not explicitly represent ion-ion, ion-water, and CO2-brine interactions. To address this limitation, this work presents a thermodynamics-informed graph learning workflow for predicting CO2 solubility in pure water, single-salt brines, and mixed brines. The model converts each brine into a chemical graph containing CO2, H2O, cations, and anions, and augments the graph descriptors with soft thermodynamic constraints for posi tivity, pressure consistency, salting-out behavior, and charge-aware composition. The workflow was tested on 3323 cleaned experimental records extracted from a published supplementary database. In a preliminary local run, tabular XGBoost gave the highest coefficient of determi nation, with R2 = 0.9856, RMSE = 0.00098, and AARD = 6.23%. Graph-descriptor XGBoost gave the lowest relative error, with AARD = 5.90%. The physics-informed graph neural model achieved R2 = 0.9741 and AARD = 6.83%, showing competitive relative-error performance but not yet outperforming boosted trees in squared-error metrics. These results show that graph based chemical descriptors can improve relative-error behavior, while high-salinity extrapolation remains the key challenge for a publishable final model.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种热力学信息约束的图学习流程，用于预测纯水、单盐盐水和混合盐水中的 CO2 溶解度。模型将盐水体系表示为包含 CO2、H2O、阳离子和阴离子的化学图，并引入正值性、压力一致性、盐析行为和电荷感知组成等软约束。在 3323 条清洗后的实验记录上，表格型 XGBoost 取得最高 R²，而图描述符 XGBoost 获得最低相对误差，表明显式表达化学相互作用有助于提升预测与解释能力。

articles.title: Thermal, wetting and microstructural properties of the tin (Sn)-58%bismuth (Bi) solder joint at 160 °C, 170°C and 180 °C
articles.title_zh: 160 °C、170 °C 和 180 °C 下 Sn-58%Bi 焊点的热学、润湿与显微组织性能
articles.abstract: The thermal, wetting and microstructural properties of tin (Sn)-58% bismuth (Bi) solder joints were investigated at three reflow temperatures of 160, 170, and 180°C to assess their performance for low-temperature assembly processes. Differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) analysis revealed that the SnBi alloy exhibited a melting range between 139 and 145°C, confirming its low temperature applicability for reduced thermal processing conditions. Contact angles were measured at 78.4°, 68.95°, and 69.39° at 160, 170 and 180°C, respectively, classifying the SnBi as having moderate wettability behavior. The spreading ratios of 347.7, 333.7 and 322.8 for 160, 170 and 180°C was measured demonstrating an inverse relationship with contact angle in accordance with wetting theory. The microstructural observations from scanning electron microscopy image (SEM) at the SnBi/Cu solder joint revealed the formation of a relatively uniform Cu₆Sn₅ intermetallic compound (IMC) layer at 170 and 180°C, whereas minimal or nearly no IMC formation was observed at 160°C due to insufficient interfacial reaction. The findings indicate that SnBi solder joint at the lower reflow temperature of 160, 170, and 180°C showed acceptable wettability condition and interfacial characteristics, supporting its potential application for energy-efficient and thermally sensitive microelectronic assembly processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估 Sn-58%Bi 低温焊料在 160、170 和 180 °C 回流条件下的热性能、润湿行为和界面显微组织。DSC 结果表明该合金熔化范围为 139–145 °C，适用于低温装配；接触角显示其具有中等润湿性。SEM 观察发现，在 170 和 180 °C 下 SnBi/Cu 界面形成较均匀的 Cu₆Sn₅ 金属间化合物层，而 160 °C 下界面反应不足、IMC 形成很少或几乎没有。

articles.title: Data-Driven Full-Spectrum Mapping of the Synthesis Landscape for Plasmonic Nanoparticles with High Chiroptical Activity
articles.title_zh: 高旋光活性等离激元纳米颗粒合成空间的全谱数据驱动映射
articles.abstract: Chiral plasmonic nanoparticles hold promise for enantioselective catalysis, biosensing and nanomedicine, but achieving high chiroptical activity of these nanoparticles remains a synthetic challenge. Multiple coupled synthesis parameters within a high-dimensional chemical landscape govern nanoparticle morphology and determine their |g-factor|. Here, by analysing full g-factor spectra of plasmonic nanoparticles, rather than only g-factor peak values, we establish a data-driven framework for the synthesis of chiral gold 432 helicoids. Gryffin algorithm-driven autonomous synthesis identified reaction conditions yielding |g-factor| = 0.24, while spectral manifold learning converted 80 nanoparticle samples into a topological landscape with four structural branches. The resulting synthesis landscape revealed that gold precursor loading enables access to three high-|g-factor| clusters, whereas glutathione directs cluster selection. Analysis of the low-|g-factor| intensity spectral region revealed previously unreported chiral rhombic dodecahedra nanoparticles that bridge achiral octahedra and final 432 helicoids, redirecting machine learning from optimisation toward mechanistic understanding of nanoparticle synthesis.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对手性等离激元纳米颗粒高旋光活性难以合成的问题，提出基于完整 g 因子光谱而非单一峰值的数据驱动框架。自主合成算法识别出可获得 |g-factor| = 0.24 的反应条件，谱流形学习则将 80 个样品映射为包含四个结构分支的拓扑景观。结果显示金前驱体用量有助于进入多个高 |g-factor| 簇，而谷胱甘肽影响簇选择；低 |g-factor| 光谱区域还揭示了此前未报道的手性菱形十二面体纳米颗粒。

articles.title: Dual Optimization for Enhanced Micrografting Efficiency of Chaenomeles japonica L.: Rootstock Selection, Medium Injection, and Leaf Fall Mitigation Strategies
articles.title_zh: 提高日本木瓜微嫁接效率的双重优化：砧木选择、培养基注射与落叶缓解策略
articles.abstract: Background Chaenomeles japonica L. serves as a multi-functional landscape shrub respected for its visual attraction and durability. Alkaline soils can lead to leaf chlorosis or yellowing of young leaves during the growing season. The cost-effective and efficient approach is to employ varieties that exhibit resistance to iron chlorosis. This study aimed to enhance the in vitro micrografting process of Chaenomeles japonica and composition of the culture medium to mitigate leaf abscission. In the first experiment investigated the effect of grafting time, rootstock type, and the injection of culture medium at the graft union. The second experimental treatments comprised: vitamin C, silver nitrate, iron 2X and 4X concentration.Results The findings indicated that the highest of callus formation was observed in late October. The rootstock type proved a critical determinant of micrograft success. Rootstock type significantly affected both scion growth and callus formation, highlighting its pivotal role in graft compatibility. Also, Silver nitrate (10 mg L− 1) is the most effective treatment for eliminating all post-subculture physiological disorders in micrografted Chaenomeles japonica. Increasing Fe concentration reduces chlorosis but does not eliminate wilting or leaf fall and Vitamin C alone is not significantly effective.Conclusions Rootstock type significantly affected both scion growth and callus formation, highlighting its pivotal role in graft compatibility. The injection of culture medium, although not influential on growth or greenness attributes, exerted a significant impact on callus formation at the graft interface, indicating a potential physiological or biochemical modulation of wound‑healing processes. Silver nitrate is the most effective treatment for eliminating all post-subculture physiological disorders in micrografted Chaenomeles japonica.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究旨在优化日本木瓜的离体微嫁接流程，并通过调整培养基组成缓解叶片脱落等生理障碍。第一部分考察嫁接时间、砧木类型和嫁接口培养基注射的影响，第二部分测试维生素C、硝酸银以及不同铁浓度处理。结果表明，10月下旬愈伤组织形成最佳，砧木类型显著影响接穗生长和愈伤组织形成，而10 mg/L硝酸银对消除继代后生理障碍最有效。

articles.title: Free-ranging wild boars exhibit elevated circulating IL-6 concentrations compared with domestic pigs from Mediterranean ecosystem
articles.title_zh: 地中海生态系统中自由活动野猪较家猪表现出更高的循环 IL-6 浓度
articles.abstract: Host ecology is a major determinant of immune function, yet its influence on systemic inflammatory phenotypes remains poorly understood in closely related wild and domestic vertebrates. We compared circulating cytokine concentrations in intensively reared domestic pigs (Sus scrofa domesticus; n = 48) and in free-ranging wild boars (Sus scrofa; n = 19) from a Mediterranean region of eastern Spain. Plasma concentrations of nine cytokines (IL-1β, IL-4, IL-6, IL-8, IL-10, IL-12/IL-23p40, IFN-α, IFN-γ and TNF-α) were quantified using multiplex immunoassays. Animals were additionally screened for Leishmania infantum exposure by ELISA and for parasite DNA by real-time PCR. Host-associated differences were evaluated using univariate, multivariable and multivariate statistical approaches. Wild boars exhibited significantly higher circulating concentrations of IL-1β and IL-6, whereas domestic pigs showed higher concentrations of IL-12/IL-23p40. The most pronounced difference involved IL-6, whose median concentration was approximately 21-fold higher in wild boars than in domestic pigs (92.83 vs. 4.44 pg/mL; FDR < 0.0001). After adjustment for age, sex, PCR status and ELISA status, only IL-6 remained independently associated with host population (β = 2.475, 95% CI = 1.33–3.62; FDR = 0.001), corresponding to an approximately 12-fold increase on the original scale. Principal component analysis and hierarchical clustering revealed substantial overlap between host populations. Nevertheless, PERMANOVA detected a significant effect of host population on overall cytokine composition (R² = 0.063, p = 0.0035), indicating modest but detectable ecological structuring of systemic immune profiles. Sensitivity analyses restricted to yearlings and PCR-characterized animals yielded consistent results. These findings identify circulating IL-6 as the most robust immune marker associated with ecological background in suids. Although global cytokine architectures remained largely conserved, free-ranging wild boars exhibited a markedly elevated systemic inflammatory tone compared with domestic pigs, highlighting the potential role of ecological conditions in shaping immune phenotypes at the wildlife–livestock interface.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究比较了西班牙东部地中海地区集约化饲养家猪和自由活动野猪的血浆细胞因子水平，以评估宿主生态对系统性炎症表型的影响。研究检测了9种细胞因子，并筛查婴儿利什曼原虫暴露和寄生虫DNA。结果显示野猪的 IL-1β 和 IL-6 水平更高，家猪的 IL-12/IL-23p40 更高，其中 IL-6 差异最明显；多因素校正后，IL-6 仍是主要保留差异的指标。

articles.title: A data-quality-aware hybrid deep learning framework for drilling penetration rate prediction from field measurements
articles.title_zh: 面向现场测量钻井机械钻速预测的数据质量感知混合深度学习框架
articles.abstract: Accurate prediction of the rate of penetration (ROP) is important for improving drilling efficiency, reducing costs and supporting intelligent drilling in subsurface energy engineering. However, field drilling data are often affected by noise, outliers, missing intervals and nonlinear interactions among operating parameters, reducing prediction reliability. Here, we develop a data-quality-aware hybrid machine learning framework for ROP prediction from real-field measurements. Principal component analysis (PCA) reduces feature redundancy, and hierarchical density-based spatial clustering of applications with noise (HDBSCAN) identifies abnormal samples. Gaussian process regression (GPR) reconstructs missing or uncertain intervals, followed by Savitzky-Golay (SG) filtering and wavelet soft-threshold denoising for signal enhancement. CatBoost, multilayer perceptron (MLP) and Transformer models are integrated in a stacking ensemble, while a residual neural network (ResNet) corrects systematic errors. Harris hawks optimization (HHO) performs coordinated hyperparameter optimization. Compared with conventional machine learning and deep learning models, the optimized framework increased the coefficient of determination (R²) from 0.9667 to 0.9755 and reduced the root mean square error (RMSE) and mean absolute error (MAE) from 2.12 to 1.42 and from 1.39 to 1.17, respectively. These results show that data-quality enhancement combined with hybrid learning improves robust prediction from noisy drilling measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种面向真实现场钻井数据的机械钻速预测框架，以应对噪声、异常值、缺失区间和操作参数非线性耦合带来的可靠性问题。框架结合 PCA 降维、HDBSCAN 异常识别、GPR 缺失重构、Savitzky-Golay 滤波和小波软阈值去噪，并集成 CatBoost、MLP 与 Transformer 的堆叠模型。作者还使用 ResNet 校正系统误差、Harris 鹰优化进行超参数协同优化，结果显示相较常规模型预测性能得到提升。

articles.title: Revealing rearrangement of local short-range order in metastable liquid metal under static magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 静磁场下亚稳液态金属局域短程有序重排的揭示
articles.abstract: Gallium-based liquid metals exhibit unique hybrid properties, yet the atomic-scale origin of their response to magnetic fields remains elusive. Here, we investigate the structural evolution of eutectic Ga85In15 liquid metal under a 0.2 T static magnetic field (SMF) using in situ high-energy X-ray scattering and Gaussian Approximation Potential (GAP)-assisted Reverse Monte Carlo modeling. We reveal that the SMF triggers a rearrangement of short-range order via bond distortion and symmetry breaking, effectively enhancing local disordered degree, alongside coordinated reduction of high-coordination polyhedral and increase in low-coordination clusters. Notably, local configuration-dependent potential energy analysis demonstrates that the field reduces the energy barriers between metastable topological configurations, providing a phenomenological mechanism for how magnetic fields modify supercooling and nucleation behaviors in metallic liquids from an atomic cluster perspective. These findings establish an SMF-generated metastability distinct from pressure or temperature effects, opening new avenues for field-assisted atomic-scale structural regulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用原位高能 X 射线散射与 GAP 辅助反蒙特卡罗建模，考察 0.2 T 静磁场下共晶 Ga85In15 液态金属的结构演化。结果表明，静磁场通过键畸变和对称性破缺诱导短程有序重排，提高局域无序程度，并使高配位多面体减少、低配位团簇增加。局域构型相关势能分析显示，磁场可降低亚稳拓扑构型之间的能垒，为理解磁场调控金属液体过冷与形核行为提供了原子团簇层面的机制。

articles.title: Quantum computer simulates hadronization, reproducing string breaking with 104 qubits
articles.title_zh: 量子计算机用 104 个量子比特模拟强子化并再现弦断裂
articles.abstract: By remotely accessing an IBM quantum computer, a research scientist at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory has successfully simulated a key process in particle physics: hadronization. Although based on a simplified model of quantum mechanics, the project lays the groundwork for how physicists can leverage the power of quantum computers to make large scientific calculations beyond the capabilities of classical supercomputers. The research is published in the journal Physical Review D.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室研究人员远程使用 IBM 量子计算机模拟粒子物理中的强子化过程。尽管该工作基于简化的量子力学模型，但其展示了量子计算机在处理经典超级计算机难以承担的大规模科学计算方面的潜力。相关研究发表于 Physical Review D。

articles.title: Topological random alloy
articles.title_zh: 拓扑随机合金
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30917v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological phases of matter are often realized in crystalline materials. To extend their understanding beyond perfect stoichiometry, we introduce a minimal model of a topological random binary alloy and show that the system realizes an exotic form of impurity-band engineering. We reveal that, in contrast to Wannier charge centers pinned by impurities in conventional semiconductors, doping a proximate quantum anomalous Hall insulator results in dopant-centric chiral current loops. The nature of such current loops is intrinsically tied to the properties of both the host and the dopant. We demonstrate that, even at dilute dopant density, these current loops can form topological domains in an otherwise trivial host and trigger a topological phase transition. On the other hand, doping a topological host having chirality opposite to that of the dopants can unexpectedly stabilize a metallic phase in which bulk transport is mediated by inter-domain edge modes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出了一个拓扑随机二元合金的最小模型，用以研究拓扑相在偏离理想晶体化学计量条件下的表现。作者发现，在接近量子反常霍尔绝缘体的体系中掺杂会产生以掺杂原子为中心的手性电流环，并可在稀掺杂下形成拓扑畴、触发拓扑相变。若拓扑宿主与掺杂诱导的手性相反，体系还可能稳定出由畴间边缘模介导体输运的金属相。
authors: Subrata Pachhal, Aziz Hasan, Adhip Agarwala

articles.title: Andreev reflection mediated by topological corner states in a two-dimensional honeycomb lattice
articles.title_zh: 二维蜂窝晶格中由拓扑角态介导的 Andreev 反射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31079v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological corner states in two-dimensional second-order topological insulators (SOTIs) are localized in real space. We numerically demonstrate that such localized topological corner states can mediate Andreev reflection when coupled to a superconducting lead. We consider a transport setup based on a two-dimensional honeycomb lattice, consisting of a normal lead, a central SOTI region, and a superconducting lead. The central SOTI region is described by the modified Kane--Mele model with an in-plane Zeeman field and hosts topological corner states in a diamond-shaped flake. Although the central region is insulating, the local density of states shows that incident electrons can turn the localized corner state into an extended scattering state, which forms a resonant tunneling channel to the superconducting lead. This process leads to a perfect Andreev reflection peak near zero energy. Away from this resonance, antiresonance dips appear in the Andreev reflection spectrum, and their positions can be tuned by the Zeeman field strength. We show that the suppression of Andreev reflection is caused by quantum interference and the imbalance between electron and hole dwell times in the central region. These results demonstrate that topological corner states can provide a resonant tunneling path to the superconducting interface and mediate Andreev reflection in second-order topological systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究数值展示了二维二阶拓扑绝缘体中的局域拓扑角态在耦合超导电极时可介导 Andreev 反射。作者构建由正常电极、中心二阶拓扑绝缘体区域和超导电极组成的蜂窝晶格输运体系，并采用含面内 Zeeman 场的修正 Kane-Mele 模型描述中心区域。结果表明，入射电子可将局域角态转化为延展散射态并形成到超导电极的共振隧穿通道，从而在近零能处产生完美 Andreev 反射峰；偏离共振时出现可由 Zeeman 场调控的反共振谷。
authors: Kai-Tong Wang, Yunjin Yu, Fuming Xu, Jian Wang

articles.title: Orientation-tunable correlated Chern insulating states in chiral twisted double bilayer graphene proximitized by WSe2
articles.title_zh: WSe2 近邻作用下手性扭转双双层石墨烯中取向可调的关联陈绝缘态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Moire flat bands in graphene systems proximitized by transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) provide a setting where spin-orbit coupling (SOC) can reshape band topology. The crystallographic alignment angle twist angle between TMDC and graphene layers is predicted to tune the balance of Ising and Rashba SOC, but a combined theoretical and experimental understanding of how twist angle governs the topological character of correlated states has not been systematically established. Here we show that in chiral-stacked twisted double bilayer graphene in proximity to WSe2, twist angle between graphene and WSe2 determines the topological character of correlated Chern insulators. Continuum model calculations reveal that Ising spin-orbit coupling dominates at zero twist angle, giving rise to flat bands with finite valley Chern numbers, whereas Rashba coupling dominates at larger twist angle, resulting in topologically trivial bands. Transport measurements at quarter filling confirm this picture: twist angle = 0 deg devices exhibit C = +1 Chern insulators, consistent with spontaneous isospin polarization, whereas twist angle = 15 degree devices show C = 0 despite exhibiting similar correlated insulating behavior. The sharp contrast establishes crystallographic alignment as a new tuning knob, complementary to twist angle, displacement field, and carrier density, for engineering correlated topological states in van der Waals heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究了与 WSe2 近邻耦合的手性堆垛扭转双双层石墨烯中，石墨烯与 WSe2 的晶向扭角如何决定关联陈绝缘体的拓扑性质。连续模型计算显示，零扭角时 Ising 自旋轨道耦合占主导，使平带具有有限谷陈数；较大扭角时 Rashba 耦合占优，能带趋于拓扑平庸。四分之一填充处的输运测量支持这一图像：零扭角器件呈现 C=+1 陈绝缘态，而较大扭角器件表现出不同的、与拓扑平庸化相符的行为。
authors: Jiao Xie, Yongqin Xie, Fanqiang Chen, Jiliang Yang, Sicheng Chen, Moyu Chen, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Shi-Jun Liang, Kemi Xu, Bin Cheng, Feng Miao

articles.title: Phonon-induced pseudogap phase in TiSe₂
articles.title_zh: TiSe2 中的声子诱导赝能隙相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31298v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To comprehend quantum ordered states, such as charge density waves (CDW), in layered transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs), it is essential to uncover their underlying normal states. Here, we use time- and angle-resolved extreme ultraviolet photoemission spectroscopy and ab initio electron-phonon calculations to perform excited state band mapping of three prototypical 1T TMDCs, i.e., TiSe₂, HfTe₂, and ZrTe₂, at room temperature. The results reveal the profound impact of strong electron-phonon-induced thermal fluctuations on the normal-phase electronic structure. Specifically, in the moderate electron-phonon coupling regime, as in HfTe₂ and ZrTe₂, thermal fluctuations only lead to small spectral broadening and band renormalization. In the strongly coupled case, exemplified by TiSe₂, we observe soft-phonon-induced, momentum-dependent suppression of spectral weight, i.e., pseudogaps - extending up to 1 eV above the Fermi level. Our work establishes the normal phase of TiSe₂ as a phonon-induced pseudogap phase governed by strong CDW fluctuations, thereby uncovering previously missing aspects of the TiSe₂ phase diagram, with broader implications for other TMDCs in the strong electron-phonon coupling regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合时间分辨与角分辨极紫外光电子能谱以及从头算电子-声子计算，对 TiSe2、HfTe2 和 ZrTe2 三种典型 1T 过渡金属二硫族化物的室温激发态能带进行测绘。结果显示，电子-声子诱导的热涨落会显著影响正常相电子结构：在 HfTe2 和 ZrTe2 中主要表现为轻微谱展宽和能带重整化，而在强耦合的 TiSe2 中，软声子导致动量依赖的谱权重抑制，即延伸至费米能级以上约 1 eV 的赝能隙。该工作将 TiSe2 的正常相确立为由强电荷密度波涨落支配的声子诱导赝能隙相。
authors: Sotirios Fragkos, Nina Girotto Erhardt, Evgenia Symeonidou, Hibiki Orio, Dominique Descamps, Stéphane Petit, Polychronis Tsipas, Kai Rossnagel, Jakub Schusser, Athanasios Dimoulas, Samuel Beaulieu, Dino Novko

articles.title: Photon Statistics from Yb3+-Doped CsPbCl3 are Inconsistent with Quantum Cutting
articles.title_zh: Yb3+ 掺杂 CsPbCl3 的光子统计与量子剪裁不相容
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31359v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: CsPb(Cl1-xBrx)3:Yb3+ has been widely reported as a broadband quantum-cutting material with a photoluminescence quantum yield exceeding 100%, making it a promising candidate for enhancing the blue-green spectral response of silicon photovoltaics. Many groups have reproduced absolute photoluminescence quantum yields over 100%, but others have struggled to obtain such high values. Here, we test the quantum-cutting capabilities of CsPbCl3:Yb3+ nanocrystals and bulk material using photon-correlation analysis. A quantum-cutting material is expected to exhibit photon bunching, but our experiments on CsPbCl3:Yb3+ show no such behavior. In fact, we observe the opposite -- anti-bunching -- under focused-excitation conditions. This observation can be explained with the previously established Auger-quenching pathway in CsPbCl3:Yb3+. Our results thus confirm high-power Auger quenching but question earlier descriptions of quantum cutting in CsPb(Cl1-xBrx)3:Yb3+.
articles.abstract_zh: CsPb(Cl1-xBrx)3:Yb3+ 曾被广泛认为是光致发光量子产率超过 100% 的宽带量子剪裁材料，有望改善硅光伏的蓝绿光响应。该研究通过光子相关分析检验 CsPbCl3:Yb3+ 纳米晶和体材料的量子剪裁能力，发现预期的光子聚束并未出现，反而在聚焦激发条件下观察到反聚束。作者认为该现象可由已知的 Auger 淬灭通道解释，从而对早期关于该体系量子剪裁的描述提出质疑。
authors: Vincent R. M. Benning, Faris Horani, Daniel R. Gamelin, Freddy T. Rabouw

articles.title: Deviations beyond the Kibble-Zurek mechanism in a Spin-Orbit-Coupled Bose-Einstein Condensate with phenomenological damping
articles.title_zh: 含唯象阻尼的自旋轨道耦合玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中超越 Kibble-Zurek 机制的偏离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31406v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the quench dynamics in a one-dimensional spin-orbit-coupled Bose-Einstein condensate (SOC-BEC) across the phase transition from plane-wave (PW) to stripe (ST), incorporating phenomenological damping. In the dissipation-free case, a state stagnation phenomenon emerges during the PW-ST quench: for slow quenches, the system remains trapped in the PW phase due to the energy gap induced by critical slowing down, which prevents spontaneous relaxation to the stripe ground state. To explore this phenomenon and examine the universal scaling predicted by the Kibble-Zurek mechanism (KZM) in open systems, we introduce a dissipative Gross-Pitaevskii equation with a phenomenological damping term. Numerical simulations reveal that weak dissipation preserves the expected KZM power-law scaling for the freeze-out time and defect density, whereas strong dissipation or long quench times lead to significant deviations. Our results demonstrate that the KZM remains applicable in dissipative quantum systems under appropriate conditions, providing insights into nonequilibrium dynamics in open quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察一维自旋轨道耦合玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体从平面波相到条纹相相变过程中的淬火动力学，并引入唯象阻尼。无耗散情况下，慢淬火会出现状态停滞，体系因临界慢化诱导的能隙而滞留在平面波相，难以自发弛豫到条纹基态。基于含阻尼项的耗散 Gross-Pitaevskii 方程模拟表明，弱耗散下冻结时间和缺陷密度仍遵循 Kibble-Zurek 幂律标度，而强耗散或长淬火时间会导致显著偏离。
authors: Jun-Hang Ren, Sheng Liu, Yong-Sheng Zhang

articles.title: Growth optimization of shallow Ge quantum wells grown by molecular beam epitaxy
articles.title_zh: 分子束外延生长浅层 Ge 量子阱的生长优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31540v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Shallow strained Ge quantum wells have gained recent attention for realizing scalable, high-performance hybrid superconductor/semiconductor-based qubits. Epitaxial superconducting contacts can improve the quality and consistency of the superconductor/semiconductor interface. The growth of Ge quantum wells by molecular beam epitaxy is then motivating due to the relative ease of integration with epitaxial superconductor growth. However, the performance of Ge quantum wells grown by molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) has been limited. To improve the properties of MBE-grown Ge quantum wells, the growth conditions were systematically optimized. Thick buffer layers are utilized to eliminate certain defects, and an optimal growth temperature is found. A peak hole mobility of 105,000 cmtextsuperscript2/Vs at 2 K is obtained in a 22-nm deep Ge quantum well, demonstrating that the Ge quantum wells grown in this study represent the highest mobilities for shallow MBE-grown samples. Mobility modeling indicates that the increase in mobility due to growth temperature optimization are likely due to a reduction in interface roughness scattering, and further improvements in mobility are expected through improved surface passivation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作面向可扩展高性能超导体/半导体混合量子比特，系统优化了分子束外延生长的浅层应变 Ge 量子阱。研究通过采用厚缓冲层以减少特定缺陷，并确定了最佳生长温度，在深度为 22 nm 的 Ge 量子阱中于 2 K 获得 105000 cm2/Vs 的峰值空穴迁移率。迁移率建模表明，生长温度优化带来的性能提升很可能源于界面粗糙散射的降低。
authors: J. T. Dong, J. P. Thompson, R. Card, K. Sardashti, C. J. K. Richardson

articles.title: Electronic theory for scanning tunneling microscopy spectra in bilayer nickelate thin films
articles.title_zh: 双层镍酸盐薄膜扫描隧道显微谱的电子理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31569v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent Scanning Tunneling Microscopy (STM) experiments measuring the superconducting gap features in thin films of superconducting bilayer nickelates La2PrNi2O7 at ambient pressure and compressive strain paved the way to study the Cooper-pairing models and the band-selective identification of the gap features in these systems. Here, using the realistic two-orbital bilayer model and the continuum Green's function formalism, we theoretically analyze orbital and band-selective local density of states as well as the corresponding STM spectra. We find that the multiorbital character and the spatial dependence of the Wannier functions leads to the spectra developing characteristic features depending on the position of the scanning tunneling microscope's tip. This allows for a band-resolved analysis of the superconducting coherence peaks and scattering momenta. We identify a clear path for experimental measurements to not only identify the debated incipiency of the gamma-band, but also identification of the coherence peaks' band origins via distance dependent measurements of the local density of states and its corrections through impurity scattering.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对常压和压缩应变下超导双层镍酸盐 La2PrNi2O7 薄膜的 STM 实验，建立理论框架分析其超导能隙特征。作者利用现实的双轨道双层模型和连续 Green 函数形式，研究轨道与能带选择性的局域态密度及相应 STM 谱。结果表明，多轨道性质和 Wannier 函数的空间依赖性会使谱线随 STM 针尖位置产生特征变化，从而为区分超导相干峰的能带来源、检验 γ 能带是否为萌生态提供实验路径。
authors: Marius Scholten, Steffen Bötzel, Frank Lechermann, Peayush Choubey, Ilya M. Eremin

articles.title: Universal scaling of many-body effects in quantum tunneling
articles.title_zh: 量子隧穿中多体效应的普适标度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31659v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum tunneling is fundamental to diverse phenomena and underpins a wide range of modern technologies. In the study of superconducting quantum computation and high-temperature superconducting materials, tunneling on multi-particle scale is central. Recently, several cold atom experiments successfully simulated the tunneling process in a many-particle ensemble. However, the many-body nature remains largely unexplored. Here, we observe the universal scaling of many-body effects in quantum tunneling process, using a hexagonal-triangular quantum simulator with independent control of barrier, temperature and interaction. In the weak-interaction regime, the critical tunneling coefficient scales parabolically with temperature under various conditions, in contrast to the linear scaling of single-particle tunneling. By further increasing the interactions beyond the mean-field regime, the scaling exponent decreases, consistent with quantum field theory predictions. Our results address the fundamental question of how many-body effects renormalize quantum tunneling, with direct implications for correlated quantum matter and devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用可独立控制势垒、温度和相互作用的六角-三角量子模拟器，观测量子隧穿过程中多体效应的普适标度。弱相互作用区域中，临界隧穿系数随温度呈抛物线标度，这与单粒子隧穿的线性标度不同。进一步增强相互作用至超越平均场区域时，标度指数降低，并与量子场论预言一致，揭示多体效应如何重整化量子隧穿。
authors: Hongmian Shui, Chi-Kin Lai, Chengyang Wu, Lorenzo Pizzino, Chi Zhang, Guohao Shen, Thierry Giamarchi, Hepeng Yao, Xiaoji Zhou

articles.title: Activated dynamics in the quantum random field Ising model
articles.title_zh: 量子随机场 Ising 模型中的激活动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31663v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the critical dynamics of the quantum random-field Ising model using the nonperturbative functional renormalization group (NP-FRG). The static critical behavior is found to be controlled by the zero-temperature fixed point of the classical random-field Ising model, where both thermal and quantum fluctuations are dangerously irrelevant. Considering a family of quantum dynamical universality classes defined by a bare dynamical kernel F_Łambda(ømega)sim |ømega|^σ, we show how this fluctuationless fixed point nevertheless controls the quantum dynamics by computing the full Matsubara-frequency dependence of the running dynamical kernel Fₖ₍ømega). This is essential at zero temperature: a naive treatment of the dynamical kernel flow leads to a divergence at a finite length scale, resulting in apparent localization. In contrast, keeping the full frequency dependence of the dynamical kernel and choosing a regulator adapted to its running scale yields a controlled flow. The resulting dynamics is of activated form, with a relaxation time given by łn τ sim ξ^Ψ. The exponent Ψ is determined by the static RFIM fixed-point exponents and by σ. At finite temperature, the flow crosses over to the classical thermally activated scaling of the random-field Ising model. These results provide a quantitative field-theoretic realization of the heuristic activation scenario proposed earlier for the quantum random-field model and establish a framework for analyzing the dynamics of other disordered quantum systems that may exhibit similar tentative localization-like singularities.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作采用非微扰泛函重整化群研究量子随机场 Ising 模型的临界动力学。静态临界行为由经典随机场 Ising 模型的零温固定点控制，其中热涨落和量子涨落均为危险无关变量。通过保留运行中的动力学核的完整 Matsubara 频率依赖并采用相适应的调节器，作者避免了朴素处理导致的有限尺度发散，得到激活形式的动力学，其弛豫时间满足 ln τ 与相关长度的幂律关系。
authors: Ivan Balog, Lovro Šaravanja, Andrei A. Fedorenko

articles.title: Energy-time entanglement from a monolithically integrated quantum dot on silicon
articles.title_zh: 硅上单片集成量子点产生的能量—时间纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31775v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scalable quantum photonic technologies require deterministic sources of entangled photons that are compatible with established semiconductor manufacturing platforms. While self-assembled III--V semiconductor quantum dots are among the most promising sources of on-demand entanglement generation, their integration with silicon-based architectures remains a central challenge. Here, we demonstrate energy--time entanglement from a single InGaAs/GaAs quantum dot monolithically grown on a silicon substrate. Under coherent two-photon excitation, we achieve coherent control of the biexciton--exciton cascade, evidenced by Rabi oscillations and dressed-state formation. Using a four-channel Franson interferometer, we observe phase-dependent two-photon interference with visibilities up to (64.0 ± 7.0)% for an 80 ps integration window (and (49.4 ± 1.9)% for a 1600 ps window), approaching the threshold for Bell inequality violation at short time scales. These results establish monolithically integrated III--V-on-silicon quantum dots as promising sources of energy--time entangled photons for scalable quantum photonic technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了在硅衬底上单片生长的单个 InGaAs/GaAs 量子点能够产生能量—时间纠缠光子。作者在相干双光子激发下实现了双激子—激子级联的相干控制，并通过 Rabi 振荡和缀饰态形成加以验证。利用四通道 Franson 干涉仪，他们观测到相位依赖的双光子干涉，在短时间积分窗口下可见度接近违反 Bell 不等式所需阈值，表明 III-V 族硅上量子点有望用于可扩展量子光子技术。
authors: Marcel Hohn, Imad Limame, Peter Ludewig, Chirag C. Palekar, Aris Koulas-Simos, Kerstin Volz, Stephan Reitzenstein

articles.title: The exceptional origin of the strange metal and the LFL-HFL transition
articles.title_zh: 奇异金属与 LFL-HFL 转变的例外代数起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31810v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose an algebraic framework for the strange metal regime of strongly correlated electrons. We show that the exceptional superconformal algebra D(2,1;α) admits two distinct contractions of its conformal sector: one to a pair of canonical fermions, the underlying degrees of freedom of the Landau-Fermi liquid (LFL), and one to the algebra of Hubbard operators, which characterise a distinct metallic regime, the Hubbard-Fermi liquid (HFL). We argue that competition between these two metallic states drives the emergence of the strange metal as a 0+1D superconformal bath. We analyse the resulting thermodynamics, and obtain a parameter-free prediction, 4π²γ⁻¹ =ḩiₛ⁻¹ + ḩi_c⁻¹, relating the Sommerfeld coefficient to the static spin and charge susceptibilities. We further show that the LFL-HFL transition is discontinuous at low temperature, owing to a degeneracy at the emergence of the HFL, and map out the resulting phase diagram. We connect the framework to microscopic lattice models and to the phenomenology of correlated insulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种用于描述强关联电子奇异金属态的代数框架。作者指出例外超共形代数 D(2,1;α) 的共形部分可收缩为两类不同代数，分别对应 Landau-Fermi 液体和 Hubbard-Fermi 液体的自由度。两种金属态之间的竞争被认为导致奇异金属作为 0+1 维超共形浴涌现，并给出 Sommerfeld 系数与静态自旋、荷易感率之间的无参数关系。研究还讨论了低温下 LFL-HFL 转变的不连续性、相图及其与微观晶格模型和关联绝缘体现象学的联系。

articles.title: Anomalous Hall Effect Driven by Chiral Superconductivity
articles.title_zh: 由手性超导驱动的反常霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31851v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Direct dc-current signatures of unconventional superconductivity remain scarce. Existing probes of unconventional pairing are typically indirect, relying on phase-diagram anomalies, responses to external fields, or optical measurements. Here we propose a zero-field Hall drag effect as a direct transport signature of chiral superconductivity. The effect arises from Coulomb drag between quasiparticles in a chiral superconductor and those in an adjacent time-reversal-symmetric normal layer. We develop a minimal hydrodynamic theory that includes both quasiparticle normal current and condensate supercurrent in the superconducting layer. In an open-circuit superconducting layer, the condensate generates a counterflowing supercurrent that cancels the net layer current, while a finite quasiparticle current remains and mediates the transverse drag response. This results in anomalous Hall voltage signal appearing abruptly when T is lowered below T_c, of the sign reflecting the sign of the superconducting order parameter phase winding.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出零磁场霍尔拖曳效应可作为手性超导的直接输运信号。该效应源于手性超导层中的准粒子与相邻时间反演对称正常层之间的库仑拖曳。作者建立包含准粒子正常电流和凝聚体超电流的最小流体动力学理论，指出在开路超导层中反向超电流抵消净电流，但有限准粒子电流仍可介导横向拖曳响应。由此产生的反常霍尔电压会在温度低于临界温度时突现，其符号反映超导序参量相位绕转方向。
authors: Vladislav Poliakov, Alex Levchenko, Leonid Levitov

articles.title: Large CISS Polarization from the Hierarchy Between Transport and Geometrical Spin Currents
articles.title_zh: 输运自旋流与几何自旋流层级差异导致的大 CISS 极化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30670v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large spin polarization observed in chiral-induced spin selectivity (CISS) remains difficult to explain quantitatively. Experimental polarizations measured in chiral molecular systems are often substantially larger than expected from weak microscopic spin-orbit interaction in organic materials. We revisit the geometrical spin current introduced previously for electrons constrained to curved paths and propose a scale argument relevant to transport through double-stranded DNA (dsDNA). Estimation of the intrinsic geometrical spin-current scale using representative dsDNA parameters yields current magnitudes substantially larger than measured transport currents in many CISS experiments. We suggest that this hierarchy allows transport to be interpreted as weak leakage from underlying curved spin-current states. Within this picture, large CISS polarization emerges as transport selection of pre-existing spin-current branches.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文重新考察手性诱导自旋选择性中难以用有机材料弱自旋—轨道相互作用解释的大自旋极化现象。作者基于电子受限于弯曲路径时的几何自旋流，提出适用于双链 DNA 输运的尺度论证。利用代表性 dsDNA 参数估算得到的内禀几何自旋流尺度显著大于许多 CISS 实验中的实测输运电流。该图像认为实际输运可视为底层弯曲自旋流态的弱泄漏，而大的 CISS 极化来自对预存自旋流分支的输运选择。
authors: Zeev Vager (Weizmann Institute of Science, Rehovot, Israel)

articles.title: Controlling the non-Markovianity of quantum Brownian motion
articles.title_zh: 量子布朗运动非马尔可夫性的可控调节
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30730v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We analyze the exact dynamics of a generalized quantum Brownian motion model, employing Gaussian master equation methods. We demonstrate that, by modulating the relative weights of specific interaction channels, we can control the degree of non-Markovianity of the system, and induce a transition from non-Markovian to Markovian regimes. The non-Markovianity of the evolution is formally characterized by leveraging the Gorini--Kossakowski--Sudarshan--Lindblad theorem and by employing quantitative measures of information backflow. Finally, we clarify the physical mechanism behind the phenomenology of this model, thereby providing a systematic platform for environment engineering through the strategic tuning of dissipation channels.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用高斯主方程方法分析广义量子布朗运动模型的精确动力学。作者表明，通过调节特定相互作用通道的相对权重，可以控制系统的非马尔可夫性程度，并诱导从非马尔可夫到马尔可夫动力学的转变。研究借助 Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad 定理和信息回流的定量度量来表征该过程，并阐明了背后的物理机制，为通过调控耗散通道进行环境工程提供了系统平台。
authors: Guglielmo Pellitteri, Vittorio Giovannetti, Vasco Cavina

articles.title: Disorder-Induced Enhancement of Fermionic Superradiance
articles.title_zh: 无序诱导的费米子超辐射增强
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30735v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Collective light-matter phenomena such as Dicke superradiance are often described as a collection of effective spins coupled homogeneously to a bosonic mode, giving rise to a collective bright mode with enhanced light-matter coupling. In fermionic systems, Pauli exclusion and Fermi-surface structure can significantly modify this picture, while randomness in the atom-light couplings raises the question of whether disorder promotes or suppresses collective behavior. Here, we study a cavity model in which fermionic particles couple to a photonic mode through a random all-to-all interaction matrix with tunable mean and variance. Combining numerical mean-field methods, analytic stability analysis and random-matrix predictions, and benchmarks against exact diagonalization, we characterize both the onset and structure of the superradiant phase. While mean coupling and disorder variance contribute in the same way to the onset, they lead to drastically different behavior within the condensed phase. Uniform coupling supports a single bright collective fermionic mode with conventional Dicke-like scaling of the cavity field. Disorder, instead, gives rise to a qualitatively different collective regime in which many grey fermionic states participate coherently, producing a parametrically enhanced scaling of the condensate with system size. Our results reveal a mechanism through which disorder can, perhaps counterintuitively, promote collective light-matter phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察费米子体系中随机光—物质耦合对 Dicke 型超辐射的影响。作者研究了一个腔模型，其中费米子通过具有可调均值和方差的随机全连接相互作用矩阵耦合到光子模，并结合数值平均场、解析稳定性分析、随机矩阵预测和精确对角化基准来刻画超辐射相的起始与结构。结果显示，平均耦合和无序方差对超辐射起始具有类似贡献，但在凝聚相内部导致截然不同的行为；均匀耦合支持单一明亮集体费米模，而无序会显著改变集体模式结构并可增强超辐射响应。
authors: David Pascual Solis, Andrea Legramandi, Soumik Bandyopadhyay, Philipp Hauke

articles.title: Diffusion-warm sampling of the XY model enables fast thermalization at scale
articles.title_zh: XY 模型的扩散预热采样实现大规模快速热化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30773v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce a novel technique for scalable sampling of spin-system states with continuous symmetries using diffusion models. By applying our approach to the XY model, a fundamental continuous-spin model in condensed matter physics, we show that our technique addresses the shortfalls of the Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) in generalization to varying system sizes. More specifically, we show that training a temperature-conditioned diffusion model on smaller-size XY model lattices enables the generation of accurate samples in larger lattice sizes. By tracking physically important observables of the model, such as spin correlations, our experiments demonstrate that diffusion sampling followed by a few MCMC steps reduces the thermalization time by an order of magnitude relative to the standard MCMC with random initialization. Our study provides valuable insight as to how generative models can be used to study continuous-state condensed matter systems at scale.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种利用扩散模型对具有连续对称性的自旋体系进行可扩展采样的新方法。以凝聚态物理中的 XY 模型为例，作者表明在较小晶格上训练的温度条件扩散模型能够生成较大晶格上的准确样本，从而改善传统 Markov 链 Monte Carlo 在系统尺寸变化上的泛化不足。通过跟踪自旋关联等物理观测量，研究发现扩散采样后接少量 MCMC 步骤可将热化时间相对于随机初始化的标准 MCMC 降低一个数量级。该工作展示了生成模型用于大规模连续态凝聚态体系研究的潜力。
authors: Sehmimul Hoque, Roger Melko, Pooya Ronagh

articles.title: Overcoming Configuration Bottleneck: Modular Pathways to Stable Semiconductor Spin-Qubit Arrays
articles.title_zh: 克服配置瓶颈：构建稳定半导体自旋量子比特阵列的模块化路径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30883v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Over the past decade, semiconductor spin qubits have progressed from few-qubit demonstrations towards larger-scale devices fabricated in increasingly reproducible academic and industrial processes. This progress marks an inflection point: the central challenge is no longer to demonstrate high-fidelity operation in carefully tuned devices, but to discover, verify, and maintain stable operating conditions reliably across many interdependent controls, varied device geometries, and disparate material platforms. In this Perspective, we frame spin-qubit operation as a modular automation problem. We decompose the workflow into five modules: bootstrapping from minimal prior information, configuration tuning, virtualization of physical gates into effective control axes, qubit-level tuning, and an operation layer with drift-aware maintenance.
