articles.abstract: Coupling single-atom catalysts (SACs) with plasmonic nanostructures offers a precise route to optimize solar-to-chemical energy conversion, yet the microscopic interplay between collective plasmon modes and localized atomic active sites remains elusive. Here, we employ real-time time-dependent density functional theory (rt-TDDFT) to reveal the ultrafast non-adiabatic dynamics of water splitting on a gold-doped silver nanocluster (Ag19Au). We demonstrate that replacing a vertex Ag atom in the tetrahedral Ag20 scaffold with a single Au atom does not merely enhance adsorbate binding, but fundamentally reconfigures the excited-state landscape. The Au dopant induces strong orbital hybridization near the Fermi level, establishing resonant interfacial charge transfer channels that are absent in the pure Ag counterpart. Upon photoexcitation, these channels facilitate the directional injection of plasmon-derived hot electrons into the O-H antibonding orbitals of the water molecule. This non-thermal mechanism drives irreversible bond dissociation within approximately 40 fs, proceeding on a timescale significantly faster than the rapid carrier thermalization that limits pure Ag clusters. These findings elucidate the quantum-mechanical role of single-atom dopants as charge regulators, providing a rigorous theoretical framework for engineering hot-electron transfer in plasmonic hybrids.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用实时含时密度泛函理论研究金掺杂银纳米团簇Ag19Au上水分裂的超快非绝热动力学。结果表明，单个Au原子替代Ag20四面体顶点Ag原子不仅增强吸附，还通过费米能级附近的强轨道杂化重构激发态能级，建立界面共振电荷转移通道。光激发后，等离激元热电子可定向注入水分子O–H反键轨道，并在约40 fs内驱动不可逆键解离，快于纯Ag团簇中载流子热化限制下的过程。

articles.title: Laser experiments push helium to record shock pressures
articles.title_zh: 激光实验将氦压缩至创纪录的冲击压力
articles.abstract: Deep inside gas giants like Jupiter and Saturn, hydrogen and helium coexist under pressures millions of times greater than Earth's atmosphere. Under those conditions, helium may separate from hydrogen and influence a planet's internal heat flow, structure and magnetic field. Understanding these processes and how these materials behave under extreme conditions is essential to building accurate models of planetary evolution.
articles.abstract_zh: 在木星和土星等气态巨行星内部，氢和氦共存于远高于地球大气压的极端压力环境中。在这些条件下，氦可能从氢中分离，从而影响行星内部热流、结构与磁场。该报道介绍了利用激光冲击实验研究氦在超高压力下行为的进展，这对建立更准确的行星演化模型具有重要意义。

articles.title: A magnetic field that kills superconductivity can also bring it back
articles.title_zh: 能够破坏超导的磁场也可能使超导重新出现
articles.abstract: Magnetic fields are generally known to destroy superconductivity in a material. However, in exceptional cases, they can lead to what is known as "re-entrant superconductivity"—where superconductivity disappears as expected, but then unexpectedly returns when the magnetic field is increased further.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁场通常会抑制或破坏材料中的超导性。然而在少数特殊体系中，随着磁场进一步增强，已消失的超导态可能再次出现，即所谓“重入超导”。该报道概述了这种反常现象及其对理解磁场、电子关联和超导机制之间关系的意义。

articles.title: Magnetic Flux Density as a Driver of Chromospheric and Coronal Emissions During the Rise of Solar Cycle 25
articles.title_zh: 太阳第25活动周上升期磁通量密度对色球和日冕辐射的驱动作用
articles.abstract: This study investigates the relationship between magnetic flux density (MFD) and key solar proxies (f10.7 cm radio flux, Mg II index, and Ca II K-line) during the ascending phase of Solar Cycle 25. Strong linear (((r = 0.94))--((0.96)))and monotonic (((h̊o = 0.85))) correlations indicate that solar magnetic fields are the primary drivers of chromosphericand coronal emissions. The temporal hierarchy revealed by correlogram analysis shows that MFD leads the chromospheric indices by 33 days, whileit has no lag with f10.7 cm, which is significant for space weather prediction. Wavelet analysis further identifies synchronized variability on 16--32 day timescales associated with solar rotation, reflecting coherent periodic behavior across different layersof the solar atmosphere.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了太阳第25活动周上升阶段磁通量密度与10.7厘米射电流量、Mg II指数和Ca II K线等太阳活动代理指标之间的关系。结果显示，磁通量密度与这些指标存在很强的线性和单调相关性，表明太阳磁场是色球和日冕辐射变化的主要驱动因素。相关图分析发现磁通量密度领先色球指标约33天，而与10.7厘米射电流量无明显滞后；小波分析还揭示了与太阳自转相关的16—32天同步变率。

articles.title: Molecular neighbours reshape protein dynamics
articles.title_zh: 分子邻近环境重塑蛋白质动力学
articles.abstract: Nature Chemistry, Published online: 25 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41557-026-02194-7 As proteins are dynamic molecular machines, to fully understand their functions we need to understand how they move. Now, nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy and molecular dynamics simulations reveal how motions of the GB1 protein domain are altered by its environment, suggesting that modulating structural plasticity could control protein function.
articles.abstract_zh: 蛋白质是动态的分子机器，理解其功能需要揭示其运动方式。该文报道核磁共振谱学与分子动力学模拟表明，GB1蛋白结构域的运动会受到周围环境调控，提示通过调节结构可塑性有望控制蛋白质功能。

articles.title: Hidden loop currents in a kagome metal
articles.title_zh: kagome金属中的隐藏环电流
articles.abstract: Nature Physics, Published online: 25 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03343-y Measurements made using nuclear quadrupole resonance and nuclear magnetic resonance have revealed tiny internal magnetic fields in a kagome metal. These fields are microscopic evidence of a hidden electronic order characterized by spontaneous atomic-scale current loops, and consistent with an imaginary charge-density wave.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用核四极共振和核磁共振测量，在一种kagome金属中发现了微弱的内部磁场。这些磁场为隐藏电子有序提供了微观证据，其特征是自发形成的原子尺度电流环，并与虚数电荷密度波图像相一致。

articles.title: Anomalous crossover from three-dimensional Heisenberg to two-dimensional Ising magnetism in a van der Waals magnet
articles.title_zh: 范德华磁体中从三维海森堡磁性到二维伊辛磁性的反常交叉
articles.abstract: Nature Physics, Published online: 25 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03356-7 Long-range magnetic order in low-dimensional systems depends on dimensionality and magnetic anisotropy. Now self-intercalation has been shown to tune a crossover from 3D Heisenberg to 2D Ising ferromagnetism in Fe3GeTe2.
articles.abstract_zh: 低维体系中的长程磁有序取决于体系维度与磁各向异性。该研究表明，在Fe3GeTe2中，自插层可以调控从三维海森堡铁磁性到二维伊辛铁磁性的交叉行为，为调节范德华磁体的磁性维度提供了途径。

articles.title: Real-Space Mapping of Electronic Conductivity in Complex Materials
articles.title_zh: 复杂材料中电子电导率的实空间映射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.24914v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce KuboMap, a real-space representation of electronic conductivity derived from the Kubo-Greenwood formula. KuboMap defines a nonnegative conductivity density whose spatial integral recovers the total conductivity and whose form is guided by Mott's picture of transport through spatially overlapping electronic states. This construction provides a direct map of the transport-active regions of a material. Applied to aluminum, KuboMap recovers an extended metallic conduction network. Applied to amorphous silicon, it distinguishes an insulating defect-free network from a defective structure in which localized near-Fermi states form connected hopping-like pathways. In silicon-oxides, it captures the loss of conduction as increasing oxygen content disrupts Silicon-rich transport networks. KuboMap provides a physically transparent route from Kubo--Greenwood conductivity to real-space transport pathways in complex materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出KuboMap，一种由Kubo-Greenwood公式导出的电子电导率实空间表示，可定义非负的电导率密度，其空间积分给出总电导率。该方法能够直接显示材料中参与输运的区域：在铝中恢复扩展的金属导电网络，在非晶硅中区分无缺陷绝缘网络与由近费米能级局域态形成的连通跃迁通道，并在硅氧化物中刻画随氧含量增加导致的导电网络破坏。KuboMap为复杂材料中从电导率计算到实空间输运路径的理解提供了物理透明的工具。
authors: C. Ugwumadu, D. A. Drabold, R. M. Tutchton

articles.title: Local spectroscopy of anyons bound to charge traps
articles.title_zh: 束缚于电荷陷阱的任意子的局域谱学研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25024v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fractional quantum Hall states host anyons, emergent quasiparticles with fractional charge and nontrivial exchange statistics. Controlling, trapping, and braiding anyons are central goals for both fundamental physics and topological quantum computation. A key step toward such control is understanding how anyons behave when confined in local potentials, where their internal structure can become relevant. Here, we use the scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy (STM/STS) to study the excitation spectrum in integer and fractional quantum Hall states of monolayer graphene near individual charged impurities. In the integer quantum Hall states, the STS spectra show lifting of orbital degeneracy near defects, appearing as a band of discrete energy levels. In fractional states, (v=1/3 and 2/5), however, we observe an additional energy splitting of the lowest-energy spectral feature that occurs only when the chemical potential lies within a fractional gap and is absent in compressible or integer regimes. We attribute this to many-body configurations of anyons trapped by an impurity potential. Strikingly, numerical calculations show that the splitting requires an anisotropic confining potential, vanishing for a rotationally symmetric trap. The competing multi-anyon states carry nearly identical charge within the core of the potential but differ in how that charge is redistributed at larger radius. Our results establish local tunneling spectroscopy as a direct probe of anyon bound states, providing a key step toward understanding and controlling their behavior in confined geometries relevant for braiding and fusion.
articles.abstract_zh: 分数量子霍尔态中存在具有分数电荷和非平庸交换统计的任意子，理解其在局域势阱中的行为是实现操控、俘获与编织的重要步骤。该研究利用扫描隧道显微镜/谱学研究单层石墨烯在带电杂质附近的整数量子霍尔态和分数量子霍尔态激发谱。在整数量子霍尔态中，缺陷附近轨道简并被解除并形成离散能级带；而在ν=1/3和2/5等分数量子霍尔态中，当化学势位于分数能隙内时出现最低能谱特征的额外劈裂，作者将其归因于被杂质势俘获的任意子多体构型。
authors: Jeong Min Park, Cristian Voinea, Yen-Chen Tsui, Songyang Pu, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Nigel R. Cooper, Michael P. Zaletel, Zlatko Papić, Ali Yazdani

articles.title: Real-space Imaging of Quantum Hall Quasiparticles
articles.title_zh: 量子霍尔准粒子的实空间成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25036v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum Hall systems host emergent quasiparticles with unusual charge, spin, and statistics, such as fractionally charged anyons. Although transport measurements have revealed many of their collective properties, identifying and visualizing individual quasiparticles remain elusive. Here we use scanning tunneling spectroscopy (STS) to image quantum Hall quasiparticles in graphene. Within incompressible quantum Hall states, we observe spatial variation of Landau level energies originating from electrostatic potentials created by charged defects in graphene and the underlying hexagonal boron nitride (hBN). For surface and near-surface defects, the Coulomb potential lifts the degeneracy of Landau orbitals, producing discrete energy splittings that reveal Landau orbital wavefunctions. In quantum Hall ferromagnetic states, quasiparticles bound to defect potentials produce distinct spatial and spectroscopic signatures that serve as hallmarks of the presence and number of localized excitations. In the fractional quantum Hall regime at one-third filling, our theoretical calculations predict discrete spectroscopic changes associated with the sequential addition of localized anyons, with a three-anyon bound state quantitatively reproducing our experimental data at ν = 5/3. These observations establish spectroscopic fingerprints of quantum Hall quasiparticles and provide a pathway toward imaging and manipulating individual anyons in real space.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子霍尔体系中可涌现具有异常电荷、自旋和统计性质的准粒子，但对单个准粒子的识别和可视化仍具挑战。该研究使用扫描隧道谱在石墨烯中成像量子霍尔准粒子，观察到由石墨烯及其下方六方氮化硼中带电缺陷产生的静电势引起的朗道能级空间变化。对于表面和近表面缺陷，库仑势会解除朗道轨道简并并产生离散能级劈裂，从而揭示朗道轨道波函数；在量子霍尔铁磁态中，束缚于缺陷势的准粒子呈现出可指示局域激发存在与数量的空间和谱学特征。
authors: Jinghao Deng, Yiming Sun, Dimitri Pimenov, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, Erich J Mueller, Xiaomeng Liu

articles.title: Exactly solvable pair-density wave in topological flat bands from magnetic translation symmetries
articles.title_zh: 由磁平移对称性产生的拓扑平带中精确可解的配对密度波
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25038v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pair-density wave (PDW) superconductors are exotic phases in which Cooper pairs carry finite center-of-mass momentum. Despite a variety of theoretical and experimental reports on PDW states, exact PDW ground states in topological bands have remained elusive. Here we construct exactly solvable models with PDW ground states in topological flat bands using a generalized version of the recently proposed quantum geometric nesting (QGN) framework. Our construction broadly applies to systems with non-commuting magnetic translation symmetries (MTS) and time-reversal symmetry, exemplified by the time-reversal invariant version of the Kapit-Mueller model with two ideal flat Chern bands with opposite Chern number. Our construction thus provides a platform for further studies of band topology and quantum geometry in PDW superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 配对密度波超导体是一类库珀对具有有限质心动量的奇异相，但拓扑能带中的精确配对密度波基态此前较难获得。作者利用推广的量子几何嵌套框架，在具有非对易磁平移对称性和时间反演对称性的拓扑平带中构造了精确可解的配对密度波基态模型。该构造以时间反演不变的Kapit-Mueller模型为例，包含两个理想平坦且陈数相反的陈能带，为研究配对密度波超导中的能带拓扑与量子几何提供了平台。
authors: Zhengzhi Wu, Zhou-Quan Wan, Steven H. Simon

articles.title: Quantum Geometry in the Continuum: Solitons in Shallow Lattices
articles.title_zh: 连续体系中的量子几何：浅晶格中的孤子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25064v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum geometry of electronic, photonic, and atomic lattice systems quantifies the distance in Hilbert space between Bloch states at neighboring lattice momenta. This quantity has profound implications for flat-band systems especially, characterizing surprising behavior such as superfluidity and superconductivity when the group velocity is zero and no transport would be expected for non-interacting particles. However, when the band is not flat, the effects of quantum geometry are often intertwined with and partly masked by the band dispersion. Here, we show that in weakly interacting bosonic systems in the critical dimension (i.e., two dimensions for Kerr nonlinearity), the deviation from critical behavior due to the presence of the lattice is governed by the quantum geometry, which is directly proportional to the fourth-order dispersion. Furthermore, we identify the family of continuous lattice potentials that saturates the bound on the quantum metric for a given effective mass tensor.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子几何刻画相邻晶格动量处Bloch态在希尔伯特空间中的距离，在平带体系中对超流和超导等现象具有重要影响。该研究表明，在临界维度的弱相互作用玻色体系中，晶格导致的临界行为偏离由量子几何控制，并且与四阶色散直接相关。作者还识别出一类连续晶格势，它们在给定有效质量张量下可达到量子度量的界限。

articles.title: Accelerating Chemical Potential Calculations with Minimal Normalizing Flows
articles.title_zh: 用极简归一化流加速化学势计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25229v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chemical potentials are among the most important properties that can be obtained from a molecular simulation since they define many technologically relevant collective properties. The chemical potential of a species in solution is obtained by computing the free energy change of adding that species into a bulk system, a calculation typically very expensive for systems such as electrolytes, due to the lack of phase space overlap between "not-inserted" and "inserted" states. Recently, normalizing flows have been introduced as a way to accelerate free energy computations by learning a bijective function, constructed to be as expressive as possible, that maps the configuration space of one Boltzmann distribution onto another. This expressivity makes them difficult to train, limiting their ability to be generated "on-the-fly" for any new system, and in practice these mappings have shown only modest sampling improvements for liquids. We address these issues by introducing a "minimal" normalizing flow (MNF). This is a trainable bijective mapping that is intentionally limited in expressivity, and instead applies low-dimensional, physically informed transformations. Useful MNFs can be trained in 1 minute of GPU time due to their simplicity and our introduction of a novel training strategy. We show how calculations of chemical potentials of Lennard-Jones particle systems can be accelerated by at least 10 times with a simple radial mapping. We also apply a radial and orientational mapping to ion solvation in water, showing that MNFs can increase the effective sample size by 3 times for charging free energy calculations and 8 times for calculating free energy changes due to force field perturbations. This provides the foundation for the development of physically-informed mappings that can accelerate complex free energy calculations while retaining low training costs.
articles.abstract_zh: 化学势是分子模拟中关键的热力学性质，通常通过计算向体相体系中加入某物种的自由能变化获得，但在电解质等体系中因相空间重叠不足而代价高昂。作者提出“极简”归一化流，这是一种有意限制表达能力、但可训练的双射映射，旨在利用低维且物理启发的变换来改进自由能采样。该方法试图缓解传统高表达归一化流训练困难、难以即时生成且在液体中采样提升有限的问题。

articles.title: Defect Engineered 2D MoS2 Materials for ML-enabled Neurotransmitter SERS Detection
articles.title_zh: 用于机器学习辅助神经递质SERS检测的缺陷工程二维MoS2材料
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25235v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An attachment of catechol-containing neurotransmitter molecules is demonstrated on defect-engineered two-dimensional MoS2 platform, leading to activation of SERS due to molecular charge transfer. Mechanisms of neurotransmitters' bio-detection are discussed and Machine Learning methods are applied to distinguish spectra of structurally similar analytes. The SERS effect and selective docking of biomolecules are achieved through an optimized approach for defect engineering: namely, introducing the sulfur vacancies in MoS2 monolayer films via soft plasma etching led to molecular attachment driven by catechol functional groups. The quality of the sensor material was controlled by Raman, photoluminescence, and XPS characterization, thus allowing for optimization of the process of defect formation and achieving sensing selectivity. The sensor material showed no response to serotonin, confirming the specificity of attachment/SERS due to S-vacancies that regulate the strength of catechol-specific molecular adsorption. Defect-engineered MoS2 has enabled SERS detection of dopamine and epinephrine down to the sub-nanomolar range (5×10⁻¹⁰ M), with strong calibration reliability (R² = 0.95 and 0.99 for pure samples). PCA-LDA achieved 100% accuracy in distinguishing dopamine and epinephrine, which establishes defect-engineered MoS2 as a tunable, low-cost SERS platform for future sensing applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了含儿茶酚基团的神经递质分子在缺陷工程二维MoS2平台上的附着，并通过分子电荷转移激活表面增强拉曼散射。作者通过软等离子体刻蚀在单层MoS2中引入硫空位，实现儿茶酚基团驱动的选择性吸附，并结合拉曼、光致发光和XPS表征优化缺陷形成过程。该传感材料对多巴胺和肾上腺素可实现亚纳摩尔浓度检测，并利用机器学习区分结构相近分析物的光谱；其对血清素无响应则支持了硫空位介导的选择性吸附机制。
authors: Md Arifur R. Khan, Besan Khader, Nicholas Trainor, Chen Chen, Joan M Redwing, Slava V Rotkin, Tetyana Ignatova

articles.title: The SU(N) Holstein Model
articles.title_zh: SU(N) Holstein模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25240v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: From the condensed matter physics perspective, the most natural single orbital tight-binding Hamiltonians, and hence the most widely studied, contain two fermionic species, corresponding to spin up and spin down electrons. In cold atom systems, however, SU(N) symmetry, in which N > 2 fermionic species reside within a single band, also occurs. In order to understand such experiments, the SU(N) Hubbard model has been increasingly studied. Here we present determinant Quantum Monte Carlo simulations of the SU(N) it Holstein Hamiltonian, in which N fermionic species couple to a single local phonon mode. We show that at half filling it has an insulating charge density wave phase (CDW) at low temperatures, in which empty sites alternate with sites with N particles. We determine the N=3 CDW phase diagram in the temperature, T, versus electron-phonon coupling, α, plane at fixed phonon frequency ømega₀ and half-filling h̊o=1.5. The critical temperature T_c for N=3 can be as high as twice the maximum attainable for N=2. We also obtain the N dependence of T_c for a representative, fixed, ømega₀ and α.
articles.abstract_zh: 在冷原子体系中，单能带内可出现N>2种费米子组分的SU(N)对称性，因此需要研究相应的电子-声子模型。作者采用行列式量子蒙特卡罗模拟SU(N) Holstein哈密顿量，其中N种费米子耦合到同一个局域声子模。结果显示，在半填充和低温下体系形成绝缘的电荷密度波相，空位与含N个粒子的位点交替排列；文中给出了N=3在温度与电子-声子耦合平面上的相图，并发现其临界温度可显著高于N=2情形。
authors: Chunhan Feng, Linh Pham, George Batrouni, Richard Scalettar

articles.title: Intrinsic Magnetic Excitations and Heavy-Fermion Formation in the Frustrated Mn Pyrochlore System YMn₂₊δZn₂₀₋ₓXₓ (X = In and Al) Revealed by Nuclear Magnetic Resonance and Nuclear Quadrupole Resonance Measurements
articles.title_zh: 核磁共振与核四极共振揭示受挫Mn烧绿石体系YMn₂₊δZn₂₀₋ₓXₓ（X=In和Al）中的本征磁激发与重费米子形成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25242v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We performed nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) and nuclear quadrupole resonance (NQR) measurements to investigate the microscopic electronic states of the d-electron heavy-fermion candidates mathrmYMn₂₊δZn₂₀₋ₓInₓ and mathrmYMn₂₊δZn₂₀₋ₓAlₓ. In these compounds, magnetic fluctuations of the Mn pyrochlore lattice are expected to play an important role in heavy-fermion formation; however, excess Mn atoms complicate the interpretation of the physical properties. Our spectral analysis reveals that In substitution exhibits much higher site selectivity and introduces significantly less disorder in local structure than Al substitution. The temperature dependence of the nuclear spin-lattice relaxation rate divided by temperature 1/T₁T measured by ⁵⁵Mn-NQR shows a clear enhancement at low temperatures, indicating the development of low-energy excitations associated with heavy-fermion formation. However, its absolute magnitude is approximately 20 times smaller than that in the related compound YMn₂, which hosts stronger antiferromagnetic correlations, indicating that the magnetic interactions are substantially weakened by the enlarged Mn-Mn distance. These results demonstrate that the heavy-fermion state in this system arises from the Mn pyrochlore network and is more closely associated with frustration-induced magnetic excitations with low energy than with conventional antiferromagnetic quantum-critical fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者通过核磁共振和核四极共振研究d电子重费米子候选材料YMn₂₊δZn₂₀₋ₓInₓ和YMn₂₊δZn₂₀₋ₓAlₓ的微观电子态。在这些化合物中，Mn烧绿石晶格的磁涨落预计对重费米子形成很重要，但过量Mn原子会使物性解释复杂化。谱学分析表明，In取代比Al取代具有更高的位点选择性并引入更少局域结构无序；55Mn-NQR测得的1/T1T在低温增强，显示与重费米子形成相关的低能激发发展，但其强度弱于相关化合物YMn2，表明增大的Mn-Mn距离削弱了磁相互作用。
authors: Shunsaku Kitagawa, Kenji Ishida, Yoshihiko Okamoto, Zenji Hiroi

articles.title: NMR evidence for a loop-current state with broken C₆ symmetry in the charge-ordered CsV₃Sb₅
articles.title_zh: 电荷有序 CsV₃Sb₅ 中具有破缺 C₆ 对称性的环电流态的 NMR 证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25251v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Loop-current (LC) order and the associated time-reversal symmetry breaking (TRSB) are pivotal for understanding hidden magnetism and unconventional superconductivity in strongly correlated quantum materials. The recently discovered kagome metal CsV₃Sb₅ provides a unique platform for exploring these intertwined phenomena. In this study, we utilize ¹²¹Sb nuclear quadrupole resonance (NQR) and ⁵¹V nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) measurements to investigate the possible existence of the LC order in CsV₃Sb₅. Below T^ast approx 45 K, we observe a field-independent NMR linewidth broadening at the V site in a high-quality single crystal, which indicates an internal magnetic field of 3.6 Oe at the V position. We show that this internal field arises from a static LC state that produces orbital magnetic moments μₘ̊ ₒᵣb ranging from 0.002 to 0.01 μ_B. Detailed analysis suggests that the observed LC state breaks C₆ rotational symmetry to possess a low symmetry of C₂. Our results provide microscopic evidence for LC order in the charge density wave (CDW) phase of CsV₃Sb₅ and show that TRSB is intertwined with electronic nematicity, imposing stringent constraints on microscopic descriptions of the kagome CDW and its relation to superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用 ¹²¹Sb 核四极共振和 ⁵¹V 核磁共振测量，探讨 kagome 金属 CsV₃Sb₅ 中环电流有序及其相关时间反演对称性破缺。作者在约 45 K 以下观察到 V 位点场无关的 NMR 线宽展宽，对应约 3.6 Oe 的内部磁场，并将其归因于静态环电流态产生的微弱轨道磁矩。进一步分析表明该环电流态将 C₆ 旋转对称性降低至 C₂，对 CsV₃Sb₅ 电荷密度波相中环电流有序及其与电子向列性的交织提供了微观证据。
authors: X. Y. Feng, Z. Zhao, J. Dou, S. Li, J. Luo, J. Yang, H. T. Yang, H. -J. Gao, R. Zhou, Guo-qing Zheng

articles.title: Kohn anomaly in a topological phase transition
articles.title_zh: 拓扑相变中的 Kohn 异常
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25381v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological crystalline insulators extend the concept of topological insulators by hosting surface states protected by crystallographic symmetry. Their topological phase transitions arise from spin-orbit-driven band inversion in the bulk electronic structure, reshaping the low-energy electronic environment and its coupling to lattice excitations. While the electronic aspects of band topology are well established, the corresponding dynamics of lattice and electron-phonon interactions remain largely unexplored. Here, we report a pronounced softening of a low-energy surface phonon mode across the topological phase transition in Pb0.77Sn0.23Se, revealed by temperature-dependent time-domain terahertz spectroscopy. Unlike the well-known phonon softening in ferroelectrics, this effect does not signal a structural instability but instead reflects electronic reconstruction. We attribute the softening to the Kohn anomaly, indicating a strong coupling between lattice vibrations and Dirac-like surface electrons in the topological phase. Consistently, the phonon linewidth deviates from the standard anharmonic temperature dependence, further evidencing enhanced electron-phonon coupling. Our results establish phonon softening as a spectroscopic signature of topological phase transitions and provide a route to distinguish topological and trivial phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究拓扑晶体绝缘体 Pb₀.₇₇Sn₀.₂₃Se 在拓扑相变过程中晶格动力学与电子-声子耦合的变化。通过温度依赖的时域太赫兹光谱，作者观察到低能表面声子模在相变附近显著软化，且不同于铁电体系中的结构不稳定软化。研究将这一现象归因于 Kohn 异常，表明拓扑相中 Dirac 型表面电子与晶格振动之间存在强耦合，声子线宽的异常温度依赖也支持这一解释。
authors: Jingwen Li, Arpita Dutta, Kush Saha, Andrzej Szczerbakow, Tomasz Story, Manfred Fiebig, Shovon Pal

articles.title: Intrinsic Defect Energetics and Fluorine Doping Effects in Li2CO3 and Li2O2: A First-Principles Study
articles.title_zh: Li₂CO₃ 与 Li₂O₂ 中本征缺陷能学及氟掺杂效应的第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25408v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lithium carbonate, Li2CO3, is a thermodynamically stable carbonate phase whose defect energetics are closely related to its stability and decomposition behavior in various lithium-based electrochemical systems. These properties of Li2CO3 are particularly important in lithium-oxygen battery environments. In these systems, Li2CO3 can form as a parasitic discharge product alongside Li2O2, the primary discharge product, leading to performance degradation. However, compared with Li2O2, the intrinsic defect thermodynamics of Li2CO3 and how chemical doping modifies its defect energetics remain insufficiently understood. In this study, first-principles calculations were performed to systematically analyze the intrinsic point-defect energetics of Li2CO3 and to evaluate the effects of fluorine doping on vacancy formation energies in Li2CO3 and Li2O2. Intrinsic defect analysis reveals that defect behavior is predominantly governed by lithium-related defects. Upon fluorine doping, lithium and carbon vacancy formation energies decrease selectively in Li2CO3, partially destabilizing the carbonate framework, while a reduction in lithium vacancy formation energy is also observed in Li2O2. These results suggest that fluorine doping modulates the defect energetics of both discharge products, potentially providing a thermodynamic basis for controlling the stability of Li2CO3 and Li2O2 under thermodynamic conditions representative of lithium-oxygen batteries.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用第一性原理计算系统分析 Li₂CO₃ 的本征点缺陷能学，并评估氟掺杂对 Li₂CO₃ 和 Li₂O₂ 中空位形成能的影响。结果表明，Li₂CO₃ 的缺陷行为主要受锂相关缺陷支配。氟掺杂会选择性降低 Li₂CO₃ 中锂空位和碳空位的形成能，从而部分削弱碳酸盐骨架稳定性；同时也会影响 Li₂O₂ 中锂空位形成能，对理解锂氧电池中副产物稳定性具有意义。
authors: Youjeong Choi, Tasuku Sugiura, Keisuke Mukai, Nanako Ishihara, Shuji Nakanishi, Teruyasu Mizoguchi

articles.title: Spin-imbalanced fermion on a dynamic lattice
articles.title_zh: 动态晶格上的自旋不平衡费米子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25411v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the magnetic order of a one-dimensional spin-1/2 fermion dynamical lattice, where itinerant fermions are coupled to bond-centered localized spins via an Ising-like spin dependent hopping. The model provides an anisotropic dynamical extension of conventional spin-1/2 fermion systems, in which the motion of itinerant fermions is directly modulated by the configuration of localized spins. Using density matrix renormalization group simulations, we map out the ground state phase diagram in various parameter spaces. Depending on the interplay among the hopping dependent on localized spins, the longitudinal field, and the external Zeeman field, two distinct phases are obtained: a paramagnetic phase and a spin-density-wave phase. Most notably, in the partially spin-polarized fermion phase, the spin-density wave ordering wave vector exhibits two distinct phenomena, corresponding respectively to the nesting vectors 2kFₚ̆ₐᵣᵣₒw and 2kFdₒwₙₐᵣᵣₒw of the spin-resolved Fermi surfaces. We further demonstrate that the two spin-density wave phases are robust against the repulsive Hubbard interaction between itinerant fermions. Our results reveal a novel route for tuning magnetic modulations in one-dimensional correlated systems and enrich the microscopic understanding of dynamical lattice magnetism.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究一维自旋 1/2 费米子动态晶格中的磁有序，其中巡游费米子通过类 Ising 的自旋依赖跃迁与键中心局域自旋耦合。利用密度矩阵重整化群模拟，作者绘制了不同参数空间下的基态相图，发现顺磁相和自旋密度波相。尤其在部分自旋极化费米子相中，自旋密度波有序波矢表现出分别对应不同自旋分辨费米面的 2kF 嵌套特征，并且这些相对排斥 Hubbard 相互作用具有稳健性。
authors: Jie Liu, Xiaofan Zhou, Suotang Jia

articles.title: Emergence of Quasi-two-dimensional Superconductivity in W-doped Bulk Noncentrosymmetric 3R-TaSe₂
articles.title_zh: W 掺杂块体非中心对称 3R-TaSe₂ 中准二维超导性的涌现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25416v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Noncentrosymmetric transition-metal dichalcogenides offer a rich environment for the study of unconventional superconducting phenomena. Here, we present a comprehensive analysis of single-crystalline W-doped 3R-TaSe₂, revealing weakly coupled anisotropic unconventional superconductivity at T_c = 2.82(2) K, with an in-plane upper critical field exceeding the Pauli limit by 1.7 times. The angular dependence of the upper critical field, along with the observation of a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transition, reveals quasi-two-dimensional superconductivity. Crucially, magnetotransport reveals a distinct two-fold rotational symmetry within the superconducting state under in-plane fields, breaking the underlying three-fold lattice symmetry. These findings establish W-doped 3R-TaSe₂ as a bulk model system for exploring intrinsic low-dimensional superconductivity and broken rotational symmetry, thus opening new directions for future quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究对单晶 W 掺杂 3R-TaSe₂ 进行了系统表征，发现其在 Tc = 2.82(2) K 处出现弱耦合、各向异性的非常规超导。面内上临界场超过 Pauli 极限约 1.7 倍，上临界场角度依赖及 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless 转变共同指向准二维超导性。磁输运还显示超导态在面内磁场下具有二重旋转对称性，破缺了晶格原有三重对称性，使该材料成为研究本征低维超导和旋转对称性破缺的块体平台。

articles.title: Spin-flip optical excitations in van der Waals antiferromagnet CrPS₄
articles.title_zh: 范德华反铁磁体 CrPS₄ 中的自旋翻转光学激发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25470v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the near-infrared optical response of the semiconducting van der Waals antiferromagnet CrPS₄ and identify previously unreported spin-entangled optical resonances. The strong and anisotropic magnetic-field dependence of these resonances reflects the underlying magnetic order and confirms the biaxial antiferromagnetic nature of CrPS₄. From the magnetic field evolution of the optical transition, we extract key magnetic parameters, including the spin-flop (approx0.9~T) and spin-saturation (approx8~T) fields. These results demonstrate a potential pathway for all-optical probing of spin states in van der Waals antiferromagnets, with relevance for spin-sensitive optoelectronic and magneto-optical devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究半导体范德华反铁磁体 CrPS₄ 的近红外光学响应，并识别出此前未报道的自旋纠缠光学共振。共振峰表现出强烈且各向异性的磁场依赖，反映其底层磁有序并证实 CrPS₄ 的双轴反铁磁特性。通过光学跃迁随磁场的演化，作者提取了自旋翻转场约 0.9 T 和自旋饱和场约 8 T 等关键磁参数，展示了全光学探测范德华反铁磁体自旋态的潜力。
authors: Dipankar Jana, Aljoscha Soll, Zdenek Sofer, Milan Orlita, Clement Faugeras, Maciej Koperski, Marek Potemski

articles.title: A Differentiable DFT-Based Framework for Inverse Materials Design
articles.title_zh: 一种基于可微 DFT 的反向材料设计框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25502v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Discovering solid-state materials with target properties remains a central challenge in computational materials science. Existing approaches -- high-throughput screening, surrogate optimization, and generative models -- require extensive evaluations or training data and extrapolate poorly to unseen compositions. Here we develop a first-principles inverse-design framework, integrating reverse-mode automatic differentiation (AD) into KKR-CPA -- the Korringa--Kohn--Rostoker method with the coherent potential approximation -- where atomic compositions are continuous variables to be optimized. Reverse-mode AD yields gradients of objective functions with respect to composition at a cost independent of the number of candidate elements, enabling gradient-based optimization to identify materials from compositional spaces spanning dozens of elements. In this framework, any computable quantity can serve as the objective. We demonstrate this generality through two contrasting applications, magnetic alloys and half-metals, yielding candidates such as (Lu₀.₅₅₃Yb₀.₄₄₇)(Co₀.₇₅₉Fe₀.₂₄₁)₂Fe₃ and FeZr(Sb₀.₉₄Te₀.₀₆). Our framework offers a physically grounded route from a target property to the material that realizes it.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种第一性原理反向设计框架，将反向模式自动微分整合进 KKR-CPA 方法，使原子组成可作为连续变量进行优化。反向自动微分能够以与候选元素数量无关的成本计算目标函数对成分的梯度，从而在包含数十种元素的组成空间中进行梯度优化。作者以磁性合金和半金属为例展示了框架的通用性，并给出若干候选材料，表明该方法可为目标性质导向的固体材料发现提供物理约束的优化路线。
authors: Kohei Ishii, Hisazumi Akai, Tetsuya Fukushima, Hikari Shinya, Koji Inui

articles.title: Dynamic dissipative structures in bistable magnetic ordered spin crossover systems: self-oscillations of magnetization
articles.title_zh: 双稳磁有序自旋交叉系统中的动态耗散结构：磁化强度自振荡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25506v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dissipative systems can exhibit a variety of behavioral modes, ranging from complex deterministic chaos to the spontaneous emergence of ordered structures. A simple example of the latter is Benard cells. More complex examples include lasers, droplet clusters, the Belousov--Zhabotinsky reaction, and biological life. Of particular interest in the context of the formation of spatiotemporal dissipative structures are bistable systems with spin crossover. This paper discusses the possibility of observing self-oscillations of magnetization in magnetically ordered systems with spin crossover. The results of theoretical calculations of the nonlinear dynamics of bistable magnetic systems under nonequilibrium conditions are presented.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文讨论具有自旋交叉的双稳磁有序系统在非平衡条件下形成时空耗散结构的可能性。作者重点分析磁化强度自振荡是否可在此类系统中出现，并给出非线性动力学的理论计算结果。研究将自旋交叉双稳性与耗散系统中的自组织行为联系起来，为探索磁性材料中的动态有序结构提供理论参考。
authors: Yu. S. Orlov, N. N. Paklin, S. V. Nikolaev, E. I. Shneyder, V. A. Dudnikov

articles.title: Mode-locking in a colloidal ring driven by power-modulated optical tweezers
articles.title_zh: 由功率调制光镊驱动的胶体环中的锁模现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25538v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Particles and clusters moving across real-space periodic potentials can become locked to discrete directions or orientations due to competing symmetries. Here, we demonstrate an analogous locking phenomenon within a synthetic frequency space. We drive ring-shaped colloidal clusters using a circular optical tweezer array, where power modulation of the traps generates coexisting, distinct potential waves. Relative displacements between the cluster and these waves trace zigzag trajectories across a synthetic two-dimensional lattice, mirroring directionally locked motion in real-space periodic potentials. By tuning the relative wave amplitudes, both the cluster's direction in synthetic space and its velocity in real space exhibit discrete plateaus, both governed by square-lattice symmetry. Furthermore, the formation of superlattices between the particles and potential wave minima mirrors the characteristic features of kinetically locked two-dimensional clusters, demonstrating the capability to explore driven cluster dynamics within higher-dimensional potentials using lower-dimensional setups. Our findings establish new strategies for controlling transport of particle clusters via power-modulated laser tweezers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在由圆形光镊阵列驱动的环形胶体团簇中展示了一种发生在合成频率空间中的锁定现象。光阱功率调制产生多个共存的势波，团簇与势波之间的相对位移在合成二维晶格中形成锯齿轨迹，类似实空间周期势中的方向锁定运动。通过调节相对波幅，团簇在合成空间中的运动方向和实空间速度均出现由方格对称性控制的离散平台，并可模拟二维团簇的动力学锁定与超晶格形成。
authors: Muyang Huang, Pik-Yin Lai, Xiaoguang Ma

articles.title: Valence-change-driven reduction of antiphase boundaries in spinel ferrite epitaxial films
articles.title_zh: 尖晶石铁氧体外延薄膜中由价态变化驱动的反相边界减少
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25617v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Antiphase boundaries (APBs) formed in thin films sometimes cause severe degradation of their physical properties. In particular, a high density of APBs in spinel ferrite films generates a non-negligible magnetic dead layer near the interface. In this study, we examined the effect of post-oxidation annealing in an oxygen plasma atmosphere on Co₀.₁₂₅Fe₂.₈₇₅O₄₍₀₀₁₎ thin films grown on MgO(001) as a model system. The thickness of the magnetic dead layer was found to be significantly reduced after post-oxidation, resulting in an increase in the saturation magnetization and an improved squareness ratio. Dark-field transmission electron microscopy analysis revealed that the post-oxidation process increased the antiphase domain size, indicating a substantial reduction in APB density. Furthermore, reflection high-energy electron diffraction and x-ray diffraction measurements confirmed that the spinel crystal structure and epitaxial strain were preserved after post-oxidation. These results suggest that post-oxidation proceeds through a topotactic solid-state reaction in which Fe².⁵⁺ ions are oxidized to Fe³⁺, accompanied by cation rearrangement across APBs, thereby reducing APB density without degrading crystallinity and leading to improved magnetic properties in spinel ferrite epitaxial films.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以 MgO(001) 衬底上的 Co₀.₁₂₅Fe₂.₈₇₅O₄(001) 薄膜为模型，考察氧等离子体气氛后氧化退火对反相边界的影响。结果显示，后氧化显著减小磁死层厚度，提高饱和磁化强度和磁滞回线方形度。暗场透射电镜表明反相畴尺寸增大、反相边界密度降低，而衍射实验确认尖晶石结构和外延应变得以保持；这一过程被解释为 Fe².⁵⁺ 氧化为 Fe³⁺ 并伴随阳离子重排的拓扑固相反应。
authors: Kouki Takeo, Eiji Kita, Hideto Yanagihara

articles.title: Critical Universality of the SU (2) Gauge Glass Model Analyzed by the Dynamical Scaling Method
articles.title_zh: 用动力学标度方法分析 SU(2) 规范玻璃模型的临界普适性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25618v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the critical phenomena of the three-dimensional (3D) SU(2) gauge glass model, which can be regarded as the O(4) spin-glass model with gauge symmetry. Using Monte Carlo simulations and the non-equilibrium relaxation method, we examine the critical behavior along phase boundaries across various degrees of disorder. Consistent with previous studies, we verify that weak disorder is irrelevant to the universality class; the critical behavior of the ferromagnetic-paramagnetic transition remains in the 3D O(4) universality class of the pure ferromagnetic system. Additionally, we demonstrate that the paramagnetic-spin glass transition exhibits universal critical behavior independent of the disorder. Our findings provide valuable insights into the fundamental properties and universality of gauge glass models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究三维 SU(2) 规范玻璃模型的临界现象，该模型可视为具有规范对称性的 O(4) 自旋玻璃模型。作者利用蒙特 Carlo 模拟和非平衡弛豫方法，考察不同无序强度下相边界附近的临界行为。结果验证弱无序不改变铁磁-顺磁转变的普适类，其仍属于纯三维 O(4) 铁磁体系；同时表明顺磁-自旋玻璃转变具有与无序强度无关的普适临界行为。
authors: Yosei Takada, Yusuke Terasawa, Yuma Osada, Yukiyasu Ozeki

articles.title: Rate Programmable Ionic-Redox Switching with Tunable Volatility in CuCrP2S6
articles.title_zh: CuCrP₂S₆ 中速率可编程且挥发性可调的离子-氧化还原开关
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25679v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Metal thiophosphates are emerging as a multifunctional material platform for neuromorphic electronics due to their accessible polar phases and ion dynamics on biologically relevant timescales. While resistive switching in these materials is frequently attributed to ferroelectric or antiferroelectric polarization, the intrinsic role of ion dynamics remains underexplored. Here, we isolate and demonstrate purely ion-driven resistive switching in paraelectric CuCrP2S6. Robust and reproducible resistive switching is observed in the absence of measurable ferroelectricity. The conductance can be tuned through both voltage amplitude and sweep rate, revealing a rate dependence characteristic of ion dynamics. The resulting resistance states exhibit controllable volatility, where switching rate determines the decay time constant of the readout current, attributed to ionic relaxation. Using either inert or reactive electrodes, we observe electrical evidence of solid-state redox activity associated with the interfacial reduction of native Cu+ ions, enabling controlled formation of filamentary conduction pathways. Analysis of this process allows extraction of the Cu+ diffusion coefficient, providing quantitative insight into the underlying transport kinetics. The understanding of ionic-redox based resistive switching in CuCrP2S6 is crucial for unleashing its full potential as a material platform for dual- or multi-mode operation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在顺电 CuCrP₂S₆ 中分离并展示了纯离子驱动的电阻开关行为，说明在无可测铁电性的情况下也能实现稳定可重复的电导调控。电导可通过电压幅值和扫描速率调节，表现出离子动力学特征的速率依赖性；不同电阻态具有可控挥发性，其读出电流衰减时间常数由开关速率决定。作者还在惰性或反应性电极下观察到与本征 Cu⁺ 离子界面还原相关的固态氧化还原活动，可形成受控的丝状导电通道，为神经形态电子器件提供了材料机制。
authors: Suzanne Lancaster, Francesco Calavalle, Mayank Sharma, Lucia Olano-Vegas, Garen Avedissian, Tanweer Ahmed, Marco Gobbi, Beatriz Martin-Garcia, Beatrice Fraboni, Felix Casanova, Luis E. Hueso

articles.title: Barocaloric phase transformation from data efficient fine-tuning of machine learned interatomic potentials
articles.title_zh: 通过数据高效微调机器学习原子间势研究压热相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25742v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solid-state cooling based on the barocaloric (BC) effect has emerged as promising environmentally friendly prospective alternative to conventional vapor-compression refrigeration. The search for suitable BC materials relies on efficient atomistic simulations of their phase behavior. Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) enable such simulations at near density functional theory (DFT) accuracy, but generating the required DFT training data remains computationally demanding, which motivates development of strategies that reduce the amount of data needed to train accurate models. In this work, we use a prototypical BC material, ammonium sulfate, as a model system and investigate how small a training set can be while still reproducing the temperature-driven structural phase transformation that underlies its BC response. We train a series of MLIPs based on the MACE architecture using three strategies: training from scratch, and naive- and multihead replay fine-tuning of the MACE-MPA-0 foundation model. These strategies are evaluated on their ability to reproduce the phase transformation of ammonium sulfate in molecular dynamics simulations across a range of training-set sizes. We find that, while the MACE-MPA-0 foundation model itself fails to reproduce the transformation, and models trained from scratch break down for small datasets, fine-tuned models reproduce the transformation using as few as 5 to 10 60-atom DFT configurations. Both fine-tuning protocols yield similarly accurate results for ammonium sulfate, but we also find some indications that multihead replay fine-tuning is more robust on configurations outside the fine-tuning domain. Exploiting this data efficiency, we further show that models can be trained on small datasets and the hybrid-DFT level, and that some form of inclusion of dispersion correction is necessary to describe the phase behavior correctly.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以典型压热材料硫酸铵为模型，探讨在尽量减少密度泛函理论训练数据的情况下，机器学习原子间势能否准确再现其温度驱动结构相变。作者基于 MACE 架构比较了从头训练、朴素微调以及多头回放微调基础模型等策略，并通过分子动力学模拟评估其对相变行为的预测能力。该工作旨在为压热材料的高效原子尺度模拟和数据节约型势函数构建提供方法依据。

articles.title: Thermoelectric response of a ferroelectric insulator
articles.title_zh: 铁电绝缘体的热电响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25767v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thermoelectric effects enable the conversion between heat and electricity without moving parts. While conventionally associated with mobile charges, we report thermoelectricity caused by bound charges in the form of temperature changes measured by multi-harmonic lock-in thermography of a ferroelectric under an ac electric field. The observed temperature gradient depends on the field-induced displacement current, a Peltier effect in a dielectric material. Its coefficient exceeds 100 V around the ferroelectric-paraelectric phase transition, which is several orders of magnitude greater than reported values in conductors. Our findings uncover previously hidden functionalities of ferroelectric materials for thermal management by directional heat transport in ferroelectrics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了铁电材料中由束缚电荷引起的热电效应，而非传统导体中由移动载流子主导的热电效应。作者利用多谐波锁相热成像，在交流电场下测量铁电体的温度变化，发现温度梯度与场致位移电流相关，体现出介电材料中的珀尔帖效应。其系数在铁电—顺电相变附近超过 100 V，显著高于已报道导体中的数值，揭示了铁电材料在定向热输运和热管理中的潜在功能。
authors: Ryo Iguchi, Takashi Teranishi, Sakyo Hirose, Ping Tang, Jun Kano, Gerrit E. W. Bauer, Ken-ichi Uchida

articles.title: Brillouin Light Scattering Spectroscopy of Propagating Magnons at Sub-Kelvin Temperatures
articles.title_zh: 亚开尔文温度下传播磁振子的布里渊光散射光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25834v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coupling light to magnetic excitations in the form of spin waves underpins both the optical study of magnetism and emerging schemes for quantum transduction, positioning the quanta of these excitations, magnons, as promising carriers for hybrid quantum networks. However, exploiting them in the quantum regime requires millikelvin temperatures to suppress thermal magnon populations, thereby confining such experiments to dilution refrigerators. There, magnons can already be excited and read out electrically, yet an optical interface required for microwave-to-optical photon conversion has been missing. Here, we demonstrate the first optical detection of coherently driven, propagating spin waves via Brillouin Light Scattering (BLS) spectroscopy inside a dilution refrigerator. By simultaneously recording the optical and electrical responses of the same spin-wave mode in a yttrium iron garnet film, we find that the BLS spectra track the electrically measured transmission across a range of applied magnetic fields. For the lowest optical power of 7.9 μW that still enabled spin-wave detection, we measured a global equilibrium sample temperature of 510 mK via a resistance thermometer, while numerical modelling of the laser-induced heating yields a maximum local temperature of 900 mK at the focal spot. This brings free-space optical access to magnons into the sub-kelvin regime, representing a milestone towards magnon-mediated quantum transduction in hybrid quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究首次在稀释制冷机内通过布里渊光散射光谱实现了对相干驱动传播自旋波的光学探测。作者在钇铁石榴石薄膜中同时记录同一自旋波模式的光学与电学响应，发现布里渊光散射谱能够随外加磁场变化追踪电学传输信号。该结果为毫开尔文量子 regime 中磁振子的光学接口以及微波—光子量子转换提供了重要实验基础。
authors: David Schmoll, Nikolai Kuznetsov, Phillip Rehberger, Franz Vilsmeier, Roman Verba, Denys Slobodianiuk, Rostyslav O. Serha, Khrystyna O. Levchenko, Sebastiaan van Dijken, Andrii V. Chumak, Sebastian Knauer

articles.title: Spontaneous spin splitting and tunable valley polarization in a two-dimensional fully compensated ferrimagnet
articles.title_zh: 二维全补偿亚铁磁体中的自发自旋劈裂与可调谷极化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25843v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Materials with controllable valley polarization and anomalous valley Hall (AVH) effect are highly desired in valleytronic applications. While current AVH studies primarily focus on ferromagnetic materials, two-dimensional (2D) antiferromagnets are more attractive for valleytronics since they possess zero net magnetization, negligible stray fields, and ultrafast spin dynamics. Nevertheless, the joint space-inversion and time-reversal (PT) symmetry in conventional collinear antiferromagnets prohibits the occurrence of AVH response. The recently proposed fully compensated ferrimagnets break PT symmetry, and the spin-opposite sublattices are not related by crystal symmetry, providing a natural platform for the coexistence of spontaneous spin splitting, valley polarization, and anomalous-Hall compatible symmetry. Herein, we demonstrate that such compensated ferrimagnetism can be realized in a Janus Mn₂BrI monolayer, with a Néel temperature above room temperature. Spontaneous spin splitting is observed due to the built-in layer-dependent electrostatic potential. When SOC is considered, valley polarization emerges for an out-of-plane Néel vector. Moreover, proper hole doping stabilizes the perpendicular magnetic anisotropy and the two valleys exhibit markedly different Berry curvatures, thereby making AHE responses allowed. Furthermore, the valence band extrema of Mn₂BrI monolayer can be effectively tuned by external biaxial strain and giant piezomagnetism can be achieved. Our results identify Janus Mn₂BrI monolayer as a promising fully compensated ferrimagnetic platform for 2D valleytronics and spintronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出 Janus Mn₂BrI 单层可实现室温以上 Néel 温度的全补偿亚铁磁性，并由于破缺 PT 对称性而具备谷电子学应用所需的对称条件。材料中内建的层依赖静电势导致自发自旋劈裂；考虑自旋轨道耦合后，在面外 Néel 矢量条件下出现谷极化。该工作表明全补偿亚铁磁体可兼具零净磁化、可调谷极化和异常谷霍尔效应相关响应。
authors: Hongyan Lv, Yueli Li, Yunfan Zhang, Jiayu Dai, Zhongjun Li, Ding-Fu Shao

articles.title: Harnessing electrostatics through temperature modulations to control ferroelectrics
articles.title_zh: 利用温度调制中的静电效应控制铁电体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25850v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Temperature modulations provide an alternative method for dynamically controlling the ferroelectric state. In this paper, we use scale-independent Landau potentials and predictive atomistic simulations to explore how temperature modulation can harness the depolarizing field to obtain non-electrical poling. We further predict that temperature gradients can be combined with strain to induce persistent polar textures such as multidomain states.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨温度调制作为动态控制铁电态的非传统手段。作者结合尺度无关的 Landau 势模型与预测性原子模拟，说明温度调制可利用退极化场实现非电场极化。研究还预测温度梯度与应变耦合可诱导持久的极性纹理，例如多畴态。
authors: Cameron A. M. Scott, Xabier Diaz de Cerio, Jorge Íñiguez-González

articles.title: A Combined Tight Binding with Machine Learning Potential Model for Magnesium Compounds
articles.title_zh: 用于镁化合物的紧束缚与机器学习势结合模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25853v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a model for magnesium-based systems that combines density functional tight binding (DFTB) with MACE, a machine learning interatomic potential (DFTB+MACE). In this model, the conventional repulsive potential, pair potential, is replaced by a many-body MACE potential. The MACE component of the model is trained on the difference between density functional theory (DFT) energies and forces and the corresponding DFTB values, but neglecting the pair potential contribution. Using this model we performed structural relaxation of MgO-CO2 adsorption systems, molecular dynamics calculations of water clusters and phonon spectrum calculations of stable fcc-MgO and metastable bcc-MgO structures. We compare the performance of our model with a pure MACE model and with DFT. We demonstrate that the DFTB+MACE model achieves improved accuracy relative to DFTB with a pair potential, in many cases with only a moderate increase in computational cost. In addition, it can provide electronic structures that most of the machine learning potentials cannot. The training dataset, originally developed for MACE, may not fully represent all regions of the potential surface we may encounter during simulations. Expanding the dataset for a wider potential surface is expected to further enhance predictive accuracy of DFTB+MACE model. Overall, the resulting DFTB+MACE framework enables simulations at length and time scales beyond the reach of first-principles methods while retaining an explicit description of electronic structures, making it particularly attractive for studying charge-transfer in materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种面向镁基体系的 DFTB+MACE 模型，用多体 MACE 机器学习势替代传统密度泛函紧束缚中的二体排斥势。MACE 部分通过学习 DFT 与 DFTB 在能量和力上的差值进行训练，并被用于 MgO-CO₂ 吸附体系结构优化、水团簇分子动力学以及 MgO 声子谱计算。结果表明，该模型相较传统 DFTB 可提高精度，同时计算成本仅适度增加，并保留了机器学习势通常不具备的电子结构信息。
authors: Jiwen Yu, Arash A. Mostofi, Andrew Horsfield

articles.title: Sensitivity-optimal coplanar waveguide design for broadband magnetic resonance spectroscopy: a Beer--Lambert framework
articles.title_zh: 面向宽带磁共振光谱的灵敏度最优共面波导设计：Beer–Lambert 框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25861v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coplanar waveguide (CPW) transmission spectroscopy is used to probe spin dynamics, ferromagnetic resonance, and complex conductivity across a wide range of materials, yet no systematic framework connects waveguide geometry to measurement sensitivity when sample volume and concentration are fixed. We show that the shared geometric scaling of sample coupling and conductor loss maps CPW design onto the Beer--Lambert optimization problem of optical spectrophotometry, reducing it to a universal one-parameter problem whose solution depends only on sample geometry and the dominant noise source -- not on sample properties, operating frequency, or system losses. The framework predicts a near-universal 1,Np optimum across the full range of sample thicknesses and design geometries. Benchmarking against seven published broadband FMR instruments reveals two fabrication-delimited classes: PCB-milled designs are bounded by a ceiling imposed by their minimum slot width, while photolithographic designs approach the additive-noise optimum. For large-area PCB samples a meander geometry offers a direct path to near-optimal sensitivity without interferometric compensation; for sub-millimeter samples, a single lithographic straight pass suffices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究建立了共面波导传输光谱中波导几何与测量灵敏度之间的系统联系，适用于固定样品体积和浓度的情况。作者指出样品耦合与导体损耗具有共同几何标度，可将设计优化映射为类似光学分光光度法中的 Beer–Lambert 优化问题。该框架给出近普适的灵敏度最优条件，并通过已有宽带铁磁共振仪器进行基准比较，区分了 PCB 加工与光刻设计所受的不同制造限制。

articles.title: High-Performance Nanophononic Resonators in Self-Suspended WSe₂ Domes and Drums
articles.title_zh: 自悬浮 WSe₂ 纳米穹顶与纳米鼓中的高性能纳米声子谐振器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25946v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Van der Waals materials are ideally suited for the implementation of high-frequency nanophononic resonators with atomically flat interfaces. Here, we present two versatile van der Waals-based nanophononic architectures: First, we introduce self-supporting nano-domes of WSe₂ as a scalable platform for the simultaneous generation of hundreds of high-quality nanoacoustic resonators with resonance frequencies in the 100 GHz range. Second, we engineer self-supporting nano-drums that reach record-high working frequencies for 2D-semiconductor transducers beyond 1 THz. Through optical pump-probe spectroscopy experiments and photoelastic linear chain model calculations, we gain a detailed understanding of the intricate interplay between phononic mode hybridization across heterostructures, the differences between modes close to the center and edge of the acoustic Brillouin zone, and the temporal structure of the photoelastic response. Both architectures have potential applications in low-cost nanoacoustic probing and the ultrafast modulation of quantum emitters in two-dimensional semiconductors. While nano-drums surpass the THz frequency barrier, nano-domes appear as an accessible, low-cost alternative for developing scalable nanophononic technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了两类基于范德华材料的自悬浮纳米声子结构：WSe₂ 纳米穹顶和纳米鼓。纳米穹顶可规模化产生数百个 100 GHz 量级的高质量纳米声学谐振器，而纳米鼓则实现了二维半导体换能器中超过 1 THz 的高工作频率。通过光泵浦—探测实验和光弹性线性链模型，作者分析了异质结构中声子模式杂化、布里渊区中心与边缘模式差异以及光弹性响应的时间结构。
authors: Jens-Christian Drawer, Bo Han, Edson Rafael Cardozo de Oliveira, Chushuang Xiang, Vita Solovyeva, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Norberto Daniel Lanzillotti-Kimura, Christian Schneider, Martin Esmann

articles.title: Capturing Nuclear Quantum Effects in Hydrogen Diffusion through MoS2 via Machine-Learning-Enhanced Path-Integral Simulations
articles.title_zh: 通过机器学习增强的路径积分模拟捕捉氢在 MoS₂ 中扩散的核量子效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25991v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hydrogen transport through layered two-dimensional (2D) materials is central to technologies such as hydrogen storage, fuel cells, and isotope separation. Among these materials, MoS2 exhibits tunable interlayer diffusion properties, whose accurate theoretical description requires accounting for nuclear quantum effects (NQEs), including zero-point motion and tunneling. Here, we present a machine-learning-enhanced atomistic study of hydrogen and deuterium diffusion in layered MoS2 based on interatomic potentials trained on r2SCAN+rVV10 density-functional-theory data. Combining well-tempered metadynamics with path-integral molecular dynamics, we investigate diffusion across multiple MoS2 polytypes and twisted bilayer structures while explicitly incorporating NQEs. Our simulations show that NQEs substantially lower free-energy barriers for hydrogen diffusion at 300 K, significantly increasing the hydrogen self-diffusion coefficient compared to classical nuclei simulations. We further identify a pronounced kinetic isotope effect, with a 35 meV difference between hydrogen and deuterium quantum free-energy barriers. In twisted bilayer MoS2, hydrogen transport exhibits strong spatial variations governed by the local stacking environments within the moiré superlattices. These results highlight the critical role of NQEs in hydrogen transport through layered materials and provide atomistic insight intoisotope-selective diffusion in structurally complex 2D systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用基于 r2SCAN+rVV10 密度泛函数据训练的机器学习原子间势，模拟氢和氘在层状 MoS₂ 中的扩散过程。作者结合良好调控的元动力学与路径积分分子动力学，显式考虑零点运动和隧穿等核量子效应，并考察多种 MoS₂ 多型及扭转双层结构。结果显示，核量子效应在 300 K 下显著降低氢扩散自由能势垒，提高自扩散系数，并产生明显的氢/氘动力学同位素效应。
authors: Ismail Eren, Ege Yigit Erbil, Maria-Judith Caisachana-Lozada, Hossein Mirhosseini, Thomas D. Kühne, Agnieszka B. Kuc

articles.title: Residual orbital magnetization governs the anomalous Hall effect in altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 剩余轨道磁化支配交替磁体中的反常霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25999v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In altermagnets that exhibit anomalous Hall effect, the small remanent magnetization exists but has been treated as too small to be relevant to the Hall response. In this work, we point out that this dismissal is incomplete because the generalized Středa relation ties the intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity (σₓy) to the orbital magnetization (M_z, the topological component from the modern orbital magnetization) by σₓy=-efracpartial M_zpartial μ. We reveal a microscopic mechanism to generate net orbital moment from the interplay of local crystal field and spin-orbit coupling for MnTe-type altermagnets, in which the magnetic anisotropy generates weak net magnetization without invoking exchange between neighboring spins (e.g., Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction). Our work indicates that residual orbital and spin magnetization is an intrinsic thermodynamic property that governs anomalous transport in unconventional antiferromagnets, including altermagnets and noncollinear antiferromagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究指出，在表现出反常霍尔效应的交替磁体中，虽存在很小的剩余磁化，但其对霍尔响应的作用不应被忽略。作者利用广义 Středa 关系说明本征反常霍尔电导与轨道磁化的化学势导数相关，并揭示了 MnTe 类交替磁体中局域晶场与自旋轨道耦合共同产生净轨道磁矩的微观机制。该工作表明剩余轨道和自旋磁化是非常规反铁磁体中支配反常输运的内禀热力学性质。
authors: Yufei Zhao, Yiyang Jiang, Kamal Das, Chao-Xing Liu, Binghai Yan

articles.title: Spin modulations in the Rashba-Hubbard chain -- a tensor network study
articles.title_zh: Rashba–Hubbard 链中的自旋调制：张量网络研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26014v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Uniform spin-orbit coupling in an open single-band Hubbard chain is an exactly removable (SU(2)) gauge field at the Hamiltonian level, but not at the level of laboratory-frame spin correlations. We study this separation using density matrix renormalization group calculations for the repulsive one-dimensional Rashba-Hubbard chain. For open boundary conditions, a site-dependent spin rotation maps the model with hopping (t) and Rashba spin-orbit strength (łambda) onto the ordinary Hubbard chain with renormalized hopping (t_łambda=sqrtt²⁺łambda²). Consequently, charge and energy diagnostics are affected only through the bandwidth renormalization, which is quadratic in weak (łambda/t). Spin correlations, however, respond already at linear order because the same transformation rotates the local spin basis by the wave vector (kₘ̊ ₛₒ=2arctan(łambda/t)). We use DMRG to verify this observable consequence across the filling diagram of finite open chains. The filling structure follows the gauge-equivalent Hubbard model, whereas the spin structure factor shows the predicted spin-orbit sidebands. A dominant Hubbard-chain magnetic wave vector (k₀) is transformed into components at (k₀± kₘ̊ ₛₒ), folded into the open-chain Brillouin zone. At half filling, where (k₀₌π), the two sidebands fold onto a single, in-plane, spin spiral wave with (k=π-kₘ̊ ₛₒ<π). Away from half filling, the incommensurate Hubbard spin response splits into two distinct spin-orbit-shifted components, producing a real-space beating pattern. Our results provide a filling-resolved tensor-network benchmark for the exactly removable limit of one-dimensional spin-orbit coupling, and establish a controlled reference point for ladders, multiorbital chains, rings, proximitized wires, and higher-dimensional Hubbard systems where spin-orbit coupling can no longer be gauged away.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用密度矩阵重正化群方法研究具有排斥相互作用的一维 Rashba–Hubbard 开链。作者指出，均匀自旋轨道耦合在哈密顿量层面可通过位置依赖的 SU(2) 规范变换消去，并映射为跃迁强度重整化的普通 Hubbard 链，但实验室参考系中的自旋关联仍会受到影响。计算结果验证了电荷和能量性质主要体现带宽重整化，而自旋结构因局域自旋基旋转而出现预期的自旋轨道边带。
authors: Jozef Genzor, Roman Krčmár, Andrej Gendiar, Chia-Min Chung, Denis Kochan

articles.title: Primary damage and mechanical degradation of WTaCrV refractory high-entropy alloy: effects of solid-solution and chemical ordering
articles.title_zh: WTaCrV 难熔高熵合金的初级损伤与力学退化：固溶与化学有序的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26019v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As advanced nuclear reactors demand novel irradiation-tolerant materials, this study investigates the radiation damage and mechanical degradation of the promising WTaCrV refractory high-entropy alloy (RHEA). To isolate complex nanoscale chemical effects, we propose an atomistic modeling strategy comparing Average-Atom (AA), random solid-solution (RSS), and local chemical order (LCO) configurations using newly developed interatomic potentials. Collision cascades simulations reveal that the number of Frenkel pairs follow NRSS > NLCO > NAA at the same radiation dose. While the RSS effect accelerates defect generation due to rugged energy landscapes, LCO enhances lattice cohesion to mitigate radiation damage. Despite more primary defects in the RSS and LCO configurations compared with the AA configurations, the RSS and LCO effects can suppress radiation-induced mechanical degradation. Irradiation severely degrade the homogenized AA model but exert a limited impact on the strength and flow stress of the RSS and LCO models. This exceptional resistance is driven by inherent lattice distortion resulting from interactions among different alloy elements, which outweighs point defect induced lattice disruptions. Moreover, the complex interactions between deformation twins and point defects cause confined plastic flow, elevating flow stress in the RSS and LCO models. The findings provide atomistic guidance for performance assessment of next-generation structural materials for extreme nuclear environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向先进核反应堆耐辐照材料需求，考察 WTaCrV 难熔高熵合金的辐照损伤和力学性能退化。作者构建了平均原子、随机固溶和局域化学有序三类原子模型，并使用新开发的原子间势进行碰撞级联模拟。结果表明随机固溶会因粗糙能量景观促进缺陷生成，而局域化学有序增强晶格内聚并缓解损伤；尽管后两类模型初级缺陷更多，它们对辐照诱导的强度和流动应力退化表现出更强抵抗力。
authors: Yihan Wu, Pengfei Yu, Yaohong Suo, Lei Zhang

articles.title: Epitaxial Strain Activates Altermagnetic Spin-Splitting Torques in RuO2(100)
articles.title_zh: 外延应变激活 RuO2(100) 中的交替磁性自旋分裂力矩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26023v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The altermagnetic nature of rutile RuO2 remains under active debate: bulk measurements indicate a nearly nonmagnetic ground state, whereas thin-film studies have reported symmetry-dependent transport signatures consistent with altermagnetism. Here, we provide experimental evidence that altermagnetic spin splitting in RuO2 is a strain-stabilized emergent state rather than an intrinsic bulk property. Angular-resolved spin-torque measurements reveal a symmetry-selected spin Hall response characteristic of altermagnetic spin splitting, which is strongest in the strained regime but progressively suppressed as the lattice relaxes toward the bulk limit. Complementary magnetic measurements further reveal enhanced coercivity and exchange-bias behavior exclusively in strained films, indicating the emergence of a strain-stabilized magnetic state. First-principles calculations reproduce the strain-dependent evolution of the Neel order and spin-split electronic structure, supporting the experimental observations. Together, these results establish altermagnetic spin splitting in RuO2 as a strain-stabilized emergent state and provide a unified explanation for the long-standing discrepancy between bulk and thin-film observations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对金红石相 RuO2 是否具有本征交替磁性这一争议，提出其交替磁性自旋分裂并非体相固有性质，而是由应变稳定的涌现态。角分辨自旋力矩测量显示，应变薄膜中存在具有对称选择性的自旋霍尔响应，并随晶格向体相弛豫而减弱。磁性测量和第一性原理计算进一步支持应变诱导的磁有序、自旋分裂电子结构及相关输运特征。
authors: Qi Jia, Seung Gyo Jeong, Seungjun Lee, Denis Tonini, Anand Santhosh, Yifei Yang, Xiangrui Li, Brahmdutta Dixit, Shuang Liang, Yu-Chia Chen, Tony Low, Bharat Jalan, Jian-Ping Wang

articles.title: Quantum Back-Action Expands the Excitonic Hilbert Space in a Soft Polar Semiconductor
articles.title_zh: 量子反作用在软极性半导体中扩展激子希尔伯特空间
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26063v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electronic excitations in solids are commonly described within a hierarchy in which the excitonic Hamiltonian is defined first and the lattice acts later through renormalization, relaxation, and dephasing. This picture assumes that the optically accessible excitonic manifold is already present at the moment of photoexcitation. Here we show that this assumption fails in a soft polar semiconductor. Using femtosecond coherent multidimensional spectroscopy on lead-halide perovskite nanocrystals, we observe quantum back-action between an electronic excitation and a collective lattice-polarization field that expands the excitonic Hilbert space in real time. The optical pulse first prepares an excitonic polarization, X1. A second configuration, X2, emerges only after the polaron field develops, while coherent X1-X2 coupling appears at later times. State formation and coherence formation are therefore resolved as distinct stages of quasiparticle formation. In contrast, CdSe quantum dots exhibit the conventional limit in which excitonic states and couplings are present at time zero and are only weakly perturbed by phonons. The observed diagonal and anti-diagonal splittings increase with nanocrystal size and correlate with radiative oscillator strength, opposite to expectations from simple quantum confinement. A dynamical polaron-field model describes the lattice polarization as an order parameter that expands the optically accessible manifold and generates time-dependent coherent coupling. These results show that strong system-bath coupling can actively create excitonic states and the coherent manifold in which they evolve.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，在软极性半导体中，光激发瞬间可访问的激子态并非预先完全存在，而会受到电子激发与集体晶格极化场之间量子反作用的动态塑造。通过飞秒相干多维光谱研究铅卤钙钛矿纳米晶，作者观察到初始激子极化 X1 之后，随极化子场形成才出现第二构型 X2，并在更晚时间建立 X1-X2 相干耦合。与之相比，CdSe 量子点表现出传统图像，即激子态和耦合在零时刻已存在且仅受声子弱扰动。
authors: Arnab Ghosh, Patrick Brosseau, Priya Nagpal, Dmitry N. Dirin, Rui Tao, Maksym V. Kovalenko, Patanjali Kambhampati

articles.title: All-electrical dephasing-protected spin qubits in altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 交替磁体中的全电控抗退相干自旋量子比特
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26066v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce altermagnetic semiconductors as a materials platform for scalable, all-electrical controllable spin qubits that operate without magnetic fields in gate-defined quantum dots. The altermagnet intrinsic finite-momentum spin polarization provides a field-free qubit splitting that is fully and continuously tunable through the dot ellipticity with electrostatic gates, delivering individually addressable qubit frequencies. Furthermore, the altermagnetic spin splitting is first-order insensitive to electric field fluctuations by construction and quantization-axis fluctuations produce only transverse coupling, yielding relaxation without pure dephasing, a distinct dephasing-protection yielding an advantage over conventional spin qubits. The net-zero magnetization eliminates stray-fields and renders the platform compatible with superconducting resonators thus enabling high-fidelity, non-demolition circuit-QED readout by dispersive coupling of the qubit spin-dependent electric dipole couples to a resonator. Starting from an effective quantum-dot description, supported by a microscopic lattice-model, we derive the qubit Hamiltonian and establish that it naturally supports a complete gate set: electric-dipole spin resonance controls single qubits, while tunable exchange combined with per-qubit frequency addressing directly implements the fermionic simulation (fSim) family of two-qubit gates. Crucially, within the same platform it is possible to implement a singlet-triplet qubit with fully electrical control over both exchange and splitting differences, removing the need for micromagnets or nuclear polarization gradients, while enabling baseband operation. Our results establish altermagnetic quantum dots as a novel, all-electrical route to spin qubits with enhanced protection.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出将交替磁性半导体作为可扩展、全电控、无需外加磁场的栅定义量子点自旋量子比特平台。交替磁体的有限动量自旋极化可产生零场量子比特能级劈裂，并能通过静电栅调控量子点椭圆率实现连续可调和单独寻址。作者指出该自旋劈裂对电场涨落一阶不敏感，量化轴涨落主要导致横向耦合，从而抑制纯退相干；同时零净磁化有利于与超导谐振器兼容并实现电路 QED 读出。
authors: José Carlos Abadillo-Uriel, Andrea Maiani, Alberto Cortijo, Ramón Aguado, Rubén Seoane Souto

articles.title: Strong photogalvanic effect in Weyl materials due to magnetic resonances
articles.title_zh: 磁共振导致 Weyl 材料中的强光伏电流效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26067v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the photogalvanic effect in Weyl semimetals under a magnetic field, focusing on the shift current. Using the Kubo formalism for an ideal, clean Weyl node at zero temperature, we derive a general analytic expression valid for arbitrary light frequency, Fermi energy, and magnetic field strength. We identify a series of resonances that can be probed experimentally. To complement the microscopic analysis, we employ the semiclassical Boltzmann approach, which allows us to incorporate finite scattering phenomenologically. Unlike most previous studies using this method, we do not treat the magnetic field perturbatively; instead, we solve the Boltzmann equation for a Weyl node exactly within the limits of validity of the semiclassical theory. Our solution reproduces the low-frequency resonances and elucidates the role of finite scattering.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察磁场下 Weyl 半金属中的光伏电流效应，重点分析位移电流。作者基于 Kubo 形式主义，对零温洁净理想 Weyl 节点推导出适用于任意光频、费米能和磁场强度的一般解析表达式，并识别出一系列可实验探测的共振。为纳入有限散射效应，研究还采用半经典 Boltzmann 方法，在其适用范围内非微扰地处理磁场，从而再现低频共振并阐明散射的作用。

articles.title: Folds of one curve: the superradiant phase diagram of Dicke modes with interacting matter
articles.title_zh: 一条曲线的折叠：含相互作用物质的 Dicke 模的超辐射相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26081v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We give a thermodynamic-limit account of Dicke models with one cavity mode coupled collectively to interacting matter. Integrating out the cavity yields an exact self-consistent functional of the magnetisation m, tilde e(m) = łambda m²/2 + eₘ̊ ₘₐₜ(łambda m): a classical penalty on the bare-matter energy eₘ̊ ₘₐₜ in the self-consistent field h = łambda m, with łambda = g²/(2ømega_c) the collective coupling. Supplying only that scalar field, the photon creates no phase the matter does not already possess. States holding a minimum form one connected curve, łambda(m) = μₘ̊ ₘₐₜ⁻¹(m)/m, so superradiant first-order transitions are folds of one equation of state not crossings of disjoint sheets, and a fold can straighten into a continuous line. The remaining rules are local, each with a spectral counterpart: onset by the leading singularity of eₘ̊ ₘₐₜ (a softening polariton), order by one bare response -- the Landau quartic, or a divergent susceptibility forcing a Larkin-Pikin (LP) fold. For the Dicke-Ising model the Landau coefficients are exact, giving in closed form the second-order boundary and both zero-quartic fields, one tricritical; a 1/d expansion maps all four phases, with the AS-PS transition first order for dłe dᵤc=3=4-z (LP) and tricritical points in the (d,ϵ) plane above. At the degenerate quadruple point the matter is a Rydberg-blockade chain, solved by strict-blockade iDMRG: the antiferromagnetic superradiant (AS) phase persists as a finite 1D wedge, first order into the corner. Other magnets: the triangular antiferromagnet keeps a continuous superradiant-superradiant line (3D-XY, no fold forced); the compass chain a BKT-functional onset; the Heisenberg and XX chains, via a conserved operator, a spectrally silent first-order onset; and the Dicke-Heisenberg diagram an exact tricritical point at the saturation corner.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文在热力学极限下研究一个腔模与相互作用物质集体耦合的 Dicke 模型，并通过积掉腔自由度得到关于磁化强度的精确自洽泛函。作者指出，光子本身不会创造物质原本不具备的相，超辐射一阶相变可理解为同一状态方程曲线的折叠，而非不同能量片之间的交叉。文中还给出相变起始、阶数及谱学对应关系，并以 Dicke-Ising 模型为例推导精确 Landau 系数和相关相边界。

articles.title: Higher Berry curvature, second Chern numbers and magnetoelectric coupling in crystalline insulators
articles.title_zh: 晶体绝缘体中的高阶 Berry 曲率、第二陈数与磁电耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26096v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We rewrite a lattice model of the four-dimensional Chern insulator as a family of translationally-invariant infinite chains over the three-dimensional Brillouin zone and compute its higher three-form Berry curvature using infinite matrix product states (iMPS). We calculate the topological phase diagram of the associated Dixmier--Douady--Kapustin--Spodyneiko (DDKS) number as a function of the model's mass term, and show that it is exactly congruent to the phase diagram in terms of the second Chern number, the analytic expression of which is known for this particular model. This agreement demonstrates that higher Berry curvature can be used to compute second Chern numbers in a manifestly quantized manner. Motivated by the connection between the second Chern form and the Chern--Simons axion coupling, we study magnetoelectric coupling in three dimensions and its relation to higher Berry phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将四维陈绝缘体的晶格模型改写为三维布里渊区上一族平移不变的无限链，并利用无限矩阵乘积态计算其高阶三形式 Berry 曲率。作者得到 Dixmier–Douady–Kapustin–Spodyneiko 数随质量项变化的拓扑相图，并证明其与该模型已知的第二陈数相图完全一致。该结果表明高阶 Berry 曲率可用于以显式量子化方式计算第二陈数，并进一步联系到三维体系中的 Chern–Simons 轴子磁电耦合和高阶 Berry 相。

articles.title: Localization region detection with directionality estimation in a two-dimensional hexagonal crystal lattice model
articles.title_zh: 二维六角晶格模型中的局域化区域检测与方向性估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.24923v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This work is devoted to data-driven identification of discrete breathers in numerical simulations of a two-dimensional crystal lattice using locally sampled wave data. Different lattice wave datasets are considered, with data collected from regions of different shapes and sizes defined by the lattice particles in mechanical equilibrium. Specifically, in addition to regions with a regular hexagonal shape, one- and quasi-one-dimensional regions reflecting the quasi-one-dimensionality of discrete breathers in two-dimensional hexagonal crystal lattices are proposed. To improve numerical efficiency, dataset dimensionality is reduced using Principal Component Analysis, and highly accurate Support Vector Machine classifiers are trained to distinguish between linear and nonlinear wave data. The obtained classifiers, together with the sliding window method, are applied to detect localization regions in two-dimensional hexagonal crystal lattice numerical simulations. High-precision algorithms for detected localization region segmentation and localized wave directionality estimation within the detected regions are further proposed, and their performance is evaluated. The presented methods are successfully applied to detect localized waves and their collision regions, as well as their directionality, performing a numerical study of stationary and traveling two-dimensional discrete breather interactions. Qualitatively better results are obtained when considering wave-data collection regions respecting the quasi-one-dimensional nature of two-dimensional discrete breathers in the hexagonal crystal lattice model.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究如何利用局部采样的波动数据，在二维六角晶格数值模拟中以数据驱动方式识别离散呼吸子。作者构建不同形状和尺寸的采样区域数据集，包括规则六角形区域以及反映离散呼吸子准一维特征的一维和准一维区域，并用主成分分析降维、支持向量机分类区分线性与非线性波数据。结合滑动窗口方法，研究进一步提出局域化区域分割和局域波传播方向估计算法，并在数值模拟中验证其性能。

articles.title: A Contactless Heat Engine Driven by Nonreciprocal Fluctuation-Induced Torques
articles.title_zh: 由非互易涨落诱导力矩驱动的无接触热机
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25053v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We describe a contactless heat engine in which quantum and thermal electromagnetic fluctuations act as the working medium. The setup consists of two concentric cylinders held at different temperatures. The inner cylinder stably levitates within the outer one due to repulsive nonequilibrium Casimir forces. The chirality of the setup is broken by using nonreciprocal dielectric materials, akin to application of a magnetic field along the common cylinder axis. Using Rytov fluctuational electrodynamics, we show that heat transfer and torque can be expressed in terms of an angular-momentum-resolved heat flux density, Φₙ₍ømega): each exchanged photon carries energy hbar ømega and angular momentum hbar n. In reciprocal media contributions from modes n and -n cancel and there is no net torque; nonreciprocity breaks this symmetry and powers rotation of the inner cylinder. Even in the absence of contact, electromagnetic fluctuations produce a frictional torque opposing rotation that we compute. This enables computation of characteristic steady state rotations, and estimation of the engine efficiency (which remains bounded by the Carnot limit). The cylindrical setup provides a natural realization of fluctuation-induced angular-momentum transfer and a possible route toward nanoscale contactless engines.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出一种无接触热机，其中量子和热电磁涨落充当工作介质，系统由处于不同温度的同心圆柱构成，内圆柱由非平衡 Casimir 排斥力稳定悬浮。通过采用非互易介电材料破坏手征对称性，交换光子的角动量通量在正负角动量模式间不再抵消，从而产生净力矩并驱动内圆柱旋转。作者利用 Rytov 涨落电动力学计算热传输、驱动力矩和涨落导致的摩擦力矩，并据此估算稳态转速和受 Carnot 极限约束的效率。
authors: Dhruv Shah, Kiryl Asheichyk, David Gelbwaser-Klimovsky, Noah Graham, Mehran Kardar, Matthias Krüger

articles.title: Wide-field NV magnetometry under simultaneous high-pressure and high-temperature conditions
articles.title_zh: 高压高温同时条件下的宽场 NV 磁ometry
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25378v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We demonstrate wide-field optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) under simultaneous high-pressure and high-temperature conditions using nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers. Although NV-center magnetometry has been widely used for spatially resolved magnetic-field imaging, its application to extreme environments combining pressure and temperature remains challenging.
