Based on this insight, we demonstrate that (1) the variance of TD is asymptotically bounded from above by Monte Carlo (MC) estimators, and (2) shorter horizon updates incurs less variance for a fixed number of samples. Beyond TD, we show that Direct Advantage Estimation (DAE), a method for estimating the advantage function, can be seen as a type of regression-adjusted control variate, which achieves a tighter bound on the variance compared to TD in the large-sample limit. Finally, we numerically illustrate the behaviors of these estimators with carefully designed environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文在表格表示的分阶段设定下分析时序差分学习的方差，指出其降低方差的机制之一是有效聚合了更多独立轨迹的信息。作者证明，在渐近意义下，TD 估计器的方差由蒙特卡洛估计器上界约束，并且在固定样本数下较短视野更新具有更低方差。论文还将直接优势估计解释为一种回归调整控制变量，并说明其在大样本极限下可获得比 TD 更紧的方差界。

articles.title: Evolutionary Two-Stage Hyperparameter Optimization Strategies for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 面向物理信息神经网络的进化式两阶段超参数优化策略
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20442v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) solve Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) by embedding physical laws into neural network training. However, their performance suffers from unstable convergence, training plateaus, and strong sensitivity to architectural and optimization hyperparameters due to the highly non-convex and multi-term structure of the physics-informed loss. In this setting, the outer-loop hyperparameter search is a noisy and black-box optimization problem over heterogeneous parameters, where classical local or gradient-based strategies are easily trapped in suboptimal regions. Evolutionary algorithms, with their population-based exploration and ability to handle mixed, non-differentiable search spaces, provide a more robust mechanism for discovering promising configurations. We propose and investigate a two-stage approach based on evolutionary algorithms that combines exploration and exploitation parts of PINNs training to improve solution accuracy and robustness under fixed computational budgets. In the first stage, we perform low-fidelity training runs with truncated epochs to rapidly screen candidate configurations, treating hyperparameter selection as a black-box outer-loop problem. In the second stage, only the most promising candidates are fully trained with standard gradient-based optimizers to refine the solution. Evaluated on three popular problems, namely Advection, Klein-Gordon and Helmholtz equations, our method consistently outperforms standard training and achieves significantly lower mean error within constrained computational resources.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对物理信息神经网络在求解偏微分方程时面临的收敛不稳定、训练平台期以及对结构和优化超参数敏感等问题，提出基于进化算法的两阶段超参数优化框架。方法先通过低保真、截断训练快速筛选候选配置，再在固定计算预算下进行更深入的开发与优化。作者强调进化算法适合处理 PINN 外层搜索中噪声大、黑箱、混合且不可微的超参数空间。
authors: Fedor Buzaev (HSE University), Dmitry Efremenko (HSE University), Egor Bugaev (HSE University), Andrei Ermakov (HSE University, AXXX), Denis Derkach (HSE University), Daria Pugacheva (HSE University, AXXX), Fedor Ratnikov (HSE University)

articles.title: Neural Architectures as Functional Priors in Physics-Informed Control Problems
articles.title_zh: 物理信息控制问题中作为函数先验的神经网络架构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19368v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this work we investigate the role of neural architectures as implicit functional priors in control problems governed by ordinary differential equations. Rather than focusing on highly complex problems, our objective is to investigate architecture-dependent effects in controlled dynamical systems within the simplest physically interpretable settings possible. In particular, we study a controlled linear RLC electrical circuit and a nonlinear Duffing-type dynamical system. Both systems are analyzed first through classical optimal-control formulations and later through PINN-based approaches. We compare different combinations of multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) and Fourier-based KAN-like architectures, and analyze their influence on the resulting controls. The numerical experiments suggest that different architectural choices systematically generate qualitatively distinct controls, even under identical governing equations, loss functionals, initial and target states, training parameters and physical constraints. Significant differences appear in the spectral structure, smoothness, energy distribution, and phase-space behavior of the learned solutions. A central observation of this work is the emergence of a functional specialization phenomenon when the neural architectures are allowed sufficient freedom to shape the structure of the learned controls. More specifically, in the systems considered here, Fourier-based architectures tend to produce trajectories with richer oscillatory content, whereas smoother low-frequency-biased architectures tend to generate more regular and energetically efficient controls. This suggests that different functional components of the control problem may be handled more efficiently by different neural architectures, leading to an implicit specialization between state representation and control generation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究神经网络架构在由常微分方程支配的控制问题中如何充当隐式函数先验。作者以受控线性 RLC 电路和非线性 Duffing 型系统为例，比较经典最优控制与 PINN 方法下多层感知机和基于傅里叶的 KAN 类架构的影响。数值结果表明，即使控制方程、损失函数、初始与目标状态、训练参数和物理约束相同，不同架构仍会产生在谱结构、平滑性、能量分布和相空间行为上显著不同的控制策略。
authors: Sonia Rubio Herranz, Fernando Carlos López Hernández, Antonio López Montes

articles.title: Optimal Ansatz-free Hamiltonian Learning In Situ
articles.title_zh: 原位无拟设最优哈密顿量学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19486v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Characterizing the features of a Hamiltonian that governs a quantum system serves as a fundamental subroutine of quantum device calibration, signal sensing, and error correction. Recent works proposed protocols have achieved the optimal Heisenberg-limited scaling learning ansatz-free Hamiltonians from their real-time evolutions without fully specifying interaction structures. However, these protocols rely on both deep circuits with interleaving probes and control, and extremely short time resolution, making them difficult to implement on near- and intermediate-term in situ quantum experiments. In this work, we propose a computationally efficient, control-free, and ancilla-free algorithm that uses only Pauli product state preparation and measurement, and learns an ansatz-free Hamiltonian H with ||H||łeqŁambda in total evolution time of Θ(fracŁambdaϵ²łog(fracŁambdaϵ)). The evolution time cost of our algorithm is optimal for any control-free protocols as we further prove a lower bound of Ømega(fracŁambdaϵ²łog(fracŁambdaϵ)). Technically, our method introduces a randomized-sampling framework that combines band-limited kernel-based time sampling with a displacement sieve for Hamiltonian structure learning. The characteristic probe time resolution depends only on Łambda instead of ǎrepsilon, which makes our protocol especially appealing in the high-precision regime for sensing and calibration applications. We also show that the algorithm maintains the same asymptotic total evolution time in the presence of state-preparation-and-measurement (SPAM) noise when the Hamiltonian is local after calibration. Our results demonstrate the fundamental cost of experimentally friendly Hamiltonian learning and provide a practical route to rigorous in situ characterization of near-term quantum platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究如何在不预先指定相互作用结构的情况下学习量子系统的哈密顿量，这是量子设备校准、传感和纠错的重要基础任务。作者提出一种计算高效、无需控制和辅助量子比特的算法，仅使用 Pauli 乘积态制备与测量即可学习范数有界的无拟设哈密顿量。论文还证明了该算法在无控制协议中的总演化时间复杂度达到最优，并通过随机采样、带限核时间估计等技术实现。

articles.title: ITNet: A Learnable Integral Transform That Subsumes Convolution, Attention, and Recurrence
articles.title_zh: ITNet：一种涵盖卷积、注意力与循环机制的可学习积分变换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19538v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Convolutional networks, recurrent networks, and transformers each encode different inductive biases -- locality, sequential memory, and content-dependent pairwise interaction -- and have remained mathematically distinct since their inception. We show that this fragmentation reflects not a fundamental diversity in how signals should be processed, but rather incomplete views of a single underlying mathematical object: a learnable integral transform. We introduce the Integral Transform Network (ITNet), a unified architecture built around a learnable kernel that depends jointly on positions and features. This kernel is implemented as a small neural network, specifically an MLP, that models pairwise interactions, enabling the model to adapt its behavior from data. We show that convolution, self-attention (including multi-head), and autoregressive recurrence (including LSTM, GRU, S4, and Mamba) arise as special cases under appropriate parameterizations, and that ITNet is a universal approximator of continuous operators. To make this practical, we develop tiled kernel fusion, importance-weighted Monte Carlo integration, and learned low-rank factorization, enabling efficient and scalable computation. A single ITNet architecture with a shared operator and lightweight modality-specific encoders matches or exceeds specialized baselines on ImageNet-1K , GLUE, ModelNet40, VQA,v2 and NLVR2. The results demonstrate that a single learned interaction mechanism can recover the behavior of all three architectural families from data.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出积分变换网络 ITNet，将卷积网络、循环网络和 Transformer 中的局部性、序列记忆与内容相关交互统一为一种可学习积分变换。其核心是一个同时依赖位置和特征的可学习核，并用小型 MLP 建模成对交互。作者说明卷积、自注意力、多头注意力以及多类自回归循环结构都可视为该框架的特例，并提出若干计算技术以提升其实用性。
authors: Ashim Dhor, Rasel Mondal, Pin Yu Chen

articles.title: Formal Verification of Learned Multi-Agent Communication Policies via Decision Tree Distillation
articles.title_zh: 通过决策树蒸馏形式化验证学习到的多智能体通信策略
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19632v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) enables agents to develop coordination strategies through emergent communication, but neural policies lack the formal safety guarantees required for safety-critical robotic deployment in drone swarms and autonomous vehicle fleets. We present the first end-to-end framework for safety verification of learned multi-agent communication policies through policy abstraction: neural policies are distilled into interpretable decision trees, then formally verified, with empirical validation confirming that verified safety properties transfer to original networks. Our four-stage pipeline consists of domain-specific feature extraction from agent observations, decision tree distillation achieving 97.9% +/- 1.2% fidelity to neural policies, automated translation to PRISM probabilistic model checker specifications with complete feature-to-state-variable correspondence, and compositional verification of Probabilistic Computation Tree Logic (PCTL) properties via pairwise decomposition with union-bound aggregation and empirical neighbor modeling. Evaluating Vector-Quantized Variational Information Bottleneck (VQ-VIB) policies for multi-drone coordination with 5-7 agents, we verify 18 temporal logic properties across safety, liveness, and cooperation, achieving 88.9% property satisfaction with all five safety thresholds satisfied (0.3% collision probability vs. 1% threshold). Monte Carlo validation of original neural policies confirms that verified safety properties transfer with <=0.6 percentage-point deviation (95% CI). Discrete VQ-VIB messages provide +11.6 to +13.6 percentage-point fidelity advantages over continuous methods, enabling 3-4x faster verification. Our framework provides empirically validated safety verification for distilled policy abstractions, serving as a practical bridge between deep MARL and formal safety workflows for multi-robot deployment.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向无人机群和自动驾驶车队等安全关键场景中多智能体强化学习通信策略缺乏形式化安全保证的问题，提出端到端验证框架。方法将神经策略蒸馏为可解释决策树，再转换为 PRISM 概率模型检测器规格，并验证 PCTL 安全性质。实验显示，蒸馏后的决策树与原神经策略具有较高一致性，且经验证的安全性质可通过经验验证转移到原网络。

articles.title: Variational Consensus Monte Carlo for Bayesian Mixture
articles.title_zh: 用于贝叶斯混合模型的变分共识蒙特卡洛
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19643v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Motivated by the privacy, sensitivity and sharing limitations of health data, we present a comprehensive pipeline for inference of Bayesian mixture models within a federated learning setting, i.e. when data cannot be fully shared or pooled across compute nodes. We adopt a Consensus Monte Carlo (CMC) approach, in which an MCMC algorithm is run independently within each data silo to estimate local posterior distributions, which are then aggregated to approximate the posterior over the full data. The variational CMC approach of Rabinovich, Angelino and Jordan (2015) [1] frames the aggregation step as a variational inference problem, but their application to mixtures assumes the number of clusters and key mixture parameters to be known. Our main methodological contributions are: (i) an extension of variational CMC to over-fitted Bayesian mixture models that infer the number of clusters and all model parameters, without requiring conjugacy; (ii) novel cluster-matching algorithms suitable for cross-silo settings in which not every cluster appears in each local dataset; (iii) a number of inference strategies for the aggregation step, matched to different federated learning constraints; and (iv) guidelines for choosing among these in practice. A comprehensive simulation study validates the framework and allows us to compare to state-of-the-art federated learning alternatives. Notably, we show that when the composition of local datasets reflects the underlying clustering structure in the data, our approach can recover small clusters with greater accuracy than standard MCMC applied to the pooled data. We illustrate the framework on large-scale electronic health record data, identifying multi-morbidity patterns in a British geriatric population.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文受健康数据隐私和共享限制的启发，提出在联邦学习场景下对贝叶斯混合模型进行推断的完整流程。方法采用共识蒙特卡洛思想，在各数据孤岛中独立运行 MCMC 估计局部后验，再通过变分聚合近似全数据后验。主要贡献包括将变分 CMC 扩展到可推断聚类数和全部参数的过拟合贝叶斯混合模型，并提出适用于跨孤岛、局部数据中并非所有簇都出现情形的簇匹配算法。
authors: Julie Fendler, Francesca L. Crowe, Tom Marshall, Sylvia Richardson, Paul D. W. Kirk

articles.title: QMaxCal: Path-Space Regularization for Open Quantum Control via Girsanov's Theorem
articles.title_zh: QMaxCal：基于 Girsanov 定理的开放量子控制路径空间正则化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19947v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reliable quantum control in the presence of decoherence requires policies that combat the effect of environmental noise on the controlled dynamics. Open quantum systems under continuous monitoring generate classical measurement records whose drift depends on the noise experienced by the system; the records of two evolutions sharing the same decoherence channels differ only in this drift, so Girsanov's theorem yields a closed-form, differentiable estimator of the KL divergence between their trajectory distributions. We instantiate this estimator with two physically motivated reference measures, yielding two regularizers that both drive the system toward states where the effects of decoherence are minimal: the Wiener KL (KL_W), which is empirically more effective under certain conditions on the noise model, and the drift-variance regularizer (R_DV), which works for all noise models. Both are qualitatively distinct from existing penalties on control fluence or smoothness: they penalize the observable consequences of control on the decoherence channels rather than the control amplitude itself. The regularizers outperform unregularized gradient-based and reinforcement-learning baselines across a range of open quantum systems -- including single- and multi-qubit benchmarks and a multi-qubit chain calibrated to a published snapshot of the IBM Kingston processor -- along several axes of evaluation: final-state fidelity, robustness to mismatch in the assumed noise model (gains grow from +17 pp at training noise to +27 pp under 2.5x noise mismatch), and occupation of forbidden states. The regularizers reduce infidelity by up to 50%, with ~16% gains on the calibrated IBM Kingston chain.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注存在退相干时的可靠量子控制，提出利用连续监测开放量子系统产生的测量记录来构造路径分布之间 KL 散度的可微估计器。基于 Girsanov 定理，作者设计了两类物理动机明确的正则化项：Wiener KL 和漂移方差正则化，用以推动系统远离易受退相干影响的状态。这些正则化不同于传统控制幅值或平滑性惩罚，直接约束控制在退相干通道中产生的可观测后果，并在实验中优于未正则化方法。
authors: Merijn Moody, Zier Mensch, Miranda C. N. Cheng, Peter G. Bolhuis, Max Welling

articles.title: Quantum ring all-reduce: communication and privacy advantages for distributed learning
articles.title_zh: 量子环形 All-Reduce：分布式学习的通信与隐私优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20344v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine learning models have scaled to unprecedented sizes, making training across distributed devices the de facto standard in the field. In this work, we explore how quantum communications can make distributed training both more communication-efficient and information-theoretically private, for both classical and quantum learning models. Ring all-reduce is the foundational communication primitive for large-scale distributed training. We present a quantum version that reduces per-link online communication by a provably optimal factor of two using pre-shared entanglement and superdense coding, without requiring the learning model or gradient computation to change. Beyond bandwidth, the primitive enables privacy guarantees that are information-theoretically impossible for any classical protocol, achieving composable ϵ-secure aggregation, via verified entanglement, at a 2x overhead in GHZ copies. Our hybrid quantum-classical communication architecture yields simultaneous communication and security advantages for large scale distributed training, regardless of whether the learning itself is quantum or classical. Finally, we characterise quantum advantages in gradient conflict detection for server-to-client communication under bandwidth constraints, a setting that arises after ring all-reduce is completed, when full gradient broadcast to external clients is infeasible. Two variants of the problem admit different separations. For margin-based alignment testing (textscGapIPτ), the quantum advantage is quadratic in the margin parameter: widetildeO(τ⁻¹łog P) qubits versus widetildeO(min(τ⁻²,P)) bits. For sign-consistency auditing against a private parameter matching (textscTieAuditϵ), the advantage represents an exponential separation in communication complexity: Ømega(sqrtP) bits whereas O(ϵ⁻²łog P) qubits suffice.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文探讨量子通信如何提升经典和量子学习模型的分布式训练效率与隐私性。作者提出量子版本的环形 all-reduce，利用预共享纠缠和超密编码，在不改变模型或梯度计算的前提下，将每条链路的在线通信量降低到原来的一半，并证明该因子最优。该原语还通过经验证的纠缠实现经典协议无法达到的信息论安全聚合，为大规模分布式训练提供通信和安全双重优势。

articles.title: Topological Data Analysis for High-Dimensional Dynamic Process Monitoring
articles.title_zh: 面向高维动态过程监测的拓扑数据分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20443v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Real-time process monitoring requires methods that extract actionable information from high-dimensional time-series data. In this work, we present a new approach for process monitoring that combines tools of topological data analysis (TDA) and machine learning. In the proposed approach, we represent multivariate time-series data as manifolds and use topological descriptors to summarize the structure of such data; we then use a neural ordinary differential equation to learn the dynamic evolution of the topological structure of the system. Using real data from an industrial process, we show that this trajectory-based event detection approach is effective at detecting diverse types of events. We contrast this approach against reconstruction-based approaches such as principal component analysis and autoencoders and against a trajectory-based approach that uses Koopman autoencoders.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种结合拓扑数据分析与机器学习的实时过程监测方法，用于从高维时间序列中提取可操作信息。方法将多变量时间序列表示为流形，用拓扑描述符概括其结构，并通过神经常微分方程学习系统拓扑结构的动态演化。基于工业过程真实数据的实验表明，该基于轨迹的事件检测方法能够识别多种事件，并与 PCA、自编码器和 Koopman 自编码器等方法进行了比较。
authors: Angan Mukherjee, Tyler A. Soderstrom, Michael J. Kurtz, Victor M. Zavala

articles.title: Entropy Estimation in Multi-Qutrit Systems via Variational and Classical Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 基于变分与经典神经网络的多 Qutrit 系统熵估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20504v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a systematic study of von Neumann entropy estimation in multi-qutrit quantum systems using two complementary approaches: variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) and classical convolutional neural networks (CNNs), evaluated using an ideal (noise-free) quantum simulator. For systems up to three qutrits, we construct and evaluate 11 hardware-efficient SU(3)-inspired ansatzes. A parameter sweep shows that estimation accuracy is primarily determined by the number of trainable parameters, provided sufficient entanglement is present. Based on this study, we fix the parameter count to approximately 120 for subsequent experiments, observing that increasing entangling-gate counts beyond a threshold yields only marginal improvements. For larger systems (two to five qutrits), we use a CNN trained on measurement outcomes from tensor-product mutually unbiased bases. The model achieves accurate and stable predictions and exhibits a systematic improvement in performance with system size, with the highest errors for two-qutrit systems and the lowest for five-qutrit systems. Notably, using only 12.5% of the measurements required for full state tomography is sufficient to reach 90th-percentile absolute errors of approximately 0.13-0.16 nats for both four- and five-qutrit systems. The CNN model is also robust to shot noise and generalizes well to out-of-distribution states. Overall, within the simulated settings studied here, our results indicate a transition in practical methods: VQAs are effective for small systems, while CNN-based estimators offer improved scalability and robustness for larger qutrit systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文系统研究在理想无噪声量子模拟器上估计多 qutrit 量子系统冯·诺依曼熵的两类方法：变分量子算法和经典卷积神经网络。对于最多三个 qutrit 的系统，作者评估了 11 种受 SU(3) 启发的硬件高效拟设，发现精度主要受可训练参数数量影响，前提是存在足够纠缠。对于更大系统，论文使用基于互补无偏基测量结果训练的 CNN，在仅使用完整状态重构所需测量的一部分时仍获得稳定准确的预测。
authors: Sai Sakunthala Guddanti, Anil Prabhakar, Ria Rushin Joseph

articles.title: AK-MCS-C2 : Active Kriging Monte Carlo Simulation method with conformal certification for failure probability estimation
articles.title_zh: AK-MCS-C2：用于失效概率估计的带共形认证主动 Kriging 蒙特卡罗模拟方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20191v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a novel active-learning framework for failure probability estimation in structural reliability analysis that integrates Active Kriging Monte Carlo simulation with conformal prediction. The proposed approach employs an adaptive cross-conformal strategy specifically designed for small-sample settings and kriging surrogate models using the J+GP conformal estimator. Unlike standard AK-MCS methods, the proposed framework provides distribution-free guarantees on prediction errors, leading to more reliable classification of samples near the limit-state surface. This improved uncertainty quantification enhances both the accuracy and robustness of failure probability estimates, especially for rare-event regimes where such efficiency is crucial. Reproducible numerical results illustrate the effectiveness of the method and also compare it to classical approaches on well-established benchmarks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种用于结构可靠性分析失效概率估计的主动学习框架，将主动 Kriging 蒙特卡罗模拟与共形预测相结合。方法采用面向小样本和 Kriging 代理模型的自适应交叉共形策略，并利用 J+GP 共形估计器，为预测误差提供分布无关保证。相较传统 AK-MCS，该框架可更可靠地分类极限状态面附近样本，提升稀有事件失效概率估计的准确性和稳健性。
authors: Edgar Jaber (CB,ENS Paris Saclay), Vincent Chabridon (EDF R&D PRISME), Mathilde Mougeot (CB,ENSIIE,ENS Paris Saclay)

articles.title: Flow Matching for Efficient and Scalable Data Assimilation
articles.title_zh: 用于高效可扩展数据同化的流匹配方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.13313v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Data assimilation (DA) estimates a dynamical system's state from noisy observations. Recent generative models like the ensemble score filter (EnSF) improve DA in high-dimensional nonlinear settings but are computationally expensive. We introduce the ensemble flow filter (EnFF), a training-free, flow matching (FM)-based framework that accelerates sampling and offers flexibility in flow design. EnFF uses Monte Carlo estimators for the marginal flow field, localized guidance for observation assimilation, and utilizes a novel flow path that exploits the Bayesian DA formulation. It generalizes classical filters such as the bootstrap particle filter and ensemble Kalman filter. Experiments on high-dimensional benchmarks demonstrate EnFF's improved cost-accuracy tradeoffs and scalability, highlighting FM's potential for efficient, scalable DA. Code is available at https://github.com/Utah-Math-Data-Science/Data-Assimilation-Flow-Matching.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出集合流滤波器 EnFF，一种无需训练、基于流匹配的数据同化框架，用于从噪声观测中估计动力系统状态。EnFF 使用边缘流场的蒙特卡罗估计、局部化观测引导，并设计了利用贝叶斯数据同化结构的新型流路径。该方法可推广若干经典滤波器，并在高维基准实验中展示了更优的成本—精度权衡和可扩展性。
authors: Taos Transue, Bohan Chen, So Takao, Bao Wang

articles.title: eCNNTO: A Highly Generalizable ConvNet for Accelerating Topology Optimization
articles.title_zh: eCNNTO：一种用于加速拓扑优化的高泛化卷积神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19921v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work proposes an element-based Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to accelerate density-based Topology Optimization (TO), termed eCNNTO. TO generally undergoes a large number of iterations, where finite element analysis is performed in every iteration, leading to the efficiency bottleneck especially when dense meshes are used to achieve high-resolution designs. To address this limitation, eCNNTO is proposed to build upon Kallioras et al. (2020), where a Deep Belief Network (DBN) was trained for every element to predict its near-optimal density from its early history, thereby skipping the great majority of iterations and significantly accelerating the TO procedure. However, the method lacks spatial correlations among neighboring elements and may lead to disconnected features in the final structure. The proposed method employs CNN with residual connections to address this issue. On top of it, a novel training strategy is introduced to further enhance the optimization efficiency, where the training dataset consists of the final stage density histories rather than early ones. This change can also help reduce the required training data size. eCNNTO requires only a small dataset to train and yet it can be generalized to problems with largely different boundary conditions, loading cases, design domain geometries, mesh resolutions, as well as non-design domains. In the end, the generalization capabilities and efficiency of eCNNTO are demonstrated through a variety of examples in two and three dimensions, achieving up to 90% and 97% reduction of iterations, respectively.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出基于单元的卷积神经网络 eCNNTO，用于加速密度型拓扑优化过程。传统拓扑优化每轮迭代都需有限元分析，在高分辨率网格下计算成本很高；既有逐单元深度置信网络方法虽能提前预测近优密度，但缺乏相邻单元间的空间相关性，可能导致结构不连通。eCNNTO 通过带残差连接的 CNN 引入空间相关建模，并采用基于最终阶段密度历史的训练策略，以提升优化效率并减少训练数据需求。

articles.title: The Tao of Agency: Autotelic AI, Embedded Agency and Dissolution of the Self
articles.title_zh: 能动性之道：自成目的人工智能、嵌入式能动性与自我的消解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19924v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Most artificial intelligence systems are built on the assumption that goals are exogenous and specified by the designer. Exploring what happens when an agent begins generating its own goals opens the field of autotelic AI. Agents are expected not merely to pursue objectives but to discover them. In this article, we trace its consequences through intrinsic motivation, resource-driven priors, causal-interventional learning, homeostasis, and embeddedness; the last of which is found to be a necessary but not sufficient condition for autotelic agency. Embeddedness individuates the agent at the cost of revealing that the individuation is non-unique, such that the same dynamics admit many valid partitions, each defining a different candidate self. The deepest problem with autotelic AI is therefore not how the agent generates goals, but how it generates and relativizes the self to which the goals are assigned. The agent must believe in its own boundary in order to act, and see through that boundary in order to understand. We consolidate these developments into a single framework and extend it along three directions: a quantum formulation in which the agent-environment cut becomes physical, a philosophical reading against non-dual contemplative traditions, and a concrete LLM-based agentic instantiation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文章讨论自成目的人工智能，即智能体不只是执行设计者给定目标，而是能够生成或发现自身目标。作者从内在动机、资源驱动先验、因果干预学习、稳态调节和嵌入性等角度分析其理论后果，并指出嵌入性虽是自成目的能动性的必要条件，但并不足以唯一界定智能体自身。文章的核心观点是，自成目的 AI 的深层问题不仅在于如何生成目标，更在于如何生成并相对化承载这些目标的“自我”边界。

articles.title: Modularity-Free Conflict-Averse Training for Generalized PINNs
articles.title_zh: 面向广义物理信息神经网络的无模块化冲突规避训练
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20156v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have become a powerful framework for solving PDEs by embedding physical laws into differentiable objectives. Despite their advances, training PINNs remains fragile: recent conflict-averse optimization schemes alleviate gradient interference between residual and boundary losses, but we show that their effectiveness deteriorates as model capacity increases. In this paper, we identify a capacity-induced failure mode, where overparameterized networks undergo functional modularity, self-partitioning into task-exclusive modules that suppress cross-objective interaction and hinder convergence toward Pareto-stationary points. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework, Modular-Sparsity Synchronization (ModSync), which integrates structural optimization into conflict-averse training by penalizing task-exclusive connections while preserving interaction-promoting pathways. Extensive experiments across diverse PDE benchmarks demonstrate that ModSync consistently prevents capacity-driven failures, sustains robust cross-objective coupling, and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy. Codes are available at r̆lhttps://github.com/heejokong/ModSync.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注物理信息神经网络在求解偏微分方程时的训练不稳定问题，尤其是残差损失与边界损失之间的梯度冲突。作者指出，现有冲突规避优化方法在模型容量增大时效果会下降，原因是过参数化网络可能出现功能模块化，自发分化为任务专属模块，从而削弱多目标交互。为此，论文提出 Modular-Sparsity Synchronization 框架，通过惩罚任务专属连接并保留促进交互的路径来防止容量诱发失效，并在多类 PDE 基准上取得更稳健的精度表现。
authors: Heejo Kong, Beomchul Park, Sung-Jin Kim, Seong-Whan Lee

articles.title: Exposing the Unsaid: Visualizing Hidden LLM Bias through Stochastic Path Aggregation
articles.title_zh: 揭示未言之物：通过随机路径聚合可视化大语言模型隐藏偏见
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19344v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit representational and syntactic biases that are difficult to evaluate due to the stochastic nature of text generation. Standard auditing methods rely on a single output inspection or static automated metrics. These approaches obscure the underlying probability distributions and fail to capture biases hidden in lower-probability generation branches. This paper introduces TreeTracer, a visual analytics tool designed to evaluate LLM bias through aggregated comparison. Using a systematic perturbation analysis pipeline, the tool replaces ontology-defined terms in each input prompt, aggregates hundreds of stochastic generations into a syntax-aligned hierarchical structure, and then performs classification-aware node merging with an auxiliary language model. The resulting structure is visualized through a custom Sankey diagram. By juxtaposing two ontology-driven trees, the workspace enables direct comparison between semantic contexts and supports systematic bias detection. Because any visualization reflects only a subset of the model's learned behavior, the system further applies contrastive inference to compute and directly display counterfactual token probabilities across contexts, reducing the risk of misinterpreting the presence of bias. We validate the workspace through case studies comparing an unaligned baseline model GPT-2 XL against the constitutionally aligned Apertus models. The visual aggregation successfully exposes hidden representational harms, such as counterfactual pronoun suppression and conversational marginalization of individuals. A preliminary user study confirms that the aggregated comparative interface reduces cognitive load and effectively supports analysts in detecting systemic biases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 TreeTracer，一种用于分析大语言模型偏见的可视分析工具，旨在捕捉单次输出检查或静态指标难以发现的低概率生成分支中的偏见。该工具通过系统性扰动输入提示中的本体术语，聚合大量随机生成结果，并构建语法对齐的层级结构，再借助辅助语言模型进行分类感知的节点合并。最终结果以定制的桑基图呈现，使用户能够并列比较不同语义语境下的生成路径，从而支持更系统的偏见检测。
authors: Matteo Pelossi, Rita Sevastjanova, Thilo Spinner, Mennatallah El-Assady

articles.title: A Tool for the Synthesis of Adaptive Probabilistic Processors Based on the Ising Model
articles.title_zh: 一种基于伊辛模型的自适应概率处理器综合工具
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19533v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This work presents a tool for the synthesis and simulation of probabilistic architectures for solving combinatorial optimization problems by mapping them to the Ising model. The proposed approach automatically constructs the Ising Hamiltonian and determines the number of probabilistic elements (p-bits) based on problem characteristics such as size and topology. Furthermore, the tool introduces an adaptive strategy for selecting the most suitable update algorithm among Gibbs Sampling, Simulated Annealing (SA), Simulated Quantum Annealing (SQA), and cluster-based methods. Experimental results using benchmark problems demonstrate improved convergence behavior and flexibility compared to fixed approaches. The proposed framework enables systematic evaluation of probabilistic computing strategies and supports the development of future hardware implementations based on MTJs and p-bits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种用于综合和仿真概率计算架构的工具，可将组合优化问题映射到伊辛模型。该工具能够根据问题规模、拓扑等特征自动构建伊辛哈密顿量并确定所需概率比特数量。它还引入自适应策略，在 Gibbs 采样、模拟退火、模拟量子退火和基于簇的方法之间选择合适的更新算法；基准实验显示其相较固定策略具有更好的收敛行为和灵活性。
authors: Jonathan Juracy Carneiro da Silva, Leonardo R. Gobatto, Jose Rodrigo Azambuja

articles.title: Review of Machine Learning Models for Solar Energetic Particle Prediction
articles.title_zh: 太阳高能粒子预测机器学习模型综述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19539v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Solar energetic particle (SEP) events have attracted increasing attention due to their significant radiation hazards for aviation, spacecraft electronics, and human missions beyond Earth's magnetosphere. From a scientific perspective, SEP events are intriguing because they arise from a set of physical processes extending from the solar surface and corona through the heliosphere, offering insight into particle acceleration and transport mechanisms that are widely applicable across astrophysics. Therefore, advancing our ability to understand and predict SEP events is essential both for deepening our knowledge of such mechanisms and for safeguarding space technologies and exploration. Traditionally, researchers have modeled SEPs using physics-based simulations and empirical methods. More recently, machine learning (ML) has emerged as a new tool for understanding and predicting SEP events. The purpose of this manuscript is to review the currently available ML models for SEP prediction, identify the datasets used for training, compare their architectures, inputs, and outputs, and, based on these insights, outline good practices and recommendations for future research.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述聚焦太阳高能粒子事件的机器学习预测模型，这类事件对航空、航天器电子设备以及地球磁层外载人任务具有重要辐射风险。文章概述了 SEP 事件的科学背景和传统物理、经验建模方法，并梳理近年来机器学习在 SEP 理解与预测中的应用。其目标是比较现有模型所用数据集、模型架构、输入与输出设置，并据此总结实践建议和未来研究方向。
authors: Spiridon Kasapis, Pouya Hosseinzadeh, Kathryn Whitman, Ricky Egeland, Manolis Georgoulis, Angelos Vourlidas, Athanasios Papaioannou, Eleni Lavasa, Anastasios Anastasiadis, Giorgos Giannopoulos, Andres Munoz-Jaramillo, Bala Poduval, Irina N. articles.title: Beyond Static Endpoints: Tool Programs as an Interface for Flexible Agentic Web Services
articles.title_zh: 超越静态端点：作为灵活智能体式网络服务接口的工具程序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19992v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In the agentic web era, LLM-based agents increasingly invoke web services as tools, yet most interfaces remain emphstatic endpoints that poorly express long-horizon workflows with loops, conditionals, joins, and retries. We present ToolPro, which represents an agent's tool intent as an emphexecutable tool program that compactly encodes multi-step service interactions with explicit effect types. ToolPro combines constraint-guided program construction, effect-aware replay for exactly-once state-modifying calls, and a profile-driven policy that decides when program execution outperforms stepwise calling. We instantiate ToolPro over MCP-style services with WebAssembly sandboxing and evaluate it on diverse workflows of real-world applications. ToolPro reduces end-to-end latency by up to 53.4% and client-side traffic by up to 96.1%, with larger gains under higher network latency and workflow complexity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 ToolPro，将智能体的工具调用意图表示为可执行的“工具程序”，用于表达包含循环、条件、汇合与重试的多步骤网络服务工作流。该方法结合约束引导的程序构建、面向效应类型的重放机制以及基于画像的执行策略，并在 MCP 风格服务与 WebAssembly 沙箱中实现。实验表明，ToolPro 可显著降低端到端延迟和客户端流量，尤其在网络延迟更高、工作流更复杂时收益更明显。
authors: Mugeng Liu, Shuoqi Li, Yixuan Zhang, Yun Ma

articles.title: Institutional Readiness and Governance Alignment: A Readiness Spine and Adaptive Loop for Sustaining Organisational Change in Developing Contexts
articles.title_zh: 制度准备度与治理协同：发展中情境下维持组织变革的准备度主干与自适应循环
articles.abstract: Purpose This paper develops the Readiness Spine and Adaptive Readiness Loop (ARL) to explain how institutional readiness supports sustained organisational alignment and change.Design/methodology/approach: The study employs theory building grounded in longitudinal action research and integrative synthesis of governance, institutional, organisational learning, and adaptive governance scholarship.Findings: Institutional readiness emerges through alignment among intent, capability, evidence, and authority, sustained through recurring cycles of variance detection and recalibration.Originality/value: The paper reconceptualises readiness as an emergent governance condition and introduces the Readiness Spine and ARL as complementary explanations of sustained organisational effectiveness.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出“准备度主干”和“自适应准备度循环”框架，用以解释制度准备度如何支撑组织持续协同与变革。研究基于纵向行动研究和对治理、制度、组织学习及适应性治理文献的综合理论建构。文章认为，制度准备度源于意图、能力、证据和权威之间的协同，并通过反复识别偏差与重新校准得以维持。

articles.title: Physical modelling composite magnetic fabrics using Big Coil Anisotropy meter and standard-sized palaeomagnetic specimens
articles.title_zh: 利用大线圈各向异性仪和标准古地磁样品对复合磁组构进行物理建模
articles.abstract: Magnetic fabric of rocks is often composite, i.e. consisting of two or more subfabrics either carried by different minerals or being oriented differently. To better understand the nature of such fabrics, composite magnetic fabric was modelled through simultaneous measurement of two specimens possessing different magnetic fabrics. Both the specimens were also measured separately, and the theoretical composite magnetic fabric was calculated from these separate measurements. Both in-phase and out-of-phase components of susceptibility were investigated. The experimental and theoretical AMS tensors are very similar differing only by measuring errors. We can conclude that using the technique volume weighted summing of susceptibility tensors in modelling composite magnetic fabric is fully justified not only for in-phase component, for which it was made many times by various authors in the past, but also for out-of-phase component, for which it is new. This approach can also be used in modelling magnetic fabric development during various geological processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过同时测量具有不同磁组构的两个样品来模拟岩石中的复合磁组构，并将实验结果与由单独测量张量加权求和得到的理论结果进行比较。研究同时考察了磁化率的同相与异相分量，发现实验与理论 AMS 张量高度一致，差异主要来自测量误差。结果表明，按体积加权叠加磁化率张量的方法不仅适用于同相分量，也可用于异相分量，并可用于模拟地质过程中磁组构的演化。

articles.title: Quantum Generative Intelligence for rare-event anomaly discovery under severe data scarcity: Applications to Glacier Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) Risk Reduction
articles.title_zh: 严重数据稀缺条件下用于稀有事件异常发现的量子生成智能：在冰湖溃决洪水风险降低中的应用
articles.abstract: Glacial lake outburst floods (GLOFs) are destructive cryosphere-related hazards shaped by nonlinear interactions among hydroclimatic forcing, glacier morphology, lake evolution, and geomorphological instability. Reliable precursor screening remains difficult because documented GLOF events are sparse, triggering mechanisms are heterogeneous, and pre-event hydroclimatic signals may appear as subtle changes in temporal organization rather than simple amplitude extremes. This study proposes a hybrid quantum-classical framework for rare hydroclimatic anomaly screening that integrates conditional multivariate sequence generation, quantum expectation-based latent anomaly scoring, and supervised rare-event classification. Hydroclimatic dynamics are modeled using conditional Wasserstein generative adversarial networks with gradient penalty (WGAN-GP), temporal convolutional sequence learning, and latent representations derived from parameterized quantum-circuit expectation values. Compared with Gaussian and sign latent baselines under identical WGAN-GP settings, the quantum latent formulation achieved lower errors in cross-feature correlation, Wasserstein distance, Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic, autocorrelation distance, and power spectral density distance in the present experimental setting. The anomaly-scoring module further identified cross-variable temporal correlation mismatch and autocorrelation deviation as precursor-relevant signals. Because the number of positive GLOF samples is limited, the supervised outputs are interpreted as high-recall anomaly-screening and ranking indicators rather than deterministic forecasts of GLOF occurrence. Explainability and ablation analyses indicate that quantum-derived temporal anomaly representations were more discriminative than compact hydroclimatic and static descriptors within the evaluated models. These results suggest that quantum expectation-based latent representations can improve hydroclimatic sequence realism and support rare-event anomaly prioritization for GLOF risk reduction under severe data imbalance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对冰湖溃决洪水事件稀少、触发机制复杂且前兆信号隐蔽的问题，提出一种量子—经典混合的罕见水文气候异常筛查框架。该框架结合条件多变量序列生成、基于量子期望值的潜在异常评分和监督式稀有事件分类，并使用 WGAN-GP、时间卷积序列学习和参数化量子线路表示水文气候动态。摘要显示，相较若干基线潜在表示，量子潜在形式在相关结构和分布度量等方面表现更优，但完整结果需参阅原文。

articles.title: HKUST-1@Co(OH)₂@rGO Nanocomposite as a High-Performance Electrode for Hybrid Supercapacitor and HER Applications
articles.title_zh: 用于混合超级电容器和析氢反应的高性能 HKUST-1@Co(OH)₂@rGO 纳米复合电极
articles.abstract: This research focuses on the invention of the HKUST@Co(OH)₂@rGO nanocomposite, which was successfully fabricated through a facile hydrothermal-assisted growth approach. The HKUST framework focused on the uniform integration of Co(OH)2 nanosheets onto conductive rGO sheets. The synergistic integration of porous HKUST and rGO significantly enhances conductivity and electrochemical performance compared with Co(OH)2, creating numerous redox-active sites and effective charge transport, resulting in an improved specific capacity (Qs) of 2640.35 C g⁻¹. For an asymmetric supercapacitor, the nanocomposite exhibited a high specific capacity of 463.22 C g⁻¹ at 1 A g⁻¹, attaining an energy density of 45.35 Wh kg⁻¹ at a power density of 2775.65 W kg⁻¹, while maintaining 97% capacitance over 10,000 charging/discharging cycles, confirming exceptional reliability. Except for energy storage, the material displayed notable hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) activity (overpotential of 46 mV), characterized by stable performance, reproducibility, and durable current response. These outcomes emphasize the dual potential of HKUST@Co(OH)₂@rGO composite as a multifunctional platform for next-generation supercapacitors and sustainable electrocatalysts, contributing a practicable pathway toward scalable energy and hydrogen technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过简便的水热辅助生长方法制备了 HKUST@Co(OH)₂@rGO 纳米复合材料，实现了 Co(OH)₂ 纳米片在导电 rGO 片上的均匀集成。多孔 HKUST 与 rGO 的协同作用提升了导电性、氧化还原活性位点数量和电荷传输性能，使材料在非对称超级电容器中表现出高比容量、较高能量密度和优异循环稳定性。该复合材料还表现出良好的析氢反应活性和耐久性，显示出面向储能与电催化的双功能应用潜力。

articles.title: Comparative Evaluation of Cytotoxicity of Zno-eugenol, Calcium Hydroxide, Resin and Bioceramic Endodontic Sealers After the Incorporation of Magnetic Nanoparticle- an in Vitro Study
articles.title_zh: 掺入磁性纳米颗粒后氧化锌丁香酚、氢氧化钙、树脂和生物陶瓷根管封闭剂细胞毒性的比较评价：一项体外研究
articles.abstract: Aim To evaluate and compare the cytotoxicity of four endodontic sealers epoxy resin-based (AH Plus), calcium hydroxide-based, zinc oxide-eugenol (ZOE)-based, and bioceramic, following the incorporation of magnetic nanoparticles (MNPs), using dental pulp stem cells (DPSCs) as the biological model.Methodology: 36 specimens were prepared and divided into four groups (n = 9 per group), each representing one sealer formulation modified with MNPs. Specimens were set in standardised cylindrical moulds (5 mm × 5 mm) at 37°C under 95% relative humidity for 48 hours, followed by UV sterilisation. DPSCs were seeded in 96-well plates at 10,000 cells/well and exposed to the respective sealer groups for 48 hours. Cytotoxicity was quantified using the MTT assay, with absorbance measured at 570 nm. Cellular morphology and adherence were assessed by phase-contrast microscopy. Data were analysed using one-way ANOVA with Tukey's post-hoc test (p < 0.05).Results The bioceramic sealer demonstrated the highest mean percentage cell viability among all experimental groups. A statistically significant difference in cell viability was observed between the AH Plus and bioceramic groups (mean difference: −428.1; 95% CI: −833.5 to − 22.65; p = 0.034). No statistically significant differences were identified among the remaining pairwise comparisons.Conclusion Within the limitations of this in vitro study, the bioceramic sealer incorporated with MNPs demonstrated superior biocompatibility compared to the epoxy resin-based sealer. All tested formulations exhibited acceptable cytotoxicity profiles relative to the control. Further in vivo investigations are warranted to validate these findings.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究以牙髓干细胞为模型，比较四类掺入磁性纳米颗粒的根管封闭剂的细胞毒性，包括环氧树脂基、氢氧化钙基、氧化锌丁香酚基和生物陶瓷封闭剂。研究通过标准化试样制备、细胞暴露、MTT 检测及显微形态观察评估细胞活性和黏附情况，并采用方差分析进行统计比较。摘要显示，生物陶瓷封闭剂具有最高的平均细胞存活率，且与 AH Plus 组之间存在显著差异。

articles.title: Radical Cations vs Cations: A Comparative Study of Retinyl Cation and Retinol Radical Cation
articles.title_zh: 自由基阳离子与阳离子：视黄基阳离子和视黄醇自由基阳离子的比较研究
articles.abstract: The reactivity of cationic and radical cationic intermediates has been extensively studied using both theoretical and experimental approaches. In the present study, the structurally related retinyl cation (Ret+) and retinol radical cation (retinol•+) were employed as models to compare the intrinsic reactivities of cations and radical cations within a common structural framework. Using laser flash photolysis (LFP) technique, these intermediates (λmax = 580–590 nm) were generated and their reactivities toward a variety of substrates were examined, including substrates undergoing exclusively electron-transfer reactions (e.g., ABTS2− and vitamin E), nucleophilic addition (e.g., Cl− and Br− anions), deprotonation (e.g., DBU), and multiple concurrent pathways (e.g., phenols, and aniline derivatives). Our results showed that all tested substrates reacted more rapidly with retinol•+ than with Ret+, with rate enhancements of up to 3–4 orders of magnitude for substrates such as ABTS2−, vitamin E, and certain phenols. For example, in methanol, the rate constants for the reactions of retinol•+ and Ret+ with ABTS2− were < 4.4×107 and 2.14×1010 M− 1 s− 1, respectively. The enhanced reactivity of retinol•+ was attributed to its higher reduction potential, which enabled an additional electron-transfer pathway alongside the nucleophilic addition and deprotonation pathways. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations further supported the greater electron affinity of retinol•+ relative to Ret+. Overall, the present findings indicated that radical cations generally exhibit higher reactivity than their corresponding cations. Finally, the potential photocytotoxicity of retinoids, which are widely used in cosmetic formulations, is discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文以结构相关的视黄基阳离子和视黄醇自由基阳离子为模型，在共同结构框架下比较阳离子与自由基阳离子的内在反应性。研究利用激光闪光光解生成中间体，并考察其与电子转移底物、亲核试剂、碱以及可能发生多路径反应的酚类和苯胺衍生物的反应。结果表明，测试底物普遍与视黄醇自由基阳离子反应更快，部分快速反应的速率提升可达数个数量级，说明自由基阳离子具有显著增强的反应活性。

articles.title: Conjugated Ferrocenes: Structure–Redox–Activity Relationships from Synthesis, Electrochemical, Computational, and Biological Studies
articles.title_zh: 共轭二茂铁：来自合成、电化学、计算和生物学研究的结构—氧化还原—活性关系
articles.abstract: The synthesis and characterization of conjugated ferrocenes 1–4, namely 1,1′-bis[2-(4-formylphenyl)ethenyl]ferrocene (1), 1,1′-bis[2-(4-ethenylphenyl)ethenyl]ferrocene (2), 1,1′-bis[2-(4-ethenylphenyl)ferrocen-1-ylethenyl]ferrocene (3), and 1,1′,2,2′-tetrakis[2-(ferrocen-1-ylethenyl)]ferrocene (4), is presented. The preparation of 3 and 4 follows a Heck C–C cross-coupling protocol, while 2 was obtained via a Wittig reaction. The electrochemical behavior of 1–4 was investigated by cyclic voltammetry, revealing reversible Fc/Fc⁺ redox couples for all compounds. Compound 1 exhibits an anodic shift, whereas compound 2 shows a cathodic shift relative to ferrocene. Compound 3 displays closely spaced redox events, while compound 4 shows distinct oxidation processes corresponding to core and peripheral ferrocenyl units, reflecting weak to moderate electronic coupling through the ethylene bridges. Cell viability assays indicate dose-dependent cytotoxic effects against PANC1 and U87 cell lines, with compound 3 showing the highest activity while maintaining low toxicity toward HDF cells. DFT calculations reveal that variations in substituents (benzaldehyde vs vinyl) modulate HOMO–LUMO gaps and correlate with observed electrochemical trends. These results highlight the role of ferrocenyl multiplicity and conjugation in tuning redox behavior and biological response.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了四种共轭二茂铁化合物的合成与表征，其中部分化合物通过 Heck 交叉偶联或 Wittig 反应制备。循环伏安结果显示这些化合物均具有可逆的二茂铁/二茂铁鎓氧化还原对，不同取代基和分子结构导致氧化电位发生阳极或阴极移动，并反映出乙烯桥连接下弱至中等的电子耦合。细胞活性实验显示其对 PANC1 和 U87 细胞具有剂量依赖性细胞毒性，其中化合物 3 活性最高且对 HDF 细胞毒性较低；DFT 计算进一步揭示取代基对前线轨道能隙和电子结构的调控作用。

articles.title: The Convective Switch: Unveiling Alpine Landslide Triggers via High-Resolution Topography and Deep Learning
articles.title_zh: 对流开关：利用高分辨率地形与深度学习揭示阿尔卑斯滑坡触发机制
articles.abstract: Background: Data-driven models, particularly deep learning, have increasingly dominated Landslide Susceptibility Mapping (LSM). However, regional studies often rely on coarse-resolution data and "black-box" architectures. Objective: This study proposes a physics-aware, Dual-Branch Deep Learning framework to predict rainfall-induced landslides in the Tyrolean Alps, bridging the gap between empirical algorithms and geomorphology. Methods: 30-day dynamic antecedent precipitation arrays were processed via an advanced Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network, fused with static 5-meter resolution morphometric derivatives. To achieve robust interpretability, an Integrated Gradients (IG) framework was implemented. Results: The model achieved a robust performance (AUC = 0.768). IG revealed the precise spatiotemporal triggers, while a physics-informed geomorphological constraint (slopes ≤ 15° = 0 probability) eliminated false-positive artifacts in valley bottoms. Conclusions: The results prove that integrating dynamic meteorological memory with high-resolution topographic constraints is essential for the next generation of predictive hazard systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种具有物理意识的双分支深度学习框架，用于预测蒂罗尔阿尔卑斯地区降雨诱发滑坡。模型将 30 天动态前期降水序列经 LSTM 处理后，与 5 米分辨率静态地貌形态指标融合，并利用积分梯度方法解释触发因素。结果显示模型具有较稳健的预测性能，且引入坡度约束可减少谷底误报，表明动态气象记忆与高分辨率地形约束的结合对下一代滑坡灾害预测系统具有重要意义。

articles.title: The microscopic origin of a hesitant world: Quadrangular holes govern path multiplicity in complex networks
articles.title_zh: 犹豫世界的微观起源：四边形洞控制复杂网络中的路径多重性
articles.abstract: Complex networks provide a unified framework for describing interacting complex systems, from cells and brains to power grids and social media. As a foundational concept in graph theory, paths that link nodes through edges play a central role in network analysis and computation. Recent work has revealed substantial heterogeneity in shortest path multiplicity across synthetic and empirical networks. However, the core structural mechanisms that give rise to such path multiplicity remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we show that path multiplicity is governed by chordless 4-cycles, namely quadrangular holes. We first investigate topological features of extremal graphs that maximize path multiplicity and, surprisingly, find that these graphs are enriched with chordless 4-cycles, suggesting a plausible microscopic mechanism underlying path multiplicity. We then validate this hypothesis across 140 empirical networks and eight classical synthetic networks. Furthermore, we verify the connection between chordless 4-cycles and path multiplicity through target-oriented optimization and theoretical derivations. Our findings reveal how local motifs shape global path multiplicity, with significant potential applications in network design and optimization in various fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究复杂网络中最短路径多重性差异的结构来源，指出无弦 4-环即“四边形洞”是控制路径多重性的关键局部结构。作者首先分析使路径多重性最大化的极值图，发现其中富集无弦 4-环，进而在 140 个真实网络和 8 类经典合成网络中验证这一假设。研究还通过目标导向优化和理论推导确认了无弦 4-环与路径多重性之间的联系，揭示了局部网络模体如何影响全局路径结构。

articles.title: Addressing hypersensitivity in density functional theory for reliable machine learning
articles.title_zh: 解决密度泛函理论中的超敏感性以实现可靠机器学习

articles.title: A Defect-Free Model of Amorphous Silicon with Pristine Electronic Structure
articles.title_zh: 具有本征电子结构的无缺陷非晶硅模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20500v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Amorphous silicon (a-Si) is understood to be the canonical continuous random network material, ideally defined by fully fourfold coordination. Here, we show that a defect-free ('ideal') model of a-Si from machine-learning-driven molecular-dynamics simulations [L. A. M. Rosset et al., Nat. Commun. 16, 2360 (2025)], subsequently evaluated with hybrid-level density-functional theory computations, can accurately reproduce the experimentally observed electronic bandgap. We compare this model with one resulting from the Wooten-Winer-Weaire (WWW) bond-switching approach and with other recent approximants to ideal a-Si. More broadly, our work provides a platform for studies of band tails, optical properties, and transport in a-Si.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究构建并评估了一种无缺陷的理想非晶硅模型，该模型来自机器学习驱动分子动力学模拟，并进一步采用混合泛函密度泛函理论计算电子结构。结果表明，该模型能够较准确地再现实验观测到的非晶硅电子带隙。作者还将其与 Wooten-Winer-Weaire 键交换模型及其他理想非晶硅近似模型进行比较，为研究带尾、光学性质和输运行为提供了平台。
authors: Louise A. M. Rosset, Chinonso Ugwumadu, Stephen R. Elliott, David A. Drabold, Volker L. Deringer

articles.title: Matrix Product Operator Encodings of the Magnus Expansion and Dyson Series
articles.title_zh: Magnus 展开与 Dyson 级数的矩阵乘积算符编码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.21597v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce a matrix product operator (MPO) encoding of the Magnus expansion and the Dyson series for one-dimensional quantum lattice models with time-dependent Hamiltonians. The MPO construction can be made accurate up to arbitrary order in the time step, it can be applied to both finite and infinite systems, and it can handle long-range interactions. The resulting MPO can be combined with state-of-the-art time evolution algorithms based on matrix product states, allowing for drastic improvements in simulating evolution under time-dependent Hamiltonians. Our MPO construction can also be used for the optimization of quantum circuits in the context of quantum simulation of time-dependent Hamiltonians.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出了用于一维含时量子晶格模型的 Magnus 展开和 Dyson 级数的矩阵乘积算符编码方法。该构造可在时间步长上达到任意阶精度，适用于有限和无限体系，并可处理长程相互作用。结合基于矩阵乘积态的先进时间演化算法后，该方法可显著改进含时哈密顿量演化模拟，并可用于含时量子模拟中的量子线路优化。
authors: Victor Vanthilt, Maarten Van Damme, Jutho Haegeman, Ian P. McCulloch, Laurens Vanderstraeten

articles.title: Foreign Object Damage Mechanism of Ti60 Alloy under High-Temperature Conditions
articles.title_zh: 高温条件下 Ti60 合金的外物损伤机制
articles.abstract: To address the problem of foreign object damage (FOD) to titanium alloy compressor blades in aero-engines under high-temperature conditions, FOD tests under the same parameters at room temperature and 500℃ were conducted on Ti60 specimens. The macroscopic and microscopic characteristics of the foreign object damage were observed by scanning electron microscopy, energy dispersive spectroscopy and electron backscatter diffraction(EBSD). The research results show that high temperature has a significant impact on the foreign object damage behavior of Ti60 alloy. Under the same impact conditions, the specimens tested at 500℃ suffered much more severe damage than those tested at room temperature. The average crater depth, crater diameter and backside bulge height increased by 63.6%, 20.3% and 91.5%, respectively. High temperature also promoted surface oxidation, forming a brittle oxide layer that fractured under the impact load, causing the generation and propagation of cracks, and ultimately resulting in a network of cracks and continuous macroscopic fracture on the surface of the craters. In addition, high temperature changed the deformation response of Ti60 alloy at room temperature, transforming it from a relatively localized plastic deformation mode to a composite mode with more extensive plastic flow and more severe local deformation at the crater center.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对航空发动机钛合金压气机叶片在高温下的外物损伤问题，对 Ti60 合金试样在室温和 500℃ 下开展相同参数的冲击实验。结果显示，高温显著加剧损伤程度，使坑深、坑径和背面鼓包高度均明显增加，并促进表面氧化形成脆性氧化层。该氧化层在冲击载荷下开裂，诱发裂纹生成和扩展，最终在损伤坑表面形成网状裂纹和连续宏观断裂。

articles.title: Nd-Doped NiFe₂O₄ Nanoparticles for Enhanced X-Band Electromagnetic Wave Absorption
articles.title_zh: 用于增强 X 波段电磁波吸收的 Nd 掺杂 NiFe₂O₄ 纳米颗粒
articles.abstract: Doping rare-earth (RE) elements into ferrites is an effective strategy for modifying their physical structure, magnetic response, and electromagnetic-wave absorption behavior. In this study, nickel ferrite nanoparticles were modified with a small amount of neodymium (Nd) using a simple coprecipitation method. The influence of Nd content on morphology, crystal structure, elemental composition, magnetic properties, and X-band absorption performance was investigated using SEM-EDX, XRD, EDX mapping, VSM, and vector-network-analyzer measurements. The results confirmed the successful formation of Nd-doped nickel ferrite materials with different Nd contents. Nd incorporation reduced nanoparticle agglomeration and altered the magnetic parameters, particularly saturation magnetization and coercive field, thereby improving impedance matching and electromagnetic-wave attenuation in the 8–12 GHz range. The strongest reflection loss reached − 25.47 dB at 11.56 GHz for the NiFe₁.₉₇Nd₀.₀₃O₄ sample at a matching thickness of 2.0 mm, corresponding to an electromagnetic-wave absorption efficiency of approximately 99.7%. These results indicate that Nd-doped NiFe₂O₄ nanoparticles are promising candidates for X-band electromagnetic-wave absorption and shielding applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用共沉淀法制备了少量 Nd 掺杂的镍铁氧体纳米颗粒，并系统考察 Nd 含量对形貌、晶体结构、元素组成、磁性能和 X 波段吸收性能的影响。结果表明，Nd 掺杂可降低颗粒团聚并调控饱和磁化强度和矫顽场等磁参数，从而改善阻抗匹配和电磁波衰减能力。NiFe₁.₉₇Nd₀.₀₃O₄ 样品在 2.0 mm 匹配厚度下于 11.56 GHz 达到 −25.47 dB 的最强反射损耗，显示出约 99.7% 的吸收效率。

articles.title: Facile Co-Precipitation Synthesis of Spinel CoFe3O4 Nanoparticles with Enhanced Visible-Light Photocatalytic and Antimicrobial Performance
articles.title_zh: 简便共沉淀法合成尖晶石 CoFe3O4 纳米颗粒及其增强的可见光光催化与抗微生物性能
articles.abstract: The structural, optical, morphological, photocatalytic, antibacterial, and antifungal properties of CoFe3O4 nanoparticles were thoroughly examined after they were successfully synthesized using a simple co-precipitation method. Field-emission scanning electron microscopy (FE-SEM), energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS), X-ray diffraction (XRD), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), Raman spectroscopy, and UV-visible spectroscopy were used to characterize the produced nanoparticles. With an optical band gap of 1.55 eV and strong visible-light absorption, UV-Vis analysis demonstrated exceptional visible-light responsiveness. Phase-pure spinel CoFe3O4 with good crystallinity and suitable oxidation states was confirmed by Raman, XRD, and XPS investigations. Analyses using FE-SEM and EDS showed homogeneous elemental distribution and almost spherical morphology. Due to improved charge separation and reactive oxygen species production, the nanoparticles demonstrated effective visible light-driven photocatalytic activity. Significant antifungal and antibacterial effects against a variety of pathogenic microbes were also noted. These results demonstrate the potential of CoFe3O4 nanoparticles as multipurpose nanomaterials for antimicrobial and environmental remediation applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用简便共沉淀法成功合成 CoFe3O4 纳米颗粒，并系统考察其结构、光学、形貌、光催化、抗菌和抗真菌性能。多种表征结果表明，样品为结晶性良好的纯相尖晶石 CoFe3O4，呈近球形且元素分布均匀，光学带隙约为 1.55 eV，具有强可见光吸收能力。纳米颗粒在可见光下表现出有效的光催化活性，并对多种病原微生物显示显著抑制作用，显示其在环境修复和抗微生物应用中的潜力。

articles.title: Understanding Structural Electrochemistry, Charge, Energy and Reactive Sensing Capabilities of Polyaniline Using Coulovoltammetry
articles.title_zh: 利用库仑伏安法理解聚苯胺的结构电化学、 charge 与能量及反应传感能力
articles.abstract: A detailed insight into the structural electrochemistry of polyaniline (PANI) has been presented through assessing the electrochemical redox processes of PANI by quantifying charge and electrical energy consumed during the reaction using coulovoltammograms. Coulovoltammetric responses during potential cycles are employed here as an efficient electrochemical tool to identify and separate the different structural components of the electrode reaction: oxidation/diffusion (fast), oxidation/relaxation (slow), reduction/diffusion (fast) and reduction/compaction (slow). The reversible and irreversible oxidations and reductions with respect to anodic and cathodic potential limits have been identified and quantified in terms of consumed charge. The accurate potential window of the PANI electrode that only has reversible oxidation/reduction is identified by the coulovoltammogram. Further, the sensing characteristics of PANI reaction have been studied using coulovoltammetry and proved that the electrochemical reactions of polyaniline can sense their working ambient such as electrical, chemical and thermal working conditions without additional connectivities through consumed charge and/or electrical energy consumed during the reaction as sensing parameters. This investigation offers valuable insight into PANI’s versatile applications as a sensing biomimetic device.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文通过库仑伏安图定量分析聚苯胺在电化学氧化还原过程中的电荷与电能消耗，从而揭示其结构电化学行为。研究将电极反应分解为快速的氧化/扩散、慢速的氧化/弛豫、快速的还原/扩散和慢速的还原/压实等组成，并识别了可逆与不可逆反应对应的电位范围。结果表明，库仑伏安法不仅可确定聚苯胺电极的可逆工作窗口，还可通过电荷或能量响应感知其电、化学和热工作环境。

articles.title: Depth-dependent coupling of dissolved organic matter chemodiversity and microbial community traits reveals threshold effects of combined fertilization on soil carbon stabilization in arid agroecosystems
articles.title_zh: 溶解性有机质化学多样性与微生物群落性状的深度依赖耦合揭示干旱农田生态系统施肥对土壤碳稳定的阈值效应
articles.abstract: Background How fertilization influences the coupled dynamics of DOM composition and microbial communities across soil depths in arid agroecosystems remains unclear.Methods The molecular composition of DOM and microbial communities in surface (0–20 cm) and subsurface (20–40 cm) soil layers from a 7-year field experiment comprising six fertilization treatments: no fertilization (CK), chemical fertilizer (NPK), organic fertilizer (M), half-rate chemical fertilizer plus M (0.5NPKM), chemical fertilizer plus M (NPKM), and 1.5-fold chemical fertilizer plus M (1.5NPKM) was analysied using spectroscopic, mass spectrometric, and sequencing approaches.Results NPK and M treatments significantly reduced DOM content in the surface layer by 12.14% and 22.87%, respectively, relative to CK. However, combined fertilization increased surface DOM content compared with the single treatments, and this effect became more pronounced with higher proportions of NPK. Organic fertilizer enhanced DOM aromaticity and facilitated the transformation of humic-like into protein-like and fulvic-like components. The application of organic fertilizer promoted the conversion of oxygen-rich and labile compounds (aliphatic/peptide-like and lipids) into nitrogen- and sulfur-containing compounds as well as more aromatic structures. Combined organic-inorganic fertilization enriched Proteobacteria/Ascomycota and increased microbial network complexity. Actinobacteria consumed labile substrates, while Acidobacteria/Chloroflexi allowed persistence via slow utilization. Fungi driving both the synthesis of fresh microbial metabolites in surface soils and the formation of stable carbon pools in subsurface layers through humification and lipid accumulation. Ascomycota regulating DOM aromaticity in the surface layer and coupling with nitrogen cycling in the subsurface.Conclusion Organic-inorganic fertilization drives soil organic carbon stabilization through molecular-level DOM-microbe interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究基于 7 年田间试验，利用光谱、质谱和测序方法分析不同施肥处理下 0–20 cm 与 20–40 cm 土层中溶解性有机质组成及微生物群落变化。结果显示，单施化肥或有机肥会降低表层 DOM 含量，而有机无机配施可提高表层 DOM，且随化肥比例增加效应增强。有机肥促进 DOM 芳香性提升及类腐殖质向类蛋白、类富里酸组分转化，并影响活性含氧化合物的转化过程，表明施肥对土壤碳稳定具有深度依赖和阈值特征。

articles.title: First-Principles Study of Hydrogen Storage Enhancement on MgH2 (001) via Multi-RE Synergistic Doping
articles.title_zh: 多稀土协同掺杂增强 MgH2 (001) 储氢性能的第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: Context Rare earth (RE) element doping has emerged as an effective strategy to enhance the hydrogen storage performance of magnesium-based alloys. In this study, first-principles calculations were employed to systematically investigate the effects of single RE (RE: Ce, Y, Nd, La)-doped and double RE co-doped systems on the thermal stability, electronic properties and hydrogen adsorption-desorption behaviors of the MgH2 (001) surface. The results demonstrate that the doping of rare earth element on the MgH2 (001) surface is thermodynamically feasible. The substitution of Mg atoms with single Y atoms reduces the hydrogen diffusion energy barrier by 1.68 eV (pure MgH2 (001) of 2.34 eV), while the synergistic substitution of Mg atoms with 2Y pairs lowers the hydrogen desorption energy barrier by 1.30 eV (pure MgH2 (001) of 2.91 eV). The electronic structure results reveal that Y doping weakens the orbital interaction between H atoms and the substrate, which markedly reduces the bonding interaction on the MgH2 (001) surface and enhances the hydrogen storage performance of MgH2 (001)-based materials. This study provides important theoretical guidance for the fabrication of rare earth-doped MgH2-based hydrogen storage materials. Methods The RE-doped MgH2 (001) surface has been investigated using DFT calculations as implemented in the VASP code, and using PAW pseudopotential within the framework of the GGA-PBE and energy cutoff of 500 eV. The force components were smaller than 0.02 eV/Å and the Grimme-D3 scheme was considered. The climbing image nudged elastic band (CI-NEB) method was adopted with a force convergence threshold of 0.05 eV·Å−1, and a Monkhorst-Pack grid of 2 × 2 × 1 k-points was used for structural relaxations and electronic-properties calculations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用第一性原理计算，系统考察 Ce、Y、Nd、La 等稀土元素单掺杂及双稀土共掺杂对 MgH2 (001) 表面热稳定性、电子结构和氢吸附/脱附行为的影响。结果表明，稀土元素掺杂在热力学上可行，其中 Y 掺杂可显著降低氢扩散能垒，2Y 协同取代可降低氢脱附能垒。电子结构分析显示，Y 掺杂削弱 H 原子与基底间的轨道相互作用，从而改善 MgH2 基材料的储氢性能。

articles.title: Agricultural liming is a large carbon sink in the Mississippi River Basin
articles.title_zh: 农业施石灰是密西西比河流域的重要碳汇
articles.abstract: The application of carbonate minerals to arable lands — agricultural liming — is a long-standing practice for counteracting soil acidification due to atmospheric pollution and anthropogenic fertilizer addition1–3. While this practice boosts crop yields and mitigates soil acidification4, it is widely considered to be a significant component of agricultural emissions of carbon dioxide (CO2)5. Here, we use a multi-decade timeseries of agricultural liming and anthropogenic acidity for the Mississippi River Basin — one of the largest agricultural catchments on Earth — together with results from reactive transport modeling to show that agricultural liming has acted as a net carbon sink over the last century. We show that ~75% (65-85%) of the maximum carbon dioxide removal potential of agricultural lime added since 1900 has been realized on the catchment scale, with a time lag due to soil cation exchange and solute transport of roughly ~15 years. Our results suggest that it is the addition of anthropogenic acidity to agricultural systems that should be thought of as an emissions source, rather than the addition of lime, and underscore that optimized soil pH management can significantly reduce agricultural greenhouse gas emissions while augmenting crop yields and soil health.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合密西西比河流域多年代农业施石灰和人为酸度时间序列，以及反应输运模型，重新评估农业施用碳酸盐矿物的碳收支作用。结果表明，自 1900 年以来施入农业石灰的最大二氧化碳去除潜力约有 75% 已在流域尺度实现，并存在约 15 年的滞后，这与土壤阳离子交换和溶质输运有关。研究认为，应将人为酸度输入视为农业系统中的重要排放来源，而非简单将施石灰视为 CO2 排放源，并强调优化土壤 pH 管理的碳减排意义。

articles.title: Five phases of localization physics observed in a single quantum system
articles.title_zh: 在单一量子系统中观测到局域化物理的五个相
articles.abstract: Physicists in China have observed five phases in localization physics within a single quantum system. Using an advanced photonic platform, the team, led by Yucheng Wang and Jingyun Fan at the Southern University of Science and Technology, Shenzhen, has demonstrated that localization physics is likely far richer than physicists anticipated. Their results have been published in Physical Review Letters.
articles.abstract_zh: 该新闻报道介绍了中国物理学家在单一量子系统中观测到局域化物理的五个相。研究团队利用先进光子平台展示了局域化现象可能比以往预期更为丰富。相关结果已发表于《Physical Review Letters》，具体实验细节和理论解释需查阅原文。

articles.title: Out-of-equilibrium cesium atoms reveal fractional Fermi seas, exposing new critical quantum phase
articles.title_zh: 非平衡铯原子揭示分数费米海并暴露新的临界量子相
articles.abstract: In a new study published in Physical Review Letters, a team from the Nägerl group, together with theory collaborator Alvise Bastianello from the CNRS and the Université Paris-Dauphine, demonstrates that highly unusual quantum states known as "fractional Fermi seas" can be quantum engineered.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道概述了一项发表于《Physical Review Letters》的研究，其中研究团队通过非平衡铯原子体系实现或揭示了被称为“分数费米海”的异常量子态。该工作表明这类量子态可通过量子工程手段构造，并可能揭示新的临界量子相。更多关于实验方案、观测信号和理论模型的细节需查阅原文。

articles.title: Twist-controlled modulation of quantum emitters in hexagonal boron nitride
articles.title_zh: 六方氮化硼中量子发射体的扭转可控调制
articles.abstract: Science Advances, Volume 12, Issue 25, June 2026.
articles.abstract_zh: 该条目为《Science Advances》2026 年第 12 卷第 25 期论文信息，摘要仅提供题名和期刊元数据。根据标题，该工作围绕六方氮化硼中量子发射体的性质如何受层间扭转或扭角调控展开，可能涉及二维材料量子光源的可控调制。具体实验方法、调制机制和性能结果需查阅原文。
authors: Angus Gale, Seungjun Lee, Seungmin Park, Evan Williams, Helen Zhi Jie Zeng, James Liddle-Wesolowski, Young Duck Kim, Milos Toth, Tony Low, Igor Aharonovich
