articles.title: Unleashing Emergent Fermions with Rydberg Atom Simulators
articles.title_zh: 利用里德堡原子模拟器释放涌现费米子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19444v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rydberg atom simulators, in both analog and digital modes, have attracted significant recent interest due to their versatile geometric reconfigurability. In this work, leveraging this feature, we propose two complementary approaches, one for each mode, to characterize emergent fermions in critical quantum many-body systems. In the analog mode, we assemble the Rydberg atoms in a "developable" (namely, preserving local couplings) Möbius band geometry to realize antiperiodic boundary conditions, where fermionic states reside. Spectroscopic measurement in this sector then reveals universal energy ratios of the bosonic and fermionic states. In the digital mode, we carry out a fermionic version of Kibble-Zurek ramping with a quantum circuit, directly addressing the fermionic scaling form. Reconfigurability allows an exponential speed-up of this task, with an O(łog Lłogłog L) circuit-depth overhead. Our work establishes the Rydberg atom simulator as a uniquely powerful platform to attack the notoriously difficult issue of experimentally probing emergent fermions that are nonlocally defined in a bosonic system.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出利用模拟和数字两种模式的里德堡原子模拟器来表征临界量子多体系统中的涌现费米子。在模拟模式中，作者构造保持局域耦合的莫比乌斯带几何以实现反周期边界条件，并通过能谱测量揭示玻色与费米态的普适能量比。在数字模式中，研究设计费米子版 Kibble-Zurek 斜坡量子电路，利用可重构性实现对非局域定义的涌现费米子的高效实验探测。
authors: Hanteng Wang, Xingyu Li, Shang Liu, Yingfei Gu, Chengshu Li

articles.title: Exact operator dynamics in Lindbladian Wess-Zumino-Witten conformal field theories
articles.title_zh: Lindblad 型 Wess-Zumino-Witten 共形场论中的精确算符动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19465v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the time evolution of physical observables in open quantum many-body systems coupled to external environments is a natural and difficult problem, and exact results are still rare. In this work, we study this problem for Wess-Zumino-Witten (WZW) conformal field theories with Lindblad jump operators linear in Kac-Moody current modes. We investigate the exact operator dynamics generated by these Lindbladians, identifying classes of current operators whose Heisenberg equations close and can therefore be solved analytically using the underlying current algebra. In Abelian U(1)ₖ WZW theories, this closure of operator dynamics holds for arbitrary settings of jump rates and includes exactly tractable cooling dynamics. In contrast, for non-Abelian WZW theories, exact closure occurs only for symmetric current-mode dissipation, where upward and downward current-mode transitions occur with equal rates, and even then it leads to a simple closed evolution only for a single current operator. Generic imbalances, including those needed for cooling, produce additional non-Abelian terms and prevent closure of the opeartor dynamics. Consequently, the current algebra gives rise to a broad family of exactly solvable dissipative dynamics in the Abelian setting, whereas in the non-Abelian case it singles out only a special exactly solvable dynamics corresponding to an infinite-temperature bath.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察外部环境耦合下开放量子多体系统中物理可观测量的时间演化，重点分析含 Kac-Moody 流模式线性 Lindblad 跳跃算符的 WZW 共形场论。作者识别出若干流算符类别，其海森堡方程可闭合并可借助底层流代数解析求解。在 Abelian U(1)ₖ WZW 理论中，任意跳跃率设置下均存在可闭合动力学并包括可精确处理的冷却过程；而在非 Abelian 情形中，精确闭合仅在对称流模式耗散等受限条件下出现。
authors: Qicheng Tang, Ruhanshi Barad, Xueda Wen

articles.title: Optical spin injection in graphane and fluorographene
articles.title_zh: 石墨烷与氟化石墨烯中的光学自旋注入
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19571v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate the optical spin-injection response in different stoichiometric configurations of graphane and fluorographene using density functional theory. Our goal is to determine which configuration yields the strongest degree of spin polarization. The results show that the fluorographene zigzag configuration yields the best degree of spin polarization response (a̧l DSPz), with 98% spin polarized electrons at the band edge and over a wide range of excitation photon energies. In contrast, other graphane and fluorographene configurations achieve a a̧l DSPz of roughly 83--100%, but only within a limited photon-excitation energy range. In structures with low spin-orbit coupling, the degree of spin polarization is close to 100% over a wide range of photon energies. For higher spin-orbit coupling, this strong response appears, but only in a narrow photon energy region. Additionally, under the band-resolved decomposition scheme, the contributions of different band-to-band transitions to the a̧l DSPz spectrum are identified by summing only the selected valence and conduction bands. Our findings show that almost the entire a̧l DSPz spectrum of the fluorographene zigzag configuration comes from transitions that involve only the top valence band, which is a mixture of C--p and F--p states.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究基于密度泛函理论，理论分析不同化学计量构型的石墨烷和氟化石墨烯的光学自旋注入响应，以寻找最高自旋极化程度的结构。结果显示，氟化石墨烯锯齿构型在带边及较宽激发光子能量范围内可产生约 98% 的自旋极化电子，表现最佳。研究还通过能带分解识别不同带间跃迁对自旋极化谱的贡献，为二维材料中的光控自旋电子应用提供理论依据。
authors: Angélica Marina López-Martínez, César Castillo-Quevedo, Cesar Camas-Flores, Analila Luna-Valenzuela, Jose Luis Cabellos

articles.title: Thickness-Dependent Interlayer Coupling and Semiconductor-to-Semimetal Crossover in Arsenene Multilayers
articles.title_zh: 砷烯多层膜中厚度依赖的层间耦合与半导体—半金属跨越
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19780v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interlayer interactions in layered materials are often assumed to transfer from the bilayer to the bulk, but this assumption can fail when chemically active out-of-plane orbitals participate in bonding. We combine diffusion quantum Monte Carlo (DMC) and density functional theory (DFT) to determine how interlayer coupling evolves in arsenene multilayers. DMC shows that bulk gray arsenic is compact, whereas the corresponding few-layer structures remain at substantially larger interlayer separations despite sharing the same nominal A₁B₋₁ adjacent-layer registry. Registry alone therefore does not determine the bonding regime; thickness and coordination reshape the interlayer interaction. Among the tested functionals, SCAN+rVV10 most closely reproduces DMC equilibrium separations and stacking energetics. Using the DMC-benchmarked SCAN+rVV10 calculations, we predict a thickness-driven stacking sequence from A₁A₁ to A₁B₁ and finally bulk-like A₁B₋₁. The structural crossover coincides with a stacking-dependent DFT band-gap collapse driven by enhanced interlayer As pz hybridization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合扩散量子蒙特卡罗与密度泛函理论，考察砷烯多层结构中层间耦合如何随厚度演化。结果表明，体相灰砷结构较紧凑，而少层结构即使具有相同名义层间配准也保持更大的层间距，说明配准并非决定成键机制的唯一因素。经DMC标定的SCAN+rVV10计算预言了随厚度变化的堆垛序列，并指出结构跨越伴随由As pz轨道层间杂化增强导致的带隙塌缩。
authors: Jeonghwan Ahn, Seoung-Hun Kang, Jaron T. Krogel

articles.title: Tunneling-induced translation of intact π-radical clusters on Au(111)
articles.title_zh: Au(111)表面完整π自由基团簇的隧穿诱导平移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20038v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The scanning tunneling microscope (STM) is a powerful tool for investigating and manipulating molecules on surfaces. We demonstrate with a low-temperature STM operated at 6.2 K the controlled manipulation of ternary clusters of persistent molecular π radicals as a whole. The ternary clusters - each self-assembled from three α,γ-bisdiphenylene-β-phenylallyl (BDPA) molecules on Au(111) - maintain their natural cluster structure throughout tip-induced translation and rotation relative to the surface. Sustained and repeated dragging of radical clusters is shown to facilitate the construction of artificial assemblies of several clusters. Our results provide new opportunities for the creation and investigation of radical-based spin assemblies on surfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用6.2 K低温扫描隧道显微镜，实现了对Au(111)表面由三个BDPA分子自组装形成的三元持久π自由基团簇的整体操控。团簇在针尖诱导的平移和旋转过程中保持其天然结构不被破坏。反复拖拽这些自由基团簇可构建多团簇人工组装体，为表面自由基自旋组装结构的制备与研究提供了新途径。
authors: Jacob D. Teeter, Kateryna Averchenko, Maximilian Eliasch, Stefan Müllegger

articles.title: Norms, overlaps and Yangian descendants for the Haldane--Shastry spin chain
articles.title_zh: Haldane–Shastry自旋链的范数、重叠与Yangian后代态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20168v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Haldane-Shastry spin chain is a prototypical integrable model with long-range interactions, notable for hosting quasiparticles with fractional statistics and serving as a discrete analogue of a conformal field theory. Its remarkable simplicity is closely tied to a full Yangian spin symmetry. While the highest-weight states for this symmetry are known explicitly, a systematic treatment of the descendant states, needed for the computation of various physical quantities, has remained incomplete. In this work, we provide a detailed construction of these descendants in terms of the algebraic Bethe ansatz following recent work of Ferrando et al. In the limit of extreme twist, it includes the Gelfand-Tsetlin basis. As an application, we derive product and determinant formulae for norms and overlaps of these states.
articles.abstract_zh: Haldane–Shastry自旋链是具有长程相互作用和Yangian对称性的典型可积模型，其最高权态已知，但后代态的系统构造仍不完整。本文基于代数Bethe Ansatz构造Yangian后代态，并在极端扭转极限下包含Gelfand–Tsetlin基。作为应用，作者推导了这些态的范数与重叠的乘积公式和行列式公式。
authors: Yunfeng Jiang, Jules Lamers, Yuan Miao

articles.title: Truncated Wigner dynamics of biclique quantum spin glasses
articles.title_zh: 双团完全图量子自旋玻璃的截断Wigner动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20187v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum spin glasses are often considered testbeds for studying quantum optimization algorithms and as such have been the subject of various quantum advantage claims. Here we investigate the near adiabatic dynamics of biclique quantum spin glasses within the (discrete) truncated Wigner approximation (TWA). Benchmarks on small systems show that TWA recovers sample-to-sample fluctuations of the Edwards-Anderson order parameter, over a wide range of annealing times, with increasing fidelity when the system size increases. We extract critical exponents from the Binder cumulant in line with theoretical expectations, reproducing recent quantum experiments. The computational cost of the method is minimal and it can easily be applied to tens of thousands of qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文在离散截断Wigner近似框架下研究双团完全图量子自旋玻璃的近绝热动力学，这类体系常被用作量子优化算法与量子优势研究的测试平台。小系统基准测试显示，TWA能在较宽退火时间范围内恢复Edwards–Anderson序参量的样本间涨落，并且随系统尺寸增大保真度提高。作者还从Binder累积量提取出与理论预期一致的临界指数，且该方法计算成本很低，可扩展到数万量子比特。

articles.title: Effects of nonlocal interactions on s- and d-wave superconducting correlations in the extended Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: 非局域相互作用对扩展Hubbard模型中s波和d波超导关联的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the influence of nonlocal interactions on superconducting correlations within the extended Hubbard model. In addition to the on-site Coulomb interaction and nearest-neighbor hopping, we include next-nearest-neighbor hopping together with several physically relevant nonlocal terms, namely nearest-neighbor Coulomb interaction, correlated hopping, exchange interaction, and pair hopping. Using Lanczos exact diagonalization on a 4×4 cluster, supported by projector quantum Monte Carlo simulations for selected parameter regimes, we analyze pairing correlations in both the s- and d-wave channels. We demonstrate that nonlocal interactions exert a highly nontrivial and symmetry-dependent influence on superconducting correlations. While the on-site repulsion in cooperation with next-nearest-neighbor hopping enhances d-wave pairing tendencies, correlated hopping and nearest-neighbor Coulomb interaction strongly promote s-wave correlations, whereas exchange and pair-hopping interactions can efficiently suppress superconductivity beyond relatively small critical strengths. When all nonlocal interactions are considered simultaneously, the resulting phase diagrams reveal a complex interplay and competition between different pairing symmetries. Our results highlight the crucial role of extended interactions in shaping the pairing landscape of strongly correlated systems and demonstrate that a comprehensive treatment beyond the minimal Hubbard model is essential for a realistic description of unconventional superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在扩展Hubbard模型中考察非局域相互作用对超导关联的影响，除在位库仑相互作用和最近邻跃迁外，还纳入次近邻跃迁、最近邻库仑相互作用、关联跃迁、交换相互作用和成对跃迁等项。作者使用4×4团簇的Lanczos精确对角化，并在部分参数区间辅以投影量子蒙特卡罗，分析s波和d波配对关联。结果显示非局域相互作用对超导具有强烈且依赖对称性的影响：在位排斥与次近邻跃迁可增强d波倾向，而关联跃迁和最近邻库仑相互作用促进s波关联，交换与成对跃迁则可能在较小临界强度后抑制超导。

articles.title: Fractional excitations in Kitaev quasi-one-dimensional chain
articles.title_zh: Kitaev准一维链中的分数化激发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20309v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Kitaev honeycomb model has attracted significant interest due to its quantum spin liquid ground state, fractionalized Majorana excitations, and topological properties. Motivated by these features, we introduce a quasi-one-dimensional Kitaev-like spin chain derived from a truncated honeycomb geometry. The resulting Majorana band structure contains both dispersive and flat bands, with a gap closing at a critical anisotropy that separates trivial and chiral topological phases. Under open boundary conditions, the topological regime hosts zero-energy edge modes protected by chiral symmetry, placing the system in the BDI symmetry class with a quantized winding number. In the excited spectrum, localized plaquette modes emerge near zero energy and can be tuned by introducing domains of negative plaquettes. The dynamical spin correlation function reveals broad continua associated with fractionalized excitations, together with characteristic low-energy spectral weight from edge Majorana modes. These features distinguish the present system from conventional Heisenberg spin chains and provide experimentally relevant fingerprints of chiral topological order. Our model thus establishes a conceptual bridge between the two-dimensional Kitaev spin liquid and Kitaev's one-dimensional quantum wire.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从截断蜂窝几何出发，提出一种准一维Kitaev型自旋链，用以研究量子自旋液体相关的Majorana分数化激发与拓扑性质。其Majorana能带同时包含色散带和平带，并在临界各向异性处发生能隙闭合，分隔平庸相与手征拓扑相。开放边界下，拓扑区域出现受手征对称性保护的零能边缘模，体系属于BDI对称类且具有量子化绕数；动力学自旋关联函数则显示分数化激发连续谱及边缘Majorana模的低能谱权重。

articles.title: Thermal reconstruction as a method of substrate preparation for highly crystalline superconducting TiN resonators
articles.title_zh: 用于高结晶性超导TiN谐振器的衬底热重构制备方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20317v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High quality crystalline growth of a thin film on sapphire requires sufficient substrate preparation, often achieved via the use of aggressive chemical cleaning. Direct thermal reconstruction of the sapphire substrate via a CO₂ laser beam may allow for an alternative way to prepare the substrate for epitaxy without the use of any chemical processing. Within this work, we demonstrate that thermal annealing of sapphire into its (sqrt31×sqrt31)R±9deg reconstruction is a valid alternative preparation technique for sapphire substrates. TiN films grown via plasma-assisted molecular beam epitaxy upon these substrates exhibit greater crystallinity than those grown on chemically cleaned sapphire substrates. Superconducting resonators fabricated from these films exhibit similar performance, with many possessing internal quality factors at single photon levels greater than 10⁶ for both substrate preparation methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作探索用CO₂激光束直接热重构蓝宝石衬底，以替代外延薄膜生长前常用的强化学清洗。作者证明，将蓝宝石热退火至其(sqrt31×sqrt31)R±9°重构可作为有效衬底制备方法。基于这些衬底通过等离子体辅助分子束外延生长的TiN薄膜比化学清洗衬底上的薄膜具有更高结晶性，而由其制备的超导谐振器性能相近，许多器件在单光子水平下内品质因子超过10⁶。
authors: Thomas J. Smart, Marc Neis, Janine Lorenz, Marcello P. Guardascione, Roudy Hanna, Michael Schleenvoigt, Yuan Gao, Joscha Domnick, Benjamin Bennemann, Abdur Rehman Jalil, Jin Hee Bae, Harsh Bhardwaj, F. Stefan Tautz, Felix Lüpke, Detlev Grützmacher, Rami Barends, Pavel A. Bushev, Peter Schüffelgen

articles.title: Superconductivity and non-Fermi liquid metals in a charge-1/3 anyon fluid
articles.title_zh: 电荷1/3任意子流体中的超导性与非费米液体金属
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20403v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We revisit the charge-1/3 anyon fluid obtained by doping the ν = 2/3 Jain fractional Chern insulator (FCI). In the standard composite fermion description, the doped anyons fractionalize into three translation-related flavors of secondary composite fermions, whose gauge-mediated interactions drive a robust inter-flavor pairing instability. In our previous work, we analyzed a flavor-asymmetric paired state and obtained a charge-ordered Fermi liquid. Inspired by a recent paper, we consider an alternative flavor-symmetric paired state and show that it is an SC* state: a charge-2e condensate that coexists with residual Z₂ topological order. The weak and strong pairing regimes share the same intrinsic topological order but differ in chiral central charge, giving c₋ = 7/2 and c₋ = 2. We further show how other proposed effective field theories fit within the same composite fermion description, and argue that across the doping driven FCI-to-superconductor transition, localized anyons evolve into Bogoliubov quasiparticles rather than vortices. At low doping, we identify an approximate SU(3)-symmetric regime in which the system instead realizes a non-Fermi liquid Z₃ Orthogonal Metal with three charge-1/3 fermion pockets and no sharp electron quasiparticle. Finally, we comment on the energetics of various possible ground states and discuss implications for experiments in moire materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文重新研究由掺杂ν=2/3 Jain分数量子陈绝缘体得到的电荷1/3任意子流体。在复合费米子描述中，掺杂任意子分数化为三个与平移相关的次级复合费米子味，其规范相互作用驱动强烈的味间配对不稳定性。作者分析一种味对称配对态，指出其为SC*态，即电荷2e凝聚与残余Z₂拓扑序共存；弱配对与强配对区具有相同内禀拓扑序但手征中心荷不同，并讨论了FCI到超导转变中任意子的演化图像。

articles.title: Space-time duality approach to (inhomogeneous) integrable quenches
articles.title_zh: 用于（非均匀）可积淬火的时空对偶方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20445v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Characterising the universal aspects of non-equilibrium quantum many-body dynamics is one of the key goals of this century's physics research. Progress, however, is hindered by the lack of general theoretical frameworks for studying interacting quantum matter far from equilibrium. A recent breakthrough has been the realization that several key non-equilibrium quantities, such as the rate of growth of entanglement or the fluctuations of conserved charges within finite subsystems, can be related to equilibrium properties through a space-time duality that effectively exchanges the roles of space and time. This observation effectively enables the study of non-equilibrium phenomena using tools and concepts borrowed from equilibrium statistical mechanics and thermodynamics. A first proof of principle of this framework, dubbed space-time duality approach (SDA), was provided by interacting integrable systems, where thermodynamic properties can often be characterized exactly, while dynamical quantities typically remain beyond analytical reach. Subsequent developments, however, revealed that the SDA suffered from an intrinsic ambiguity, restricting its applicability to homogeneous quenches and to charge fluctuations arising from symmetric initial states. Here we resolve this ambiguity from first principles and derive closed-form predictions for entanglement growth and charge fluctuations after general quantum quenches. We benchmark our results against the exact analytical solution of the Rule 54 quantum cellular automaton and extensive TEBD simulations of the XXZ chain. Moreover we show that, when specialised to the entanglement entropy, our framework naturally reproduces the predictions of the quasiparticle picture.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作围绕非平衡量子多体动力学的普适性质，讨论一种将空间与时间角色互换的时空对偶方法。该方法把纠缠增长率、有限子系统守恒荷涨落等非平衡量与平衡性质联系起来，从而借助平衡统计力学和热力学工具研究远离平衡的相互作用量子物质。文章以相互作用可积系统及非均匀可积淬火为背景，旨在澄清并扩展该框架；原摘要后半部分不完整，具体技术结论需参阅原文。
authors: Riccardo Travaglino, Pasquale Calabrese, Katja Klobas, Bruno Bertini

articles.title: Correlated Mott semi-metal in the topological heavy fermion model
articles.title_zh: 拓扑重费米子模型中的关联Mott半金属
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20466v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The topological heavy-fermion model provides a minimal framework for describing the coexistence of localized moments and itinerant Dirac electrons in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene (MATBG). Several analytical and numerical methods have been applied to this model; however, whether they provide a realistic description of MATBG remains incompletely understood. In this work, we develop an Hubbard operator approach that incorporates non-local correlations beyond the single-site limit. We benchmark the approximate calculations against numerically exact determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations of a lattice-regularized model. We show that commonly used local approximations, such as Hubbard-I, fail to capture the coupling between localized and itinerant degrees of freedom, leading to incorrect spectral properties in the local-moment regime. In contrast, the Hubbard operator method provides a controlled description of both correlation functions and spectral features over a regime of parameters, in good agreement with exact numerical methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 拓扑重费米子模型为描述魔角扭转双层石墨烯中局域磁矩与巡游Dirac电子共存提供了最小框架。本文发展了包含超越单站点极限的非局域关联的Hubbard算符方法，并用格点正则化模型的行列式量子蒙特卡罗进行基准比较。结果表明，Hubbard-I等常用局域近似无法正确捕捉局域与巡游自由度耦合，导致局域磁矩区谱性质错误；Hubbard算符方法则能在一定参数范围内较好描述关联函数和谱特征。
authors: Emile Pangburn, Igor de Melo Froldi, Anurag Banerjee

articles.title: Controllable Quantum Spin Hall Phases in Bi₂Te₃₋Family van der Waals Heterobilayers
articles.title_zh: Bi₂Te₃家族范德瓦耳斯异质双层中的可控量子自旋霍尔相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20541v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The tunability and control of topological edge/surface states are crucial for the development of new device applications. In this work, by combining first-principles calculations and Wannier-based tight-binding methods, we show the emergence of quantum spin Hall phases in van der Waals heterostructures formed by stacking two trivial quintuple layers from the Bi₂Te₃ family. We demonstrate the tunability of the edge states under interlayer strain and external electric field effects, suggesting the possibility of switching topological edge states on/off by external control. Additionally, the quantum spin Hall edge channels remain robust against interlayer twist, highlighting their stability against external perturbations. Our results provide a new way to create and manipulate two-dimensional topological phases in systems based on Bi₂Te₃ family, which can be valuable for practical applications, such as topological field effect transistors and spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合第一性原理计算和基于Wannier函数的紧束缚方法，发现由Bi₂Te₃家族两个平庸五层单元堆叠形成的范德瓦耳斯异质结构可产生量子自旋霍尔相。作者表明，层间应变和外加电场可调控边缘态，暗示可通过外部手段实现拓扑边缘态的开关。量子自旋霍尔边缘通道还对层间扭转保持稳健，为基于Bi₂Te₃家族材料的拓扑场效应晶体管和自旋电子器件提供了潜在平台。
authors: Emmanuel V. C. Lopes, Pedro H. Sophia, Felipe Crasto de Lima, Adalberto Fazzio

articles.title: Quantum circuit decomposition of the tangent-fermion Dirac operator
articles.title_zh: 正切费米子Dirac算符的量子线路分解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19020v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Dirac operator on a lattice cannot be both local and free of fermion doubling, at least not without breaking fundamental symmetries. Non-local, symmetry-preserving discretizations that avoid doubling have a quantum circuit representation as a linear-combination-of-unitaries (LCU) in which both the number of terms and their norm (the subnormalization factor) grow with the lattice size, compromising the efficiency of a quantum algorithm. We show that the tangent-fermion discretization escapes this obstruction when the Dirac equation is written as a generalized eigenvalue problem with a local operator pencil: Each member of the pencil has an exact LCU, with term count that is independent of lattice size and with subnormalization factor of order unity, on a par with elliptic operators. This provides an efficient block-encoding primitive for Dirac spectra and Green functions without fermion doubling.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究晶格Dirac算符在避免费米子倍增并保持对称性时面临的非局域性问题，以及相应量子算法中线性酉组合表示的效率瓶颈。作者表明，当正切费米子离散化的Dirac方程写成带局域算符铅笔的广义本征值问题时，每个铅笔成员都具有精确LCU表示，其项数与晶格尺寸无关且次归一化因子为一量级。该结果为无费米子倍增地计算Dirac谱和Green函数提供了高效的块编码基元。

articles.title: Nonequilibrium steady states induced by stochastic mid-circuit measurements and resets on a quantum computer
articles.title_zh: 量子计算机上由随机中途测量与重置诱导的非平衡稳态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19027v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Stochastic resetting has emerged as a versatile protocol to drive quantum many-body systems to non-equilibrium steady states by interspersing unitary dynamics with measurements and resets at random times. In spite of this, a quantum hardware validation of such non-equilibrium steady states is still missing. Here, we achieve this goal by first formulating a noisy discrete-time theory where unitary gates alternate with noisy mid-circuit projective measurements and conditional resets. This noisy conditional resetting theory is then demonstrated on a superconducting quantum processor for up to N=7 qubits. We consider, as a paradigmatic case, the unitary dynamics of the interacting Floquet transverse-field Ising model. The stationary state of the noisy conditional resetting agrees quantitatively with the experiments, and it shows crossover behavior related to the equilibrium quantum phase transition of the model. Our results might thus pave the way for the preparation of collective stationary states on noisy quantum devices and for further developments of quantum algorithms involving mid-circuit measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种含噪离散时间理论，将幺正门操作与含噪中途投影测量及条件重置交替结合，用于描述随机重置驱动的量子多体非平衡稳态。作者在最多7个量子比特的超导量子处理器上验证该方案，并以相互作用Floquet横场伊辛模型为范例。实验结果与含噪条件重置理论定量一致，并显示出与模型平衡量子相变相关的交叉行为。
authors: Jakob Murauer, Sabine Tornow, Gabriele Perfetto

articles.title: Vine Codes: Low-Overhead Quantum LDPC Codes on a Planar Square Grid
articles.title_zh: 藤蔓码：平面方格上的低开销量子LDPC码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20263v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The surface code is a promising route towards large-scale quantum computing, requiring only nearest-neighbour gates amenable to superconducting hardware. However, surface codes incur large qubit overheads. Novel quantum low-density parity check (qLDPC) codes promise to reduce overheads but require long-range connections that are difficult to achieve on superconducting platforms. Here, we introduce "Vine Codes" - qLDPC codes that are implementable on a planar square grid through nearest-neighbour, two-qubit gates native to superconducting platforms (iSWAP and CZ). Our approach generalises "Directional Codes" recently introduced by Gehér et. al. (2025) which are constrained to a torus. In contrast, vine codes have open boundary conditions constructed with the aid of routing qubits. We perform extensive numeric searches and find promising candidate vine codes, e.g. [[121,4,6]], [[221,6,7]], and [[234,9,6]] codes. We verify the circuit distances and show that data and measure qubits required can be reduced by up to ~28% relative to the surface code at a circuit distance of 7. Even including routing qubits, vine codes require fewer total qubits than the surface code (e.g. ~18% reduction at circuit distance 10) and benefits are expected to increase at higher distances. We perform circuit-level noise simulations to demonstrate that under a realistic noise model and at a near-term noise rate of 10⁻³, vine codes can perform better than the surface code while using fewer qubits. We give an exhaustive list of all unique vine codes up to stabiliser-weight 9. We additionally introduce "Flip-Vine Codes" which possess single-qubit transversal Clifford gates useful for fault-tolerant logic and magic state cultivation. We furthermore construct examples of generalised open boundaries for vine codes that go beyond the familiar X/Z boundaries of the surface and tile codes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出“藤蔓码”，一种可在平面方格上通过超导平台原生的近邻双量子比特门实现的量子低密度奇偶校验码。该方案推广了先前受环面几何限制的方向码，通过路由量子比特构造开放边界条件。数值搜索给出若干有前景的候选码，并表明在特定电路距离下，相比表面码可减少数据与测量量子比特开销，甚至计入路由量子比特后仍具有潜在优势。
authors: Georgia M. Nixon, Campbell K. McLauchlan, Charles C. L. van Rest

articles.title: Proposal of quantum arrival-time measurement with a Bose-Einstein condensate
articles.title_zh: 利用玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体进行量子到达时间测量的方案
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20278v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This work shows how a Bose-Einstein condensate of ultracold atoms could be used to address a long-standing question in quantum theory: how much time does it take for a particle to reach a detector? To this end, we propose a realistic experimental setup, whose key idea is not to measure arrival times directly, but the arrival flux on the detector as a function of its position. This novel approach not only solves practical issues with having a detector close to the system, but also results in signals that allow to unambiguously distinguish different theoretical predictions. This proposal raises prospects for resolving the decades-old debate on this fundamental issue.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出利用超冷原子的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体研究量子粒子到达探测器所需时间这一长期问题。其核心思路不是直接测量到达时间，而是测量到达通量随探测器位置的变化。该方法既缓解了探测器靠近系统带来的实际困难，也能产生足以区分不同理论预言的信号。
authors: Pascal Naidon, Lucas Happ, Denis Boiron

articles.title: Interaction geometry and ground-state properties of sparse quantum lattice models
articles.title_zh: 稀疏量子晶格模型中的相互作用几何与基态性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20387v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate how interaction geometry shapes the low-energy phases of sparse tunable long-range quantum models. We focus on a class of graphs whose degree grows logarithmically with system size, and show how symmetry and frustration in graph connectivity can drive, suppress, and reshape ground-state phase transitions. The central examples are power-of-p graphs, where even and odd values of p exhibit qualitatively distinct behaviour: even-p graphs inherit the rich phase structure of the power-of-two model, while odd-p graphs are governed by geometric frustration. Fibonacci graphs provide a contrasting case, lacking the discrete self-similarity of the power-of-p family but exhibiting a direct geometric mapping between the short- and long-range limits. Across our models, we find that phase structure and criticality are governed by the same effective-geometry principle, unifying our framework for experimentally motivated long-range quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察相互作用几何如何影响稀疏、可调长程量子模型的低能相。作者聚焦于度数随系统尺寸对数增长的一类图，说明图连通性的对称性和阻挫可驱动、抑制或重塑基态相变。幂为p的图与斐波那契图展示了不同几何机制，整体结果表明相结构和临界性可由统一的有效几何原则支配。
authors: Alex Gunning, Sebastian Schmid, Zhengxiao Liu, Sridevi Kuriyattil, Aydin Deger, Andrew J. Daley

articles.title: Topological Codes Based on Space Groups
articles.title_zh: 基于空间群的拓扑码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20548v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Topological codes form one of the most important classes of stabilizer codes. Most existing algebraic constructions and analyses of topological codes assume translation invariance. Here we show that topological codes can arise in more general settings by incorporating point group operations. The central construction is a class of Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) codes called space-group codes, whose check operators are built from group-algebra templates over space groups that combine translations with point-group operations. We develop methods for analyzing topological properties of space-group codes using ring-modules and their invariant theory. At first glance, space-group codes might appear to complicate practical implementation; however, we find that they can exhibit greater locality than previous codes based purely on translations. Our framework thus extends the landscape of topological codes and opens up a broader design space for the co-design of topological codes with quantum computing platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一类称为空间群码的Calderbank-Shor-Steane拓扑稳定子码，其校验算符由结合平移与点群操作的空间群群代数模板构造。作者发展了利用环模及其不变量理论分析这些码拓扑性质的方法。尽管引入点群操作看似会增加实现复杂度，但结果显示空间群码可能比纯平移构造具有更好的局域性，从而拓展了拓扑码与量子硬件协同设计的空间。
authors: Chong-Yuan Xu, Ze-Chuan Liu, Yong Xu

articles.title: Gap reopening as a possible signature of coupling between Majorana zero modes in Sn-(Bi,Sb)2(Te,S)3-based Josephson trijunctions
articles.title_zh: Sn-(Bi,Sb)2(Te,S)3基约瑟夫森三结中马约拉纳零模耦合的可能信号：能隙重新打开
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.06474v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In the past two decades, enormous efforts have been made to search for possible platforms and schemes to implement topological quantum computation (TQC). In exploring the Fu-Kane scheme of TQC based on Josephson trijunctions constructed on topological insulators, the predicted Majorana phase diagram of an individual trijunction has already been verified experimentally. If Majorana zero modes indeed exist in this kind of trijunction, coupling between them in multiple trijunction devices should be further expected. In this study, we fabricated Josephson devices containing two adjacent Josephson trijunctions on the surface of Sn-(Bi, Sb)2(Te, S)3 and observed a possible signature of the coupling effect manifesting as the reopening of a minigap in both trijunctions where a closure would otherwise be expected if the trijunctions existed individually. While alternative interpretations cannot be fully ruled out, our findings provide experimental support for the validity of the Fu-Kane theory and provide further motivation for advancing the TQC scheme proposed by Fu and Kane.
articles.abstract_zh: 该实验研究面向Fu-Kane拓扑量子计算方案，在Sn-(Bi,Sb)2(Te,S)3表面制备含有两个相邻约瑟夫森三结的器件。作者观察到一种可能的马约拉纳零模耦合信号：在单个三结预期能隙闭合的位置，两个三结中均出现小能隙重新打开。尽管不能完全排除其他解释，该结果为Fu-Kane理论的有效性及相关拓扑量子计算路线提供了进一步实验支持。
authors: Duolin Wang, Xiang Zhang, Yunxiao Zhang, Heng Zhang, Fucong Fei, Xiang Wang, Bing Li, Xiaozhou Yang, Yukun Shi, Zhongmou Jia, Enna Zhuo, Yuyang Huang, Anqi Wang, Zenan Shi, Zhaozheng Lyu, Xiaohui Song, Peiling Li, Bingbing Tong, Ziwei Dou, Jie Shen, Guangtong Liu, Fanming Qu, Fengqi Song, Li Lu

articles.title: Propagating Collective Spin-valley Modes in Twisted WSe2
articles.title_zh: 扭转WSe2中的传播型集体自旋-谷模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.18770v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The emergence of neutral collective modes is a hallmark of correlated quantum phases but is often challenging to probe experimentally. In two-dimensional flatband systems, charge responses have been intensively investigated yet neutral excitations remain largely unexplored. In particular, intervalley coherent state (IVC) features a neutral Goldstone mode due to spontaneously broken valley U(1) symmetry. While IVC state has been proposed as a unifying theme across graphene and semiconductor based systems, its defining feature, the neutral Goldstone mode, remains elusive in experiment. Here we investigate space and time resolved transport of neutral modes in twisted WSe2 moire superlattices through a novel ultrafast imaging technique. We uncover two new propagating collective modes with very different velocities, which emerge near the van Hove singularity (VHS) in both intermediate (3.5 to 4 degree) and large (around 5 degree) angle twisted WSe2. The fast-propagating mode has a large speed of about 3 km/s and is consistent with a Goldstone mode for an IVC state, while the slow-moving mode is likely a gapped amplitude mode. They can be understood as the spin-valley analogues of collective modes of a superfluid, whose propagation is imaged for the first time in a condensed matter system. Our study demonstrates a powerful new approach for probing charge-neutral modes in quantum materials and offers key insights into the interplay between charge and spin-valley physics in moire superlattices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用超快成像技术研究扭转WSe2莫尔超晶格中中性模式的时空分辨输运。作者在接近范霍夫奇点处发现两种速度差异显著的传播型集体模式，出现在中等和较大扭转角样品中。快速模式速度约为3 km/s，与区间谷相干态的Goldstone模式相符；慢速模式则可能是有能隙的振幅模式。
authors: Richen Xiong, Yi Guo, Chenxin Qin, Taige Wang, Fanzhao Yin, Samuel L. Brantly, Youngjoon Choi, Junhang Qi, Jinfei Zhou, Zihan Zhang, Melike Erdi, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Shu Zhang, Seth Ariel Tongay, Andrea F. Young, Liang Fu, Chenhao Jin

articles.title: Non-Abelian topological superconductivity from melting Abelian fractional Chern insulators
articles.title_zh: 由阿贝尔分数量子陈绝缘体熔化产生的非阿贝尔拓扑超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.17996v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Fractional Chern insulators (FCI) are exotic phases of matter realized at partial filling of a Chern band that host fractionally charged anyon excitations. Recent numerical studies in several microscopic models reveal that increasing the bandwidth in an FCI can drive a direct transition into a charge-2e superconductor rather than a conventional Fermi liquid. Motivated by this surprising observation, we propose a theoretical framework that captures the intertwinement between superconductivity and fractionalization in a lattice setting. Leveraging the duality between three field-theoretic descriptions of the Jain topological order, we find that bandwidth tuning can drive a single parent FCI at ν = 2/3 into five different superconductors, some of which are intrinsically non-Abelian and support Majorana zero modes. Our results reveal a rich landscape of exotic superconductors with no normal state Fermi surface and predict novel higher-charge superconductors coexisting with neutral non-Abelian topological order at more general filling fractions ν = p/(2p+1).
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究受到数值发现的启发：增大分数量子陈绝缘体中的带宽可能直接诱导电荷2e超导体，而非传统费米液体。作者提出一个理论框架描述晶格中超导性与分数化之间的交织，并利用Jain拓扑序的多种场论描述之间的对偶性。结果表明，在ν=2/3处带宽调控可使同一母体分数量子陈绝缘体进入五种不同超导相，其中部分为内禀非阿贝尔相并支持马约拉纳零模。

articles.title: Ab initio Phase Diagram of Ta2O5
articles.title_zh: Ta2O5的从头算相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.03649v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Tantalum pentoxide (Ta2O5) is a polymorphic wide-bandgap semiconductor with outstanding dielectric properties and widespread use in optical and electronic technologies. Its rich structural diversity, arising from multiple polymorphs accessible under different synthesis conditions, has made Ta2O5 a long-standing subject of interest. However, a unified understanding of the thermodynamic stability and phase transitions of its polymorphs across pressure-temperature (P-T) space has remained elusive. Here, using first-principles calculations, we map the thermodynamic landscape of Ta2O5 and establish a comprehensive P-T phase diagram together with a phase-stability hierarchy. We find that Gamma-Ta2O5 and B-Ta2O5 dominate the phase diagram over a broad range of P-T conditions: Gamma-Ta2O5 is stabilized at low pressures, while B-Ta2O5 becomes thermodynamically favored at higher pressures up to ~ 60 GPa, beyond which Y-Ta2O5 emerges as the most stable phase. Crucially, the zero-point energy (ZPE), one aspect of nuclear quantum effects (NQEs), plays a significant role in determining relative phase stability, contributing substantially to the Gibbs free energy and altering phase boundaries. A re-entrant phase transition between Gamma and B-Ta2O5 is predicted near ~ 2 GPa, revealing unexpected complexity in the phase behavior of this oxide. More generally, we identify a characteristic temperature (T₀₎, at which zero-point and thermal phonon contributions to the free energy become comparable, and show that T₀ is approximately one-third of the Debye temperature. This relationship provides a simple, physically transparent criterion for assessing the importance of NQEs in phase stability, with implications extending beyond Ta2O5 to a broad class of complex oxides.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用第一性原理计算系统绘制五氧化二钽在压力-温度空间中的热力学相图，并建立多晶型相稳定性层级。结果显示，Gamma-Ta2O5和B-Ta2O5在广泛条件下占主导：前者在低压稳定，后者在较高压力下更有利，而约60 GPa以上Y-Ta2O5成为最稳定相。研究还强调零点能等核量子效应对相对相稳定性具有重要影响。
authors: Yan Gong, Huimin Tang, Yong Yang, Yoshiyuki Kawazoe

articles.title: Isotope effect in the work function of lithium
articles.title_zh: 锂功函数中的同位素效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.15437v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The work functions of 7Li and 6Li metals have been measured as a function of temperature, by using photoionization of pure isolated metal nanoparticles in a beam. These data reveal a marked isotope effect in the temperature variation of these work functions. Furthermore, for both isotopes the curvature of this temperature variation is found to be significantly larger than may be ascribed purely to a change in the electron gas density. These findings enhance the characterization of lithium as a quantum material in which the interplay between electronic and ionic degrees of freedom is nontrivial, and call for a microscopic understanding beyond simple models. Additionally, the slope of the work function curves was observed to vanish in the low temperature limit, as had been predicted on the basis of the Third Law of thermodynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过束流中纯孤立金属纳米粒子的光电离，测量了7Li和6Li金属功函数随温度的变化。数据表明，两种同位素的功函数温度依赖存在显著同位素效应，且曲率大于仅由电子气密度变化所能解释的程度。结果凸显锂作为量子材料中电子与离子自由度非平凡耦合的重要性，并观察到低温极限下功函数曲线斜率趋零，符合热力学第三定律的预言。
authors: Atef A. Sheekhoon, Abdelrahman O. Haridy, Vitaly V. Kresin

articles.title: Spatially Indirect Exciton Condensation in Two-Dimensional Strongly Correlated Semimetals
articles.title_zh: 二维强关联半金属中的空间间接激子凝聚
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.18445v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Identifying materials hosting an excitonic insulator ground state has been one of the major pursuits in condensed matter physics in recent years. Promising candidates in transition metal chalcogenide compounds (TMC), including 1T-TiSe₂, Ta₂Pd₃Te₅, and Ta₂NiSe₅, share a crucial common characteristic: their low-energy physics is governed by electrons in d- orbitals subject to strong on-site Coulomb interactions. In this work, we investigate spatially indirect exciton condensation in two-dimensional semimetals on triangular lattice. Using a combination of dynamical mean-field theory and the determinant quantum Monte Carlo method, we study two- and three-orbital Hubbard models incorporating strong on-site (U) and inter-orbital interactions (V). Our results demonstrate that on-site Hubbard U can strongly suppress the condensation temperature T_c, an effect that is particularly pronounced at higher electron-hole pair densities. This behavior contrasts sharply with the case without on-site U, where T_c grows with pair density at fixed V. Moreover, we uncover competition among multiple electron-hole pairing channels in the three-orbital model, which also acts to suppress T_c of exciton condensation. An orbital-selective electron-hole pairing state is identified. These findings may help explain the large discrepancy between strong binding-energy and relative low transition temperature for indirect excitons in TMCs materials, offering important insights for understanding and engineering exciton condensation in materials with strongly correlated d- shell electrons.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨三角晶格二维半金属中的空间间接激子凝聚，关注强在位库仑相互作用对激子绝缘体基态的影响。作者结合动力学平均场理论与行列式量子蒙特卡洛方法，研究含在位相互作用 U 与轨道间相互作用 V 的两轨道和三轨道 Hubbard 模型。结果表明，在位 Hubbard U 会显著压低凝聚温度，且在较高电子—空穴对密度下尤为明显；这与无在位 U 时凝聚温度随对密度增加而升高的情形形成对比。研究还揭示了三轨道模型中多个电子—空穴配对通道之间的竞争。
authors: Yao Zeng, Shi-Cong Mo, Xiang Chen, Wéi Wú

articles.title: Measuring Rényi entropy with an Echo Protocol
articles.title_zh: 利用回波协议测量 Rényi 熵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.05237v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present efficient and practical protocols to measure the second Rényi entropy, whose exponential is known as the purity. Our approach is based on expressing the purity in terms of transition probabilities generated by an echo-type forward-backward evolution sequence, making it applicable to quantum many-body systems. Notably, our approach does not rely on random-noise averaging, a feature that can be extended to protocols to measure out-of-time-order correlation functions, as we demonstrate. By way of example, we show that our protocols can be practically implemented in superconducting qubit-based platforms, as well as in cavity-QED trapped ultra-cold gases.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了高效且实用的第二 Rényi 熵测量协议，其指数形式对应于量子态纯度。该方法将纯度表示为由回波式正向—反向演化序列产生的跃迁概率，因此适用于量子多体系统。与许多方案不同，该方法不依赖随机噪声平均，并可推广到乱序时间序关联函数的测量。作者以超导量子比特平台和腔 QED 囚禁超冷气体为例，说明了该协议的可实现性。
authors: Yi-Neng Zhou, Robin Löwenberg, Julian Sonner

articles.title: Visible Imaging of Incoherent 1200-nm Light via Triplet--Triplet Annihilation Upconversion
articles.title_zh: 通过三重态—三重态湮灭上转换实现非相干 1200 nm 光的可见成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.15184v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Upconversion of low-energy photons to higher-energy photons provides an opportunity to surpass traditional limitations in fields such as 3D printing, photovoltaics, and photocatalysis. Triplet--triplet annihilation upconversion (TTA-UC) is particularly appealing for such applications as it can efficiently upconvert low-intensity, incoherent light. However, previously demonstrated thin-film TTA systems are simultaneously constrained by modest efficiencies and limited reach into the near infrared (NIR). Here, we design a single-layer thin-film bulk heterojunction that integrates PbS quantum dots (QDs) as tunable NIR absorbers within an organic semiconductor matrix of TES-ADT, achieving large anti-Stokes shifts up to 500 nm and high internal quantum efficiencies across the NIR-I and NIR-II windows (800-1200 nm). Through the incorporation of 5-tetracene carboxylic acid ligands on the PbS QD surface, the yield of sensitized triplets was boosted, as confirmed by transient absorption and time-resolved photoluminescence measurements. The resulting films demonstrated a 15-fold improvement in UC efficiency. Furthermore, we demonstrate visible imaging of incoherent 1200 nm light via thin-film TTA-UC at incident intensities at the imaging mask as low as 20 mWcm², marking a significant advance toward practical implementation of solid-state NIR-to-visible upconversion.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用三重态—三重态湮灭上转换，将低能近红外光转换为高能可见光，面向三维打印、光伏和光催化等应用。作者设计了单层薄膜体异质结，将 PbS 量子点作为可调近红外吸收体嵌入 TES-ADT 有机半导体基体，在 800–1200 nm 的 NIR-I 与 NIR-II 波段实现了最高约 500 nm 的大反斯托克斯位移和较高内部量子效率。通过在 PbS 量子点表面引入 5-并四苯羧酸配体，敏化三重态产率得到提升，并由瞬态吸收和时间分辨光致发光验证。所得薄膜的上转换效率提高约 15 倍，并展示了对 1200 nm 非相干光的可见成像能力。
authors: Pournima Narayanan (Department of Electrical Engineering, Stanford University, Stanford, CA 94305, USA, Department of Chemistry, Stanford University, Stanford, CA 94305, USA), Rabeeya Hamid (Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, University of Wisconsin--Madison, Madison, WI 53706, USA), Linda Pucurimay (Department of Electrical Engineering, Stanford University, Stanford, CA 94305, USA, Department of Material Science Engineering, Stanford University, Stanford, CA 94305, USA), Ona Segura Lecina (Department of Electrical Engineering, Stanford University, Stanford, CA 94305, USA), Ben P. articles.title: Record nonlinear conversion efficiency in the production of high spectral purity vacuum ultraviolet laser at 148 nm
articles.title_zh: 148 nm 高光谱纯度真空紫外激光产生中的创纪录非线性转换效率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19484v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coherent vacuum-ultraviolet (VUV) lasers are indispensable for precision measurement, quantum optics, and materials science. Recent high-resolution spectroscopy of the Th-229 nuclear clock transition near 148 nm highlights the urgent demand for intense, narrow-linewidth VUV lasers for advancing metrology and testing fundamental physics. However, existing VUV generation schemes typically require enhancement cavities [C. Zhang et al., Opt. Lett. 47, 5591-5594 (2022)], atomic resonances [Q. Xiao et al., Nature 650, 852-856 (2026)], or random quasi-phase-matched nonlinear crystals [V. Lal et al., Optica 12, 1971-1974 (2025)]. Here, we demonstrate a VUV frequency comb via cascaded frequency doubling of a 2400 nm Cr:ZnS comb to its 16th harmonic in nonlinear crystals. The final stage employs a bulk-grown, spatially uniform quasi-phase matched (QPM) crystal developed by IPG, combining VUV transparency, high ḩi² nonlinearity, and power scalability. Using this QPM crystal we generate a VUV frequency comb with 40 μW average power (1 nW per mode at 80 MHz mode spacing) with a conversion efficiency order of magnitude higher than other known methods. These results establish a scalable route to compact VUV sources via direct frequency doubling, opening a path toward a robust continuous-wave nuclear clock laser.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了一种用于产生 148 nm 附近高光谱纯度真空紫外激光的高效非线性频率转换方案，服务于精密测量、量子光学和材料科学等需求，尤其与 Th-229 核钟跃迁光谱相关。作者通过将 2400 nm Cr:ZnS 频率梳在非线性晶体中级联倍频至第 16 次谐波，产生真空紫外频率梳。最终级采用体生长、空间均匀的准相位匹配晶体，兼具真空紫外透明性、较强二阶非线性和功率可扩展性。实验获得平均功率 40 μW、80 MHz 模间隔下每模约 1 nW 的真空紫外频率梳，转换效率较已知方法提高约一个数量级。
authors: Sergey Vasilyev, Tian Ooi, Igor Moskalev, Mike Mirov, Andrey Muraviev, Dmitrii Konnov, Victor Churikov, Viktor Sukharev, Evgeny Galenin1, Jack F. Doyle, Chuankun Zhang, Kai Li, Georgiy Seryogin, Dan Perlov, Igor Samartsev, Konstantin Vodopyanov, Jun Ye

articles.title: μ-MOPA Architecture for Photonic Integrated Solid State Laser
articles.title_zh: 用于光子集成固体激光器的 μ-MOPA 架构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19768v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diode-pumped solid-state (DPSS) lasers play a central role in modern photonics owing to their exceptional efficiency and ability to extend spectral coverage beyond the reach of semiconductor diodes. These attributes have enabled breakthroughs in precision metrology, quantum optics, and coherent communications. However, bringing the proven advantages of DPSS gain media such as Nd:YAG onto an integrated photonic platform has remained difficult, largely due to inefficient pump utilization and limited power-scaling in chip-scale implementations. Here, we demonstrate the first photonic-integrated Nd:YAG laser-amplifier system that overcomes these challenges with a micro-chip based master-oscillator-power-amplifier (μ-MOPA) architecture. The seed laser, employing a double-resonant microring resonator, could reach a threshold as low as 2.9 μ W. The single-pass waveguide amplifier, when optimized separately, provides up to 46.6 dB small-signal gain. Combining the low-threshold seed with cascaded waveguide amplifiers, the integrated μ-MOPA delivers more than 12 dBm of amplified continuous-wave output power. These results establish Nd:YAG waveguide integration as a practical route to compact and high-performance solid-state light sources.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了首个光子集成 Nd:YAG 激光—放大器系统，采用基于微芯片的主振荡功率放大器（μ-MOPA）架构，以解决芯片级固体增益介质中泵浦利用率低和功率扩展受限的问题。种子激光器使用双谐振微环谐振器，阈值低至 2.9 μW。单程波导放大器在单独优化时可提供最高 46.6 dB 的小信号增益。将低阈值种子源与级联波导放大器结合后，集成 μ-MOPA 实现了超过 12 dBm 的连续波放大输出功率。
authors: Yu Guo, Yubo Wang, Haoqi Zhao, Fengyan Yang, Guangcanlan Yang, Hao Xie, Hong X. Tang

articles.title: Efficient classical representation and quantum state preparation of complete active space wavefunctions
articles.title_zh: 完全活性空间波函数的高效经典表示与量子态制备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19457v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum computers promise to solve the electronic structure problem for a large class of molecules. However, the performance of relevant quantum algorithms hinges on preparing initial states with substantial overlap with the target eigenvector. For classically challenging molecules with strong electron correlation, starting from multi-reference states, such as complete active space (CAS) wavefunctions is necessary. Unfortunately, the most advanced state preparation protocols applied to such states result in a gate complexity that scales exponentially with the active space size d. In fact, even encoding a CAS state classically is traditionally believed to be intractable for chemically relevant systems. Here, we draw insights from the recently introduced Quantum Paldus Transform (QPT) to show that there exists an efficient classical representation of CAS states and to design a new state preparation routine outperforming previous ones. The QPT represents a transformation from the Fock basis to a friendlier symmetry-adapted basis. Our main contribution consists in showing that CAS states expanded in this basis can efficiently be represented as a matrix product state (MPS) with a bond dimension scaling as O(d²⁾. One can then efficiently load the MPS on a quantum computer and use the inverse QPT to transform the state to the Fock basis. Moreover, our method can easily be extended to the efficient preparation of CAS states in first quantisation with similar complexity. Crucially, we demonstrate that the complexity of both state preparation protocols only grows polynomially as O(d³⁾ , which constitutes to the best of our knowledge an exponential improvement over the state of the art.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作关注量子计算求解电子结构问题时的初态制备，尤其是强电子关联分子所需的完全活性空间（CAS）多参考波函数。传统观点认为，CAS 态的经典编码以及现有量子态制备协议通常随活性空间大小呈指数复杂度。作者借鉴量子 Paldus 变换，将 Fock 基变换为更便于处理的对称适应基，并指出 CAS 态在该基下存在高效经典表示。基于此，论文设计了新的量子态制备例程，旨在优于此前用于 CAS 态的制备方法。

articles.title: Electrical Noise Produced by Micron-Sized Particles above a Surface Paul Trap
articles.title_zh: 表面 Paul 阱上方微米级颗粒产生的电噪声
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19585v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Electric field noise produced by the surface of ion trap electrodes reduces the fidelity of quantum computing operations. Despite decades of investigation its microscopic origins remain unclear. Here, we measure electric field noise at trapping locations along the symmetry axis of a linear surface Paul trap. We find that noise levels vary by three orders-of-magnitude in one 600,μm section of the trap. Optical and scanning electron microscope images show micron-sized particles close to the trapping locations with the highest noise levels. We find that modeling the particles as a lossy dielectric with a effective loss tangent tanθ=0.33(0.06) describes the magnitude of the noise, as well as its spatial and frequency dependence. Our observations may explain the large variation of reported noise levels in literature.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究离子阱电极表面产生的电场噪声，这类噪声会降低量子计算操作保真度，但其微观来源长期不明。作者沿线性表面 Paul 阱对称轴测量俘获位置处的电场噪声，发现同一 600 μm 区段内噪声水平可相差三个数量级。光学显微镜和扫描电子显微镜图像显示，噪声最高的俘获位置附近存在微米级颗粒。将这些颗粒建模为具有有效损耗角正切 tanθ=0.33(0.06) 的有损介质，可解释噪声的幅值及其空间和频率依赖性，并可能说明文献中噪声水平差异巨大的原因。
authors: Ben Saarel, Ozgur Sahin, Hartmut Häffner, Alpha T. N'Diaye

articles.title: Optimized Quantum States for Sensing in the Presence of Loss and Phase Noise
articles.title_zh: 存在损耗与相位噪声时用于传感的优化量子态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19649v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Squeezed vacuum lets gravitational-wave detectors and other quantum sensors surpass the standard quantum limit, and is optimal in the loss-limited regime; phase noise breaks this optimality. Numerically optimizing the quantum Fisher information across the loss and phase-noise landscape, we identify non-Gaussian states that outperform any Gaussian state. These fall into three classes: Fock-like, cubic-phase-like, and states with discrete rotational symmetry. Limiting the average number of photons in the input state to barn=5, with 1-η = 5% photon loss and 200 mrad phase noise, the non-Gaussian advantage reaches up to 2.2 dB. Furthermore, we observe that the non-Gaussian advantage can persist even when the measurement strategy is homodyne detection.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对引力波探测器等量子传感场景，考察在光子损耗和相位噪声共同存在时的最优输入量子态。虽然压缩真空可突破标准量子极限，并在损耗受限情形下最优，但相位噪声会破坏这种最优性。作者通过数值优化量子 Fisher 信息，发现若干优于任意 Gaussian 态的非 Gaussian 态，包括类 Fock 态、类三次相位态以及具有离散旋转对称性的态。在平均光子数限制为 5、5% 光子损耗和 200 mrad 相位噪声下，非 Gaussian 优势最高可达 2.2 dB，并且在同相探测测量策略下仍可能保持。
authors: Shruti Maliakal, Zachary Mann, Christopher Wipf, Rana X Adhikari, Su Direkci, Yanbei Chen

articles.title: Multi-objective design of photon blockade for bright single-photon sources
articles.title_zh: 面向高亮度单光子源的光子阻塞多目标设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20160v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: High-quality single-photon sources, realized through saturable emitters, photon blockade, or heralded pair generation, are indispensable building blocks for photonic quantum platforms. Although these mechanisms suppress multiphoton emission through distinct principles typically captured by analytical models, their practical implementation is constrained by conflicting requirements for purity, brightness, and indistinguishability, which must be balanced within high-dimensional design landscapes. Here, we propose a computational framework for optimizing competing metrics of single-photon sources. Building on a Liouville-space adjoint formulation that efficiently evaluates multiple objectives in Markovian open quantum systems, we develop a Jacobian-based update, which ensures first-order monotonic reduction of multi-objective costs. By incorporating simulated annealing to escape gradient-vanishing plateaus, our framework achieves a design success rate of nearly 60 % for photon blockade with g2(0) smaller than 0.1 and theoretically bounded brightness across a broad parameter space, without any analytical guidance. This framework provides a general recipe for multi-objective design of open quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于优化单光子源竞争指标的计算框架，面向纯度、亮度和不可区分性之间的权衡。该方法基于 Liouville 空间伴随公式，可在 Markov 开放量子系统中高效评估多个目标，并引入基于 Jacobian 的更新以保证多目标代价的一阶单调降低。作者还结合模拟退火来摆脱梯度消失平台。该框架在无解析指导的情况下，在广泛参数空间内实现了近 60% 的光子阻塞设计成功率，可得到 g2(0) 小于 0.1 且亮度受理论界限约束的方案。
authors: Sunkyu Yu, Xianji Piao, Namkyoo Park

articles.title: Tracking Representation Dynamics in Large Language Models with Persistent Homology
articles.title_zh: 用持久同调追踪大型语言模型中的表示动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19542v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are commonly aligned through supervised fine-tuning, yet little is known about how their internal representations evolve during this process. We study alignment dynamics using persistent homology by tracking the topology of activation spaces throughout fine-tuning. Across four transformer language models ranging from 1B to 7B parameters and three alignment objectives corresponding to helpful, harmless, and mixed training data, we find that the majority of topological reorganization occurs during the earliest stages of training. A dense checkpoint analysis reveals a transient peak in topological activity followed by rapid stabilization. We further show that different alignment objectives induce distinguishable topological trajectories, while instruction-tuned and pretrained models exhibit qualitatively different patterns of evolution. Our results suggest that persistent homology provides a complementary perspective on alignment, revealing representation-level changes that are not apparent from behavioral metrics alone.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用持久同调分析监督微调过程中大型语言模型内部表示空间的拓扑演化，以补充传统行为指标对对齐过程的理解。作者考察了四个 1B 至 7B 参数规模的 Transformer 语言模型，以及有帮助性、无害性和混合数据三类对齐目标。结果显示，大部分拓扑重组发生在训练最早阶段，密集检查点分析揭示了拓扑活动的短暂峰值及随后的快速稳定。不同对齐目标会诱导可区分的拓扑轨迹，而指令微调模型与预训练模型表现出定性不同的演化模式。
authors: Naman Malhotra, Jay Ambadkar, Abhinav Gupta, Kushal Kasivel, Abbas Schwarz, Kamillo Ferry, Anthea Monod

articles.title: Human Universal Grasping
articles.title_zh: 人类通用抓取
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.17054v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Humans can grasp objects effortlessly, whereas multi-fingered robots are far from this level of generality. We argue that the most natural source of robot grasping data is from humans, who pick up thousands of objects every day. We present HUG, a flow-matching model that generates diverse human grasps for any user-specified object in a single RGB-D image captured from a stereo camera. Using smart glasses, we first collect 1M-HUGs, an egocentric dataset of human grasps spanning 1M frames (27.8 hrs) and 6,707 object instances across 41 buildings. Next, to model the distribution of natural human grasps, our novel flow-matching model fuses RGB and depth observations to output a grasp parameterized by wrist translation, wrist rotation, and MANO hand pose. Predicted grasps can be retargeted to various robot hands, enabling zero-shot grasping in everyday scenes. To standardize evaluation, we build a new simulated benchmark, HUG-Bench, of 90 unseen objects from five geometric categories and various sizes, with metric-scale 3D meshes. We evaluate HUG in the real world on the 30-object test set of HUG-Bench across multiple stereo cameras, robot embodiments, and household environments. HUG outperforms the state-of-the-art grasping baselines by +23% and +34% on our challenging object set. Code, data, benchmark, checkpoints, and an interactive demo are released on our website: https://grasping.io/
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出 HUG，一个基于流匹配的模型，可根据双目相机拍摄的单张 RGB-D 图像，为用户指定物体生成多样化的人类抓取姿态。作者使用智能眼镜采集了 1M-HUGs 第一视角数据集，包含 100 万帧、27.8 小时数据、6707 个物体实例，覆盖 41 栋建筑。模型融合 RGB 与深度观测，输出由手腕平移、手腕旋转和 MANO 手部姿态参数化的抓取，并可重定向到多种机器人手，实现日常场景中的零样本抓取。作者还构建了 HUG-Bench 模拟基准，包含 90 个未见物体及公制度量三维网格，并在真实环境中使用多个双目相机对 30 个测试物体进行了评估。
authors: Kevin Yuanbo Wu, Tianxing Zhou, Isaac Tu, Billy Yan, Irmak Guzey, David Fouhey, Dandan Shan, Lerrel Pinto

articles.title: GLARE: A Natural Language Interface for Querying Global Explanations
articles.title_zh: GLARE：用于查询全局解释的自然语言接口
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19735v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While global explanations are crucial for understanding vision models across datasets, classes, and decision contexts, their complex and monolithic nature often hinders practical exploration. Because users typically seek targeted answers to specific questions rather than static artifacts, we present an LLM-based interactive interface that provides natural language access to global explanations for black-box image classifiers. The system's core LLM acts as a mediator, translating natural language questions into structured SQL queries over local explanation data. This enables flexible aggregation without exposing users to low-level representations. For each query, the interface outputs statistics-augmented natural language responses, supporting local explanations, and intent-aligned visualizations. We evaluate the system on intent interpretation, query mapping accuracy, generalization to novel queries and datasets, and robustness to linguistic errors. Our results demonstrate that LLM-mediated querying substantially improves the accessibility and usability of global explanations for human-centered XAI.
articles.abstract_zh: 全局解释有助于理解视觉模型在数据集、类别和决策情境中的行为，但其复杂且整体化的形式往往不便于实际探索。本文提出一种基于大语言模型的交互式接口，使用户能够用自然语言查询黑箱图像分类器的全局解释；核心模型将问题转换为针对局部解释数据的结构化 SQL 查询，并生成带统计信息的自然语言回答和可视化。实验从意图理解、查询映射准确性、对新查询和新数据集的泛化以及语言错误鲁棒性等方面评估，表明该方法提升了面向人的可解释 AI 的可访问性与可用性。

articles.title: Grounded Inference: Principles for Deterministically Encapsulated Generative Models
articles.title_zh: 扎根推理：确定性封装生成式模型的原则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19753v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The incorporation of generative models into traditional computational systems presents both enormous opportunity and tremendous peril. Although many early adopters have realized these perils at great expense, the field still requires foundational frameworks to de-risk incorporation of AI into traditional systems. This manuscript establishes this foundation through the definition of four specific primitives of AI blended architecture, designed to enable deterministic encapsulation of probabilistic models. It further establishes two overarching anti-patterns broadly represented across industry to serve as warnings for engineers in this field. This framework was designed to enable successful integration of AI into traditional systems while providing a foundation upon which generative model providers could build the next generation of generative model interfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 将生成式模型嵌入传统计算系统既带来巨大机遇，也带来可靠性和安全风险。本文提出用于 AI 融合架构的四个基础原语，旨在对概率生成模型进行确定性封装，从而降低其在传统系统中的集成风险。文章还总结了两个在工业实践中常见的反模式，为工程人员提供警示，并为生成式模型接口的下一代设计提供框架基础。

articles.title: How LLMs Fail and Generalize in RTL Coding for Hardware Design?
articles.title_zh: 大语言模型在硬件设计 RTL 编码中如何失败与泛化？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19347v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Translating sequential programming priors into the parallel temporal logic of hardware design remains a crucial bottleneck for large language models(LLM). To investigate this, we introduce a new error taxonomy grounded in problem solvability, inspired by cognitive theory. Our taxonomy categorizes failures into syntactic, semantic, solvable functional, and unsolvable functional types. Evaluations reveal a strict empirical ceiling on the VerilogEval benchmark, as frontier models plateau at a 90.8% initial pass rate. These plateaus are defined by unsolvable functional errors, exposing persistent knowledge gaps immune to test time compute scaling. Furthermore, we expose a striking surface convergence gap: optimization readily eliminates syntax errors but concurrently exacerbates deeper functional failures. Our findings demonstrate that alignment techniques merely teach models to compile. While repeated sampling strategies can patch solvable errors, register-transfer level(RTL) coding capacity remains strictly bounded by pretraining knowledge. Addressing challenges in the current LLM based hardware generation pipeline requires more studies in model reasoning rather than alignment interventions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究大语言模型将顺序编程先验迁移到硬件设计中并行时序逻辑时的能力瓶颈。作者提出基于问题可解性的错误分类法，将失败划分为语法、语义、可解功能和不可解功能等类型，并在 VerilogEval 基准上观察到前沿模型初次通过率的经验上限。结果显示，优化可减少语法错误，却可能加深功能性错误；重复采样可修补部分可解问题，但 RTL 编码能力仍受预训练知识限制。
authors: Guan-Ting Liu, Chao-Han Huck Yang, Chenhui Deng, Zhongzhi Yu, Brucek Khailany, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang

articles.title: DynAMO:Dynamic Asset Management Orchestration via Topological Multi-Agent Scheduling
articles.title_zh: DynAMO：通过拓扑多智能体调度实现动态资产管理编排
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19382v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: While LLM-powered agents offer end-to-end automation for industrial asset lifecycles, real-world Industry 4.0 deployment is hindered by latency, concurrency instability, and safety risks. We present DynAMO (Dynamic Asset Management Orchestration), a deployment-ready engine using a Plan-then-Execute architecture to generate verifiable workflow graphs. DynAMO supports both SequentialWorkflow (topological execution) and ParallelWorkflow (dependency-aware concurrency). By dynamically identifying independent tasks, DynAMO preserves structural correctness and safety while significantly improving efficiency through controlled reasoning overlap. Across six controlled experiments on the AssetOpsBench industrial benchmark, DynAMO demonstrates substantial performance and robustness gains. Parallel execution reduces end-to-end latency by a median of 1.6x over sequential orchestration, rising to 1.8x on highly parallelizable workflows. After instrumenting external tool calls with realistic latencies, a latency decomposition shows that LLM reasoning and orchestration still account for more than 90% of execution time, identifying model inference as the primary system bottleneck. Structured context pruning reduces inference latency by approximately 30%, and DynAMO maintains correct functional behaviour (task completion, agent sequencing, and output quality) while exhibiting graceful degradation under controlled fault injection. Reproducibility analysis further confirms stable execution under repeated runs, with parallel scheduling reducing latency variance. These findings establish DynAMO as a practical blueprint for scalable, safe, and latency-aware agent deployment in Industry 4.0 automation pipelines. Code is available at: https://github.com/kushwaha001/DynAMO
articles.abstract_zh: 面向工业 4.0 的资产生命周期自动化中，LLM 智能体仍面临延迟、并发不稳定和安全风险。本文提出 DynAMO，一种采用“先规划后执行”架构的部署级引擎，可生成可验证的工作流图，并支持拓扑顺序执行与依赖感知的并行执行。基于 AssetOpsBench 的实验表明，并行编排在保持结构正确性和安全性的同时降低端到端延迟；延迟分解还显示模型推理和编排仍是主要耗时来源。

articles.title: Spatial Distribution and Controlling Factors of Vanadium and Chromium in a Vanadium- Titanium Magnetite Tailings Reservoir and Surrounding Soils in the Panxi Region
articles.title_zh: 攀西地区钒钛磁铁矿尾矿库及周边土壤中钒和铬的空间分布与控制因素
articles.abstract: Vanadium (V) and chromium (Cr) in soils surrounding vanadium-titanium magnetite tailings reservoirs represent important environmental risks, especially after reservoir closure and soil covering. This study investigated a closed, soil-covered tailings reservoir in the Panxi region using surface soils and S-series vertical profiles. ArcGIS interpolation, BCR sequential extraction, Visual MINTEQ scenario simulation and Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM)-SHAP modeling were combined to characterize spatial distribution, chemical fractionation, potential aqueous speciation and controlling factors. V and Cr concentrations ranged from 25.87 to 621.05 and from 13.03 to 385.07 mg kg− 1, with maxima 4.53 and 4.62 times regional background values, respectively. V enrichment was relatively widespread, whereas Cr enrichment was more localized. Hotspots occurred mainly near the dam toe and in sedimentary zones, indicating coupled effects of tailings input, runoff transport and local deposition. Vertical profiles showed profile-specific enrichment without consistent depth trends. Sequential extraction indicated that V and Cr were mainly residual, suggesting limited short-term mobility, although non-residual fractions still indicated potential release risks. Under an oxidized Visual MINTEQ scenario, V(V) was predicted mainly as H2VO4−, whereas Cr(VI) was mainly CaCrO4(aq). Correlation and LightGBM-SHAP analyses identified amorphous Fe/Al, exchangeable Ca/Mg, pH, CEC, SOM, texture and dam-toe proximity as major controls. Overall, V and Cr contamination around the closed and soil-covered tailings reservoir was controlled by coupled processes of tailings input, runoff transport, mineral fixation and soil physicochemical regulation. Future risk assessments should focus on dam-toe sedimentary zones and integrate total concentrations, chemical fractions, landform conditions and machine-learning results.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以攀西地区一座已闭库并覆土的钒钛磁铁矿尾矿库为对象，分析周边表层土壤及垂向剖面中钒和铬的污染特征。作者结合 GIS 插值、BCR 连续提取、Visual MINTEQ 情景模拟和 LightGBM-SHAP 建模，评估其空间分布、化学形态、水相物种及控制因素。结果显示钒富集较广泛、铬富集更局部，热点主要位于坝脚和沉积区；两者以残渣态为主，短期迁移性相对有限。

articles.abstract: A newly developed method allows researchers to dynamically switch chirality—a particular lack of mirror symmetry—to generate spin currents in semiconductors, researchers from Science Tokyo report. Their approach relies on the reversible insertion and removal of small chiral molecules from the interlayer gaps of a layered, nonchiral semiconductor material using electrochemistry.
articles.abstract_zh: Science Tokyo研究人员报道了一种可动态切换半导体手性的方法，用于在无需磁体的情况下产生自旋电流。该方法通过电化学手段，在层状非手性半导体的层间间隙中可逆地插入和移除小型手性分子，从而实现手性调控。

articles.title: AI-Guided Design of Oral Insulin Analogs Using GNN and ADME Modeling
articles.title_zh: 基于图神经网络与ADME建模的口服胰岛素类似物AI引导设计
articles.abstract: Oral insulin delivery remains a critical unsolved challenge in diabetes therapeutics, primarily due to rapid gastrointestinal (GI) proteolytic degradation and negligible epithelial permeability of native insulin. We present a ten stage automated computational pipeline for rational design of oral insulin B-chain analogs integrating graph neural networks (GNNs), molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) estimation, GI stability modeling, nanoparticle delivery assessment, ADME profiling, and PI3K/AKT pathway safety evaluation. From the wild-type B-chain (UniProt: P01308), 300 unique mutant sequences were generated via guided stochastic mutagenesis and scored using a two-layer graph convolutional network (GCN) with 29 dimensional residue-level node features. The top-ranked candidate, MUT₂₇₁ (L6W;S9A;V12W;G20F), achieved a composite score of 0.762, docking energy of − 8.386 kcal/mol, RMSD of 0.057 nm, and GI score of 0.602. Of 300 candidates, 93.3% satisfied PI3K/AKT safety thresholds. Validation yielded binding-docking Spearman r = 0.696 (p = 2.86 × 10⁻²²) and stability-RMSD r = 0.875. Transcriptomic GSEA identified PI3K/AKT as the dominant enriched pathway (ES = 1.254, p = 10⁻⁸). This work constitutes the first unified pipeline jointly addressing GNN-based sequence-property learning, GI delivery modeling, transcriptomic pathway context, and multi-objective safety aware ranking for insulin B-chain analog design.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对口服胰岛素易被胃肠道蛋白酶降解且上皮通透性极低的问题，提出了一个十阶段自动化计算流程，用于理性设计胰岛素B链类似物。流程整合图神经网络、分子对接、分子动力学估计、胃肠稳定性建模、纳米颗粒递送评估、ADME分析及PI3K/AKT通路安全性评价。研究从野生型B链生成300个突变序列并筛选出候选MUT₂₇₁，显示出较优的综合评分、结合能和稳定性指标，同时多数候选满足PI3K/AKT安全阈值。

articles.title: Preparation of high-performance fluororubber composites via in situ synthesis of bead-like carbon nanotube/nanosilica composite fillers
articles.title_zh: 通过原位合成珠状碳纳米管/纳米二氧化硅复合填料制备高性能氟橡胶复合材料
articles.abstract: This study proposes the in situ deposition of nanoscale silica spheres onto carbon nanotube surfaces to form bead-like binary composite fillers (CNTs@SiO₂). The silica spheres act as anchor points that connect adjacent carbon nanotubes, upgrading the constraint on fluororubber (FKM) molecular chains from point-like to linear and thereby significantly enhancing the mechanical reinforcement of fluororubber. At a loading of 15 phr, the tensile strength, stress at 300% strain, tear strength, hardness, room-temperature storage modulus, and electrical conductivity of the composites increased by 186%, 131.1%, 82.4%, 19.6%, 66.8%, and 880%, respectively. In addition, wear resistance and thermal properties were also significantly improved; the wear index was reduced by 82.9%, and the FKM/15-CNTs@SiO₂ composite exhibited a rapid thermal response during heating and cooling cycles. In conclusion, the bead-like nanofiller-filled FKM demonstrated excellent mechanical reinforcement and heat resistance, expanding its application potential in semiconductor packaging, aerospace, new energy vehicles, and the petrochemical industry.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出在碳纳米管表面原位沉积纳米二氧化硅球，形成珠状二元复合填料CNTs@SiO₂。二氧化硅球作为锚点连接相邻碳纳米管，使其对氟橡胶分子链的约束由点状增强为线状，从而显著提升力学增强效果。在15 phr填充量下，复合材料的拉伸强度、撕裂强度、储能模量、电导率、耐磨性和热响应性能均明显改善，显示出在半导体封装、航空航天、新能源汽车和石化工业中的应用潜力。

articles.title: akaitools: A Python package for parsing and analyzing AkaiKKR electronic structure calculations
articles.title_zh: akaitools：用于解析和分析AkaiKKR电子结构计算的Python软件包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18399v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Korringa-Kohn-Rostoker (KKR) Green's function method is a first-principles electronic structure approach well suited to substitutionally disordered alloys through the Coherent Potential Approximation (CPA). AkaiKKR is a widely used implementation, known for efficient treatment of metallic systems and their magnetic properties. Its output, however, is unstructured plain text with no programmatic interface, leaving data extraction entirely to the user and making systematic or high-throughput studies impractical. akaitools is a Python package that parses AkaiKKR output files into structured, type-annotated Python objects. The package covers three output types: self-consistent field (SCF) results, which capture convergence history and per-atom electronic and magnetic properties; spin-resolved, orbital projected density of states for each CPA component; and Bloch spectral functions on a user-defined k-point path. Results come back as immutable dataclasses backed by NumPy arrays. Energy quantities are available in both Rydbergs and electronvolts, and results can be exported to Pandas DataFrames. A built-in plotting module produces Matplotlib figures for DOS curves and SCF convergence. A command-line interface provides file summaries and JSON export without any Python scripting. The package also includes a programmatic input file generator, so full calculation pipelines from input preparation to output analysis can be run in Python.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文介绍了akaitools，一个用于将AkaiKKR输出文件解析为结构化、带类型标注Python对象的软件包。AkaiKKR基于KKR格林函数方法并适用于结合相干势近似研究替位无序合金，但其纯文本输出缺乏程序化接口，不利于系统化和高通量分析。akaitools支持自洽场结果、自旋分辨轨道投影态密度和Bloch谱函数等输出类型，并提供NumPy数组、Pandas导出及绘图功能，以提升电子结构数据处理效率。

articles.title: Magnetotransport Measurements on Isolated Polycrystalline Grains of Type-II Silicon Clathrate
articles.title_zh: II型硅笼合物孤立多晶晶粒的磁输运测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18449v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The first low-temperature electronic transport characterization of individual polycrystalline grains of type-II silicon clathrate (NaₓSi₁₃₆, x łl 1), isolated using microfabrication techniques, is reported. Structural characterization via Raman spectroscopy confirms that the isolated grains are largely devoid of amorphous silicon (a-Si). Temperature-dependent resistivity reveals multiple conduction regimes, including thermally activated freeze-out behavior and a transition to low-activation-energy transport at cryogenic temperatures, consistent with hopping conduction mechanisms. Hall measurements from 290 K to 3.5 K yield carrier concentration and mobility trends that correlate with the extracted activation energies, verifying n-type conduction. Additionally, gate-dependent conductivity measurements demonstrate electrostatic tunability at room temperature. Collectively, these results establish the magnetotransport parameters of single, isolated grains of type-II silicon clathrate and demonstrate the potential of this material for future quantum and optoelectronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究首次报道了利用微加工技术分离的II型硅笼合物NaₓSi₁₃₆单个多晶晶粒的低温电子输运表征。拉曼光谱表明孤立晶粒中非晶硅含量很低，温度依赖电阻率揭示了热激活冻结和低温低激活能输运等多个导电区间，符合跳跃导电机制。霍尔测量证实其为n型导电并给出载流子浓度和迁移率趋势，栅压调控实验还显示其室温电导具有静电可调性，表明该材料在量子和光电子器件中具有潜力。
authors: Sam Saiter, Joseph P. Briggs, Yinan Liu, Audrey Faricy, Gavin Sher, Carolyn A. Koh, Reuben T. Collins, Meenakshi Singh

articles.title: Persistent current and orbital magnetization along a valley-contrasting junction in bilayer graphene in a magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 磁场中双层石墨烯谷对比结上的持久电流与轨道磁化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18461v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In a magnetic field bilayer graphene hosts an octet of pseudo-zero-mode electron levels nearly degenerate in orbitals n=(0,1), valleys and spins. They split in valleys by electrostatic gating. In gated bilayer graphene, in which the interlayer bias is set up to flip sign across a line, one has a line junction that traps a portion of pseudo-zero-mode electrons inside the insulating bulk band gap, giving rise to electron states localized along the junction, known as kink states. A close look is made into the spectra and electromagnetic response of such kink states. There are two species of valley current associated with them, a drift current driven by the bias gradient and a circulating current coming from cyclotron motion. It turns out that they both flow in essentially the same direction, with the circulating current exhibiting a magnetic character distinct from those of other higher levels. In equilibrium they spatially circulate within the kink states, creating a quasi-one-dimensional channel of orbital magnetization. The electric control of the orbital magnetization and valley currents via a network of gated junctions will find useful applications in valley electronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了磁场下栅控双层石墨烯中谷对比线结的电子谱和电磁响应。当层间偏置在线两侧反号时，体能隙中会俘获赝零能级电子并形成沿结局域的kink态。作者指出这些态包含由偏置梯度驱动的漂移谷电流以及源于回旋运动的环流，两者基本同向流动，并在平衡态下形成准一维轨道磁化通道。该机制有望通过栅控结网络实现对轨道磁化和谷电流的电学调控。

articles.title: Magnetic field induced transition from nodeless to nodal superconductivity in β-PdBi₂
articles.title_zh: β-PdBi₂中磁场诱导的无节点到有节点超导转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18482v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent tunneling measurements on β-PdBi₂ reported a magnetic field induced phase transition from a fully gapped to a nodal superconducting state. We develop a microscopic theory of superconductivity in this multi-band material, taking into account spin-orbit coupling and Zeeman splitting. We show that there are two attractive pairing channels in this system: an s-wave and a p-wave. At zero magnetic field, s-wave superconductivity wins. At a finite field, this channel becomes less favorable because Fermi surfaces split, and the gap symmetry changes to p-wave. We show that at a higher field, the excitation spectrum of a p-wave multi-band superconductor becomes gapless, with nodal points located in between the split Fermi surfaces. We argue that this behavior accounts for the experimentally observed field-induced nodal superconductivity in β-PdBi₂.
