articles.title: Studies of Neutrino-Nucleus Elastic Scattering with Point-Contact Germanium Detectors at the Kuo-Sheng Reactor Neutrino Laboratory
articles.title_zh: 在国圣反应堆中微子实验室利用点接触锗探测器研究中微子—原子核弹性散射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.16864v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The low energy and intense flux of electron anti-neutrinos from nuclear reactors provide the perfect stage to study elastic neutrino-nucleus scattering (ν Aₑₗ) in the fully coherent regime. We report results from the TEXONO experiment using electro-cooled p-type point-contact Germanium detectors with masses of 523~g and 1434~g at the Kuo-Sheng Reactor Neutrino Laboratory. We report improved constraints on the ν Aₑₗ cross section with a combined exposure of 404(813.7)~kg-days of Reactor ON(OFF) data at an electron-equivalent threshold of 200~eVₑₑ. The Lindhard model, in which the quenching factor is parameterized by a single parameter k, is adopted to describe the suppression of ionization yield. At the benchmark value of k=0.162, a limit of h̊o<2.0 at 90% confidence level (CL) is derived, where h̊o represents the ratio of the observed to the predicted Standard Model cross section. Moreover the region k>0.205 is excluded at 90% CL using the SM-predicted ν Aₑₗ rate. A bound on the neutrino magnetic moment from ν Aₑₗ at μν < 5.9 × 10⁻¹⁰~μ_B at 90% CL is also derived.
articles.abstract_zh: TEXONO 合作组利用电制冷 p 型点接触锗探测器研究反应堆电子反中微子的相干中微子—原子核弹性散射。实验在 200 eV 电子等效阈值下结合反应堆开机与停机数据，给出了对散射截面的改进约束。基于 Lindhard 淬灭因子模型，作者报告了标准模型截面比值、淬灭参数以及中微子磁矩的限制结果。

articles.title: DEM-FF: A Universal Machine Learning Force Field for Earth’s Interior Studies
articles.title_zh: DEM-FF：面向地球内部研究的通用机器学习力场
articles.abstract: Universal machine-learning force fields (uMLFFs) have transformed computational materials science by allowing rapid material discovery across broad chemical spaces. Planetary material simulations, however, present challenges beyond the capability of current uMLFF. The extreme pressures, high temperatures, and chemically complex multi-component system of Earth’s deep interior lie far outside their training dataset. Moreover, many fundamental questions in deep-Earth geochemistry rely on accurate free-energy calculations via thermodynamic integration (TI), and no existing uMLFF supports such calculations. Here we introduce DEM-FF (Deep-Earth Materials Force Field), a universal MLFF that overcomes both barriers. DEM-FF covers 25 elements within major geological systems, including fluids, volatiles, silicate melts, minerals, and metallic alloys, and maintains DFT-level accuracy from 0 to 360 GPa and 300 to 10,000 K, with energy RMSE below 10 meV/atom and force RMSE below 0.3 eV/Å. Crucially, configurations sampled along complete TI pathways are incorporated during training, providing DEM-FF the ability to perform reliable free-energy calculations. We validate this by reproducing experimentally measured water solubilities in basaltic melts at 0.1 to 0.5 GPa. We then apply DEM-FF to investigate hydrogen partitioning between pyrolitic silicate melt and liquid iron alloy during core formation using two-phase coexistence simulations with self-consistent redox control. These simulations reveal that compositionally realistic systems yield partition coefficients orders of magnitude lower than those from simplified binary models, and constrain Earth’s core hydrogen content to approximately 560–840 ppm. This value is substantially below previous estimates and implies that hydrogen alone cannot account for the core’s density deficit. DEM-FF provides a unified framework for compositionally realistic simulations of core-mantle differentiation, volatile cycling, and high-pressure material behaviors across Earth’s interior.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 DEM-FF，即面向深部地球材料的通用机器学习力场，旨在覆盖现有通用力场难以处理的高压、高温和复杂多组分地质体系。该力场涵盖主要地质体系中的 25 种元素，包括流体、挥发分、硅酸盐熔体、矿物和金属合金，并在宽广压力与温度范围内保持接近密度泛函理论的精度。作者还将热力学积分路径上的构型纳入训练，使其能够支持可靠的自由能计算。

articles.title: Cascade Oxidation and Cation Exchange Reactions to Progressively Engineer High-entropy Metal Oxides
articles.title_zh: 通过级联氧化与阳离子交换反应逐步构筑高熵金属氧化物
articles.abstract: Increasing the compositional complexity of metal oxides is highly desirable in fields such as catalysis, biomedicine, and multifunctional devices. Compared with the direct synthesis of metal oxides, where the composition is fixed upon preparation, dynamic incorporation of guest cations into preformed microstructures offers greater flexibility in composition design and higher efficiency for investigating composition–property relationships. However, conventional cation exchange reactions impose stringent requirements regarding the size, mobility, and solvation energies of both host and guest cations, thereby limiting their applicability to a narrow set of cation groups. Herein, we demonstrate a redox potential–driven cascade oxidation and cation exchange (COCE) reaction that enables the predictable incorporation of multiple polyvalent cations into pre‑electrodeposited Ag7O₈NO₃ microparticles, following the sequence of their redox potentials. Using this COCE method, any polyvalent cation can be first oxidized and subsequently introduced into the preformed microparticles. We experimentally achieve the incorporation of more than five distinct cation species into the preformed microstructures—a capability beyond the reach of any existing methods. This approach facilitates the investigation of composition-dependent property evolution in high‑entropy metal oxides, starting from a single sample of simple stoichiometry, and allows for unambiguous tracking of property changes upon the sequential introduction of additional cations into the lattice. These findings provide principles for engineering high-performance high-entropy metal oxide catalysts.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种由氧化还原电位驱动的级联氧化—阳离子交换反应，用于向预制 Ag7O8NO3 微粒中可预测地引入多种多价阳离子。与传统阳离子交换相比，该方法降低了对宿主与客体离子尺寸、迁移性和溶剂化能的限制。作者展示了按氧化还原电位顺序逐步引入多种阳离子的策略，为高熵金属氧化物的组成设计和性质调控提供了更灵活途径。

articles.title: Magneto-polaritons in a wide parabolic quantum well: symmetry breaking and kinetic energy cancellation
articles.title_zh: 宽抛物量子阱中的磁极化激元：对称性破缺与动能抵消
articles.abstract: Magneto-polaritons emerge as hybrid quasiparticle excitations in an electron gas confined by a parabolic potential and subjected to a strong tilted magnetic field. In this work, we provide a rigorous analytical derivation of the Fock-space decoupling procedure that reveals the emergence of two independent harmonic oscillators. We demonstrate that this decoupling leads to the exact cancellation of the free-particle kinetic energy term along the direction orthogonal to the field-confinement plane, even while the associated momentum remains a strictly conserved quantum number. This exact neutralization yields a massive state degeneracy that scales fundamentally with the universal expression of fluxon injection. Furthermore, we map the trajectory of the Fermi level through the hybridized dispersion branches, uncovering discrete jumps that directly govern the localization and transport properties of the magneto-polariton gas. These results establish a robust framework for non-dissipative collective transport in nanoscale heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究在抛物势束缚电子气并施加强倾斜磁场时形成的磁极化激元混合准粒子。作者解析推导了 Fock 空间解耦过程，揭示体系可化为两个相互独立的谐振子。研究指出，垂直于场—束缚平面方向的自由粒子动能项会被精确抵消，而相应动量仍为守恒量，从而产生大规模简并并影响费米能级跃迁、局域化和输运性质。

articles.title: Spin-by-spin chemical design of carbon-based ferromagnetic quantum spin-1/2 chains
articles.title_zh: 碳基铁磁量子自旋 1/2 链的逐自旋化学设计
articles.abstract: Ferromagnetic Heisenberg spin-1/2 chains represent a fundamental model of quantum magnetism, supporting collective spin-wave excitations that govern coherent spin dynamics and transport in one dimension. However, the realization of ferromagnetic organic spin chains with chemically programmable interactions remains largely unexplored. Here we encode ferromagnetic Heisenberg spin-1/2 chains within a carbon-based molecular architecture. Using open-shell [2]triangulene as a chemically defined spin-1/2 building block, we combine on-surface synthesis with site-selective scanning tunneling microscope tip–induced transformations to construct designer chains on Au(111) with spin-by-spin control. Real-space spectroscopic measurements correlate atomic structure with collective magnetic behavior, revealing signatures consistent with ferromagnetic exchange and finite-size spin-wave excitations. These results establish a chemically controlled realization of ferromagnetic quantum spin chains in a purely π-conjugated carbon framework.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在纯 π 共轭碳基分子架构中实现了可化学编程的铁磁 Heisenberg 自旋 1/2 链。作者以开壳层 [2]三角烯作为定义明确的自旋 1/2 构筑单元，结合表面合成和扫描隧道显微镜针尖诱导的位点选择性转化，在 Au(111) 表面构筑可逐自旋设计的链结构。实空间谱学测量将原子结构与集体磁行为关联起来，观察到与铁磁交换和有限尺寸自旋波激发一致的特征。

articles.title: Molecular Dynamics and Experimental Investigation of TOTM-Plasticized EPDM Rubber for Sealing-Related Mechanical Performance
articles.title_zh: 用于密封相关力学性能的 TOTM 增塑 EPDM 橡胶的分子动力学与实验研究
articles.abstract: Ethylene propylene diene monomer rubber (EPDM) is widely used in sealing-related applications where flexibility, compression recovery, and stress retention are critical for long-term compressive service. In this work, trioctyl trimellitate (TOTM) was introduced as a plasticizer to prepare TOTM/EPDM systems with different TOTM contents, and molecular dynamics simulations combined with experimental tests were used to investigate the resulting microstructural evolution, segmental motion, and mechanical response. The simulation results show that TOTM inserts into the interchain regions of EPDM and modifies the chain packing state. The fractional free volume (FFV) first decreases and then slightly recovers with increasing TOTM content, indicating the combined effects of interchain void filling and plasticization-induced relaxation. The mean square displacement (MSD), radial distribution function (RDF), coordination number, and radius of gyration (Rg) results further suggest that moderate TOTM contents promote segmental mobility, effective local interactions, and relatively stable chain conformations. The simulated mechanical response and experimental results consistently demonstrate that TOTM reduces the stiffness, hardness, and stress at the same strain, while the elongation at break increases initially and then decreases. These results indicate that appropriate plasticization improves the flexibility and interfacial conformity potential of EPDM, whereas excessive TOTM may weaken interchain constraints and structural support. Overall, 15–20 wt% TOTM can be regarded as a candidate optimization range for TOTM/EPDM systems for sealing-related mechanical performance, with the formulation near 15 wt% showing a better balance among segmental mobility, flexibility, and compressive service stability.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将偏苯三酸三辛酯作为增塑剂引入 EPDM 橡胶，结合分子动力学模拟与实验测试研究其微观结构、链段运动和力学响应。模拟表明，TOTM 可进入 EPDM 链间区域并改变链堆积状态，自由体积分数随含量变化呈现孔隙填充与增塑松弛的综合效应。均方位移、径向分布函数、配位数和回转半径等结果表明适量 TOTM 有助于促进链段运动和局部相互作用，并改善密封相关力学表现。

articles.title: Quantum-Safe Aadhaar: A Decentralized Multi-Chain KYC System Using Ring-LWE DIDs using did:pqie
articles.title_zh: 量子安全 Aadhaar：使用基于 Ring-LWE 的 did:pqie 去中心化多链 KYC 系统
articles.abstract: We present a post-quantum, cross-chain Aadhaar e-KYC system that decouples citizen identity from any single blockchain while preserving full quantum resistance. The system introduces did:pqie — a new W3C Decentralized Identifier (DID) method grounded in Ring Learning With Errors (Ring-LWE) cryptography (n = 512, q = 24593, = 4.0) — and demonstrates its application across three heterogeneous ledgers: Hyperledger Indy, Ethereum, and Polkadot. Upon government approval of a KYC submission, the system automatically issues a W3C Verifiable Credential anchored simultaneously on all three chains. Service access is gated by a Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP)-based token that proves credential validity without revealing any personally identifiable information. Selective disclosure via Merkle commitments allows citizens to reveal only required attributes. Our evaluation shows that the entire system — DID generation, multi-chain VC issuance, and ZKP token generation — operates within practical latency bounds while providing 256-bit post-quantum security. The did:pqie method has been submitted for registration with the W3C DID Methods Registry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种后量子、跨链的 Aadhaar 电子 KYC 系统，将公民身份与单一区块链解耦，同时保持量子抗性。系统引入基于 Ring-LWE 密码学的 W3C 去中心化标识符方法 did:pqie，并在 Hyperledger Indy、Ethereum 和 Polkadot 三类异构账本上演示其应用。经政府批准后，系统可在多链上锚定可验证凭证，并通过零知识证明令牌验证凭证有效性而不泄露个人身份信息。

articles.title: Development of Forest Fire Hotspot Identification and Rapid Evaluation Technique for Tropical Landscapes Utilizing Open-access Climatic and Soil Data (FIRE-TROPICS)
articles.title_zh: 利用开放获取气候与土壤数据的热带景观森林火灾热点识别与快速评估技术（FIRE-TROPICS）的开发
articles.abstract: Climate change is increasing fire risk in tropical forests traditionally considered fire-resilient, as demonstrated by recent fire events within Cleopatra’s Needle Critical Habitat (CNCH), Palawan. This study developed the FIRE-TROPICS framework, a rapid and scalable forest fire susceptibility mapping system integrating open-access climatic, topographic, vegetation, moisture, wind, and anthropogenic datasets within machine learning and geospatial workflows. Logistic Regression (LR) and Random Forest (RF) models were implemented to identify dominant fire predictors and generate spatial susceptibility maps. Correlation analysis revealed four major environmental clusters linking elevation, temperature, wind, vegetation-moisture indices, and anthropogenic accessibility variables. Multicollinearity analysis reduced the LR model to five independent predictors: elevation, aspect eastness, aspect northness, slope, and logarithm of distance to roads. The LR model identified elevation as the strongest predictor (((β = -2.14))), indicating greater fire susceptibility at lower elevations. In the RF model, land surface temperature (0.21), elevation (0.14), and NDWI (0.12) emerged as the most important predictors, while anthropogenic variables such as distance to roads (0.04) and structures (0.03) showed weaker influence. Both models consistently identified temperature-, elevation-, and wind-related variables as dominant controls on fire occurrence. Susceptibility maps highlighted similar hotspot regions, with RF producing sharper localized hotspots and LR generating smoother susceptibility gradients. The framework demonstrates the value of integrating machine learning and geospatial systems for rapid wildfire hotspot identification and decision support in tropical conservation landscapes facing increasing climate-driven fire risk.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向气候变化背景下热带森林火灾风险上升的问题，开发了FIRE-TROPICS框架，用于快速、可扩展地绘制森林火灾易发性图。框架整合开放获取的气候、地形、植被、湿度、风场和人为活动数据，并采用逻辑回归与随机森林识别关键火灾预测因子。结果显示，低海拔、地表温度、植被—水分指标以及道路可达性等变量与火灾易发性密切相关，为热带保护区火灾风险管理提供了低成本工具。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning (PIML) for the Inverse Design of Narrow and Flat bands Metallo–Dielectric Optical Filters Based on aTMM and Dispersion Relations
articles.title_zh: 基于aTMM与色散关系的窄带和平顶金属—介质光学滤波器反向设计的物理信息机器学习方法
articles.abstract: Designing multilayer thin films and metamaterials with selective optical response is one of the key problems in photonics, sensing and optoelectronics. Traditional methods depend on brute-force electromagnetic solvers like the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method that are computationally expensive and need to perform a sweeping set of parameters to find an appropriate structural configuration. A physics-informed machine learning (PIML) system has been presented, which integrates data generation by dispersion with the anisotropic transfer matrix method (aTMM) to allow the effective inverse design of metallo-dielectric (MD) ZnO-Ag multilayer stacks on the 400–1700 nm spectral range, including the visible (VIS) and near infrared (NIR) spectral regions, and can be applied to predict the thicknesses of optical coats in thin films in the ultraviolet spectral range. Specialized sets of dispersion spectra D(λ) were obtained in three structural configurations: a single super-periodic stack (5 MD layers) with narrowband spectral responses with offsets of 30-80nm, and two (9 MD layers) and three (17 MD layers) super-periodic stacks with flat-top spectral reactions with offsets of 80-300nm. Three independent PIML models were trained on these datasets with regard to each category of structures. The trained models possessed accuracy in spectral requirements such as central wavelength, bandwidth and offset of the physical thicknesses of metal and dielectric layers and could easily predict optimized multilayer designs without taking time in electromagnetic simulations. aTMM validation of the predicted structures demonstrates the capability of the predicted structures to achieve narrowband and flat-top transmission spectra in the VIS-NIR spectrum. The suggested PIML-aTMM solution offers a rapid, inexpensive, and physically guided method of automated inverse design of multilayer optical filters and metamaterial devices, and has a direct connection to sensing, imaging, spectroscopy, and photonic communication applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种物理信息机器学习框架，将色散数据生成与各向异性传输矩阵方法结合，用于金属—介质ZnO-Ag多层薄膜滤波器的高效反向设计。方法覆盖可见光至近红外波段，并可扩展到紫外薄膜涂层厚度预测。相较依赖FDTD等暴力搜索的传统方法，该框架旨在以更低计算成本预测满足窄带或平顶光谱响应需求的多层结构参数。

articles.title: In-situ Volume Estimation Method for Sea Cucumbers Based on Lightweight Binocular Vision and Spatiotemporal Constraints
articles.title_zh: 基于轻量化双目视觉与时空约束的海参原位体积估计方法
articles.abstract: Sea cucumber body volume is a key indicator for precision management and yield estimation in marine ranching. Conventional contact-based measurement methods often induce stress-related contraction and evisceration, leading to significant measurement bias. Meanwhile, existing non-contact visual methods face two main challenges for in-situ deployment: high computational complexity that strains underwater edge device constraints, and the limitations of implicit reconstruction algorithms in characterizing non-convex papillae features. To address the trade-off between measurement accuracy and limited edge computing resources, this paper proposes a lightweight binocular vision volume estimation framework. The framework optimizes the measurement pipeline through three key modules: (1) At the perception level, an asymmetric decoupled instance segmentation network (YOLO11-ED-Head) is designed to reduce cross-channel computational redundancy while maintaining accurate mask extraction. (2) At the reconstruction level, an explicit Alpha Shape topological algorithm is introduced to help preserve non-convex manifold features and mitigate volumetric inflation. (3) At the decision level, a spatial-temporal filtering pipeline combining ROI gating and 70% quantile statistics is constructed to reduce the impact of unreliable observations caused by dynamic curling and occlusion. Experimental results on a lightweight surrogate platform demonstrate that the proposed system achieves an average processing speed of 16.8 FPS, with a Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 9.8% and a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 6.2 cm3. This study provides a computationally efficient framework, demonstrating applicable potential for future edge-computing deployment in the automated yield measurement of benthic organisms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对海参体积这一海洋牧场精准管理与产量估计关键指标，提出一种适于水下边缘设备部署的轻量化双目视觉体积估计框架。方法包括改进的实例分割网络YOLO11-ED-Head、用于保留非凸疣足特征的Alpha Shape显式拓扑重建算法，以及结合空间与时间约束的决策模块。该框架旨在避免接触式测量导致的应激收缩和排脏偏差，同时在有限计算资源下提高原位体积估计精度。

articles.title: A Physio-Informatic Paradigm for Quantum Annealing and Neuromorphic AI: Extending PIRA for Sub-Exponential Energy Optimization
articles.title_zh: 面向量子退火与神经形态人工智能的生理信息范式：将PIRA扩展至亚指数能量优化
articles.abstract: This paper introduces PIRA-X, extending the Physio-Informatic Reduction Algorithm (PIRA) paradigm from discrete classical boundaries to continuous-state physical architectures, notably Quantum Annealing (QA) substrates and Neuromorphic crossbar arrays. Combinatorial NP-hard mappings and deep neural network optimization suffer from exponential energy scaling on classical von Neumann architectures. By integrating Landauer's thermodynamic erasure principle with non-equilibrium physical state variables, we model optimization as a native thermodynamic relaxation lifecycle. We present a multi-dimensional tensor governing equation that bounds physical information pressure gradients, enforcing a strict sub-exponential, logarithmic convergence trajectory of T(d)=O(d łn d) across rugged, non-convex energy landscapes. Simulated benchmarks across extensive TSPLIB instances demonstrate significant execution gains against conventional stochastic baselines. Rigorous statistical validation via Wilcoxon signed rank testing (p=0.00012) and an exceptional Cohen's d effect size (4.72) confirm the computational viability of hardware-native, physio-informatic acceleration.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出PIRA-X，将生理信息约简算法从离散经典边界扩展到量子退火基底和神经形态交叉阵列等连续态物理架构。作者将Landauer热力学擦除原理与非平衡物理状态变量结合，把优化过程建模为本征热力学弛豫生命周期。模拟基准和统计检验表明，该硬件原生的生理信息加速框架在若干组合优化场景中具有潜在的亚指数收敛与能耗优化优势。

articles.title: Constant Potential Electrochemistry with Multiscale Quantum Mechanical / Machine Learning Simulations
articles.title_zh: 基于多尺度量子力学/机器学习模拟的恒电位电化学
articles.abstract: Deeper theoretical understandings of electrified interfaces become important for the development of electrochemical devices. While much progress has been in computational electrochemistry, constant-potential-simulations pose fundamental challenges. Here, we report a multiscale quantum-mechanical/machine-learning (QM/ML) approach, effectively reducing the computational time, but maintaining the accuracy of QM with an explicit description of the electrolyte components. Implementation of a bias potential to the electrodes, maintained with a bespoke computational potentiostat, allows the system to achieve the constant potential (μVT) ensemble. Charging dynamics and electrolyte response show a one-to-one correlation in the pure water but not in the ionic system. Lager electrolytes lead to a longer convergence timescale of interfacial polarization due to greater configurational entropy, yet remains consistent in generating μVT ensemble. Without employing the potentiostat, the potential exhibits significant fluctuations reinforcing its necessity. Multiscale embedding theory that takes advantage of increasingly powerful machine learning surrogate models offers a promising avenue to model realistic electrochemical systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种多尺度量子力学/机器学习方法，用于在显式电解质描述下开展恒电位电化学界面模拟。通过定制计算恒电位仪向电极施加并维持偏置电位，体系可达到恒电位μVT系综，同时显著降低计算时间并保持量子力学精度。结果表明，纯水与离子电解质中的充电动力学和界面极化响应存在差异，且若不使用恒电位仪，电位会出现显著波动，凸显该方法的必要性。

articles.title: Anti-Kasha fluorescence, persistent room-temperature phosphorescence and delayed emission from a nearly flat non-symmetric polycyclic hydrocarbon
articles.title_zh: 近乎平面的非对称多环烃中的反Kasha荧光、持久室温磷光与延迟发射
articles.abstract: We introduce monohomotruxene (MHTX), a non-symmetric polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon (PAH) designed by reducing the symmetry of homotruxene (HTX) and truxene (TX). This partial planarization greatly enhances the complex photophysics over symmetric, triply twisted HTX, substantially increasing the photoluminescence quantum yield (PLQY) in both solution and solid state, a result we attribute to its enhanced molecular rigidity and symmetry breaking. MHTX displays an unconventional violation of Kasha’s rule, yielding excitation-dependent dual emission, giving a greater total PLQY than measured when exciting S1. Excitation of the S2 state under anaerobic conditions produces intense, 455–480 nm, ultralong room-temperature phosphorescence (RTP), lasting over 12 s at room temperature, the longest phosphorescence reported for a hydrocarbon. In contrast, excitation to the S1 state yields prompt fluorescence and weak delayed fluorescence (DF) by triplet-triplet annihilation (TTA) in the neat film. Aggregate species also present a complex emissive behavior with weak orange phosphorescence and strong, blue TTA-DF. These findings establish MHTX as a highly promising new emissive scaffold, highlighting the remarkable potential of non-symmetric PAH architectures for accessing complex excited-state dynamics and advanced photophysical functionalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了一种通过降低同三聚茚和三聚茚对称性而设计的非对称多环芳烃单同三聚茚（MHTX）。部分平面化与对称性破缺增强了分子刚性，使其在溶液和固态中表现出更高的光致发光量子产率及复杂光物理行为。MHTX表现出激发依赖的双重发射和反Kasha规则现象，在无氧条件下激发S2态可产生持续超过12秒的强室温超长磷光，并在薄膜中出现延迟荧光等过程。

articles.title: Synergistic Hydrogen Bonding and Coulomb Force Enhance Electron Transport for Ultrasensitive Ammonia Sensing
articles.title_zh: 协同氢键与库仑力增强电子传输以实现超灵敏氨气传感
articles.abstract: Zero-dimensional molecular-based materials, benefiting from their structurally isolated nature, offer advantages in suppressing baseline current and achieving a high signal-to-noise ratio, thereby holding promising potential for high sensitivity in sensing applications. However, its inherently isolated structure limits post-adsorption charge transport, leading to an unavoidable performance compromise. We proposed synergistic hydrogen bond–Coulomb force strategy employs a pre‑constructed long‑range -NH3+/Cl− Coulomb array in zero-dimensional molecular-based material, SnATP-NH3+. This -NH3+/Cl− Coulomb array not only shortens the inter-cluster distance but also generates active sites for ammonia. The ammonia molecules are selectively captured by the protonated ammonium groups, then serve as molecular linkers by forming dual hydrogen bonds. This synergistic assembly effectively reduces the electron transport barrier, lowering the activation energy from 0.92 eV to 0.83 eV, and increases the mobility from 1.29 × 10− 4 cm2 V− 1 S− 1 to 5.53 × 10− 3 cm2 V− 1 S− 1. The resulting sensor achieves an exceptional room-temperature response of 22,000% to 100 ppm NH3 and a detection limit of 42 ppb. This response is the highest reported among all room-temperature chemiresistive single-component materials and outperforming the best-reported coordination polymer by one order of magnitude.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出氢键—库仑力协同策略，用于克服零维分子基材料结构孤立导致的吸附后电荷传输受限问题。作者在SnATP-NH3+中预构建长程-NH3+/Cl−库仑阵列，既缩短簇间距离，又提供氨分子选择性吸附位点。氨分子通过双氢键充当分子连接体，降低电子传输势垒并提高迁移率，使传感器在室温下对氨气表现出极高响应和低检测限。

articles.title: Effective removal of methyl violet dye by montmorillonite-incorporated carboxymethyl cellulose-g-poly(methacrylic acid-co-acrylamide) nanocomposite hydrogel
articles.title_zh: 蒙脱土掺入羧甲基纤维素接枝聚（甲基丙烯酸-co-丙烯酰胺）纳米复合水凝胶对甲基紫染料的高效去除
articles.abstract: A novel nanocomposite hydrogel adsorbent, carboxymethyl cellulose grafted poly(methacrylic acid-co-acrylamide) containing montmorillonite, CMC-g-Poly(MAA-co-AAM)/MMT, was synthesized via free radical polymerization and investigated for the removal of methyl violet (MV) dye molecules from aqueous solutions. Thermogravimetric results indicated that the incorporation of a small amount of montmorillonite (2.5% wt.) into the hydrogel matrix significantly improved the thermal stability of the nanocomposite hydrogel. Moreover, experimental findings revealed that at temperatures above 35°C, the presence of montmorillonite (MMT) nanoparticles enhanced the adsorption efficiency. The effects of various parameters including pH, temperature, contact time, pollutant concentration, and adsorbent dosage were studied. The maximum MV dye removal was achieved at pH = 10, 25°C, with a contact time of 30 minutes, an initial dye concentration of 10 mg/L, and an adsorbent dose of 1 g/L, yielding removal efficiencies of 97.2 and 98.19% for CMC-g-Poly(MAA-co-AAM)/MMT-2.5%wt. and CMC-g-Poly(MAA-co-AAM), respectively. Kinetic studies demonstrated that the adsorption process followed a pseudo-second-order model. In addition, isotherm studies revealed that the experimental data were in good agreement with the Freundlich isotherm model. The adsorbents maintained high adsorption efficiency after five consecutive adsorption–desorption cycles, indicating their potential for extensive applications in adsorption science and technology.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过自由基聚合合成了含蒙脱土的羧甲基纤维素接枝聚（甲基丙烯酸-co-丙烯酰胺）纳米复合水凝胶，并评估其对水溶液中甲基紫染料的吸附去除能力。少量蒙脱土的引入提高了水凝胶热稳定性，并在较高温度下改善吸附效率。实验考察了pH、温度、接触时间、初始浓度和吸附剂用量等因素，最佳条件下甲基紫去除率接近或超过97%，吸附动力学符合准二级模型。

articles.title: Recurrent repurposing of an OxyR-linked regulatory locus
articles.title_zh: 与OxyR相关调控位点的反复再利用
articles.abstract: Bacterial transcriptional regulators can gain or lose target genes as lineages diversify, but how this turnover unfolds at specific loci over evolutionary time is not well understood. In many bacteria, the gene encoding OxyR, a peroxide-responsive transcription factor, is positioned next to genes linked to peroxide-stress regulation. Here, we investigated the evolutionary history of the oxyR-adjacent locus to determine how it was remodeled during the diversification of Gammaproteobacteria. Across 1,683 genomes, this position was occupied by 28 different types of neighbors with potential oxidative-stress-related roles, suggesting repeated recruitment of stress-associated outputs to the same locus. The identity of the oxyR 5' neighbor varied among major clades and included nucleoside-diphosphate-sugar epimerase, alkyl hydroperoxide reductase subunit C (ahpC), hybrid peroxidase-reductase (hyPrx), the peroxide-responsive small RNA oxyS, and several others. Phylogenomic patterns support a lineage-specific replacement series along the path from the gammaproteobacterial ancestor to Enterobacteriaceae: an ancestral epimerase gene was replaced by ahpC, then hyPrx, and finally oxyS. Position weight matrix scans and de novo motif discovery detected potential OxyR-binding motifs in the intergenic regions associated with oxyS, hyPrx, ahpC, and epimerase, albeit with stronger support for oxyS and hyPrx than for ahpC and epimerase. Taken together, these observations suggest that the conserved feature of the oxyR-adjacent region is regulatory position rather than gene identity. The locus represents an evolutionarily labile OxyR-linked output node whose molecular occupant changed repeatedly, including a transition from protein-based peroxide defense to RNA-based regulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了γ-变形菌中与过氧化物响应转录因子OxyR相邻基因位点的演化重塑过程。对1683个基因组的比较显示，该位置被28类具有潜在氧化应激相关功能的邻近基因占据，提示同一基因组位点在不同谱系中反复招募应激输出模块。系统发育基因组学结果支持从γ-变形菌祖先到肠杆菌科的谱系特异性替换序列，包括表异构酶、ahpC、hyPrx以及最终的oxyS等邻近元件。

articles.title: Sustainably Producing Green Fuel Ammonia in Equatorial Waters and Piping It Worldwide, and Removing Atmospheric CO 2 to Return to the 1960s Temperature Rise Level by 2100
articles.title_zh: 在赤道海域可持续生产绿色燃料氨并全球管道输送，同时去除大气二氧化碳以在2100年前恢复至20世纪60年代升温水平
articles.abstract: Global warming poses a serious threat to humanity and ecosystems; however, no fundamental solution has yet been found. This study examined strategies to overcome the challenges currently facing solar and wind power generation, such as limited installation space, reduced power grid inertia, and large-scale energy storage. A floating offshore photovoltaic (FOPV) power plant is proposed for the vast equatorial waters. This power plant will produce green hydrogen and synthesize green fuel ammonia, a hydrogen energy carrier. This enables worldwide transportation and storage via pipelines, minimizing losses. Furthermore, we constructed a model that removes CO2eq (with over 36,000 Gt cumulative in the atmosphere) and restores the temperature rise to the levels of the 1960s. Based on the proportional relationship between cumulative CO2eq emissions and temperature rise from 1850 to 2024, numerical analyses were conducted on global warming from 1850 to 2100 under four scenarios. The results showed that early implementation reduces the cost of restoring temperature rise levels to the 1960s and mitigates health hazards. Furthermore, because fuel costs are zero, the cost of electricity—including CO2eq removal—could be lower than current levels. Although the model proposed in this study requires validation testing for practical implementation, it holds the potential to become an effective energy production model with global influence in the transition to green energy that is sustainable for the duration of the Sun’s lifespan.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出在广阔赤道海域建设漂浮式海上光伏电站，用于制取绿氢并合成作为氢能载体的绿色燃料氨。作者设想通过管道实现全球运输与储存，以降低能源输送损失，并构建去除大气中累积二氧化碳当量、将温升恢复至20世纪60年代水平的情景模型。基于1850—2024年累积排放与温升的比例关系，研究比较了至2100年的多个情景，认为越早实施越有助于降低恢复成本并减轻健康危害。

articles.title: Intrinsic structural factors and solvent effects on excited-state dynamics and photophysical properties of BIDP derivatives with dual-ESIPT units
articles.title_zh: 具有双ESIPT单元的BIDP衍生物中内在结构因素与溶剂效应对激发态动力学和光物理性质的影响
articles.abstract: When multiple excited-state intramolecular proton transfer (ESIPT) units are incorporated into a molecule, the excited-state dynamics become more complex and sensitive to both intrinsic structure and solvent environment. However, a systematic understanding of how intrinsic and extrinsic factors regulate these dynamics remains unclear. Herein, quantum-chemical calculations were performed to elucidate the effects of the number of ESIPT units, coupling position, symmetry, and solvent polarity on the photochemical behavior and photophysical properties of BIDP derivatives with dual-ESIPT units. The results show that structural symmetry alteration can significantly change H-bond strength and ESIPT efficiency, compared with other intrinsic factors. Topological analysis of the electron localization function along proton-transfer channels offers mechanistic insights into the reduction in proton-transfer barriers for excited-state molecules with mirror-symmetric structures. The DLPNO-STEOM-CCSD method enables accurate assessment of energies in different electronic states for the keto tautomer. Furthermore, calculated radiative and nonradiative decay rate constants support that emission from keto-form BIDP derivatives exhibits anti-Kasha characteristics. In addition, high-polarity solvents impede the ESIPT process by preferentially stabilizing the more polar enol structures compared with the corresponding transition state structures. We expect that this theoretical work will provide valuable insights into the design and development of photochromic materials featuring dual ESIPT units.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用量子化学计算，系统分析双激发态分子内质子转移（ESIPT）单元BIDP衍生物中ESIPT单元数量、耦合位置、分子对称性和溶剂极性对光化学行为的调控作用。结果表明，相较其他内在因素，结构对称性的改变可显著影响氢键强度和ESIPT效率。电子定位函数拓扑分析揭示了镜面对称结构降低质子转移势垒的机制，相关辐射与非辐射衰减速率计算也有助于解释其发光特征。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Generic or Quantum-Specific? Why the Control Matters: Difficulty-Matched Probes of LLM Quantum-Code Failures
articles.title_zh: 通用错误还是量子特异错误？控制组为何重要：面向大语言模型量子代码失败的难度匹配探测
articles.abstract: When a large language model (LLM) fails to generate correct quantumcode, is the failure quantum-specific---rooted in phase, basis, unitarity, orentanglement reasoning---or a generic code-generation weakness that merelysurfaces on quantum tasks? We probe this with a paired-prompt design: everyquantum-coding task is matched to a classical-coding task that exercises thesame general programming skills without the quantum-specific content.Evaluating nine models from four providers on twelve paired prompts, graded bysimulator equivalence, we record seventy-three quantum-half failures. Ourcentral finding is methodological: the choice of control determines the answer.Against a structural control matched only on output shape, every observedquantum failure looks quantum-specific; but that control passes 99.5% of allcells, so the figure reflects its easiness, not quantum-specific cognition. Wetherefore construct a difficulty-matched control for the one prompt that admitsa clean classical analogue---the three-qubit quantum Fourier transform, matchedto the iterative Cooley--Tukey fast Fourier transform---under which apparentspecificity falls to eight of sixteen (50%) and splits by model: capablemodels fail the quantum task while passing the classical ordering task, whereasweaker models fail both. For forty-four of sixty-three failures the quantumtarget is trivial to write classically, so no difficulty-matched control canexist and specificity is not measurable; we decline to claim those failures arequantum-specific. We release the dataset, cached responses, codings, and thefull analysis pipeline.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨大语言模型生成量子代码失败时，错误究竟源于量子概念推理缺陷，还是一般代码生成能力不足。作者采用成对提示设计，将每个量子编程任务与不含量子内容但考察相同通用编程技能的经典任务配对，并用模拟器等价性评估九个模型在十二组提示上的表现。结果强调控制组选择会显著影响结论：仅按输出结构匹配的控制组会夸大量子特异性，而难度匹配控制组显示部分失败并非量子特有，并且不同模型之间存在差异。

articles.title: Empirical Analysis of Cost Escalation in Mega-Infrastructure Projects: A Case Study of the I-35 Capital Express Central Project
articles.title_zh: 大型基础设施项目成本升级的实证分析：以 I-35 Capital Express Central 项目为例
articles.abstract: infrastructure projects in the United States frequently face persistent challenges related to cost overruns, schedule delays, and inefficient resource allocation. These issues are often driven by inaccurate early-stage cost estimation, incomplete risk assessment, and limited integration of data-driven decision-making in planning and execution phases. Public sector mega-infrastructure projects are systematically susceptible to structural cost underestimations and market pricing volatility during the procurement lifecycle, In recent years, advances in data analytics, statistical modeling, and artificial intelligence have created new opportunities to improve infrastructure cost estimation and control. This research delivers an empirical investigation into cost escalation drivers by examining the 2.67 Billion actively awarded execution package of the Interstate 35 (I-35) Capital Express Central mega-project in Austin, Texas. Utilizing a quantitative methodology anchored in official Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) Let Contract Bid Tabulations and institutional capital ledgers, this study systematically analyzes seven critical operational segments: Drainage Tunnels, Mainlane Widening, Bridge Replacements, Advanced Utility Relocations, Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), Environmental Mitigation, and Right-of-Way (ROW) real estate acquisitions. The empirical findings reveal a profound divergence between theoretical civil engineering estimates and open-market reality, demonstrating an aggregate cost escalation of 526,421,092.06, which represents a + 24.54% budget overrun prior to structural deployment. Line-item micro-data indicates that real estate condemnation within densified urban areas and advanced subsurface geotechnical risks are the primary macroeconomic catalysts driving this variance. The study concludes with institutional recommendations for updating public highway construction cost indices, advocating for risk-adjusted baseline estimation models to mitigate fiscal exposure in future large-scale public works.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以美国得克萨斯州奥斯汀 I-35 Capital Express Central 大型基础设施项目为案例，分析公共部门大型工程中的成本上涨问题。作者基于得州交通部合同投标表和机构资本台账等数据，考察早期成本估算偏差、风险评估不足、市场价格波动和资源配置效率等潜在驱动因素。研究旨在通过数据分析和统计建模改进基础设施项目的成本估算与控制，具体分项结果需查阅原文。

articles.title: A transferable machine learning approach to predict quantum circuit parameters for electronic structure problems

articles.abstract: The individual optimization of quantum circuit parameters is currently one of the main practical bottlenecks in variational quantum eigensolvers for electronic systems. To this end, several machine learning approaches have been proposed to mitigate the problem. However, such method predominantly aims at training and predicting parameters tailored to individual molecules: either a specific structure, or several structures of the same molecule with varying bond lengths. This work explores machine learning based modeling strategies to include transferability between different molecules. We use a well investigated quantum circuit design and apply it to model properties of a variety of molecular systems where we show parameter prediction that is systematically transferable to instances significantly larger than the training instances.

articles.title: Controlling Defects and Probing Dynamics in Active Nematics with Deep Reinforcement Learning
articles.title_zh: 利用深度强化学习控制活性向列相中的缺陷并探测其动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13721v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological defects govern much of the flow behavior and orientational order in active nematics, making their control relevant for active matter physics, smart materials, and microfluidics. Applied activity patterns can induce self-propulsion of active nematic defects, but general-purpose methods for exploiting this effect to control defects remain largely unexplored. Here we use deep reinforcement learning (RL) to perform minimum-time position control of +1/2 defects in hybrid lattice Boltzmann simulations of active nematodynamics. Spatiotemporally patterned activity, implemented as a control field in the active stress, steers defects through microchannel geometries and reveals finite-time reachable regions of defect position space. Reachability is shaped by director anisotropy, homeotropic wall anchoring, and the allowed activity patterns: local patterns steer defects in free domains but fail in junctions, whereas global patterns open otherwise inaccessible channels. In constrained geometries, the original defect may be unable to reach some goals intact, but controlled pair creation enlarges the effective reachable set by transferring control to a newly created +1/2 defect. The trained RL controllers outperform static and rule-based baselines, and controllers trained only on simple junctions can be combined without fine-tuning into a meta-controller that successfully steers defects through a larger test maze. Free energy visualizations show that guided defects write persistent, history-dependent distortions into the director field that can later be partially erased by -1/2 defects. Thus, RL-based control uncovers how confinement, anchoring, actuation geometry, and defect creation determine reachable motion in active nematics, providing a framework for other control tasks in soft and active matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究使用深度强化学习，在活性向列流体的混合格子玻尔兹曼模拟中实现对 +1/2 拓扑缺陷的最短时间位置控制。作者通过时空调制的活性图案作为控制场，引导缺陷在微通道几何中运动，并分析缺陷位置空间的有限时间可达区域。结果表明，可达性受到指向矢各向异性、壁面锚定条件和活性图案形式的影响，受限几何中还可通过受控缺陷对产生来扩展有效可达范围。
authors: Russ Islam, Kyogo Kawaguchi, Yuto Ashida

articles.title: Enhancement of spin current in Fe₈₅Co₁₅/Ni₈₀Fe₂₀ bilayers via interlayer ferromagnetic coupling
articles.title_zh: 通过层间铁磁耦合增强 Fe₈₅Co₁₅/Ni₈₀Fe₂₀ 双层膜中的自旋流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13805v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a detailed study on how the strength of the interlayer magnetic coupling on Fe₈₅Co₁₅/Ni₈₀Fe₂₀ bilayers modifies the spin wave behavior of this system. A series of Fe₈₅Co₁₅/Ni₈₀Fe₂₀ bilayers deposited on MgO[100] substrates were grown by magnetron sputtering. Magnetic characterization of the samples was performed using a vibrating sample magnetometer and magneto-optical Kerr effect. The in-plane hysteresis loops reveal a cubic magnetic anisotropy of magnetocrystalline origin, with easy and hard axis along the [100] and [110] Fe-Co crystallographic directions, respectively. Ferromagnetic resonance measurements were performed to analyze the in-plane angular dependence of the resonance field, and also the resonance field at several frequencies was determined along the hard axis. By using a bilayer model in the frame of the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert magnetization equation of motion, the magnetization precession components were calculated, as well as the dependence of precession area on the Fe-Co layer thickness and the ferromagnetic interlayer coupling. We observe a maximum in the area of the ellipsoid generated by the magnetization precession of the permalloy layer at a certain exchange constant, showing that this effect could be used to maximize the injected spin currents, which could be tuned by changing the interlayer exchange constant in bilayer systems, the saturation magnetization of the materials, or the excitation frequency.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究系统考察 Fe₈₅Co₁₅/Ni₈₀Fe₂₀ 双层膜中层间磁耦合强度对自旋波行为的影响。样品通过磁控溅射沉积在 MgO[100] 衬底上，并利用振动样品磁强计、磁光克尔效应和铁磁共振进行表征。作者结合 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert 方程的双层模型计算磁化进动分量，分析 Fe-Co 层厚度和层间铁磁耦合对进动面积及相关自旋流增强的作用。
authors: A. A. Pérez Martínez, D. Velázquez Rodríguez, D. Goijman, T. Torres, M. H. Aguirre, J. Gómez, A. Butera, E. De Biasi, J. Milano

articles.title: A Collective-Spin Derivation of the Uniform Magnon Hamiltonian in Cavity Magnonics
articles.title_zh: 腔磁振子学中均匀磁振子哈密顿量的集体自旋推导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13830v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a direct collective-spin derivation of the effective uniform-mode Hamiltonian used in cavity magnonics. Starting from a nearest-neighbor Heisenberg ferromagnet coupled to long-wavelength magnetic fields, we show that the relevant dynamics can be restricted to the fully symmetric spin sector, where the exchange interaction contributes only a constant energy shift and the ferromagnet behaves as a macrospin of length Ns. Applying the Holstein--Primakoff transformation directly to this total spin yields the usual uniform magnon mode and its leading nonlinear corrections without first introducing site-resolved bosonic operators. This collective formulation makes explicit the interpretation of the ferromagnet as a synthetic large-spin atom and provides a compact route to the effective Hamiltonians used in driven and Floquet cavity magnonics. As a physical consequence, the leading nonlinear correction produces an occupation-dependent reduction of the effective magnon--photon coupling, providing a simple signature of finite-spin saturation under strong uniform-mode driving.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从最近邻海森堡铁磁体与长波长磁场耦合出发，直接以集体自旋形式推导腔磁振子学中常用的均匀模有效哈密顿量。作者说明相关动力学可限制在全对称自旋扇区，此时交换相互作用只给出常数能量平移，铁磁体等效为长度为 Ns 的宏自旋。对总自旋直接施加 Holstein–Primakoff 变换可得到均匀磁振子模及其主要非线性修正，并揭示强驱动下有限自旋饱和导致的占据数依赖磁振子—光子耦合减弱。
authors: Tomas Aguiar, Marcos Cesar de Oliveira

articles.title: Machine-learned dynamics of surface polarons at reduced oxide surfaces
articles.title_zh: 还原氧化物表面极化子的机器学习动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13833v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reducible oxides exhibit a rich interplay of electronic, structural, and chemical properties that underpins applications in catalysis, photovoltaics, batteries, and energy storage. This interplay is strongly shaped by excess electrons, often introduced by oxygen vacancies, that localize as small polarons and influence charge transport and surface chemistry. At surfaces, these polarons play a central role in charge localization, mobility, and reactivity, yet their finite-temperature dynamics remain difficult to access from first principles. Ab initio molecular dynamics is typically limited to picosecond time scales, precluding statistically meaningful sampling of polaron hopping dynamics. To overcome this limitation, we extend machine-learning-assisted polaron dynamics [V. Birschitzky et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 134, 216301 (2025)] to redox-active oxide surfaces, using oxygen-deficient rutile TiO2(110) as a paradigmatic case. By accessing several nanoseconds of dynamics over a range of temperatures, we show that small-polaron mobility at the reduced rutile TiO2(110) surface is suppressed by several orders of magnitude relative to the corresponding bulk material, providing a microscopic interpretation of the lower electron mobilities observed in porous rutile TiO2 compared with single-crystal samples. This suppressed mobility arises from the loss of favorable hopping pathways: surface polaron motion is largely confined to planar inter-row trajectories within the second topmost layers, with only rare interlayer hopping events. Oxygen vacancies further reshape the polaron free-energy landscape by acting as attractive centers for excess electrons, biasing the polaron distribution toward nearby Ti sites and promoting occasional charge transfer to the outermost surface layer. These results establish a transferable machine-learning strategy for investigating polaron dynamics in reducible oxides.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将机器学习辅助的极化子动力学方法扩展到具有氧化还原活性的氧化物表面，以缺氧金红石 TiO2(110) 为典型体系。通过获得跨越多个温度范围、长达数纳秒的动力学采样，作者研究了表面小极化子的局域化、迁移与跳跃行为。结果表明，还原 TiO2(110) 表面的小极化子迁移率相较体相显著受抑，为理解表面电荷输运和反应活性提供了更长时间尺度的第一性原理辅助视角。

articles.title: Closed-loop discovery of out-of-distribution processing protocols by evolutionary search and uncertainty-aware learning
articles.title_zh: 通过进化搜索与不确定性感知学习闭环发现分布外加工协议
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13859v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many materials and chemical systems exhibit history-dependent responses, where functional outcomes are governed not only by final-state variables but by the time-dependent sequence of fields, temperatures, or chemical potentials applied during operation. Discovering new processing protocols is therefore a high-dimensional search problem in which the control variable is an entire waveform or sample history, and conventional strategies either remain confined to conservative interpolative families or become prohibitively measurement intensive. Here, a closed-loop workflow is introduced that couples evolutionary search over a compact waveform representation with uncertainty-aware deep kernel learning to generate, rank, and experimentally validate candidate protocols. Applied to ferroelectric thin films, with the scanning-probe tip-bias waveform as the protocol and the nonlinear electromechanical response as the reward, the workflow discovers waveform families that enhance nonlinearity by de-aging the film. Spatially resolved before/after measurements show that the best-performing waveforms selectively activate pre-existing, weakly pinned domain-wall segments, whereas the worst drive long-range irreversible switching. This framework reframes protocol tuning as out-of-distribution discovery, generalizable to synthesis and annealing trajectories, battery formation protocols, and other high-dimensional control problems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种闭环材料实验工作流，将紧凑波形表示上的进化搜索与具备不确定性感知能力的深核学习结合，用于生成、排序并实验验证候选加工协议。该方法应用于铁电薄膜，以扫描探针针尖偏压波形作为协议、非线性机电响应作为奖励函数，发现了能够通过去老化增强非线性的波形族。空间分辨的前后对比测量显示，表现最佳的波形可选择性激活预先存在的弱钉扎区域，展示了面向历史依赖材料响应的高维协议发现能力。
authors: Yu Liu, Stanislav Udovenko, Ching-Che Lin, Jaegyu Kim, Lane W. Martin, Susan Trolier-McKinstry, Sergei V. Kalinin

articles.title: DFTB coupled with NEGF study of the structural, electronic and transport properties of goldene 2D material
articles.title_zh: DFTB 结合 NEGF 研究二维金烯材料的结构、电子与输运性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13869v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the structural, electronic, and transport properties of the goldene 2D material using the density functional tight-binding (DFTB) method. Electronic transport calculations were conducted in conjunction with the non-equilibrium Green's functions (NEGF) technique. Our study reveals that the Au 2D material is dynamically and thermally stable, and it possesses good elastic properties. On the other hand, goldene has a linear relationship between current and voltage at low potentials, indicating its metallic character. The calculated current-potential curve correlates well with transmission functions and the electronic density of states around the Fermi level. We also investigated the electronic structure and magnetic properties of silicon (Si)-doped Au 2D material. Our results show that the Si atom can induce a local magnetic state in the goldene monolayer. The resulting magnetic moment is 0.63 μ_B.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作采用密度泛函紧束缚方法研究二维 goldene（金烯）的结构、电子和输运性质，并结合非平衡格林函数方法计算电子输运。结果显示该二维 Au 材料具有动力学和热稳定性、良好弹性性质，并在低电压下呈线性电流—电压关系，体现其金属性。作者还研究了 Si 掺杂金烯，发现 Si 原子可诱导局域磁态，磁矩约为 0.63 μB。

articles.title: Dynamical multiferroicity in framework materials
articles.title_zh: 框架材料中的动力学多铁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13874v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dynamical multiferroicity, which describes the magnetic fields generated by circularly polarized phonons in materials, is an established mechanism for optical control of magnetism. Here we perform ab initio calculations of dynamical multiferroicity in inorganic and organic framework materials, with the goal of identifying materials which enable the generation of large magnetic fields by light. We find the metal--organic framework material Zn(NH₄₎₍formate)₃ to have modes with magnetic moments almost twice that of SrTiO₃; these modes involve circular motions of NH₄⁺ hydrogen ions with high gyromagnetic ratios. The complex structure and flexibility of framework materials can allow such angular momentum localization, and also increase the maximum light-induced magnetization permitted by the Lindemann melting criterion.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文通过从头算研究无机和有机框架材料中的动力学多铁性，即圆偏振声子在材料中产生磁场的机制。作者发现金属有机框架 Zn(NH4)(formate)3 的某些声子模式磁矩接近 SrTiO3 的两倍，这与 NH4+ 中高旋磁比氢离子的圆周运动有关。研究指出，框架材料的复杂结构与柔性有利于角动量局域化，并可能提高由光诱导磁化所允许的上限。

articles.title: Molecular Beam Epitaxy of Mn2In2Se5 van der Waals Layers Using Mn Intercalation
articles.title_zh: 利用 Mn 插层分子束外延生长 Mn2In2Se5 范德华层
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13906v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The weak van der Waals (vdW) force in layered chalcogenide materials has enabled the growth of ternary chalcogenide layers using unconventional approaches. Here, we report the molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) growth of Mn2In2Se5, a spin glass material with high level of magnetic frustration, through the heterointegration of MnSe on In2Se3. Directly depositing α-MnSe on the vdW In2Se3 layers results in Mn intercalation, transforming the In2Se3 layer into Mn2In2Se5. Large growth windows, including substrate temperatures from 250-450 degC and Se:Mn flux ratio of 1.1-3.1, have been identified for the intercalation process. With an optimized MnSe deposition time, smooth, single-crystalline, and (0001)-oriented Mn2In2Se5 layers with a root-mean-square (RMS) roughness of 1.5 nm can be synthesized. Further extending the MnSe deposition time results in the growth of uniform rock-salt structured α-MnSe (111) layers with a thickness of up to 8 nm and a narrow full-width-at-half-maximum (FWHM) of 0.35deg in MnSe (222) XRD rocking curves. This report presents a unique approach for the growths of uniform and single-crystalline Mn2In2Se5 vdW layers using MBE, and potentially opens a pathway for synthesis of ternary vdW chalcogenides by intercalation of new atomic species in binary vdW chalcogenides.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了通过在 In2Se3 上异质集成 MnSe，实现自旋玻璃材料 Mn2In2Se5 的分子束外延生长。直接在范德华 In2Se3 层上沉积 α-MnSe 会引发 Mn 插层，并将 In2Se3 转化为 Mn2In2Se5；作者确定了较宽的工艺窗口，包括 250–450°C 的衬底温度和 1.1–3.1 的 Se:Mn 通量比。经优化沉积时间可获得平滑、单晶、(0001) 取向的 Mn2In2Se5 层，进一步延长沉积时间则可形成均匀岩盐结构 α-MnSe(111) 层。
authors: Qihua Zhang, Ke Wang, Wesley Auker, Maria Hilse, Stephanie Law

articles.title: Direct/adaptive-mixture phase-gradient learning for neural-network quantum states with complex phase structure
articles.title_zh: 面向复杂相位结构神经网络量子态的直接与自适应混合相位梯度学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13912v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural-network quantum states (NQS) are a leading variational tool for quantum many-body physics, yet their optimization is fragile whenever the ground state carries a non-trivial sign or complex phase structure, a situation generic to gauge fields, broken time-reversal symmetry, and fermionic statistics. We trace this fragility to the stochastic estimator of the phase gradient rather than to network expressiveness. The phase sector of the Monte Carlo energy gradient is a noisy score-function estimator; differentiating the local energy instead yields a direct estimator that is unbiased for the same phase force, has far lower variance, and requires only a separated amplitude--phase ansatz. Demonstrated on a 100-site flux ladder, a small network trained this way reaches 0.89% median error, where tuned standard baselines plateau at 1.8% and wider or deeper standard-gradient networks degrade from 8.4% to 24.6%. The advantage carries over to chiral XXX chains: the direct estimator again converges to a markedly lower error than the standard one, across α and size; it grows with flux and vanishes in zero-flux controls. An adaptive-mixture of the two estimators is provably never worse in variance than the better endpoint at the optimal mixing coefficient, with seed-resolved diagnostics tracing much of the gain to eliminating failed runs. Estimator design thus emerges as a first-class lever for complex-valued neural quantum states.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文关注神经网络量子态在具有非平凡符号或复相位结构的量子多体基态优化中容易失稳的问题，并将其归因于相位梯度的随机估计器而非网络表达能力不足。作者提出对局域能量求导得到直接相位梯度估计器，该估计器在相同相位力下无偏且方差更低，但需要振幅—相位分离的 ansatz。数值结果显示，该方法在 100 位点通量梯和手性 XXX 链上均较标准梯度方法达到更低误差，且优势随通量增强、在零通量对照中消失。
authors: Yi-Ran Xue, Rui Wang, Baigeng Wang, Chenan Wei

articles.title: Machine Learning Accelerated SSNEB for Efficient Minimum Energy Pathway Calculations
articles.title_zh: 机器学习加速的 SSNEB 方法用于高效最小能量路径计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13917v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Metastable states and their minimum energy pathways (MEPs) are central to understanding transformations and phase stability in complex materials, yet mapping transition pathways between competing states remains computationally demanding and experimentally challenging. Here, we introduce a hybrid solid-state nudged elastic band (SSNEB) framework that integrates two pretrained machine learning models, EquiformerV2 (eqV2) and the equivariant Smooth Energy Network (eSEN), with DFT for energy, force, and stress evaluations. Applied to three solid-state systems, CsPbI₃, GaN, and TiO₂, our framework achieves up to a 7-fold speedup while converging to the same pathways predicted by first-principles calculations. Moreover, the hybrid SSNEB framework enables systematic benchmarking of existing ML models, providing both efficiency and reliability for predicting MEPs across various materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种混合固态爬山弹性带框架，将两个预训练机器学习模型 EquiformerV2 和 eSEN 与 DFT 结合，用于能量、力和应力评估。该方法应用于 CsPbI3、GaN 和 TiO2 三类固态体系，在保持与第一性原理计算相同转变路径的同时最高实现约 7 倍加速。该框架还可用于系统评估现有机器学习势模型在最小能量路径预测中的效率与可靠性。
authors: Yu Zhang, Guanzhi Li, Minkyung Han, Sean Gasiorowski, Daniel Ratner, Chunjing Jia, Yu Lin

articles.title: Oxygen deficiency and valency reconstruction in multiferroic V-doped HfO₂
articles.title_zh: 多铁性 V 掺杂 HfO2 中的氧缺陷与价态重构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13950v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interplay of oxygen deficiency and vanadium multiple valency in the candidate multiferroic V-doped Pca2₁ hafnia HfO₂ is studied by first-principles calculations. Low-lying V majority gap states accept electrons from oxygen-vacancy donors, reducing their formation energy, and converting nominal V⁴⁺ centers into V³⁺. The resulting local magnetization and screening changes are reflected in the calculated V core-level shifts, which are consistent with the experimentally observed XPS signatures. The calculated V³⁺/V⁴⁺ population ratio determined by oxygen vacancies only matches experiment in reducing conditions, suggesting that additional electron reservoirs may contribute under ALD growth conditions. A similar scenario also seems to apply to the recently observed multiferroicity in Cr-doped hafnia, where oxygen deficiency is intrinsic to the growth technique.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文采用第一性原理计算研究候选多铁性 V 掺杂 Pca21 相 HfO2 中氧缺陷与钒多价态之间的相互作用。低能 V 多数自旋带隙态可接收来自氧空位施主的电子，从而降低氧空位形成能，并将名义 V4+ 中心转化为 V3+。计算得到的局域磁化、屏蔽变化和 V 芯能级位移与实验 XPS 特征相符，同时表明在 ALD 生长条件下可能还存在额外电子库参与价态调控。

articles.title: XRDiff: Crystal Structure Prediction from Powder X-Ray Diffraction Data Using Diffusion Models
articles.title_zh: XRDiff：利用扩散模型从粉末 X 射线衍射数据预测晶体结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14003v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Determining the crystal structure of a material from its powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) pattern is a central challenge in materials science. PXRD is an accessible and widely used characterization technique, yet recovering the atomic structure from diffraction data requires solving an underdetermined inverse problem due to the loss of phase information. Generative modeling can provide a prior over atomic structure and learn the mapping from PXRD patterns to crystal structures via simulated structure-spectrum pairs. We present XRDiff, a diffusion model that recovers crystal structures from PXRD given either the stoichiometry or, in a more challenging setting, the elemental constituents and total number of atoms in the unit cell. We evaluate on datasets where each stoichiometry has multiple polymorphs and all polymorphs of a given composition are held out together, ensuring that high performance reflects genuine use of the diffraction signal. XRDiff achieves strong structure recovery rates on simulated benchmarks, indicating that the model learns a spectrum-to-structure mapping precise enough to differentiate between polymorphs. To address generalization to experimental data, we compare a full-spectrum encoding against an encoding based on peak descriptors. The peak-based encoding generalizes substantially better, outperforming even a model trained on full spectra with augmentations fitted to the experimental noise distribution. These results demonstrate that representations robust to the noise and artifacts present in real-world PXRD offer a practical and scalable path toward closing the simulation-to-experiment gap, enabling zero-shot crystal structure solution from experimental PXRD with full or partial chemical composition input.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出 XRDiff，一种从粉末 X 射线衍射图谱恢复晶体结构的扩散生成模型。PXRD 结构解析因相位信息丢失而属于欠定反问题，作者通过模拟结构—谱图对学习从衍射信号到原子结构的映射，并可在给定化学计量比或仅给定元素组成与晶胞原子数的条件下工作。评估采用多晶型数据并按成分整体留出，结果显示 XRDiff 能有效区分多晶型并实现较强的结构恢复能力。
authors: Nofit Segal, Mingda Li, Benjamin Kurt Miller, Rafael Gómez-Bombarelli

articles.title: Symmetry of the critical current function in superconducting nanodevices
articles.title_zh: 超导纳米器件中临界电流函数的对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14051v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a variety of nano-scale superconducting devices containing more than one weak link. Even in devices with multiple weak links the IB symmetry is usually obeyed, which means that if we reverse both the bias current direction and the magnetic field direction at the same time, the superconducting response, namely the critical current, remains unchanged. We also provide a detailed analysis of the situations in which such symmetry is violated.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究了多种包含多个弱连接的纳米尺度超导器件中临界电流随偏置电流与磁场变化的对称性。作者指出，即使器件含有多个弱连接，通常仍满足 IB 对称性，即同时反转偏置电流方向和磁场方向时，超导响应或临界电流保持不变。文章还分析了这种对称性可能被破坏的具体情形。
authors: Ziqi Zhao, Cliff Sun, Ci-You Huang, Jiankun Zhang, Xiangyu Song, Alexey Bezryadin

articles.title: General Theory for Ferroelectric Control of Spin Splitting in Collinear Antiferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 共线反铁磁体中铁电调控自旋劈裂的一般理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14055v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrical control of magnetism is crucial for next-generation spintronics. While recent advances have demonstrated ferroelectric switching in two-dimensional magnets, a general design strategy spanning different dimensionalities remains elusive. Here, we develop a group-theoretical framework for achieving ferroelectric control of spin splitting in collinear antiferromagnets, including altermagnets and compensated ferrimagnets. By systematically classifying switching operators through symmetry analysis, we identify a universal pathway for the simultaneous reversal of electric polarization and nonrelativistic spin splitting.We validate this approach in three representative systems: quasi-one-dimensional (6,14) Zigzag graphene nanoribbons, two-dimensional~ḩNb3I8, and three-dimensional altermagnetic~ḩMnSe2. Our work establishes a versatile design paradigm for magnetoelectric devices and expands the functional landscape of low-power spintronic materials beyond the low-dimensional limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文建立了一个群论框架，用于在共线反铁磁体中实现铁电极化对自旋劈裂的电学控制，涵盖交替磁体和补偿亚铁磁体等体系。通过对开关算符进行系统的对称性分类，作者提出了同时反转电极化和非相对论自旋劈裂的通用路径。该理论在准一维锯齿形石墨烯纳米带、二维 h-Nb3I8 和三维交替磁体 h-MnSe2 中得到验证，为低功耗自旋电子材料与磁电器件设计提供了通用范式。
authors: Zhihao Dai, Yingwei Chen, Junyi Ji, Chaoyu He, Hongjun Xiang

articles.title: Altermagnetism and bond-nematicity in the spin-1/2 square lattice J₁₋J₂₋δ model
articles.title_zh: 自旋1/2平方晶格 J₁-J₂-δ 模型中的交替磁性与键向列性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14101v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study appearance of bond-nematicity in insulating altermagnetic materials induced by increased frustration and quantum-fluctuations driven melting of the altermagnetic order. Using novel machine learning approach that combines symmetry enhanced neural network architectures and variational Monte Carlo we consider the spin-1/2 square lattice J₁₋J₂₋δ model known to have altermagnetic ordering in the regime of small geometric frustration and a gapless spin liquid phase in the regime of strong frustration and small exchange interaction modulation parameter δ. In the regime where exchange modulation is relatively large, resulting in the significant splitting of the magnon modes with different chiralities in the altermagnetic regime, we find that melting of the altermagnetic order by increased frustration leads to an intriguing phase that hosts coexisting symmetry protected topological valence bond solid and bond-nematic orders. The phase is characterized by condensation of magnon pairs that results in bond-nematicity, breaking of U(1) spin rotation and Z₂ spin inversion symmetries and chiral splitting of the triplon-like energy levels in the excitation spectrum. Whilst numerous recent studies address non-trivial impact of altermagnetic moments on various properties in altermagnetic materials, like electronic band structure and superconductivity, influence of strong quantum fluctuations and phases that can result from melting of the altermagnetic order are much less explored. Our study therefore presents an important step in identifying exotic phases of matter that can emerge in vicinity of the altermagnetic order.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察绝缘交替磁性材料中，在几何阻挫增强和量子涨落导致交替磁序熔化时出现的键向列性。作者结合对称性增强神经网络与变分蒙特卡洛方法研究自旋1/2平方晶格 J₁-J₂-δ 模型，发现当交换调制较强时，交替磁序熔化可产生同时具有对称性保护拓扑价键固体序和键向列序的相。该相与磁振子对凝聚相关，并伴随 U(1) 自旋旋转和 Z₂ 自旋反演对称性的破缺。
authors: Tanja DJurić, Shenlong Yu, Pinaki Sengupta

articles.title: Interface-engineered oxidation-resistant wafer-level Tantalum-Tantalum thermocompression bonding for 3D integration of superconducting interconnects
articles.title_zh: 用于超导互连三维集成的界面工程抗氧化晶圆级钽-钽热压键合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14103v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Wafer-level 3D integration of superconducting interconnects requires low-thermal budget bonding processes compatible with superconducting materials. Rapid native oxide formation on tantalum (Ta) surfaces limits low-temperature, low-pressure direct Ta-Ta thermocompression bonding. In this study, we develop an oxidation-resistant bonding process using an ultrathin Au passivation layer to suppress oxide formation during bonding. The engineered interface enables blanket Ta-Ta wafer bonding at 300 ⁱ̧rcC under 4.93 bar, significantly reducing the bonding thermal budget and generation of α-Ta across the interface, which potentially improves coherence time as reported in literature. Structural and interfacial analyses confirm oxide suppression and continuous metallic bonding, having a bond strength of 169 MPa. This work demonstrates a low-temperature, low-pressure Ta-Ta thermocompression bonding strategy for scalable 3D superconducting interconnect integration.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对超导互连晶圆级三维集成中钽表面易形成天然氧化层、限制低温低压直接键合的问题，提出了超薄金钝化层辅助的抗氧化钽-钽热压键合工艺。该界面工程方法在 300 °C、4.93 bar 条件下实现了整片钽-钽晶圆键合，并抑制界面氧化与 α-Ta 生成。结构和界面表征显示形成连续金属键合，键合强度达到 169 MPa，表明该策略适用于可扩展的三维超导互连集成。
authors: Harsh Mishra, Ullas Pandey, Sathish Bonam, Adirae Dinesh, Sai Rama Krishna Malladi, Shiv Govind Singh

articles.title: Probing Structure and Ionic Transport in Molten Lithium Carbonate
articles.title_zh: 熔融碳酸锂中结构与离子输运的探测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14118v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Li₂CO₃ (LC) is a cornerstone material for clean energy technologies, including high-temperature molten carbonate fuel cells, electrochemical carbon capture, and lithium-based batteries. However, capturing the complex, many-body interactions governing the structure and transport in LC in its molten state has remained a challenge, constrained by the computational cost of ab initio methods and the accuracy limitations of classical force fields. To address this gap, we deploy equivariant graph-based machine learned interatomic potentials, specifically, the multi atomic cluster expansion (MACE) and neural equivariant interatomic potential (NequIP) architectures that are trained on melt-quench ab initio molecular dynamics data. Our benchmarking demonstrates that MACE provides superior transferability and precision in predicting energies and forces compared to NequIP. Subsequently, we use the optimized MACE model to perform large-scale molecular dynamics simulations to probe the properties of molten LC. Besides describing the structural features, such as the dominant presence of C-O pair correlations under molten conditions, our MACE model reproduces experimentally-measured static structure factors and shear viscosity values. Further, our simulations indicate that Li transport in LC is fundamentally dominated by concerted motion, as evidenced by Haven's ratios being significantly below unity (0.20-0.40). Notably, we identify a temperature-driven transition from anisotropic (and highly concerted) Li transport, supported by persistent oxygen-centered Voronoi cages at 1000~K, to isotropic (and less concerted) diffusion at 1400~K. Thus, we provide fundamental insights into the structural and transport properties of molten LC and also demonstrate a robust and scalable framework for the accelerated design of molten salt electrolytes and ionic liquids.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向熔融 Li₂CO₃ 中复杂多体相互作用难以由从头算或经典力场准确高效描述的问题，训练并比较了 MACE 与 NequIP 两类等变图机器学习原子间势。基准测试表明，MACE 在能量和力的可迁移性与精度方面优于 NequIP。作者进一步利用优化后的 MACE 模型开展大规模分子动力学模拟，以研究熔融碳酸锂的结构特征和离子输运性质，包括熔融条件下显著的 C-O 成对关联。
authors: Debsundar Dey, Abhirup Patra, Anand Narayanan Krishnamoorthy, Gopalakrishnan Sai Gautam

articles.title: Fermi gas of polar molecules in the Pauli-blocked regime
articles.title_zh: 泡利阻塞 regime 中的极性分子费米气体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14135v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum gases of polar molecules have recently emerged as a powerful platform for exploring exotic many-body dynamics and correlated quantum behavior. To achieve the full potential of this platform, the production of deeply degenerate quantum gases of molecules in arbitrary confinement geometries is necessary. Here, we successfully evaporate fermionic KRb molecules in both 3D and quasi-2D geometries to well below their Fermi temperatures utilizing dipolar collisions. As we evaporate deeper into degeneracy in both geometries, we enter the Pauli-blocked regime with polar molecules, which we independently confirm for the first time by measuring the Pauli suppression of elastic collisions. Moreover, the Pauli suppression of collisions contributes to the limitation of our final molecular temperature to about 25% of the Fermi temperature in both geometries, particularly limiting quasi-2D evaporation where the Pauli blockade drastically reduces an otherwise large elastic to inelastic scattering ratio. This work demonstrates the production of degenerate Fermi gases of polar molecules both in a 3D harmonic trap and in mono- and bi-layer 2D configurations. Further, our work explores the fundamental limits on evaporation of molecular Fermi gases set by the Pauli-exclusion principle, which could be overcome in the future by introducing distinguishable scattering partners.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在三维和准二维几何中利用偶极碰撞对费米 KRb 极性分子进行蒸发冷却，使其温度远低于费米温度。随着体系进入更深的简并区，作者首次通过测量弹性碰撞的泡利抑制，独立确认了极性分子中的泡利阻塞 regime。结果表明，泡利抑制同时限制了最终温度，约为费米温度的 25%，并对准二维蒸发尤为显著。
authors: Junyu Lin, Annette N. Carroll, Phillip Martin, Calder Miller, Reuben R. W. Wang, Kevin Xu, John L. Bohn, Tim de Jongh, Jun Ye

articles.title: The Structure-tuning Magnetism in the Co(NbxTa1-x)2O6 Series
articles.title_zh: Co(NbₓTa₁₋ₓ)₂O₆ 系列中的结构调控磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14183v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Low dimensional quantum materials have been extensively studied within the physics community, among which Co2+ is one of the most popular magnetic ions to be embedded into the structural motif. CoNb2O6 and CoTa2O6 both have adopted an effective spin-1/2 state, with the former attracting enduring interest while the latter being rarely investigated. This difference can be attributed to their distinct crystal structures, not only in crystal systems, but more important, how the CoO6 octahedra are connected. We successfully merge these two compounds together and map out the doping limits. We find out Ta and Nb dopants modify the properties of the parent compounds in subtle but different ways and construct a magnetic phase diagram of the Co(NbxTa1-x)2O6 (0 < x < 1) series. In addition, our results suggest that Ta-doping may pave a way to strengthen the lower-dimensional quantum phenomena in CoNb2O6 before its crystal structure starts to melt down.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究低维量子磁性材料 CoNb₂O₆ 与 CoTa₂O₆ 之间的固溶系列 Co(NbₓTa₁₋ₓ)₂O₆，并确定其掺杂范围。作者发现 Nb 与 Ta 掺杂会以细微但不同的方式改变母体化合物的性质，并构建了该系列的磁相图。结果还表明，在晶体结构失稳之前，Ta 掺杂可能有助于增强 CoNb₂O₆ 中的低维量子现象。
authors: Sirui Huang, Lun Jin, Yuchen Liu, Xiyu Chen, Leili Tan

articles.title: Ferromagnetic Order of Reduced Magnetic Moments in a Frustrated Sawtooth Chain of the Magnetic Semiconductor ZnYb₂S₄
articles.title_zh: 磁性半导体 ZnYb₂S₄ 锯齿链中约化磁矩的铁磁有序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14196v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In a sawtooth spin chain, competing nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor interactions suppress long-range order, yielding novel quantum states such as a spin-dimer singlet, 1/2 magnetization plateau, and spin contraction. Here, we investigate the magnetic properties of the orthorhombic semiconductor ZnYb₂S₄, in which Yb³⁺ ions with an effective spin-1/2 form a sawtooth chain along the b-axis. The specific heat exhibits a sharp peak at Tₘ̊ ₘ = 1.4 K, at which the magnetic entropy Sₘ̊ ₘ reaches only 27% of Rln2. This reduced Sₘ̊ ₘ at Tₘ̊ ₘ indicates the entropy release of the ground state doublet of Yb³⁺ even for T > Tₘ̊ ₘ. The isothermal magnetization M(B) at 0.28 K exhibits hysteresis for łeft|Bi̊ght| łeq 0.2 T and increases monotonically for B > 0.2 T. The spontaneous magnetization is only 0.1 it μₘ̊ B/Yb, an order of magnitude smaller than that expected for the ground state doublet of Yb³⁺. Moreover, in powder neutron diffraction measurements, no superlattice reflections due to antiferromagnetic order are observed for T < Tₘ̊ ₘ. Therefore, in the ground state, the Yb moments are ferromagnetically aligned, but their amplitude is reduced by magnetic frustration in the sawtooth Yb chain.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察正交晶系半导体 ZnYb₂S₄ 的磁性，其中有效自旋1/2的 Yb³⁺ 离子沿 b 轴形成锯齿链。比热在 1.4 K 出现尖峰，但对应磁熵仅为 Rln2 的 27%，说明在转变温度以上已存在显著熵释放；低温磁化显示小的自发磁矩且存在磁滞。粉末中子衍射未观察到反铁磁超晶格峰，因此作者认为基态中 Yb 磁矩呈铁磁排列，但磁矩幅值显著约化。
authors: Shinji Okada, Hiroto Suzuki, Nonoka Higa, Yasuyuki Shimura, Takanori Taniguchi, Takahiro Onimaru

articles.title: Spin mixing induced dynamics of spinor solitons in F=1 Bose Einstein condensates
articles.title_zh: F=1 玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中自旋混合诱导的自旋孤子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14231v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We explore soliton interactions in a homogeneous spinor F=1 Bose Einstein Condensate (BEC) in the presence of a magnetic field, focusing on dark bright dark and bright dark bright configurations. We investigate how these interactions depend on the phase differences among bright solitons and their influence during the dynamics. Our findings align with prior non spinor results, i.e., repulsion among in phase bright solitons and attraction among out of phase pairs in self repulsive atomic BECs. The potential bright soliton attraction, added to the short range repulsion of dark dark soliton interactions, can lead to bound states. However, we find that these bound states break in the presence of spinor interactions due to the particle exchange dynamics between the hyperfine states of the components. Additonally, we develop an effective classical model to describe the soliton dynamics, using a Lagrangian approach. The accuracy of the model is tested by comparing it against numerical simulations. Our results suggest that the proposed model captures the essential features of soliton behavior in the presence of spin interactions, and provides congruent soliton trajectories and interspecies particle exchange dynamics in most of the cases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在外磁场存在下，考察均匀 F=1 自旋玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的暗-亮-暗和亮-暗-亮孤子相互作用。结果显示，亮孤子之间的相位差显著影响动力学：同相亮孤子相互排斥，反相亮孤子相互吸引，并可能与暗孤子的短程排斥共同形成束缚态。自旋相互作用引起的超精细态粒子交换会破坏这些束缚态；作者还建立了基于拉格朗日方法的有效经典模型，并通过数值模拟验证其能捕捉主要动力学特征。
authors: T. Panagos, A. Romero-Ros, G. C. Katsimiga, P. Schmelcher, P. G. Kevrekidis

articles.title: p-wave magnet and hedgehog-type Berry curvature in helimagnetic MnAu₂
articles.title_zh: 螺旋磁体 MnAu₂ 中的 p 波磁性与刺猬型贝里曲率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14246v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently discovered altermagnetism in collinear compensated magnets shows even-parity spin texture in momentum space. Beyond the collinear spin ordering, unique odd-parity spin textures emerge in noncollinear compensated magnets. The noncollinear candidates, however, remain unexplored toward a room-temperature metallic altermagnet. Here, we demonstrate that MnAu2 exhibits metallic p-wave magnetism and large spin splitting induced by helical spin ordering. By adapting the band-unfolding scheme based on the translation operators combined with spin rotations, first-principles calculations reveal an unconventional Fermi surface around the tildeM-point composed of a single electron pocket with p-wave spin texture. Moreover, the spin twist in the helimagnet triggers topologically non-trivial hedgehog Berry curvature, which links to the nonlinear Hall effect and spin Hall effect. Considering the experimental T_C = 335 to 370 K, MnAu₂ could establish itself as an ideal candidate for a room-temperature metallic p-wave magnet, promising for versatile spintronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出 MnAu₂ 是一种由螺旋自旋序诱导的金属 p 波磁体，并具有显著自旋劈裂。基于结合自旋旋转的平移算符能带展开方法，第一性原理计算显示其在特定费米面附近具有带 p 波自旋纹理的单电子口袋。螺旋磁结构中的自旋扭转还诱导拓扑非平庸的刺猬型贝里曲率，可能关联非线性霍尔效应和自旋霍尔效应；结合其实验居里温度，MnAu₂ 被认为是室温金属 p 波磁体的有前景候选材料。
authors: Hogyun Jeong, Sangyun Lee, Junhee Shin, Jung-Woo Yoo, Changhee Sohn, Yoon Seok Oh, Hosub Jin

articles.title: Pronounced in-plane anomalous Hall effect with vanishing out-of-plane response in Cr1.2Te2
articles.title_zh: Cr1.2Te2 中显著的面内反常霍尔效应与消失的面外响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14272v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report an unconventional anomalous Hall regime in the van der Waals ferromagnet Cr1.2Te2, in which the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) is present for in-plane magnetization but absent for out-of-plane magnetization. In this purely in-plane regime, the anomalous Hall signal exhibits a threefold angular dependence during both in-plane and out-of-plane rotations of the magnetization, which cannot be accounted for by the conventional dipolar contribution but instead requires an octupolar contribution. Although the octupolar term qualitatively captures the observed behavior, the experimentally extracted octupole differs quantitatively from first-principles calculations based solely on the intrinsic Berry-curvature mechanism, indicating an essential role for extrinsic scattering processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道范德华铁磁体 Cr1.2Te2 中一种非常规反常霍尔 regime：当磁化位于面内时存在反常霍尔效应，而面外磁化时响应消失。在该纯面内 regime 中，反常霍尔信号随磁化方向的面内和面外旋转均呈三重角依赖，常规偶极贡献无法解释，需引入八极矩贡献。实验提取的八极矩与仅基于内禀贝里曲率机制的第一性原理计算存在定量差异，提示外禀散射过程具有重要作用。
authors: Wenzhi Peng, Zheng Liu, ShaSha Wang, Haolin Pan, Changlong Wang, Xiangbiao Shi, Jiahao Han, Qian Niu, Yang Gao, Bin Xiang, Dazhi Hou

articles.title: Mass-imbalanced two-dimensional Bose-Fermi mixtures with boson-fermion pairing
articles.title_zh: 具有玻色-费米配对的质量不平衡二维玻色-费米混合物
