articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation fails when retrieval surfaces weak evidence, when generation misuses adequate evidence, or both, but most abstention methods focus primarily on the generator. We propose UR-RAG, a deployment controller that fuses four runtime signals (retrieval decisiveness, semantic entropy, cluster agreement, and answer support) into one closed-form max-aggregation score, calibrates a shipping threshold against unconditional shipped risk Pr(fail ∧ ship) via a Hoeffding upper-confidence rule, and routes each query through a cheap-then-expensive cascade. Unlike learned-fusion baselines which train a separate parametric head, UR-RAG sets its four channel weights from the same proxy failure labels CRC already consumes and no extra correctness annotations are required. We compare UR-RAG to an 8-feature learned-fusion (LF) logistic baseline on the same signals and the same conformal threshold under a K=5 cross-fit over 13 cells where each cell is a unique combination of dataset, retriever, and cheap-to-expensive generator pair (datasets: TriviaQA, SQuAD, HotpotQA, NQ-open). Three empirical patterns are most relevant: (i) We find that a single cheap-tier weight vector transfers across all nine single-hop cells. Leave-one-cell-out auto-tuning produces the cheap-tier vector (0.25, 0.25, 0, 1.0) across all 9 single-hop cells, with zero weight on cluster-agreement throughout. (ii) The cost of avoiding an additional learned correctness head is small. Within-distribution transfer trails per-cell LF by an average of 0.79 percentage points (pp) in area under the curve (AUC) with a 95% confidence interval (CI) of [0.45, 1.16] pp. The pooled-fit LF performs nearly the same as per-cell LF, suggesting the gap reflects the cost of forgoing correctness supervision. (iii) The cascade ships ~80% of shipped answers from the cheap tier and uses ~62% of always-Tier-2 token cost, while every shipping decision is attributable to a single channel and the deployment artifact is a ~200-byte JSON per tier. UR-RAG complements rather than replaces learned fusion: it trades a small AUC margin for label-free weight selection, per-channel auditability at inference, and cross-cell weight transfer. The source code is available at: https://github.com/CMU-AGAI/urrag-hallucination-detection.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出UR-RAG部署控制器，用于在检索证据薄弱或生成模型误用证据时降低检索增强生成系统的输出风险。方法将检索决断性、语义熵、簇一致性和答案支持度四类运行时信号融合为闭式最大聚合评分，并利用Hoeffding上置信规则按无条件输出风险校准阈值。作者在多个问答数据集、检索器和生成器组合上与学习式融合基线比较，强调其无需额外正确性标注且可通过廉价到昂贵的级联路由实现部署控制。

articles.title: Edge spin galvanic effect in altermagnets

articles.abstract: Author(s): L. E. Golub The authors predict here an edge spin galvanic effect in d -wave altermagnets, where nonequilibrium spin polarization generates an electric current flowing along the sample edge. The effect originates from the interplay of altermagnetic spin splitting and edge scattering, is sensitive to edge orientation, and reverses upon reversal of the Néel vector. The work also proposes a pure spin edge photocurrent induced by polarized radiation, analyzes its frequency dependence, and demonstrates its conversion into an electric current by an external magnetic field. [Phys. Rev. B 113, L220404] Published Thu Jun 11, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作预测了d波交替磁体中的边缘自旋伽伐尼效应，即非平衡自旋极化可在样品边缘诱导沿边电流。该效应源于交替磁自旋劈裂与边缘散射的耦合，对边缘取向敏感，并会随 Néel 矢量反转而反向。文章还提出由偏振辐射诱导的纯自旋边缘光电流，分析其频率依赖，并展示其可在外磁场作用下转化为电流。

articles.title: Toward a temperature-insensitive composite diamond clock
articles.title_zh: 迈向温度不敏感的复合金刚石钟
articles.abstract: Author(s): Sean Lourette, Andrey Jarmola, Jabir Chathanathil, Victor M. Acosta, A. Glen Birdwell, Peter Blümler, Dmitry Budker, Sebastián C. Carrasco, Tony G. Ivanov, Shimon Kolkowitz, and Vladimir S. Malinovsky Although a solid-state frequency reference based on nitrogen-vacancy (N- V ) centers in diamond is attractive for compact, multifunctional timekeeping and sensing, their strong lattice coupling produces temperature sensitivity that has precluded a stable clock. This study uses the electron’s zero-field splitting and the nitrogen’s nuclear quadrupole splitting in a composite frequency reference that cancels first-order temperature dependence, reducing thermal drift by more than an order of magnitude. The results establish a practical route toward robust, chip-scale diamond clocks that simultaneously support magnetic, electric, thermal, and inertial sensing in a single integrated platform. [Phys. Rev. Applied 25, 064046] Published Thu Jun 11, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向基于金刚石氮-空位中心的固态频率参考，其小型化和多功能传感潜力长期受限于强晶格耦合导致的温度敏感性。作者将电子零场分裂与氮核四极分裂组合为复合频率参考，以抵消一阶温度依赖，使热漂移降低一个数量级以上。结果为稳健的芯片级金刚石钟提供了实践路径，并有望在同一集成平台上支持磁、电、热和惯性传感。

articles.abstract: Author(s): Jan Biedermann and Lukas Janssen Quantum criticality involving Dirac fermions has long been studied theoretically but has remained difficult to access experimentally. articles.title: Semi-universal solution of the Thomas–Fermi equation for neutral jellium spheres
articles.title_zh: 中性均匀正电背景球的 Thomas–Fermi 方程半普适解
articles.abstract: The Thomas–Fermi model of electronic structures provides a universal solution for neutral atoms. As a result, the energy of a neutral atom with nuclear charge Z is given as −0.7687 Z 7/3 . Are there other systems where such universal solutions can be found? In this work, we look for an answer to this question and discover that for neutral jellium spheres, a semi-universal solution of the Thomas–Fermi equation exists; one parameter, f = N 2/3 r s , determines the properties of many neutral jellium spheres with different numbers of electrons ( N ) and bulk density parameters ( r s ). This parameter is connected to an earlier approximate analytical solution given in the context of simple metal clusters. The Thomas–Fermi energy of a neutral jellium sphere is found to be a simple function of f and N , of a form similar to that for atoms. Additional examples of semi-universal solutions are given by generalizing our method to other potentials. The present work, therefore, provides a motivation to explore whether such universal forms can be found in more accurate orbital-free density functional theories.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作探讨除中性原子外是否还存在 Thomas–Fermi 电子结构模型的普适或半普适解。作者发现，对于中性 jellium 球，参数 f = N⁽²/3) rₛ 可在很大程度上决定不同电子数和体密度参数体系的性质，并给出类似原子情形的能量标度形式。研究还将方法推广到其他势能形式，为在更精确的无轨道密度泛函理论中寻找普适结构提供了动机。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Relativistic strengthening of hydrogen bonds in bihalide anions: A four-component CCSD(T) study
articles.title_zh: 双卤化物阴离子中氢键的相对论性增强：四分量 CCSD(T) 研究
articles.abstract: In this study, we systematically investigate relativistic effects in bihalide anions [XHX] − (X = F, Cl, Br, I) using four-component coupled-cluster calculations based on the Dirac–Coulomb Hamiltonian at the CCSD(T) level. Relativistic contributions are quantified by comparing results obtained with the four-component Dirac–Coulomb and Lévy–Leblond Hamiltonians, both combined with a Gaussian nuclear charge distribution model. Relativistic effects are intrinsic to molecular systems and can, in principle, modify hydrogen-bond strengths alongside solvation, nuclear quantum effects, and nuclear dynamics. We identify two distinct regimes of relativistic behavior for bihalide anions with light (F, Cl) and heavy (Br, I) halogen nuclei. Relativistic effects lead to a measurable enhancement of hydrogen bonding as reflected in rovibrational constants (vibrational frequencies and rotational constants), equilibrium geometries, thermodynamic parameters, and the electron-density distribution, in contrast to the known trend of relativistic weakening of covalent bonding in the neutral hydrogen halides HX (X = F, Cl, Br, I). The maximum relativistic strengthening of the hydrogen bond is about 0.6–0.7 kcal/mol, while the relativistic localization of electron density in the internuclear region amounts to ∼0.1%–3.0%.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用基于 Dirac–Coulomb 哈密顿量的四分量 CCSD(T) 计算，系统考察 [XHX]⁻（X = F、Cl、Br、I）双卤化物阴离子中的相对论效应。通过与 Lévy–Leblond 哈密顿量结果比较，作者发现轻、重卤素体系呈现不同的相对论行为，且相对论效应会增强氢键强度，体现在振转常数、平衡几何、热力学参数和电子密度分布等方面。这一趋势不同于中性氢卤化物 HX 中已知的相对论性共价键削弱。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Understanding the sign problem from an exact path integral Monte Carlo model of interacting harmonic fermions
articles.title_zh: 从相互作用谐振费米子的精确路径积分蒙特卡罗模型理解符号问题
articles.abstract: This work shows that the recently discovered operator contraction identity for solving the discrete path integral of the harmonic oscillator can be applied equally to fermions in any dimension. This then yields an exactly solvable model for studying the sign problem where the path integral Monte Carlo energy at any time step for any number of fermions is known analytically or can be computed numerically. It is found that the sign problem is primarily a property of the free fermion propagator, but repulsive/attractive pairwise interactions can shift the sign problem to larger/smaller imaginary time but do not make it more severe than the non-interacting case. More surprisingly, one can prove analytically that the first closed-shell state in D dimension, with n = D + 1 fermions, has no sign problem at large imaginary time. Direct numerical simulations confirm that this is also true for higher closed-shell states in two and three dimensions. Fourth-order and newly found variable-bead algorithms are used to compute ground state energies of quantum dots with up to 110 electrons and are compared to results obtained by modern neural networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作将用于求解谐振子离散路径积分的算符收缩恒等式推广到任意维度的费米子体系，从而构建了一个可精确求解的符号问题研究模型。结果表明，符号问题主要源于自由费米子传播子，而排斥或吸引的成对相互作用会将符号问题推向更大或更小的虚时间，但不会比无相互作用情形更严重。作者还发现并数值验证了某些闭壳层态在大虚时间下不存在符号问题，并将高阶及可变 bead 算法用于多电子量子点基态能计算。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: On Teleparallel Gravitational Description ofMagnetic Black String and Singularity Analysis
articles.title_zh: 磁性黑弦的远平行引力描述与奇点分析
articles.abstract: The problems concerning a magnetic black string in non-vacuum spacetime with cylindrical symmetry in the framework of TEGR have been investigated. We have derived the field equations for the magnetic black string with cylindrical spacetime symmetry. Furthermore, we have solved the field equations for vacuum as well as non-vacuum case. In analysing the singularities, we have involved some scalars, namely some scalars obtained from torsion tensor field and the scalar  •Q_K derived from the contortion of the Weitzenb¨ock connection, which is in fact equal to the Kretschmann scalar of the Levi-Civita connection.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本在等效广义相对论的远平行引力框架下，研究具有柱对称性的非真空时空中的磁性黑弦问题。作者推导了相应场方程，并分别求解真空与非真空情形；在奇点分析中，引入由挠率张量场得到的若干标量以及由 Weitzenböck 连接挠曲张量导出的标量，该标量与 Levi-Civita 连接的 Kretschmann 标量等价。

articles.title: Physics-guided surrogate learning enables zero-shot control of turbulent wings
articles.title_zh: 物理引导的代理学习实现湍流机翼零样本控制
articles.abstract: Turbulent boundary layers over aerodynamic surfaces are a major source of aircraft drag, yet their control remains challenging due to multiscale dynamics and spatial variability, particularly under adverse pressure gradients. Reinforcement learning has outperformed state-of-the-art strategies in canonical flows, but its application to realistic geometries is limited by computational cost and transferability. Here we show that these limitations can be overcome by exploiting local structures of wall-bounded turbulence. Policies are trained in turbulent channel flows matched to wing boundary-layer statistics and deployed directly onto a NACA4412 wing at Rec=2×105 without further training, being the so-called zero-shot control. This achieves a 28.7% reduction in skin-friction drag and a 10.7% reduction in total drag, outperforming the state-of-the-art opposition control by 40% in friction drag reduction and 5% in total drag. Training cost is reduced by four orders of magnitude relative to on-wing training, enabling scalable flow control.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本提出利用壁湍流局部结构训练控制策略，以降低真实翼型湍流边界层控制的计算成本与迁移困难。策略在与机翼边界层统计特征匹配的湍流通道流中训练，并无需再训练直接部署到 Re_c = 2×10⁵ 的 NACA4412 机翼上，实现了显著的摩擦阻力和总阻力降低。相比机翼上直接训练，该方法将训练成本降低多个数量级，并优于传统 opposition control。

articles.title: A magneto-convective origin for solar-wind Alfvénic fluctuations
articles.title_zh: 太阳风阿尔芬涨落的磁对流起源
articles.abstract: The solar wind is a highly structured and supersonic plasma outflow that originates in the Sun’s outer atmosphere [1,2]. The energy source driving the wind is still subject to intense debate. While recent observations point to magnetic reconnection as a primary driver [3-5], Alfvénic waves are often invoked as a key contributor [6,7]. However, a direct observational link between wave activity in the low solar atmosphere and the young solar wind has remained elusive. Here we show that magneto-convection on the solar surface drives Alfvénic fluctuations in the solar wind. Using observations from the Daniel K. Inouye Solar Telescope [8], Solar Dynamics Observatory [9], and Parker Solar Probe [10], we find that the energy density of fluctuations in the inner corona and young solar wind peak in the same frequency range, establishing a direct connection between the two populations. This frequency range matches timescales of Alfvénic fluctuations driven by surface convection that survive transmission into the low corona. Our results demonstrate that Alfvénic waves excited by the magneto-convection provide a basal energy flux, which indicates that the solar wind is driven by a multi-component mechanism.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本利用 Daniel K. Inouye Solar Telescope、Solar Dynamics Observatory 和 Parker Solar Probe 的观测，探讨太阳表面磁对流与年轻太阳风中阿尔芬涨落之间的联系。作者发现内日冕和年轻太阳风中的涨落能量密度在相同频率范围内达到峰值，该频率范围与由太阳表面对流激发并能传入低日冕的阿尔芬涨落时间尺度相符。结果表明，磁对流激发的阿尔芬波可提供基础能量通量，支持太阳风由多成分机制驱动的图景。

articles.title: Quaternion wavefunction derivation of the Newton-regime sphere drag coefficient from SU(2) representation theory
articles.title_zh: 基于 SU(2) 表示论的四元数波函数推导牛顿区球体阻力系数
articles.abstract: A quaternion wavefunction formulation of the incompressible Euler equations is developed in which the velocity field is encoded as a pure quaternion Q = v ・ σ transforming as spin-1 under the adjoint representation of SU(2). While the encoding of a three-dimensional velocity field as a pure quaternion is a known algebraic construction, the present work introduces a quaternion wavefunction Ψ whose logarithmic quaternion gradient yields incompressibility as a Cauchy–Riemann–Fueter condition restricted to the real part alone, leaving the vorticity entirely unconstrained. This partial holomorphicity condition, applied to ln Ψ rather than to v directly, reduces the four Euler equations to a single constrained Gross–Pitaevskii equation and provides a geometric selection principle for physically realised incompressible flows, resolving D’Alembert’s 270-year-old paradox: the paradox arises because classical potential flow incorrectly assumes that all velocity-field interaction energy couples to pressure; the representation-theoretic analysis shows that only 4/9 does. The principal analytical result is a zero-parameter derivation of the Newton-regime sphere drag coefficient. The convective nonlinearity couples spin- 1⊗spin-1, which decomposes via the Clebsch–Gordan series as 0⊕1⊕2 with dimensions 1 + 3 + 5 = 9. The j = 0 sector corresponds to the kinetic energy density |v|2 of the convective nonlinearity, not to the divergence of v, and carries nonzero energy in any incompressible flow. Because pressure is a rotational scalar, the Wigner–Eckart theorem restricts the local algebraic coupling of the pressure gradient to the j ≤ 1 subspace of the momentum equation; the j = 2 strain modes contribute to the global pressure field through the Poisson equation but their contribution to the fore-aft drag integral vanishes under the isotropic wake symmetry of the sphere. In the Newton regime (103 < Re < 105) the strongly turbulent separated wake of the sphere drives an effectively isotropic distribution of energy across the nine interaction modes, so the fraction coupling to net drag equals the dimension ratio (1 + 3)/9 = 4/9. This yields CD,∞ = 4/9 ≈ 0.444 with zero adjustable parameters, in 1% agreement with Achenbach’s measurements. Two further results are reported. The formulation recovers the classical Stokes–Oseen law CD = (24/Re)(1 + 3Re/16) through quaternion perturbation theory with no fitting, providing an independent validation at low Reynolds number. A topological criterion for vortex shedding onset yields Rec = (2π/αtopo)2/3, where the single geometric prefactor αtopo ≈ 1.42×10−3 is determined from the experimental value ReCexp = 270 ± 5; this establishes 2 topological consistency rather than a zero-parameter prediction. Viscous skin friction is computed explicitly and contributes CDvisc = 48/Re in the Newton regime. Comprehensive validation against experimental data spanning Re = 0.1 to 5 × 103 yields R2 = 0.9996 and mean absolute error 5.8%. The transition regime 1 < Re < 100 is not yet resolved analytically within the framework; a Schiller–Naumann benchmark is included there for completeness only.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本发展了一种不可压 Euler 方程的四元数波函数表述，将速度场编码为在 SU(2) 伴随表示下按自旋 1 变换的纯四元数。作者提出对波函数对数施加部分 Cauchy–Riemann–Fueter 型条件，使不可压缩性仅约束实部而不直接约束涡量，并声称可将 Euler 方程化为受约束的 Gross–Pitaevskii 方程。基于这一表示论框架，论文进一步声称给出了牛顿区球体阻力系数的无参数推导，并用以解释达朗贝尔佯谬。

articles.title: Optically Programmable Magnetic Bipole Based on Coupled Quantum Dots for THz Bright-Dark Mode Control
articles.title_zh: 基于耦合量子点的光学可编程磁偶极子用于太赫兹明暗模控制
articles.abstract: This work presents a theoretical model of twomagnetically coupled quantum dots treated as an artificialmagnetic bipole. The system dynamics are governed by theGorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad (GKSL) master equa-tion, which provides a first-principles treatment of coherencedecay, magnetic relaxation, and pure dephasing beyond a singlephenomenological T2. The THz magnetic response is derivedfrom the linear susceptibility obtained by solving the Blochequations for the collective bright and dark mode coherences ofthe density matrix. A microscopic decomposition of the effectivecoupling is employed, combining magnetic near-field, excitonichybridization, and spin–orbit contributions. The results, obtainedfrom the density-matrix equations of motion, show that a shortoff-resonant optical pulse can switch the double quantum-dotsystem between constructive and destructive magnetic interfer-ence regimes via an optically induced differential AC Starkshift. This framework provides a physically grounded theoreticalplatform for studying optically controlled THz response incoupled quantum-dot systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出了一个将两个磁耦合量子点视为人工磁偶极子的理论模型，并用GKSL主方程描述相干衰减、磁弛豫和纯退相干。作者通过密度矩阵布洛赫方程求解集体亮模与暗模相干性，推导太赫兹磁响应及线性磁化率。结果表明，短的非共振光脉冲可通过差分AC斯塔克位移在相长与相消磁干涉之间切换，为光控耦合量子点太赫兹响应研究提供了理论框架。

articles.title: Development of a self-reporting electrochemical sensor utilizing CoNiFe-PBA for detection of BPA in food Samples
articles.title_zh: 利用CoNiFe普鲁士蓝类似物构建自报告电化学传感器检测食品样品中的双酚A
articles.abstract: Bisphenol A (BPA), a widely used endocrine-disrupting chemical, poses significant health risks due to its potential to migrate from food packaging into food products. In this study, we developed a self-reporting electrochemical sensor based on molecular imprinting technology for the detection of BPA in food samples. The sensor was constructed through sequential modification of the electrode with reduced graphene oxide (RGO) and CoNiFe Prussian blue analogue (CoNiFe-PBA). The resulting configuration exhibited a self-reporting signal at ~ 0.47 V (vs. Ag/AgCl), arising from the synergistic redox interplay of the multi-metal centers in CoNiFe-PBA. The MIP film was synthesized via electropolymerization, employing BPA as the template and o-phenylenediamine (o-PD) as the functional monomer. Under optimal conditions, the sensor demonstrated a wide linear detection range (0.5–500 nM) and a low detection limit (0.19 nM). Owing to its high selectivity, sensitivity, and accuracy, the sensor offers a reliable approach for precise quantification of trace BPA in complex food matrices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究开发了一种基于分子印迹技术的自报告电化学传感器，用于检测食品样品中的双酚A。传感器通过在电极上依次修饰还原氧化石墨烯和CoNiFe普鲁士蓝类似物构建，并利用多金属中心的协同氧化还原作用产生约0.47 V的自报告信号。在优化条件下，该传感器具有0.5–500 nM的线性范围和0.19 nM的低检出限，可用于复杂食品基质中痕量双酚A的高选择性、高灵敏检测。

articles.title: Physics-Guided Transformer Framework for Real-Time Voltage Stability Margin Prediction under Renewable Uncertainty
articles.title_zh: 面向可再生能源不确定性的实时电压稳定裕度预测物理引导Transformer框架
articles.abstract: This paper proposes a Physics-Guided Transformer (PG-Transformer) framework that integrates physical knowledge of power systems with advanced deep learning architectures for accurate and uncertainty-aware VSM prediction. Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) data collected from benchmark IEEE 39-bus and IEEE 118-bus systems are preprocessed using denoising, normalization, and windowing techniques to form a multivariate time-series dataset. Classical stability indices—L-index, Thevenin Equivalent Ratio, and PV Margin are embedded into the learning pipeline to guide the model toward physically consistent feature representations. To address severe class imbalance, a Conditional Wasserstein GAN with Gradient Penalty (CWGAN-GP) is employed to generate synthetic unstable samples while maintaining physical validity. The proposed PG-Transformer employs multi-head self-attention for spatio-temporal correlation learning and Monte Carlo Dropout for uncertainty quantification. Experimental results show that the model achieves an RMSE of 0.0378, R² of 0.973, accuracy of 96.8%, F1-score of 0.94, and AUC of 0.987, outperforming state-of the art baselines such as Random Forest, CNN-LSTM, and Physics-Guided LSTM models. Ablation studies confirm the complementary benefits of physics-guided features, GAN-based resampling, and uncertainty modeling, collectively improving accuracy by 6.6%. The framework operates with an average inference latency of 1.75 ms/sample, validating its suitability for real-time voltage stability monitoring in renewable-rich smart grids.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出一种物理引导Transformer框架，将电力系统物理知识与深度学习结合，用于准确且具备不确定性表征的电压稳定裕度预测。研究利用IEEE 39节点和118节点系统的PMU数据，并将L指数、戴维南等效比和PV裕度等经典稳定指标嵌入学习流程，同时通过CWGAN-GP生成物理合理的不稳定样本以缓解类别不平衡。实验结果显示，该模型在误差、拟合优度、准确率、F1分数和AUC等指标上优于随机森林、CNN-LSTM等基线方法。

articles.title: Arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi reshape rhizosphere microbial communities to alleviate phosphorus deficiency in soda-saline soils
articles.title_zh: 丛枝菌根真菌重塑根际微生物群落以缓解苏打盐碱土中的磷缺乏
articles.abstract: Microbial activity and P availability are severely limited in soda saline-alkali soils, restricting plant growth. Although arbuscular mycorrhizal (AM) fungi enhance P uptake, how they modulate rhizosphere microbes to improve P availability there remains unclear. Here, we combined a microcosm experiment with metagenomic sequencing and partial least squares path modeling to examine how inoculation with Rhizophagus intraradices affected rhizosphere properties, P fractions, phosphatase activities, microbial community composition, and growth of Elaeagnus angustifolia under soda saline‑alkali stress. AM inoculation markedly promoted plant growth and root development, improved soil physicochemical conditions, and stimulated both alkaline and acid phosphatase activities via a coordinated “stress alleviation—community reassembly—network optimization—accelerated turnover” pathway. Specifically, AM fungi restructured the rhizosphere microbiome by enriching phosphate‑solubilizing taxa, mainly Actinobacteria (Streptomyces) and Proteobacteria (Pseudoxanthomonas, Sphingomonas), thereby intensifying organic P mineralization and shifting the system from static P‑pool maintenance to rapid P flux. These results demonstrate that AM fungi collaborate with functional microbial guilds to create a dynamic P‑turnover system that alleviates P limitation by promoting root proliferation, expanding absorptive surfaces, modifying the rhizosphere microenvironment, and regulating phosphate‑solubilizing bacterial communities. This study provides a theoretical basis for sustainable management of soda saline‑alkali soils.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合微宇宙实验、宏基因组测序和偏最小二乘路径模型，考察接种根内根孢囊霉对苏打盐碱胁迫下沙枣根际性质、磷形态、磷酸酶活性、微生物群落和植物生长的影响。结果表明，丛枝菌根真菌显著促进植物生长和根系发育，改善土壤理化条件，并通过“胁迫缓解—群落重组—网络优化—周转加速”途径提升酸性和碱性磷酸酶活性。其作用机制包括富集链霉菌、假黄单胞菌和鞘氨醇单胞菌等解磷类群，强化有机磷矿化并推动磷库向更快速的磷通量转变。

articles.title: Observation of Parametric Resonance Phenomenon in a Cold Cesium Atoms
articles.title_zh: 冷铯原子中参量共振现象的观测
articles.abstract: We report the first observation of motional excitation induced by parametric resonance of cold ¹³³Cs atoms in a dual-species magneto-optical trap (MOT) simultaneously trapping 133Cs and 85Rb atoms. By modulating the cooling laser’s intensity at approximately twice the resonant frequency of the trap, the atoms inside the trap separate into two atomic clouds, oscillating with a π phase difference due to the trap potential’s nonlinearity, resulting in a finite oscillation length. This behavior reflects general nonlinear dynamics and is described as a Hopf bifurcation or limit cycle motion. The measured oscillation amplitude was compared with theoretical calculations derived from simple Doppler cooling theory, changing modulation amplitude, magnetic field gradient, and saturation parameter. In addition, we investigate the noise-induced switching dynamics by measuring the temporal evolution of atomic populations localized in each of the two attractors under resonant symmetry lifting induced by an effective bias field. Notably, this dual-species MOT system is expected to provide a new platform for studying nonlinear and nonequilibrium dynamics between cold rubidium and cesium atomic ensembles. PACS numbers: 37.10.Vz, 37.10.De, 37.10.Gh
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了在同时俘获133Cs和85Rb的双组分磁光阱中，首次观测到由冷133Cs原子参量共振诱导的运动激发。通过以约两倍阱共振频率调制冷却激光强度，阱中原子分裂为两个相位差为π的原子云，体现出非线性阱势导致的有限振幅振荡，可用Hopf分岔或极限环运动描述。作者还比较了振荡振幅与多普勒冷却理论预测，并研究了有效偏置场下两个吸引子之间的噪声诱导切换动力学。

articles.title: Phase-selective Floquet engineering in a charge density wave material
articles.title_zh: 电荷密度波材料中的相位选择性Floquet工程
articles.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 24, June 2026. SignificanceFloquet engineering provides an emerging approach to tailor quantum materials using time-periodic drives. Here, we demonstrate Floquet engineering of TiSe2which is enabled by the spatially periodic charge density wave (CDW) transition. We ...
articles.abstract_zh: 该PNAS论文围绕利用时间周期性驱动调控量子材料的Floquet工程展开，研究对象为具有空间周期性电荷密度波转变的TiSe2。摘要信息较为有限，但其核心是展示电荷密度波相位如何为Floquet调控提供选择性通道。具体实验配置、观测结果和物理机制需结合原文进一步确认。

articles.title: Universal critical behavior in ideal Bose-Einstein condensation
articles.title_zh: 理想玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚中的普适临界行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11338v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ideal Bose-Einstein condensation (BEC) remains a paradigmatic example of a continuous phase transition and a cornerstone for understanding quantum degenerate bosonic matter. We demonstrate that critical behavior of the ideal Bose gas near the BEC phase transition falls into three distinct classes, determined exclusively by the low-energy scaling of the density of states. Depending on its scaling exponent, which is controlled by dimensionality and confinement, the transition displays either the usual algebraic divergences of thermodynamic susceptibilities, divergent behavior with marginal logarithmic corrections, or a more subtle form of criticality, where only the correlation length diverges. Our work provides a unified framework for criticality in noninteracting bosonic systems. This classification applies broadly to atomic, photonic, polaritonic, and magnonic condensates, where dimensionality, confinement, and spectral engineering can strongly reshape the density of states.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，理想玻色气体在玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚相变附近的临界行为可依据低能态密度的标度分为三类。不同标度指数由维度和束缚条件决定，对应普通代数发散、带边缘对数修正的发散，以及仅相关长度发散的更隐蔽临界性。该分类为非相互作用玻色体系的临界行为提供了统一框架，并适用于原子、光子、极化激元和磁振子凝聚等系统。
authors: Arturo Camacho-Guardian, Leon Kleebank, Frank Vewinger, Martin Weitz, Julian Schmitt, Rosario Paredes, Victor Romero-Rochín

articles.title: Compressed minimum-purity time evolution for late-time quantum dynamics
articles.title_zh: 用于长时间量子动力学的压缩最小纯度时间演化方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11392v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unitary time evolution of initially simple quantum many-body states rapidly generates entanglement and complex correlations, which limits direct numerical simulations. The late-time dynamics of physical observables, however, typically exhibits an effective simplicity in the form of hydrodynamics or kinetic theory. This leads to the question whether microscopic equations of motion can remain accurate and tractable up to long time scales by discarding irrelevant information in a controlled manner. Here, we introduce compressed minimum-purity time evolution (CoMPuTE) as an approach to keep track of a consistent set of reduced local density matrices, closing the hierarchical equations of motion using a minimum-purity principle. In benchmark applications we demonstrate (i) accurate description of energy diffusion in the one-dimensional mixed-field Ising model, (ii) the applicability to genuinely out-of-equilibrium Floquet dynamics starting from a pure state, and (iii) the limitations of the local reduced density matrix approximation when describing transport in the XXZ chain at Δ=1 that is governed by increasingly non-local integrals of motion. The CoMPuTE method enhances computational efficiency in comparison to the closely related local-information time evolution algorithm, opening a possible route towards an extension to systems in higher spatial dimensions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出压缩最小纯度时间演化方法，用于在舍弃无关信息的同时跟踪一组一致的局域约化密度矩阵，并以最小纯度原则闭合层级运动方程。基准测试显示，该方法能够准确描述一维混合场Ising模型中的能量扩散，也可用于从纯态出发的非平衡Floquet动力学。研究同时指出，当输运由逐渐非局域的守恒量控制时，如Δ=1的XXZ链，局域约化密度矩阵近似存在局限。
authors: Moksh Bhateja, Jonas B. Rigo, Markus Schmitt

articles.title: Topological Phase Transition in Mechanical Honeycomb Lattice
articles.title_zh: 机械蜂窝晶格中的拓扑相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11427v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological materials provide a new tool to direct wave energy with unprecedented precision and robustness. Three elastic topological phases, the valley Hall, Chern and spin Hall insulators, are currently studied, and they are achieved separately in rather distinct configurations. Here, we explore analytically various topological phase transitions for in-plane elastic wave in a unified mass-spring honeycomb lattice. It is demonstrated that the three elastic topological phases can be realized in this single lattice by designing mass, stiffness or introducing Coriolis' effect. In particular, the interface between valley Hall and Chern insulators is found to support topological interface mode for the first time. Perturbation method is used to derive the analytic effective continuum model in the neighbor of band degeneracy, and the physics in topological phase transitions are revealed through evaluation of topological invariants. The topologically protected interface states, their decaying profile as well as the pseudo-spin-indicating polarization specific for elastic wave are systematically analyzed, and these results are further confirmed numerically by Bloch wave analysis of domain wall strip and transient simulation of finite sized sample. This study offers a concise and unified analytical model to explore topology nature of elastic wave, and can provide intuitive guidance to design of continuum mechanical topological materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在统一的质量–弹簧蜂窝晶格模型中解析考察面内弹性波的多种拓扑相变。作者证明，通过设计质量、刚度或引入科里奥利效应，可在同一晶格中实现谷霍尔、陈绝缘体和自旋霍尔三类弹性拓扑相。研究还首次指出谷霍尔绝缘体与陈绝缘体界面可支持拓扑界面模，并通过有效连续模型、拓扑不变量和数值分析揭示其界面态衰减与弹性波伪自旋极化特征。
authors: Yi Chen, Xiaoning Liu, Gengkai Hu

articles.title: Superconductivity near quarter- and half-filling of a strongly correlated triangular Hubbard band in twisted trilayer WSe2
articles.title_zh: 扭转三层WSe2中强关联三角Hubbard能带在四分之一和半填充附近的超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11495v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The triangular-lattice Hubbard model is one of the paradigmatic settings for studying correlated electronic systems with geometric frustration that can give rise to a variety of phases. Recently, twisted bilayer TMD systems have emerged as attractive experimental platforms for realising such a model in the moderate-correlation regime. Alternating twisted trilayer TMD systems are expected to realise stronger correlations than bilayer systems owing to their mirror symmetry. Here we report the discovery of superconductivity near quarter- and half-filling, together with various correlated phases, in alternating twisted trilayer WSe2 (TTWSe2). At half filling, a robust correlated insulating state persists over a broad range of displacement fields, signalling the strongly correlated regime. Upon doping, superconductivity emerges over an extended region of the phase diagram. Near quarter filling, another superconducting state appears flanked by correlated metals. Our results establish the TTWSe2 system as a compelling platform for studying strongly correlated triangular-lattice Hubbard physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了交替扭转三层WSe2中在四分之一填充和半填充附近出现的超导性以及多种关联相。由于镜面对称性，交替扭转三层过渡金属二硫族化物有望比双层体系实现更强的关联效应；实验中半填充处的强关联绝缘态在宽位移场范围内保持稳定。掺杂后，体系在相图较大区域出现超导性，并在四分之一填充附近观察到由关联金属相夹持的另一超导态，表明该体系是研究强关联三角晶格Hubbard物理的有力平台。
authors: Yungi Jeong, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Joonho Jang

articles.title: Invariants of Sequential Circuits and Generalized Non-Abelian Statistics
articles.title_zh: 序贯电路不变量与广义非阿贝尔统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11527v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-invertible symmetries in quantum many-body systems generally give rise to sequential unitary circuits that move symmetry defects. In this paper, we investigate invariants defined by sequences of such circuits, which move non-invertible defects and generate a Berry phase evaluated on quantum states with defects. We show that this Berry phase generally defines an invariant under local deformations, provided that the sequential circuits preserve the locality of those deformations. This invariant also rules out a short-range-entangled state that preserves the non-invertible symmetry, thereby signaling the 't Hooft anomaly of a non-invertible symmetry purely in terms of unitary operators acting on a state. We then apply this framework to loop excitations in three spatial dimensions and identify a new loop excitation in the (3+1)D D₄ topological order, which we dub a non-Abelian fermionic loop. Using the invariant of sequential circuits, we characterize the statistics of non-Abelian fermionic loops. In addition, we find a new (3+1)D mixed topological order with a single non-Abelian fermionic loop, whose long-range entanglement is protected by an invariant of sequential circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文研究由非可逆对称性诱导的序贯幺正电路不变量，这类电路可移动对称缺陷，并在含缺陷量子态上生成Berry相。作者证明，只要序贯电路保持局域形变的局域性，该Berry相可定义局域形变下的不变量，并可排除保持非可逆对称性的短程纠缠态，从而以作用于态的幺正算符表征非可逆对称性的't Hooft异常。研究还将该框架用于三维空间中的环激发，识别并刻画了(3+1)维D4拓扑序中的一种新的非阿贝尔费米环及相关混合拓扑序。
authors: Shintaro Sato, Yoshimasa Hidaka, Ryohei Kobayashi

articles.title: Intrinsic Nonreciprocity in Electron-Phonon Interaction Driven Thermoelectric Diodes
articles.title_zh: 电子–声子相互作用驱动热电二极管中的内禀非互易性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11904v2 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study an electron-phonon interaction driven thermoelectric diode. The nonreciprocity in this diode arises from the asymmetry between the probabilities of phonon emission and absorption in the electron-phonon interaction, as well as the structural reflection asymmetry. We reveal the intrinsic nature of this nonreciprocity, as the forward and backward electron transport remains asymmetric even when the applied temperature difference is not reversed. This intrinsic nonreciprocity gives rise to two novel transport phenomena. One is a novel thermoelectric effect which is driven by the temperature difference between the leads and the central device region, rather than the conventional temperature difference between the two leads. The second, and more significant, phenomenon is the suppression of electronic backscattering in the load resistor. This suppression decreases the resistance of the load resistor, which leads to the breakdown of Ohm's addition law. Under suitable conditions, the presence of electron-phonon interaction can yield a larger thermoelectric current compared to the case without it. This intrinsic nonreciprocity opens up a new pathway for low-power electronics besides topology and superconductivity, and for nonreciprocal thermoelectric devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察一种由电子–声子相互作用驱动的热电二极管，其非互易性源于声子发射与吸收概率的不对称以及结构反射不对称。作者指出这种非互易性具有内禀性质，即使不反转外加温差，正向与反向电子输运仍保持不对称。由此产生两种新输运现象：由引线与中心器件区域之间温差驱动的热电效应，以及负载电阻中电子背散射受抑导致电阻降低和欧姆加法定律失效；在适当条件下，电子–声子相互作用还可增强热电电流。
authors: Hao-Kun Ke, Lie-Run Tian, Pei-Hao Fu, Jun-Feng Liu, Jun Wang, H. Xu

articles.title: Estimation of conserved charges for a one dimensional system with inhomogeneous hopping
articles.title_zh: 非均匀跃迁一维系统中守恒荷的估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11991v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum integrability in a system is characterized by a large number of conserved charges. However, finding the conserved charges in a generic quantum system is highly challenging. The integrable matrix theory provides a unified framework to obtain the conserved charges in a certain class of systems. We demonstrate this framework in case of a single-particle system on a 1D finite-sized lattice with inhomogeneous nearest neighbor hopping to study the statistical properties of the system across its chaotic--integrable crossover from the perspective of the conserved charges. The eigenspectrum of our random matrix model is studied first. We then estimate the conserved charges and find their properties throughout the chaotic to integrable transition of the system. We calculate the number of conserved charges across this crossover and observe that it is nearly equal to the size of the system at its integrable limit. Our result suggests that the number of conserved charges, estimated using the integrable matrix theory, can be a measure of quantum integrability.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子可积性通常由大量守恒荷表征，但在一般量子系统中寻找这些守恒量十分困难。该工作利用可积矩阵理论，研究具有非均匀最近邻跃迁的一维有限尺寸单粒子晶格模型，并从守恒荷角度考察其从混沌到可积的交叉行为。作者先分析随机矩阵模型的本征谱，再估计交叉过程中的守恒荷及其性质，发现可积极限下守恒荷数量接近系统尺寸。结果表明，基于可积矩阵理论估计的守恒荷数量可作为量子可积性的度量。

articles.title: From Topological Order to Mixed-State Phases: A Ground-State Probe of Fractionalized Excitations
articles.title_zh: 从拓扑序到混合态相：分数化激发的基态探针
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12132v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: How do we detect topological phases from a single ground state? Entanglement entropy and spectrum have long been the standard tools -- but the reduced density matrix (RDM) itself contains far more information. We show that the RDM of a 2D topologically ordered system, expressed at the entanglement cut, realizes a 1D mixed-state phase. For the Z₂ toric code phase, it is a 1D Z₂ strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SW-SSB) phase, where deconfinement of anyons manifests as the short-range correlation of both Z₂ charge and Z₂ domain-wall in the RDM. The bulk e-m duality translates into a Kramers--Wannier self-duality of the SW-SSB phase. Extending the framework to gapped Z₂ spin liquids, the global spin-rotation symmetry manifests as an additional weak symmetry for the 1D RDM. Spin-frac12 spinons result in a cusp on the disorder parameter of spin-rotation at θ=π, providing a direct, ground-state signature of symmetry fractionalization. We verify this prediction analytically using the matrix product density operator formalism and numerically for the kagome-lattice resonating valence bond state. The proposed observable requires only a single ground-state wavefunction, making it amenable to quantum simulation platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨如何仅由单个基态探测二维拓扑相，强调约化密度矩阵本身包含超越纠缠熵和纠缠谱的信息。作者指出，二维拓扑有序体系在纠缠切口处的约化密度矩阵可实现一维混合态相；在 Z₂ toric code 相中，它对应一维 Z₂ 强到弱自发对称性破缺相，任意子的去禁闭表现为约化密度矩阵中电荷和畴壁的短程关联。进一步推广到有能隙 Z₂ 自旋液体时，自旋旋转对称性分数化会在 θ=π 处的无序参数中产生尖点，为基态中识别对称性分数化提供直接信号。作者用矩阵乘积密度算符解析验证，并在 kagome 晶格共振价键态中进行了数值检验。
authors: Yunlong Zang, Yu-Bin Li, Shenghan Jiang

articles.title: Structural Changes and Transport Properties of YBa₂Cu₃O₇ Locally Modified by a He⁺ Focused Ion Beam
articles.title_zh: He⁺聚焦离子束局域改性 YBa₂Cu₃O₇ 的结构变化与输运性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12145v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Irradiation of a material with ions can cause various defects that can lead to structural phase transitions and the modification of the material's properties. Here we study the irradiation of the epitaxyally grown thin films of the high-temperature superconductor YBa₂Cu₃O₇ with 30,keV He⁺ ions which leads to the expansion of the crystal lattice, decrease of the critical temperature T_c and eventually transition to an insulator. Fabrication of such insulating regions with a focused He-Ion beam with a spot size of sim 10,nm is a powerful technique for fabrication of superconducting nano-devices. Using low-temperature resistivity measurements, diffraction with a nanofocused X-ray beam and atomic force microscopy, we investigated how the structure and the electric transport properties of YBa₂Cu₃O₇ depend on the irradiation dose in a range 10--100,ions/nm² and on the lateral size of the irradiated area in a range 30--5000,nm.
articles.abstract_zh: 离子辐照可在材料中引入缺陷，从而诱发结构相变并调控材料性质。该工作研究 30 keV He⁺ 离子辐照外延生长的高温超导薄膜 YBa₂Cu₃O₇，发现其会导致晶格膨胀、临界温度降低，并最终转变为绝缘体。利用低温电阻率测量、纳米聚焦 X 射线衍射和原子力显微镜，作者系统考察了结构与电输运性质随辐照剂量及辐照区域横向尺寸的变化。该技术可用于以约 10 nm 尺度制备超导纳米器件中的绝缘区域。
authors: Ross Carter, Robin Hutt, Paul Zimmermann, Ainur Abukaev, Jan Ullmann, Simon Koch, Christoph Schmid, Manfred Burghammer, Reinhold Kleiner, Dieter Koelle, Edward Goldobin, Ivan A. Zaluzhnyy

articles.title: Experimental straintronics in nanotube quantum dots
articles.title_zh: 纳米管量子点中的实验应变电子学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12180v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Single-wall carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) are narrow ribbons of graphene with atomically precise edges and a single quantum transport channel, at experimentally-relevant dopings. This makes them ideal systems to harness quantum transport straintronics (QTS), i.e. using mechanical strain to control accurately quantum transport. We present QTS data from three single-wall carbon nanotube quantum dot (SWCNT-QD) transistors over a broad range of in-situ tunable and reversible uniaxial strain (Δǎrepsilonₘₑchapprox 0 to 3 %). We first present the nanofabrication of the suspended SWCNT transistors whose channel lengths are approx 30 nm. The channels are strained by moving gold clamps holding firmly the nanotubes. We present detailed charge transport data, dI/dVB - VB - VG and dI/dVB - VB - Δǎrepsilonₘₑch, showing a large mechanical-gating effect of the SWCNT-QDs. The precise reversibility of the data, and their agreement with QTS theory, confirms that the tubes are strained elastically. We demonstrate that the mechanical control of the QD doping is not due to capacitive-gating effects, but to quantitatively predictable bandstructure changes including a strain-tunable bandgap. This precise mechanical control of the doping and bandgap of SWCNT-QDs could find applications in qubits, condensed matter physics, and homojunction molecular transistors.
articles.abstract_zh: 单壁碳纳米管可视为具有原子级精确边界的窄石墨烯带，在实验相关掺杂下具有单一量子输运通道，因而适合利用机械应变精确控制量子输运。该工作报道了三个单壁碳纳米管量子点晶体管在可原位调谐、可逆单轴应变范围内的量子输运应变电子学实验数据。作者展示了悬空纳米管晶体管的纳米加工方法，并通过移动金夹具对约 30 nm 通道施加应变，观测到显著的机械栅控效应。数据的高度可逆性及其与理论一致性表明纳米管处于弹性应变状态，且量子点掺杂的机械控制主要源于能带结构变化而非电容栅控效应。
authors: L. Huang, I. G. Rebollo, A. R. Champagne

articles.title: Quantum dynamic simulation of triplet formation in an effective model of Y6 (BTP-4F)
articles.title_zh: Y6（BTP-4F）有效模型中三重态形成的量子动力学模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12221v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct a five-state model for photoexcitation in Y6 (BTP-4F) dimers, and then solve the non-adiabtic dynamics using the Hierarchical Equations of Motion (HEOM) method. We find that triplets are populated mainly via a transiently excited intermolecular charge-transfer singlet to triplet Frenkel exciton route; this route is not available to the monomer. Analysis of one-particle transition density matrices suggests that the charge-transfer states are spatially distinct to the Frenkel exciton states, indicating that the large spin-orbit-coupling for this transition is due to it being permitted by an associated change in orbital character. Aggregation in Y6 therefore directly enables fast and high-yield intersystem crossing. We selenise our model dimers, significantly enhancing spin-orbit-coupling, which then accelerates this charge-transfer mediated route. Looking forwards to simulations on larger aggregates, we show that, though Marcus theory gives qualitatively correct dynamics, the long-time yields are incorrect due to it missing quantum recurrences. Instead, we show that the recently developed memory-kernel projectori̧teGestsson2025-ez method can produce semi-classical rates directly from the HEOM equations which lead to quantitatively correct dynamics and yields.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作构建了 Y6（BTP-4F）二聚体光激发过程的五态模型，并采用分层运动方程方法求解非绝热动力学。研究发现，三重态主要通过瞬态激发的分子间电荷转移单重态到三重 Frenkel 激子的路径形成，而该路径在单体中不存在。单粒子跃迁密度矩阵分析表明，电荷转移态与 Frenkel 激子态在空间上不同，相关轨道性质变化允许较强自旋轨道耦合。结果说明 Y6 的聚集可直接促进快速且高产率的系间窜越，硒化模型二聚体还可进一步增强该电荷转移介导路径。
authors: Isabel Creed, Lucy J. F. Hart, Pranay Venkatesh, Tom Ward, Jarvist Moore Frost

articles.title: Enhanced localization length in a disordered one-dimensional band via cavity coupling to delocalized states
articles.title_zh: 通过腔耦合离域态增强无序一维能带中的局域长度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12224v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the localization properties of cavity-coupled electronic states in disordered systems, motivated by recent proposals of cavity-mediated hopping in quantum Hall systems. We first introduce a minimal two-band model in which localized states in a disordered one-dimensional band are coupled, through a homogeneous cavity mode, to an excited band of delocalized states. Combining perturbation theory with a transfer-matrix approach, we show that cavity-assisted hopping between localized states decays exponentially with distance, implying that the eigenstates remain localized even beyond the perturbative regime. Nevertheless, the corresponding localization length increases with the light-matter coupling strength and can extend over several lattice sites in the single-electron ultrastrong-coupling regime. We then study a disordered Landau band coupled to a cavity mode within the framework developed in Refs.[1,2]. We find that the effective cavity-mediated coupling between edge states also decays exponentially with distance, but with a localization length that can reach micrometer scales for experimentally realistic parameters. By analyzing the inverse participation ratio, we show that this enhanced coupling is predominantly mediated by the most extended states of the upper Landau band. Our results demonstrate that, while cavity-induced hopping in disordered quantum Hall systems remains exponentially localized, the associated localization length can become sufficiently large for the corresponding states to exhibit effectively delocalized behavior on mesoscopic length scales.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究受量子霍尔体系中腔介导跃迁方案启发，考察无序体系中与光腔耦合的电子态局域性质。作者提出一个最小双能带模型，其中无序一维能带中的局域态通过均匀腔模与激发能带中的离域态耦合。结合微扰理论和转移矩阵方法，研究表明腔辅助的局域态间跃迁随距离指数衰减，因此即使超出微扰区间本征态仍保持局域。尽管如此，局域长度会随光物质耦合增强而增大，在单电子超强耦合区可扩展到多个晶格位点；对无序 Landau 能带的分析还显示，边缘态间腔介导耦合也呈指数衰减，但在现实参数下局域长度可达微米尺度。
authors: Francesco Mattiotti, Guido Pupillo, Jérôme Dubail, David Hagenmüller
